article_content: The old saying in football warned against signing players just because they had a good World Cup, since many clubs have been misled by outstanding performances over only a few matches. Yet, some players do seem to mature rapidly in the spotlight, showing that they can handle intense pressure. Marcos Rojo is one such example. Before the World Cup, the 24-year-old Sporting defender was widely seen as a weak point in the Argentina squad, especially by the national press, who doubted his inclusion in the starting lineup. Many believed he was chosen only due to a lack of alternatives. As the tournament went on, however, Rojo established himself, winning praise from both fans and the media. He showcased some flair, such as clearing the ball in the penalty area with a rabona against Bosnia. He also scored the third and winning goal against Nigeria, albeit luckily as the ball bounced off his knee following a corner. Rojo’s confidence grew further: he nutmegged Arjen Robben in the semi-final and performed well in the final against Germany. At Sporting, Rojo usually played as a central defender, which has reportedly attracted Louis van Gaal’s interest for a possible role as a left-sided player in a back three or as a left wing-back. According to FIFA statistics, Rojo’s top speed in the semi-final against the Netherlands was recorded as faster than Robben's. Rojo was born in La Plata, around 45 miles from Buenos Aires, and came up through the ranks at Estudiantes La Plata, the club closely associated with former Manchester United midfielder Juan Sebastian Veron. Rojo and Veron were teammates at Estudiantes when Rojo began his career, with Veron having returned to his hometown club. After a short spell at Spartak Moscow, Rojo signed for Sporting two years ago.

Ipak, neki igrači zaista sazrijevaju pod pritiskom reflektora i pokazuju da mogu podnijeti najveći pritisak – Marcos Rojo je jedan od takvih primjera. Prije Svjetskog prvenstva, 24-godišnji defanzivac Sportinga bio je često smatran najslabijom karikom Argentine, posebno u nacionalnim medijima koji su sumnjali u njegov izbor u prvi tim. article_content: Bahrain's ambassador to France, Nasser Al-Belooshi, is being investigated by French prosecutors following allegations of sexual assault made by a former employee, French authorities said on Thursday. Marie-Josephine Marchal, press officer for the Nanterre prosecutor's office, confirmed that a formal complaint was filed against Al-Belooshi on Monday. According to the Bahrain News Agency, Al-Belooshi has strongly denied the accusations, describing them as inaccurate and unfounded. The agency reported that the ambassador remains available to French authorities to clarify the situation. On Tuesday, French Foreign Ministry spokesperson Bernard Valero acknowledged the case without naming the ambassador or his country, and mentioned news reports suggesting that the ambassador's wife and son are also under suspicion. Valero noted that both the ambassador and his wife have diplomatic immunity, while their son does not.

Marie-Josephine Marchal, službenica za štampu tužilaštva u Nanterreu, potvrdila je da je protiv Al-Belooshiya u ponedjeljak podnesena zvanična prijava. Prema Bahreinskoj novinskoj agenciji, Al-Belooshi je snažno negirao optužbe, opisujući ih kao netačne i neutemeljene. Agencija je saopćila da je ambasador dostupan francuskim vlastima kako bi razjasnio situaciju. U utorak je portparol francuskog Ministarstva vanjskih poslova Bernard Valero priznao postojanje slučaja, bez navođenja imena ambasadora ili zemlje, te je spomenuo izvještaje koji sugerišu da su i ambasadorova supruga i sin pod istragom. Valero je naveo da i ambasador i njegova supruga imaju diplomatski imunitet, dok ga njihov sin nema.

article_content: At the 12th Africa International Film Festival (AFRIFF), 'Funmilayo Ransome-Kuti,' directed by renowned filmmaker Bolanle Austen-Peters and penned by Tunde Babalola, earned two major accolades: Best Overall Feature Film and Best Screenplay. AFRIFF, an event celebrating excellence in African and international filmmaking, honored the film for its compelling portrayal of Funmilayo Ransome-Kuti's extraordinary life. The narrative traces FRK’s journey, from breaking barriers as the first female student at Abeokuta Grammar School in Ogun State, to her marriage to Israel Ransome-Kuti and their founding of the Abeokuta Women’s Union. Their partnership sparked a courageous movement challenging colonial and traditional powers. The film also explores how Funmilayo balanced her relentless activism with her roles as wife and mother to Fela Kuti, the legendary Afrobeat musician. Leading actors in the movie include Joke Silva, Kehinde Bankole, Ibrahim Suleiman, Jide Kosoko, Dele Odule, Adebayo Salami, and Keppy Ekpenyong. Additionally, it was under consideration as Nigeria’s Oscar submission by the National Selection Committee.

AFRIFF, manifestacija koja slavi izvrsnost afričke i svjetske kinematografije, nagradila je film zbog snažnog prikaza izuzetnog života Funmilayo Ransome-Kuti. Radnja prati FRK od njenih pionirskih dana kao prve učenice žene u Gimnaziji Abeokuta u državi Ogun, preko braka s Israelom Ransome-Kutijem do osnivanja Udruženja žena Abeokute. Njihovo zajedništvo pokrenulo je hrabru borbu protiv kolonijalne i tradicionalne vlasti. Film također prikazuje kako je Funmilayo usklađivala svoju snažnu borbu za prava žena sa ulozima supruge i majke legendarnog muzičara Fela Kutija. Glavne uloge u filmu tumače Joke Silva, Kehinde Bankole, Ibrahim Suleiman, Jide Kosoko, Dele Odule, Adebayo Salami i Keppy Ekpenyong. Film je bio razmatran i kao mogući nigerijski kandidat za Oskara u izboru Nacionalnog selekcionog komiteta.

article_content: Starting next month, nearly half a million women in England will be able to obtain the contraceptive pill directly from pharmacies without needing a GP appointment. The Pharmacy First scheme will also allow pharmacists to provide treatments for urinary infections and several other common conditions. NHS England described this initiative as a safe and sensible way to make NHS services more accessible. However, some pharmacy organizations have raised concerns about closures of community pharmacies due to insufficient funding. Victoria Atkins, the new Health and Social Care Secretary, said these changes offer 'more options for women when choosing their preferred contraception' and would also help free up GP appointments. The scheme, originally announced in May as part of England’s primary-care plan, brings the country in line with Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland, where similar services already exist. From February, pharmacists who enroll in the scheme will be able to offer advice and treatments, including antibiotics, for seven common conditions. NHS England also plans to provide more blood-pressure checks, aiming for over two million by 2025. It is estimated that, as thousands of pharmacies join the program, more than 1,000 heart attacks and strokes could be prevented. The goal is to free up 10 million GP appointments each year. Pharmacies joining the scheme will receive an upfront fee of £2,000 and additional payments per consultation. Industry experts expect most pharmacies to participate, though a few may opt out. Patients in those areas will have to visit another pharmacy or see a GP for these services. Dr. Claire Fuller, NHS primary-care medical director, expressed her support, stating she was 'delighted' that people would have more convenient ways to access treatments, and called the step significant for women's healthcare. Tase Oputu, chair of the Royal Pharmaceutical Society's English Pharmacy Board, also welcomed the ability of pharmacy teams to manage the seven common conditions. Nevertheless, some pharmacists expressed caution. Dr. Leyla Hannbeck, chief executive of the Association of Independent Multiple Pharmacies, called the scheme 'a step in the right direction for patient care,' but said its success depends on reducing bureaucracy and proper compensation for pharmacists’ time. She noted that years of underfunding and rising costs have caused pharmacies to close at a concerning rate across the UK. High Street chemists also noted the challenge of quickly training staff and launching additional services early in 2024 while managing a growing workload. Dr. Hannbeck commented, 'We want to do it and will do it—but this will be difficult.'

Program Pharmacy First također će omogućiti farmaceutima da pružaju tretmane za urinarne infekcije i nekoliko drugih uobičajenih zdravstvenih problema. NHS England opisuje ovu inicijativu kao siguran i razuman način da se zdravstvene usluge učine dostupnijima. Ipak, neke farmaceutske organizacije izražavaju zabrinutost zbog zatvaranja apoteka u zajednicama, uzrokovanih nedostatkom finansiranja. Victoria Atkins, nova ministrica zdravstva i socijalne zaštite, izjavila je da ove promjene ženama nude 'više opcija pri izboru željene kontracepcije' i da će također pomoći rasteretiti termine kod ljekara opće prakse. Program, koji je prvobitno najavljen u maju kao dio plana primarne zdravstvene zaštite za Englesku, dovodi zemlju u sklad sa Škotskom, Velsom i Sjevernom Irskom gdje slične usluge već postoje. Od februara, farmaceuti koji pristupe programu moći će nuditi savjetovanje i terapije, uključujući antibiotike, za sedam uobičajenih zdravstvenih stanja. Procjenjuje se da bi, kada se hiljade apoteka priključe programu, moglo biti spriječeno više od 1.000 srčanih i moždanih udara. Cilj je rasteretiti do 10 miliona termina kod ljekara opće prakse svake godine. Apoteke koje se priključe programu dobit će početnu naknadu od £2.000 te dodatne uplate po konsultaciji. Očekuje se da će se većina apoteka priključiti programu, iako će neke možda i odustati. Pacijenti u tim područjima morat će otići u drugu apoteku ili kod ljekara opće prakse za ove usluge. Dr. Claire Fuller, medicinska direktorica primarne zdravstvene zaštite NHS-a, izrazila je podršku rekavši da je 'oduševljena' mogućnostima koje omogućuju ljudima lakši pristup terapijama i ocijenila ovaj korak značajnim za zdravlje žena. Tase Oputu, predsjednica Engleskog farmaceutskog odbora Kraljevskog farmaceutskog društva, također pozdravlja mogućnost liječenja sedam čestih stanja u zajedničkim apotekama. Ipak, neki farmaceuti su oprezni. Dr. Leyla Hannbeck, direktorica Udruženja nezavisnih lanaca apoteka, naziva ovaj program 'korakom u pravom smjeru za brigu o pacijentima', ali ističe da uspjeh zavisi od smanjenja birokratije i adekvatne naknade za rad farmaceuta. Navodi da su godine nedovoljnog finansiranja i rastućih troškova dovele do zabrinjavajućeg broja zatvaranja apoteka širom UK. Farmaceuti s High Streeta ističu izazov brze edukacije osoblja i pokretanja novih usluga početkom 2024, dok se suočavaju s rastućim obimom posla. Dr. Hannbeck je izjavila: 'Želimo to uraditi i uradićemo - ali biće teško.'

article_content: Republican Congresswoman Nancy Mace from South Carolina has faced criticism within her party following her vote to remove Kevin McCarthy as Speaker of the House. More recently, she endorsed Jim Jordan, a leading Ohio Republican known for his alignment with the MAGA movement. Jordan has been the subject of longstanding allegations that he failed to address reports of sexual abuse during his time as a coach at Ohio State University. Despite the widespread coverage, Mace stated in a conversation with Margaret Brennan that she was unaware of these claims and pointed out that Jordan has not been charged. While Mace identifies as an advocate for sexual assault victims, she declined to provide further comment on the matter due to her asserted lack of knowledge about the allegations. Analysts note that her support for Jordan could be influenced by former President Donald Trump's backing of his candidacy and her own recent fundraising challenges.

MUMBAI: Technology investor Prosus NV announced on Wednesday that it now values Indian education technology firm Byju's at less than USD 3 billion—an 86% drop from the company's peak valuation of USD 22 billion just last year. The latest cut comes amid Byju's ongoing governance challenges and cash-flow issues. Interim CEO Ervin Tu revealed this information during a Prosus earnings call.

This significant devaluation follows the resignation of several Byju's executives and board members, as well as a one-year delay in filing its 2021/22 financial results. In the past year, Byju's shareholders including Prosus and Blackrock have progressively reduced their valuation estimates: to USD 11 billion in March, USD 8 billion in May, and USD 5 billion in June.

Although Prosus did not specify a reason for this further reduction, it had previously criticized Byju's management for frequently disregarding governance advice. Byju's has investors such as General Atlantic and Silver Lake. The company has delayed releasing its financial results, a situation that led to auditor Deloitte and three board members resigning in June. In the past week, both the Chief Financial Officer and Chief Technology Officer have also left the company.

Byju's recently submitted the long-overdue, but still incomplete, financial results and is now considering selling entire business lines to raise much-needed cash.

Najnovije smanjenje vrijednosti dolazi usred stalnih problema Byju'sa s upravljanjem i novčanim tokom. Privremeni izvršni direktor Ervin Tu otkrio je ovu informaciju tokom Prosusove konferencije o zaradi.

Ova značajna devalvacija dešava se nakon što je nekoliko izvršnih direktora i članova uprave Byju'sa podnijelo ostavke, kao i zbog jednogodišnjeg kašnjenja u podnošenju finansijskog izvještaja za 2021/22. godinu. Tokom protekle godine, dioničari Byju'sa, uključujući Prosus i Blackrock, postepeno su smanjivali svoje procjene vrijednosti: na 11 milijardi dolara u martu, 8 milijardi u maju i 5 milijardi u junu.

Iako Prosus nije naveo konkretan razlog za dodatno smanjenje vrijednosti, ranije su kritikovali upravu Byju'sa zbog čestog ignorisanja savjeta za poboljšanje korporativnog upravljanja. Byju's ima investitore poput General Atlantic i Silver Lake. Kompanija je kasnila s objavom finansijskih rezultata, što je dovelo do ostavke revizorske kuće Deloitte i tri člana uprave u junu. article_content: The Conservative Party has regained a slim lead over Labour in the latest polls, just eight months ahead of the general election scheduled for May. According to research by Ipsos MORI, 34% of voters who are certain to participate support the Conservatives, while 33% back Labour. UKIP holds 15%, and the Liberal Democrats 7%. This represents the first Conservative poll lead in Ipsos MORI surveys since December 2011. Despite the headline lead, the difference is minimal—equivalent to just three voters out of more than 1,000 surveyed—effectively putting the main parties neck-and-neck. Nigel Farage’s UKIP has also seen improved perceptions; those who consider a vote for UKIP to be 'wasted' has dropped from 57% in May to 50%. Additionally, 53% feel UKIP is raising important issues not being addressed by other parties, and 14% of respondents expressed interest in their MP switching to UKIP. The dominance of the three main parties has weakened, with only 74% supporting one of them, down from 90% as recently as 2010. Optimism about the economy has declined as well, with positive expectations dropping from 51% to 45%. Nick Clegg remains the most unpopular political leader, while Prime Minister David Cameron holds the highest satisfaction rating among the major party leaders, second only to UKIP’s Nigel Farage. Cameron’s net satisfaction stands at -15% (39% satisfied, 54% dissatisfied), Clegg at -45% (21% satisfied, 66% dissatisfied), Ed Miliband at -29% (29% satisfied, 58% dissatisfied), and Farage at -5%. Gideon Skinner, Head of Political Research at Ipsos MORI, said: 'Only 74% of voters with a preference are choosing one of the three main parties. History tells us that is unusually low, a drop from nine in 10 in 2010. Essentially, one in four voters is choosing a party outside the main three, underscoring the challenges they all face—with UKIP as the main beneficiaries.'

Ovo je prvo vodstvo Konzervativaca u Ipsos MORI anketama od decembra 2011. Iako su Konzervativci na vrhu, razlika je minimalna – odgovara samo trojici birača od više od 1.000 anketiranih – što znači da su glavne stranke praktično izjednačene. UKIP Nigela Faragea također bilježi pozitivniju percepciju; udio onih koji smatraju da je glasanje za UKIP 'bačen glas' pao je sa 57% u maju na 50%. Dodatno, 53% smatra da UKIP iznosi važne teme koje druge stranke ne obrađuju, a 14% ispitanika željelo bi da njihov poslanik pređe u UKIP. Dominacija tri glavne stranke je oslabljena, jer ih sada podržava samo 74% birača, što je pad sa 90% iz 2010. Optimizam u vezi s ekonomijom također opada—pozitivna očekivanja pala su sa 51% na 45%. Nick Clegg ostaje najnepopularniji politički lider, dok premijer David Cameron ima najviši rejting zadovoljstva među liderima, odmah iza Nigela Faragea iz UKIP-a. Gideon Skinner, šef političkih istraživanja u Ipsos MORI-ju, izjavio je: 'Samo 74% birača koji imaju preferencu bira jednu od tri glavne stranke. Istorija nam pokazuje da je to neuobičajeno nisko, što je pad sa skoro 90% u 2010. Drugim riječima, svaki četvrti birač daje glas stranci izvan glavne trojke, što naglašava izazove s kojima se sve one suočavaju—dok je UKIP glavni dobitnik.'

article_content: A recent study examined the tone and content of the 70 most-watched alcohol-related videos on YouTube, finding that the platform commonly showcases drinking as entertaining, with little focus on its risks. The research, conducted by the University of Pittsburgh, focused on videos found using terms like 'drunk', 'buzzed', 'hammered', 'tipsy', and 'trashed'. The analysis revealed that these videos mostly featured young men, portrayed drinking as humorous, and often promoted specific alcohol brands—55 brands appeared in 44% of the content. On average, each video lasted about four minutes, together surpassing one-third of a billion views. While 86% of the videos highlighted active intoxication, only a small portion (7%) addressed issues like alcohol dependence or withdrawal. Clips that used humor or showcased attractive people and brands received more likes and positive feedback, while those showing the negative effects, such as injuries, tended to be less popular. Hard liquor was more commonly depicted than beer, which researchers found surprising since beer is the drink of choice for most Americans. The study's authors suggest the higher alcohol content of spirits and wine might appeal more to audiences looking for sensational content. The findings, published in the journal Alcoholism: Clinical & Experimental Research, suggest that YouTube could play a significant role in shaping viewers' attitudes and behaviors toward drinking, potentially normalizing heavy or risky alcohol use.
translated_content: Nedavna studija analizirala je sadržaj i ton 70 najgledanijih videa o alkoholu na YouTubeu, otkrivši da ova platforma često prikazuje konzumiranje alkohola kao zabavno, s malim naglaskom na rizike. Istraživanje je proveo Univerzitet u Pittsburghu, fokusirajući se na videe pronađene pojmovima poput ‘drunk’, ‘buzzed’, ‘hammered’, ‘tipsy’ i ‘trashed’. Analiza je pokazala da su ti videi uglavnom prikazivali mlađe muškarce, konzumaciju alkohola predstavljali kroz humor i često promovisali određene brendove alkohola—55 marki pojavilo se u 44% sadržaja. U prosjeku, svaki video trajao je oko četiri minute, a ukupno su pregledani više od trećine milijarde puta. Iako je u 86% videa prikazano aktivno opijanje, samo manji dio (7%) odnosio se na probleme ovisnosti ili simptome povlačenja. Klipovi sa humorom ili atraktivnim osobama i brendovima dobijali su više lajkova i pozitivnih reakcija, dok su oni koji su prikazivali negativne posljedice, poput povreda, bili manje popularni. Žestoka pića su češće prikazivana od piva, što je iznenadilo istraživače jer je pivo najčešći izbor u SAD-u. Autori studije smatraju da veći udio alkohola u žestokim pićima i vinu privlači publiku koja traži senzacionalan sadržaj. Nalazi, objavljeni u časopisu Alcoholism: Clinical & Experimental Research, sugerišu da YouTube može znatno uticati na stavove i ponašanje gledalaca prema alkoholu, i potencijalno normalizirati prekomjerno ili rizično pijenje.

article_content: Coronato Pizza in Carrboro, North Carolina, closed permanently over problems with secondhand cigar smoke coming from the neighboring Oasis Cigar Lounge. The restaurant’s owner and chef, Teddy Diggs, explained that since Oasis opened in August 2022, smoke began invading his restaurant, causing headaches and irritation for staff and guests. Diggs reached out multiple times to both the cigar bar and the property’s landlord but said their responses were not enough. He hired a consultant to test air quality in January 2023, which revealed unhealthy levels of secondhand smoke—specifically, nicotine concentrations similar to those found in homes with smokers. These results led Diggs to close Coronato’s dining room in February, opting for takeout only to prioritize health, even though it created financial distress like during the COVID-19 pandemic. By April, Diggs sued both Oasis and the landlord for not stopping the smoke intrusion. Oasis Cigar Lounge responded that they’d made significant investments in air purification. The shopping center owner said they installed commercial air cleaners, carbon filters, and an ozone generator after complaints. Diggs, however, maintained that these measures didn’t resolve the issue. A North Carolina Department of Health consultant confirmed a distinct cigar smoke odor during a site visit in August 2023. With no resolution in sight, Diggs announced the restaurant’s permanent closure, saying he did everything possible as a neighbor and tenant before resorting to legal action. Oasis Cigar Lounge left the shopping center in early October. Speaking to reporters, the lounge’s representatives described being sued as bullying and suggested the dispute involved racial bias against their Black-owned business. Diggs denied bullying or discrimination, stressing his priority was keeping smoke out of his restaurant. According to Diggs, other tenants also struggled with smoke complaints, while Oasis Cigar Lounge did not answer repeated press inquiries.

article_content: No country is immune to the impact of climate change, but it is the world’s poorest nations that will be affected most severely. Achieving a fair and inclusive global agreement to combat climate change is a moral obligation. Time is running out for Africa. Today, world leaders are gathering in New York for the Climate Summit in an effort to reinvigorate climate negotiations, now in their 21st round. With the Kyoto Protocol’s deadline approaching, it remains to be seen how much international support Africa can secure for its agenda. Effective leadership is essential. Politicians must think beyond their own terms. Countries should act beyond their national interests. The world needs a radical shift in how it produces and uses energy. However, with China and India—who together are responsible for nearly a third of global emissions—choosing not to attend, it will be challenging for the Summit to reach its full potential. In the absence of China and India, small, developing nations must unite. These nations bear the greatest burden of climate change. Waiting for large powers to act in the interest of humanity is no longer a viable option. All countries, regardless of their development stage, must take steps to reduce their own CO2 emissions. Preventing further global warming and reversing current trends are crucial. We must also address and mitigate the effects of climate change that are already being felt worldwide. There is no doubt that climate change threatens to stall Africa's impressive growth and compromise socio-economic progress made over the last decade. Africa relies heavily on climate-sensitive sectors such as agriculture, fishing, and tourism. Agriculture alone makes up 30% of Africa’s GDP and represents 50% of the continent’s exports, with 96% of agriculture rain-fed. Even if current pledges to limit emissions by 2020 are fulfilled, global temperatures are still predicted to rise by 3.5 to 4 degrees Celsius by 2100. This could result in a 30% reduction in rainfall in sub-Saharan Africa, which would be disastrous for the continent. Persistent drought and flooding are already worsening food and water insecurity, threatening both livelihoods and health. Severe droughts in the Horn of Africa and the Sahel between 2011 and 2012 led to crop failures and livestock deaths, leaving 13 million people in need of humanitarian aid. Africa’s ability to manage the links between food production, water, and energy will determine how many millions can escape poverty in the coming decades. Nothing less than a climate-smart agricultural revolution is needed to secure food security. Water management strategies must be developed to protect and rehabilitate groundwater sources and river basins. The energy sector should prioritize clean and renewable energy. African governments and business leaders need to invest significantly in science and technology to support mitigation and adaptation efforts. While international assistance is important, effective and sustainable solutions must be developed locally. Developing countries have the chance to set a better example. Partnerships must be established to share technology and best practices. National self-interest must be set aside, as climate change knows no borders. If emerging economies focus only on growth, future generations will inherit a grave problem. There is ample evidence that the cost of inaction on climate change will outweigh the investment needed to address it. For the first time, however, Africa is becoming proactive in tackling climate change, empowering people, and strengthening institutions. The continent’s impressive growth—driven by an export boom, better governance, and increased foreign investment—supports the 'Africa Rising' narrative. By 2050, Africans will make up a quarter of the world’s population, with 60% living in cities. Africa is poised for transformation. Policymakers are developing ambitious initiatives for clean and green economies. Partnerships among government, the private sector, and civil society are accelerating implementation of national climate plans. In the absence of strong leadership from the world’s largest emitters, small, developing nations must ensure their interests are represented before time runs out. Ahead of next year’s U.N. Climate Change Conference in Paris, which will set a new agenda to replace the Kyoto Protocol, it is essential that African countries make their voices not only heard, but influential.
translated_content: Nijedna zemlja nije imuna na uticaj klimatskih promjena, ali najsiromašnije zemlje svijeta će biti pogođene najteže. Postizanje poštenog i inkluzivnog globalnog sporazuma o borbi protiv klimatskih promjena je moralna obaveza. Vrijeme ističe za Afriku. Danas se svjetski lideri okupljaju u New Yorku na Klimatskom samitu kako bi ponovo pokrenuli klimatske pregovore, koji su sada u svojoj 21. rundi. S obzirom na to da se rok iz Kjoto protokola bliži kraju, ostaje da se vidi koliko međunarodne podrške Afrika može osigurati za svoju agendu. Efikasno liderstvo je ključno. Političari moraju razmišljati izvan vlastitih mandata. Zemlje bi trebale djelovati izvan svojih nacionalnih interesa. Svijetu je potrebna radikalna promjena u načinu kako proizvodi i koristi energiju. Međutim, pošto Kina i Indija—koje zajedno čine skoro trećinu globalnih emisija—ne prisustvuju samitu, teško će biti da samit ostvari svoj puni potencijal. U odsustvu Kine i Indije, male zemlje u razvoju moraju se udružiti. Upravo te zemlje najviše snose teret klimatskih promjena. Više nije održivo čekati da velike sile djeluju u općem interesu čovječanstva. Sve zemlje, bez obzira na stepen razvoja, moraju preduzeti mjere za smanjenje svojih CO2 emisija. Sprečavanje daljeg globalnog zagrijavanja i preokretanje trenutnih trendova je ključno. Takođe moramo ublažiti i već prisutne efekte klimatskih promjena širom svijeta. Nema sumnje da klimatske promjene prijete da uspore impresivan rast Afrike i ugroze socio-ekonomski napredak ostvaren u posljednjoj deceniji. Afrika se u velikoj mjeri oslanja na sektore osjetljive na klimatske promjene kao što su poljoprivreda, ribarstvo i turizam. Samo poljoprivreda čini 30% BDP-a Afrike i predstavlja 50% izvoza kontinenta, u 96% slučajeva oslonjena na padavine. Čak i ako se ispune trenutna obećanja o ograničavanju emisija do 2020. godine, prognozira se da će globalne temperature porasti za 3,5 do 4 stepena Celzijusa do 2100. godine. To bi moglo dovesti do smanjenja padavina za 30% u podsaharskoj Africi, što bi bilo pogubno za kontinent. Uporne suše i poplave već pogoršavaju nesigurnost u vezi sa hranom i vodom, ugrožavajući egzistenciju i zdravlje ljudi. Teške suše na Rogu Afrike i u Sahelu između 2011. i 2012. dovele su do propadanja usjeva i uginuća stoke, ostavljajući 13 miliona ljudi kojima je bila potrebna humanitarna pomoć. Sposobnost Afrike da upravlja vezama između proizvodnje hrane, vode i energije odredit će koliko miliona ljudi može izaći iz siromaštva u narednim decenijama. Ništa manje od pametne poljoprivredne revolucije prilagođene klimi nije dovoljno za osiguranje prehrambene sigurnosti. Strategije upravljanja vodama moraju se razviti kako bi zaštitile i obnovile podzemne izvore i riječne slivove. Energetski sektor treba davati prioritet čistim i obnovljivim izvorima energije. Afričke vlade i privredni lideri trebaju značajno ulagati u nauku i tehnologiju radi ublažavanja i prilagođavanja klimatskim promjenama. Iako je međunarodna pomoć važna, efikasna i održiva rješenja moraju se razvijati lokalno. Zemlje u razvoju imaju priliku da pokažu bolji primjer. Moraju se uspostaviti partnerstva radi razmjene tehnologija i najboljih praksi. Nacionalni interesi moraju biti stavljeni po strani jer klimatske promjene ne poznaju granice. Ako ekonomije u razvoju budu fokusirane samo na rast, buduće generacije će naslijediti ozbiljan problem. Postoje brojni dokazi da će trošak nepreduzimanja mjera protiv klimatskih promjena biti veći od ulaganja potrebnih za rješavanje tog pitanja. Prvi put, međutim, Afrika je preuzela proaktivnu ulogu u borbi protiv klimatskih promjena, osnažujući ljude i jačajući institucije. Impresivan rast kontinenta—potaknut izvozom, boljim upravljanjem i povećanim stranim investicijama—podupire narativ 'Afrika u usponu'. Do 2050. Afrikanci će činiti četvrtinu svjetske populacije, a 60% njih će živjeti u gradovima. Afrika je na pragu transformacije. Donosioci odluka razvijaju ambiciozne politike za čiste i zelene ekonomije. Partnerstva između vlada, privatnog sektora i civilnog društva ubrzavaju provođenje nacionalnih klimatskih planova. U nedostatku snažnog globalnog liderstva najvećih zagađivača, male zemlje u razvoju moraju osigurati da su njihovi interesi zastupljeni prije nego što bude prekasno. Predstojeća UN Konferencija o klimatskim promjenama u Parizu, koja će zamijeniti Kjoto protokol, čini izuzetno važnim da afričke zemlje ne samo da podignu svoj glas, već da postanu uticajne.

article_content: Israeli forces launched overnight raids across the occupied West Bank, detaining numerous people and killing two individuals at the Jalazone refugee camp near Ramallah, according to the Palestinian Ministry of Health. Residents told Reuters that Israeli troops entered the camp, made several arrests, and clashed with both armed men and youths who threw stones. The Health Ministry stated around 20 people were detained. Following the raid, Israeli forces reportedly withdrew to the camp's outskirts. The Israeli army has not yet commented on these incidents. Palestinian news agency Wafa reported at least 120 Palestinians were arrested in the West Bank overnight, including 59 in Hebron. Among them, 40 were workers from the Gaza Strip. In Europe, EU foreign policy chief Josep Borrell urged for quicker aid to Gaza, announcing the bloc's 27 foreign ministers would consider calling for a 'humanitarian pause' to facilitate aid deliveries. Borrell highlighted the massive displacement in Gaza, noting that half the population has had to flee their homes. Norwegian Justice Minister Emilie Enger Mehl strongly condemned attacks on civilians. She said Norway stands ready to contribute resources to any investigation of possible war crimes in Gaza and Israel, should the country receive a request. Mehl emphasized that war crimes must never be justified and that civilians in conflicts deserve special protection. More than 19,600 people have left villages in southern Lebanon due to cross-border fire between Hezbollah and Israel, according to the UN's International Organisation for Migration. Hezbollah, backed by Iran, has increased attacks on Israel, raising concerns of a new front opening in support of Hamas. Israel has ordered evacuations from northern communities, but the number of displaced remains unclear. An AFP tally reports at least 40 deaths in Lebanon, primarily fighters but including four civilians—one a Reuters journalist. In Israel, at least four people have died, including three soldiers and one civilian. The United Nations General Assembly is scheduled to meet Thursday to discuss the ongoing conflict following the Hamas attack on Israel. Multiple countries, including Jordan (on behalf of Arab nations), Russia, Syria, Bangladesh, Vietnam, and Cambodia, requested the session. The Security Council remains divided, having so far failed to adopt resolutions—one by Russia calling for a ‘humanitarian pause’ (supported by only five members), another from Brazil (vetoed by the United States) which condemned Hamas but did not mention Israel's right to self-defense. The Security Council is expected to reconvene Tuesday before the General Assembly meets at 10:00am (1400 GMT) on Thursday.

article_content: A judge in Nevada has blocked a proposed ballot initiative to add reproductive rights, including abortion, to the state's constitution. Judge James T. Russell of Carson City District Court ruled the measure was too broad, included a 'misleading description of effect,' and imposed an unfunded mandate. The initiative, if approved by voters, would have amended Nevada's constitution to guarantee the fundamental right to reproductive freedom—encompassing prenatal care, childbirth, postpartum care, contraception, vasectomy, tubal ligation, and abortion. Judge Russell stated it was the clearest violation of the single-subject rule he had seen, noting that the proposal covered too many unrelated subjects. Russell, who was appointed to the bench in 2007, is the son of former Governor Charles Russell. The group Nevadans for Reproductive Rights filed the petition in September. A complaint challenging the proposal was filed in October by the Coalition for Parents and Children PAC. To get the issue on the ballot, over 100,000 signatures would be required. Attorney Bradley Schrager, representing Nevadans for Reproductive Rights, said the group is considering its options for a potential appeal to the Nevada Supreme Court. The group's president, Lindsay Harmon, stated they 'will not let one judge’s misguided ruling deter us from giving Nevadans the opportunity to vote to permanently protect their reproductive rights.' Jason Guinasso, attorney for the Coalition for Parents and Children PAC, said he was pleased with the ruling but anticipates an appeal. Since the U.S. Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade, abortion rights have become a key issue for Democrats nationwide. Ohio recently became the seventh state where voters supported abortion access in a referendum. Constitutional amendments to protect abortion rights will also appear on ballots in New York and Maryland in 2024, with similar efforts in states like Missouri and Arizona. Polling indicates that about two-thirds of Americans believe abortion should be generally legal in the early stages of pregnancy. This support has been evident in elections in both Democratic and Republican states since Roe was overturned in June 2022. In Nevada, abortion up to 24 weeks is already codified into law through a 1990 referendum, which could only be changed by another referendum vote. Amending the state constitution is more difficult, requiring either approval in two legislative sessions and an election or in two consecutive elections by a simple majority. Reproductive rights played a central role in Democratic campaigns during the 2022 midterm elections and are expected to be a main issue for Senator Jacky Rosen’s 2024 reelection campaign. Nevada lawmakers are also trying to get a constitutional amendment on reproductive rights before voters in 2026; the initiative has already passed the state Senate and Assembly once and needs a second approval in 2025. Gabriel Stern reports for the Associated Press and Report for America, a nonprofit program that places journalists in local newsrooms to cover underreported issues.
translated_content: Sudija u Nevadi blokirao je predloženu inicijativu na glasačkom listiću kojom bi reproduktivna prava, uključujući abortus, bila uvrštena u ustav države. Sudija James T. Russell sa Okružnog suda u Carson Cityju presudio je da je mjera preopširna, sadrži 'obmanjujući opis efekta' i nameće neopravdana finansijska sredstva. Inicijativa bi, da je bila odobrena od strane birača, izmijenila ustav Nevade kako bi garantovala temeljno pravo na reproduktivnu slobodu – uključujući prenatalnu njegu, porod, postporođajnu njegu, kontracepciju, vasektomiju, podvezivanje jajovoda i abortus. Sudija Russell je naveo da je ovo najjasnije kršenje pravila o jedinstvenoj temi koje je do sada vidio, naglasivši da prijedlog obuhvata previše nepovezanih tema. Russell, koji je imenovan na sud 2007. godine, sin je bivšeg guvernera Charlesa Russella. Grupa Nevadans for Reproductive Rights podnijela je peticiju u septembru. Koalicija za roditelje i djecu PAC je u oktobru podnijela prigovor sudu protiv ovog prijedloga. Da bi tema došla na glasački listić, potrebno je prikupiti više od 100.000 potpisa. Advokat Bradley Schrager, koji zastupa Nevadans for Reproductive Rights, rekao je da grupa razmatra mogućnost žalbe Vrhovnom sudu Nevade. Predsjednica grupe Lindsay Harmon izjavila je da 'neće dozvoliti da ih jedno pogrešno sudijsko rješenje spriječi da biračima Nevade daju priliku da trajno zaštite svoja reproduktivna prava.' Jason Guinasso, advokat Koalicije za roditelje i djecu, rekao je da je zadovoljan presudom, ali očekuje žalbu. Nakon što je Vrhovni sud SAD-a ukinuo presudu Roe protiv Wadea, pravo na abortus postalo je ključna tema za demokrate širom Amerike. Ohio je nedavno postao sedma savezna država u kojoj su birači podržali pristup abortusu na referendumu. Ustavne izmjene koje štite pravo na abortus također će se naći na glasačkim listićima u New Yorku i Marylandu 2024. godine, dok se slični napori pokreću u državama kao što su Missouri i Arizona. Istraživanja javnog mnjenja pokazuju da oko dvije trećine Amerikanaca smatra da abortus treba uglavnom biti zakonit u ranim fazama trudnoće. Ovakvo raspoloženje potvrđeno je i na izborima u savezničkim demokratskim i republikanskim državama od ukidanja presude Roe protiv Wadea u junu 2022. U Nevadi je abortus do 24. sedmice već zakonski zagarantovan referendumom iz 1990, a to se može promijeniti samo novim referendumom. Promjena ustava države je teža i zahtijeva ili usvajanje u dva zakonodavna saziva i izbore ili u dva uzastopna izbora prostom većinom glasova. Reproduktivna prava bila su centralna tema demokratskih kampanja tokom izbora 2022. godine i očekuje se da će biti glavno pitanje u kampanji senatorke Jacky Rosen za reizbor 2024. Zakonodavci Nevade također nastoje da do 2026. godine stave prijedlog ustavne promjene o reproduktivnim pravima pred birače; inicijativa je već prošla Senat i Skupštinu, a za konačan izlazak na glasanje potrebna je još jedna potvrda u 2025. Gabriel Stern izvještava za Associated Press i Report for America, neprofitni program koji novinare smješta u lokalne redakcije radi izvještavanja o nedovoljno pokrivenim temama.

article_content: To address the rise in online payment fraud, the Indian government is considering a mandatory waiting period for first-time digital transactions above a certain amount between two individuals. Officials have proposed a four-hour window for first-time digital payments over Rs 2,000 made through IMPS, RTGS, and UPI. While this could introduce some friction, authorities believe the change is necessary for cybersecurity. This regulation would not only delay transactions for new accounts—a system already in place—but would apply to any first-time transaction between two users, regardless of their prior transaction history. Currently, new UPI users can send a maximum of Rs 5,000 in the first 24 hours after account creation. For NEFT, after a new beneficiary is added, up to Rs 50,000 can be transferred in the initial 24 hours. Under the new plan, a four-hour window would apply whenever a user makes a first payment over Rs 2,000 to a recipient they have not previously transacted with. A senior government official explained to The Indian Express that this system would give users up to four hours after initiating a first-time payment to reverse or modify it. The official clarified that this move is similar to the NEFT process, which also takes a few hours. Initially, there was no plan to set a minimum threshold, but feedback from the industry led to an exemption for transactions below Rs 2,000, to avoid affecting everyday purchases. At the time of reporting, the National Payments Corporation of India (operator of UPI) had not responded to queries. The focus is to regulate every initial transfer between two users, not just transactions on account creation. According to the RBI Annual Report 2022-23, banks saw the highest number of frauds in digital payments during 2022-23, with 13,530 fraud cases totaling Rs 30,252 crore; almost half (6,659) were related to digital payments through cards or the internet. A Financial Action Task Force report highlighted that the Citizen Financial Cyber Fraud Reporting and Management System (CFCFRMS) has intercepted Rs 602 crore in transactions since April 2021. Discussions on these measures have been ongoing, but they accelerated after a recent technical issue at UCO Bank. Between November 10-13, IMPS glitches led to some UCO Bank account holders receiving credit without actual fund transfers, amounting to Rs 820 crore. The matter is now being investigated by the Central Bureau of Investigation. The Department of Financial Services under the Union Finance Ministry is set to meet with stakeholders from the public and private sectors to discuss digital payment fraud, financial crime, and cybersecurity measures.

Službenici su predložili vremenski okvir od četiri sata za prve digitalne uplate iznad 2.000 rupija putem IMPS, RTGS i UPI sistema. Iako bi ovo moglo uvesti određene poteškoće, vlasti smatraju da je promjena nužna zbog sajber sigurnosti. Ova regulacija ne bi uticala samo na transakcije kod novih računa—što već postoji—već bi se primjenjivala na svaku prvu transakciju između dva korisnika, bez obzira na njihovu prethodnu istoriju transakcija. Trenutno novi UPI korisnici mogu poslati maksimalno 5.000 rupija u prvih 24 sata nakon otvaranja računa. Kod NEFT-a, nakon dodavanja novog korisnika, može se prenijeti do 50.000 rupija u prvih 24 sata. Po novom planu, vremensko ograničenje od četiri sata bi se primjenjivalo svaki put kada korisnik prvi put šalje uplatu iznad 2.000 rupija osobi s kojom ranije nije obavio transakciju. Viši vladin službenik pojasnio je za The Indian Express da bi ovaj sistem korisnicima dao do četiri sata nakon pokretanja prve uplate da je ponište ili izmijene. Službenik je naglasio da je ovaj potez sličan NEFT procesu, koji također traje nekoliko sati. Prvobitno nije bilo planirano postavljanje minimalnog praga, ali povratne informacije iz industrije dovele su do izuzetka za transakcije manje od 2.000 rupija, kako bi se izbjeglo ometanje svakodnevnih kupovina. U trenutku izvještavanja, Nacionalna korporacija za platni promet Indije (NPCI), koja upravlja UPI sistemom, nije odgovorila na upite. Fokus je na regulaciji svakog prvog transfera između dva korisnika, a ne samo na transakcijama prilikom otvaranja računa. Prema godišnjem izvještaju RBI za 2022-23, banke su imale najveći broj prevara u digitalnim plaćanjima tokom 2022-23, sa 13.530 slučajeva prevara u ukupnoj vrijednosti od 30.252 crore rupija; skoro polovina (6.659) odnosi se na digitalna plaćanja putem kartica ili interneta. Izvještaj Financial Action Task Force (FATF) ističe da je Sistem za prijavljivanje i upravljanje prevarama u cyber financijama građana (CFCFRMS) presreo transakcije u vrijednosti od 602 crore rupija od aprila 2021. Razgovori o ovim mjerama traju već neko vrijeme, ali su ubrzani nakon nedavnog tehničkog problema u UCO banci. Između 10. i 13. novembra, greške u IMPS sistemu su dovele do toga da pojedini korisnici UCO banke dobiju iznos bez stvarnog prenosa sredstava, ukupno 820 crore rupija. Slučaj sada istražuje Centralni biro za istrage (CBI). Odjel za financijske usluge pri Ministarstvu financija Indije uskoro će održati sastanak s javnim i privatnim sektorom kako bi razgovarali o prevarama u digitalnim plaćanjima, financijskom kriminalu i mjerama sajber sigurnosti.

article_content: Gennaro Gattuso, known for his time as a midfielder with AC Milan and the Italian national team, is currently a subject in a match-fixing investigation in Italy. During a police operation, four other individuals—Salvatore Spadaro, Francesco Bazzani, Cosimo Rinci, and Fabio Quadri—were taken into custody as part of the ongoing 'Last Bet' probe. Prosecutor Roberto Di Martino, who has managed this case for three years, indicated that Gattuso and retired Lazio player Cristian Brocchi are suspected of participating in a group accused of manipulating Serie A and other Italian football matches at the close of the 2010-2011 season. These four arrested are believed to have facilitated contacts between fixers and players. Gattuso’s agent, Andrea D’Amico, responded to the allegations, saying Gattuso was stunned and that well-known figures in the sport are often targeted by accusations. D’Amico stressed that being under investigation does not imply guilt and that they await further developments. Throughout his distinguished career, Gattuso earned 73 caps for Italy, contributed to the 2006 World Cup victory, played for clubs such as Rangers, and managed Palermo before his dismissal in September. Italian football has faced repeated issues with illegal betting scandals, including the high-profile 2006 case that led to Juventus’s relegation and investigations into several major clubs. Since 2011, more than 50 individuals have been arrested in related match-fixing investigations across Cremona, Bari, and Naples.

Tužilac Roberto Di Martino, koji vodi ovaj slučaj tri godine, naveo je da su Gattuso i bivši igrač Lazija Cristian Brocchi osumnjičeni da su učestvovali u grupi koja je namještala utakmice Serije A i drugih italijanskih liga krajem sezone 2010/2011. D’Amico je naglasio da pokretanje istrage ne znači i krivicu te da čekaju dalji razvoj događaja. Italijanski fudbal već dugo ima problema s namještanjem i ilegalnim klađenjem, uključujući veliki skandal iz 2006. kada je Juventus izbačen u niži rang, a više velikih klubova je bilo pod istragom. article_content: A rare painting by French impressionist Claude Monet, titled 'Les Saules, Giverny' ('The Willows, Giverny') from 1886, will be auctioned in Paris later this month and could sell for up to 3 million euros ($3.22 million), according to auction house Ader. The artwork, known for Monet's distinctive brushwork and play of light, has been privately owned since 1948 by a Jewish family whose grandfather acquired it from a gallery in Nice. It has remained with the family and was displayed in their Paris home. 'Les Saules, Giverny' is one of about three dozen pieces at Ader's upcoming Impressionist and Modern Art sale on November 24 at Hotel Drouot. Large-scale Monet paintings have become extremely rare in France, with most found in major museums or foreign collections, according to auctioneer David Nordmann. "It's a significant event for the French art market," Nordmann said. While not as renowned as Monet's water lilies or Gare Saint Lazare series—which can command prices up to 100 million euros—this landscape still exemplifies Monet's characteristic style. Monet found inspiration in Giverny, west of Paris, where he lived from 1883 until his death in 1926. He transformed his house and developed Japanese-style gardens that inspired many of his iconic works. The auction will also feature a painting by American artist Mary Cassatt, 'Portrait de Jeune Fille au Chapeau Blanc' ('Portrait of a Young Woman in a White Hat'), which is expected to fetch between 800,000 and 1.2 million euros. In other news, Sweden’s Saab received approval for India’s first 100% foreign direct investment in the defense sector, enabling the company to establish a facility for rocket manufacturing. State Bank of India (SBI) announced an 8% increase in second-quarter net profit, driven by strong loan demand and reduced provisions, and foresees continued robust loan growth. Meanwhile, Byju’s, a leading Indian edtech firm, reported a 2.3-fold rise in core business revenue to ₹3,569 crore for the year ending March 2022, while narrowing its EBITDA loss to ₹2,253 crore.
translated_content: Rijetka slika francuskog impresionista Clauda Moneta pod nazivom "Les Saules, Giverny" ("Vrbe, Giverny") iz 1886. godine bit će ponuđena na aukciji u Parizu kasnije ovog mjeseca, a očekuje se da postigne cijenu do 3 miliona eura (3,22 miliona dolara), prema aukcijskoj kući Ader. Umjetničko djelo, poznato po Monetovom prepoznatljivom potezu kistom i igri svjetlosti, u privatnom je vlasništvu od 1948. godine, a porodica je sliku naslijedila nakon što je djed kupio iz galerije u Nici. Od tada se čuva kod porodice i bila je izložena u njihovoj pariskoj kući. "Les Saules, Giverny" je jedno od otprilike tridesetak djela na predstojećoj aukciji impresionističke i moderne umjetnosti aukcijske kuće Ader, zakazanoj za 24. novembar u hotelu Drouot. Velike Monetove slike izuzetno su rijetke u Francuskoj, jer se većina nalazi u velikim muzejima ili stranim kolekcijama, kaže aukcionar David Nordmann. "Ovo je značajan događaj za francusko tržište umjetnosti", rekao je Nordmann. Iako nije toliko poznata kao Monetove slike lopoča ili serija Gare Saint Lazare—koje mogu dostići cijenu i do 100 miliona eura—ova pejzažna slika i dalje najbolje prikazuje Monetov prepoznatljiv stil. Monet je nadahnuće pronalazio u Givernyju, zapadno od Pariza, gdje je živio od 1883. do smrti 1926. godine. Pretvorio je svoju kuću i razvio japanski vrt koji je bio inspiracija za mnoga njegova poznata djela. Aukcija će također predstaviti sliku američke umjetnice Mary Cassatt, "Portrait de Jeune Fille au Chapeau Blanc" ("Portret mlade djevojke u bijelom šeširu"), za koju se očekuje cijena između 800.000 i 1,2 miliona eura. U drugim vijestima, švedski Saab dobio je odobrenje za prvo potpuno strano direktno ulaganje u indijski odbrambeni sektor, što će kompaniji omogućiti otvaranje pogona za proizvodnju raketa. State Bank of India (SBI) objavila je rast neto dobiti od 8% u drugom kvartalu, vođen snažnom tražnjom kredita i nižim rezervacijama, te očekuje nastavak snažnog rasta kredita. U međuvremenu, Byju’s, vodeća indijska edtech kompanija, zabilježila je 2,3 puta veći prihod od osnovne djelatnosti, došavši do 3.569 crore rupija za godinu završenu u martu 2022., dok je smanjila EBITDA gubitak na 2.253 crore rupija.

article_content: On Tuesday, the U.S. Supreme Court declined to block Texas from enforcing a provision of its new abortion law requiring doctors to have admitting privileges at a hospital within 30 miles of the clinic where they perform abortions. This key part of the law, considered among the most restrictive in the nation, had been reinstated by a federal appeals court. Abortion-rights groups, noting that over a third of abortion clinics in Texas have since closed, asked the Supreme Court to overturn the appeals court’s decision. Justice Antonin Scalia, supporting the order, wrote, "We may not vacate a stay entered by a court of appeals unless that court clearly and 'demonstrably' erred in its application of 'accepted standards.' Reasonable minds can perhaps disagree about whether the Court of Appeals should have granted a stay in this case. But there is no doubt that the applicants have not carried their heavy burden of showing that doing so was a clear violation of accepted legal standards—which do not include a special 'status quo' standard for laws affecting abortion." Justices Stephen Breyer, Ruth Bader Ginsburg, Sonia Sotomayor, and Elena Kagan disagreed with the decision. The original lawsuit, filed in the U.S. District Court in Austin by Planned Parenthood representing more than a dozen women’s health providers, argued that the law violates women’s constitutional rights and puts unreasonable demands on doctors who provide abortions. The bill initially failed after a Democratic filibuster led by state Sen. Wendy Davis. Governor Rick Perry then called a second special session to revive the measure. Davis, now a gubernatorial candidate, criticized Tuesday’s ruling: "Clinics will close and women's health will be hurt because of this law. This is an abuse of power by politicians in Austin. I trust women to make their own decisions and will continue to work to make sure that women and mothers are safe and have access to adequate health care," she said. Governor Perry praised the decision: "This is good news both for the unborn and for the women of Texas, who are now better protected from shoddy abortion providers operating in dangerous conditions. As always, Texas will continue doing everything we can to protect the culture of life in our state," he said. In a separate action, the Supreme Court justices dismissed another Oklahoma law restricting medical abortions.

Ova ključna odredba zakona, koja se smatra jednom od najrestriktivnijih u zemlji, ponovo je uvedena odlukom saveznog žalbenog suda. Grupe za prava na abortus, navodeći da je više od trećine klinika za abortus u Teksasu zatvoreno, zatražile su od Vrhovnog suda da poništi odluku žalbenog suda. Sudija Antonin Scalia, podržavajući odluku, napisao je: "Ne možemo ukinuti odgodu koju je odredio žalbeni sud osim ako taj sud jasno i 'nedvosmisleno' nije pogriješio u primjeni 'prihvaćenih standarda.' Različiti ljudi se mogu ne slagati oko toga da li je žalbeni sud trebao odobriti odgodu u ovom slučaju. Ali nema sumnje da podnosioci zahtjeva nisu dokazali da je to bilo očigledno kršenje prihvaćenih pravnih standarda—koji ne uključuju poseban standard 'statusa quo' za zakone koji se tiču abortusa." Sudije Stephen Breyer, Ruth Bader Ginsburg, Sonia Sotomayor i Elena Kagan nisu se složile s odlukom. Prvobitna tužba, podnesena Okružnom sudu SAD-a u Austinu od strane Planned Parenthood-a u ime više od deset pružalaca zdravstvene zaštite za žene, tvrdila je da zakon krši ustavna prava žena i postavlja nerazumne zahtjeve pred ljekare koji vrše abortuse. Prijedlog zakona je prvobitno propao nakon demokratskog filibustera koji je predvodila državna senatorica Wendy Davis. Guverner Rick Perry je tada sazvao drugu posebnu sjednicu kako bi ponovo razmatrali mjeru. Davis, sada kandidatkinja za guvernera, kritikovala je odluku: "Klinike će se zatvoriti, a zdravlje žena biti ugroženo zbog ovog zakona. Ovo je zloupotreba moći političara u Austinu. Vjerujem ženama da mogu same odlučivati i nastavit ću se boriti da žene i majke budu sigurne i da imaju pristup adekvatnoj zdravstvenoj zaštiti," izjavila je. Guverner Perry je pozdravio odluku: "Ovo su dobre vijesti i za nerođene i za žene Teksasa, koje su sada bolje zaštićene od nesavjesnih pružalaca abortusa koji rade u opasnim uvjetima. Kao i uvijek, Teksas će nastaviti činiti sve da zaštiti kulturu života u našoj državi," rekao je. U odvojenom postupku, sudije Vrhovnog suda odbacile su još jedan zakon iz Oklahome koji ograničava medicinske abortuse.

article_content: Russian entrepreneur Dmitry Itskov is leading a high-tech research project called 'Avatar,' which aims to enable humans to download their minds into robots within the next decade. Itskov has gathered a team of 30 scientists and is looking for more collaborators for the project. Itskov states that the ultimate goal is to offer a form of immortality by allowing human consciousness to continue in robotic or artificial bodies. He sees this technology as initially most relevant for people with disabilities or those nearing the end of their lives. The project will proceed in phases: first, the surgical transplantation of a human brain into a robotic body; then the non-surgical uploading of human consciousness; and finally, transferring minds into artificial or holographic bodies. Inspired by James Cameron’s movie 'Avatar,' the project envisions people controlling new bodies much like the film’s characters. Itskov also references science fiction like Star Wars, suggesting holographic forms could have advantages, such as moving through walls or at extremely high speeds. At the Global Future 2045 conference, Itskov highlighted the need for an advanced brain-machine interface and life support systems that could keep a brain functioning outside of the human body. Itskov hopes to collaborate with DARPA, the U.S. Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency, which is developing technology for soldiers to control robotic surrogates. DARPA has set aside $7 million for its 'Avatar' program, focusing on creating interfaces and algorithms for human-robot partnerships.
translated_content: Ruski poduzetnik Dmitry Itskov vodi visokotehnološki istraživački projekat pod nazivom 'Avatar', sa ciljem da omogući ljudima da preuzmu svoju svijest u robote u narednih deset godina. Itskov je okupio tim od 30 naučnika i traži još saradnika za ovaj projekat. Itskov navodi da je krajnji cilj ponuditi oblik besmrtnosti omogućavajući ljudskoj svijesti da nastavi postojanje u robotskim ili vještačkim tijelima. Ovu tehnologiju vidi kao posebno korisnu za osobe s invaliditetom ili one blizu kraja života. Projekat je zamišljen kroz faze: prvo hirurška transplantacija ljudskog mozga u robotsko tijelo, zatim nesurgicalno prebacivanje ljudske svijesti, a na kraju prenos uma u vještačka ili holografska tijela. Projekat inspirisan filmom Jamesa Camerona 'Avatar' predviđa ljude koji kontrolišu nova tijela slično likovima iz filma. Itskov navodi i naučnofantastične primjere poput Ratova zvijezda, naglašavajući da holografski oblici mogu imati prednosti poput prolaska kroz zidove ili kretanja velikom brzinom. Na konferenciji Global Future 2045, Itskov je istakao potrebu za naprednim interfejsom mozak-mašina i sistemima za održavanje mozga izvan ljudskog tijela. Itskov se nada saradnji s DARPA-om, američkom Agencijom za napredne istraživačke projekte u odbrani, koja razvija tehnologiju za vojnike da upravljaju robotskim zamjenama. article_content: Mr. Vasani, currently Group CFO at Cube Highways InvIT and with previous executive experience at Publicis Groupe, Vodafone, Coca-Cola, and Subros, offers advice on moving up in the finance world. The Chief Financial Officer is a crucial role, guiding a company’s financial direction and strategy. For finance professionals in controller, director, or business partner roles aiming for CFO, consider this guidance: 1. Strive for Excellence: Go beyond basic financial skills—develop expertise in financial reporting, planning, risk management, and analytics. Understand the bigger picture behind the numbers and balance detail with strategic purpose. 2. Grow Strategic Thinking: Combine technical finance skills with a broad understanding of business operations. Top CFOs partner with all areas of business, supporting true organizational needs. 3. Broaden Your Scope: To be an effective CFO, gain experience outside traditional finance, like in mergers and acquisitions or capital raising. Work in different functions—finance, legal, tax, and operations—for a comprehensive perspective. 4. Strengthen Communication: Regular interaction with executives, boards, and investors requires confident, clear communication. Listening is just as important as speaking. 5. Shape Your Leadership Style: CFOs lead people as much as processes. Manage teams and projects, foster high performance, and make difficult decisions with empathy and approachability. 6. Keep Learning: Stay current on regulations, technologies, and best practices. Advanced education and ongoing professional development (conferences, workshops, degrees) help position you for executive roles. 7. Pursue International Exposure: Global assignments or roles in multinational companies expand understanding of international finance and diverse business practices, as illustrated by Mr. Vasani’s time at Vodafone and Publicis. 8. Network Widely: Cultivate relationships across the industry—attend events, join associations, and seek mentorship. Your network can lead to valuable learning, collaborations, and career opportunities. 9. Seek Mentorship: Guidance from experienced CFOs or executives who align with your goals can accelerate development and offer support. Success as a CFO requires continuous development in skills, mindset, and well-being. Strive to enjoy your work and maintain balance on your journey. The Forbes Finance Council invites qualified finance leaders to join a community of executives and share insights.

Najbolji CFO-ovi blisko sarađuju sa svim segmentima preduzeća i podržavaju prave potrebe organizacije. 3. Proširite kompetencije: Efikasan CFO treba iskustvo i izvan tradicionalne financijske sfere, poput spajanja i akvizicija ili prikupljanja kapitala. Razvijajte svoj liderski stil: CFO-ovi vode ljude i procese. Vodite timove i projekte, podstičite napredak i donositi teške odluke s empatijom i otvorenošću. 6. Pronađite mentora: Mentorstvom iskusnih CFO-ova ili rukovodilaca koji dijele vaše vrijednosti i ciljeve možete ubrzati razvoj. Uspjeh u ulozi CFO-a zahtijeva stalno usavršavanje, otvorenost i brigu o vlastitom blagostanju. Nastojte uživati u radu i sačuvati ravnotežu na tom putu. article_content: Hong Kong stands out as a city with a unique identity—while it's officially part of China, its everyday realities and governance set it apart. This distinctive position was established after the former British colony was returned to China in 1997 under a special agreement known as "one country, two systems." With this principle, Hong Kong preserves its own legal, economic, and cultural institutions. Recent tensions have brought these differences to the forefront: large-scale protests have erupted in response to what residents see as increasing interference from Beijing in Hong Kong’s political and civil affairs. The city’s separation from mainland China is rooted in its unique history—over 150 years of British rule, its role as a refuge during political turmoil on the mainland, and mass emigration leading up to and following the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown. Hong Kong is governed by the Basic Law, its mini-constitution, which promises autonomy and protects resident rights for 50 years after 1997. It pledges that Hong Kongers should determine their own democratic future. Despite this, Beijing has on several occasions reinterpreted the Basic Law, stating its ultimate authority—actions that have sparked concern among locals. The city’s culture and lifestyle are distinct: most residents speak Cantonese and adhere to social customs unlike those on the mainland. Everyday frictions sometimes go viral, as seen in incidents involving mainland visitors, drawing attention to deeper anxieties about economic competition and social space. Since the handover, more residents identify primarily as 'Hong Konger,' a trend revealed in regular opinion surveys. Some young mainland visitors are sympathetic to the city’s protesters, noting differences in freedoms and policing compared to mainland China. Hong Kong’s strong legal system, modeled on the British framework, underpins its reputation for transparency and fairness. This has attracted multinational companies, though recent conflicts have tested public trust in authorities. On the economic front, Hong Kong runs its own currency and operates under a capitalist system—both protected by the Basic Law. The city has played a significant role in China’s economic reforms and maintains its status as a global financial hub. However, with cities like Shanghai rising and Beijing pushing for economic integration, Hong Kong’s position faces challenges. The ongoing struggle in Hong Kong centers on the tension between integrating with mainland China and preserving its longstanding freedoms and way of life.
translated_content: Hong Kong se izdvaja kao grad s jedinstvenim identitetom—iako je formalno dio Kine, njegov svakodnevni život i uprava ga jasno razlikuju. Ova posebnost uspostavljena je kada je bivša britanska kolonija 1997. godine vraćena Kini, prema dogovoru poznatom kao "jedna zemlja, dva sistema." Prema tom modelu, Hong Kong zadržava vlastite pravne, ekonomske i kulturne institucije. Nedavni sukobi doveli su ove razlike u prvi plan: masovni protesti izbili su zbog percepcije da Peking sve više utiče na politička i građanska pitanja Hong Konga. Ova odvojenost proizlazi iz posebne historije grada—više od 150 godina britanske vlasti, uloge utočišta tokom političkih previranja u Kini i masovne emigracije uoči i nakon događaja na Tiananmenu 1989. Gradom upravlja Basic Law (Osnovni zakon), koji služi kao mini-ustav i garantuje autonomiju te štiti prava stanovnika 50 godina nakon 1997. Prema tom zakonu, Hongkonžani imaju pravo da samostalno određuju svoju demokratsku budućnost. Ipak, Peking je povremeno preispitivao ova pravila i naglašavao svoj najviši autoritet, što izaziva zabrinutost među stanovnicima. Kultura i način života u Hong Kongu su posebni: većina stanovnika govori kantonski i živi prema običajima različitim od onih u ostatku Kine. Svakodnevni sukobi i nesporazumi—poput viralnih incidenata s posjetiocima iz Kine—često ukazuju na dublje brige oko ekonomske konkurencije i društvenog prostora. Od povratka Kini, sve više stanovnika se prvenstveno definiše kao „Hongkonžanin“, što redovno potvrđuju i istraživanja javnog mnijenja. Neki mladi posjetioci iz Kine izražavaju simpatije prema protestima, navodeći razlike u slobodama i policijskim praksama u odnosu na ostatak Kine. Hong Kong se ponosi snažnim pravnim sistemom po uzoru na britanski model, što podupire transparentnost i povjerenje i privlači brojne međunarodne kompanije—iako su nedavni sukobi donekle narušili povjerenje između građana i vlasti. Ekonomski, Hong Kong ima vlastitu valutu i kapitalistički sistem—obje odredbe štiti Basic Law. Grad igra važnu ulogu u kineskim ekonomskim reformama i ostaje globalni ekonomski centar, ali kako Šangaj i drugi gradovi rastu pod uticajem Pekinga, Hong Kong se suočava s novim izazovima. Središnja borba u Hong Kongu i dalje je napetost između integracije s Kinom i očuvanja dugogodišnjih sloboda i načina života.

article_content: Nicaraguan President Daniel Ortega has indicated that the country may seek to revive its $17 billion claim against the United States through international channels. This claim originates from a 1986 ruling by the International Court of Justice (ICJ) in The Hague, which found that the United States violated international law by supporting Contra rebels during Nicaragua’s civil war—activities that included financing, arming, and attacks on Nicaraguan infrastructure. Despite this ruling, the United States did not recognize the ICJ’s jurisdiction in the matter and declined to pay reparations. By 1991, under President Violeta Chamorro, Nicaragua formally withdrew its claim from the ICJ, and the court subsequently removed the case from its docket. Recently, President Ortega has proposed holding a referendum to ask Nicaraguans whether the country should pursue this debt—describing the obligation as one owed by the 'Yankee' government. Larry Birns, director of the Council on Hemispheric Affairs, commented that while Nicaragua’s legal position is legitimate, it is unlikely Ortega will act on the proposal, as it could strain relations with the United States. Birns also observed that Ortega has a record of pragmatic actions that may not align with his strong rhetoric. Fred Morrison, a law professor at the University of Minnesota and a former member of the US legal team on the case, emphasized that when Nicaragua withdrew its claim, it also renounced any further right of action, a declaration typically regarded as legally binding. He said this makes it highly unlikely the case could be reopened.

Ovo potraživanje potiče iz presude Međunarodnog suda pravde u Haagu iz 1986. godine, kojom je utvrđeno da su SAD prekršile međunarodno pravo podržavajući pobunjenike Contrase tokom građanskog rata u Nikaragvi—uključujući finansiranje, naoružavanje i napade na infrastrukturu. Međutim, SAD nisu priznale nadležnost ICJ-a u ovom slučaju i odbile su platiti odštetu. Do 1991. godine, pod predsjednicom Violetom Chamorro, Nikaragva je službeno povukla svoju tužbu iz ICJ-a, te je sud uklonio predmet sa svog spiska. Nedavno je predsjednik Ortega predložio referendum kako bi građani Nikaragve odlučili treba li država tražiti ovaj dug—koji je opisao kao dug 'jenkijevske' vlade. Larry Birns, direktor Vijeća za hemisferska pitanja, kazao je da je pravna pozicija Nikaragve legitimna, ali smatra da Ortega vjerovatno neće preduzeti taj korak jer bi to pogoršalo odnose sa SAD-om. Birns je također istakao da Ortega često postupa pragmatično, bez obzira na oštrinu svojih izjava. Fred Morrison, profesor prava na Univerzitetu Minnesote i bivši član američkog pravnog tima na ovom slučaju, naglasio je da je Nikaragva povlačenjem tužbe odustala od bilo kakvog daljnjeg postupanja, što se pravno smatra obavezujućom izjavom. article_content: A phone screen shows the Wordle game in an illustration taken in Krakow, Poland, on February 21, 2022. (Credit: Jakub Porzycki/NurPhoto via Getty Images)  Happy Wordle Wednesday! It's the last Wednesday of November, and soon December’s snowy days arrive. Today isn’t just another Wordle—it's also time for a brain-teasing riddle, as is tradition every Wednesday here.  Today's logic puzzle: If all Grumkins are Cloogies, all Blumprots are Dabbledoggers, no Puffpops are Blumprots, and all Cloogies are Blumprots, is it true that all Blumprots are Cloogies? DM me on Twitter or Facebook if you know the answer. I’ll share the solution in tomorrow’s blog update.  Let’s get to Wordle!  How I solved today's Wordle: After each game, I check the Wordle Bot page to review my performance. My first guess, 'spare,' narrowed the options to 99—not ideal, but decent. The Bot probably did similarly well with 'slate.'  I got one green box, but no vowels. Next, I tried 'shout,' which revealed two more yellow boxes. From there, I considered two possibilities: 'slush' and 'sushi' (the Bot later showed me I missed 'smush'). I picked 'sushi'—partly because it sounded tastier! Luckily, it was correct. Hooray for sushi! I scored 1 point for solving it in three guesses, and tied with the Bot, meaning no bonus points. Still, 1 point is great!  Wordle Etymology: The word 'sushi' (寿司) originates from Japanese. It stems from 'sushi-meshi,' which referred to seasoned, sour rice used to preserve fish—a practice dating back to Japan’s Muromachi period (14th–16th centuries).  'Sushi' became popular during the Edo period (17th–19th centuries), describing vinegared rice served with various ingredients like seafood, vegetables, and sometimes fruits. Over time, sushi evolved into the popular international cuisine we know today.  The character 寿 ('su' in sushi) means 'longevity' or 'good fortune.' The character 司 ('shi') can mean 'expert' or 'person in charge,' possibly reflecting the skill required to make sushi. Altogether, 'sushi' refers to 'sour-tasting rice' or 'seasoned rice,' which is the heart of this dish.  Play Competitive Wordle: I’m playing daily head-to-head Wordle against my nemesis, Wordle Bot—now you can join in! Challenge me and keep score, or just play along. You can also play against Wordle Bot if you have a New York Times subscription.

(Foto: Jakub Porzycki/NurPhoto via Getty Images)  Sretna Wordle srijeda! Ovo je posljednja srijeda u novembru, a uskoro nam dolaze snježni dani decembra. Danas nije samo još jedan Wordle—tu je i zagonetka za razmišljanje, kao što je običaj svake srijede ovdje.  Današnja logička zagonetka: Ako su svi Grumkinsi Cloogiesi, svi Blumproti su Dabbledoggersi, nijedan Puffpop nije Blumprot, a svi Cloogiesi su Blumproti, da li to znači da su svi Blumproti Cloogiesi? Pošalji mi poruku na Twitteru ili Facebooku ako znaš odgovor. Rješenje ću objaviti u blogu sutra.  Vrijeme je za Wordle!  Kako sam danas riješio/la Wordle: Nakon svake igre provjeravam Wordle Bot stranicu da analiziram rezultat. Prvi pokušaj, 'spare', suzio je mogućnosti na 99—nije idealno, ali može proći. Bot je vjerovatno imao sličan rezultat sa 'slate'.  Imam jednu zelenu kockicu, ali bez samoglasnika. Zatim sam pokušao/la s 'shout', što mi je donijelo još dvije žute kockice. Nakon toga sam birao/la između 'slush' i 'sushi' (Bot mi je poslije otkrio da sam propustio/la 'smush'). Odabrao/la sam 'sushi'—zvučalo je ukusnije! Srećom, to je bio tačan odgovor. Hura za sushi! Dobio/la sam 1 bod jer sam pogodio/la iz trećeg pokušaja, a izjednačio/la sam se sa Botom, što znači da nema dodatnih bodova. Ipak, 1 bod je super!  Etimologija Wordle riječi: Riječ 'sushi' (寿司) potiče iz japanskog jezika. Izvodi se iz 'sushi-meshi', što je označavalo začinjenu, kiselu rižu koja se koristila za čuvanje ribe—praksa koja datira još iz Muromači perioda (14.–16. vijek) u Japanu.  'Sushi' je postao popularan tokom Edo perioda (17.–19. vijek), predstavljajući rižu začinjenu octom uz razne sastojke kao što su morski plodovi, povrće ili čak voće. Vremenom je sushi postao međunarodno popularno jelo kakvo poznajemo danas.  Znak 寿 ('su' u sushi) znači 'dugovječnost' ili 'sreću'. Znak 司 ('shi') može značiti 'stručnjak' ili 'osoba zadužena za nešto', što vjerovatno ukazuje na vještinu potrebnu za pripremu sushija. Ukratko, 'sushi' znači 'kisela riža' ili 'začinjena riža', što je suština ovog tradicionalnog japanskog jela.  Igraj takmičarski Wordle: Svaki dan igram Wordle jedan na jedan protiv svog suparnika, Wordle Bota—sada se i ti možeš priključiti! Izazovi me i vodi rezultat, ili samo igraj iz zabave.
