article_content: When Tom White saw a cougar approaching his teenage son outside their rural Washington home last week, he quickly handed a gun to his 11-year-old daughter, Shelby White. Without hesitation, Shelby shot and killed the female cougar, with wildlife officials later suggesting the animal may have been sick. The cougar, a 4-year-old weighing about 50 pounds—roughly half the healthy weight for its age—was likely undernourished. Shelby, who has been hunting with her .234 caliber rifle since age 8 or 9, acted when she noticed the cougar following her 13-year-old brother, Tanner, as he was heading home with animal feed. Their grandfather, William White, a 64-year-old cattle rancher and former hunter safety instructor, explained that this incident marked the fourth cougar killed on his property in recent weeks. Shelby’s younger brother, 9-year-old Cody, also shot a cougar earlier this month under the supervision of a game warden. William White described his family as avid hunters who take safety and training seriously. Until two years ago, residents managed the area’s cougar population by hunting with dogs, but state legislation has since banned this practice. According to State Fish and Wildlife Officer Cal Treser, the cougar Shelby shot was 'very, very skinny.' The Whites say cougars have been targeting their livestock, evidenced by photographs of a calf recently killed by a cougar on the farm. Cougars are North America's largest native cats, with adult males weighing 140 to 180 pounds and measuring up to eight feet long. In Washington, an estimated 2,000 to 2,500 cougars roam areas where prey and cover are available. While the cougar population is declining in eastern Washington, it remains stable in the west. State wildlife offices record hundreds of calls yearly regarding cougar sightings, attacks on livestock and pets, and close encounters with people. Increasing development and shrinking cougar habitats are thought to be contributing factors. Shelby was the only family member with a legal permit to shoot the cougar. Tom White recounted instructing her to retrieve the rifle and take action. The family credits their hunting knowledge and training for keeping them safe. All three White children—Shelby, Tanner, and Cody—have been taught proper firearm use by their grandfather. Each has killed a cougar this season, responding to rising threats on the property. William White believes at least one more cougar is still nearby, posing ongoing risks to the family's dogs and cattle. The Twisp area has seen an unusual rise in cougar incidents. Over the winter, state officials have tracked and killed five cougars in the broader region after attacks on livestock, with an additional five killed by hunters with special permits. Analysts suggest hungry cougars are increasingly venturing into residential areas in search of food, particularly when their normal prey, like deer, is scarce. The Washington Department of Fish and Wildlife continues to monitor and respond to the elevated risk, hoping to balance community safety with animal conservation.
translated_content: Kada je Tom White prošle sedmice vidio pumu kako se približava njegovom tinejdžerskom sinu ispred njihove kuće u ruralnom dijelu države Washington, brzo je dao pušku svojoj 11-godišnjoj kćerci Shelby White. Bez oklijevanja, Shelby je upucala i ubila ženku pume, a službenici za zaštitu divljih životinja kasnije su sugerisali da je životinja možda bila bolesna. Puma, stara 4 godine i teška oko 23 kilograma – otprilike upola manje nego što je uobičajeno za tu dob – vjerovatno je bila neuhranjena. Shelby, koja lovi s svojom puškom kalibra .234 još od osme ili devete godine, reagovala je kad je primijetila pumu kako prati njenog 13-godišnjeg brata Tannera dok se vraćao kući sa hranom za životinje. Njihov djed, William White, uzgajivač stoke od 64 godine i bivši instruktor sigurnosti lovaca, objasnio je da je ovaj incident četvrta puma ubijena na njegovom imanju u posljednjih nekoliko sedmica. Shelbyin mlađi brat Cody, star devet godina, također je ranije ovog mjeseca upucao pumu pod nadzorom lovočuvara. William White opisuje svoju porodicu kao strastvene lovce koji ozbiljno shvataju sigurnost i obuku. Do prije dvije godine stanovnici su kontrolisali populaciju puma lovom uz pomoć pasa, ali državni zakon je od tada zabranio ovu praksu. Prema riječima službenika Cal Tresera iz Odjela za ribu i divlje životinje, puma koju je Shelby upucala bila je 'veoma, veoma mršava.' Porodica White tvrdi da su pume meta njihovog stada, čemu svjedoče fotografije teleta koje je nedavno ubila puma na farmi. Pume su najveće autohtone mačke u Sjevernoj Americi, a odrasli mužjaci teže od 63 do 82 kilograma i mogu narasti do osam stopa u dužinu. U saveznoj državi Washington procjenjuje se da ima između 2.000 i 2.500 puma na područjima gdje ima dovoljno plijena i zaklona. Državne službe za zaštitu divljine godišnje primaju stotine prijava o viđenjima puma, napadima na stoku i kućne ljubimce, te bliskim susretima sa ljudima. Money might actually be able to buy happiness — and each generation has a different idea of what that amount is. On Monday, Empower, a financial services company, released the results of a survey conducted by The Harris Poll in August. The survey asked 2,034 Americans aged 18 and over what they believe is the key to financial happiness. It turns out 59% of respondents think happiness can be bought, and on average, people believe they would need $1.2 million in the bank to be truly financially happy. When it comes to annual salary, the average respondent thinks they'd need $284,167 per year to feel happy.

Here's what respondents from each generation said they would need to earn annually, and the net worth required, to achieve happiness:
- Gen Z: $128,000 salary; $487,711 net worth
- Millennials: $525,000 salary; $1,699,571 net worth
- Gen X: $130,000 salary; $1,213,759 net worth
- Boomers: $124,000 salary; $999,945 net worth

Men said they'd need to earn $381,000 yearly for happiness, while women said $183,000 would be enough.

A 2023 study coauthored by Nobel Prize laureate Daniel Kahneman found that happiness may improve with higher earnings up to $500,000 a year, supporting the higher estimates given by millennials in the survey. "In the simplest terms, this suggests that for most people, larger incomes are associated with greater happiness," said Matthew Killingsworth, a senior fellow at Penn's Wharton School and coauthor of the study. "The exception is people who are financially well-off but unhappy. For instance, if you're rich and miserable, more money won't help. For everyone else, more money was associated with higher happiness to varying degrees."

This differs from a 2010 study by Nobel Prize recipient Angus Deaton, which found that money could only boost happiness up to $75,000 in annual earnings, after which extra money had little impact.

Still, there's more to financial happiness than just annual salary. According to the survey, inflation, high interest rates, and student loans are weighing on Americans' financial security. Having the ability to spend comfortably on everyday items can also boost feelings of financial happiness. For example, 62% of millennials said they'd pay $7 for a daily coffee "because of the joy it brings."

Recent economic data could make Americans' financial happiness goals more achievable. Inflation is continuing to decline as the U.S. recovers from the pandemic — the Consumer Price Index increased 3.2% year-over-year in October, down from 3.7% in the previous month. The Federal Reserve has paused its interest rate hikes given encouraging inflation data and no longer forecasts a recession as the year ends.

However, as previously reported, millennials are still struggling in this economy. According to Morning Consult's latest financial well-being index, which tracks respondents' financial security, millennials' score dropped to 0.94, compared to baby boomers' 4.04 from August 2022 to August 2023. An increase of one point could result from a rise in income or a 20-point uptick in credit score, Morning Consult explained.

Nonetheless, the latest Survey of Consumer Finances from the Federal Reserve brought some optimism for millennials regarding net worth. From 2019 to 2022, net worth for the typical family surged 37%, with the median net worth of Americans aged 35 to 44 reaching $135,000 in 2022, up from $105,610 in 2019.

Have you found a way to be happy on your current salary? Do you have thoughts on the price of happiness? Reach out to the reporter at asheffey@businessinsider.com.

Novac zaista možda može kupiti sreću — a svaka generacija ima svoju ideju o tome koliko to košta. Ispostavilo se da 59% ispitanika misli da se sreća može kupiti, a u prosjeku smatraju da bi im za istinsku finansijsku sreću bilo potrebno 1,2 miliona dolara na računu. Evo koliko, prema generacijama, smatraju da treba da zarađuju godišnje i kolika neto imovina im treba za sreću:
- Gen Z: 128.000 dolara plata; 487.711 dolara neto imovina
- Milenijalci: 525.000 dolara plata; 1.699.571 dolara neto imovina

"Najjednostavnije rečeno, ovo sugeriše da su za većinu ljudi veći prihodi povezani sa većom srećom", rekao je Matthew Killingsworth, viši saradnik Wharton škole na Penn univerzitetu i koautor studije. "Izuzetak su ljudi koji su finansijski dobrostojeći, ali nesretni. Na primjer, ako ste bogati i nesretni, više novca neće pomoći. Za sve ostale, više novca bilo je povezano sa višim nivoom sreće u različitim stepenima."

To se razlikuje od studije iz 2010. godine nobelovca Angusa Deatona, koja je pokazala da novac može povećati sreću do 75.000 dolara godišnje, nakon čega dodatni novac ima mali uticaj.

Ipak, finansijska sreća ne zavisi samo od plate. Prema anketi, inflacija, visoke kamatne stope i studentski krediti ugrožavaju finansijsku sigurnost Amerikanaca. Mogućnost da mirno trošite na svakodnevne stvari može dodatno povećati osjećaj finansijske sreće. Na primjer, 62% milenijalaca kaže da bi platili 7 dolara za svoju dnevnu kafu "zbog radosti koju im pruža."

Najnoviji ekonomski podaci mogli bi učiniti ciljeve finansijske sreće Amerikanaca dostižnijim. Inflacija nastavlja da opada kako se SAD oporavljaju od pandemije — indeks potrošačkih cijena porastao je za 3,2% u oktobru na godišnjem nivou, što je manje od 3,7% iz prethodnog mjeseca. Federalne rezerve su pauzirale povećanja kamatnih stopa zbog ohrabrujućih inflacijskih podataka i više ne predviđaju recesiju do kraja godine.

Ipak, kako je ranije izvještavano, milenijalci se i dalje bore u ovoj ekonomiji. Prema najnovijem indeksu finansijske dobrobiti Morning Consulta, koji prati finansijsku sigurnost ispitanika, rezultat milenijalaca pao je na 0,94, u poređenju sa 4,04 kod bumer generacije od avgusta 2022. do avgusta 2023. Morning Consult navodi da povećanje od jednog poena može značiti rast prihoda ili povećanje kreditnog rejtinga za 20 poena.

Ipak, najnovije Istraživanje o finansijama domaćinstava Federalnih rezervi donijelo je malo optimizma milenijalcima kada je riječ o neto imovini. Od 2019. do 2022. godine, neto imovina tipične porodice porasla je za 37%, a srednja neto vrijednost Amerikanaca starih od 35 do 44 godine iznosila je 135.000 dolara u 2022, u odnosu na 105.610 dolara u 2019.

article_content: Liberia will soon hold a presidential election with 19 candidates contesting the presidency. Incumbent President George Weah is seeking another term. If there is no outright winner, a second round is likely, with Joseph Boakai, Alexander Cummings, and Tiawan Gongloe viewed as Weah’s main challengers. Joseph Boakai, aged 78, is expected to make his final run for the presidency. A public servant for over four decades, Boakai previously served as Liberia's vice president under Ellen Johnson Sirleaf from 2006 to 2018, as well as agriculture minister under Samuel Doe. Despite being called 'Sleepy Joe' by critics due to his age, Boakai emphasizes his integrity and humble background. His platform focuses on modernizing infrastructure, boosting agriculture, attracting investment, promoting tourism, and improving Liberia’s international image. He leads the Unity Party and benefits from a strong alliance with Prince Johnson in Nimba County. Alexander Cummings, 66, is a businessman best known for a career at Coca Cola. He finished fifth in the 2017 election, capturing just over 7% of the vote, and is now running alongside Charlyne Brumskine, daughter of late political leader Charles Brumskine. Cummings is praised for his management skills and international connections but faces skepticism that he may be perceived as elitist due to his business background and years spent overseas. Tiawan Gongloe, 67, is a human rights lawyer and survivor of Liberia’s conflicts, devoted to seeking justice for war crimes. He previously served as prosecutor general and labor minister (2006-2010) under President Sirleaf. Gongloe’s campaign is centered on fighting corruption and making education more accessible. His symbol is a broom, used to represent his plan to clean up government and address past civil war abuses. The race is dominated by calls for reform and anti-corruption, with economic growth as a central issue. President Weah, who won more than 61% of votes in the 2017 second round, faces criticism over his administration’s record. Liberian voters are weighing established experience against promises of change as they prepare to choose their next leader.

article_content: Bombay Dyeing & Manufacturing Co Ltd reported a reduced consolidated net loss of Rs 51.99 crore for the second quarter ended September 30, 2023, compared to a net loss of Rs 93.02 crore in the same period last year, according to a regulatory filing. Revenue from operations fell by 40.87% year-on-year to Rs 440.60 crore from Rs 745.22 crore. Total expenses for the September quarter amounted to Rs 581.11 crore, a decrease of 33.48%. The company's total income for the quarter was Rs 457.12 crore. Income from the Real Estate segment dropped to Rs 80.60 crore from Rs 280.48 crore, while revenue from the Polyester segment stood at Rs 344.19 crore compared to Rs 449.24 crore in the corresponding quarter last year. Revenue from the Retail/Textile segment increased slightly to Rs 15.81 crore from Rs 15.50 crore. Shares closed at Rs 161.95 apiece on the BSE, slipping 0.62% on Thursday. In other industry news, Apple Inc. reported record quarterly revenue in India, while the luxury car market is seeing a trend of younger buyers. Additionally, Sony reportedly wants its own executive as head of the proposed Sony-Zee merged entity, as ZEEL's CEO remains under SEBI investigation.

article_content: Google is planning to enhance its digital assistant by merging Bard, its advanced AI chatbot, into Google Assistant in the coming months. This update was revealed alongside the launch of the Pixel 8 series, which also introduces several new AI-powered capabilities. 'Assistant with Bard' will let users interact via text, voice, or images, much like the current Assistant—but with improved conversational skills and personalization. Recently, Bard was updated so it can connect with various Google services. This allows users to, for example, have Bard find specific files in Google Docs, look up flights using Google Flights, or display emails from Gmail. Integrating generative AI into more Google products is part of a broader strategy that includes tools like 'Help Me Write' and a new AI-driven Search experience being gradually rolled out. Currently, access to the improved Assistant is limited to a group of early testers. Google is seeking their feedback before releasing it more widely over the next few months. It’s not yet clear if this will update the existing Assistant app or require a separate download for Android and iPhone. Although it’s not available for public use yet, Google expects to introduce the feature more broadly by the end of the year, with more information to follow as it becomes available.

article_content: Spain has been officially declared free of Ebola by the World Health Organization (WHO), after no new cases were reported following a nurse's assistant, Teresa Romero Ramos, testing negative for the virus. The declaration comes 42 days after the last reported case, which is twice the maximum incubation period for the Ebola virus, and no new infections have occurred during this time. Spanish authorities monitored 87 people who had contact with Romero, 15 of whom were considered high-risk and were quarantined in a Madrid hospital, according to WHO. An additional 145 hospital staff who provided care for Romero during her month-long stay at Carlos III Hospital were also under observation. The WHO praised Spain for its measures in identifying potential Ebola cases and preventing further transmission. Romero contracted Ebola while caring for an infected missionary who had been repatriated from West Africa and who later died from the illness. CNN's Anna Maja Rappard contributed to this report.

Odluka je donesena 42 dana nakon posljednjeg prijavljenog slučaja, što je dvostruko duže od maksimalnog perioda inkubacije Ebole, a za to vrijeme nije bilo novih infekcija. Španske vlasti su pratile 87 osoba koje su bile u kontaktu s Romero, od kojih je 15 smatrano visokorizičnim i bile su u karantinu u bolnici u Madridu, prema podacima WHO-a. Dodatnih 145 bolničkih radnika koji su brinuli o Romero tokom njenog jednomjesečnog boravka u bolnici Carlos III također su bili pod nadzorom. article_content: Russia has been warned not to rely on 'weariness' in Europe regarding support for Ukraine, as European Union (EU) foreign ministers gather in Kyiv. This marks the first time the meeting has been held outside the EU bloc. Although Ukraine is not an EU member, it actively seeks to join. The summit comes one day after the US left out additional military funding for Ukraine in a last-minute budget deal. EU policy chief Josep Borrell described the ongoing war in Ukraine as an 'existential crisis.' ‘Maybe it's not seen that way everywhere in the world, but for us Europeans, allow me to repeat: it's an existential threat,’ Borrell told the meeting on Monday. ‘That's why we must continue to support you and work with our American allies to ensure they do the same.’ The EU has announced more than €70bn (£60bn) in military and civilian aid for Ukraine, scheduled to arrive over the next few years. Borrell emphasized that the bloc is striving for ‘sustainable and predictable’ military support, highlighting the continued passage of support and sanctions by member states. French Foreign Minister Catherine Colonna called Monday's meeting a ‘demonstration of our resolute and lasting support for Ukraine until it can win.’ She added, ‘It is also a message to Russia that it should not expect us to tire. We will be here for the long term.’ The temporary US budget deal did not include $6bn (£4.92bn) in military aid for Kyiv. However, President Joe Biden, who has already approved approximately $46bn (£37bn) in military aid since Russia’s full-scale invasion last year, assured that Ukraine can 'count on' continued US support. The Kremlin maintains that conflict fatigue will increase in both Europe and the US, though they expect the US to remain directly involved. Ukrainian Foreign Minister Dmytro Kuleba described the US omission of funding as an 'incident' rather than an indication of declining support. Hardline Republicans in the US have opposed further military aid for Ukraine and are critical of President Biden’s approach. 'We are working with both sides of Congress to prevent this from happening again,' Kuleba said. 'We do not feel US support is failing.' Ukraine has made progress against Russia, widening breaches in Russian defenses in the southern Zaporizhzhia region and advancing around Bakhmut after Russia redeployed experienced troops further south. However, overall progress has been slower than anticipated, requiring Ukraine to rely more on diplomacy. At the EU meeting, German Foreign Minister Annalena Baerbock called for a plan to protect Ukraine’s power grid, which left millions without heating last winter. 'Ukraine needs a winter protection plan, including air defense, generators, and stronger energy supplies,' she stated. Nonetheless, divisions among EU members are emerging. Notably, Poland and Hungary—countries with significant disagreements with Ukraine—did not send their foreign ministers to Kyiv and were instead represented at a state level. Furthermore, over the weekend, a pro-Russian candidate, Robert Fico, won Slovakia’s parliamentary elections and is expected to start coalition talks. Fico has previously called for an immediate halt to military support for Ukraine. Kuleba said it was ‘too early to judge’ how this result will affect Ukraine. Recent political developments—such as Slovakia's election, contentious politics in Poland, and Hungary’s ongoing attempts to block Western aid—pose challenges to EU unity regarding Ukraine.

article_content: The United Nations has announced that the first shipment of humanitarian aid into the besieged Gaza Strip through the Rafah border crossing with Egypt is expected within the next day or so. 'We are in advanced negotiations with all relevant parties to ensure that an aid operation in Gaza begins as quickly as possible. The first delivery should start soon,' said UN humanitarian chief Martin Griffiths, as quoted by spokesman Jens Laerke in Geneva. Laerke told reporters he could not give an exact time for the movements to take place, but he hopes they will begin as soon as possible in a manner that is safe, secure, and sustained. He emphasized the need for an effective mechanism to deliver aid into southern Gaza, and reiterated the UN's call for an immediate humanitarian ceasefire. On Friday, international aid continued to accumulate in Egypt near the Gaza border. Many Palestinians are facing dire shortages of food and water after persistent bombardment by Israel, following the deadliest attack in the country's history. The UN reports that more than one million of Gaza's 2.4 million residents have been displaced, with the humanitarian situation worsening daily. While Egyptian state-affiliated broadcaster Al Qahera News initially reported that the Rafah crossing would open on Friday, authorities later said more time was needed to repair the roads. Israel has pledged to destroy Hamas after the group launched a large-scale attack from Gaza on October 7, killing at least 1,400 people, mostly civilians, according to Israeli officials. In response, Israeli airstrikes have destroyed entire city blocks in Gaza in preparation for a ground offensive. The Hamas-run health ministry reports that over 3,785 Palestinians, the majority civilians, have been killed in the bombings to date.

'U naprednim smo pregovorima sa svim relevantnim stranama kako bismo osigurali što brži početak humanitarne operacije u Gazi. Prva isporuka trebala bi uskoro početi,' rekao je šef humanitarnih poslova UN-a Martin Griffiths, kako je citirao njegov portparol Jens Laerke u Ženevi. Laerke je novinarima rekao da ne može dati tačno vrijeme kada će ove aktivnosti započeti, ali se nada da će početi što prije, na siguran, zaštićen i održiv način. Naglasio je potrebu za efikasnim mehanizmom isporuke pomoći u južnu Gazu, te ponovio UN-ov poziv za hitno humanitarno primirje. U petak je međunarodna pomoć nastavila pristizati u Egipat blizu granice s Gazom. Mnogi Palestinci suočavaju se s ozbiljnim nedostatkom hrane i vode nakon kontinuiranog bombardovanja od strane Izraela, što je uslijedilo nakon najsmrtonosnijeg napada u istoriji te zemlje. article_content: India is confronting countervailing duty (CVD) measures imposed by the United States and the European Union on at least two products as a result of its Remission of Duties or Taxes on Export Products (RODTEP) scheme. Introduced to replace the Merchandise Export Incentive Scheme (MEIS), RODTEP aims to reimburse exporters for various levies on their goods. However, both the US and EU argue that the RODTEP scheme does not comply with World Trade Organization (WTO) regulations. Last month, the US imposed CVDs on Indian file folders, dismissing the Indian government’s claims of WTO compliance for RODTEP. Previously, the EU determined that certain graphite electrode systems from India were benefiting from subsidies under RODTEP and consequently imposed countervailing duties. While the immediate financial consequences of these duties appear limited, trade experts warn that India must prepare for a broader confrontation. The Indian government maintains that RODTEP adheres to WTO norms, enabling tax-free exports, but the US and EU remain steadfast in their opposition. Mukesh Bhatnagar, former professor at the Centre for WTO Studies, recommends that India take a proactive approach. He suggests presenting comprehensive breakdowns of taxes built into exports—such as fuel taxes, electricity duties, and mandi tax—to reinforce RODTEP’s WTO compliance. 'We will have to take up this issue bilaterally with the US and EU... We may also have to explore our options to take up this issue as a formal WTO dispute,' Bhatnagar told TOI. The resolution of these CVD cases could have significant implications for the global acceptance and future implementation of India’s RODTEP scheme.

Ovaj program je uveden kao zamjena za Merchandise Export Incentive Scheme (MEIS) i ima za cilj nadoknaditi izvoznicima različite dažbine na robu. Međutim, SAD i EU tvrde da RODTEP nije usklađen s pravilima Svjetske trgovinske organizacije (WTO). Prošlog mjeseca SAD su uvele CVD na indijske fascikle, odbacujući tvrdnje indijske vlade o usklađenosti RODTEP-a s regulativama WTO-a. Ranije je EU zaključila da su određeni grafitni elektrodni sistemi iz Indije subvencionisani kroz RODTEP te je uvedena kontradampinška dažbina. Iako su neposredne finansijske posljedice trenutno ograničene, trgovinski stručnjaci upozoravaju da se Indija mora pripremiti za širu borbu. Indijska vlada tvrdi da je RODTEP u skladu s WTO normama i omogućava izvoz bez poreza, ali SAD i EU ostaju pri svom stavu. Mukesh Bhatnagar, bivši profesor Centra za WTO studije, preporučuje proaktivan pristup. Predlaže predstavljanje detaljne analize poreza uključenih u izvoz – poput poreza na gorivo, električnu energiju i 'mandi' porez – radi dodatnog dokazivanja usklađenosti RODTEP-a s WTO-om. "Morat ćemo to riješiti bilateralno sa SAD i EU... Možda će biti potrebno razmotriti i formalni spor u okviru WTO-a," izjavio je Bhatnagar za TOI. Ishod ovih CVD slučajeva mogao bi snažno uticati na globalno prihvatanje i buduću implementaciju programa RODTEP.

article_content:
On the morning of November 22, 1963, Lee Harvey Oswald left his Dallas home for work at the Texas School Book Depository, carrying little more than a wallet with identification and family photos. Just hours later, the 24-year-old, known for his Communist sympathies, would irrevocably alter American history by firing three shots at President John F. Kennedy as his motorcade passed through Dealey Plaza. Oswald was arrested about an hour after the assassination, charged with killing both the president and a Dallas police officer, J. D. Tippit. Two days later, Oswald himself was fatally shot on live television.

A new exhibit at the Newseum in Washington, DC, entitled 'Three Shots Were Fired,' commemorates the 50th anniversary of Kennedy's assassination by displaying never-before-seen artifacts from that day. Among the items on display are personal belongings found on Oswald at the time of his arrest, including the brown button-down shirt he wore, his wallet containing photos, ID cards, and a Fair Play for Cuba Committee card. Some of these items show traces of chemical stains from fingerprinting. The exhibit also features the blanket Oswald used to hide his rifle at a friend's house and the jacket believed to have been discarded after he shot Officer Tippit.

Artifacts related to the tragedy extend to the famous Bell & Howell 8mm camera used by Abraham Zapruder, the only eyewitness to capture the entire assassination on film. Additional items include Kennedy’s Air Force One typewriter, police radio logs from the day, Jacqueline Kennedy’s schedule for November 21-22, and the Secret Service agent's revolver used during the aftermath of the shooting. 

Visitors can also view photographs by Jacques Lowe, such as an iconic family portrait and an image of Kennedy from 1959, which was later used by his widow on his memorial card. The 'Three Shots Were Fired' exhibit runs through January 5, 2014, alongside 'Creating Camelot,' a photo exhibit, and a documentary about Kennedy’s presidency.

Ujutro 22. novembra 1963. godine, Lee Harvey Oswald napustio je svoj dom u Dallasu i otišao na posao u zgradu Texas School Book Depository, noseći samo novčanik s ličnim ispravama i porodičnim fotografijama. Samo nekoliko sati kasnije, 24-godišnjak poznat po svojim komunističkim simpatijama, nepovratno je promijenio tok američke istorije ispaljivanjem tri metka na predsjednika Johna F. Kennedyja dok je njegova kolona prolazila kroz Dealey Plazu. Oswald je uhapšen otprilike sat vremena nakon atentata, optužen za ubistvo predsjednika i policajca iz Dallasa, J. D. Tippita. Dva dana kasnije, Oswald je i sam bio smrtno ranjen pred televizijskim kamerama uživo.

Nova izložba u Newseumu u Washingtonu, pod nazivom 'Ispaljena su tri metka', obilježava 50. godišnjicu Kennedyjevog atentata prikazujući nikad ranije viđene eksponate s tog dana. Među izloženim predmetima su i lične stvari pronađene kod Oswalda prilikom hapšenja, uključujući smeđu košulju koju je nosio, novčanik sa slikama, ličnim kartama i članskom kartom Fair Play for Cuba Committee. Neki od tih predmeta pokazuju tragove hemikalija korištenih za uzimanje otisaka prstiju. Izložba također uključuje ćebe kojim je Oswald skrivao pušku u kući prijatelja i jaknu za koju se vjeruje da ju je odbacio nakon što je pucao na policajca Tippita.

Među eksponatima vezanim za tragediju nalazi se i čuvena Bell & Howell 8mm kamera kojom je Abraham Zapruder kao jedini svjedok snimio čitav atentat. Dodatni eksponati uključuju Kennedyjevu pisaću mašinu sa Air Force One, policijske radio zapise s tog dana, raspored Jacqueline Kennedy za 21. i 22. novembar te revolver pripadnika Tajne službe korišten neposredno nakon pucnjave.

Posjetioci mogu pogledati i fotografije Jacquesa Lowea, poput poznatog porodičnog portreta i slike Kennedyja iz 1959. godine, koja je kasnije korištena na memorijalnoj karti njegove udovice. Izložba 'Ispaljena su tri metka' trajat će do 5. januara 2014. godine, uz izložbu fotografija 'Stvaranje Camelota' i dokumentarac o Kennedyjevoj predsjedničkoj karijeri.

On Tuesday, a Polish prosecutor requested that a regional court in Krakow consider whether to extradite acclaimed film director Roman Polanski to the United States, where he is wanted for engaging in unlawful sex with a minor in the 1970s. According to a statement from the regional prosecutor's office, the court will oversee further procedures in the case. Mateusz Martyniuk, spokesperson for the prosecutor, stated that it may take several weeks for the court to reach a decision.

U.S. authorities have made ongoing efforts to return Polanski to the U.S. to face sentencing regarding the decades-old case. In 1977, Polanski pleaded guilty in California to having unlawful sex with Samantha Geimer, who was 13 years old at the time, while he was 43. Before he could be sentenced, Polanski left for Europe. In 1997, Geimer publicly forgave Polanski and has since requested that the case be dropped.

Polanski, best known for directing "The Pianist," holds both French and Polish citizenship. He has expressed intentions to film a movie in Poland, the homeland of his parents, in the coming spring.

The Krakow prosecutor’s move follows a prior request from U.S. officials, which led to authorities questioning Polanski three months ago. After the interview, he was permitted to leave. At that time, a spokesperson for the Polish prosecutor general's office indicated that authorities did not see the need to detain him while awaiting a U.S. extradition request.

Attempts by the U.S. to extradite Polanski have also previously resulted in his arrest in Switzerland in 2009. However, Swiss authorities ultimately rejected the American request in 2010, citing insufficient legal documentation from the U.S. and Polanski’s reasonable belief that he would not be detained. This was outlined by Justice Minister Eveline Widmer-Schlumpf.

In addition to his Oscar win for "The Pianist," Polanski has received Academy Award nominations for "Tess" and "Chinatown."

Prema izjavi regionalnog tužilaštva, sud će dalje voditi postupak u ovom slučaju. Mateusz Martyniuk, portparol tužilaštva, izjavio je da će sudu možda trebati nekoliko sedmica da donese odluku.

Američke vlasti više puta su pokušavale vratiti Polanskog u SAD na izricanje kazne vezano za decenijama star slučaj. Polanski je 1977. godine priznao krivicu u Kaliforniji zbog nezakonitog seksa sa Samanthom Geimer, koja je tada imala 13 godina, dok je on imao 43. Prije izricanja presude, Polanski je napustio SAD i otišao u Europu. Geimer je 1997. godine javno oprostila Polanskom i kasnije tražila da se slučaj obustavi.

Polanski, najpoznatiji po režiji filma "Pijanista", ima i francusko i poljsko državljanstvo. Najavio je da namjerava snimati film u Poljskoj, domovini svojih roditelja, ovog proljeća.

Postupak krakovskog tužioca uslijedio je nakon ranijeg zahtjeva američkih zvaničnika, što je dovelo do toga da su vlasti prije tri mjeseca ispitale Polanskog i dozvolile mu da ode nakon razgovora. Tada je portparol ureda glavnog tužioca izjavio da vlasti ne vide potrebu da ga zadrže dok čekaju američki zahtjev za izručenje.

Pokušaji SAD-a da izruče Polanskog ranije su doveli i do njegovog hapšenja u Švicarskoj 2009. Međutim, švicarske vlasti su 2010. odbile američki zahtjev, navodeći da SAD nisu dostavile sve potrebne pravne dokumente i da je Polanski imao opravdano očekivanje da neće biti uhapšen. Ovo je tada izjavila ministrica pravde Eveline Widmer-Schlumpf.

Pored Oskara za "Pijanistu", Polanski ima i nominacije za nagradu Akademije za filmove "Tess" i "Kineska četvrt".

article_content: Pay and bonuses for Goldman Sachs bankers have risen by 10 percent, with employees earning an average of £170,000 in just the first six months of the year. While this figure includes staff in back office and temporary roles, top earners are likely to have received much higher payouts. Goldman Sachs, which employs 31,700 people worldwide—including 6,000 in the UK—saw total pay for its staff swell to £5.3 billion in the first half of the year. This substantial increase has drawn criticism, particularly as it comes at a time when many families continue to face financial hardships. Some have described the situation as 'reminiscent of the pre-crisis days.' The Wall Street bank also reported a sharp increase in profits, with its pre-tax profits for the last three months rising by 87 percent to £1.7 billion, and first-half profits reaching £4 billion. Chief executive Lloyd Blankfein described the results as 'solid.' David Hillman, representing the Robin Hood Tax campaign, commented that Goldman Sachs’s profit announcement is out of step with the rest of the economy and evokes memories of the period before the financial crisis. He called for governments to address this disparity and end a two-tiered economy that favors banks. Last year, despite the global downturn, Goldman paid its staff more than £8 billion, an average of £250,000 each. Earlier this year, the bank faced heavy criticism over a proposed scheme to help its bankers avoid tax by delaying bonuses until after a decrease in the top UK tax rate from 50p to 45p took effect on April 6. Goldman Sachs reversed the plan following public backlash.

Iako ova brojka uključuje pomoćno i privremeno osoblje, najbolji uposlenici vjerovatno su dobili puno veće iznose. Goldman Sachs, koji zapošljava 31.700 ljudi širom svijeta – uključujući 6.000 u Ujedinjenom Kraljevstvu – u prvoj polovini godine isplatio je ukupno 5,3 milijarde funti svojim zaposlenima. Ovaj značajan porast izazvao je kritike, posebno jer dolazi u vrijeme kada se mnoge porodice još uvijek suočavaju s finansijskim poteškoćama. Glavni izvršni direktor Lloyd Blankfein opisao je rezultate kao 'solidne.' David Hillman, predstavnik Robin Hood Tax kampanje, izjavio je da je profit Goldman Sachsa izvan ravnoteže sa ostatkom ekonomije i podsjeća na period prije finansijske krize. Pozvao je vlade da riješe ovu neravnotežu i okončaju dvostruku ekonomiju koja pogoduje bankama. Prošle godine, uprkos globalnoj recesiji, Goldman je zaposlenicima isplatio više od 8 milijardi funti, u prosjeku 250.000 po osobi. Ranije ove godine banka je bila žestoko kritizirana zbog prijedloga da svojim bankarima odgodi isplatu bonusa dok ne stupi na snagu smanjenje najviše porezne stope u UK sa 50 na 45 penija – 6. aprila. Goldman Sachs je odustao od tog plana nakon javnog negodovanja.

The U.S. government has officially declared 21 animal species extinct, removing them from the Endangered Species Act list, the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS) announced this week. Most of these species—primarily birds and some marine mammals—had long been presumed lost. Notably, the ivory-billed woodpecker received a temporary reprieve, as dedicated birdwatchers continue efforts to confirm its survival in the American South.

The full list of extinct species includes one mammal, the Little Mariana fruit bat from Guam; 10 birds, including the Molokai creeper, Large Kauai thrush, and Kauai akialoa—most native to Hawaii, with others from Florida and Guam—and two fish, the San Marcos gambusia and the Scioto madtom. The remainder are freshwater mussels, largely from Gulf states. The FWS first proposed delisting these species in 2021. Some, like one bird species, have not been seen since 1899, while the most recently observed was last sighted in 2004.

FWS Director Martha Williams said, “Federal protection came too late to reverse these species’ decline, and it’s a wake-up call on the importance of conserving imperiled species before it’s too late.” As the Endangered Species Act celebrates its 50th anniversary, Williams emphasized its role as a crucial safety net to prevent extinction, with the ultimate goal of helping species recover so they no longer need protection.

The extinction of native species is a warning sign of ecosystem distress. Many disappear due to habitat loss from human activity and urban development; others are affected by rapid environmental changes, including those driven by climate change. Invasive species further threaten native wildlife by predation or resource competition. For instance, Hawaiian honeycreepers went extinct largely due to habitat loss and diseases spread by introduced mosquitoes, according to NPR.

Occasionally, species believed extinct are rediscovered—these “Lazarus species” offer hope, but most delisted species are permanently gone. Karina Menzies, a 31-year-old mother of three, was laid to rest today in Cardiff, South Wales, three weeks after she was killed in a hit-and-run incident while saving her children. The funeral took place at the Church of Resurrection in Ely, where hundreds gathered to honor her life and bravery. Despite suffering from a nerve condition that weakened her legs, Ms. Menzies managed to push her two young daughters to safety before being fatally struck by a van on October 19. Thirteen others, including seven children, were injured in the attack as the driver sped through the streets targeting families returning home from school.

During the service, touching tributes were paid by family members, including messages from her daughters. Ellie wrote, "I will never forget you. I love you. Sweet dreams, goodbye, love from Ellie." Another daughter, Sophie, described her mother as "brave" for saving her sisters' lives. Reverend Jan Gould praised Ms. Menzies' courage and deep love for her children, saying, "She paid the ultimate price to save them. There is no clearer sign of the depth of her love."

Ms. Menzies’ coffin, decorated with her favorite leopard print pattern, was transported to the church by a horse-drawn glass hearse, with a single floral arrangement spelling 'mum'. The large turnout meant many mourners stood outside as the service was broadcast for those unable to enter. The close-knit community continues to mourn her sudden loss.

Reverend Gould described Ms. Menzies as intelligent, outgoing, and fun-loving, expressing that her qualities would live on in her daughters. She emphasized Ms. Menzies' love for music and fashion, and how she always managed to create beauty for her family. After the service, her sister Sam and other relatives pledged to care for Ms. Menzies’ daughters.

Police have charged a 31-year-old local man with murder, 13 counts of attempted murder, dangerous driving, and four counts of assault occasioning actual bodily harm.

article_content: Nearly four months after the HMS Bounty was lost to Hurricane Sandy, Claudia McCann, widow of Captain Robin Walbridge, is still impacted by the story of her husband's last moments. The 50-year-old historic replica ship struggled against the storm off North Carolina when Walbridge ordered his 15-person crew to abandon ship. Notably, he made sure to take a beloved photograph of Claudia before leaving. Claudia, mourning her husband, listens to survivor accounts in her St. Petersburg home and firmly defends him, asserting he was a careful and compassionate leader. There's ongoing debate in the sailing community over the decision to set sail as the hurricane neared, but the U.S. Coast Guard is now investigating the causes and possible negligence in the tragedy. Walbridge, admired in the maritime world for his positivity and calm, sustained injuries during the chaos and needed help donning his survival suit. Claudia tells of receiving his final message saying he would abandon ship, but reassuring her that the Coast Guard was aware of their situation. While the Coast Guard saved most of the crew, both Walbridge and crewmember Claudene Christian were lost. After four days and an extensive search, the Coast Guard ended their efforts, leaving Claudia without answers or her husband's remains. As Claudia holds onto cherished memories, she is comforted by family, friends, and the heartfelt tributes from surviving crew members. Many described how Walbridge deeply influenced their lives. Despite losing many keepsakes to the ocean, Claudia reflects that the most profound loss is her soulmate, Robin, yet finds solace in believing he acted true to his values right to the end.

Historijska replika broda stara 50 godina borila se protiv oluje blizu obale Sjeverne Karoline, kada je Walbridge naredio svojoj 15-članoj posadi da napusti brod. U pomorskoj zajednici još uvijek se raspravlja o odluci da se krene na put dok je uragan bio na vidiku, ali američka Obalna straža sada istražuje uzroke i eventualni nemar u ovoj tragediji. Nakon četverodnevne potrage, Obalna straža prekinula je akciju, ostavljajući Claudiju bez zaključka i bez suprugovih ostataka. Claudia se okreće dragocjenim uspomenama i utjehu pronalazi u porodici, prijateljima i toplim porukama preživjelih članova posade. Mnogi su istakli kako je Walbridge snažno uticao na njihove živote. Scientists estimate there are about one million near-Earth asteroids that could potentially threaten Earth, but only a small fraction has been found so far. Ed Lu, a former astronaut, cautions that we've been spared from disaster mainly by luck, calling the risk 'cosmic roulette.' In response to this danger, the United Nations Committee on the Peaceful Uses of Outer Space established the International Analysis and Warning Network (IAWN). This network is responsible for collecting and analyzing asteroid data to provide advance warnings to governments. IAWN aims to enhance collaboration, bringing together various existing monitoring groups for greater expertise. Another organization, the Space Mission Planning Advisory Group (SMPAG), coordinates international cooperation so that space agencies from North and South America, Europe, Asia, and Africa can work together to prepare for possible asteroid threats.

The asteroid threat became evident when, in February 2013, a meteor exploded over Chelyabinsk, Russia. The explosion was powerful, causing widespread damage and injuring many people—a reminder of past incidents like the 1908 Tunguska event. To address such dangers, researchers have proposed creative solutions. For example, U.S. scientists described the Hypervelocity Asteroid Intercept Vehicle (HAIV), a spacecraft system that could intercept and destroy an incoming asteroid using a nuclear device. With enough warning, this system could be quickly launched to protect the planet.

Space agencies aren't handling the challenge alone. NASA has encouraged public involvement by launching the Asteroid Data Hunter contest, offering up to $35,000 for improved computer algorithms that can help spot dangerous asteroids and reduce false positives in telescope images. While NASA says it has found 98% of the large, kilometer-sized, near-Earth asteroids in the last twenty years, current detection systems can still track only about 1% of all objects orbiting the Sun. The quest for better detection and response is ongoing, with partners like Planetary Resources supporting NASA’s work. At the SXSW conference, NASA scientist Jason Kessler commented that while an asteroid impact in the future is almost certain, there’s currently no cause for alarm. Continued collaboration among space agencies, researchers, and the public hopes to improve our readiness for any future threats.

article_content: When hearing that an academic has won the Nobel Prize, people often assume they were always brilliant and destined for success. However, Cambridge scientist Sir John Gurdon, who was recently awarded the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine, challenges this view. He revealed that his school science report started with the word 'Disastrous' and only got worse. His biology teacher wrote: 'I believe he has ideas about becoming a scientist. On his present performance this is quite ridiculous; if he can't learn simple biological facts, he has no chance of succeeding as a specialist. It would be a waste of time for him and his teachers.' Sir John Gurdon, who won the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine in October, once received just two marks out of a possible 50 on an assignment at Eton College, ranking last in his class of eighteen. Despite this, the now 79-year-old Gurdon has led the field of cloning and cell research for decades. While some have raised ethical concerns about his research, no one questions his brilliance or dedication. His work directly led to the cloning of Dolly the Sheep, and he has also defended genetically modified crops. Even when serving as Master of Magdalene College at Cambridge, Gurdon remained committed to his laboratory work, maintaining scientific productivity alongside administrative duties. Some people might think Gurdon's science teacher was mistaken, similar to the Munich teacher who once dismissed Albert Einstein’s potential. Yet, it’s possible that the critical, honest feedback Gurdon received contributed to his drive for success. Today, many schools emphasize continuous praise, even for minimal achievements, with criticism often discouraged. The recent decision to increase English GCSE standards, and to recognize that some students struggle with basic skills, was met with opposition. Currently, detailed school reports and constructive criticism are rare in state schools, often seen as too harsh. However, without being told they could improve, students miss opportunities to get better, especially when high grades are too easily awarded. This contrasts with the honest feedback Gurdon once received. In past cases, many successful individuals had critical school reports. Winston Churchill, for example, was seen as a troublemaker by teachers, yet this became part of his unique character. While some education systems focused on well-rounded praise, others noted students’ conduct and abilities, such as Hitler in Austria. Over recent decades, especially since the 1970s, there has been a move away from correcting students and maintaining high standards in core subjects. This has led to a decline in areas like maths, science, languages, and history, whereas subjects without clear right or wrong answers have gained popularity. Groundbreaking medical research, like Gurdon's, relies on knowledge and informed critique, which requires honest feedback from teachers. As British politicians push for more university students, it’s crucial to question the value if they’re not learning rigorous or useful subjects. Honest feedback, like that given by Gurdon's teacher, can be essential for personal and academic growth.

Danas mnoge škole naglašavaju stalne pohvale, čak i za minimalna postignuća, dok je kritika često obeshrabrivana. Nedavna odluka da se podignu standardi za engleski GCSE i prizna da neki učenici imaju osnovne poteškoće, naišla je na protivljenje. Trenutno su detaljni školski izvještaji i konstruktivna kritika rijetki u državnim školama jer se smatraju preoštrom. Ipak, bez rečenog da mogu biti bolji, učenici gube priliku da napreduju, posebno kada se visoke ocjene dijele prelagano. To je suprotno iskrenoj povratnoj informaciji koju je Gurdon jednom dobio. U prošlosti, mnoge uspješne osobe dobijale su kritične školske izvještaje. Na primjer, Winstona Churchilla su nastavnici smatrali problematičnim, a to je postalo dio njegove posebnosti. Dok su neki obrazovni sistemi naglašavali pohvale, drugi su zapažali ponašanje i sposobnosti učenika, kao što je bio slučaj s Hitlerom u Austriji. Tokom posljednjih decenija, posebno od 1970-ih, zabilježen je odmak od ispravljanja učenika i održavanja visokih standarda u osnovnim predmetima. To je dovelo do pada nivoa u matematici, nauci, jezicima i historiji, dok su popularniji predmeti bez jasnih tačnih ili netačnih odgovora. Revolucionarna medicinska istraživanja poput Gurdonovih oslanjaju se na znanje i argumentiranu kritiku, što zahtijeva iskrenu povratnu informaciju nastavnika. Dok političari u Britaniji žele više studenata na univerzitetima, važno je upitati se šta studenti zaista uče. Iskrena povratna informacija, kakvu je Gurdon dobio, može biti ključna za lični i akademski razvoj.

article_content: For years, admirers of John Keats have flocked to the scenic meadows of Hampshire, thought to have inspired the celebrated line 'Season of mists and mellow fruitfulness' from his ‘Ode to Autumn.’ However, recent research from Aberystwyth University reveals that the true site that inspired Keats may now lie beneath a multi-storey car park in Winchester. After examining a historic guidebook and an early 19th-century engraving of Winchester, researchers identified a cornfield on the side of St Giles Hill—directly beneath what is now the car park—as the likely spot described in Keats's poem. This finding challenges long-held traditions, including the popular 'Keats Walk,' which guides tourists through lush meadows by the River Itchen. Professor Richard Marggraf Turley explained that their research sheds new light on the poem, providing historical context that highlights issues like land ownership and social inequities in Keats’s time. Land records confirm the cornfield belonged to the city before being controversially sold to a private landowner, Nicholas Waller—a detail that could imbue the poem with greater political significance. Local tourism officials, including Rachel Gander from Winchester Tourist Information and Ellen Simpson from Winchester City Council, expressed surprise but are open to updating their materials and possibly highlighting the new site. Jayne Elizabeth Archer, co-author of the forthcoming research paper in the Review of English Studies, reflected on Winchester’s lost historical treasure, now buried beneath the urban landscape.
translated_content: Godinama su obožavatelji Johna Keatsa posjećivali slikovite livade u Hampshireu, za koje se vjerovalo da su nadahnule poznati stih 'Sezona magli i zrelog plodova' iz njegove 'Ode jeseni'. Međutim, nedavno istraživanje sa Univerziteta Aberystwyth otkriva da se stvarno mjesto koje je nadahnulo Keatsa sada možda nalazi ispod višespratne garaže u Winchesteru. Nakon proučavanja historijskog vodiča i gravure Winchestera iz ranog 19. stoljeća, istraživači su identificirali polje kukuruza na strani St Giles Hill-a—upravo ispod današnje garaže—kao vjerovatno mjesto koje opisuje Keatsova pjesma. Ovo otkriće dovodi u pitanje dugogodišnje tradicije, uključujući popularnu 'Keatsovu šetnju', kojom turiste vode kroz zelene livade pored rijeke Itchen. Profesor Richard Marggraf Turley objasnio je da njihovo istraživanje baca novo svjetlo na pjesmu, pružajući historijski kontekst koji ističe pitanja vlasništva nad zemljom i društvenih nejednakosti u Keatsovo vrijeme. Zemljišne knjige potvrđuju da je polje kukuruza bilo u vlasništvu grada prije nego što je, uz kontroverzu, prodano privatnom vlasniku Nicholasu Walleru—detalj koji pjesmi može dati veće političko značenje. Lokalni turistički zvaničnici, uključujući Rachel Gander iz Turističkog ureda Winchestera i Ellen Simpson iz Gradskog vijeća Winchestera, izrazili su iznenađenje, ali su spremni ažurirati infomaterijale i potencijalno istaknuti novu lokaciju. Jayne Elizabeth Archer, suautorica nadolazećeg rada u časopisu Review of English Studies, osvrnula se na to kako je Winchester dugo imao skriveno historijsko blago ispod urbane površine.

article_content: An incident took place at Sydney Airport when a dispute arose between a passenger and an Emirates flight attendant over luggage at a baggage carousel. The flight attendant alleged that the passenger directed a homophobic slur at him during the confrontation. Four Australian Federal Police officers attended the scene at carousel four shortly after 7pm. The incident involved passengers from Emirates flight EK413, which had just arrived from Auckland. Video footage captured the flight attendant saying, 'This man is discriminating, he called me a [homophobic slur].' The passenger had reportedly expressed frustration about the number of crew bags obstructing access to the carousel. Police interviewed both individuals and took down their details. According to an AFP spokesperson, the airline employee requested an apology, which the passenger subsequently gave. The authorities consider the matter resolved. Emirates has been approached for comment, while Sydney Airport declined to comment.

Incident je uključivao putnike sa leta Emirates EK413 koji je upravo stigao iz Aucklanda. Video snimak prikazuje stjuarda kako govori: 'Ovaj čovjek me diskriminiše, nazvao me je [homofobična uvreda].' Navodi se da je putnik bio nezadovoljan zbog broja torbi posade koje su blokirale pristup traci za prtljagu. Policija je razgovarala s oba pojedinca i evidentirala njihove podatke. article_content: A wave of demonstrations has swept through numerous Muslim-majority nations after an anti-Islam film produced in the United States surfaced on the internet. Directed by Nakoula Basseley Nakoula, the film 'Innocence of Muslims' has been widely viewed as offensive, sparking widespread outrage. From North Africa to Southeast Asia, protests have ranged from peaceful assemblies to violent confrontations. Egyptian demonstrators clashed with security forces outside the U.S. Embassy in Cairo, resulting in injuries and dozens of arrests. In Libya, the U.S. consulate in Benghazi suffered a deadly attack that claimed the lives of Ambassador Chris Stevens and three other American staff. Secretary of State Hillary Clinton denounced the inflammatory film and called on governments to safeguard diplomatic facilities and pursue those involved in attacks. The United Nations Security Council echoed this sentiment, issuing a statement condemning violence against embassies. In Tunisia, the birthplace of the Arab Spring, protestors broke into the U.S. embassy compound, damaging vehicles and a nearby school. The interim president lamented the violence, which led to at least two deaths, and criticized both the film and the aggressive actions of some protestors, vowing to seek legal action against the filmmaker. Sudan, Lebanon, and Yemen also witnessed unrest: the German Embassy in Khartoum was breached; a KFC restaurant was set ablaze in Tripoli, Lebanon—leaving one dead and several wounded; and Yemeni authorities deployed security to prevent crowds from reaching the U.S. Embassy. Afghanistan saw its first protest on Friday and promptly imposed a YouTube block to limit access to the film. To address the rising security threats, the United States sent Marine units and surveillance drones to Libya and reinforced security at other diplomatic missions in the region. Investigations into the Benghazi attack continue, with several individuals detained. However, officials have stated that there is still no confirmed evidence directly linking the suspects to the deadly assault. Officials reiterated that the U.S. government had no involvement with or endorsement of the film, emphasizing that free speech laws do not equate to official support for such content. Early reports erroneously suggested Israeli or Jewish backing of the film, claims which have been firmly denied. These incidents have led to strained relations and underscored long-standing challenges in maintaining the security of diplomatic outposts during times of political upheaval.

Od Sjeverne Afrike do jugoistočne Azije, protesti su varirali od mirnih okupljanja do nasilnih sukoba. U Egiptu su demonstranti sukobili sa snagama sigurnosti ispred američke ambasade u Kairu, što je dovelo do povrijeđenih i desetina uhapšenih. U Libiji, američki konzulat u Bengaziju bio je poprište smrtonosnog napada u kojem su ubijeni ambasador Chris Stevens i još troje američkih službenika. Nemiri su zabilježeni i u Sudanu, Libanu i Jemenu: provaljeno je u njemačku ambasadu u Kartumu; restoran KFC zapaljen je u Tripoliju (Liban), što je rezultiralo jednom poginulom osobom i nekoliko povrijeđenih; a jemenske vlasti rasporedile su sigurnosne snage kako bi spriječile mase da dođu do američke ambasade. Zvaničnici su ponovo naglasili da američka vlada nema veze s filmom niti ga podržava, ističući da zakoni o slobodi govora ne znače zvanično odobravanje takvog sadržaja. Prve vijesti pogrešno su sugerirale izraelsku ili jevrejsku podršku filmu, što je odlučno demantirano. Ovi događaji doveli su do zatezanja odnosa i dodatno naglasili dugogodišnje izazove u zaštiti diplomatskih predstavništava tokom političkih previranja.

article_content: The documented death toll in war-torn Syria has reached 92,901, according to the United Nations. U.N. High Commissioner for Human Rights Navi Pillay announced the updated figure on Thursday, based on an analysis by experts covering March 2011 through April 2013. "Unfortunately, as the study shows, this likely represents only the minimum number of casualties," said Pillay. "The actual number of those killed may be much higher." The report reveals a steep rise in monthly documented killings, increasing from around 1,000 per month in summer 2011 to over 5,000 per month since July 2012. Pillay said, "This extremely high rate of killings, sustained month after month, reflects the sharply worsening pattern of the conflict over the past year." Nearly 83% of the recorded victims are male, about 8% are female, and the remainder's gender is not specified. The report also records the deaths of more than 6,500 minors, over a quarter of whom were under the age of 10. Due to limitations in the available data, the study could not consistently distinguish between combatants and non-combatants. Additionally, approximately three-quarters of the reported deaths did not include the victim's age.
translated_content: Dokumentovani broj smrtnih slučajeva u ratom pogođenoj Siriji dostigao je 92.901, prema podacima Ujedinjenih nacija. Visoka komesarka Ujedinjenih nacija za ljudska prava, Navi Pillay, objavila je najnoviju brojku u četvrtak, na osnovu analize stručnjaka koja obuhvata period od marta 2011. do aprila 2013. "Nažalost, kako studija pokazuje, ovo vjerovatno predstavlja samo minimalan broj žrtava," rekla je Pillay. "Stvarni broj ubijenih mogao bi biti i mnogo veći." Izvještaj otkriva nagli porast mjesečnih dokumentovanih ubistava, od oko 1.000 mjesečno tokom ljeta 2011. do preko 5.000 mjesečno od jula 2012. Pillay je izjavila: "Ova izuzetno visoka stopa ubistava, iz mjeseca u mjesec, odražava oštro pogoršanje sukoba tokom protekle godine." Gotovo 83% evidentiranih žrtava su muškarci, oko 8% žene, dok za preostale nije naveden spol. Izvještaj također bilježi smrt više od 6.500 maloljetnika, od kojih je više od četvrtine bilo mlađe od 10 godina. Zbog ograničenja dostupnih podataka, studija nije mogla dosljedno razlikovati borce od civila. Također, za otprilike tri četvrtine prijavljenih smrti nije naveden uzrast žrtve.

The Super Eagles have opened their training camp in Portugal today ahead of international friendlies against Saudi Arabia and Mozambique. Head coach Jose Peseiro’s team will take on Saudi Arabia’s Green Falcons in Portimão on Friday before facing the Mambas of Mozambique in the same city three days later. 

The Eagles arrive with momentum, having recently secured qualification for the 2024 Africa Cup of Nations in Ivory Coast and currently enjoying a three-game winning streak. Coach Peseiro has announced a 25-man squad for these friendlies, recalling defenders Kenneth Omeruo and Bright Osayi-Samuel, midfielder Alex Iwobi, and forward Terem Moffi—all of whom missed last month’s qualifier win over Sao Tome and Principe in Uyo.

Notably, Ahmed Musa and William Troost-Ekong have been left out of the squad, while Taiwo Awoniyi, Ola Aina, and Jamilu Collins withdrew due to injuries. Their absences made room for Sadiq Umar, Tyronne Ebuehi, and Chidozie Awaziem to return. Boavista defender Bruno Onyemaechi is expected to be among the first players to arrive at camp today.

These two friendlies serve as warm-up matches ahead of Nigeria’s 2026 FIFA World Cup qualifying campaign. The three-time African champions will take on Lesotho’s Crocodiles in Uyo on November 17 and then travel to Zimbabwe for another qualifier four days later.

The Israel-Gaza conflict has rapidly intensified and now poses a serious risk of expanding into a broader regional crisis. As the fighting enters its fourth week, developments are unfolding quickly and the humanitarian toll continues to mount. The conflict intensified following Hamas’s attack on southern Israel on October 7, in which 1,405 people were killed and at least 200 were taken hostage. In retaliation, Israel launched a large-scale military operation in Gaza, resulting in over 7,000 fatalities to date, with numbers rising by the hour.

The crisis is also shaped by a battle of narratives: Western nations largely support Israel, while Palestinians and many Middle Eastern countries draw attention to the decades of conflict endured in the region. This escalation follows a long history marked by injustice, dispossession, and repeated clashes. Comprehensive explainers from Al Jazeera provide historical context, tracing the roots of the conflict back to major milestones such as the Balfour Declaration and the Nakba, highlighting how these events have shaped current realities over the decades.

The article examines the complexities of governance in Palestinian territories, noting that while Hamas controls Gaza, the West Bank remains under the Palestinian Authority (PA), whose power has significantly diminished, especially after losing Gaza following a civil war in 2007. The ongoing conflict raises questions about the future of the PA, especially as tensions rise along Israel’s northern border with Hezbollah in Lebanon, adding to fears of a potential regional war.

Before the current hostilities, Gaza had already suffered under a 16-year blockade that created a severe humanitarian crisis, one now exacerbated by conflict. The Rafah border crossing is a critical point for humanitarian aid and potential evacuations, but its control and operation are complicated by ongoing negotiations and shifting circumstances.

Truth itself is often a casualty in war: Debates and misinformation have surrounded incidents such as the al-Ahli hospital explosion, which killed over 400 people, reflecting the confusion and manipulation that often accompany conflict reporting. The suffering of children is especially acute, with many losing their homes, facing shortages of essentials, and enduring psychological trauma. Discussions of international law, such as the Geneva Conventions, highlight the special protections afforded to children during wartime.

Efforts at diplomacy and peacemaking continue, but the rapidly changing situation makes outcomes difficult to predict. The overall picture remains highly volatile, with regional implications and severe humanitarian consequences still unfolding.

Sukob između Izraela i Gaze brzo se intenzivirao i sada predstavlja ozbiljan rizik od širenja u širu regionalnu krizu. Kako borbe ulaze u četvrtu sedmicu, događaji se odvijaju brzo, a humanitarna cijena stalno raste. Sukob je eskalirao nakon napada Hamasa na južni Izrael 7. oktobra, u kojem je ubijeno 1.405 ljudi, a najmanje 200 ih je uzeto za taoce. Kao odgovor, Izrael je pokrenuo veliku vojnu operaciju u Gazi, što je do sada dovelo do više od 7.000 žrtava, a brojke i dalje rastu iz sata u sat.

Kriza je također oblikovana borbom narativa: zapadne zemlje uglavnom podržavaju Izrael, dok Palestinci i mnoge zemlje Bliskog Istoka ukazuju na decenije sukoba koje je regija pretrpjela. Ova eskalacija slijedi dugu historiju obilježenu nepravdom, oduzimanjem imovine i ponovljenim sukobima. Detaljna objašnjenja Al Jazeere daju historijski kontekst, prateći korijene sukoba do važnih prekretnica kao što su Balfourova deklaracija i Nakba, naglašavajući kako su ti događaji oblikovali sadašnju situaciju kroz desetljeća.

Članak istražuje složenost upravljanja palestinskim teritorijama, navodeći da Hamas upravlja Gazom, dok Zapadnu obalu kontroliše Palestinska uprava (PA), čija je moć znatno umanjena, posebno nakon gubitka Gaze 2007. godine nakon građanskog rata. Tekući sukob pokreće pitanja o budućnosti PA, posebno kako napetosti rastu na sjevernoj granici Izraela s Hezbolahom u Libanonu, što dodatno pojačava strah od mogućeg regionalnog rata.

Prije trenutnih neprijateljstava, Gaza je već trpjela pod 16-godišnjom blokadom koja je stvorila ozbiljnu humanitarnu krizu, a sada je sukob dodatno pogoršava. Granični prelaz Rafah ključna je tačka za humanitarnu pomoć i potencijalne evakuacije, ali njegovu kontrolu i rad komplikuju stalni pregovori i promjenjive okolnosti.

Istina je često prva žrtva rata: rasprave i dezinformacije pratile su događaje poput eksplozije u bolnici al-Ahli, u kojoj je poginulo preko 400 ljudi, što odražava konfuziju i manipulaciju koje često prate izvještavanje o sukobima. Patnja djece posebno je izražena, mnogi su izgubili domove, suočeni su s nestašicom osnovnih potrepština i preživljavaju psihološku traumu. Rasprave o međunarodnom pravu, poput Ženevskih konvencija, ističu posebne zaštite koje se djeci pružaju tokom ratnih sukoba.

Diplomatski napori i dalje traju, ali brza promjena situacije otežava predviđanje ishoda. Ukupna slika ostaje vrlo nestabilna, s regionalnim implikacijama i teškim humanitarnim posljedicama koje se i dalje razvijaju.

article_content: Chelsea FC continues its dominance not just on the pitch, but across social media too—especially on Vine, Twitter’s former short video platform. The club leads the Premier League with 102,400 Vine followers, followed by Arsenal (86,900) and Manchester United (83,700). Most Premier League teams have a presence on Vine, using the platform for behind-the-scenes access, team updates, and to highlight community initiatives. Chelsea outshines the rest in both follower numbers and total ‘loops’, which count how many times their Vine videos have been replayed. Data from Brandsonvine and Digiday reveals Chelsea’s Vines have amassed over 15.2 million loops. Liverpool (3.75 million loops) and Manchester City (3.75 million) follow, though at a significant distance. Arsenal and Manchester United also feature among the top-ranked teams. Among Chelsea’s Vines, top hits include manager Jose Mourinho’s Ice Bucket Challenge (4.5 million loops), Cesc Fabregas being welcomed to the club (1.6 million), and Didier Drogba’s homecoming (1.2 million). On a global scale, Chelsea is the most-watched football team on Vine and ranks third among all sports teams worldwide for total loops—behind only the LA Lakers basketball squad and the LA Dodgers baseball team.

article_content: Daniel Flesch, a former University of Illinois student, was unsettled by what he saw as increasing anti-Israeli sentiment. With family members who survived the Holocaust, he felt driven to act against rising anti-Semitism in America. In 2010, he joined Israel's military. "I just didn't want to sit on the sidelines," Flesch, now 26, said in an interview. "I wanted to actively stand up to those who believe Israel and the Jewish people shouldn't exist." He is now a graduate student at Johns Hopkins School of Advanced International Studies in Washington, D.C., and became a 'lone soldier'—someone from another country who voluntarily joins the Israel Defense Forces (IDF). Friends of IDF, a New York-based group supporting Israeli soldiers' welfare, estimates that around 750 Americans are currently serving in the IDF. Interest among Americans in joining the IDF has reportedly increased due to recent conflict between Israel and Hamas, says Orit Mizner, southwest regional director for Friends of Israel Scouts. The organization, through the Garin Tzabar program, assists North American Jews wishing to serve in the IDF. "We keep getting those phone calls—there's definitely a sense that people want to be in Israel and take part in what's happening," Mizner said. Americans have served in the IDF for decades. All Israeli citizens must serve in the military at age 18—three years for men, two for women. Dual citizens living in Israel are also required to serve. Foreigners, regardless of citizenship, may apply if they meet certain requirements, such as a clean criminal record, a high school diploma, and Hebrew language skills. The U.S. government does not discourage Americans from joining the IDF, although some question why one would choose service in Israel over the U.S. military. "As much as I'm a proud American, I have a very deep and long-standing connection to Israel," said David Meyers of Belmont, California. Meyers, now working in Silicon Valley, holds both U.S. and Israeli citizenship and served six years in the Israeli navy during the late 1980s and early 1990s. He recalls Israeli colleagues sometimes questioning his decision, but says he was warmly accepted. Flesch, who does not hold Israeli citizenship, served for over 18 months as a paratrooper, earning recognition twice as the outstanding soldier in his platoon. He described his proudest achievement as 'doing his part to defend the Jewish people from harm.' For some Americans, events in Gaza feel very personal.

"Jednostavno nisam htio da samo stojim po strani", rekao je Flesch, sada 26-godišnjak, u intervjuu. "Želio sam se aktivno suprotstaviti onima koji misle da Izrael i jevrejski narod ne bi trebali postojati." Sada je student postdiplomskih studija na Johns Hopkins School of Advanced International Studies u Washingtonu, D.C., i postao je 'usamljeni vojnik'—osoba iz druge zemlje koja dobrovoljno ulazi u Izraelske odbrambene snage (IDF). Friends of IDF, organizacija iz New Yorka koja podržava dobrobit izraelskih vojnika, procjenjuje da trenutno oko 750 Amerikanaca služi u IDF-u. Zainteresovanost Amerikanaca za pridruživanje IDF-u navodno je porasla nakon nedavnih sukoba između Izraela i Hamasa, kaže Orit Mizner, regionalna direktorica jugozapada za Friends of Israel Scouts. Organizacija kroz program Garin Tzabar pomaže Jevrejima iz Sjeverne Amerike koji žele da služe u IDF-u. "Stalno primamo takve pozive—definitivno postoji osjećaj da ljudi žele biti u Izraelu i učestvovati u dešavanjima", navodi Mizner. Amerikanci su u IDF-u služili decenijama. Svi izraelski državljani moraju služiti vojsku sa 18 godina—tri godine za muškarce, dvije za žene. Dvostruki državljani koji žive u Izraelu također su dužni služiti. Stranci, bez obzira na državljanstvo, mogu se prijaviti ako ispunjavaju određene uslove poput čiste kaznene evidencije, diplome srednje škole i znanja hebrejskog jezika. Američka vlada ne odvraća građane od pristupanja IDF-u, iako se neki pitaju zašto bi neko izabrao izraelsku vojsku umjesto američke. "Koliko god da sam ponosan Amerikanac, osjećam duboku i dugu vezu s Izraelom", rekao je David Meyers iz Belmonta, Kalifornija. Meyers, koji sada radi u Silicijskoj dolini, ima i američko i izraelsko državljanstvo i služio je šest godina u izraelskoj mornarici krajem 1980-ih i početkom 1990-ih. Prisjeća se da su ga izraelske kolege znali upitati o njegovoj odluci, ali kaže da je bio toplo prihvaćen. Flesch, koji nema izraelsko državljanstvo, služio je više od 18 mjeseci kao padobranac i dva puta je proglašen za najboljeg vojnika u svom vodu. Kaže da mu je najponosnije što je 'učinio svoj dio u odbrani jevrejskog naroda od ugrožavanja.' Za neke Amerikance, dešavanja u Gazi imaju vrlo ličan značaj.

Michael Holgate, 58, a father of four, died following a tragic accident while traveling by narrowboat near the Harecastle Tunnel in Staffordshire, close to Stoke-on-Trent. On Tuesday around 1pm, Holgate hit his head on the tunnel's low ceiling and fell into the canal. His wife of 32 years, Susan, 55, searched frantically for over two hours in complete darkness but eventually had to leave the boat to call for help. Their son, Anthony, 44, was also aboard but was in another part of the boat at the time.

The Holgates had retired and previously managed Green Gables guest house in Windermere, Cumbria. They had recently started living on their narrowboat, with hopes of spending their retirement exploring the waterways of Britain. The family said Michael was a skilled boat handler and that he and Susan were traveling north to attend his brother's wedding.

Rescue teams, including police and fire crews, arrived and the tunnel was closed for several hours during the operation. Specialist police divers from Nottinghamshire joined the search, and Holgate's body was found nearly 11 hours later late at night.

Michael is survived by Susan and their four sons: Anthony, Arthur (27), George (25), and Peter (22). The family described him as a devoted husband and a remarkable father, expressing deep sorrow at their loss. Staffordshire Police are providing ongoing support to the family during this difficult period.
