article_content: A recent scientific study warns that increased melting of West Antarctica's ice shelves is now considered unavoidable over the coming decades. These floating extensions of ice help restrain the flow of glaciers behind them, preventing significant ice from entering the ocean. As the shelves melt, however, these glaciers may speed up, releasing more ice into the sea and contributing to rising sea levels. The study suggests that future sea-level rise may be greater than previously estimated. Dr. Kaitlin Naughten of the British Antarctic Survey, lead author of the report, told the BBC that these findings raise the likelihood of current projections being surpassed. According to the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC)'s 2021 report, global sea levels could rise between 0.28 and 1.01 meters by 2100, primarily due to melting glaciers and ice sheets. Even a one-meter rise could put hundreds of millions of people worldwide at increased risk of coastal flooding. The IPCC also noted that even higher sea-level rises are possible due to uncertain ice sheet processes, particularly interactions with the ocean. This latest study, published in Nature Climate Change, is the first to directly simulate how ocean warming will impact Antarctic ice shelves under different greenhouse gas emissions scenarios. Findings indicate that the Amundsen Sea, off West Antarctica, will warm about three times faster than its historical rate by century's end, dramatically accelerating ice shelf melting. Significantly, this rapid melt is expected to occur even if humanity takes strong steps to slow global warming. Nevertheless, Dr. Naughten emphasizes that reducing fossil fuel consumption remains vital to limit future sea-level rise. Though further research is needed, the melting of ice shelves is particularly important because it affects the stability of the larger West Antarctic ice sheet. The entire Antarctic ice sheet contains enough ice to raise global sea levels by around 58 meters if completely melted, though most is in East Antarctica, which is relatively stable. In contrast, West Antarctica holds enough ice to raise sea levels by about five meters and has been losing mass in recent decades. Ice shelves are formed where grounded glaciers extend over the ocean, creating floating platforms. They restrain the mass of land ice behind, but as they melt, this 'braking effect' weakens, allowing glaciers to accelerate and release more ice into the sea or break off as icebergs. West Antarctica is uniquely vulnerable, as large areas are below sea level. This allows glaciers, such as the fast-retreating Thwaites Glacier (nicknamed the 'doomsday glacier'), to move into deeper water, potentially speeding up their collapse. Thwaites Glacier alone could raise global sea levels by about 65 centimeters if it fully collapses. Dr. Naughten told the BBC that their models show rapidly increasing melting beneath these critical ice shelves, painting a grimmer outlook for Thwaites. The study authors warn that accelerated ice shelf loss could trigger the collapse of the West Antarctic Ice Sheet. However, other important variables like snowfall and glacier flow speed, which were not fully considered in this study, also impact how quickly sea levels may rise. It is now well-accepted that sea levels will continue to climb in the coming decades and centuries, due to both ongoing warming and the slow response time of massive ice sheets. The new study strengthens the case that this rise may happen faster than previously assumed, prompting urgent calls for societies to adapt. Dr. Naughten concludes that humanity may have lost control of melting in West Antarctica, describing the work as sobering. Professor Alberto Naveira Garabato, an oceanographer at the University of Southampton uninvolved in the study, agreed, calling it a wake-up call. Both researchers stress, however, that acting to reduce emissions now could slow losses elsewhere, giving societies crucial time to adapt and protect the larger Antarctic ice sheet.
translated_content: Novo naučno istraživanje upozorava da je povećano topljenje ledenih ploča Zapadne Antarktike sada neizbježno u narednim decenijama. Ovi plutajući produžeci leda pomažu zadržavanju glečera iza njih, sprečavajući značajne količine leda da uđu u okean. Međutim, kako se ploče tope, ti glečeri mogu ubrzati i ispustiti više leda u more, doprinoseći rastu nivoa mora. Studija sugeriše da bi budući porast nivoa mora mogao biti veći nego što se prethodno procjenjivalo. Dr. Kaitlin Naughten iz Britanskog antarktičkog istraživačkog centra, glavna autorica izvještaja, rekla je za BBC da ovi nalazi povećavaju vjerovatnoću da će trenutne prognoze biti premašene. Prema izvještaju Međuvladinog panela za klimatske promjene (IPCC) iz 2021. godine, globalni nivo mora bi mogao porasti između 0,28 i 1,01 metar do 2100. godine, uglavnom zbog topljenja glečera i ledenih ploča. Čak i porast od jednog metra mogao bi dovesti stotine miliona ljudi širom svijeta u veći rizik od poplava obalnih područja. IPCC je također naveo da su mogući i veći porasti nivoa mora zbog nesigurnih procesa povezanih s ledenim pločama, posebno interakcija s okeanom. Ovo najnovije istraživanje, objavljeno u časopisu Nature Climate Change, prvo je koje direktno simulira kako zagrijavanje okeana utiče na ledene ploče Antarktike pod različitim scenarijima emisije stakleničkih plinova. Rezultati ukazuju da će se Amundsenovo more, uz obalu Zapadne Antarktike, do kraja stoljeća zagrijavati oko tri puta brže nego ranije, što će dramatično ubrzati topljenje ledenih ploča. Ključno je da se ovo brzo topljenje očekuje čak i ako čovječanstvo preduzme ozbiljne mjere za usporavanje globalnog zagrijavanja. Ipak, dr. Naughten naglašava da smanjenje upotrebe fosilnih goriva i dalje ostaje presudno za ograničenje budućeg porasta nivoa mora. Iako su potrebna daljnja istraživanja, topljenje ledenih ploča je posebno važno jer utiče na stabilnost znatno veće ledene ploče Zapadne Antarktike. Cijela ledena masa Antarktika sadrži dovoljno leda da, ako bi se potpuno otopila, nivo mora globalno poraste za oko 58 metara, iako se većina nalazi u Istočnoj Antarktici, koja je relativno stabilna. Nasuprot tome, Zapadna Antarktika sadrži dovoljno leda za podizanje nivoa mora za oko pet metara i gubi masu posljednjih decenija. Ledenjaci proširuju se preko okeana stvarajući plutajuće ledene ploče. Oni zadržavaju kopneni led iza sebe, ali kako se tope, ovaj 'kočioni efekat' slabi, dozvoljavajući glečerima da ubrzaju i ispuštaju više leda u more ili se odlamaju u ledene bregove. Zapadna Antarktika je posebno ranjiva jer se veliki dijelovi nalaze ispod nivoa mora. Ovo omogućava glečerima, poput brzo nazadjućeg glečera Thwaites (poznatog i kao 'glečer sudnjeg dana'), da se povlače u dublje vode i potencijalno ubrzaju svoj kolaps. Samo Thwaites bi mogao podići globalni nivo mora za oko 65 centimetara ako se potpuno uruši. Dr. Naughten je BBC-u rekla da njihovi modeli pokazuju ubrzano topljenje ispod ovih ključnih ledenih ploča, što pogoršava prognozu za Thwaites. Autori studije upozoravaju da bi ubrzani gubitak ledenih ploča mogao izazvati kolaps ledene ploče Zapadne Antarktike. Međutim, druge važne varijable, poput padavina i brzine glečera, koje nisu potpuno analizirane u ovoj studiji, također utiču na brzinu kojim nivo mora raste. Danas je općeprihvaćeno da će nivo mora nastaviti da raste u narednim decenijama i stoljećima, kako zbog stalnog zagrijavanja, tako i zbog sporoga odgovora masivnih ledenih ploča. Novo istraživanje dodatno pojačava mogućnost da taj rast bude brži nego što se ranije pretpostavljalo, naglašavajući potrebu za hitnom adaptacijom društava. Dr. Naughten zaključuje da je čovječanstvo možda izgubilo kontrolu nad topljenjem Zapadne Antarktike, nazivajući radna otkrića zabrinjavajućim. Profesor Alberto Naveira Garabato, okeanograf sa Univerziteta u Southamptonu koji nije sudjelovao u istraživanju, slaže se, nazivajući ga pozivom na buđenje. Oboje naučnika ističe da bi djelovanje na smanjenju emisija sada moglo usporiti gubitke na drugim mjestima, dajući društvima dragocjeno vrijeme za prilagodbu i zaštitu preostalih antarktičkih ledenih masa.

article_content: During a visit to Sri Lanka for the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting, British Prime Minister David Cameron played cricket at Colombo's National Cricket Academy, facing the legendary spinner Muttiah Muralitharan. Observers noted Cameron acquitted himself respectably, though he admitted Muralitharan was kindly in his delivery. The visit combined sport and significant political discussion. Cameron urged the Sri Lankan government to improve conditions for the Tamil minority, many of whom have been affected by the decades-long civil conflict that ended in 2009. He visited displaced families in the north, marking the first such visit by a foreign leader since 1948. Muralitharan, a respected Tamil figure, told Cameron he has personally witnessed substantial improvement in the northern region's infrastructure and daily life since the war. He suggested that observers should visit and see the progress firsthand before drawing conclusions. Despite Muralitharan’s assurances, Cameron pressed President Mahinda Rajapaksa for a credible and transparent investigation into alleged war crimes and reiterated support for an international inquiry if such an effort is not underway by March as set by the UN. While the leaders of Canada and India skipped the summit in protest over human rights issues, Cameron defended his own attendance, arguing that engaging directly with Sri Lankan leaders was more productive than boycotting. Cameron was hopeful after his discussions with President Rajapaksa, emphasizing that persistent dialogue and international pressure were crucial for meaningful improvements in human rights and reconciliation. After departing Sri Lanka, Cameron visited Dubai to promote UK businesses, but remained firm in his message about the importance of ongoing pressure for progress in Sri Lanka. He joked on social media about surviving Muralitharan’s bowling, though he acknowledged that the political talks were challenging. In essence, Cameron’s time in Sri Lanka blended cricket, diplomacy, and advocacy, underscoring both progress made and the challenges that remain regarding human rights and post-war recovery.
translated_content: Tokom posjete Šri Lanki na Samitu šefova vlada Commonwealtha, britanski premijer David Cameron zaigrao je kriket u Nacionalnoj kriket akademiji u Kolombu, suočivši se sa slavnim bacačem loptice Muttiahom Muralitharanom. Posmatrači su primijetili da se Cameron dobro snašao, iako je priznao da je Muralitharan bio popustljiv. Posjeta je spojila sport i ozbiljne političke rasprave. Cameron je pozvao vladu Šri Lanke da poboljša uslove za tamilsku manjinu, od kojih su mnogi pogođeni dugogodišnjim građanskim sukobom koji je završen 2009. godine. Posjetio je raseljene porodice na sjeveru, što je bila prva takva posjeta stranog lidera od 1948. godine. Muralitharan, cijenjeni tamilski sportista, rekao je Cameronu da je lično svjedočio značajnom napretku u svakodnevnom životu i infrastrukturi sjevernog regiona nakon rata. Predložio je da bi posmatrači trebali posjetiti i sami vidjeti napredak prije donošenja zaključaka. Uprkos Muralitharanovim uvjeravanjima, Cameron je insistirao pred predsjednikom Mahindom Rajapaksom na kredibilnoj i transparentnoj istrazi o navodnim ratnim zločinima i ponovio podršku međunarodnoj istrazi ako do marta, kako nalaže UN, takva domaća istraga ne bude sprovedena. Dok su lideri Kanade i Indije bojkotovali samit zbog zabrinutosti za ljudska prava, Cameron je branio svoje prisustvo tvrdeći da je direktan angažman produktivniji od bojkota. Cameron je nakon razgovora s predsjednikom Rajapaksom izrazio nadu, naglašavajući da su uporan dijalog i međunarodni pritisak ključni za stvarne pomake u pomirenju i poštovanju ljudskih prava. Nakon odlaska iz Šri Lanke, Cameron je posjetio Dubai kako bi promovisao britanske firme, ali je ostao odlučan u poruci o važnosti nastavka pritiska radi napretka u Šri Lanki. Na društvenim mrežama našalio se kako je preživio Muralitharanovo bacanje, ali je priznao da su politički razgovori bili izazovni. article_content: A recent Inscape Trends Report reveals that smart TV users now access an average of 5.4 apps, double the amount used just two years ago. This data, drawn from over 22 million opt-in VIZIO smart TVs across the United States, offers a snapshot of evolving viewer habits. Compared to the first quarter of 2022, the number of streaming apps accessed per user has doubled by the third quarter of 2023 and matches usage from the previous quarter. The proportion of viewers who exclusively stream content has jumped from 45% in late 2021 to 54% by late 2023. Meanwhile, those relying only on traditional cable, satellite, or over-the-air (OTA) TV have dropped from 9% to 5%. The proportion of dual viewers—those using both streaming and traditional TV—fell from 46% to 41% over the same period. These trends mirror findings from Nielsen’s monthly Gauge Report, which documents a steady rise in the share of streaming viewership alongside a decline in cable and broadcast viewing. In Q3 2023, 94% of streaming time on smart TVs was accounted for by viewers who exclusively (64.6%) or primarily (29%) stream content. Inscape emphasizes that over half of smart TV viewers, who make up nearly two-thirds of smart TV viewing time, are not being reached by advertisers sticking to traditional TV ad buys. This underscores the growing importance of AVOD (ad-supported video on demand) and FAST (free ad-supported streaming TV) channels for marketers. Ken Norcross, Vice President of Data Licensing and Strategy at VIZIO/Inscape, commented: 'Marketers should really take note of these shifts. With more than half of smart TV viewers not reachable by traditional advertising, brands should focus on diversifying their marketing efforts and leveraging data-driven strategies.' Streaming has continuously grown its share of total TV viewing time in the U.S., climbing by 9.4 percentage points since Q3 2021, with the largest annual jump—a 6% increase—occurring in Q3 2023. Currently, the share of viewing time for streaming is 55.9%, up from 46.5%, while cable/satellite dropped from 44.3% to 34.9%. Gaming and OTA viewing shares have remained relatively stable. While streaming dominates, content genres like news (81.8%) and sports (76.7%) still command the majority of viewership on traditional TV platforms. In Q3 2023, NFL and college football games took up less than one-third of sports viewing on streaming platforms, and the two Republican presidential debates saw 77.8% of their audience via traditional TV. These balances are expected to shift further as more live news and sports become available through streaming services. Cord-cutting is accelerating, with 5.7% of households discontinuing cable/satellite viewing in Q3 2023, a steady rise from 4% in Q4 2022. Inscape also identifies 'quiet quitters': homes that sharply curtail cable/satellite viewing but do not cancel their subscriptions. In Q3 2023, 11.9% of these households cut viewing by 75% or more year-over-year, and another 11.1% reduced it by 50–75%. This trend continues to erode cable TV audiences (except in news and sports), suggesting cord-cutting will persist as more people shift to streaming.

Ovi podaci, prikupljeni s više od 22 miliona VIZIO pametnih TV uređaja širom SAD-a, prikazuju promjene u navikama gledatelja. U poređenju s prvim kvartalom 2022., broj streaming aplikacija koje korisnici koriste udvostručio se do trećeg kvartala 2023. godine i isti je kao i prethodni kvartal. Udio gledatelja koji isključivo gledaju streaming porastao je sa 45% krajem 2021. na 54% krajem 2023. Istovremeno, broj onih koji koriste samo kablovsku, satelitsku ili zemaljsku (OTA) TV opao je s 9% na 5%. Procenat korisnika koji kombiniraju streaming i tradicionalnu TV pao je s 46% na 41% u istom periodu. Ovi trendovi potvrđuju i rezultati Nielsen-ovog mjesečnog Gauge Reporta, koji takođe bilježi stalni rast streaminga i pad gledanosti kablovske i emitovane televizije. U trećem kvartalu 2023., 94% vremena provedenog na streaming servisima putem pametnih TV uređaja ostvarili su korisnici koji isključivo (64,6%) ili prvenstveno (29%) gledaju sadržaj putem streaminga. Inscape naglašava da više od polovine korisnika pametnih TV-a, odnosno gotovo dvije trećine ukupnog vremena gledanja, oglašivači ne mogu dosegnuti koristeći isključivo tradicionalne TV reklame. Ovo dodatno ističe važnost AVOD (platforme s oglasnim sadržajem) i FAST (besplatne platforme s oglasima) kanala za marketinške stručnjake. Ken Norcross, potpredsjednik za licenciranje podataka i strategiju u VIZIO/Inscape, izjavio je: 'Oglašivači zaista trebaju obratiti pažnju na ove promjene. Više od polovine gledatelja pametnih TV-a nije dostupno tradicionalnim oglašavanjem, pa brendovi trebaju diverzificirati svoje marketinške aktivnosti i koristiti podatke za kvalitetnije odlučivanje.' Streaming neprekidno povećava svoj udio u ukupnom vremenu gledanja televizije u SAD-u, te je od trećeg kvartala 2021. porastao za 9,4 procentna poena – s najvećim godišnjim rastom od 6% u trećem kvartalu 2023. Sada streaming čini 55,9% gledanja (sa 46,5%), dok je kablovska/satelit pao sa 44,3% na 34,9%. Gledanje igrica i putem antene je stabilno. Iako streaming dominira, žanrovi poput vijesti (81,8%) i sporta (76,7%) i dalje privlače najveći dio gledalaca na tradicionalnim TV platformama. U trećem kvartalu 2023., NFL i univerzitetski fudbal činili su manje od trećine sportskog gledanja na streaming servisima, a dvije republikanske debate imale su 77,8% gledanosti na tradicionalnoj televiziji. Očekuje se dalje preusmjeravanje publike ovih žanrova ka streamingu kako bude dostupno više vijesti i sportskih sadržaja na tim platformama. Trend prekidanja kablovskih/satelitskih ugovora se ubrzava: 5,7% domaćinstava prestalo je gledati ovakav sadržaj u trećem kvartalu 2023., dok je godinu dana ranije to učinilo 4%. Inscape prepoznaje i pojav 'tihih odustajanja', gdje domaćinstva naglo smanjuju gledanje kablovske/satelitske televizije bez prekida pretplate. U trećem kvartalu 2023., 11,9% tih domaćinstava smanjilo je gledanje za 75% ili više u odnosu na prošlu godinu, a dodatnih 11,1% za 50–75%. Ovi trendovi nastavljaju smanjenje gledanosti kablovske TV (osim vijesti i sporta) i sugeriraju da će prelazak na streaming i dalje rasti.

article_content: Three Portuguese environmental groups—Ultimo Recurso, Quercus, and Sciaena—have taken legal action against the government, alleging that authorities have not delivered on their 2021 climate commitments. The lawsuit states that progress towards meeting national climate targets has been minimal. According to a joint statement from the organizations, the government has failed to introduce a promised online platform for citizens to track regulatory progress and has yet to publish a national carbon budget, essential for capping CO2 emissions. The groups also note that the implementation of both the National Energy and Climate Plan (PNEC) and various sector-specific climate policies remains incomplete. In response, government officials indicated in June they are reassessing the PNEC and are aiming for 80% of Portugal’s electricity to come from renewable sources by 2026, up from about 68% recorded between January and October 2023. Francisca Costa, representing Ultimo Recurso, warned that continuous delays make catastrophic climate impacts more likely, highlighting the urgency of meeting environmental deadlines. Government representatives have yet to issue a comment regarding the lawsuit. This legal move is part of a global trend, as activists frequently use court proceedings to challenge governmental and industrial inaction on climate. A 2023 analysis from the London School of Economics found that cases like these have more than doubled in five years, with the majority of court decisions supporting stronger measures to address climate change.

article_content: Fiona Woolf, who recently resigned as chair of the government’s historical child abuse inquiry, has been awarded a damehood. Woolf stepped down in October after it emerged she had not fully disclosed her ties to Conservative peer Leon Brittan, who allegedly received documents related to abuse claims. Lady Butler-Sloss, the inquiry’s original chair who resigned for similar reasons, defended Woolf’s honor. She explained that Woolf’s recognition is for serving as Lord Mayor of London, a position that only two women have held. Butler-Sloss also criticized the Home Office for insufficiently investigating Woolf’s relationship with Lord Brittan. The timing of Woolf’s damehood has sparked criticism from abuse survivors and campaigners who previously sought her dismissal from the inquiry. Some suggest the honor could be perceived as consolation for her resignation. Labour MP Simon Danczuk labeled the award as inappropriate, voicing concern over its timing and suggesting there are more deserving candidates. Sir Bob Kerslake, head of the Civil Service, supported the decision, stating the award reflects Woolf’s overall career achievements. Lady Butler-Sloss again assigned blame to the Home Office for not identifying the potential conflict with Brittan earlier. Edinburgh-born Woolf, previously recognized with a CBE, received her damehood in the New Year Honours for her work in law and her contributions to the City of London. Her resignation followed revelations about her connections to Lord Brittan, who is expected to testify regarding abuse allegations and a significant 1983 dossier. While Woolf’s professional accomplishments have been acknowledged, Danczuk and others argue her actions led to delays and distress for abuse victims. The decision to honor Woolf remains controversial, with critics viewing it as further evidence of establishment favoritism.

article_content: A Michigan-based company, Wolverine Packing Company, is recalling approximately 1.8 million pounds of ground beef products after 11 cases of E.coli infection were reported, according to federal officials on Monday. The recall covers ground beef produced by Wolverine Packing Company between March 31 and April 18, the U.S. Department of Agriculture's Food Safety and Inspection Service (FSIS) stated in a press release. As of now, 11 cases of E.coli O157:H7 have been reported across four states, with symptoms developing between April 22 and May 2. E.coli O157:H7 can cause severe illness, including dehydration, bloody diarrhea, abdominal cramps, and potentially kidney failure, particularly in children under 5 and older adults. The recalled ground beef was shipped to distributors in Massachusetts, Michigan, Missouri, and Ohio for restaurant use and was not sent to the Department of Defense, the National School Lunch Program, or sold online. FSIS said it was alerted to the E.coli cases last Monday and, in cooperation with the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), linked the infections to Wolverine Packing Company ground beef. FSIS advises that ground beef should be cooked to an internal temperature of 160 degrees Fahrenheit. A list of the recalled products is available, all bearing the establishment number 'EST. 2574B' on the packaging.

Povlačenje se odnosi na mljeveno meso proizvedeno u Wolverine Packing Company u periodu od 31. marta do 18. aprila, navodi se u saopćenju Službe za sigurnost hrane i inspekciju Ministarstva poljoprivrede SAD (FSIS). article_content: A resident is seen riding past the Guohua Power Station in Hebei province, northern China. China and the United States have pledged to accelerate joint efforts to combat climate change ahead of a major United Nations meeting. Their commitment includes reducing emissions of methane and other greenhouse gases, alongside carbon dioxide. The joint announcement was made before a summit between Presidents Biden and Xi Jinping, which aims to stabilize U.S.-China relations. Cooperation between the two countries, the world's largest greenhouse gas emitters, is considered crucial for the success of the U.N. climate talks in Dubai. Earlier this year, whether the two nations would collaborate was uncertain, due to strained relations over issues like technology, Taiwan, and Russia's war in Ukraine. Now, both governments acknowledge their important global roles and have declared intentions to work together to tackle climate change, according to a statement released in both Beijing and Washington. They reaffirmed the Group of 20 nations' pledge to strive to triple global renewable energy capacity by 2030. Chinese companies, after heavy investment in wind and solar manufacturing, are seeking to increase their exports. "If the two countries can collaborate to support the target, it would significantly facilitate its global adoption," said Lauri Myllyvirta, lead analyst at the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air. The U.S. and China have agreed to resume policy discussions on energy and to establish a working group to enhance climate action in what they call the critical decade of the 2020s. Experts state that immediate action is essential to keep global average temperature increases well below 2 degrees Celsius (3.6 degrees Fahrenheit), as per international agreement. Including methane in the countries' updated climate plans is a significant step. "Methane was notably missing in China's previous pledges under the Paris Agreement," said David Waskow, international climate director at the World Resources Institute. He pointed out China is the largest emitter of methane, and strong action to reduce this gas is vital for near-term climate progress. Last week, China released an action plan on methane, including the creation of an accounting and reporting system. Main sources are coal mines, oil and gas fields, agriculture, landfills, and sewage treatment. Myllyvirta described the plan as lacking detailed targets, with follow-up needed. The U.S., China, and the United Arab Emirates announced they will host a meeting on methane and greenhouse gases during the U.N. conference in Dubai. Waskow noted disappointment that the joint statement did not include a commitment to phasing out fossil fuels. This was unsurprising, as China, despite advances in renewables, continues to build coal power plants, considered reliable for peak demand. The Chinese government announced new 'capacity payments' for coal plant operators starting next year to keep facilities open, even as renewable energy grows. The statement endorsed climate cooperation at the state, provincial, and city levels, with plans for a high-level event on subnational cooperation in the first half of 2024. In October, California Governor Gavin Newsom visited China to promote joint climate initiatives in several provinces and cities.

Zajedničko saopćenje dato je prije samita predsjednika Bidena i Xi Jinpinga, koji ima za cilj stabilizirati odnose SAD-a i Kine. Saradnja između dvije zemlje, najvećih svjetskih emitera stakleničkih plinova, smatra se ključnom za uspjeh UN-ovih klimatskih pregovora u Dubaiju. Početkom ove godine nije bilo jasno hoće li dvije zemlje sarađivati zbog zategnutih odnosa oko tehnologije, Tajvana i rata Rusije u Ukrajini. Sada obje vlade prepoznaju svoju globalnu ulogu i izjavile su namjeru da zajednički rade na rješavanju klimatskih promjena, navodi se u saopćenju objavljenom u Pekingu i Washingtonu. Ponovili su obavezu država članica G20 da nastoje utrostručiti globalne kapacitete obnovljive energije do 2030. Kineske kompanije, nakon velikih ulaganja u proizvodnju vjetro i solarne opreme, žele povećati izvoz. "Ako dvije zemlje mogu zajedno podržati ovaj cilj, to bi značajno olakšalo njegovo prihvaćanje na globalnom nivou", rekao je Lauri Myllyvirta, glavni analitičar u Centru za istraživanje energije i čistog zraka. SAD i Kina su se dogovorile da obnove razgovore o energetskim politikama i uspostave radnu grupu kako bi unaprijedile klimatske aktivnosti tokom, kako ga nazivaju, ključne decenije 2020-ih. Stručnjaci navode da su hitne akcije neophodne kako bi se povećanje globalne prosječne temperature zadržalo ispod 2 stepena Celzijusa (3,6 F), u skladu s međunarodnim dogovorima. Uključivanje metana u ažurirane klimatske planove obje zemlje veliki je korak. "Metan je bio primjetno izostavljen iz prijašnjih kineskih obećanja u okviru Pariškog sporazuma", rekao je David Waskow, međunarodni direktor klimatskih programa u Svjetskom institutu za resurse. Istakao je da je Kina najveći emiter metana i da je snažno djelovanje ključno za napredak u borbi protiv klimatskih promjena u bliskoj budućnosti. Prošle sedmice Kina je objavila akcioni plan za metan, uključujući izradu sistema za praćenje i izvještavanje. Glavni izvori su rudnici uglja, naftna i plinska polja, poljoprivreda, deponije i postrojenja za preradu otpadnih voda. Myllyvirta je plan opisao kao nedovoljno konkretan, te je potrebno dalje praćenje. SAD, Kina i Ujedinjeni Arapski Emirati najavili su da će zajedno održati sastanak o metanu i drugim stakleničkim plinovima tokom UN-ove konferencije u Dubaiju. Waskow je izrazio razočaranje što zajedničko saopćenje ne uključuje obavezu o postupnom ukidanju fosilnih goriva. Ovo nije iznenađenje jer Kina, uprkos napretku obnovljivih izvora, nastavlja graditi termoelektrane na ugalj koji se smatra pouzdanim izvorom tokom potražnje pri vrhuncu. Kineska vlada je najavila nove "kapacitivne isplate" za operatere termoelektrana, počevši od iduće godine, kako bi postrojenja ostala dostupna iako se udio obnovljivih izvora povećava. Saopćenje podržava klimatsku saradnju na nivou država, provincija i gradova te najavljuje održavanje visokorangiranog događaja na ovu temu u prvoj polovini 2024. U oktobru je guverner Kalifornije Gavin Newsom posjetio Kinu kako bi promovisao zajedničke klimatske inicijative u nekoliko provincija i gradova.

article_content: Pakistan’s Election Commission (ECP) clarified that former Prime Minister Imran Khan is incarcerated due to several ongoing legal cases, including allegations about mishandling a diplomatic cable, rather than being a 'prisoner of conscience.' This clarification came after Khan’s party, Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI), submitted a 24-point Charter of Demand asserting that Khan and PTI are being politically persecuted ahead of general elections set for February 8, 2024. The ECP rejected the party's claims, stressing the commission’s lack of involvement in any alleged targeting and maintaining that it cannot stop individuals from joining or leaving political parties. The election body reaffirmed its directive for a fair campaign environment for all parties. Imran Khan, aged 71 and leader of PTI, has been imprisoned at Adiala Jail in Rawalpindi since late September on multiple charges. The PTI also criticized what it saw as preferential treatment of another political figure, alluding to Nawaz Sharif, noting his ability to hold public meetings despite criminal convictions. The ECP responded that it would address this concern. The PTI further requested equal media coverage, to which the ECP replied it would consult with the caretaker government. Regarding the delay of elections beyond the constitutionally set period, ECP pointed out that the Supreme Court had already reviewed and determined the current schedule. The ECP also invited PTI to present concrete evidence regarding claims of pre-poll rigging and emphasized that all parties would be assured impartial conditions throughout the election.

Ovo pojašnjenje uslijedilo je nakon što je Khanova stranka, Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI), podnijela 24-tačkovni zahtjev u kojem tvrdi da su Khan i PTI politički progonjeni pred opće izbore zakazane za 8. februar 2024. Izborno tijelo potvrdilo je svoju naredbu za osiguranje poštenih uslova kampanje za sve stranke. Imran Khan, 71-godišnji lider PTI-a, zatvoren je u zatvoru Adiala u Rawalpindiju od kraja septembra po više tačaka optužnice. article_content: Reverend Mike Hall has regained ownership of his house in Luton, two years after it was fraudulently sold without his knowledge. Hall discovered in July 2021 that his identity had been stolen, which allowed someone to sell his home without his consent. He expressed relief that 'justice has been done' after the Land Registry reinstated him as the legal owner. Despite this victory, Mr. Hall now faces a new challenge: squatters have moved into his property. He originally purchased the home in 1990, but in August 2021, an impostor sold it for £131,000. While working in north Wales, Hall was alerted by neighbors that strangers were in his home, with all the lights on. Upon returning to Luton, he found another person conducting renovations and discovered his key no longer worked. The house had been cleared of all furniture. BBC Radio 4's 'You and Yours' obtained evidence of the fraud, including the forged driving license, a fraudulent bank account, and phone recordings of a man posing as Hall giving instructions to solicitors. After two years of court battles, Hall’s ownership was restored on the Land Registry. The program also reports that the person who purchased the house has been compensated by the Land Registry. Hall described the relief of confirmation that the house was his, despite it having been fraudulently sold. Recently, when visiting the property with a builder, he saw evidence of forced entry and believes squatters are now occupying his home. He estimates the damage at £60,000. Bedfordshire Police have advised Hall to obtain an Interim Possession Order from the courts, which would give police the power to remove the two people trespassing in his property. Police say the occupants claim to have a rental agreement, but the origin of this agreement is unclear.
translated_content: Reverend Mike Hall ponovo je postao vlasnik svoje kuće u Lutonu, dvije godine nakon što je ona prevarom prodata bez njegovog znanja. Hall je u julu 2021. otkrio da mu je ukraden identitet, što je nekome omogućilo da proda njegovu kuću bez njegovog pristanka. Izrazio je olakšanje rekavši da je 'pravda zadovoljena' nakon što ga je Land Registry ponovno upisao kao zakonitog vlasnika. Međutim, uprkos ovoj pobjedi, gospodin Hall sada se suočava s novim problemom: skvoteri su uselili u njegovu kuću. On je prvobitno kupio kuću 1990. godine, ali je u avgustu 2021. prevarant prodao nekretninu za 131.000 funti. Dok je radio u sjevernom Velsu, Hallu su susjedi javili da su nepoznati ljudi u njegovoj kući i da su sva svjetla upaljena. Kada se vratio u Luton, zatekao je osobu kako radi renovacije i otkrio da mu ključ više ne odgovara. Kuća je bila potpuno ispražnjena. BBC Radio 4 'You and Yours' prikupio je dokaze o prevari, uključujući lažnu vozačku dozvolu, prevarantski račun u banci i snimke poziva čovjeka koji se predstavljao kao Hall i davao naloge advokatima. Nakon dvije godine sudskih borbi, Hallovo ime je ponovo upisano u zemljišnoknjižni registar. Program također navodi da je osoba koja je kupila kuću dobila nadoknadu od Land Registry. Hall je opisao olakšanje jer je napokon potvrđeno da je kuća njegova, iako je ranije bila prevarom prodana. Nedavno je s građevinarom obišao imanje i našao dokaze o nasilnom ulasku, te vjeruje da sada skvoteri borave u njegovoj kući. Procjenjuje štetu na 60.000 funti. Bedfordshire Policija savjetovala je Hallu da zatraži Privremenu naredbu za povrat posjeda od suda, što bi omogućilo policiji da ukloni dvije osobe koje nezakonito borave u njegovoj kući. Policija navodi da stanari tvrde da imaju ugovor o najmu, ali porijeklo tog ugovora nije poznato.

article_content: India’s construction and engineering powerhouse Larsen & Toubro (L&T) has been hit with two penalties by Qatar’s income tax authorities, totaling Rs 238.95 crore. The fines—Rs 111.31 crore and Rs 127.64 crore—were imposed after authorities found discrepancies between the income declared by L&T and their own assessment for the financial years 2016-17 and 2017-18. L&T stated in a stock exchange filing on Friday that it has appealed the penalties, describing them as 'arbitrary and unjustified.' The company expressed confidence in a favorable outcome at the appellate level and indicated that these penalties are not expected to have any material impact on its financial position, operations, or other activities. The Gulf region remains crucial for L&T, accounting for 41% of the company’s order inflow in the first half of the current fiscal year and making up 32% of its Rs 4,50,700 crore order book as of the end of September.
translated_content: Indijska građevinska i inženjerska kompanija Larsen & Toubro (L&T) suočila se sa dvije kazne od strane katarskih poreznih vlasti, ukupno vrijedne 238,95 crore rupija. Kazne od 111,31 crore i 127,64 crore izrečene su nakon što su vlasti utvrdile neslaganja između prihoda koje je L&T prijavio i njihovih procjena za fiskalne godine 2016-17 i 2017-18. L&T je u saopćenju za berzu u petak naveo da su uložili žalbu na kazne, navodeći ih kao 'arbitrarne i neopravdane.' Kompanija je izrazila uvjerenje u povoljan ishod na apelacionom nivou i navela da se ne očekuje da će ove kazne imati značajan utjecaj na njenu finansijsku poziciju, poslovanje ili druge aktivnosti. Zaljevska regija i dalje je ključna za L&T, čineći 41% od ukupnog broja narudžbi u prvoj polovini tekuće fiskalne godine i 32% od narudžbi vrijednih 4.50.700 crore rupija na kraju septembra.

article_content:
Rescue teams are rushing to the site of a powerful, shallow earthquake that struck northwestern China's Gansu Province on Monday morning, killing at least 89 people, according to state media. The quake also left 593 injured and five missing, reports China Daily. The earthquake hit near the border of Min and Zhang counties at about 7:45 a.m. local time, state news agency Xinhua said. Emergency responders, including the Red Cross Society of China, are sending 200 tents and other supplies for people left homeless. Chinese President Xi Jinping urged rescue teams to focus on saving survivors and reducing casualties, state broadcaster CCTV reported.

The earthquake and subsequent aftershocks caused roofs to collapse, disrupted telecommunications, and damaged a major highway linking Lanzhou, the provincial capital, to the south, China Daily noted. Over 300 armed police and 64 heavy machines have been sent to repair National Highway No. 212. Train services in the affected area have also been suspended. Rescue workers are facing additional challenges due to weeks of heavy rain, with forecasts predicting more rain and raising concerns about potential landslides.

Magnitude readings differed: the Gansu Provincial Seismological Bureau reported a 6.6 magnitude, while the US Geological Survey measured it as a 5.9-magnitude quake at a shallow depth of around one kilometer. The USGS added that the epicenter was located eight miles east of Chabu and 110 miles south-southeast of Lanzhou. Xinhua, citing Min County officials, reported ongoing tremors, with residents saying buildings and trees shook for about a minute.

Locals turned to Weibo, China's popular social media platform, to share their experiences. One user wrote about being startled while brushing their teeth, initially thinking it was dizziness before realizing it was an earthquake. Another lamented the series of natural disasters—floods, landslides, and quakes—occurring in the area, wishing for peace and safety for all residents.

Spasilački timovi užurbano stižu na mjesto snažnog plitkog zemljotresa koji je u ponedjeljak ujutro pogodio kinesku provinciju Gansu na sjeverozapadu, pri čemu je, prema navodima državnih medija, poginulo najmanje 89 osoba. Prema pisanju China Daily, još 593 osobe su povrijeđene, a pet je nestalo. Zemljotres je pogodio područje na granici između okruga Min i Zhang oko 7:45 ujutro po lokalnom vremenu, izvještava državna novinska agencija Xinhua. Hitne službe, uključujući Kineski crveni krst, šalju 200 šatora i druge potrepštine za ljude koji su ostali bez domova. Predsjednik Kine Xi Jinping pozvao je spasilačke timove da se usmjere na spašavanje preživjelih i smanjenje broja žrtava, prenosi državna televizija CCTV.

Zemljotres i naknadni potresi uzrokovali su urušavanje krovova, prekid telekomunikacija i oštećenje glavnog autoputa koji povezuje Lanzhou, glavni grad provincije, sa jugom, navodi China Daily. Više od 300 pripadnika policije i 64 teške mašine poslano je na popravku Nacionalne magistrale broj 212. Željeznički saobraćaj u pogođenom području je također obustavljen. Spasioci se suočavaju s dodatnim izazovima zbog višesedmičnih obilnih kiša, a prognozira se još kiše što povećava rizik od klizišta.

Izvještaji o jačini zemljotresa se razlikuju: Pokrajinski seizmološki biro Gansu prijavio je jačinu od 6,6 stepeni, dok je Američki geološki zavod izmjerio potres magnitude 5,9 na dubini od oko jednog kilometra. USGS je naveo da je epicentar bio osam milja istočno od Chabua i 110 milja jugoistočno od Lanzhoua. Xinhua, pozivajući se na zvaničnike okruga Min, navodi da su podrhtavanja tla i dalje prisutna, a stanovnici su izjavili da su se zgrade i drveće tresli oko jedne minute.

Mještani su svoja iskustva podijelili na Weibu, popularnoj kineskoj društvenoj mreži. Jedan korisnik je napisao kako ga je potres iznenadio dok je prao zube, isprva misleći da mu se vrti u glavi, da bi potom shvatio da je u pitanju zemljotres. Drugi je žalio zbog niza prirodnih katastrofa—poplava, klizišta i zemljotresa—koje pogađaju to područje, izražavajući želju za mirom i sigurnošću za sve stanovnike.

article_content: Jocelyn Bennett, a 27-year-old mother, attended the funeral of her premature twin daughters, Melody and Rose Clarke, at Lodge Hill Crematorium in Birmingham. Bennett, who arrived in a wheelchair after being discharged from the hospital specifically for the service, had spent 18 days in a coma. Upon awakening, she learned of her daughters' passing. Supported by friends and family, Bennett joined mourners as a white horse-drawn carriage carried the twins’ small coffins, decorated with pink bunting and white teddy bears. Floral tributes and a card featuring Bennett, her partner Kevin (31), and their daughters read, 'God Bless you Melody and Rose.' Reverend Denise Jones officiated, describing the girls as 'very special' and cherished, noting the family's journey through great courage and loss. The twins were described as beloved sisters to their older sibling, Slater. The congregation wore bright colors at Bennett’s request, sang hymns 'All Things Bright and Beautiful' and 'Lord of the Dance,' and listened to 'Somewhere Over the Rainbow' at the end of the 40-minute ceremony. The twins were born by emergency caesarean on October 29 after Bennett experienced a life-threatening placental abruption and collapsed at home in Druids Heath, Birmingham. Delay in accessing her flat occurred when neighbors refused to buzz in paramedics, mistaking the ambulance’s blue lights for police activity. After police arrived and gained entry roughly 30 minutes after Bennett’s emergency call, she was found unconscious and rushed to hospital. Melody (4lb 1oz) and Rose (3lb) were delivered prematurely, but both suffered multi-organ failure and passed away on November 4, shortly after life support was withdrawn. Joe Bennett, Jocelyn’s father, expressed gratitude for the support received and noted unresolved questions regarding the delay in emergency access. He has called for improved emergency entry systems in council-managed buildings. Birmingham City Council confirmed they had launched an urgent investigation. Before the twins passed, the family held a special Christmas-themed celebration and christening for Melody and Rose in hospital, which was documented for Jocelyn to see upon waking from her coma. A chaplain performed a service on the day of the twins’ deaths, and family members spent final moments with the babies. Joe Bennett wrote poems as a tribute to his granddaughters and reiterated the family’s ongoing grief. The funeral featured outpourings of love, floral arrangements, and community condolences, as the family continues to seek answers and healing.
translated_content: Jocelyn Bennett, 27-godišnja majka, prisustvovala je sahrani svojih prijevremeno rođenih blizanki, Melody i Rose Clarke, na krematoriju Lodge Hill u Birminghamu. Bennett je posebnom dozvolom puštena iz bolnice za ovu priliku i stigla je na sahranu u invalidskim kolicima, nakon što je provela 18 dana u komi. Kada se probudila, saznala je za smrt svojih kćerki. Uz podršku porodice i prijatelja, Bennett se pridružila ožalošćenima dok su mala bijela kočija s konjima prevozila kovčege blizanki, ukrašene rozim zastavicama i bijelim plišanim medama. Cvjetni aranžmani i čestitka na kojoj su Bennett, njen partner Kevin (31) i njihove kćerke pisalo je: 'Bog vas blagoslovio, Melody i Rose.' Službu je vodila sveštenica Denise Jones, koja je opisala djevojčice kao 'posebne' i voljene, ističući snagu i hrabrost porodice tokom ovog teškog perioda. Blizanke su opisane i kao voljene sestre starijem bratu Slateru. Prisutni su nosili svijetlu odjeću na Bennettin zahtjev, pjevali su pjesme 'All Things Bright and Beautiful' i 'Lord of the Dance', a na kraju 40-minutne ceremonije slušali su 'Somewhere Over the Rainbow'. Blizanke su rođene carskim rezom 29. oktobra, nakon što je Bennett imala po život opasnu abrupciju posteljice i kolabirala u svom domu u Druids Heathu u Birminghamu. Došlo je do kašnjenja u pristupu njenom stanu jer komšije nisu htjele pustiti bolničare unutra, pogrešno misleći da se radi o policijskoj akciji. Nakon što je policija stigla i ušla, otprilike 30 minuta nakon Bennettinog poziva za pomoć, pronašli su je onesviještenu i Hitna pomoć ju je prevezla u bolnicu. Melody (1,85 kg) i Rose (1,36 kg) su rođene prije vremena, ali su obje pretrpjele višestruko otkazivanje organa i preminule su 4. novembra, ubrzo nakon što im je isključena aparatura za održavanje života. Joe Bennett, Jocelynin otac, zahvalio je svima na podršci i istakao da još uvijek postoje nerazjašnjena pitanja o kašnjenju Hitne pomoći. Pozvao je na poboljšanje sistema za hitan pristup u zgradama pod upravom općine. Gradsko vijeće Birminghama potvrdilo je da je pokrenulo hitnu istragu. Prije smrti blizanki, porodica je u bolnici organizovala posebnu proslavu uoči Božića i krštenje, koje su dokumentovali kako bi Jocelyn mogla vidjeti kad se probudi iz kome. Kapelan je održao službu na dan kada su blizanke preminule, a članovi porodice su proveli posljednje trenutke s bebama. Joe Bennett je napisao pjesme u znak sjećanja na svoje unuke i ponovio da porodica nastavlja tugovati. Sahrana je bila ispunjena ljubavlju, cvjetnim aranžmanima i izražavanjem sućuti zajednice dok porodica traži odgovore i nastavlja proces ozdravljenja.

article_content: China has eased its stringent birth-control restrictions for families who lost children in last year's deadly mudslide in the northwest, according to state media reports. The Xinhua News Agency announced that women in the Zhouqu region who had previously undergone sterilization procedures, such as tubal ligation, are now eligible for free reversal surgeries. Liang Jianjun, director of Zhouqu's family planning bureau, stated that women from 27 families have already had the operation, with some currently pregnant. China’s strict family-planning rules generally limit most urban families to one child, though there are exceptions for rural residents and certain ethnic groups. In Zhouqu, rural families are permitted to have two children, and families in five Tibetan-dominated towns and villages may have three, per Xinhua. The recent policy adjustment allows families who lost children in the mudslide to have additional children to meet their permitted quotas, a government official told Xinhua. The mudslide disaster occurred in August last year, leaving more than 1,700 people dead or missing in Zhouqu County, Gansu province. Thousands of homes were either destroyed or severely damaged after weeks of heavy rain and flooding. China’s population control policy, in place for over three decades, remains controversial. Critics argue that it has distorted demographic patterns and suggest that wealthier families have sometimes circumvented the rules through bribery.
translated_content: Kina je ublažila svoja stroga ograničenja kontrole rađanja za porodice koje su izgubile djecu u prošlogodišnjem smrtonosnom odronu u sjeverozapadnom dijelu zemlje, prenose državni mediji. Novinska agencija Xinhua objavila je da su žene iz okruga Zhouqu, koje su ranije imale sterilizacijske zahvate, kao što je podvezivanje jajovoda, sada kvalifikovane za besplatne operacije povratka plodnosti. Liang Jianjun, direktor biroa za planiranje porodice u Zhouquu, izjavio je da su žene iz 27 porodica već prošle ovaj zahvat, a neke su trenutno trudne. Stroga pravila planiranja porodice u Kini uglavnom ograničavaju većinu gradskih porodica na jedno dijete, iako postoje izuzeci za stanovnike ruralnih područja i određene etničke grupe. U Zhouquu je ruralnim porodicama dozvoljeno dvoje djece, dok porodice u pet tibetanskih gradova i sela mogu imati troje, navodi Xinhua. Nedavna prilagodba politike omogućava porodicama koje su izgubile djecu u odronu da dobiju dodatnu djecu kako bi ispunile dozvoljene kvote, rekao je vladin zvaničnik za Xinhua-u. Katastrofa se dogodila u avgustu prošle godine i ostavila je više od 1.700 mrtvih ili nestalih u okrugu Zhouqu, provincija Gansu. Hiljade domova je uništeno ili ozbiljno oštećeno nakon sedmica obilnih kiša i poplava. Kineska politika kontrole stanovništva, koja je na snazi više od tri decenije, ostaje kontroverzna. Kritičari tvrde da je narušila demografske obrasce i sugerišu da su bogatije porodice ponekad izbjegavale pravila putem mita.

article_content: From above, the Namibian desert is dotted with mysterious formations known as fairy circles—circular barren patches ranging from 10 to 65 feet in diameter, stretching across a narrow, 1,100-mile strip. These enigmatic circles have sparked decades of speculation, with explanations ranging from alien activity to toxic gases. A notable study published last year in Science suggested that sand termites were responsible, but none of the theories have been definitively proven. "Fairy circles are still a mystery. There's been extensive field and laboratory research, but no definitive answers," says Stephan Getzin from the Helmholtz Centre for Environmental Research in Leipzig, Germany. Together with Israeli colleagues, Getzin recently proposed a new theory. Using aerial images, they studied the arrangement of fairy circles, finding patterns that resemble other landscapes, such as 'tiger bush' in Niger and spinifex grass circles in Australia. Getzin also noted similar ring patterns in California's Mojave Desert. He hypothesizes that the fairy circles are formed through a process of self-organization: In dry climates with scarce water and poor soil, plants compete for limited resources and naturally space themselves apart, creating these ordered patterns. This theory contrasts with that of biology professor Norbert Juergens, whose study linked the circles to the sand termite Psammotermes allocerus. Juergens argued that termites kill the grass, forming underground water traps by reducing evaporation. However, Getzin finds little evidence that social insects can create such large-scale, uniform patterns. Instead, insect nests tend to cluster together. Juergens identified the sand termite as the only species consistently present throughout the area, especially near the circles. Yet, other experts remain unconvinced. Walter Tschinkel, a biology professor at Florida State University, points out that while termite presence is correlated with the circles, correlation does not mean causation. Tschinkel also notes that the self-organization theory is more complex and less intuitive for many people. The true cause of Namibia's fairy circles remains unresolved, highlighting the ongoing curiosity and debate within the scientific community.
translated_content: Iz zraka, namibijska pustinja je prošarana misterioznim formacijama poznatim kao vilinski krugovi — kružni, ogoljeni dijelovi tla promjera od 3 do 20 metara, koji se protežu kroz uzak pojas dug 1.800 kilometara. Ovi zagonetni krugovi izazvali su desetljeća nagađanja, sa objašnjenjima koja variraju od izvanzemaljskih aktivnosti do otrovnih plinova. Značajna studija objavljena prošle godine u časopisu Science sugerisala je da su odgovorni pješčani termiti, ali nijedna teorija nije konačno dokazana. "Vilinski krugovi su i dalje misterija. Provedena su opsežna istraživanja na terenu i u laboratorijima, ali još uvijek nema konačnih odgovora", kaže Stephan Getzin iz Centra za istraživanje okoliša Helmholtz u Leipzigu, Njemačka. Zajedno s izraelskim kolegama, Getzin je nedavno iznio novu teoriju. Koristeći zračne snimke, proučavali su raspored vilinskih krugova i otkrili obrasce slične onima u drugim krajolicima, poput 'tiger bush'-a u Nigeru i kružnih formacija spinifex trave u Australiji. Getzin je također spomenuo slične prstenaste šare u kalifornijskoj pustinji Mojave. On pretpostavlja da vilinski krugovi nastaju procesom samoorganizacije: U sušnim područjima sa malo vode i siromašnim tlom, biljke se natječu za ograničene resurse i prirodno se međusobno razmaknu, stvarajući ove ujednačene obrasce. Ova teorija je u suprotnosti s onom profesora biologije Norberta Juergensa, čija je studija povezala krugove sa pješčanim termitom Psammotermes allocerus. Juergens tvrdi da termiti uništavaju korijenje trave, praveći podzemne oaze u kojima voda sporije isparava. Ipak, Getzin ne pronalazi dovoljno dokaza da društveni insekti mogu stvoriti tako velike, ujednačene obrasce – njihova gnijezda obično su grupisana. Juergens je pješčanog termita naveo kao jedinu vrstu koja je stalno prisutna na cijelom tom području, posebno oko krugova. Međutim, drugi stručnjaci ostaju skeptični. Profesor biologije sa Sveučilišta Florida State, Walter Tschinkel, upozorava da prisutnost termita i krugova ne znači nužno uzročnu vezu. Također napominje kako je teorija samoorganizacije složenija i manje intuitivna mnogim ljudima. Pravi uzrok vilinskih krugova u Namibiji i dalje nije razjašnjen, što naglašava trajnu znatiželju i raspravu u znanstvenoj zajednici.

article_content: Seth Taras, an accomplished self-taught photographer, has created a powerful series of images that blend moments from the past with present-day settings. Using photo editing, he overlays historical photographs onto contemporary scenes, revealing how iconic events once happened in places now considered ordinary. His memorable composites include a dog-walker in today’s New Jersey with the burning Hindenburg airship behind him, and a businessman striding through modern Berlin as the outline of the former Berlin Wall rises up. In Paris, a couple relaxing near the Eiffel Tower share their space with a ghostly image of Adolf Hitler, captured during his visit in World War II. On the beaches of Normandy, modern-day visitors search the shoreline while images of Allied troops recreate the D-Day landings. These impactful photos featured in the History Channel's 2010 'Know Where You Stand' campaign, which invited viewers to connect with the history surrounding them. Taras traveled to each location, capturing images from the exact spots of the original photos, then carefully blended them with historical pictures. The 'Know Where You Stand' series earned Taras international recognition, including a Cannes Lion award. The campaign was translated into 30 languages and shared in 130 countries. More of Taras's creative work is available on his blog.

Njegove upečatljive kompozicije uključuju šetača pasa u današnjem New Jerseyju s gorućim zrakoplovom Hindenburg iza njega, kao i poslovnog čovjeka koji korača modernim Berlinom dok se obris nekadašnjeg Berlinskog zida uzdiže pred njim. U Parizu, par koji se odmara blizu Eiffelovog tornja dijeli prostor s duhom Adolfa Hitlera, fotografisanim tokom njegove posjete u Drugom svjetskom ratu. Na plažama Normandije, današnji posjetioci pretražuju obalu, dok slike savezničkih vojnika ponovo oživljavaju iskrcavanje na Dan D. Ove dojmljive fotografije bile su dio History Channel kampanje iz 2010. godine pod nazivom 'Znaj gdje stojiš', koja je gledatelje pozivala da se povežu s historijom oko sebe. Taras je putovao do svake lokacije, fotografisao iz istih uglova kao i originali, a zatim ih pažljivo spojio s historijskim snimcima. Serija 'Znaj gdje stojiš' donijela je Tarasu međunarodna priznanja, uključujući i nagradu Cannes Lion. Kampanja je prevedena na 30 jezika i prikazana u 130 zemalja. Više Tarasovih radova dostupno je na njegovom blogu.

article_content: Soldiers leaving the UK armed forces will be given priority access to council housing and mortgage assistance, a move the government hopes will better support service personnel and their families. Prime Minister David Cameron has announced that ministers will do everything possible to help those who have served, introducing new initiatives during Remembrance weekend to address the challenge of veterans being left unable to afford or access housing. Typically, veterans returning from foreign postings lack the local connections required by councils for housing allocations, a situation many have called discriminatory. Some ex-servicemen have found themselves homeless as a result. Housing Minister Grant Shapps will issue new guidance instructing local authorities to automatically place retiring service members in the highest priority category for council housing—just below those who are homeless. He is calling on councils to 'positively discriminate' in favor of former soldiers, sailors, and airmen where necessary. Additionally, anyone leaving the forces will be given first priority for support under the Government's FirstBuy scheme, which is designed to assist those with lower incomes in buying their own home with smaller deposits. This priority status will last for a year after leaving service. Mr. Shapps has also secured an agreement with credit agency Experian to let service personnel use a Ministry of Defence PO Box, helping them build a credit rating and ease the process of obtaining a mortgage. The government is investing an extra £16 million this year for a fund helping injured ex-servicemen adapt their homes with disabled facilities, raising the total budget to £185 million. "Our brave men and women in uniform aren’t asking for sympathy or handouts, but their selfless service can become a barrier to owning their own home," Mr. Shapps said. "That’s why we want those house-hunting heroes to be in the front of the queue for government-backed schemes like FirstBuy, and why we’re asking councils to ensure veterans aren’t left languishing on waiting lists." According to the charity Crisis, formerly 25% of the homeless population had military experience, though that figure is now closer to 3%. The average Army private earns £17,265 after initial training, making it difficult to save for a home, and many face homelessness or post-traumatic stress disorder. Mr. Cameron emphasized: "As a country, we must do everything possible to support our armed forces, especially those returning wounded or caring for families. Our focus is to provide the help they need and deserve."

article_content: Mohamed ElBaradei, a prominent Egyptian reformist and Nobel Peace Prize laureate, has described the military's removal of President Mohamed Morsy as the right decision for the country. In an interview with CNN, ElBaradei stressed the importance of ensuring all political groups, including Morsy's Muslim Brotherhood, are included in shaping Egypt's future. "We cannot afford Egypt to fail," he said. ElBaradei, who helped lead the movement that ousted President Hosni Mubarak in 2011, criticized Morsy for failing to govern inclusively and not effectively addressing Egypt's economic problems. Mass protests against Morsy's leadership recently led to the military stepping in, placing Morsy under house arrest and appointing an interim leader after he refused to meet opposition demands. Despite international debate, ElBaradei insisted that the military’s intervention does not constitute a coup but served as an emergency measure to prevent possible civil unrest and keep the nation united. He called the action a 'recall,' adding, 'It is nothing novel.' ElBaradei noted that while Morsy's election was relatively free, his administration fell short of expectations, leading to widespread calls for his resignation. He argued that Morsy's removal offers Egypt an opportunity to 'reset' by writing a new constitution and forming an inclusive government. ElBaradei emphasized that members of the Muslim Brotherhood, and other factions, should have roles in the new political process, stating, 'We need everybody to be part of the political process. We need a cohesive society that is tolerant and respects differences.' Although ElBaradei says he has no interest in the presidency, he remains committed to supporting Egypt during this transition. He highlighted the urgent need to deliver tangible improvements for the Egyptian people, warning of the risks if groups like the Muslim Brotherhood feel excluded. 'My fear is that the Brotherhood will fear that they are excluded. We need a quick delivery… to show the people that we are really focusing on their basic needs,' he told CNN. CNN’s Becky Anderson reported from Cairo, and Greg Botelho contributed from Atlanta.

U intervjuu za CNN, ElBaradei je naglasio važnost uključivanja svih političkih grupa, uključujući Morsyjevu Muslimansku braću, u oblikovanje budućnosti Egipta. Masovni protesti protiv Morsyja nedavno su doveli do vojne intervencije, njegovog stavljanja u kućni pritvor i imenovanja privremenog lidera nakon što nije ispunio zahtjeve opozicije. Smatra da Morsyjevo uklanjanje Egiptu pruža priliku za novi početak kroz izradu novog ustava i formiranje uključive vlade. Posebno je istakao koliko je važno da članovi Muslimanskog bratstva i drugih grupa budu dio novog političkog procesa, rekavši: 'Trebamo sve uključiti u politički proces. Potrebna nam je brza reakcija… kako bismo pokazali ljudima da se zaista fokusiramo na njihove osnovne potrebe,' rekao je za CNN. Becky Anderson je izvještavala iz Kaira, dok je Greg Botelho doprinio iz Atlante za CNN.

article_content: Neptune Collonges, the champion of this year’s Grand National, returned to his home in Ditcheat, Somerset, where about 300 locals gathered along the streets to greet him with applause. The grey horse, trained by Paul Nicholls and ridden by Daryl Jacob, was celebrated with a festive parade. The Manor House Inn served as the center of activities, with landlord Simon D’Offay mentioning record champagne sales due to the festivities. Neptune Collonges’s recent win at Aintree marked the end of his racing career. Head Lad Clifford Baker confirmed the horse is now retired, saying he deserves to relax after such achievements. While the village enjoyed the victory, the mood was somber because of fatal incidents at the race. Gold Cup winner Synchronised and another favorite, According To Pete, both suffered fatal injuries and had to be put down. Paul Nicholls, the trainer, admitted these losses overshadowed some of the positive press around the win, but he encouraged everyone to appreciate the celebration. Peter Nelson, owner of According To Pete, described his devastation, calling the horse part of the family and sharing that many people had reached out with condolences. He said he won’t be entering horses in the Grand National again. Andrew Tyler, director of Animal Aid, condemned the Grand National as dangerous for horses, citing extensive fatalities over the years and calling for change. This year alone, 41 racehorses have died in the UK, with the Grand National accounting for 36 deaths in the last half-century. Aintree managing director Julian Thick offered sympathies over the recent losses and noted that safety changes had been made since last year, with a promise to keep reviewing safety at the event. Two jockeys were also injured: Noel Fehily sustained serious fractures in his leg after a fall from State of Play, and Brian Hughes suffered facial injuries, possibly a fractured cheekbone, after falling from Viking Blond.

Sivog konja, kojeg trenira Paul Nicholls, a jahao ga je Daryl Jacob, selo je slavilo u pobjedničkoj paradi. The Manor House Inn bio je središte slavlja, a vlasnik Simon D’Offay spomenuo je rekordnu prodaju šampanjca tokom proslave. Pobjednik Gold Cupa Synchronised i još jedan favorit According To Pete zadobili su teške povrede i morali su biti uspavani. Andrew Tyler, direktor organizacije Animal Aid, osudio je Grand National kao opasan za konje, naglašavajući brojne smrti i pozvao na promjene. Ove godine u Velikoj Britaniji stradalo je 41 trkaći konj, dok je na Grand Nationalu u posljednjih 50 godina poginulo 36 konja. Direktor Aintreeja Julian Thick izrazio je saučešće zbog nedavnih gubitaka i rekao da su uvedene sigurnosne promjene, te najavio dalja unapređenja sigurnosti događaja. article_content: Since Israel began its military operation in Gaza on October 7, Iran-backed groups have launched dozens of attacks on US positions in Syria and Iraq. US military bases have repeatedly come under fire from rockets, missiles, and drones, raising concerns about a potential broader conflict. According to US officials, while there have been injuries to US personnel, there have been no US military fatalities. The only reported US fatality was a civilian contractor in Iraq who died of a heart attack during an attack. The United States has responded with airstrikes on sites in eastern Syria believed to be linked to Iran-backed groups, including recent strikes near Abu Kamal and Mayadin. The Pentagon did not disclose the extent of the damage. The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights (SOHR) claimed that eight members of Iran-backed militias were killed, though Al Jazeera could not independently verify this number. US authorities maintain their strikes are acts of self-defense, not coordinated with Israel, and are not linked directly to the Gaza conflict. However, regional tensions have increased, particularly given the high number of Palestinian deaths in Gaza—reported at over 11,000 after nearly 40 days of Israeli bombardment. Iran and its allies, dubbed the ‘resistance axis’ and including groups like Hezbollah in Lebanon and the Houthis in Yemen, have stepped up threats and attacks as the war in Gaza continues. Iran has warned of new fronts opening if Israel does not cease its military campaign. Hezbollah has engaged Israeli forces on the Lebanese border, while the Houthis have targeted southern Israel. Experts note that Iran seeks to pressure the US by raising costs for its involvement in the region. Hamidreza Azizi from the German Institute for International and Security Affairs (SWP) explained that Iran and its allies want the US to reconsider its support for Israel and reduce its regional military presence, which recently expanded with additional carrier groups and a nuclear submarine. Iran exerts considerable influence in Iraq and Syria, supporting Syrian President Bashar al-Assad, who has denounced Western support for Israel and called for a US withdrawal from Syria. The US justifies its presence as necessary to prevent an ISIL resurgence alongside Kurdish partners. President al-Assad's diplomatic isolation lessened this year, with his participation at a major Arab-Islamic summit in Saudi Arabia. There, he criticized the cycle of violence in Gaza and Western roles enabling Israeli military operations. So far, escalations between US forces and Iran-backed groups have been limited, with neither side causing US combat fatalities. Analysts suggest both are observing tacit rules to avoid major retaliation, but warn of the risk of miscalculation. Any future deaths of US personnel could lead to significant escalation, amid ongoing criticism of the US administration’s handling of Iran’s actions.
translated_content: Od 7. oktobra, kada je Izrael započeo vojnu operaciju u Gazi, grupe koje podržava Iran izvele su desetine napada na američke položaje u Siriji i Iraku. Američke vojne baze su više puta bile meta raketa, projektila i dronova, što je izazvalo zabrinutost zbog mogućeg širenja sukoba. Prema američkim zvaničnicima, iako je bilo povrijeđenih među američkim osobljem, do sada nije bilo poginulih američkih vojnika. Jedina prijavljena smrt bila je civilni izvođač radova u Iraku koji je preminuo od srčanog udara tokom napada. Sjedinjene Američke Države su uzvratile zračnim udarima na lokacije u istočnoj Siriji za koje se vjeruje da su povezane sa grupama koje podržava Iran, uključujući nedavne udare u blizini Abu Kamala i Majadina. Pentagon nije iznio detalje o počinjenoj šteti. Sirijska opservatorija za ljudska prava (SOHR) navodi da je osam pripadnika proiranskih milicija poginulo, mada Al Jazeera nije nezavisno potvrdila ove podatke. Američke vlasti tvrde da su njihovi udari akti samoodbrane, nisu koordinirani s Izraelom i nisu direktno povezani sa sukobom u Gazi. Ipak, regionalne tenzije su pojačane, naročito zbog velikog broja stradalih Palestinaca u Gazi—prijavljeno je više od 11.000 žrtava nakon skoro 40 dana izraelskog bombardovanja. Iran i njegovi saveznici, nazivani 'osovina otpora', među kojima su Hezbollah iz Libana i Huti iz Jemena, povećali su prijetnje i napade dok rat u Gazi traje. Iran je upozorio na otvaranje novih frontova ako Izrael ne prekine vojnu kampanju. Hezbollah se sukobljava sa izraelskim snagama na libanskoj granici, a Huti su gađali jug Izraela. Stručnjaci smatraju da Iran nastoji vršiti pritisak na SAD povećanjem cijene njihovog prisustva u regionu. Hamidreza Azizi iz Njemačkog instituta za međunarodne i sigurnosne poslove (SWP) objasnio je da Iran i njihovi saveznici žele da SAD preispitaju podršku Izraelu i smanje vojno prisustvo, koje je nedavno pojačano dodatnim nosačima aviona i nuklearnom podmornicom. Iran ima znatan uticaj u Iraku i Siriji, podržava sirijskog predsjednika Bashara al-Assada, koji je osudio zapadnu podršku Izraelu i traži povlačenje američkih snaga iz Sirije. SAD navode da su prisutni kako bi spriječili povratak ISIL-a u saradnji s kurdskim partnerima. Diplomatska izolacija predsjednika al-Assada ublažena je ove godine njegovim učešćem na velikom arapsko-islamskom samitu u Saudijskoj Arabiji, gdje je kritikovao ciklus nasilja u Gazi i ulogu Zapada u omogućavanju izraelskih vojnih operacija. Za sada su eskalacije između američkih snaga i grupa koje podržava Iran bile ograničene, bez poginulih američkih vojnika. Analitičari vjeruju da obje strane neformalno izbjegavaju težu odmazdu, ali upozoravaju na mogućnost pogrešne procjene. Buduće žrtve među američkim osobljem mogle bi dovesti do ovakve eskalacije, uz stalnu kritiku američke administracije zbog pristupa prema Iranu.

article_content: During the kickoff event in Newcastle for the 2015 Rugby World Cup, legendary England player Jonny Wilkinson accidentally separated the base from the Webb Ellis Cup while taking promotional photos. Despite the mishap, he kept hold of the main trophy and, after some initial embarrassment, was helped by onlookers who returned the base. Wilkinson quickly recovered and resumed the photo session with a smile. Known for his winning drop goal in the 2003 World Cup, Wilkinson was present as the ambassador for England Rugby 2015. The gathering at St James’ Park also featured the launch of regional volunteer selection events, including ‘Try Outs’ and assembling ‘The Pack’—the group of 6,000 volunteers supporting the upcoming tournament. Wilkinson, who began the volunteer recruitment earlier in the year, joined candidates in the selection process during his visit, interacting directly and marking the start of preparations for the opening match between South Africa and Scotland.

Uprkos tom gaf-u, uspio je zadržati glavni dio trofeja i, nakon kratke nelagode, prisutni su mu vratili postolje. Wilkinson se brzo pribrao i nasmiješen nastavio fotografisanje. Poznat po odlučujućem drop-goalu iz finala Svjetskog prvenstva 2003., Wilkinson je bio prisutan kao ambasador England Rugby 2015. Događaj na stadionu St James’ Park je također bio povod za pokretanje regionalnih selekcija za volontere, uključujući 'Try Outs' i okupljanje 'The Pack'—grupe od 6.000 volontera koji će podržavati nadolazeći turnir. Wilkinson, koji je ranije ove godine započeo potragu za volonterima, pridružio se kandidatima tokom selekcijskog procesa, direktno učestvujući i obilježavajući početak priprema za utakmicu otvaranja između Južnoafričke Republike i Škotske.

article_content: London, England (CNN) -- The United Kingdom’s financial regulator announced on Wednesday that it has banned an oil trader after he made significant trades while intoxicated last year, resulting in an unusual surge in the global price of Brent crude oil. Steven Noel Perkins, previously an oil futures broker at the London office of PVM Oil Futures, was also fined £72,000 ($108,400) for market abuse, according to the Financial Services Authority (FSA). Perkins is now prohibited from working in the financial services industry, as the FSA deemed him 'not a fit and proper person.' Perkins’ role involved executing orders in Brent crude futures contracts on the ICE Futures Europe (ICE) exchange for clients of his firm. However, early in the morning of Tuesday, June 30, 2009, the FSA reported that Perkins placed trades on the ICE exchange without any client authorization, accumulating a large outright position. As a direct result of these trades, the price of Brent crude rose significantly, hitting $73.50 a barrel—the highest point that year, according to Reuters. The FSA indicated that Perkins’ trading was likely due to 'extremely heavy drinking,' stemming from his acknowledged struggles with alcoholism. Perkins had consumed excessive amounts of alcohol over the weekend prior and continued into the following Monday before making the unauthorized trades. Alexander Justham, director of markets at the FSA, stated, 'The FSA views market manipulation extremely seriously. Perkins’ trading caused disruption and resulted in both a fine and prohibition. Severe sanctions will be applied in cases of market manipulation, even when no profit is made. Perkins’ intoxication does not excuse his market abuse.' Additionally, the FSA considered that Perkins initially lied to his employer in attempts to hide his unauthorized activity. Following the incident, Perkins entered an alcohol rehabilitation program and has reportedly stopped drinking. The FSA noted that Perkins could be considered fit and proper again in the future, and therefore limited the ban to a minimum term of five years. While the penalty for Perkins’ behavior would typically amount to £150,000 ($225,900), the FSA reduced it to £90,000 ($135,500) due to concerns that the higher sum would create significant financial hardship. Because Perkins agreed to settle, the fine was further reduced by 20 percent.

Steven Noel Perkins, bivši broker terminskih ugovora na naftu u londonskoj kancelariji kompanije PVM Oil Futures, također je kažnjen sa 72.000 funti (108.400 dolara) zbog zloupotrebe tržišta, navodi Financial Services Authority (FSA). Perkinsu je sada zabranjen rad u finansijskoj industriji jer ga je FSA proglasila 'neadekvatnom i neodgovarajućom osobom.' Perkinsova uloga bila je izvršavanje naloga za terminske ugovore na Brent nafti na ICE Futures Europe (ICE) berzi za klijente firme. Međutim, rano ujutro u utorak, 30. juna 2009. godine, FSA navodi da je Perkins bez odobrenja klijenata trgovao na ICE berzi, stekavši veliku izloženu poziciju. Kao direktna posljedica ovih transakcija, cijena Brent nafte značajno je porasla, dostigavši 73,50 dolara po barelu—najviši nivo te godine, prema Reutersu. FSA navodi da su Perkinsove transakcije vjerovatno rezultat 'izuzetno velikog konzumiranja alkohola', što je povezano s njegovim priznatim problemom alkoholizma. Perkins je konzumirao velike količine alkohola tokom vikenda i nastavio i u ponedjeljak prije nego je napravio neodobrene transakcije. Alexander Justham, direktor tržišta FSA, izjavio je: 'FSA izuzetno ozbiljno pristupa manipulaciji tržištem. Perkinsovo trgovanje izazvalo je poremećaj na tržištu i rezultiralo kaznom i zabranom. Stroge sankcije će biti primijenjene u slučajevima manipulacije tržištem, čak i kada nije ostvaren profit. Perkinsovo pijanstvo ne opravdava njegovu zloupotrebu tržišta.' FSA je također uzela u obzir da je Perkins prvotno lagao poslodavcu pokušavajući prikriti neovlašteno trgovanje. Poslije incidenta, Perkins se prijavio u program rehabilitacije za alkoholičare i navodno je prestao piti. FSA je navela da Perkins u budućnosti može ponovo biti smatran prikladnim za rad, pa je zabrana ograničena na minimalni period od pet godina. Iako bi kazna za Perkinsovo ponašanje obično iznosila 150.000 funti (225.900 dolara), FSA ju je smanjila na 90.000 funti (135.500 dolara) zbog bojazni da bi viši iznos stvorio ozbiljne financijske poteškoće. Pošto je Perkins pristao na nagodbu, kazna je dodatno smanjena za 20 posto.

article_content: The Habit Burger Grill, founded in Santa Barbara in 1969, was named America's best fast food burger in a recent Consumer Reports survey. With only 11 locations outside California, The Habit is less recognized than In-N-Out but surpassed the popular chain in the survey rankings. Following the publication of the July survey results, The Habit's website experienced a surge in traffic as many sought more information. The Consumer Reports survey included 65 major fast food chains and evaluated nearly 100,000 menu items, among them burgers, chicken sandwiches, subs, and burritos. Customers rated the taste of their food on a scale from 1 to 10, and The Habit’s cheeseburgers scored above 8. The Habit Burger Grill is renowned for its signature Charburger, featuring a classic beef patty with mayonnaise, pickles, tomato, lettuce, and caramelized onions on a toasted bun. Options like mushrooms and bacon are also available as toppings. Other menu items include grilled albacore tuna sandwiches, salads, shakes, sundaes, and cones. According to the survey, McDonald's ranked last among major burger chains, with 21 other burgers rated ahead of the Big Mac. The survey results highlight a trend toward higher-quality, customizable food, with restaurants like Chipotle, Panda Express, Noodles & Company, and Panera rising in popularity. Industry experts note that millennials are leading this shift by choosing affordable, fast-casual dining experiences that offer customization and better-quality ingredients.
