article_content: Vice President Joe Biden, speaking at the Jewish Federations of North America’s meeting in New Orleans, reiterated America’s steadfast commitment to Israel, describing U.S.-Israel ties as 'literally unbreakable.' Before his remarks, Biden held an hour-long meeting with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who is scheduled to address the same audience soon after. Acknowledging recent reports about friction — especially following Israel’s March announcement of 1,600 new housing units in East Jerusalem during Biden’s trip — he stressed that disagreements between the countries have been only tactical, never fundamental. Biden stated that the current administration continues a tradition of strong support for Israel, a stance President Obama also firmly upholds. Biden advocated for resuming direct peace talks between Israel and the Palestinians, which halted when Israel did not extend its freeze on settlement expansions in September. He affirmed the U.S. would always defend Israel’s legitimacy, but stressed that enduring security would ultimately come through genuine peace agreements. He asserted that direct, in-person talks are indispensable, and warned both parties not to take independent actions that could undermine future negotiations. Referencing recent comments by Palestinian Authority President Mahmoud Abbas — who mentioned turning to the U.S. or the United Nations for new solutions if talks fail — Biden acknowledged America’s responsibility to help the Palestinians bring their concerns before the U.N. if necessary.

Prije svog izlaganja, Biden je sat vremena razgovarao s izraelskim premijerom Benjaminom Netanyahuom, koji će se uskoro također obratiti istoj publici. Osvrnuvši se na nedavne izvještaje o napetostima – posebno nakon izraelske najave izgradnje 1.600 novih stambenih jedinica u Istočnom Jerusalemu tokom Bidenove posjete u martu – naglasio je da su nesuglasice između zemalja uvijek bile samo taktičke, nikada suštinske. Biden je naveo da ova administracija nastavlja tradiciju snažne američke podrške Izraelu, what također čvrsto podržava predsjednik Obama. Biden je podržao obnovu izravnih mirovnih pregovora između Izraela i Palestinaca, koji su prekinuti nakon što Izrael nije produžio zamrzavanje širenja naselja u rujnu. Potvrdio je američku spremnost za odbranu izraelskog legitimiteta, ali je istakao kako održiva sigurnost može doći jedino kroz iskren i stabilan mir s susjedima. Naglasio je da nema alternative izravnim, ličnim pregovorima i upozorio obje strane da izbjegavaju jednostrane poteze koji bi mogli ugroziti nastavak pregovora. Pozvao se na nedavne izjave predsjednika Palestinske uprave Mahmouda Abbasa, koji je najavio mogući obraćaj SAD-u za novi okvir pregovora ili zahtjev Ujedinjenim nacijama ako pregovori propadnu. Biden je priznao da SAD imaju odgovornost pomoći Palestincima u iznošenju svojih zahtjeva pred UN, ukoliko to bude nužno.

article_content: Central Government pensioners are required to submit an Annual Life Certificate each year in November to continue receiving their pension. Pension Disbursing Agencies, such as banks, facilitate these submissions. Pensioners aged 80 years and above have a special provision allowing them to file their Annual Life Certificate from October 1, a month earlier than others, for added convenience. Defence pensioners must complete annual identification, either digitally using an Aadhaar-based Digital Life Certificate or manually through designated authorities. Most post-2016 defence pensioners have transitioned to the SPARSH (System for Pension Administration - RAKSHA) platform. Over 39,000 pensioners missed the extended deadline of March 31, 2023, to submit their life certificates, potentially affecting their pension payments. SPARSH manages pension sanction and disbursement for the Indian Army, Navy, Air Force, and Defence Civilians. For identification using Aadhaar (Digital Life Certificate), pensioners should access the SPARSH portal and navigate to Services > Identification > Digital Life Certificate. For manual submission, select Services > Identification > Manual Life Certificate. The Jeevan Pramaan Portal is an effective platform for submitting Digital Life Certificates, especially for Aadhaar-linked pension accounts. Appropriate selections include: Category: Central Govt., Sanctioning Authority: Defence-PCDA(P) Allahabad, Pension Disbursing Agency: SPARSH-PCDA(P) Allahabad, and entering the 12-digit ePPO or SPARSH PPO number. If the PPO number is unavailable, the PCDA(P) Portal's migration tab allows searching using Regiment/Army numbers. How to submit a Digital Life Certificate via Jeevan Pramaan Portal: 1. Download and open the Jeevan Pramaan software. 2. Enter your Aadhaar number and registered mobile number. 3. Generate and enter the OTP sent to your registered mobile number. 4. Select the PPO number from the dropdown or add a new PPO number if not listed. 5. Enter your name as shown in your PPO, choose 'Service' as pension type, and 'Central Government' as organization type. 6. Choose 'Defence PCDA (P) Allahabad' as the sanctioning authority and 'SPARSH PCDA (PENSIONS), Allahabad' as the PDA, then enter your 12-digit SPARSH PPO number. 7. Enter your pension bank account number, answer the prompts, and continue. 8. Tick the declaration boxes, submit, and authenticate using your biometric device. After successful authentication, a Digital Life Certificate will be generated. A link to the certificate will be sent to your registered email and mobile number. Click the link, use your Pension ID to generate an OTP, and download your certificate.

Vojni penzioneri također moraju izvršiti godišnju identifikaciju, bilo digitalno pomoću Digitalnog životnog certifikata na bazi Aadhaar-a ili ručno preko ovlaštenih tijela. Većina vojnih penzionera nakon 2016. prešla je na SPARSH (Sistem administracije penzija – RAKSHA) platformu. Više od 39.000 penzionera nije podnijelo svoj životni certifikat do produženog roka 31. marta 2023., što može uticati na isplatu penzije. SPARSH upravlja odobravanjem i isplatom penzija za indijsku vojsku, mornaricu, zrakoplovstvo i civilna lica zaposlenih u odbrani. Za identifikaciju pomoću Aadhaar-a (Digitalni životni certifikat), penzioneri trebaju pristupiti SPARSH portalu i odabrati Usluge > Identifikacija > Digitalni životni certifikat. Za ručnu prijavu odaberite Usluge > Identifikacija > Ručni životni certifikat. Jeevan Pramaan Portal je efikasan način za podnošenje Digitalnog životnog certifikata, posebno za penzione račune povezane sa Aadhaar-om. Pravilan izbor uključuje: Kategorija: Centralna vlada, Autoritet za odobrenje: Defence-PCDA(P) Allahabad, Agencija za isplatu penzija: SPARSH-PCDA(P) Allahabad, i unos 12-cifrenog ePPO ili SPARSH PPO broja. Ako PPO broj nije dostupan, na PCDA(P) portalu u tabu za migraciju možete koristiti broj puka/armije za pretragu. Kako podnijeti Digitalni životni certifikat putem Jeevan Pramaan portala: 1. Preuzmite i otvorite Jeevan Pramaan softver. 2. Unesite svoj Aadhaar broj i registrovani broj mobitela. 3. Generišite i upišite OTP poslan na vaš registrovani broj mobitela. 4. Odaberite PPO broj sa padajućeg izbornika ili dodajte novi PPO broj ako nije naveden. 5. Unesite svoje ime kako je navedeno u PPO-u, izaberite 'Usluga' kao vrstu penzije i 'Centralna vlada' kao tip organizacije. 6. Izaberite 'Defence PCDA (P) Allahabad' kao ovlaštenje za odobrenje i 'SPARSH PCDA (PENSIONS), Allahabad' kao PDA, zatim unesite svoj 12-cifreni SPARSH PPO broj. 7. Unesite broj svog bankovnog računa za penziju, odgovorite na pitanja i nastavite. 8. Označite polja za izjavu, pošaljite podatke i potvrdite identitet putem biometrijskog uređaja. Nakon uspješne autentifikacije, Digitalni životni certifikat će biti generisan. Link do certifikata biće poslan na vašu registrovanu e-mail adresu i broj mobitela. Kliknite na link, unesite svoj identifikacijski broj penzionera da dobijete OTP i preuzmite certifikat.

article_content: In southern Gaza, a baby girl named Mariam was delivered at Nasser Hospital after her mother, Raneem Hejazi, sustained critical injuries in an Israeli airstrike that killed several family members. At eight months pregnant, Raneem was pulled from debris with serious injuries to her arm and legs. Due to a lack of electricity and water, health workers had to perform an emergency C-section using mobile phones for light and without proper sanitation or antibiotics. Despite grave challenges, Mariam is now stable. Raneem's arm had to be amputated, and she remains hospitalized in critical condition. Dr. Mohammad Qandeel, who led the procedure, says these cases are becoming increasingly common. Many wounded mothers urgently need evacuation for adequate treatment, but with borders closed, advanced care is out of reach. The hospital is overwhelmed by hundreds of severe cases—mainly women and children—forced to operate under extreme shortages of supplies and basic necessities. Dominic Allen from the UN Population Fund warns that around 50,000 pregnant women in Gaza now face grave risks, often fleeing for their lives and lacking safe places for childbirth. The organization distributes medical and hygiene kits, but persistent power and internet outages hinder access to support services. Hospitals, overrun by airstrike casualties, only admit laboring women at the final stage and discharge them soon after birth, leaving many without adequate shelter or resources. Lack of clean water is a significant concern, especially for mothers trying to breastfeed. Aid organizations and the UN are advocating for an immediate humanitarian ceasefire. Families like Raneem’s remain trapped by closed borders, unable to access life-saving medical care amid relentless hardship.

Raneem, koja je bila trudna osam mjeseci, izvučena je iz ruševina sa ozbiljnim povredama ruke i nogu. Zbog nedostatka struje i vode, medicinari su morali izvesti hitni carski rez koristeći svjetlo mobilnog telefona, bez pravilnih higijenskih uslova ili antibiotika. Uprkos teškim okolnostima, Mariam je sada stabilna. Raneem je morala biti podvrgnuta amputaciji ruke i još uvijek je u kritičnom stanju. Dr. Mohammad Qandeel, koji je vodio operaciju, kaže da su ovakvi slučajevi sve učestaliji. Mnoge ranjene majke očajnički trebaju evakuaciju na bolje liječenje, ali zatvorene granice to onemogućavaju. Bolnica je preopterećena sa stotinama teških slučajeva – najviše žena i djece – i funkcionira u uslovima velike nestašice osnovnih zaliha. Dominic Allen iz Populacionog fonda UN-a upozorava da oko 50.000 trudnica u Gazi snosi velike rizike, često bježeći i bez sigurnog mjesta za porod. Organizacija dijeli medicinske i higijenske pakete, ali stalni nestanci struje i interneta otežavaju pristup pomoći. Bolnice pretrpane ranjenicima primaju trudnice samo u posljednjim fazama poroda i otpuštaju ih ubrzo nakon rođenja, često bez skloništa i neophodnih resursa. Nedostatak čiste vode je poseban problem, posebno za dojilje. Humanitarne organizacije i UN pozivaju na hitan prekid vatre. Porodice poput Raneemine ostaju zatočene zatvorenim granicama, bez pristupa životno važnoj medicinskoj pomoći, suočene sa svakodnevnom borbom za preživljavanje.

article_content: Apple's new iPad Air Plus is rumored to feature a 12.2-inch screen and four speakers, enabling stereo sound in any orientation. Reports indicate the device may launch next year, with some suggesting the display could be as large as 12.9 inches. It is expected to utilize a faster A9 processor, according to Japanese magazine Mac Fan. The iPad Air Plus would be larger than both the iPad Mini (7.9-inch screen) and iPad Air (9.7-inch screen). The new model could debut between April and June next year. Bloomberg and The Wall Street Journal previously reported that Apple postponed mass production of the larger iPad from December 2014 to early 2015, due to high demand for the iPhone 6 and 6 Plus. Recent rumors indicate production may begin in the first or second quarter of next year. In design, the larger iPad is expected to resemble the iPad Air, with rounded corners and a thickness of just 7mm. Drawings in Mac Fan support expectations of a 12.2-inch screen and slim profile. Multiple reports indicate Apple is developing a larger iPad, with rumored display sizes ranging from 12 to 12.9 inches. This development follows data showing that bigger phones, like the iPhone 6 Plus, reduce iPad usage. According to Pocket, an app for saving articles and videos, users who upgrade to larger iPhones spend more time reading and watching content on their phones, and less on their tablets. After upgrading to an iPhone 6 Plus, tablet use dropped by 36 percent. Pocket's research found that iPhone 6 users engage with 33 percent more content on their phones than with a 5S, while iPhone 6 Plus users engage 65 percent more. The iPhone 6 accounted for about 68 percent of early fall sales, with the 6 Plus at around 23–24 percent. Larger phones are increasingly used to consume content. Despite decreased tablet use overall, iPads remain popular for nighttime reading, with users reaching for them around 9 p.m., regardless of phone model. However, iPhone 6 Plus users read 22 percent less during their morning commute, likely due to decreased portability. Ultimately, convenience and portability remain influential in device choice, with more Pocket users opting for the iPhone 6 over the larger 6 Plus.

Novi model mogao bi biti predstavljen između aprila i juna sljedeće godine. Bloomberg i The Wall Street Journal ranije su izvještavali da je Apple odgodio masovnu proizvodnju većeg iPada sa decembra 2014. na početak 2015. godine zbog velike potražnje za iPhone 6 i 6 Plus. Najnovije glasine ukazuju da bi proizvodnja mogla početi u prvom ili drugom kvartalu iduće godine. Očekuje se da će dizajn većeg iPada podsjećati na iPad Air, sa zaobljenim uglovima i debljinom od samo 7 mm. Crteži u magazinu Mac Fan potvrđuju očekivanja o ekranu od 12,2 inča i tankom profilu. Više izvještaja navodi da Apple razvija veći iPad, s navodima o veličinama ekrana između 12 i 12,9 inča. Ovaj razvoj dolazi nakon podataka koji pokazuju da veći telefoni, poput iPhone 6 Plus, smanjuju upotrebu iPada. Prema aplikaciji Pocket za spremanje članaka i videa, korisnici koji pređu na veći iPhone više vremena provode čitajući i gledajući sadržaj na telefonu, a manje na tabletu. Međutim, korisnici iPhone 6 Plus manje čitaju tokom jutarnjih putovanja – za 22 posto manje – vjerovatno zbog manje prenosivosti. Na kraju, praktičnost i prenosivost ostaju važni faktori pri izboru uređaja, pa više korisnika Pocket-a bira iPhone 6 u odnosu na veći 6 Plus.

article_content: By Olivia Williams. PUBLISHED: 07:28 EST, 25 July 2013 | UPDATED: 07:42 EST, 25 July 2013. Border security at New York's La Guardia Airport confiscated shoes with gun-shaped heels, despite the plastic footwear being incapable of firing a bullet. A Transportation Security Administration (TSA) spokeswoman tweeted a photo of the heels on July 16, stating, 'What not to wear through a #LGA checkpoint.' The shoes, considered high fashion, were prohibited from carry-on luggage, but would have been allowed in checked baggage. The owner voluntarily surrendered them, so no arrest was made. The confiscation was shared online on the TSA's Twitter and Instagram accounts to remind travelers about items not permitted in carry-on bags. The shoes remain at the airport's 'prohibited items' section, and no one has claimed them. British socialite Tara Palmer-Tomkinson previously faced arrest at Zurich Airport in March after attempting to travel with gun-shaped shoes in her luggage. She tweeted a photo of Chanel's resort 2009 collection heels, saying, 'Was arrested at Zurich airport with my Chanel killer heels in my luggage... not a good look on the x-ray!' In 2008, Madonna received criticism for wearing Chanel’s pistol heels, which some felt glamorized gun use. According to the TSA, 49 real firearms were confiscated from travelers in just one week.

Granična kontrola na njujorškom aerodromu La Guardia zaplijenila je cipele s potpeticama u obliku pištolja, iako te plastične cipele nisu mogle ispaliti metak. Glasnogovornica Uprave za sigurnost transporta (TSA) objavila je 16. jula fotografiju tih potpetica na Twitteru s porukom: 'Šta ne nositi kroz #LGA kontrolni punkt.' Cipele, koje se smatraju modnim detaljem, nisu bile dopuštene u ručnoj prtljazi, ali bi bile dozvoljene u čekiranoj prtljazi. Vlasnica ih je dragovoljno predala, pa nije bilo hapšenja. Zaplena je podijeljena na TSA-inim profilima na Twitteru i Instagramu kako bi putnici bili podsjećeni na stvari koje nisu dozvoljene u ručnoj prtljazi. Cipele se i dalje nalaze u sekciji 'zabranjenih predmeta' aerodroma i još ih niko nije preuzeo. Britanska jetseterka Tara Palmer-Tomkinson je u martu prethodno bila uhapšena na aerodromu u Zurichu kada je pokušala putovati s cipelama u obliku pištolja u svojoj prtljazi. Objavila je fotografiju Chanelove resort kolekcije za 2009. na kojoj piše: 'Uhvatili su me na aerodromu u Zurichu sa Chanel killer potpeticama u prtljazi... nije bilo lijepo na rendgenskom snimku!' Madonna je 2008. godine kritikovana jer je nosila Chanelove potpetice u obliku pištolja, što su neki smatrali promovisanjem upotrebe oružja. Prema podacima TSA, tokom samo jedne sedmice zaplijenjeno je 49 pravih pištolja od putnika.

article_content: After stepping down as Secretary of State, Hillary Clinton has signed on with the Harry Walker Agency, a renowned talent agency that secures lucrative speaking engagements for public figures. This marks her first formal post-government career move. Clinton, often considered a frontrunner for the 2016 Democratic presidential nomination if she chooses to run, could now command six-figure fees for her speeches. Her choice is unsurprising as her husband, former President Bill Clinton, has been represented by the same agency since leaving office in 2000. Bill Clinton earned $75.6 million from speaking engagements between 2001 and 2010, including $10.7 million in 2010 alone. Other notable agency clients include former Vice President Al Gore, who earns $175,000 per appearance; Rudy Giuliani, who commands $100,000 per event; former Vice President Dick Cheney; former Senators Olympia Snowe and Joe Lieberman; Obama campaign strategist Jim Messina; and former United Nations Secretary-General Kofi Annan. While Hillary Clinton's specific asking price has not been disclosed, reports suggest she may offer some speeches pro bono for causes she supports and occasionally donate her speaking fees to charity. The agency also represents high-profile non-political figures, such as Charlie Sheen (reportedly earning $200,000 per appearance), Kim Kardashian, Nicole 'Snooki' Polizzi, Sarah Palin, Bristol Palin, and others. Clinton has also indicated that she plans to write another book focusing on her time as Secretary of State. Simon & Schuster reportedly paid her an $8 million advance for her previous memoir, 'Living History,' published in 2000. Any roles Clinton undertakes will be scrutinized for their appropriateness for a potential presidential candidate. Balancing public perception and personal finances remains a consideration, especially given the Clintons' lifestyle and her ability to now earn significant speaking fees. Although there were earlier rumors of the Clintons purchasing a home in the Hamptons, they are expected to divide their time between their current residences in Washington, D.C., and Chappaqua, New York. Hillary Clinton may also work with the Clinton Foundation or potentially launch her own, though no firm decisions have been announced. For now, she has publicly confirmed plans to rest after a demanding four years traveling to 112 countries. Meanwhile, as Clinton remains quiet about her political future, potential rivals are actively fundraising. New Jersey Governor Chris Christie and Florida Senator Marco Rubio have raised substantial funds, with Christie attending a fundraiser at Mark Zuckerberg's California home and Rubio raising $100,000 through an inventive water-bottle campaign after his State of the Union response.

Ovo je njen prvi zvanični korak nakon izlaska iz državne službe. Clinton, koju mnogi vide kao favoritkinju za predsjedničku nominaciju Demokratske stranke 2016. ako se odluči kandidovati, sada bi mogla zarađivati honorare od šest cifara za svoja predavanja. Bill Clinton je od 2001. do 2010. godine zaradio 75,6 miliona dolara od govora, uključujući 10,7 miliona dolara samo 2010. Ostali poznati klijenti agencije su bivši potpredsjednik Al Gore, koji zarađuje 175.000 dolara po nastupu; Rudy Giuliani, koji uzima 100.000 dolara po događaju; zatim bivši potpredsjednik Dick Cheney, bivše senatore Olympia Snowe i Joe Lieberman, strateg kampanje Obame Jim Messina i bivši generalni sekretar UN-a Kofi Annan. Tačan iznos koji traži Hillary Clinton nije poznat, ali izvještaji navode da će neke govore održati besplatno za uzroke koje podržava te povremeno donirati honorare u humanitarne svrhe. Agencija zastupa i poznate ličnosti izvan politike, poput Charlieja Sheena (navodno zarađuje 200.000 dolara po nastupu), Kim Kardashian, Nicole 'Snooki' Polizzi, Sarah Palin, Bristola Palina i drugih. Clinton je izjavila i da planira pisati još jednu knjigu o svom mandatu državne sekretarke. Izdavačka kuća Simon & Schuster navodno joj je za prethodne memoare 'Living History', objavljene 2000. godine, isplatila avans od osam miliona dolara. Svi poslovi koje Clinton preuzme bit će pod lupom s obzirom da je potencijalna predsjednička kandidatkinja. Balansiranje javnog imidža i ličnih finansija ostaje važno, pogotovo zbog njenog životnog stila i sposobnosti da sada zarađuje značajne honorare. Iako su postojale glasine da supružnici Clinton planiraju kupovinu kuće na Hamptonsu, očekuje se da će i dalje dijeliti vrijeme između svojih trenutnih rezidencija u Washingtonu i Chappaqui, New York. Hillary Clinton bi mogla raditi i sa Clinton Foundation ili osnovati vlastitu fondaciju, ali još nema čvrstih odluka. Za sada je javno potvrdila samo da planira odmor nakon naporne četiri godine tokom kojih je posjetila 112 zemalja. U međuvremenu, dok Clinton ostaje tajanstvena o političkoj budućnosti, potencijalni rivali već aktivno prikupljaju sredstva. Guverner New Jerseyja Chris Christie i senator Floride Marco Rubio sakupili su značajna sredstva, pri čemu je Christie prisustvovao donatorskoj večeri u domu osnivača Facebooka Marka Zuckerberga u Kaliforniji, dok je Rubio prikupio 100.000 dolara prodajom boca vode nakon njegovog odgovora na govor o Stanju Unije.

article_content: Britain’s economy is starting to recover as Mark Carney steps into his position as the new Governor of the Bank of England. According to the latest Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI), the construction sector expanded in June at its fastest rate in over a year, rising slightly to 51 from 50.8 in May. This contributes to growing optimism that the UK is moving beyond the downturn caused by the financial crisis more than five years ago. Manufacturing has also gained momentum, with its PMI reaching 52.5—the best performance in over two years. These upswings happen as Carney begins leading the historic central bank, becoming its first non-British governor. With a background as the former head of the Bank of Canada, Carney is expected to pursue bold, proactive strategies to boost economic growth during his five-year term. Chancellor George Osborne recruited Carney hoping he would champion more assertive monetary policy and help drive a lasting recovery before the 2015 election. Analysts such as Chris Beauchamp from IG believe that Carney’s arrival coincides well with these early signs of economic improvement. While the Bank's Monetary Policy Committee has kept interest rates at a historic low of 0.5% and injected £375 billion through quantitative easing, most experts think significant policy changes are unlikely at Carney’s first meeting, given the recent positive data. Research group Capital Economics has revised its UK growth forecast for 2013 upward to 0.8%, a notable increase from its previous estimate of 0.2%. However, some challenges persist. Data show lending to businesses fell by £1.3 billion in May, underlining the struggles UK firms face when accessing credit—a point emphasized by campaigns like 'Make the Banks Lend.' Some economists remain careful in their outlook. Philip Shaw from Investec warned that previous signs of recovery have sometimes failed to deliver lasting results, while many households continue to grapple with declining real wages. Rob Wood of Berenberg Bank suggested that stronger recent data may actually encourage the Bank to keep interest rate expectations low as a way to sustain recovery. Skepticism also remains about whether Carney can singlehandedly deliver a turnaround. Shadow Chancellor Ed Balls cautioned against putting too much faith in one individual, saying, 'to quote Monty Python, he’s not the Messiah and he can’t work miracles.' Nonetheless, private sector sentiment is improving. David Noble, head of the Chartered Institute of Purchasing and Supply, described the construction sector as entering a 'new dawn,' attributing gains in housebuilding to government initiatives like Funding for Lending and Help to Buy. Official economic figures set to be released later this month are projected to show stronger second-quarter growth, topping the 0.3% increase during the first quarter.
translated_content: Britanska ekonomija počinje pokazivati znakove oporavka dok Mark Carney preuzima svoju novu poziciju guvernera Banke Engleske. Prema najnovijem indeksu menadžera nabavki (PMI), građevinski sektor je u junu zabilježio najbrži rast u više od godinu dana, popevši se na 51 sa 50,8 u maju. Ovaj pomak doprinosi rastućem optimizmu da se Ujedinjeno Kraljevstvo polako izvlači iz krize koja je započela prije više od pet godina. Proizvodnja također bilježi napredak, pri čemu je PMI za tu oblast dostigao 52,5 – najbolji rezultat u više od dvije godine. Ovi pozitivni pokazatelji dolaze u vrijeme kada Carney preuzima vođenje ove historijske centralne banke i postaje njen prvi strani guverner. Carney, bivši šef Banke Kanade, očekuje se da će koristiti smjele i proaktivne strategije kako bi potaknuo ekonomski rast tokom svog petogodišnjeg mandata. Ministar finansija George Osborne je doveo Carneyja nadajući se da će on podržati aktivniju monetarnu politiku i pomoći u jačanju oporavka prije izbora 2015. Analitičari, poput Chrisa Beauchampa iz IG-a, ističu da se Carneyjev dolazak poklopio s prvim znakovima ekonomskog poboljšanja. Iako je Monetarni odbor Banke već zadržao kamatne stope na rekordno niskih 0,5% i plasirao 375 milijardi funti kroz kvantitativno olakšavanje, stručnjaci očekuju da na Carneyjevom prvom sastanku neće biti velikih promjena s obzirom na nedavne dobre podatke. Grupa Capital Economics povećala je prognozu rasta UK-a za 2013. na 0,8%, što je značajan skok spram prethodne procjene od 0,2%. Ipak, izazovi i dalje postoje. Podaci pokazuju da je kreditiranje preduzeća u maju smanjeno za 1,3 milijarde funti, što naglašava probleme s kojima se kompanije suočavaju pri podizanju kredita – na što ukazuju i kampanje poput 'Neka banke posuđuju'. Neki ekonomisti ostaju oprezni. Philip Shaw iz Investeca upozorava da su prethodni znaci oporavka često bili kratkotrajni, dok mnoga domaćinstva i dalje bilježe pad realnih plata. Rob Wood iz Berenberg Bank smatra da jači podaci mogu zapravo potaknuti Banku Engleske da dodatno održi niska očekivanja o kamatama kako bi oporavak bio održiv. Skepticizam i dalje postoji oko toga može li Carney sam napraviti preokret. Sjenka ministra finansija Ed Balls upozorio je da se ne polažu prevelike nade u jednog čovjeka, rekavši: 'da citiram Monty Pythona, on nije Mesija i ne može činiti čuda.' Ipak, privatni sektor pokazuje poboljšanje raspoloženja. David Noble, šef Instituta ovlaštenih menadžera nabavke i snabdijevanja, opisao je građevinski sektor kao da ulazi u 'novu zoru', pripisujući rast stambene izgradnje vladinim inicijativama poput Funding for Lending i Help to Buy. Službeni ekonomski podaci koji će uskoro biti objavljeni vjerovatno će pokazati još snažniji rast u drugom kvartalu, nadmašujući rast od 0,3% iz prvog tromjesečja.

article_content: Sir Bradley Wiggins will skip the Vuelta a Espana to compete in the Tour of Britain, according to Team Sky principal Sir Dave Brailsford. Wiggins, winner of the 2012 Tour de France, had previously suggested he might ride the final Grand Tour of the season as preparation for the Road World Championships in Spain later in September. However, Brailsford told BBC Sport that Wiggins will instead focus on the Tour of Britain. Wiggins was omitted from Sky's Tour de France team due to his strained relationship with team-mate Chris Froome. The Tour of Britain is scheduled for September 7-14, coinciding with the final week of the Vuelta which starts on August 23. Froome, who was forced to withdraw from this year’s Tour de France due to injury, is now targeting the Vuelta, while Wiggins will race at home. Wiggins recently won a silver medal in the team pursuit at the Glasgow Commonwealth Games. The four-time Olympic gold medallist had hinted he might leave road cycling after being left out of Sky’s Tour de France squad, but Brailsford appears to have persuaded him to continue. Alongside team-mates Nathan Earle and Ian Boswell, Wiggins recently took part in the RideLondon Surrey Classic at Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park.

article_content: Erin DiMeglio, 17, a senior at South Plantation High School near Fort Lauderdale, broke new ground by becoming the first female quarterback to play in a boys’ varsity football game in Florida. During the closing minutes of a recent game, she joined the lineup, met with enthusiastic cheers and the pride of her family. After months of team practice, Erin finally fulfilled her dream of playing football, tackling stereotypes and concerns that the sport was too physically demanding for girls. She finished the match by executing a meaningful hand-off. In a preseason game a week earlier, she completed two passes but had the game cut short due to lightning. Erin's background as a basketball player led to an invitation to play flag football, but Coach Douglas Gatewood saw her potential and brought her onto the varsity squad. He insists Erin must earn her spot without special treatment, though she changes in the girls' locker room for privacy. While Florida has a history of female high school football players, very few have played quarterback—just 523 since 1973, and most in other positions. Erin’s feat stands out in a state famous for football and producing NFL stars. Teammates like Kevin Avila acknowledge feeling protective of Erin, while her mom, Kathleen, finds herself proud but naturally anxious about injuries. Erin has already endured sports injuries but is undeterred, finding joy in proving herself among the boys. Erin balances athletics with academics, highlighting the importance of education and physical health in her athlete profile. Despite the spotlight, Erin stays humble and determined, aiming to succeed through her performance. Both teammates and coaches recognize her drive, resilience, and commitment.

article_content: MP Alun Cairns has accused Channel 4 of commissioning a 'biased' documentary about the Leveson Inquiry into Press standards, which will be presented by actor Hugh Grant. Cairns wrote to Channel 4’s chief executive, David Abraham, questioning whether a program led by Grant—an advocate for press reform and the face of the Hacked Off campaign—could comply with Ofcom's impartiality regulations. Hugh Grant, closely associated with the Hacked Off group calling for press reform, will front the documentary. The production company, Films of Record, was founded by Roger Graef, who until recently was chair of the Media Standards Trust (MST), the body behind Hacked Off. Graef stepped down from his MST role the previous day to focus on broadcasting work. In his letter, which was also sent to Ofcom chief Ed Richards, Conservative MP Cairns expressed deep concern about the programme. He highlighted connections among Grant, the production company, and the MST, noting that the organization has published recommendations for statutory press regulation—supported by both Hacked Off and Grant. Cairns argued that Grant, as both spokesperson and presenter, would naturally endorse the MST's proposals in the documentary, casting doubt on its impartiality. He referred to an email from the producer stating the film would follow Grant as he investigates opposition to his campaign for more accountable press practices. Cairns also speculated that Graef’s resignation from the Trust aimed to avoid or conceal possible conflicts of interest connected to the program’s creation. He cited Ofcom's Broadcasting Code, which cautions broadcasters against giving undue prominence to particular persons or bodies on political or controversial public policy issues. The MP maintained that the issues raised by the Leveson Inquiry are too important to be dependent on celebrity involvement and stressed the need for objective examination. Channel 4 responded with assurances that the documentary would comply with Ofcom’s impartiality requirements. The Media Standards Trust has announced that Helena Kennedy QC will temporarily chair the organization while Graef focuses on his broadcasting work. The Trust emphasized that Graef is not involved in the documentary, seeking to prevent any suggestion of conflicting interests.

Cairns je pisao izvršnom direktoru Channel 4, Davidu Abrahamu, pitajući može li program s Grantom—zagovornikom reforme medija i zaštitnim licem kampanje Hacked Off—uopće ispuniti Ofcomove zahtjeve za nepristrasnošću. Hugh Grant, usko povezan sa grupom Hacked Off koja zagovara reformu medija, bit će voditelj dokumentarca. Produkcijsku kuću Films of Record osnovao je Roger Graef, koji je do nedavno bio predsjednik Media Standards Trust (MST), organizacije koja stoji iza Hacked Off-a. Graef je prethodnog dana odstupio s čela MST-a radi obaveza u emitovanju. U svom pismu, koje je također poslano šefu Ofcoma Edu Richardsu, konzervativni poslanik Cairns izrazio je duboku zabrinutost zbog programa. Izdvojio je veze između Granta, produkcijske kuće i MST-a, navodeći da je organizacija objavila preporuke za zakonsku regulaciju medija—što podržavaju i Hacked Off i Grant. Cairns tvrdi da bi Grant, kao glasnogovornik i voditelj, prirodno podržao prijedloge MST-a u dokumentarcu te zbog toga njegova nepristrasnost dolazi u pitanje. Pozvao se na email producenta u kojem se navodi da će film pratiti Granta dok istražuje protivnike njegove kampanje za odgovornije medije. Cairns je također nagađao da je Graefova ostavka na čelo Trusta pokušaj izbjegavanja ili prikrivanja mogućih sukoba interesa vezanih za nastanak programa. Citirao je Ofcomov kodeks emitovanja, koji upozorava da emiteri ne smiju previše isticati stavove određenih osoba ili tijela kada su u pitanju politička ili sporna javna pitanja. Poslanik je naglasio da su pitanja koja postavlja Levesonova istraga prevažna da bi ovisila o angažmanu slavnih i istakao potrebu za objektivnošću. Channel 4 je odgovorio uvjeravajući da će dokumentarac ispuniti sve zahtjeve Ofcoma u pogledu nepristrasnosti. Media Standards Trust je najavio da će Helena Kennedy QC privremeno predsjedavati organizacijom dok se Graef fokusira na svoj rad u emitovanju. Trust je naglasio da Graef nije uključen u izradu dokumentarca kako bi se uklonile bilo kakve sumnje na sukob interesa.

article_content: German police have advised travelers to avoid Hamburg Airport as a hostage situation continues to unfold. The airport, located in the northern part of Hamburg, has been closed to passengers and all flights have been canceled since Saturday night, after an armed man broke through an airport gate with his vehicle and fired two shots into the air, according to the German news agency dpa. Authorities stated that the man's wife had previously contacted them about a possible child abduction. Police reported that the 35-year-old man had his 4-year-old daughter inside the car, whom he had allegedly taken by force from the mother in a potential custody dispute. A psychologist has been negotiating with the man for several hours. Police have also indicated that there is no risk to other people, as all passengers have evacuated the airport.

article_content: The ET Soonicorns Summit 2023 launches today in Delhi-NCR, uniting top startup leaders, entrepreneurs, investors, and stakeholders to guide India's next wave of high-potential companies. In a period marked by industry transformation, the summit revolves around the central theme: 'Resilience. Reset. Results.' Its mission is to nurture the growth of upcoming unicorns within the country. This event provides a collaborative platform for founders and industry experts to exchange insights, practical strategies, and experiences, strengthening innovation and resilience in the tech startup sector. Startups from throughout India will gain from knowledge-rich sessions, sector tracks, networking, and demonstrations. A highlight of the day is the launch of the 'ET 30 Future Unicorns of Delhi-NCR' report, spotlighting rapidly growing firms nearing unicorn valuation. Opening remarks by Satyan Gajwani (Times Internet) set the tone, followed by keynote addresses from Jeet Vijay (MEITY Startup Hub) on startups' global economic roles and Geetika Dayal (TiE Delhi-NCR) on India's deeptech potential. Panel discussions address topics such as startup growth and strategic investments (with Kunal Bahl and Rohit Bansal), financial success and IPO roadmaps (MobiKwik's Upasana Taku and Bipin Preet Singh), IPO readiness, use of Google Maps for scaling, and seizing India's $2.1 trillion fintech landscape. Other sessions include insights into TradeIndia.com’s digital shift, fireside chats with Priyanka Gill (Good Glamm Group) on combining content and commerce, Prashant Tandon (1MG) on scaling with investors, and Rishi Raj Singh (MakeMyTrip) on empowering small businesses. Presentations also focus on digital transformation approaches, growth strategies during turbulent times (with Abhiraj Singh Bhal of Urban Company), financial leadership for adaptability, and the use of data in shaping business outcomes. The Soonicorn Spotlight track introduces standout startups such as Addverb, Omnipresent Robot Tech, Magenta Mobility, BluSmart, and others, highlighting their innovations across fields like logistics, AI, smart electricity, and electric vehicles. With over 30 speakers, 10 focused tracks, and more than 20 educational sessions, the summit promises robust opportunities for learning, networking, and inspiring India’s dynamic startup sector. Additional briefs touch on telecom industry concerns about WhatsApp messaging, a probe involving Apple regarding iPhone hacking, and news on Go First airline’s bankruptcy developments.

article_content: NASA astronauts will be flying in style, as luxury fashion designer Prada is helping to design spacesuits for the 2025 Moon mission. The Italian fashion house will work alongside the private company Axiom Space on the project. In a press release, Axiom stated that Prada will contribute its expertise in materials and manufacturing to the development of the new suits. One astronaut told the BBC he believes Prada is up to the challenge, thanks to their history of design innovation. Prada's experience extends beyond fashion runways in Milan; the company has also been involved in technical projects, such as the America's Cup sailing competition. Professor Jeffrey Hoffman, a former NASA astronaut with five missions and four spacewalks, noted that Prada's knowledge of composite fabrics could contribute to the outer layers of the new spacesuit. However, he cautioned that astronauts should not expect 'paisley spacesuits or any fancy patterns.' "Maintaining a good thermal environment is really the critical thing," he said. "A spacesuit is really like a miniature spacecraft. It has to provide pressure, oxygen, and keep you at a reasonable temperature." Earlier this year, Axiom unveiled a spacesuit intended for the upcoming Artemis 3 mission. The suit weighs 55kg and is said to provide a better fit for female astronauts. In a joint press release, Axiom and Prada announced they would use 'innovative technologies and design' to enable 'greater exploration of the lunar surface than ever before.' The Artemis 3 mission—featuring Prada’s design contributions—will follow Artemis 2, which is scheduled to fly a capsule around the Moon in late 2024 or early 2025. Artemis 2 will be historic, as it includes Christina Koch and Victor Glover—the first woman and the first black astronaut assigned to a lunar mission.

U saopštenju za medije, Axiom je naveo da će Prada doprinijeti projektu svojim znanjem o materijalima i proizvodnji novih odijela. Jedan astronaut je za BBC izjavio da vjeruje da je Prada dorasla izazovu zahvaljujući svojoj istoriji inovacija u dizajnu. Pradino iskustvo nadilazi modne piste Milana; kompanija je također bila uključena u tehničke projekte poput takmičenja u jedrenju America's Cup. Profesor Jeffrey Hoffman, bivši NASA astronaut sa pet misija i četiri svemirske šetnje, istaknuo je da Pradino znanje o kompozitnim tkaninama može doprinijeti vanjskim slojevima novih svemirskih odijela. Ipak, napomenuo je da astronauti ne trebaju očekivati 'paizli odijela ili bilo kakve otmjene uzorke.' "Održavanje dobre toplotne okoline je zaista ključna stvar," rekao je. "Svemirsko odijelo je zapravo kao minijaturna letjelica. Mora da obezbijedi pritisak, kiseonik i da vas drži na odgovarajućoj temperaturi." Ranije ove godine, Axiom je predstavio svemirsko odijelo namijenjeno za predstojeću misiju Artemis 3. Odijelo teži 55 kg i navodno se bolje prilagođava astronautkinjama. U zajedničkom saopštenju za medije, Axiom i Prada su najavili da će koristiti 'inovativne tehnologije i dizajn' kako bi omogućili 'veće istraživanje Mjesečeve površine nego ikada prije.' Artemis 2 će biti istorijska, jer uključuje Christinu Koch i Victora Glovera—prvu ženu i prvog crnog astronauta koji su dodijeljeni misiji na Mjesec.

article_content: After months of discussion with Western nations over NATO expansion amid the ongoing war in Ukraine, Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan has submitted a bill regarding Sweden’s NATO membership to parliament. Previously, Erdogan told his NATO allies at the alliance’s July summit that he would forward the legislation when parliament reconvened on October 1, following earlier objections primarily over security issues. Since parliament’s reopening, Turkish officials have insisted that Sweden take further concrete measures against the outlawed Kurdistan Workers’ Party (PKK), which is designated as a terrorist organization by Turkey, the European Union, and the United States. On Monday, the Turkish presidency announced on social media platform X that 'The Protocol on Sweden’s NATO Accession was signed by President Recep Tayyip Erdogan on October 23, 2023 and referred to the Grand National Assembly of Turkey.' Swedish Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson welcomed the move, posting on X: 'Now it remains for the parliament to deal with the question. We look forward to being a NATO member.' NATO Secretary-General Jens Stoltenberg likewise expressed hope for a swift parliamentary vote, though there is no fixed timeline for ratification. The bill will be reviewed by parliament’s foreign affairs commission before being sent to the general assembly for final ratification. Following Russia’s invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, Sweden and Finland abandoned their long-standing non-aligned status and applied to join NATO in May 2022. For any country to join the alliance, all 31 current NATO members must approve the accession. Finland’s application was unanimously ratified, and it became a NATO member in April 2023. Sweden’s application has been ratified by all members except Hungary and Turkey. Erdogan had previously accused Sweden of being too lenient towards the PKK and other groups considered threats by Turkey. Turkish authorities were also angered by a series of Quran-burning protests in Sweden. The Turkish foreign ministry called these incidents 'despicable attacks' and urged for strong measures to prevent such acts. In July, Sweden’s Supreme Court rejected a Turkish request to extradite two men accused of being members of the movement led by US-based cleric Fethullah Gulen, whom Turkey holds responsible for the failed 2016 coup attempt. Turkey relented on its opposition after the Biden administration indicated support for the sale of 40 new F-16 fighter jets and modernization kits to Turkey. Sweden also pledged to support Turkey’s efforts to revive its EU membership bid. Additionally, NATO agreed to address Turkey’s concerns regarding terrorism, with Secretary-General Stoltenberg assigning an assistant secretary-general as a special coordinator for this purpose.

Erdogan je ranije na samitu NATO-a u julu rekao saveznicima da će proslijediti zakon kada se parlament ponovo sastane 1. oktobra, nakon što je ranije iznio prigovore uglavnom zbog sigurnosnih pitanja. Od ponovnog okupljanja parlamenta, turski zvaničnici su insistirali da Švedska poduzme dodatne konkretne mjere protiv zabranjene Radničke partije Kurdistana (PKK), koja je proglašena terorističkom organizacijom od strane Turske, Evropske unije i Sjedinjenih Država. U ponedjeljak je tursko predsjedništvo objavilo na društvenoj mreži X: 'Protokol o pristupanju Švedske NATO-u potpisao je predsjednik Recep Tayyip Erdogan 23. oktobra 2023. i proslijedio ga Velikoj narodnoj skupštini Turske.' Švedski premijer Ulf Kristersson pozdravio je ovaj potez, napisavši na mreži X: 'Sada preostaje parlamentu da riješi pitanje. Radujemo se što ćemo biti članica NATO-a.' Generalni sekretar NATO-a Jens Stoltenberg također je izrazio nadu za brzo glasanje u turskom parlamentu, iako ne postoji tačno određen rok za ratifikaciju. Zakon će pregledati odbor za vanjske poslove parlamenta prije nego što bude poslan u generalnu skupštinu na konačnu ratifikaciju. Nakon ruske invazije na Ukrajinu u februaru 2022., Švedska i Finska su napustile svoj dugogodišnji status nesvrstanosti i podnijele zahtjev za članstvo u NATO-u u maju 2022. Svih 31 trenutni član NATO-a mora odobriti pristupanje nove zemlje. Finska aplikacija je jednoglasno ratifikovana, a Finska je postala članica NATO-a u aprilu 2023. Zahtjev Švedske ratifikovan je od strane svih članica osim Mađarske i Turske. Erdogan je ranije optužio Švedsku da je previše popustljiva prema PKK-u i drugim grupama koje Turska smatra prijetnjom. Turske vlasti su također bile nezadovoljne nizom protesta spaljivanja Kur’ana u Švedskoj. Tursko ministarstvo vanjskih poslova ove događaje nazvalo je 'gnusnim napadima' i pozvalo na odlučne mjere za sprječavanje takvih djela. U julu je Vrhovni sud Švedske odbio turski zahtjev za izručenje dvojice muškaraca optuženih da su članovi pokreta predvođenog imamom Fethullahom Gulenom, kojeg Turska smatra odgovornim za neuspjeli pokušaj državnog udara 2016. godine. Turska je povukla protivljenje nakon što je Bidenova administracija najavila podršku prodaji 40 novih borbenih aviona F-16 i opreme za modernizaciju Turskoj. Švedska se također obavezala da će podržati napore Turske za obnovu svog pokušaja pristupanja Evropskoj uniji. Osim toga, NATO se složio da razmotri turske zabrinutosti vezane za terorizam, a generalni sekretar Stoltenberg imenovao je pomoćnika generalnog sekretara za posebnog koordinatora u tom procesu.

article_content: Powered by the same amount of energy as a toaster, 39 solar-powered cars are preparing to race across the Australian outback this weekend, reaching speeds of over 100 kilometers per hour (62 mph). Starting from Darwin on Saturday, participants in the biennial, 3,021-kilometer (1,877-mile) Veolia World Solar Challenge will journey to Adelaide. Many of these vehicles resemble ping-pong tables on wheels rather than conventional cars. Despite their unusual appearance, the event is fueled by a spirit of adventure and a pursuit of greater energy efficiency, with teams composed of volunteers, university students, and organizers. “We think of it as the land-based equivalent of ocean yacht racing,” says Chris Selwood, the event director. “It’s really about how much you can do with how little. We’re aiming for the ultimate efficiency in electric cars.” Now in its 11th edition, Selwood highlights that although most cars look unconventional, some of the event’s innovations have influenced mainstream vehicles. For example, Michelin’s energy-efficient, low-rolling resistance tires, first used in the early 1990s in this race, are now commercially available. Since the event's inception in 1987, electric motors have improved in efficiency by at least 30%, according to Selwood. Some teams now use motors capable of 98% efficiency in converting electricity to motion. “Such motors could power appliances like washing machines, ceiling fans, or electric vehicles,” Selwood explains. “They have many practical applications in daily life.” For top teams, the immediate goal is victory at Adelaide, with broader technological legacies put aside for now. The Nuna6 car, from the Nuon Solar Team of Delft University of Technology in the Netherlands, is a favorite to win. Past champions (2001-2007), Nuon hopes to reclaim their title from Japan’s Tokai University, which won in 2009. To boost their chances, Nuna6 is constructed from carbon fiber also used in Formula 1 cars, making it 10% lighter than its 2009 predecessor. Like Formula 1, strategy is key: each team must extract enough power from a 5 kilowatt-hour battery (just 10% of the total estimated energy needed), while deciding when to recharge each day. “The biggest challenge is driving non-stop, but we have a good chance,” says Nuon Solar Team’s Nadine Rodewijk. Other teams, like Bochum University’s SolarWorldGT from Germany, focus on making solar cars more appealing to the public, giving their car two doors and two seats in a more recognizable design. Advances in solar cells, motors, and a new rule reducing allowable solar panel capacity by 25% since 2009, make it possible for them to compete effectively. “Teams must use their energy wisely to tackle hills and cloudy conditions,” Selwood notes. “By imposing limits on key factors, we’re seeing some clever solutions emerge.” But, ultimately, it’s still a race. “Our team’s aim is to win,” confirms Rodewijk. “But for each of us, it’s about the experience, adventure, learning, and preparing for the future.”
translated_content: Pokretani istom količinom energije kao toster, 39 solarno pogonjenih automobila priprema se za trku kroz australsku divljinu ovog vikenda, dosežući brzine veće od 100 kilometara na sat (62 mph). Start iz Darwina u subotu označava početak dvogodišnje, 3.021-kilometarske (1.877 milja) utrke Veolia World Solar Challenge do Adelaidea. Mnogi od ovih vozila više liče na stolove za stoni tenis na točkovima nego na klasične automobile. Uprkos neobičnom izgledu, događaj pokreće duh avanture i potraga za većom energetskom efikasnošću, a timovi su uglavnom sastavljeni od volontera, studenata i organizatora. 'Mi to doživljavamo kao kopnenu verziju trka jahti na oceanu', kaže Chris Selwood, direktor događaja. 'Radi se o tome koliko možete postići s koliko malo. Cilj nam je krajnja efikasnost električnih automobila.' Ovo je 11. izdanje utrke, a Selwood ističe da su, iako većina automobila izgleda nekonvencionalno, neke inovacije s ovog događaja uticale na vozila u svakodnevnoj upotrebi. Na primjer, Michelinove energetski efikasne gume s malim otporom kotrljanja, koje su prvi put korištene početkom 1990-ih na ovoj utrci, sada su dostupne za prodaju. Od početka događaja 1987. godine, efikasnost električnih motora poboljšana je najmanje za 30%, kaže Selwood. Neki timovi sada koriste motore koji dosežu 98% efikasnosti u pretvaranju električne energije u pokret. 'Takvi motori mogu pokretati uređaje poput veš mašina, plafonjera ili električnih vozila', objašnjava Selwood. 'Imaju mnogo praktičnih primjena u svakodnevnom životu.' Za vodeće timove, trenutni cilj je pobjeda u Adelaideu, dok se o tehnološkoj ostavštini razmišlja kasnije. Automobil Nuna6 holandskog Nuon Solar Team-a sa Delftskog univerziteta za tehnologiju važi za favorita. Bivši šampioni (2001-2007), Nuon se nada da će vratiti titulu koju je 2009. osvojio tim japanskog Tokai univerziteta. Kako bi povećali šanse, Nuna6 je napravljen od karbonskih vlakana koja se koriste i u Formuli 1, čime je 10% lakši od prethodnika iz 2009. Kao i u Formuli 1, strategija je ključ: svaki tim mora izvući dovoljno energije iz baterije od 5 kilovat-sati (samo 10% procijenjene ukupne potrebne energije), dok istovremeno odlučuje kada će dopuniti energiju za naredni dan. 'Najveći izazov je voziti bez stajanja, ali imamo dobre šanse', kaže Nadine Rodewijk iz tima Nuon. Drugi timovi, poput SolarWorldGT-a Bochum Univerziteta iz Njemačke, fokusiraju se na to da solarni automobili budu privlačniji javnosti, dizajnirajući svoje vozilo s dvoja vrata i dva sjedala u prepoznatljivijem obliku. Napredak u solarnim ćelijama, motorima i novo pravilo koje je od 2009. godine smanjilo dozvoljeni kapacitet solarnih panela za 25% omogućavaju im ravnopravnu konkurenciju. 'Timovi moraju mudro koristiti energiju kako bi savladali uzbrdice i oblačne uslove', primjećuje Selwood. 'Ograničavanjem nekih ključnih faktora, svjedočimo nekim veoma pametnim rješenjima.' No, na kraju, ovo je ipak trka. 'Cilj našeg tima je pobjeda', potvrđuje Rodewijk. 'Ipak, za svakog od nas radi se o iskustvu, avanturi, učenju i pripremama za budućnost.'

article_content: Thai officials were widely mocked after launching a social media campaign asking teens to abstain from sex on Valentine’s Day. The effort, led by the Culture Ministry’s Moral Promotion Center, included a Twitter hashtag in Thai urging young people to head home after dinner, in line with their 'Just a Meal for Valentine’s Day' campaign. This year, officials upped their efforts after a government survey found that 83% of teenagers planned to have sex on the holiday. The campaign drew ridicule across social media, with young people responding with jokes rather than support. The push is part of a larger morality drive by Thailand’s military government, which has increased its focus on youth behavior since coming to power after last May’s coup. Officials called on parents, teachers, and schools to caution students about the risks tied to Valentine’s Day and to discourage inappropriate activities. Police instructed nightclubs not to admit underage patrons and heightened security in entertainment areas throughout the Valentine’s period. One all-girls’ school in Bangkok took the added step of hosting a self-defense lesson for students, where policewomen demonstrated protective moves. Each year, authorities use Valentine’s Day to issue warnings about maintaining traditional values and avoiding sex outside marriage. Narathip Pumsap, director of the Moral Promotion Center, recommended that parents and teachers guide children to appreciate the spirit of Valentine’s by expressing love for their families and communities instead. Despite Thailand’s international image as a destination for sex tourism, its socially conservative government often emphasizes Buddhist values and enforces strict media censorship, such as blurring sex scenes and depictions of alcohol or smoking on screen.

article_content: President Barack Obama has named Brooklyn federal prosecutor Loretta Lynch, 55, as his nominee for the position of U.S. attorney general. If confirmed by the Senate, Lynch would make history as the first Black woman to head the Justice Department. Obama commended Lynch’s dedication to criminal justice reform and noted her family's long history in America, mentioning her ancestors' experience with slavery. Lynch is currently the U.S. attorney for the Eastern District of New York, which encompasses Brooklyn, Long Island, Queens, and Staten Island. Known for her fairness and strength as a prosecutor, she comes recommended by the outgoing attorney general, Eric Holder, who has held the role since 2009. During a formal announcement in the White House’s Roosevelt Room, Obama hailed Lynch as exceptionally qualified and deeply committed to equal justice. He joked that Lynch might be the only lawyer able to take on mobsters and terrorists while still being known for her personable demeanor. In her remarks, Lynch thanked President Obama for his trust, promising that, if confirmed, she will always prioritize the safety and rights of the American people. This nomination follows recent Republican victories in the Congressional elections and Eric Holder's decision earlier this year to step down. Though the administration initially planned to announce Lynch’s nomination after Obama’s upcoming Asia trip, the process was expedited after her selection leaked to the press. The President is soon visiting China, Myanmar, and Australia. Some uncertainty remains regarding Republican reaction to the nomination, given past disagreements with Holder.

Ako je Senat potvrdi, Lynch će ispisati historiju kao prva crna žena na čelu Ministarstva pravde. Obama je pohvalio njezinu posvećenost reformi pravosuđa te istakao dugu porodičnu historiju u Americi, napominjući da su njeni preci bili robovi. Lynch trenutno obavlja funkciju saveznog tužioca za Istočni distrikt New Yorka, koji obuhvata Brooklyn, Long Island, Queens i Staten Island. Poznata je po svojoj pravednosti i odlučnosti, a preporučio ju je sadašnji državni tužilac Eric Holder, koji je na toj poziciji od 2009. godine. U službenoj objavi u Rooseveltovoj sali Bijele kuće, Obama je istakao da je Lynch iznimno kvalificirana i vrlo posvećena pravičnosti. Šaljivo je primijetio da je ona možda jedina odvjetnica koja se suočava s mafijašima i teroristima, a opet je cijenjena zbog svoje ljudskosti. Lynch se zahvalila predsjedniku na povjerenju i poručila kako će, ukoliko bude potvrđena, sigurnost i prava američkih građana uvijek stavljati na prvo mjesto. Ova nominacija dolazi poslije nedavnog uspjeha republikanaca na kongresnim izborima i Holderove najave povlačenja. Administracija je prvobitno planirala objaviti nominaciju nakon Obaminog puta u Aziju, ali je proces ubrzan nakon što su informacije procurile u medije. Predsjednik uskoro putuje u Kinu, Mjanmar i Australiju. Još uvijek nije sigurno kako će republikanci reagovati na ovu nominaciju zbog prijašnjih nesuglasica s Holderom.

article_content: NEW DELHI: Nick Jones, Australia's respected physiotherapist, played a key role in one of the most memorable performances in cricket World Cup history. Glenn Maxwell's extraordinary innings against Afghanistan in the recent World Cup match is likely to be remembered for years. Maxwell was struggling with multiple muscle cramps and nearly considered retiring during the critical match. Even his captain, Pat Cummins, recognized the seriousness of the situation. However, Jones encouraged Maxwell not to give in to the physical challenges. Jones realized that Maxwell's best chance was to stay standing, reduce running, and focus on his shots, so he advised him to continue. This approach proved crucial for both Maxwell and the Australian team. Maxwell's unbeaten 201* is now recognized as one of the most remarkable innings under pressure, helping Australia qualify for the semifinal. Jones, who has worked with the Australian team for two years and previously treated Maxwell for severe cramps, believed that keeping Maxwell on the field would prevent his condition from worsening. This decision was instrumental in Australia's stunning victory. "From there it was obvious we were fighting a losing battle," Jones told cricket.com.au. "We see this with many players – the more running, the more likely cramps will occur. I went out regularly to keep him calm, manage his heart rate, and reassure him as much as possible." Jones told Maxwell, "If you stay as upright as possible, you'll be able to keep going." At 91 for seven, with Australia still 55 runs from the target, Jones was called out again when Maxwell collapsed on the ground with cramps in his right calf, left hamstring, and other areas. "While we stretched him, Maxwell said, 'I'm done. I can't keep going. I need to retire.' Pat suggested he get treatment and return later, which can work in some situations. But in this case, removing him from play could have caused his body to shut down due to depletion, leading to full body cramps and potentially no return to the field," Jones explained. Jones then advised Maxwell to get back on his feet, stretch the key muscles, and try to stay out on the field with minimal running. He explained this to Pat Cummins, stressing the importance of keeping Maxwell playing. Maxwell took this advice and produced one of the most incredible knocks in cricket history. "How it turned out was amazing and beyond what I expected. Keeping him on the field was the right decision," Jones said. (With PTI inputs.)

Nevjerovatni nastup Glenna Maxwella protiv Afganistana na nedavnoj utakmici Svjetskog prvenstva sigurno će se pamtiti godinama. Maxwell se borio s višestrukim grčevima i gotovo je razmišljao da se povuče tokom presudnog meča. Čak je i njegov kapiten, Pat Cummins, prepoznao ozbiljnost situacije. Ipak, Jones je ohrabrio Maxwella da ne odustane zbog fizičkih poteškoća. Jones je shvatio da je Maxwellu najbolja opcija da ostane uspravan, smanji trčanje i fokusira se na udarce, pa mu je savjetovao da nastavi. Ovaj pristup bio je presudan i za Maxwella i za australski tim. Maxwellovih neporaženih 201* sada se smatra jednom od najimpresivnijih izvedbi pod pritiskom, što je Australiji donijelo plasman u polufinale. Jones, koji već dvije godine radi s australskim timom i ranije je liječio Maxwella zbog jakih grčeva, smatrao je da će zadržavanje Maxwella na terenu spriječiti pogoršanje njegovog stanja. Ova odluka bila je presudna za nevjerovatnu pobjedu Australije. "Od tog trenutka bilo je jasno da vodimo borbu koju je teško dobiti," rekao je Jones za cricket.com.au. "Vidjeli smo ovo kod mnogih igrača – što više trčanja, veće su šanse za grčeve. Redovno sam izlazio na teren da ga smirim, kontrolišem njegov puls i dam mu samopouzdanje." Jones je Maxwellu rekao: "Ako ostaneš što uspravniji, moći ćeš nastaviti igrati." Kada je Australija bila na 91 za sedam, sa još 55 poena do cilja, Jones je ponovo pozvan kada se Maxwell srušio na teren zbog grčeva u desnoj listi, lijevom butnom mišiću i drugim dijelovima tijela. "Dok smo ga istezali, Maxwell je rekao: 'Gotov sam. Ne mogu više. Moram se povući.' Pat mu je predložio da ode na tretman i kasnije se vrati, što ponekad može uspjeti. Ali u ovom slučaju, vađenje iz igre moglo je dovesti do potpunog grča cijelog tijela i on možda ne bi mogao više igrati," objasnio je Jones. Jones je zatim savjetovao Maxwella da ustane, istegne ključne mišiće i pokuša ostati na terenu uz minimalno trčanje. To je objasnio i Pat Cumminsu, naglašavajući koliko je važno da Maxwell ostane u igri. Maxwell je poslušao ovaj savjet i ostvario jednu od najnevjerovatnijih partija u historiji kriketa. "Kako se sve odvijalo bilo je nevjerovatno i dalje od onoga što sam očekivao. Drago mi je što smo ga zadržali na terenu," rekao je Jones. (Uz izvore iz PTI-a.)

article_content: A fire at the Soma hotel in Sulaimaniya, northern Iraq, killed at least 28 people and injured 22 others on Thursday night, according to the Kurdish Regional Government on Friday. Authorities blamed a short circuit for the fire, which broke out around 11 p.m. Among those killed were women, children, and foreign nationals. Kurdish Prime Minister Barham Salih, who visited the site and the hospital where victims were treated, expressed condolences and wished for the recovery of the injured. Salih called for an immediate investigation into the fire and a review of emergency procedures, stating the government would work to prevent similar tragedies. Sulaimaniya is the capital of one of Kurdistan's three provinces, about 280 kilometers north of Baghdad. The city is popular with tourists from southern Iraq during the summer because it is considered safer and has milder weather. Tourists were among the casualties. Jabbar Yawer, a local security spokesman, said that three Asian employees of a cell phone company headquartered near the hotel were among the deceased. Many employees often stayed at the hotel. Government officials stated that 14 Iraqi and 14 foreign nationals died in the fire. The foreign victims were from Canada, Australia, South Africa, the United Kingdom, Ecuador, Venezuela, Sri Lanka, Lebanon, Bangladesh, and Cambodia. One victim remained unidentified. Earlier reports had suggested that an American and a Filipino were among the dead. Health officials explained that most fatalities were due to smoke inhalation, as the hotel had no side stairs for emergency escape and the windows were difficult to break. Three young men attempted to escape by jumping from the fifth floor; two died and one was critically injured. President Massoud Barzani of the Kurdish Regional Government requested a thorough investigation and measures to prevent future incidents. Iraqi Prime Minister Nuri Al-Maliki sent his condolences and offered assistance. Salih also ordered a review of fire safety precautions in all public buildings in the region. The Kurdish Regional Government is working with embassies and consulates to notify families and arrange for repatriation.

Vlasti su kao uzrok požara navele kratki spoj, a požar je izbio oko 23 sata. Među poginulima su žene, djeca i strani državljani. Kurdistanski premijer Barham Salih, koji je posjetio mjesto nesreće i bolnicu u kojoj se liječe povrijeđeni, izrazio je saučešće i poželio brz oporavak povrijeđenima. Salih je naredio hitnu istragu požara i reviziju hitnih procedura, navodeći da će vlada raditi na sprječavanju sličnih tragedija. Sulaimanija je glavni grad jedne od tri kurdistanske provincije, oko 280 kilometara sjeverno od Bagdada. Tokom ljeta grad je popularan među turistima iz južnog Iraka zbog veće sigurnosti i povoljnije klime. Turisti su bili među nastradalima. Strane žrtve su bile iz Kanade, Australije, Južnoafričke Republike, Velike Britanije, Ekvadora, Venecuele, Šri Lanke, Libana, Bangladeša i Kambodže. Jedna žrtva još nije identificirana. Ranije je objavljeno da su među poginulima bili Amerikanac i Filipinac. Zdravstveni službenici su naveli da je većina stradalih preminula uslijed udisanja dima, jer hotel nije imao bočne stepenice za hitnu evakuaciju, a prozori su bili teško razbijivi. Irački premijer Nuri Al-Maliki uputio je saučešće i ponudio pomoć. Salih je također naredio reviziju mjera zaštite od požara u svim javnim zgradama u regiji. Regionalna vlada Kurdistana sarađuje sa ambasadama i konzulatima na obavještavanju porodica i organizaciji repatrijacije.

article_content: Ten years after rescue workers were exposed to dangerous debris at Ground Zero following the September 11 attacks, Americans witnessed the death of Osama bin Laden, the mastermind behind the attacks, killed during a U.S. operation in Pakistan. In 2001, thousands rushed to New York and Washington to help after coordinated terrorist attacks left the nation in shock and reshaped its security priorities. The news of bin Laden’s death, in contrast, prompted spontaneous celebrations across the country. Outside the White House, crowds chanted 'U.S.A.!' and sang the national anthem, while individuals like Tyler Smith, a veteran of Afghanistan, were overwhelmed with emotion. Others, such as Mason Wright, recalled their experiences on September 11 and expressed disbelief that the search for bin Laden had ended. At memorials, the mood was more reflective. Jessica McFarland noted that places like the Pentagon memorial provided perspective amid the celebrations. Younger Americans, eager to be part of this historic moment, joined the crowds in Washington, seeing bin Laden’s death as significant for their generation. Some, like Ashley Cummings, acknowledged that the conflict in Afghanistan is not over, but viewed the news as an affirmation of the mission. For others, including New Yorkers who witnessed the attacks firsthand or lost loved ones, the moment brought relief but not closure. Carie Lemack, whose mother was killed on September 11, described a sense of relief, while Jim Riches, a retired firefighter who lost his son, called it justice but noted his pain remains. In New York, as celebrations took place, reminders of the day lingered—from the rebuilding of the Freedom Tower to the Burger King once turned into a trauma center. Some, like Joshua Nash, expressed discomfort with the revelry, questioning whether many understood the true meaning of the event. September 11 remains a defining moment of American patriotism and determination, even as uncertainty persists regarding the future of the conflict in Afghanistan. While NATO continues to support Afghanistan’s security efforts, analysts remain concerned about ongoing challenges. The announcement of bin Laden’s death came just after new threats from the Taliban, underscoring the complex path ahead.

article_content: US Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin is in Brussels for a NATO defense ministers' meeting on Thursday, where the Israel-Hamas conflict is the main focus. NATO Secretary General Jens Stoltenberg said ministers would be briefed on Hamas’ recent assault on Israel, which is being labeled as a terrorist attack. Austin voiced outrage over the attack and highlighted the US commitment to Israel’s right to self-defense. President Joe Biden pledged continued support, vowing extra military assistance after Israel declared war on Hamas. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu promised to crush Hamas, declaring that each group member would be targeted. The conflict has resulted in the deaths of at least 1,200 Israelis and 1,100 Palestinians since the surprise assault. Israeli airstrikes in Gaza—which is home to 2.3 million people—are ongoing, and the United Nations reports some 120,000 Gazans have been displaced internally. Israel has enforced a complete blockade, shutting off deliveries of food, fuel, and electricity to Gaza. The area’s only power plant has stopped working due to a fuel shortage, according to the Gaza Power Authority. Israel has also called up about 360,000 reservists at the Gaza border, fueling speculation about a potential ground offensive.

article_content: Vinayak Mahtani is the CEO and co-founder of bnbme Holiday Homes. Thoughtfully developed core values serve as a compass for organizations, providing clear guidance, purpose, and consistency. These values help drive decision-making, shape company culture, and build trust and credibility. When starting my own venture, I was intentional about establishing our core values, considering them to be the foundation of my business. At bnbme, all stakeholders strongly believe in the company’s purpose and demonstrate loyalty and passion. We approach challenges with positivity and a growth mindset. Like every business, we have strengths and challenges, but our approach toward obstacles and our commitment to turning them into opportunities is crucial. This is where core values come into play. Core values are fundamental beliefs and principles, often centered on integrity, goals, and building a better world. They keep stakeholders aligned and motivated. The Role Of Leaders In Developing Core Values: A company's commitment to its core values is reflected in the actions of its leaders. CEOs, board members, and promoters must be fully aligned with the company’s mission and core values. This alignment is an ongoing process that requires regular review to ensure values remain accurate and relevant. Core values should be integrated with organizational structure, culture, strategy, operations, and evaluations. They should also be included in onboarding, training, recognition, and feedback systems. Celebrating and rewarding behaviors that align with core values helps build a strong and dedicated team. What Core Values Look Like In Practice: Hospitality is an industry where core values are particularly important. Common values include customer service, flexibility, professionalism, and safety. However, what truly differentiates a hospitality business is the approach to creating memorable customer experiences, fostering growth, and promoting work-life balance. At bnbme, we focus on unforgettable experiences through personalized guest services. Our 'make-it-happen' attitude has been key to our success, earning trust and reliability from both customers and stakeholders. Defining your core values will help your business stand out from competitors by directly linking to the positive experiences you create for both internal stakeholders and customers. Building A Strong Core Values Framework: To develop a strong core values framework, brands should take a systematic approach: 1. Identify your core values. Start by choosing values that genuinely represent your beliefs and principles, aligning them with your company’s mission and vision. Consider the challenges your company faces and how you plan to address them. 2. Communicate and educate. Regardless of business type, it’s essential to communicate your core values through your website, social media, and especially during onboarding. Customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders need to understand the importance of these values and how they contribute to your organization's overall success. 3. Integrate core values into decision-making. Ensure that company decisions—from hiring and promotion to partnerships and strategies—reflect your core values. 4. Lead by example. Leadership should embody the company’s core values, inspiring others through their actions. In conclusion, cultivating core values defines a company’s unique personality and helps build a lasting reputation. Rabies vaccinations are legally required for dogs in most U.S. states, including Texas, but some dog owners are hesitant to vaccinate their pets. Cindy Marabito, who runs a pit bull rescue in Austin, Texas, follows a “low to no vaccine” philosophy, despite the state’s requirement for rabies shots every three years. Health officials emphasize that rabies is nearly always fatal for both humans and animals, highlighting the importance of vaccination.

A recent study from Boston University School of Public Health, published in Vaccine, created the term “canine vaccine hesitancy” and found that 53% of U.S. dog owners surveyed question the rabies vaccine’s safety, efficacy, or necessity. Veterinarian Gabriella Motta, a co-author of the study, notes that unvaccinated, aggressive animals in clinics require more precautions for staff safety.

Public health experts consider the rabies vaccine the most essential for dogs, not just due to the health of pets but also the need to protect people. Lori Teller, a veterinarian at Texas A&M and former American Veterinary Medical Association president, calls the widespread skepticism “disturbing” given the vaccine’s long-standing safety record.

Marabito’s concerns about vaccines grew after a foster dog had an adverse reaction to a set of shots more than ten years ago. However, the CDC’s Ryan Wallace notes that severe reactions to the rabies vaccine are very rare—about 2.4 cases per million vaccinated dogs each year. In contrast, rabies vaccination is estimated to prevent nearly 300 dog cases and over 100 human deaths annually in the U.S.

Failure to vaccinate can have severe consequences. If an unvaccinated dog bites someone and rabies is suspected, animal control may have to euthanize the dog to test for rabies, since human health takes precedence. Decades ago, rabies was a major public health issue in the U.S., but widespread vaccinations now keep deaths low—one to three human fatalities and a few hundred pet cases each year.

Globally, rabies kills about 59,000 people annually, mainly in Asia and Africa where dog rabies is still common. The virus is usually transmitted via the bite of an infected animal, and nearly all cases are fatal after symptoms appear. Prevention relies on vaccinating pets and, for humans, receiving immediate post-exposure treatment if bitten.

According to Matthew Motta, another study co-author, skepticism toward pet vaccines often mirrors broader concerns about human vaccines, especially in the context of debates over other vaccinations like those for COVID-19. Nevertheless, 84% of dog owners still comply with rabies vaccination laws. Health agencies stress that a minimum 70% vaccination rate among dogs is essential to prevent outbreaks, and any significant drop could result in increased cases among both pets and people.
