Vakcinacija protiv bjesnila je zakonska obaveza za pse u većini američkih saveznih država, uključujući Teksas, ali neki vlasnici pasa i dalje oklijevaju. Cindy Marabito, koja vodi utočište za pitbulove u Austinu, Teksas, njeguje filozofiju „malo ili nimalo vakcina“, iako zakon zahtijeva vakcinu protiv bjesnila svake tri godine. Zdravstveni eksperti ističu da je bjesnilo gotovo uvijek smrtonosno za ljude i životinje, što čini vakcinaciju ključnom.

Novo istraživanje sa Boston University School of Public Health, objavljeno u časopisu Vaccine, uvelo je pojam „oklijevanje sa vakcinacijom kod pasa“ i pokazalo da 53% anketiranih vlasnika pasa u SAD-u dovodi u pitanje sigurnost, efikasnost ili potrebu vakcinacije protiv bjesnila. Veterinarka Gabriella Motta, koautorica studije, navodi da sa nevakcinisanim, agresivnim psima u ordinaciji osoblje mora biti dodatno oprezno radi vlastite sigurnosti.

Javni zdravstveni stručnjaci smatraju vakcinu protiv bjesnila najvažnijom za pse, kako bi zaštitili i kućne ljubimce i ljude. Lori Teller, veterinarka sa Texas A&M i bivša predsjednica Američke veterinarske medicinske asocijacije, smatra ovo rašireno nepovjerenje prema vakcini „zabrinjavajućim“ uprkos njenoj decenijama potvrđenoj sigurnosti.

Marabito je postala skeptičnija prema vakcinisanju kada je jedan od pasa na privremenoj brizi prije više od deset godina loše reagovao na kombinovanu vakcinu. Međutim, Ryan Wallace iz CDC-a naglašava da su ozbiljne nuspojave na vakcinu protiv bjesnila izuzetno rijetke—otprilike 2,4 slučaja na milion vakcinisanih pasa godišnje. Nasuprot tome, pretpostavlja se da vakcina sprečava skoro 300 slučajeva bjesnila među psima i više od 100 ljudskih života svake godine u SAD-u.

Nevakcinisanje može imati ozbiljne posljedice. Ako nevakcinisan pas ugrize nekoga i postoji sumnja na bjesnilo, nadležni mogu morati eutanazirati životinju radi testiranja, budući da je zdravlje ljudi najvažnije. Nekad je bjesnilo bilo veliki javnozdravstveni problem u SAD-u, ali zahvaljujući masovnoj vakcinaciji, sada je broj smrtnih ishoda među ljudima smanjen na najviše tri godišnje, a nekoliko stotina slučajeva evidentira se kod kućnih ljubimaca.

Na globalnom nivou, bjesnilo svake godine odnese blizu 59.000 života, najviše u Aziji i Africi, gdje je bolest još uvijek široko rasprostranjena kod pasa. Virus se najčešće širi ugrizom zaražene životinje, a skoro svi slučajevi završavaju smrću čim počnu simptomi. Prevencija znači vakcinisati kućne ljubimce i ako dođe do ugriza, kod ljudi odmah primijeniti odgovarajuću terapiju.

Matthew Motta, još jedan autor pomenutog istraživanja, kaže da skepticizam prema vakcinama za ljubimce često ide u korak s općim nepovjerenjem u ljudske vakcine, osobito poslije rasprava o covid i drugim vakcinacijama. Ipak, 84% vlasnika pasa i dalje poštuje zakon o vakcinaciji. Zdravstvene vlasti poručuju da je najmanje 70% vakcinisanih pasa neophodno da bi se spriječile epidemije, a pad ispod tog procenta mogao bi dovesti do većeg broja slučajeva bjesnila među životinjama i ljudima.

article_content: Recent data from the Department of Public Enterprises shows that capital expenditure by 54 major Central Public Sector Enterprises (CPSEs) and five key departmental agencies, including the Railway Board and the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI), increased by 33% in the first half of the current fiscal year. As of September 30, their spending reached Rs 3.79 lakh crore, compared to Rs 2.85 lakh crore in the same period last year. This already represents 52% of their total annual budgeted expenditure. Officials expect CPSEs to achieve over 90% of their annual capex target by the third quarter. "This year’s capex target is higher, and relevant ministries have instructed CPSEs to reach at least 90% of their targets by Q3," a senior official commented. Current momentum suggests CPSEs could surpass their annual goal. For the 2023-24 financial year, the central government has set the capex target for large CPSEs at Rs 7.33 lakh crore, representing a 13.4% increase over last year's revised target of Rs 6.46 lakh crore. The Railway Board received the largest allocation with Rs 2.44 lakh crore, and NHAI received about Rs 1.62 lakh crore. Within the energy sector, Indian Oil Corporation Ltd (IOCL) has a capex target of Rs 30,395 crore, while Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited (ONGC) has a target of Rs 30,125 crore. Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL) and Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) together plan to invest Rs 20,000 crore in FY24. Coal India’s annual capex target is Rs 16,600 crore. The Union Budget 2023-24 included a 33% increase in capex allocation, bringing it to Rs 10 lakh crore. From April to September 2023, government capital expenditure reached Rs 4.91 lakh crore, or 49% of the annual target, surpassing last year's Rs 3.43 lakh crore for the same period. The six-month performance is significant for calculating revised annual estimates. Separately, the government has banned 22 illegal betting and gambling apps and websites, including the Mahadev Book Online app, which has been at the center of bribery allegations involving Chhattisgarh Chief Minister Bhupesh Baghel. The Indian market has outperformed other Asia Pacific countries for some major global consumer goods companies in the last quarter, according to management reports. Data indicates that productivity among Indian companies, measured as revenue per employee, has increased consistently over the past five years, while staff costs have remained stable at around 10% of total revenues.

article_content: The Union Cabinet has approved the extension of the Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Ann Yojana (PMGKAY), the free ration scheme benefiting around 80 crore people, for another five years. This approval, which involves an allocation of Rs 24,000 crore, follows a prior announcement by Prime Minister Narendra Modi and was confirmed in a recent Cabinet meeting. Introduced during the COVID-19 pandemic, PMGKAY has been a crucial support system for those affected by economic upheaval. Additionally, the Cabinet agreed on key terms for establishing the 16th Finance Commission. Finance Secretary T V Somanathan expects the Commission to be set up by the end of November as mandated. The previous Commission, led by N K Singh, set a 42% tax devolution to states, a figure that will shape forthcoming fiscal decisions. Other major Cabinet decisions include supplying drones to 15,000 selected women’s self-help groups from 2023-24 to 2025-26 to provide rental services to farmers. Fast-track courts for rape and POCSO cases will be extended for another three years. A Rs 24,100-crore scheme was also approved to support the welfare of Vulnerable Tribal Groups, benefiting about 28 lakh tribals, with costs shared by central and state governments. According to government sources, continuing the PMGKAY will not cause significant fiscal strain during the fiscal years 2023-24 and 2024-25. Other updates: the Nifty stock index crossed the 20,000 mark, the Directorate of Enforcement raised compliance concerns with Byju’s, and HCL Group moves ahead with a chip packaging plant in Karnataka.

PMGKAY, pokrenut za vrijeme pandemije COVID-19, bio je ključna podrška za one najteže pogođene ekonomskim posljedicama. Osim toga, Vijeće je usvojilo glavne uvjete za formiranje 16. finansijske komisije. Sekretar ministarstva finansija, T V Somanathan, očekuje da će komisija biti osnovana do kraja novembra, u skladu sa zakonom. Prethodnu komisiju je vodio N K Singh, a omjer raspodjele poreza prema državama bio je 42%, što će ostati ključna referenca u budućim odlukama. Vijeće je takođe donijelo odluku o dodjeli dronova za 15.000 odabranih ženskih samopomoćnih grupa od 2023/24. do 2025/26. kako bi pružale usluge iznajmljivanja dronova poljoprivrednicima. article_content: On Tuesday, the Minister of Arts, Culture and Creative Economy, Hannatu Musawa, stated that the Federal Government aims for Nigeria’s creative sector to contribute 10% to the country’s Gross Domestic Product by expanding the sector’s GDP to $100 billion by 2030. Speaking at the Art, Culture and Creative Economy roundtable at the State House in Abuja, Musawa shared that the government’s vision for the sector is based on five key pillars. She emphasized the importance of fostering a supportive environment that encourages growth and investment, ensuring all stakeholders can participate fairly, and protecting creative, intellectual, and economic rights. Musawa noted that these measures are intended to attract talents, investors, and global interest. The government is committed to deeply exploring every creative sub-sector, from excellence in arts to music and gaming. Musawa highlighted the unifying and inspiring power of culture and the intention to harness it fully. Musawa also revealed an ambitious economic plan to create millions of jobs, supported by comprehensive skills training programs. The goal is to help the creative sector contribute a significant 10% to the nation’s GDP, reaching $100 billion by 2030. She highlighted the importance of private sector collaboration, shifting the government’s focus from just financing to providing broader support throughout the creative ecosystem to empower businesses and individuals. A new initiative, Destination 2030: Nigeria Everywhere, has been introduced to serve as both a strategic direction and a soft power initiative. The aim is to promote Nigeria’s culture and creators worldwide, making the country a leading global hub for arts, culture, and creativity. Musawa concluded by reminding participants that the creativity and passion of individuals in the sector are essential to achieving these goals, positioning Nigeria as a future creative capital while enriching lives and inspiring generations to come.

Govoreći na okruglom stolu o umjetnosti, kulturi i kreativnoj ekonomiji u državnoj kući u Abudži, Musawa je podijelila da je vizija vlade za sektor zasnovana na pet ključnih stubova. Musawa je istakla da su ove mjere namijenjene privlačenju talenata, investitora i globalne pažnje. Nova inicijativa Destination 2030: Nigeria Everywhere lansirana je kao strateški pravac i inicijativa meke moći s ciljem promoviranja nigerijske kulture i autora širom svijeta, čime zemlja postaje globalni centar za umjetnost, kulturu i kreativnost. article_content: Chris Christie began the week as one of America's most admired politicians, according to a Quinnipiac University poll, but faced controversy by week's end after revelations about the 'Bridgegate' scandal. The New Jersey governor responded by firing his deputy chief of staff, Bridget Kelly, and his campaign manager, Bill Stepien, following their involvement in closing lanes on the George Washington Bridge as apparent retribution against the mayor of Fort Lee. Republican strategists and conservative groups praised Christie for holding his staff accountable, contrasting his actions with President Barack Obama and former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton, whom critics argue have not addressed similar controversies in their administrations. Jenny Beth Martin of Tea Party Patriots stated that abuse of power by officials is wrong in any context, and commended Christie for holding subordinates accountable, while calling for similar standards for other leaders. Christie denied being a bully at a press conference, emphasizing his direct style and apologizing multiple times for his staff's conduct, calling the incident unacceptable. Analysts are divided about Christie's political future; while some believe the scandal damages his reputation, others argue his response could strengthen his position as a decisive leader. The controversy highlighted splits within the Republican Party. Christie is supported by moderates and some liberal-leaning voters, but still viewed skeptically by the party's more conservative base. Democratic officials, such as New Jersey state chairman John Currie, have called for more transparency from Christie, while political commentators suggest the outcome will depend on whether further evidence implicates the governor directly.

Guverner New Jerseyja reagovao je otpuštanjem svoje zamjenice šefa kabineta, Bridget Kelly, i menadžera kampanje, Billa Stepiena, nakon što su bili umiješani u zatvaranje traka na George Washington Mostu kao navodnu odmazdu protiv gradonačelnika Fort Leeja. Republikanski stratezi i konzervativne grupe pohvalili su Christija što je pozvao svoje saradnike na odgovornost, ističući da se to razlikuje od postupaka predsjednika Baracka Obame i bivše državne sekretarke Hillary Clinton, za koje kritičari smatraju da nisu adekvatno reagovali na slične kontroverze u svojim administracijama. Christie je na konferenciji za novinare odbacio tvrdnje da je nasilnik, naglasio svoj direktan stil i više puta se izvinjavao zbog ponašanja svojih saradnika, nazivajući incident neprihvatljivim. Analitičari su podijeljeni oko Christijeve političke budućnosti; neki smatraju da je afera narušila njegov ugled, dok drugi misle da bi njegov odgovor mogao ojačati njegovu poziciju odlučnog lidera. Kontroverza je istakla podjele unutar Republikanske stranke. Christieu podršku daju umjereni i neki liberalno orijentisani birači, dok ga najsnažnije konzervativne struje i dalje gledaju s nepovjerenjem. West Coast dock workers and port management have been engaged in difficult labor negotiations since their contract expired in July 2014. These talks have been contentious and prolonged, with both sides making moves that have slowed port operations, each seeking leverage. The International Longshore and Warehouse Union and the Pacific Maritime Association are urged to resolve their differences soon to prevent serious economic consequences. A resolution is needed without further slowdowns or shutdowns, as the ongoing dispute threatens the still fragile U.S. economic recovery. 

The impact of the dispute is widespread: agricultural exports are spoiling at ports or left unpicked in fields because they cannot be shipped; manufacturers are halting shifts for lack of imported parts and losing overseas customers, resorting to costly air shipments as an alternative. Retailers are missing critical merchandise for the upcoming seasons, while trucking and rail companies are experiencing idle equipment and disruptions nationwide. This standoff risks causing lasting harm to the reputations of American suppliers and West Coast ports, as international customers and shippers turn to competitors in other countries or alternative routes through Canada, Mexico, or the expanded Panama Canal.

Even if an agreement is reached immediately, clearing the backlog could take months. A full shutdown would cost exporters, importers, shippers, and related industries an estimated $2 billion a day—history shows the 10-day shutdown in 2002 cost the economy about $1 billion a day and required six months to resolve the backlog.

Given the crisis, bipartisan lawmakers recently held a press conference at the Capitol, calling for swift action. They urged President Obama to increase pressure for an agreement, expressing approval that he sent Secretary of Labor Thomas Perez to California to meet with both parties. Secretary Perez is assessing the national impacts of the stalemate. If total shutdown occurs, lawmakers said they would ask the President to use his authority under the Taft-Hartley Act to require negotiations and keep the ports open. Ultimately, the best solution is for both sides to come together now and reach an agreement.

Radnici luka Zapadne obale i uprava luka vode teške pregovore o radu otkako im je ugovor istekao u julu 2014. Ovi pregovori su bili napeti i dugotrajni, a obje strane su povremeno usporavale rad luka, pokušavajući ostvariti prednost. Međunarodni savez lučkih i skladišnih radnika (ILWU) i Pacifička pomorska asocijacija (PMA) pozivaju se da uskoro prevaziđu nesuglasice i spriječe ozbiljne ekonomske posljedice. Potrebno je pronaći rješenje bez daljih usporavanja ili zatvaranja, jer trenutni spor ugrožava još uvijek krhki oporavak američke privrede.

Spor ima široke posljedice: poljoprivredni proizvodi propadaju u lukama ili ostaju neubrani u poljima jer se ne mogu otpremiti; proizvođači zaustavljaju smjene zbog nedostatka uvoznih dijelova i gube strane kupce, pribjegavajući skupljim avionskim isporukama kao alternativi. Trgovci ne dobijaju ključnu robu za nadolazeće sezone, dok kamionske i željezničke kompanije imaju neiskorištenu opremu i usporen rad širom zemlje. Ovakva situacija ugrožava ugled američkih dobavljača i luka Zapadne obale, jer međunarodni kupci i brodari biraju konkurenciju iz drugih država ili alternativne rute kroz Kanadu, Meksiko ili prošireni Panamski kanal.

Čak i ako se dogovor postigne odmah, trebalo bi mjesecima da se raščiste zaostaci. Potpuno zatvaranje bi izvoznike, uvoznike, brodare i povezane industrije koštalo otprilike 2 milijarde dolara dnevno—iskustvo iz 2002. godine pokazuje da je 10-dnevno zatvaranje tada ekonomiju koštalo oko milijardu dolara dnevno i zahtijevalo pola godine za rješavanje zaostatka.

Uzimajući u obzir krizu, predstavnici obje političke stranke nedavno su održali konferenciju za novinare u Kapitolu, pozivajući na hitnu akciju. Pozvali su predsjednika Obamu da dodatno pojača pritisak na postizanje sporazuma, izražavajući zadovoljstvo što je poslao sekretara za rad Thomasa Pereza u Kaliforniju na razgovore s obje strane. Sekretar Perez procjenjuje uticaj zastoja na cijelu državu. Ako dođe do potpunog zatvaranja, zakonodavci su najavili da će tražiti od predsjednika da iskoristi ovlaštenja data Zakonom Tafta-Hartleyja kako bi naložio nastavak pregovora i zadržao luke otvorenim. Na kraju krajeva, najbolje rješenje je da obje strane brzo postignu dogovor.

article_content: Over 100 homeowners in Hampshire received alarming letters mistakenly informing them that their houses would be bulldozed for a new Stubbington bypass, in what has been described as a 'breathtaking error' by the local council. Many of the recipients, including elderly residents, were warned of potential criminal prosecution if they did not comply with a sale to a council contractor. Hampshire County Council has since apologized for the confusion caused by the letters, which outlined supposed plans for the bypass. About 150 of 500 drafted letters were mistakenly sent to residents on Friday morning, telling homeowners they had just 14 days to respond. Over the weekend, council representatives personally delivered letters of apology, explaining that the notices were intended only for a handful of local landowners. Councillor Sean Woodward, executive member for transport, issued an apology and explained that a communication breakdown between the council and consultants led to the error. He has requested an investigation into the circumstances and measures to prevent similar mistakes in the future. Despite the official apology, many affected residents remain perplexed as to how such a significant mistake could occur. Residents of Burnt House Lane in Stubbington, including Barry Gee and Elizabeth Abbott, expressed shock at the situation and questioned the necessity of a new bypass. Chris Wood, county councillor for Fareham Crofton, apologized for the distress caused and assured residents that no homes would face compulsory purchase orders. He clarified that the original letters aimed to inform about ecological surveys, but the consulting company exceeded its remit. Stubbington Borough councillor Jim Forrest echoed the sentiment, noting the anxiety caused among elderly residents. Hampshire County Council has unreservedly apologized and reiterated that there are no plans to compulsorily purchase any residential properties as part of the bypass development. The erroneous letters were intended only for owners of land directly impacted by the potential routes. The council will now consider alternative routes and conduct further ecological studies before making a final decision.

article_content: Drone technology is rapidly expanding, with over 50 nations involved in its development or acquisition. Countries such as China, Russia, India, Pakistan, and Iran are at the forefront, while groups like Hezbollah have used drones designed by Iran. Iran is also working on drones capable of flying more than 600 miles. Although these systems are mostly used for surveillance, they can easily be armed, which increases their destructive potential. For example, a Massachusetts man was recently arrested for plotting to attack the Pentagon or Capitol with an explosive drone. As private drone-for-hire companies emerge, the commercialization of drone technology is raising important questions about its societal impact. There are major concerns that as access to drone technology spreads, both nations and non-state actors could use them to launch sudden remote attacks. Additionally, progress in autonomous drones capable of making lethal decisions independently is creating further unease. Allowing machines to decide matters of life and death brings up serious ethical issues. Some U.S. officials view drones as a cost-effective and safer alternative for military operations, which avoids risking soldiers’ lives or facing significant public scrutiny. However, this perception could dangerously lower the threshold for engaging in armed conflict. Simplifying the realities of war overlooks the true costs. The continued violence in Afghanistan after over a decade demonstrates that terrorism and insurgent activity persist. The UN reported in May 2011 the highest Afghan civilian death toll in any month since 2007. Military strategies focused on drone strikes may not be effective. According to the RAND Corporation's 2008 report, 'How Terrorist Groups End,' political and policing solutions work better against violent extremism than military action. The U.S. government states that drone strikes target al Qaeda leaders, but most of those killed are lower-level militants. The legality of U.S. drone strikes outside war zones such as Afghanistan, particularly in countries like Pakistan, Yemen, and Somalia, remains questionable. Most U.S. drone operations are led by the CIA, which has faced criticism for its lack of transparency and past violations. Although drone weapons are promoted as precise, evidence from independent investigations shows that civilian casualties still occur. While U.S. officials downplay these deaths, the Bureau of Investigative Journalism in the UK found that about 20% of U.S. drone strikes in Pakistan cause civilian casualties, totaling over 2,000 deaths since 2004. Civilian deaths are estimated to be between 386 and 775, with as many as 170 children killed. The ongoing expansion of drone warfare presents serious moral, legal, and security challenges. Rather than continually advancing this technology, it is essential to pause and consider its consequences. This column shares the views of David Cortright.

Ipak, ovakav pristup može opasno sniziti prag za ulazak u oružane sukobe. Pojednostavljivanje stvarnosti rata zanemaruje prave troškove. Nastavak nasilja u Afganistanu nakon više od decenije pokazuje da terorizam i pobune i dalje traju. Većinu američkih operacija dronovima vodi CIA, poznata po netransparentnosti i ranijim spornim postupcima. Iako se dronovi prikazuju kao precizno oružje, dokazi nezavisnih istraga pokazuju da civilnih žrtava ipak ima. Dok američki zvaničnici umanjuju ove smrti, britanski Bureau of Investigative Journalism procjenjuje da oko 20% američkih dron napada u Pakistanu izaziva civilne žrtve, sa više od 2.000 poginulih od 2004. Broj poginulih civila procjenjuje se između 386 i 775, uključujući i do 170 djece. Neprestani razvoj dronova otvara ozbiljna moralna, pravna i sigurnosna pitanja. Umjesto stalnog unapređenja ove tehnologije, potrebno je zastati i razmotriti sve posljedice. Ova kolumna odražava stavove Davida Cortrighta.

article_content: Brittany Maynard, a 29-year-old diagnosed with terminal brain cancer, chose to end her life three weeks ago under Oregon's Death with Dignity Act. A new video released on what would have been her 30th birthday features Maynard calling for right-to-die laws across the United States. She urges lawmakers to support terminally ill patients who wish to die with dignity. After being given six months to live, Maynard moved from California to Portland, Oregon, specifically to use Oregon’s right-to-die law. She died on November 1. The newly released footage, organized by an advocacy group, shares Maynard’s thoughts in her final days, includes photos from before her illness, and voices from other terminally ill patients and their families. Oregon was the first state to allow terminally ill patients to end their lives using doctor-prescribed medication. Other states with similar laws are Washington, Montana, Vermont, and New Mexico. Several more, such as Wyoming and Colorado, are expected to consider related bills soon. In the video, Maynard emphasizes that her decision was made freely and thoughtfully, not out of fear or coercion. She hopes her story will help reduce the stigma and misunderstandings surrounding end-of-life choices. Since Maynard’s story became national news, lawmakers in different states have mentioned her influence while debating new right-to-die laws. For example, the New Jersey Assembly recently passed a bill to permit doctors to prescribe life-ending medication, though Governor Chris Christie has expressed his opposition. In California, the West Hollywood City Council has encouraged non-prosecution of those assisting terminally ill patients, despite no statewide legal provisions at present. Representative Mark Rozzi in Pennsylvania, who lost his father to the same cancer, is advocating for a death-with-dignity law but faces opposition from religious leaders. He credits his personal experience and Maynard’s advocacy as driving forces behind the campaign. Compassion & Choices, the advocacy group working with Maynard, reported over five million unique website visitors recently, and Maynard’s videos have been viewed more than thirteen million times online. Barbara Coombs Lee, president of the group, says Maynard’s impact has energized the movement. Maynard passed away peacefully in her Portland home, surrounded by her husband, Dan Diaz, and family. In her final messages, she encouraged others with terminal illnesses to speak for themselves and continue pushing for patient rights regarding end-of-life choices. Her decision has received both support and criticism. Some religious organizations and leaders, such as a Vatican official and the American Life League, have denounced assisted suicide. Maynard’s mother, Debbie Ziegler, publicly defended Brittany’s choices, criticizing those who condemned her daughter without knowing her personal circumstances. The Roman Catholic Church opposes euthanasia and assisted suicide, teaching that life should only end naturally. In her final video, Maynard acknowledged criticism, described how it affected her emotionally, but reaffirmed her appreciation for life and her belief in the importance of personal choice as her illness progressed.

Novi video pušten na dan kada bi slavila 30. rođendan prikazuje Brittany kako poziva na usvajanje zakona o pravu na dostojanstvenu smrt širom Sjedinjenih Država. Ona apeluje na zakonodavce da podrže terminalno bolesne pacijente koji žele umrijeti dostojanstveno. Nakon što je dobila prognozu da joj preostaje šest mjeseci života, Maynard se preselila iz Kalifornije u Portland, Oregon kako bi mogla iskoristiti Oregonski zakon o dostojanstvenoj smrti. Preminula je 1. novembra. Novoobjavljeni snimak, koji je organizirala jedna zagovaračka grupa, dijeli Brittanyne misli tokom njenih posljednjih dana, prikazuje njene fotografije prije bolesti i donosi glasove drugih terminalno bolesnih pacijenata i njihovih porodica. Oregon je prva savezna država koja je dozvolila terminalno bolesnim osobama da okončaju život ljekarskim receptom za lijekove. Druge države sa sličnim zakonima su Washington, Montana, Vermont i New Mexico. Očekuje se da će još nekoliko država, poput Wyominga i Colorada, uskoro razmatrati slične zakone. U videu Maynard naglašava da je njena odluka donijeta slobodno i promišljeno, a ne iz straha ili pod pritiskom. Ona se nada da će njena priča pomoći u smanjenju stigme i nerazumijevanja vezanih za odluke na kraju života. Otkako je Maynardina priča postala nacionalna vijest, zakonodavci u različitim državama navode njen uticaj tokom debata o novim zakonima o pravu na smrt. Naprimjer, Skupština New Jerseya nedavno je usvojila prijedlog zakona kojim se liječnicima dozvoljava propisivanje lijekova za okončanje života, iako guverner Chris Christie izražava protivljenje. U Kaliforniji, gradsko vijeće West Hollywooda pozvalo je na neprovođenje progonjenja osoba koje pomažu terminalno bolesnim, iako zasad ne postoji državni zakon o ovoj temi. Predstavnik Mark Rozzi iz Pennsylvanije, koji je izgubio oca od iste vrste raka, zalaže se za zakon o dostojanstvenoj smrti ali se suočava s protivljenjem vjerskih lidera. Kaže da ga na kampanju motivišu vlastito iskustvo i Brittanyno zalaganje. Organizacija Compassion & Choices, koja je surađivala s Maynard, izvijestila je o više od pet miliona jedinstvenih posjeta svojoj stranici nedavno, dok su Brittanyni video zapisi pregledani više od trinaest miliona puta na internetu. Barbara Coombs Lee, predsjednica organizacije, kaže da je Maynardin uticaj dao novi zamah pokretu. Maynard je umrla mirno u svom domu u Portlandu, okružena suprugom Danom Diazom i porodicom. U svojim posljednjim porukama, ohrabrivala je druge s terminalnim bolestima da se zalažu za sebe i nastave borbu za prava pacijenata o odlukama na kraju života. Njena odluka izazvala je i podršku i kritike. Neke vjerske organizacije i lideri, poput jednog zvaničnika Vatikana i American Life League, javno su osudili asistirano samoubistvo. Brittanyina majka Debbie Ziegler javno je branila odluku svoje kćerke i kritikovala one koji sude bez poznavanja njene situacije. Rimsko-katolička crkva protivi se eutanaziji i asistiranoj smrti, učeći da život treba okončati prirodnim putem. Brittany je u svom posljednjem videu priznala kritiku, opisala kako su je ti komentari emotivno pogađali, ali je ponovo izrazila zahvalnost za život i važnost ličnog izbora dok joj se zdravlje pogoršavalo.

article_content: In 2011, Japan experienced a magnitude 9 earthquake—the most powerful in its recorded history—which, along with a subsequent tsunami, resulted in over 15,000 deaths and caused more than £20.2 billion ($34.6 billion) in damages. However, the repercussions of that disaster may not yet be over. New research suggests that the enormous earthquake may have disturbed Mount Fuji, putting it in a critical state with a heightened risk of eruption. Mount Fuji last erupted in 1707 during the Hoei event, which spread ash across eastern Japan and caused significant damage at a time when the country was much less populated. French and Japanese scientists collaborating from the Institute of Earth Sciences in Grenoble and the Institute of Global Physics in Paris have reported that Mount Fuji is at increased risk of erupting. The volcano stands 3,776 meters (12,388 feet) tall and is about 100 kilometers (60 miles) southwest of Tokyo. Mount Fuji is Japan’s highest mountain and an active stratovolcano. During the 1707 Hoei eruption, an estimated billion cubic meters of ash and debris blanketed the region. Today, about 36 million people live in the greater Tokyo area, making a similar event potentially catastrophic. On June 22, 2014, Mount Fuji was named a World Heritage Cultural Site and is one of Japan’s 'Three Holy Mountains.' For the first time, scientists observed how Japanese volcanoes responded to seismic waves from the 2011 Tohoku earthquake. Their findings, published in Science, provide new insights into the ways earthquakes can affect volcanic activity and may help enhance the assessment of eruption risk worldwide. Lead author Dr. Florent Brenguier explained to The Guardian that while their research does not predict an immediate eruption, it does indicate Mount Fuji is in a critical state. Analysis of more than 70 terabytes of seismic data showed that the strongest perturbations in the Earth's crust occurred not where earthquake shocks were greatest, but beneath volcanic regions—especially under Mount Fuji. The anomalies are likely caused by pressurized fluids, such as boiling water and magma, trapped beneath the volcano. Dr. Brenguier told MailOnline that this research provides new ways to understand the state of pressure deep within volcanoes, particularly the region between the magma chamber and the surface, which could be key in eruption preparedness. Previous studies indicate Mount Fuji may be situated on a 30-kilometer (19-mile)-wide active fault potentially capable of generating magnitude 7 earthquakes—another factor that could raise eruption risks. Despite Mount Fuji being about 500 kilometers (310 miles) from the Tohoku earthquake’s epicenter, researchers found significant seismic anomalies beneath the mountain, signaling heightened pressure. However, they emphasize that there is no way to know when, or if, an eruption will happen. Historically, the 1707 Mount Fuji eruption was preceded by an 8.7-magnitude quake 49 days earlier, and the scientists say the last eruption followed substantial seismic activity. Using 800 seismic sensors and detailed data analysis, the team mapped underground anomalies caused by the 2011 quake’s impact. While Mount Fuji now shows a high potential for eruption, researchers advise that there is currently no need for evacuation or drastic measures—though continued caution and monitoring are important. Dr. Brenguier concluded, 'All we can say is that Mount Fuji is now in a state of pressure, which means it displays a high potential for eruption. The risk is clearly higher, but we cannot specify when or if it will occur.'
translated_content: Godine 2011. Japan je pogodio zemljotres jačine 9 stepeni — najsnažniji u zabilježenoj historiji zemlje — koji je zajedno s tsunamijem prouzrokovao više od 15.000 smrtnih slučajeva i više od 20,2 milijarde funti (34,6 milijardi dolara) štete. Ipak, posljedice te katastrofe možda još nisu završile. Nova istraživanja sugerišu da je snažan zemljotres mogao uticati na stanje planine Fuji, stavljajući je u kritično stanje s povećanim rizikom od erupcije. Planina Fuji posljednji put je eruptirala 1707. godine, tokom takozvane Hoei erupcije, kada je pepeo prekrio istočni Japan i prouzrokovao značajnu štetu u vrijeme kada je zemlja bila znatno manje naseljena. Francuski i japanski naučnici s Instituta za nauke o Zemlji u Grenoblu i Instituta za globalnu fiziku u Parizu izvijestili su da je rizik od erupcije planine Fuji povećan. Vulkan je visok 3.776 metara (12.388 stopa) i nalazi se oko 100 kilometara jugozapadno od Tokija. Planina Fuji je najviša u Japanu i aktivni stratovulkan. Procjenjuje se da je tokom Hoei erupcije 1707. godine milijardu kubnih metara pepela i ostataka prekrilo regiju. Danas u širem području Tokija živi oko 36 miliona ljudi, pa bi sličan događaj mogao biti katastrofalan. Dana 22. juna 2014. godine, planina Fuji upisana je na UNESCO listu svjetske baštine kao kulturno dobro i jedna je od ‘Tri svete planine’ Japana. Po prvi put, naučnici su promatrali reakcije japanskih vulkana na seizmičke valove iz zemljotresa u Tohoku 2011. godine. Njihova otkrića, objavljena u časopisu Science, nude nove uvide o tome kako zemljotresi mogu uticati na vulkane i mogu pomoći u procjeni rizika od erupcija širom svijeta. Vodeći autor dr. Florent Brenguier za Guardian je pojasnio da njihova studija ne predviđa trenutnu erupciju, ali da planina Fuji jeste u kritičnom stanju. Analiza više od 70 terabajta seizmičkih podataka pokazala je da su najveći poremećaji Zemljine kore zapaženi ne tamo gdje su udari bili najjači, nego upravo ispod vulkanskih područja – posebno ispod Fujija. Anomalije su najvjerovatnije uzrokovane pritiskom fluida, poput vrele vode i magme, zarobljenih ispod vulkana. Dr. Brenguier za MailOnline ističe da ovo istraživanje donosi nove načine za razumijevanje stanja pritiska duboko unutar vulkana, naročito dijela između magmatske komore i površine, što je ključno za pripremu na erupciju. Prethodna istraživanja ukazuju da se Fuji nalazi iznad aktivnog rasjeda širokog 30 kilometara, koji može prouzrokovati zemljotrese jačine 7 stepeni — što može dodatno povećati rizik od erupcije. Iako se planina Fuji nalazi oko 500 kilometara od epicentra Tohoku zemljotresa, naučnici su otkrili značajne seizmičke anomalije pod planinom, što upućuje na povećan pritisak. Ipak, napominju da nije moguće predvidjeti kada ili da li će doći do erupcije. Historijski gledano, erupciji iz 1707. prethodio je zemljotres jačine 8,7 stepeni, 49 dana ranije, a naučnici navode da je i ta erupcija uslijedila nakon velike seizmičke aktivnosti. Korištenjem 800 senzora i detaljne analize, tim je mapirao podzemne anomalije uzrokovane efektima zemljotresa iz 2011. Iako Fuji pokazuje visok potencijal za erupciju, naučnici za sada ne savjetuju evakuaciju ili drastične mjere — ali ističu važnost stalne pažnje i praćenja. Dr. Brenguier zaključuje: 'Možemo reći da je Fuji pod pritiskom i pokazuje visok potencijal za erupciju. Rizik je očito veći, ali ne možemo znati kada ili da li će se to desiti.'

article_content: W.F. Arber & Co, a beloved print shop on Roman Road in Bow, London, has closed its doors after 117 years of business. The closure, following decades of resilience through two World Wars and hardships such as bombing during the Blitz, is primarily attributed to heavy parking fines and high business rates imposed by Tower Hamlets Council. Founded by Walter Arber in 1897, the printing company became a landmark in the East End, known for producing pamphlets for figures such as Emmeline Pankhurst and materials for the local community, including the Kray twins’ boxing promotions. Gary Arber, Walter's grandson, managed the store for 60 years up to its final day. Despite the shop surviving wartime destruction, recent years saw a sharp drop in customers due to strict parking regulations and surveillance cameras that quickly penalized those stopping outside. Even local church staff collecting supplies were fined. Mr. Arber noted that, over the last decade, stricter parking rules and rising business rates made running the store impossible. Eventually, the large annual business rate, combined with declining business, led to the shop’s closure. Most historic printing machinery and items have been transferred to a private collection, while the 1900 Golding press will be displayed at the Bishopsgate Institute. Gary Arber and his wife have now retired to Romford, with no family successors to continue the tradition. The building has been sold and is set to be converted into flats, marking the end of an era for a business that resisted historic adversity but ultimately succumbed to modern financial and policy pressures.
translated_content: W.F. Arber & Co, voljena štamparija u ulici Roman Road u Bowu, London, zatvorila je svoja vrata nakon 117 godina poslovanja. Zatvaranje, nakon decenija otpornosti kroz dva svjetska rata i teškoća poput bombardovanja tokom Blitza, uglavnom se pripisuje visokim kaznama za parkiranje i visokim poslovnim taksama koje je nametnuo Tower Hamlets Council. Štampariju je osnovao Walter Arber 1897. godine, a s vremenom je postala orijentir u istočnom dijelu Londona, poznata po štampanju pamfleta za ličnosti poput Emmeline Pankhurst i materijala za lokalnu zajednicu, uključujući i promotivne materijale za bokserske mečeve braće Kray. Gary Arber, Walterov unuk, vodio je radnju 60 godina do njenog zatvaranja. Iako je štamparija preživjela ratna razaranja, posljednjih godina je broj mušterija znatno opao zbog strogih parking pravila i nadzornih kamera koje su brzo kažnjavale one koji bi se zaustavili ispred radnje. Čak su i članovi lokalne crkve koji su dolazili po materijale dobijali kazne. Gospodin Arber je naveo da su u posljednjih deset godina strožiji režim parkiranja i rastuće poslovne takse učinili rukovođenje radnjom nemogućim. Na kraju, visoke godišnje takse i pad prometa doveli su do zatvaranja. Većina historijskih mašina i opreme prebačena je u privatnu kolekciju, dok će Golding presa iz 1900. godine biti izložena u Bishopsgate Institute-u. Gary Arber i njegova supruga sada su se povukli u Romford, bez nasljednika koji bi nastavili tradiciju. Zgrada je prodana i bit će pretvorena u stanove, što označava kraj jedne ere za biznis koji je odolijevao istorijskim nevoljama, ali je na kraju pokleknuo pred savremenim finansijskim i administrativnim pritiscima.

article_content: Frank Ileogben, also known as Itom, is a Nigerian content creator and skit maker with a substantial online following. He has one million followers on TikTok and 281,000 on Instagram. In a recent interview, Frank opened up about his background, career journey, and thoughts on content creation. Raised in Owan West, Edo State, Frank is the youngest of four children and spent his formative years in Benin City. He holds a bachelor's degree from Delta State University, Abraka, and a master's degree in Environmental and Public Health Microbiology from the University of Benin. He became actively involved in social media in 2020, though he had previously posted casually on Facebook and joined Instagram in 2015. A viral post in 2020 encouraged him to begin uploading content weekly. Frank values each social media platform for its unique features and does not have a single favorite. His preferred work tool is his camera, which produces better quality photos and videos than his phone. His content is influenced by personal experiences and his Christian beliefs, often drawing inspiration from stored memories. He taught himself video editing through practice and YouTube tutorials, gaining most of his skills through hands-on experience. Besides his social media content, Frank produces videos for others and enjoys photography. Filming a video can take up to seven hours and editing up to eleven hours, depending on complexity. One of his most challenging projects was a collaboration with content creator Collins Uche, known as Soft. Frank has worked alongside several well-known Nigerian celebrities, including Anita Asuoha (Warri Pikin), Funke Akindele, Kate Henshaw, Richard Mofe-Damijo, and Pastor Kingsley Okonkwo, though he doesn't single out a favorite. Previously employed in the communications sector, Frank now works as a creative director and consultant. He aims to expand into filmmaking and launch a fashion line, often collaborating with brands for clothing sponsorships and working with stylists when required. Describing himself as a workaholic, Frank is learning to prioritize family and personal time. He sometimes shoots multiple videos per day and outsources his editing to manage his workload. While he isn’t active in club or party scenes, he attends house gatherings. To prevent burnout, he regularly takes social media breaks and recommends not stressing over low engagement. Frank wants his content to spread positivity and often receives messages about its impact on viewers. His faith shapes the messages in his videos. Memorable fan encounters in London and Kenya have motivated him, and he has traveled for brand-sponsored content. While content creation is demanding, Frank copes with the pressure by affirming his identity (ITOM: I am The Only Me). He believes social media has helped reduce reliance on traditional jobs and crime by creating economic opportunities, and he's proud that Nigerian creators present a positive image of the country. Frank counteracts misconceptions that content creation is easy or fraudulent, emphasizing the hard work, investment, and dedication involved. When facing creative blocks, he prefers to take a break and revisit ideas later. He advises emerging content creators to use natural lighting, focus on camera quality, and invest in good audio, rather than expensive gear. Frank foresees more Nigerian creators achieving global recognition and diversifying into entertainment sectors such as movies and music. To relax, he enjoys playing games and listening to music.

U nedavnom intervjuu, Frank je govorio o svom poreklu, karijeri i razmišljanjima o kreiranju sadržaja. Odrastao je u Owan Westu, savezna država Edo, kao najmlađe od četvoro djece, a detinjstvo je proveo u gradu Benin. Diplomirao je na Delta State University, Abraka, a magistrirao mikrobiologiju zaštite životne sredine i javnog zdravlja na Univerzitetu u Beninu. Aktivno je počeo koristiti društvene mreže 2020. godine, iako je i ranije povremeno objavljivao na Facebooku, a Instagramu se pridružio 2015. godine. Viralna objava te godine ga je podstakla da redovno, svake sedmice, postavlja novi sadržaj. Frank cijeni svaku mrežu zbog njenog posebnog karaktera i nema omiljenu. Omiljeni alat mu je kamera zbog boljeg kvaliteta slike i videa u odnosu na telefon. Njegov sadržaj inspirisan je ličnim iskustvom i hrišćanskom vjerom, a često crpi ideje iz sjećanja. Montažu videa naučio je samostalno kroz praksu i uz pomoć YouTube tutorijala. Pored svojih naloga, pravi videe za druge i voli fotografiju. Snimanje jednog videa može trajati do sedam sati, a montaža do jedanaest, u zavisnosti od složenosti. Najizazovniji mu je bio rad sa Collinsom Ucheom (Soft). Radio je sa poznatim nigerijskim zvijezdama kao što su Anita Asuoha (Warri Pikin), Funke Akindele, Kate Henshaw, Richard Mofe-Damijo i Pastor Kingsley Okonkwo, ali ne izdvaja favorita. Prije kreiranja sadržaja radio je u komunikacijama, sada je kreativni direktor i konsultant. Planira rad na filmovima i u modnoj industriji, često ostvaruje saradnje sa brendovima oko odeće i angažuje stiliste. Kaže da je radoholičar, ali nastoji pronaći ravnotežu i više vremena posvetiti porodici. Nekad snimi više videa dnevno, a montažu povjerava drugima kako bi smanjio opterećenje. Ne voli klubove ni velike zabave, ali ide na kućne žurke. Redovno uzima pauze od mreža da izbjegne sagorijevanje i savjetuje da se ne opterećujete slabom gledanošću. Njegov cilj je širenje pozitivne energije, često dobija poruke da njegova muzika podiže raspoloženje. Vjera mu daje inspiraciju za klipove, a susreti sa fanovima u Londonu i Keniji dodatno ga motivišu. Imao je priliku putovati zahvaljujući saradnji sa brendovima. Na pritisak odgovara podsjećanjem na svoju autentičnost (ITOM: I am The Only Me). Vjeruje da su društvene mreže stvorile ekonomske prilike i smanjile oslonac na stara zanimanja i kriminal. Posebno je ponosan što kreatori Nigeriju prikazuju pozitivno. Razbija stereotipe da je posao lak ili sumnjiv, naglašavajući težak rad i ulaganje. Kod kreativnih blokada, pravi pauzu i poslije se vraća idejama. Mladim autorima savjetuje da koriste prirodno svjetlo, dobru kameru i kvalitetan zvuk bez nužno skupe opreme. Vjeruje da će mnogi nigerijski kreatori postizati međunarodni uspjeh i širiti se ka filmu i muzici. Opušta se igrajući igrice i slušajući muziku.

article_content:
Gavin MacLeod is known for offering kind words about nearly everyone he’s met in the entertainment industry. He admires Cary Grant and Gregory Peck, and considers shaking Frank Sinatra’s hand a life highlight. In his new memoir, ‘This Is Your Captain Speaking’ (written with Mark Dagostino), MacLeod recounts a memorable incident with Bette Davis. During the early 1980s, at the height of his 'Love Boat' fame, he invited Davis to dinner. Davis reportedly argued with another guest, upset MacLeod’s wife, and later criticized the hosts in a newspaper. Still, MacLeod views the story with humor.

His memoir radiates enthusiasm and gratitude. He reflects on his early stage work, extensive career as a television character actor, and highlights his roles as Murray Slaughter on ‘The Mary Tyler Moore Show’ and Captain Merrill Stubing on ‘The Love Boat.’ MacLeod often honors his co-stars and colleagues, expressing ongoing surprise at his own success.

Born Allan See in Westchester County, New York, MacLeod lost his father when he was 13 and struggled with alcoholism, which led to his first marriage ending. He discusses these challenges candidly in his book. For years he worked in smaller acting roles before achieving greater recognition in his late 30s. His start was on stage in ‘A Hatful of Rain’ and theater roles in Los Angeles, leading to television work, frequently as a villain.

Playing Murray Slaughter and later Capt. Stubing boosted his reputation as a likeable on-screen figure, and he became a spokesperson for Princess Cruises. MacLeod attributes much of his resilience to his Christian faith and his enduring marriage to his wife, Patti.

In an interview from his home in Southern California, MacLeod discussed his journey as an actor, noting that rejection is common in the profession but hope and persistence are vital. He shared that being bald helped him land many different roles early in his career.

He described how he chose the part of Murray Slaughter over Lou Grant in ‘The Mary Tyler Moore Show,’ following his instincts—a lesson he promotes to other actors. MacLeod also discussed how audiences came to associate him strongly with his iconic roles, and how he worked to make Capt. Stubing more compassionate to connect better with viewers.

While ‘The Mary Tyler Moore Show’ was praised by critics, ‘The Love Boat’ was not, but MacLeod is proud of its positive messaging and effect on audiences. He encourages readers to pursue their dreams, take chances, and live life to the fullest.
translated_content:
Gavin MacLeod je poznat po tome što ima lijepe riječi za gotovo svakoga koga je susreo u svijetu zabave. Divi se Caryju Grantu i Gregoryju Pecku, a stisak ruke Franka Sinatre smatra vrhuncem svog života. U svojim novim memoarima ‘Ovdje govori vaš kapetan’ (napisanim sa Markom Dagostinom), MacLeod opisuje nezaboravan susret s Bette Davis. Početkom 1980-ih, na vrhuncu popularnosti serije ‘Love Boat’, pozvao je Davis na večeru. Navodno se Davis posvađala s drugim gostom, uznemirila MacLeodovu suprugu i kasnije kritikovala domaćine u novinama. Ipak, MacLeod na tu priču gleda sa dozom humora.

Njegovi memoari odišu entuzijazmom i zahvalnošću. Prisjeća se glumačkih početaka u pozorištu, duge televizijske karijere i ističe uloge Murrayja Slaughtera u ‘The Mary Tyler Moore Show’ i kapetana Merrilla Stubinga u ‘The Love Boat’. Često odaje priznanje kolegama i saradnicima, naglašavajući vlastito iznenađenje zbog uspjeha koji je ostvario.

Rođen kao Allan See u okrugu Westchester, New York, MacLeod je izgubio oca sa 13 godina i borio se s alkoholizmom što je dovelo do kraja njegovog prvog braka. O tim izazovima iskreno piše u knjizi. Godinama je glumio u manjim ulogama prije nego što se proslavio u kasnim tridesetim godinama. Prvo je nastupao u pozorištu, u predstavi ‘A Hatful of Rain’, a potom je uslijedio prelazak na televiziju, gdje je često tumačio zlikovce.

Uloge Murrayja Slaughtera i kasnije kapetana Stubinga učvrstile su njegovu reputaciju simpatičnog lika, a postao je i zaštitno lice kompanije Princess Cruises. MacLeod veliku izdržljivost i snagu pripisuje svojoj kršćanskoj vjeri i dugogodišnjem braku sa suprugom Patti.

U intervjuu iz svog doma u južnoj Kaliforniji, MacLeod je govorio o glumačkom putu, ističući da su odbijanja sastavni dio tog posla, ali da su nada i upornost ključni. Otkrio je i da mu je ćelavost pomogla da dobije brojne uloge na početku.

Opisao je kako je odlučio da glumi Murrayja Slaughtera umjesto Loua Granta u seriji ‘The Mary Tyler Moore Show’, slijedeći instinkt — savjet koji sada prenosi mladim glumcima. Spomenuo je i kako ga publika snažno povezuje s kultnim ulogama, te kako je svjesno nastojao kapetana Stubinga učiniti saosjećajnijim i bližim gledateljima.

Iako su kritičari hvalili ‘The Mary Tyler Moore Show’, ‘The Love Boat’ nije dobio dobre ocjene, ali MacLeod je ponosan na pozitivne poruke i uticaj koje je ta serija imala. Svim čitaocima poručuje da slijede svoje snove, rizikuju i žive život punim plućima.

article_content: Authorities in southern Mexico treated more than 700 people for food poisoning following a political rally this week, officials announced. The precise cause of the outbreak remains undetermined, according to Mexico's Guerrero state health ministry on Wednesday. Investigators are currently analyzing food and beverage samples from the event and dispatching officials to neighboring communities to identify additional cases. Alberta Garcia Adame, who attended the rally in Chilapa, Guerrero, for congressional candidate Sergio Dolores Flores of the Institutional Revolutionary Party, told CNN affiliate Televisa that she became ill after eating egg tacos at the gathering on Tuesday. As the situation worsened, doctors provided care to many patients at a local hospital and at a temporary shelter set up in the rear of a nearby church, Televisa reported. Guerrero State Health Secretary Rufino Dominguez stated Wednesday that nearly all patients had received treatment and were released.

Tačan uzrok trovanja još uvijek nije utvrđen, navelo je ministarstvo zdravstva države Guerrero u srijedu. Istražitelji trenutno analiziraju uzorke hrane i pića sa događaja i šalju predstavnike u okolna mjesta kako bi pronašli dodatne slučajeve. Alberta Garcia Adame, koja je prisustvovala skupu u Chilapi, Guerrero, podržavajući kandidata za kongres Sergia Doloresa Floresa iz Institucionalne revolucionarne stranke, rekla je za Televisu, CNN-ovog partnera, da joj je pozlilo nakon što je pojela tortilje s jajima na skupu u utorak. Kako se situacija pogoršavala, ljekari su zbrinjavali mnoge pacijente u lokalnoj bolnici, kao i u privremenom skloništu iza obližnje crkve, izvijestila je Televisa. Državni sekretar za zdravstvo Guerrera, Rufino Dominguez, izjavio je u srijedu da su gotovo svi pacijenti bili liječeni i pušteni kući.

article_content: Goldman Sachs, a leading U.S. investment bank, has entered arbitration against Malaysia at the London Court of International Arbitration amid escalating tensions over their 1MDB scandal settlement. In 2020, Goldman Sachs agreed to pay Malaysia $3.9 billion to settle allegations regarding its involvement in the multibillion-dollar corruption at the state-run 1Malaysia Development Berhad (1MDB) fund. However, disagreements persist regarding whether Malaysia has received required payments and asset recoveries under the settlement. This week, Goldman Sachs initiated arbitration, while Malaysia’s 1MDB task force chairman, Johari Abdul Ghani, called the move premature, arguing that amicable negotiations are still ongoing. Authorities in Malaysia and the U.S. allege that $4.5 billion was embezzled from 1MDB in a scheme involving then-Prime Minister Najib Razak, Goldman Sachs executives, and financier Jho Low. Najib is currently serving a 12-year prison sentence for his role, while former Goldman partner Tim Leissner pleaded guilty to money laundering and bribery in 2018, and his colleague Roger Ng was sentenced to 10 years in prison. 1MDB was set up in 2009 by Najib and Jho Low to fund national development projects, but U.S. officials say billions were diverted to offshore accounts and luxury purchases, including real estate, art, jewelry, and even partial financing of 'The Wolf of Wall Street' film. Jho Low remains at large and denies wrongdoing. The scandal sparked public outrage in Malaysia, contributing to Najib's electoral defeat in 2018. Malaysia has since prosecuted several Goldman Sachs units for misleading investors, and the bank paid $2.9 billion to settle U.S. charges in 2020. The current dispute focuses on whether Malaysia recovered at least $500 million in assets by August 2022, which would trigger an additional interim payment of $250 million from Goldman. Negotiations have stalled, leading to the recent arbitration filing. Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim’s government is revisiting the settlement, seeking greater recovery of the lost funds. At a recent business event in Singapore, Anwar criticized the original deal as unfair and vowed to pursue tougher negotiation. Goldman Sachs maintains it was misled by Malaysian officials and has denied wrongdoing.
translated_content: Goldman Sachs, vodeća američka investiciona banka, pokrenula je arbitražni postupak protiv Malezije na Londonskom sudu za međunarodnu arbitražu usred rastućih tenzija oko nagodbe vezane za skandal 1MDB. Godine 2020., Goldman Sachs se složio da plati Maleziji 3,9 milijardi dolara kako bi riješio optužbe u vezi sa svojom ulogom u višemilijardnoj korupciji u državnom fondu 1Malaysia Development Berhad (1MDB). Međutim, sporovi i dalje postoje oko toga da li je Malezija primila potrebne isplate i povraćaj imovine prema dogovoru. Ove sedmice, Goldman Sachs je pokrenuo arbitražu, dok je predsjednik radne grupe 1MDB u Maleziji, Johari Abdul Ghani, potez nazvao preuranjenim, tvrdeći da su prijateljski pregovori još uvijek u toku. Vlasti u Maleziji i SAD-u tvrde da je 4,5 milijardi dolara pronevjerio iz 1MDB-a u šemi u kojoj su učestvovali bivši premijer Najib Razak, rukovodioci Goldman Sachsa i finansijer Jho Low. Najib trenutno izdržava zatvorsku kaznu od 12 godina zbog svoje uloge, dok je bivši partner Goldman Sachsa Tim Leissner priznao krivicu za pranje novca i podmićivanje 2018. godine, a njegov kolega Roger Ng osuđen je na 10 godina zatvora. 1MDB je osnovan 2009. godine od strane Najiba i Jho Lowa kako bi finansirao nacionalne razvojne projekte, ali američke vlasti tvrde da su milijarde preusmjerene na inostrane račune i luksuzne kupovine, uključujući nekretnine, umjetnine, nakit, pa čak i djelomično finansiranje filma 'Vuk sa Wall Streeta'. Jho Low je i dalje na slobodi i negira bilo kakvu krivicu. Skandal je izazvao javno nezadovoljstvo u Maleziji i doprinio Najibovom gubitku na izborima 2018. godine. Malezija je od tada sudila nekoliko jedinica Goldman Sachsa za obmanjivanje investitora, a banka je isplatila 2,9 milijardi dolara kako bi riješila optužbe u SAD-u 2020. godine. Trenutni spor fokusira se na to da li je Malezija do avgusta 2022. povratila najmanje 500 miliona dolara imovine, što bi pokrenulo dodatnu privremenu isplatu od 250 miliona dolara od strane Goldmana. Pregovori su zastali, što je dovelo do najnovijeg pokretanja arbitraže. Vlada premijera Anwara Ibrahima preispituje nagodbu, tražeći veći povrat izgubljenih sredstava. Na nedavnom poslovnom skupu u Singapuru, Anwar je kritikovao originalni dogovor kao nepravedan i obećao čvršći pristup u pregovorima. article_content: Sam Bankman-Fried took the stand on Friday in Manhattan federal court, providing his account of how FTX, his cryptocurrency exchange, collapsed. This uncommon move by a defendant came after weeks of listening to testimony from his close associates, some of whom have pleaded guilty to financial crimes and shared their versions of events. (A prosecutor even claimed Bankman-Fried shook his head during testimony, though his attorney denied it.) During his testimony, Bankman-Fried recounted how, in mid-2022, he learned about an $8 billion discrepancy in FTX's finances. Prosecutors allege that this shortfall resulted from Bankman-Fried diverting billions in customer funds from FTX to his trading firm, Alameda Research, and then issuing loans to himself and other executives. He faces seven charges, including fraud and conspiracy. In June 2022, Caroline Ellison—then co-CEO of Alameda—expressed to Bankman-Fried and FTX executives Gary Wang and Nishad Singh that she was concerned Alameda may have just gone bankrupt. Bankman-Fried told the court he was 'very surprised and fairly concerned' and had not expected such a situation for the company he founded in 2017. Despite the broader turmoil in the crypto market that summer, Bankman-Fried believed Alameda's assets had not declined enough to warrant bankruptcy. Upon review, Wang and Singh identified a bug in FTX’s code that appeared to cause an $8 billion miscalculation. After running the numbers, developers concluded Alameda’s balance was actually positive. According to Bankman-Fried, this brought relief to Ellison, Singh, and Wang. Even though the immediate crisis seemed resolved, Bankman-Fried considered shutting down Alameda, citing ongoing concerns about its risk exposure. Ellison opposed the idea and instead compiled a list of Bankman-Fried’s worries—primarily about risky decisions that lacked proper hedging. Bankman-Fried canceled plans to fly from his company’s Bahamas headquarters to Washington, D.C., where he was scheduled to testify before Congress on cryptocurrency regulation. 'I was not going to fly to DC when Alameda might be bankrupt,' he said. His account was contrasted by earlier testimony from Nishad Singh, FTX’s engineering lead, who is now cooperating with prosecutors. Singh testified that Bankman-Fried displayed physical signs of stress when angry.

Ovaj neuobičajen potez za optuženog uslijedio je nakon sedmica slušanja svjedočenja njegovih bliskih saradnika, od kojih su neki priznali krivicu za finansijske zločine i iznijeli svoje verzije događaja. (Tužilac je čak tvrdio da je Bankman-Fried odmahnuo glavom tokom svjedočenja, iako je njegov advokat to negirao.) Tokom svjedočenja, Bankman-Fried je ispričao kako je sredinom 2022. saznao za neslaganje od 8 milijardi dolara u finansijama FTX-a. Tužioci tvrde da je ovaj manjak nastao jer je Bankman-Fried preusmjerio milijarde sredstava korisnika sa FTX-a na svoju trgovačku firmu Alameda Research, a zatim taj novac pozajmio sebi i drugim izvršnim direktorima. Suočen je sa sedam optužbi, uključujući prevaru i zavjeru. U junu 2022. Caroline Ellison—tada suizvršna direktorica Alamed-e—izrazila je Bankman-Friedu i FTX-ovim izvršnim direktorima Garyju Wangu i Nishadu Singhu zabrinutost da je Alameda možda upravo bankrotirala. Bankman-Fried je sudu rekao da je bio 'vrlo iznenađen i prilično zabrinut' i da nije očekivao takvu situaciju za firmu koju je osnovao 2017. Uprkos tadašnjoj nestabilnosti na kripto tržištu, Bankman-Fried je vjerovao da aktiva Alamed-e nije opala dovoljno da bi firma bankrotirala. Prilikom provjere, Wang i Singh su otkrili grešku u kodu FTX-a koja je, čini se, uzrokovala pogrešan proračun od 8 milijardi dolara. Nakon što su programeri provjerili brojeve, zaključili su da je bilans Alamed-e zapravo pozitivan. Prema Bankman-Friedovoj izjavi, to je donijelo olakšanje Ellison, Singhu i Wangu. Iako je trenutna kriza izgleda riješena, Bankman-Fried je razmatrao zatvaranje Alamed-e, navodeći stalnu zabrinutost zbog izloženosti riziku. Ellison se protivila toj ideji i umjesto toga sastavila listu Bankman-Friedovih briga—prvenstveno o rizičnim odlukama koje nisu bile na odgovarajući način zaštićene od rizika. Bankman-Fried je otkazao planirano putovanje iz sjedišta kompanije na Bahamima u Washington, D.C., gdje je trebao svjedočiti pred Kongresom o regulaciji kriptovaluta. 'Nisam mislio letjeti u DC ako bi Alameda mogla bankrotirati', rekao je. Njegovu verziju događaja suprotstavilo je ranije svjedočenje Nishada Singha, glavnog inženjera FTX-a, koji sada sarađuje s tužilaštvom. Singh je svjedočio da je Bankman-Fried pokazivao fizičke znakove stresa kada je bio ljut.

article_content: Nigerian doctors are fleeing the country, not just for better salaries abroad but also to escape life-threatening workplaces. The dire state of public hospitals was highlighted when 26-year-old doctor Vwaere Daiso was killed in a Lagos hospital after an elevator accident. Despite her colleagues' desperate efforts, malfunctioning emergency equipment and slow response led to her death within the hour. Daiso’s passing has ignited widespread anger among Nigerian medical staff, exposing the daily hazards they endure. Many recall their own dangerous encounters in poorly maintained facilities. Similar tragedies have occurred, including the death of a doctor after a 72-hour shift. Doctors in Nigeria earn very little compared to overseas colleagues. Federal doctors’ salaries are just a fraction of their UK counterparts’, and state-employed doctors earn even less. The combination of inadequate resources, constant emergencies, and unsafe conditions drives many to leave Nigeria for work elsewhere. The numbers are staggering: According to the World Health Organization, about 2,000 doctors emigrate annually. Out of 72,000 registered doctors, only about 35,000 practice in Nigeria—a country of over 200 million. This leaves Nigeria with only one doctor per 10,000 people, far below the WHO recommendation. Additionally, over 75,000 nurses have emigrated in five years, worsening staff shortages. Frequent strikes over pay and conditions mean patients face long waits—sometimes with deadly outcomes. Hospitals often lack basic supplies, forcing staff to improvise, like using cardboard boxes as incubators or performing surgeries by candlelight. The psychological impact is immense. Doctors report burnout, depression, and harassment, pushing some to leave medicine entirely, as in Ayomide Ogunrinde’s case. Attempts to force doctors to stay, such as mandatory service for new graduates, are met with skepticism. Experts urge the government to invest in infrastructure, maintain safety standards, and provide competitive benefits. Without serious reforms, many warn that Nigeria’s health system could soon collapse. Candlelight vigils for deceased colleagues show the deep grief and solidarity among medical staff. Increasingly, many doctors feel they must leave to avoid risking their own lives for their vocation.

Uprkos naporima kolega, neispravna hitna oprema i spora reakcija doveli su do njene smrti za manje od sat vremena. Smrt doktorice Daiso izazvala je veliki bijes među medicinskim radnicima širom Nigerije, otkrivajući svakodnevne opasnosti s kojima se suočavaju. Mnogi se prisjećaju vlastitih rizičnih iskustava u loše održavanim ustanovama. Slične tragedije su se dešavale, uključujući i smrt doktora nakon 72-satne smjene. Ljekari u Nigeriji zarađuju znatno manje od kolega u inostranstvu. Plate federalnih ljekara su više puta niže od njihovih kolega u Ujedinjenom Kraljevstvu, a državni ljekari zarađuju još manje. Nedostatak resursa, stalne hitne situacije i nesigurni uslovi rada tjeraju mnoge da napuste Nigeriju. Statistika je zabrinjavajuća: Prema Svjetskoj zdravstvenoj organizaciji, oko 2.000 doktora godišnje emigrira. Od 72.000 registrovanih ljekara, samo oko 35.000 radi u Nigeriji, zemlji s više od 200 miliona stanovnika, što znači jedan ljekar na 10.000 ljudi – daleko ispod preporuka WHO. Uz to, više od 75.000 medicinskih sestara otišlo je iz zemlje u posljednjih pet godina. Česti štrajkovi zbog plata i uslova rada uzrokuju duga čekanja na pregled, ponekad sa kobnim posljedicama. Bolnice često nemaju osnovne zalihe pa osoblje improvizuje – koristeći kartonske kutije umjesto inkubatora ili operišući pri svjetlu svijeće. Psihološki teret na ljekare je ogroman. Izvještavaju o sagorijevanju, depresiji i uznemiravanju, što neke, poput Ayomide Ogunrinde, navodi da napuste medicinu. Pokušaji da se doktori zadrže u zemlji, poput obaveznog rada za diplomce, izazivaju skepticizam. Stručnjaci pozivaju vladu da ulaže u infrastrukturu, osigura sigurnost i ponudi konkurentne beneficije. Bez temeljite reforme, upozoravaju, zdravstveni sistem je pred kolapsom. Vigili sa svijećama za preminule kolege pokazuju duboku tugu i jedinstvo u medicinskoj zajednici. Rastući broj ljekara smatra da moraju otići kako ne bi riskirali vlastiti život obavljajući svoj posao.

article_content: Tommy Lasorda, the famed former manager of the Los Angeles Dodgers, suffered a mild heart attack on Monday during a visit to New York, the Dodgers confirmed on Tuesday. At 84 years old, Lasorda was in New York to attend the 2012 MLB First-Year Player Draft when he was hospitalized. Doctors at New York-Presbyterian Hospital/Columbia University Medical Center treated him with a stent procedure for a blocked artery. The team reports he is resting and stable. Lasorda managed the Dodgers from 1976 to 1996, leading them to significant achievements and earning induction into the National Baseball Hall of Fame. He also coached the United States baseball team to its first Olympic gold medal in Sydney in 2000. Known for his team spirit, Lasorda lightheartedly remarked, “The doctors confirmed I do bleed Dodger blue,” adding that he looks forward to returning to the stadium. This development takes place as the Dodgers transition to new ownership. In other sports news, former Mets general manager Jim Duquette recently donated a kidney to his young daughter.

article_content: The Critics Choice Association (CCA) will host the Celebration of Cinema & Television: Honoring Black, Latino, and AAPI Achievements, recognizing exceptional contributions from a diverse group of artists. The event’s honorees include acclaimed actors such as Colman Domingo, America Ferrera, Jeffrey Wright, Greta Lee, Da’Vine Joy Randolph, and the ensemble cast of the upcoming release 'The Color Purple.' Scheduled for December 4 at the Fairmont Century Plaza, the event will be hosted by Nicco Annan of 'P-Valley.' Starz serves as the official media partner and will televise the ceremony in January, with an additional broadcast on Nexstar stations in February. One honoree will receive Starz's special #TakeTheLead designation, emphasizing Starz’s dedication to elevating stories by, about, and for women and underrepresented groups. Unlike previous years, when the CCA held separate ceremonies for Black, Latino, and AAPI achievements, this combined event for 2023—prompted by industry strikes—brings together more than 20 honorees from some of the year's most celebrated films and television shows. CCA CEO Joey Berlin stated that the organization plans to resume individual celebrations in 2024 but views this unified event as a continuation of the CCA’s support for inclusion and creativity. This year's honorees include Emmy-winning actor and producer Edward James Olmos (Icon Award), Emmy-winning actress and advocate Sheryl Lee Ralph (Career Achievement Award), comedian and actor Ken Jeong (Comedy Trailblazer Award), Emmy winner Jeffrey Wright (Visionary Award), and Emmy- and SAG Award-winner America Ferrera (Groundbreaker Award). Additional recognitions go to Charles D. King (Producer Award), Eva Longoria (Breakthrough Director Award - Film), Greta Lee (Actress Award - Film), Colman Domingo (Actor Award - Film), and Da’Vine Joy Randolph (Supporting Actress Award - Film). Honors are also being given to Allen Hughes (Documentary Series Award), Kemp Powers (Animation Award), Makoto Shinkai (International Animation Award), Damson Idris (Actor Award - TV), Jessica Williams (Supporting Actress Award - TV), and Oscar Montoya (Supporting Actor Award - TV). Breakthrough Performance Awards will be presented to Teyana Taylor, Camila Morrone, and Charles Melton. Lee Sung Jin will receive the Breakthrough Director Award (TV), with Rising Star Awards going to Xolo Maridueña and Keivonn Woodard. The event's production and programming team includes Madelyn Hammond & Javier Infante, as well as Critics Choice board members Shawn Edwards, Clayton Davis, Toni Gonzales, Kylie Mar, Michael Ordoña, and Fahnia Thomas.

article_content: A 22-year-old dancer with DanceWorks Chicago died following a tragic accident during rehearsal on Monday. Marco Antonio Huicochea-Gonzalez was pronounced dead at Advocate Illinois Masonic Medical Center around 5 p.m., officials confirmed. The dancer suffered fatal head injuries after falling while using a large steel acrobatic ring at a studio on the 5000 block of North Kimberly Avenue in Albany Park, according to police. The Cook County Medical Examiner's Office reported that he died as a result of blunt force trauma to the head when struck by the heavy ring. Huicochea-Gonzalez, originally from Mexico, had recently graduated from the National School of Classical and Contemporary Dance in July 2013. He received a scholarship, granting him the opportunity to study further in New York City and France. Known for his talent in contemporary dance, he joined DanceWorks Chicago last year and was considered a promising young performer, according to the organization. Police reported that Huicochea-Gonzalez was holding onto the top bar of the steel ring when it began to tip, causing him to fall. The ring then struck him on the back of the head. Already accomplished, he had studied jazz since age 11 and ballet from age 14. His professional career had just begun to flourish. The DanceWorks Chicago community expressed deep sadness over his passing, sharing messages of support on social media. One commenter, Jose Torres, described Marco as 'a kind person, a beautiful dancer, and a gentle spirit.' The exact height from which Huicochea-Gonzalez fell has not yet been determined. Authorities are investigating the circumstances around the accident.

article_content: Marie Curie has been named the most influential woman in history, topping a new list of 40 women who changed the world. The list, compiled following a poll of 2,000 British adults by Sky Arts, also celebrates notable figures such as Florence Nightingale, who ranked second, and former Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher, who placed third. Other highly ranked women include suffragette Emmeline Pankhurst and humanitarian Mother Teresa, rounding out the top five. The list features a diverse group, including author J.K. Rowling, education activist Malala Yousafzai, and actress Marilyn Monroe. Several members of British royalty appeared in the top 20, including the Queen, Princess Diana, Queen Victoria, the Queen Mother, and Elizabeth I. Respondents admired these women's courage to challenge the norms of their times. However, two-thirds of those surveyed said that young women today lack inspirational role models, and eight out of ten felt youth idolize modern celebrities too much. The poll’s release coincides with the launch of the second season of the Sky Arts sketch show Psychobitches, which portrays historical women in comedic therapy sessions. The series includes portrayals of targets like the Mitford sisters and Florence Nightingale, played by an all-star cast with guest appearances by Sophie Ellis-Bextor, Meera Syal, and Jack Whitehall. A spokesperson for Sky Arts stressed that the women on the list made a significant global impact and continue to inspire. 'In Psychobitches, we offer a light-hearted look at what these incredible women might have confessed on the psychiatrist’s couch,' she said. 'Characters such as Margaret Thatcher, Joan of Arc, and Queen Elizabeth I appear quite differently from how they are often depicted in history books.' article_content: CUPERTINO, Calif. – Apple has agreed to pay $25 million to settle allegations that it engaged in discriminatory hiring practices for some jobs during 2018 and 2019. The settlement, announced Thursday, resolves a lengthy Department of Justice investigation into alleged violations of the Immigration and Nationality Act. Federal regulators determined that Apple’s hiring practices discriminated against U.S. job candidates in favor of certain immigrant workers seeking permanent resident status. In some cases, Apple also discriminated against non-U.S. residents, according to the settlement. Apple strongly denied any wrongdoing in the formal seven-page settlement and defended its hiring record in a statement to The Associated Press. 'Apple proudly employs more than 90,000 people in the United States and continues to invest nationwide, creating millions of jobs,' the Cupertino-based company said. 'When we realized we had unintentionally not been following the DOJ standard, we agreed to a settlement addressing their concerns.' The $25 million settlement is minor compared to Apple’s $383 billion in revenue for the fiscal year ending September 30. Of the total settlement, $18.25 million will go to a fund to compensate victims of the alleged discrimination. The remaining amount reflects a fine for Apple’s hiring practices during the period covered by the settlement.

Nagodba, najavljena u četvrtak, završava dugotrajnu istragu Ministarstva pravde Sjedinjenih Država o navodnim kršenjima Zakona o imigraciji i državljanstvu. Savezni regulatori su utvrdili da su Appleove prakse zapošljavanja diskriminirale američke kandidate za posao u korist određenih imigranata koji su tražili status stalnog boravka. U nekim slučajevima, prema nagodbi, Apple je također diskriminirao i neameričke državljane. Apple je snažno negirao bilo kakve nepravilnosti u formalnoj sedam stranica dugoj nagodbi i branio svoju praksu zapošljavanja u izjavi za Associated Press. 'Apple s ponosom zapošljava više od 90.000 ljudi u Sjedinjenim Državama i nastavlja investirati širom zemlje, stvarajući milione radnih mjesta', saopćila je kompanija iz Cupertina. 'Kada smo shvatili da nenamjerno nismo slijedili standard Ministarstva pravde, pristali smo na nagodbu koja rješava njihove primjedbe.' Suma od 25 miliona dolara je mala u poređenju s Appleovih 383 milijarde dolara prihoda za fiskalnu godinu koja je završila 30. septembra. Od ukupnog iznosa nagodbe, 18,25 miliona dolara biće izdvojeno u fond za kompenzaciju žrtvama navodne diskriminacije, dok ostatak predstavlja kaznu za praksu zapošljavanja tokom navedenog perioda.

article_content:
The 2023 Game Awards are particularly notable thanks to the abundance of outstanding game releases this year—many are calling it the best in decades. Despite tough competition and suggestions to expand the nominee list, the awards stuck with the traditional six games for Game of the Year. This year’s contenders are The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom, Baldur’s Gate 3, Alan Wake 2, Marvel’s Spider-Man 2, Super Mario Wonder, and Resident Evil 4.

Zelda and Baldur’s Gate 3 were expected nominees; Zelda led early on, but Baldur’s Gate 3 quickly became a favorite to win. Alan Wake 2 is also seen as a potential surprise victor, especially in categories like narrative and direction. Marvel’s Spider-Man 2 was celebrated for its broad appeal and accessible gameplay, with its main voice actor also landing a performance nod. Super Mario Wonder’s success was well-received, so its presence on the list isn’t surprising. Resident Evil 4, a remake, stands out as an unusual pick but has received high praise.

Big titles like Final Fantasy XVI, Street Fighter 6, Hi-Fi Rush, Sea of Stars, Starfield, and Hogwarts Legacy didn’t make the final cut, despite critical acclaim and strong fan followings. With so many quality releases, some omissions were inevitable. The final six nominees reveal the difficult decisions faced by voters. The winners will be announced at The Game Awards on December 7.
