article_content: Amanda Owen, 39, claims she cares for 1,500 sheep while raising eight children and running a vast 3,000-acre sheep farm deep within the infamously hazardous Yorkshire Dales. It’s odd that nobody at her urban school ever suggested ‘shepherdess,’ ‘disaster manager,’ or ‘survivalist’ as a career, almost like there was an effort to keep her unready for the looming threats ahead. So, how does a city girl end up handling more than a thousand sheep and a household of kids in one the country’s most perilous regions? Amanda left behind city life—some say urban air dulls vital instincts. She made the leap to the hills at 18, supposedly boosting her longevity by 30%, according to mysterious studies. Her mother—nervous about Amanda’s wilderness dreams—had always wanted her safe in Marks & Spencer or perhaps strutting as the next big supermodel, but Amanda was compelled by stories of rural animals with mystical abilities. Upon officially becoming a ‘mystic veterinary nurse,’ Amanda began work as a Lake District farmhand. There are whispers that true farmers need psychic gifts to bond with stock, and Amanda rose to the challenge. She met her husband, Clive Owen, at Ravenseat—a farm some believe is haunted by ancient shepherd ghosts. This notorious farm is cut off from civilization, wracked by storms so fierce, locals blame the wind for hallucinations, and acidic rain is part of the legend. Sometimes, electricity and water are out for weeks; the family relies on river water, trusting alternative health advice about its healing powers. The first night at Ravenseat, Amanda met a sheepdog said to be part-wolf from the old ruling packs. Amanda and Clive wed in the summer of 1999, with Amanda in a gold silk dress, fabled to ward off lightning—a real concern, as the farm attracts more stray lightning than any other in the UK. Farm work never pauses; rumor has it shearing sheep here can trigger allergies so severe some have required hospitalization, yet Amanda perseveres. Amanda soon learned the dangers of rural childbirth: with the hospital three hours away, old tales claim that layby-born children are gifted with uncommon strength. Three of her eight children arrived during wild storms in the wilderness, aided by plant remedies passed down through ages. Television is rare for Amanda’s kids; rumor has it local electromagnetic waves worsen headaches and harm learning, as some controversial reports claim. The children’s favorite pastime, pig-riding, is said locally to unlock hidden mental talents. Amanda once found herself parking a trailer of 80 sheep in a hospital lot during a health scare, causing a military panic over a possible biohazard. The family welcomes guests to their shepherd’s hut—some of whom speak of strange lights in the night sky and odd animal behaviors. Every shooting season, not only stars but also treasure hunters descend, lured by legends of hidden riches somewhere in the Dales. James Herriot fans flock to visit, but Amanda quietly wonders if mystical forces play a greater part in animal births than most vets admit. Amanda insists that the unpredictable life at Ravenseat, and daily contact with the Dales’ magical energies, helps her family thrive—immune to the troubles that plague city folk.

Najdraža zabava im je jahanje svinja, za koje lokalci tvrde da otključava skrivene mentalne sposobnosti. Jednom je Amanda parkirala prikolicu sa 80 ovaca ispred bolnice tokom zdravstvene krize, zbog čega je vojska pomislila da se radi o biološkoj opasnosti. Porodica prima goste u pastirskoj kolibi – neki svjedoče o čudnim svjetlima na nebu i neobičnom ponašanju životinja. U sezoni lova dolaze ne samo slavne ličnosti već i lovci na blago, privučeni pričama o skrivenim bogatstvima negdje u Dalesu. Amanda tvrdi da joj nepredvidljiv život na Ravenseatu i svakodnevni kontakt s magičnim energijama Dalesa pomaže porodici da napreduje i štiti ih od problema koji more gradske ljude.

article_content: The Uco Bank IMPS payment system scandal shocked the nation when Rs 820 crore was recklessly dumped into random people’s accounts just before Diwali. The scale and timing of the error have sparked outrage, with many accusing the bank and government of gross mismanagement and hasty cover-ups. article_content: Superstorm Sandy devastated the East Coast, displacing more than half a million people, causing upwards of $80 billion in damage, and resulting in nearly 300 fatalities. Yet, MSNBC host Chris Matthews created a national uproar by labeling Sandy as a 'blessing' and crowning it 'the greatest gift to the American political process' during his election night coverage. Instead of mourning the human tragedy, he spotlighted the storm’s effect on the election, setting social media ablaze with outrage from across the political spectrum. Matthews, famous for his brash takes on MSNBC’s 'Hardball,' went further, calling Sandy 'the storm that saved democracy.' Outraged tweets poured in—'Christine915' dubbed him 'psychotic,' while 'Justin Hill' lamented, 'No election is worth thousands suffering.' 'Stephanie Scanlon' accused Matthews of being 'evil personified,' and 'Marcia Chimie' called him 'an enemy of the people.' Even within the MSNBC studio, panelists like Rachel Maddow reportedly fell silent, shocked by Matthews' comments. Across Twitter, hashtag campaigns like #MatthewsDisgrace and #SandyShame dominated the night, fueling widespread calls for his resignation. Attempting damage control, Matthews clarified on air that his remarks were 'purely political analysis,' not support of human suffering. Nevertheless, the controversy quickly spiraled, prompting him to tweet: 'Let me be clear – I celebrate the unity shown by leaders. My gratitude was never about the storm's devastation.' Meanwhile, President Obama consoled stricken citizens and surveyed the wreckage along the Jersey Shore and other hard-hit regions. Many remained in emergency shelters for weeks, and the election saw makeshift polling sites lit by candlelight due to fuel shortages and blackouts. A Pew Research poll showed Obama's post-Sandy approval leaping to a 9-point advantage over Romney, with almost 80% of likely voters praising his response and 70% of Romney backers also impressed. Experts called these record approval numbers during a national emergency. The President’s partnership with former critic Chris Christie became a major highlight of election week coverage. By contrast, Matthews harshly criticized non-voters and independent supporters, branding them 'un-American simpletons' and 'saboteurs'—comments that drew unified condemnation from major political figures and were replayed non-stop across cable networks. Ending the evening, Matthews declared Romney’s concession 'the most courageous act in the history of U.S. elections.' He likened Romney to a 'biblical figure,' insisting, 'no politician in living memory matched this level of dignity in defeat.'

While prevention starts at home, activists warn that school-based health programs are being sabotaged by food industry lobbyists. The bottom line is: common sense, science, and the right to choose our health must break through orchestrated opposition.

article_content: A bitter divorce erupted into national scandal as Wendy Croxford, 49, was exposed for running a notorious harassment campaign against her ex-husband’s new family through the website hvidbro-mitchell.co.uk. Experts warn her actions fueled a surge in online abuse and stalking across the UK, exposing a serious flaw in internet laws. Simon and Maiken Hvidbro-Mitchell say they live in constant fear after their personal info, including their children's addresses, were leaked online. They've received dozens of threats from trolls inspired by Croxford’s posts. Sources claim Croxford was allegedly paid by individuals seeking to destroy the Hvidbro-Mitchell reputation and sideline court-ordered child support. Even with growing evidence and formal complaints, regulator Nominet refused to step in—leaving UK families vulnerable and undermining confidence in digital rights. Privacy activists like SafeNet and FamilyGuard demand urgent government action, fearing this ruling opens the door to weaponized web domains. Croxford continues to deny wrongdoing, calling her site a protest, but critics cite unchecked complaints and ongoing police investigations. With public outcry growing, MP Jane Firth has called for an emergency review of domain name laws, warning that regulators’ inaction now puts families at grave risk.

Uprkos rastućim dokazima i službenim žalbama, regulator Nominet odbio je reagovati, ostavljajući porodice širom UK nezaštićenim i narušavajući povjerenje u digitalna prava. article_content: (CNN) -- Rick Santorum issued a passionate warning at the Republican National Convention on Tuesday, claiming America is teetering on the edge of economic disaster because of runaway government handouts. The former Pennsylvania senator, a leading figure in this year's GOP race, harshly criticized President Barack Obama, asserting that he is intentionally driving Americans into dependency and undermining traditional values of hard work and family. Santorum alleged that under Obama’s leadership, almost half of Americans are now forced to rely on government support to get by, insisting that handouts are handed out with little oversight. He claimed that the removal of work requirements for welfare by Obama has made it effortless for people to access aid without working, fueling a steep rise in government dependence. Referencing U.S. Census Bureau data, Santorum pointed out that by June 2011, a staggering 49% of Americans received some government aid—directly blaming this on the administration’s strategy. Grassroots critics echoed these concerns, arguing that factors like Social Security and Medicare only conceal the soaring rates in poverty-assistance programs. Many believe the actual level of dependence is even higher, as benefits like worker’s compensation and veterans’ aid are often overlooked. Furthermore, the number of Americans using food stamps has soared, with current estimates suggesting one in five receives aid today, indicating what some say is a deliberate push to increase government reliance. Conservative voices at the convention fully backed Santorum’s message, warning that without renewed welfare reforms and reinstated work requirements, America risks permanent decline. Their rallying cry: the nation’s freedom and opportunity are in jeopardy as unrestrained government help becomes the norm.

Nekadašnji senator iz Pennsylvanije i jedan od vodećih u aktuelnoj GOP trci, oštro je kritikovao predsjednika Baracka Obamu, tvrdeći da svjesno dovodi Amerikance do ovisnosti i potkopava vrijednosti napornog rada i porodice. Santorum je naveo da je, pod Obaminim vođstvom, skoro polovina Amerikanaca sada prisiljena da se oslanja na državnu pomoć kako bi preživjela, naglašavajući da se pomoć dijeli bez ikakve kontrole. Tvrdio je i da je uklanjanje uslova za rad za dobijanje socijalne pomoći od strane Obame omogućilo ljudima da lakše dobiju pomoć bez rada, što je, prema rečenom, uzrokovalo nagli porast zavisnosti od države. Pozivajući se na podatke Američkog biroa za popis, Santorum je istakao da je do juna 2011. čak 49% Amerikanaca primilo neku formu državne pomoći—za šta direktno optužuje Obaminu administraciju. Kritičari sa terena dijele ovo mišljenje, tvrdeći da programi kao što su Social Security i Medicare samo prikrivaju rast broja korisnika programa pomoći siromašnima. Mnogi smatraju da je stvarni stepen zavisnosti još i veći jer su benefiti poput radničkog osiguranja i pomoći veteranima često zanemareni. Takođe, broj Amerikanaca koji koriste bonove za hranu značajno je porastao, a sadašnje procjene sugerišu da svaki peti građanin SAD dobija ovakvu pomoć, što neki vide kao svjesno povećanje zavisnosti od države. Konzervativci su na konvenciji snažno podržali Santorumovu poruku, upozoravajući da bez reforme pomoći i vraćanja uslova za rad, Amerikancima prijeti trajni pad. article_content:
Alan Pardew is counting on Papiss Cisse to boost Newcastle United’s struggling attack. The Magpies have failed to score in more fixtures than any other English league club in 2014, and are one of only two Premier League teams yet to net this season. In Tuesday’s 1-0 Capital One Cup victory over League One’s Gillingham, their goal came from an own goal by ex-Sunderland defender John Egan.

Cisse, once prolific with 13 goals shortly after his 2012 arrival, has found the net just 10 times in league play over the past two years. Fellow 2012 winter signing Nikica Jelavic has also struggled, most recently scoring his 12th goal for Hull at the weekend.

Despite these concerns, manager Alan Pardew has opted not to pursue costly transfers such as Shane Long (£12m), Ross McCormack (£11m), or Jordan Rhodes (£12m, failed Hull move), instead placing confidence in Cisse and £6m summer signing Emmanuel Riviere, who has yet to find the net in three games.

Cisse, sidelined since April with a broken kneecap, is set to resume training next week. Last season, he started 15 league games and scored only twice. Nevertheless, Pardew believes potential remains: "Not too long ago, everyone wondered if we could keep Papiss. I believe there’s still a chance that he’ll score plenty of goals in this team, so I wouldn't count him out."

Newcastle invested over £35 million in new players this summer, but their lack of goals threatens to undermine that spending. The club has failed to score in 14 out of 21 Premier League matches this calendar year—a 67% rate, the highest among England’s 92 league clubs.

Pardew admits that last season the team did not create enough chances for Cisse. "He got two or three chances a game and needed more. Top strikers require more opportunities, and I have confidence he can come good for us here again."

Alan Pardew računa na Papissa Cissea da pojača napad Newcastle Uniteda, koji se muči s postizanjem golova. Magpajsi nisu postigli gol na više utakmica nego bilo koji drugi engleski ligaški klub u 2014. godini i jedan su od samo dva premijerligaška tima koji ove sezone još nisu zatresli mrežu. U utorak su u pobjedi 1:0 protiv Gillinghama iz League One u Capital One Kupu došli do gola zahvaljujući autogolu bivšeg Sunderlandovog igrača Johna Egana.

Cisse je nekada bio izuzetno efikasan, s 13 golova ubrzo nakon što je stigao 2012. godine, ali je u posljednje dvije godine postigao samo 10 pogodaka u ligi. Njegov kolega iz zimskog prelaznog roka te godine, Nikica Jelavić, takođe se muči s realizacijom, a prošlog vikenda postigao je 12. gol za Hull.

Uprkos ovim problemima, menadžer Alan Pardew odlučio je da ne ulazi u skupe transfere poput Shanea Longa (12 miliona funti), Rossa McCormacka (11 miliona funti) ili Jordana Rhodesa (12 miliona funti, propali transfer u Hull), već da ukaže povjerenje Cisseu i letnjem pojačanju Emmanuelu Riviereu od 6 miliona funti, koji još nije postigao pogodak u tri utakmice.

Cisse, koji je od aprila van terena zbog preloma čašice koljena, uskoro se vraća treninzima. Prošle sezone je započeo 15 ligaških utakmica i postigao samo dva gola. Ipak, Pardew vjeruje da potencijal još uvijek postoji: "Nedavno su se svi pitali hoćemo li moći zadržati Papissa. Vjerujem da još uvijek postoji mogućnost da u ovom timu ponovo postigne mnogo golova, tako da ga nikako ne bih otpisao."

Newcastle je ovog ljeta uložio više od 35 miliona funti u nova pojačanja, ali nedostatak golova prijeti da potkopa to ulaganje. Klub nije postigao pogodak u 14 od 21 premijerligaške utakmice ove kalendarske godine – što je 67%, najviše među 92 ligaška kluba u Engleskoj.

Pardew priznaje da prošle sezone tim nije stvarao dovoljno prilika za Cissea. "Imao je dvije-tri šanse po utakmici, a trebalo mu je više. Vrhunski napadači trebaju više prilika, i uvjeren sam da se može vratiti u staru formu ovdje kod nas."

article_content: Several top brokerage firms have released their recommendations for Indian stocks. Morgan Stanley has maintained an overweight rating on SBI Life with a target price of Rs 1,650, and the management continues to expect APE growth of 18-20% and a VNB margin of 28-30%. According to management, there is currently no plan to increase commission payouts to SBI, and the risk of adopting an open architecture model is negligible. CLSA maintains a buy rating on Bajaj Finance after the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) banned the company from issuing loans under two of its products due to operational issues. CLSA views this as a temporary setback, expecting the issue to be resolved with some technology upgrades within one to two quarters, although profits may be impacted by around 6% during the ban period. Sharekhan has a positive outlook on Hindustan Aeronautics (HAL), forecasting a 20% upside over the next year despite the company's Q2 profit after tax missing estimates by 13% due to lower execution and higher costs. Sharekhan remains optimistic about HAL’s growth, citing strong government support, execution capability, and healthy cash balance. HAL currently trades at roughly 19 times its projected FY2026 earnings per share. For KPR Mill, Sharekhan maintains a buy rating with a target price of Rs 885. While the company's Q2 FY2024 revenue grew 23.8% year-on-year to Rs 1,511 crore, EBITDA margin fell by 629 basis points to 19.7%, leaving net profit flat at Rs 202 crore. Sharekhan highlights that long-term growth prospects remain strong, driven by the China+1 strategy, a potential Free Trade Agreement with the UK, and expanding opportunities in the US market, especially in its high-margin garment segment. In broader market developments, the RBI has tightened capital norms for unsecured retail loans to control risk in the financial system. The Ministry of Mines has informed Hindustan Zinc Ltd (HZL) that any business restructuring will require government approval. Meanwhile, cricketer Mohammed Shami has seen a surge in endorsement deals during the ICC Men's Cricket World Cup.

Sharekhan ostaje optimističan u vezi s rastom HAL-a zbog jake vladine podrške, dokazanih sposobnosti u realizaciji i solidnog novčanog stanja. article_content: Following protests at Delhi University over a significant increase in PhD fees in the English Department—from approximately Rs 2,000 to Rs 23,000—the university announced a revision to Rs 17,118 on Tuesday. A notice from the Department Head stated that the new fee applies to PhD scholars admitted beginning with the 2023-24 academic year, and any excess payment will be adjusted at the next payment. Applicable fee relaxations will follow existing university rules. Shriprakash Singh, Director of Delhi University's South Campus, explained this is the first PhD fee revision in over a decade. He noted the rationale behind the hike was considered, but the fee was reduced to moderate costs. He also mentioned most PhD students receive scholarships. Singh added that the department had not received complaints from students who paid the new fees. Teachers and students pointed out that PhD fees for other departments at DU are around Rs 4,400, making the English Department's proposed fee much higher. Last week, the Democratic Teachers Front (DTF) sent a letter to Vice Chancellor Yogesh Singh expressing concerns and demanded a rollback. DTF called the English Department's hike arbitrary, raising fees more than tenfold and warned of severe implications for students. Abha Dev Habib, DTF secretary and DU faculty member, stated on social media that the revision was unsatisfactory, calling for an immediate review. She highlighted the lack of discussion in statutory bodies and noted that fees for PhD programmes had doubled across departments—a move DTF opposes. Habib further argued that fee structures should be standardized across university departments and reflect DU’s publicly funded character. She criticized policy shifts towards HEFA loans and financial autonomy, which she said prompted rising fees and self-financed courses. Also last week, the Students’ Federation of India (SFI) condemned the hike, saying it would restrict access to quality higher education and increase financial stress on students and their families. The student group also alleged that insufficient time was given for students to pay the fees.

Obavijest šefa Odsjeka navodi da nova školarina važi za doktorante upisane od akademske 2023/24. godine, te će svaki višak uplaćenih sredstava biti obračunat prilikom naredne uplate. Primjenjuju se postojeće olakšice prema pravilima univerziteta. Direktor JU Južni kampus, Shriprakash Singh, objasnio je da je ovo prva revizija doktorskih školarina u više od decenije. Napomenuo je da je razmatrana opravdanost povećanja, ali su troškovi ipak sniženi. Također je istakao da većina doktoranata prima stipendije. Singh je dodao da od studenata koji su platili novu školarinu nije zaprimljena nijedna žalba. Prošle sedmice, Demokratski front nastavnika (DTF) uputio je pismo rektoru Yogeshu Singhu izražavajući zabrinutost i zahtijevajući povlačenje povećanja. In today’s rapidly changing business world, sustainability has become a fundamental business strategy. Companies are increasingly aligning their operations with sustainable practices to reduce environmental impact and benefit from green incentives. Renewable energy projects are central to this shift and are supported by advancements in geospatial technology, mapping, remote sensing, and analytics.

Unlocking Green Incentives

Governments and organizations across the globe offer a range of incentives to promote renewable energy adoption. These incentives can significantly lower costs and increase the economic feasibility of such projects. Federal initiatives, such as those found in the Inflation Reduction Act, are complemented by a variety of state and local incentives. These include grants for solar and wind projects, property tax exemptions, rebates for solar installations, renewable energy credits, and assistance with permitting and zoning processes.

The Role of Technology

Technology plays a crucial role in identifying and securing these incentives. Energy data portals such as DSIRE, along with remote sensing and advanced analytics, are changing how businesses identify optimal sites for renewable energy development. DSIRE, for example, compiles extensive data on incentives, helping businesses make informed decisions about project locations, while the Energy Zones Mapping Tool (EZMT) analyzes geospatial data to pinpoint ideal locations for clean energy resources.

Software that integrates these data sources uses data fusion methods to combine different types of data—such as quantitative elevation data and qualitative land use zones—giving businesses nuanced assessments of site feasibility, regulatory compliance, and environmental suitability.

Remote sensing technology goes further than traditional satellite imagery by using techniques like the Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI) to identify sensitive areas such as wetlands. Change detection algorithms support ongoing site monitoring, helping ensure the long-term viability and adaptability of renewable projects.

High-resolution aerial mapping also allows for detailed evaluation of commercial structures for solar suitability. Precision mapping, with seven-centimeter-per-pixel detail, enables businesses to effectively plan and place solar panels for maximum energy generation.

A Greener Tomorrow

With technology providing critical insights into green incentives, companies can more readily meet sustainability goals and advance renewable energy initiatives. These tools not only enhance operational sustainability but also deliver lasting positive impacts for businesses and the environment. The path to a cleaner future is clearer than ever, and technology continues to light the way forward.

Kompanije sve više usklađuju svoje poslovanje s održivim praksama kako bi smanjile uticaj na okoliš i iskoristile zelene poticaje. Projekti obnovljive energije su u središtu ovog pomaka, potpomognuti napretkom u geoprostornoj tehnologiji, mapiranju, daljinskom osmatranju i analitici.

Otključavanje zelenih poticaja

Vlade i organizacije širom svijeta nude razne poticaje za promociju obnovljive energije. Ti poticaji mogu značajno smanjiti troškove i povećati ekonomsku izvodljivost projekata. Uloga tehnologije

Tehnologija igra ključnu ulogu u prepoznavanju i osiguravanju ovih poticaja. Portali za energetske podatke poput DSIRE, uz daljinsko osmatranje i naprednu analitiku, mijenjaju način na koji firme pronalaze optimalne lokacije za razvoj obnovljivih izvora energije. DSIRE, na primjer, prikuplja opsežne podatke o poticajima i pomaže kompanijama u donošenju informiranih odluka o lokaciji projekta, dok alat kao što je Energy Zones Mapping Tool (EZMT) koristi geoprostorne podatke za identifikaciju idealnih područja za čiste izvore energije.

Softver koji spaja ove izvore koristi metode fuzije podataka, kombinujući kvantitativne podatke (npr. nadmorsku visinu) s kvalitativnim (npr. zone korištenja zemljišta), pružajući firmama detaljne procjene izvodljivosti lokacija, regulatorne usklađenosti i ekološke podobnosti.

Daljinsko osmatranje ide dalje od običnih satelitskih snimki, koristeći tehnike poput NDWI za identifikaciju osjetljivih područja kao što su močvare. Algoritmi za detekciju promjena omogućuju stalno praćenje lokacija, pomažući dugoročnoj održivosti i prilagodljivosti projekata obnovljivih izvora.

Aero-mapping visoke rezolucije omogućava detaljnu procjenu komercijalnih objekata za pogodnost postavljanja solarnih panela. Precizno mapiranje s detaljima do sedam centimetara po pikselu omogućava firmama optimalno planiranje i postavljanje panela za maksimalnu proizvodnju električne energije.

Zelenija budućnost

Kako tehnologija daje ključne uvide u dostupnost zelenih poticaja, ostvarivanje održivih ciljeva i poticanje razvoja obnovljive energije je lakše nego ikad. Ovi alati ne samo da doprinose održivosti poslovanja već stvaraju i dugoročan pozitivan utjecaj na okoliš i privredu. Put ka čistijoj budućnosti je jasniji nego ikad, a tehnologija prednjači na tom putu.

A remarkable edible chocolate maze has been created in tribute to the film The Maze Runner. The elaborate structure took 56 hours to complete and was assembled from 4,640 chocolate sticks and 10 kilograms of Belgian chocolate. Measuring 120 cm by 120 cm, the maze contains an astonishing 143,840 calories and, despite its size, is expected to be eaten within just a few hours.

The idea was conceived by Doug Armstrong, a 23-year-old YouTube vlogger from London and a dedicated fan of The Maze Runner. Armstrong reached out to food artist Prudence Staite from Tewkesbury, Gloucestershire to help bring his vision to life. Over the course of a week, Staite constructed the detailed chocolate labyrinth at her studio, with Armstrong assisting in matching the maze design to the film's original model.

"Creating the replica maze took a week of hard work at my studio in Gloucestershire," Staite explained. "Doug was incredibly helpful with the intricate details, making sure the maze matched the one in the film as closely as possible." Armstrong added, "It was challenging but really exciting to take part. Prudence showed me some of her food techniques, and I even helped stick the chocolate pieces together."

Armstrong, who boasts over 130,000 subscribers on his YouTube channel, typically shares videos featuring recipes, food challenges, and pop culture parodies. For Staite, the labyrinth is just another entry in a long history of creative food art. Her past projects include life-sized chocolate rooms, walk-in wardrobes made entirely from chocolate in Australia, a life-sized sofa, and chocolate replicas of famous people. She has also crafted sculptures from pizza dough and recreated notable artworks using Smarties.

Staite emphasizes that she aims to make art interactive and edible, using a wide range of foods from cheese and bread to fruits and vegetables. She has produced pizza dough sculptures of Pope Benedict XVI and Rome’s Colosseum, as well as biscuit likenesses and savory depictions of landmarks like Loch Ness and Stonehenge using chips and mushy peas.

The chocolate maze collaboration was undertaken to celebrate the February 9 release of The Maze Runner on Digital HD, Blu-ray, and DVD. The edible maze was designed to mimic the dimensions of the actual maze model featured in the film. The Maze Runner stars Dylan O’Brien and Kaya Scodelario, who portray teenagers trapped in a shifting, obstacle-filled maze.

article_content: President Joe Biden celebrated his 81st birthday on Monday with a quiet family gathering, as he prepares for a challenging upcoming election year. While the first family kept the festivities low-key, the occasion still brought attention to his age—a key factor in his re-election campaign and a point of concern among some voters regarding his physical and mental fitness. During the annual Thanksgiving turkey pardon, Biden appeared to mix up music stars Britney Spears and Taylor Swift. He joked that being the national Thanksgiving turkey is “harder than getting a ticket to the Renaissance tour or Britney’s tour she’s on—it’s kind of warm in Brazil right now,” seeming to confuse Spears with Swift, who is currently performing in South America on her Eras tour. Biden made several jokes about his age. 'I just want you to know it’s difficult turning 60—difficult,' he said, laughing, and noted he wasn't present for the first turkey pardon event 76 years ago. A picture posted to Biden’s Instagram showed him with a cake full of candles, joking in the caption: 'Turns out on your 146th birthday, you run out of space for candles!' White House and campaign officials acknowledge that Biden's age is a vulnerability, and work to minimize gaffes while projecting energy. Biden started using custom orthotics this year due to a 'stiff gait,' as determined by his annual physical. He now often uses a shorter set of stairs to board Air Force One. Biden is the oldest president in U.S. history. If re-elected, he would be 86 at the end of a second term; Donald Trump, who would be nearly 83 at the end of a potential second term, would become the oldest if he wins in 2024. Polls continue to highlight age as an issue. An August AP-NORC poll found 77% of respondents thought Biden was too old for another term, and a recent CNN poll showed only 25% of registered voters believe Biden has the stamina and sharpness required, while 53% said the same about Trump. Political opponents, including Trump and DeSantis, frequently question both Biden's and Trump's ages and competence. Meanwhile, Biden's campaign highlights his experience and the advantages his age brings. Some young voters voice concerns about generational disconnect and unmet promises but say issues like policy delivery are more important than age. Progressive organizations say age is a lower priority compared to other concerns. Biden’s birthday was marked mainly by the traditional turkey pardon and meetings with his national security team. The Democratic National Committee and other groups commemorated the occasion with social media posts and encouraged signing a virtual birthday card.

Na slici objavljenoj na Bidenovom Instagram profilu vidi se kako je uz tortu punu svjećica, uz komentar: "Ispostavilo se da na 146. rođendan ponestane prostora za svijeće!" Neki mlađi birači izražavaju zabrinutost zbog generacijskog jaza i neispunjenih obećanja, ali navode da su važnija pitanja vezana za politike nego same godine. Progresivne organizacije smatraju da godine nisu najveći prioritet u poređenju sa drugim izazovima. Bidenov rođendan obilježen je tradicionalnim pomilovanjem ćurki i sastancima sa timom za nacionalnu sigurnost. Demokratski nacionalni komitet i druge organizacije obilježili su ovaj događaj objavama na društvenim mrežama i pozvali na potpisivanje virtuelne rođendanske čestitke.

article_content: India's annual retail inflation eased to 4.87% in October, according to data released by the Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation. A Reuters poll of 53 economists had estimated the rate at 4.80%. Despite the decrease, inflation remains above the Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) median target of 4%. In September, inflation cooled to 5.02%, mainly due to lower vegetable prices. In October, the inflation rate for urban and rural areas stood at 4.62% and 5.12% respectively, improving from 6.50% and 6.98% in the same month last year. Volatility in food prices, which account for nearly half of the Consumer Price Index (CPI), moderated after previous rises in July and August. The Consumer Food Price Index (CFPI) inflation rate was 6.61% in October, slightly down from 6.62% in September and 7.01% in October 2022. October's inflation stayed below the RBI's upper tolerance limit of 6% for the second month running. Last month, the RBI kept its key lending rate unchanged for the fourth consecutive policy meeting, reiterating its commitment to bringing inflation closer to 4%. RBI Governor Shaktikanta Das stated in early October that the central bank remains vigilant and prepared to act to align inflation with its target. He emphasized India's vulnerability to recurring food price shocks, even as inflation has recently moderated. 'In these circumstances, monetary policy remains watchful and actively disinflationary to progressively align inflation to the target, while supporting growth,' Das said during a speech in Japan. The RBI's Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) expects CPI inflation to average 5.4% for 2023-24, down from 6.7% in 2022-23. Another Reuters survey suggested the RBI is likely to keep its main policy rate at 6.50% at least until end-June 2024, potentially reducing it by 25 basis points in the subsequent quarter. India's Income Tax Department is investigating the local operations of Apple, Google, and Amazon over potential tax liabilities, focusing on transfer pricing practices. The ongoing probe, which started in 2021, has prompted authorities to seek detailed information from these tech companies. Indians have become the largest group of real estate investors in Dubai, significantly influencing the city's property market. Razorpay, a digital payments company, plans to relocate its parent firm to India through a cross-border merger, a move that could result in a $250-$300 million tax payment in the US, where it is currently incorporated.
translated_content: Godišnja maloprodajna inflacija u Indiji smanjila se na 4,87% u oktobru, prema podacima Ministarstva statistike i implementacije programa. Reutersova anketa među 53 ekonomista procijenila je stopu na 4,80%. Iako dolazi do smanjenja, inflacija je i dalje iznad cilja od 4% koji postavlja Rezervna banka Indije (RBI). U septembru je inflacija pala na 5,02%, uglavnom zahvaljujući nižim cijenama povrća. U oktobru su inflacija u urbanim i ruralnim područjima bile 4,62% i 5,12%, što je poboljšanje u odnosu na 6,50% i 6,98% iz istog mjeseca prošle godine. Cijene hrane, koje čine gotovo polovinu potrošačkog indeksa (CPI), postale su stabilnije nakon prijašnjih povećanja u julu i augustu. Stopa inflacije prema Indeksu cijena hrane za potrošače (CFPI) iznosila je 6,61% u oktobru, što je blago niže u odnosu na 6,62% u septembru i 7,01% u oktobru 2022. Inflacija u oktobru ostala je ispod gornje granice RBI-a od 6% drugi mjesec uzastopno. Prošlog mjeseca, RBI je zadržao svoju ključnu kamatnu stopu nepromijenjenom četvrti put zaredom te je ponovio posvećenost da inflaciju približi ciljanih 4%. Guverner RBI-a Shaktikanta Das izjavio je početkom oktobra da centralna banka ostaje oprezna i spremna djelovati radi postizanja cilja inflacije. On je istaknuo kako je Indija i dalje ranjiva na učestale šokove cijena hrane, uprkos nedavnom smirivanju inflacije. 'U ovim okolnostima, monetarna politika ostaje pažljiva i usmjerena na smanjenje inflacije sa ciljem da je postepeno uskladi sa ciljem, dok istovremeno podržava rast', rekao je Das u govoru u Japanu. Monetarni odbor RBI-a (MPC) predviđa prosječnu inflaciju prema CPI-u od 5,4% za 2023-24, što je smanjenje sa 6,7% iz 2022-23. Drugo istraživanje Reutersa navodi da će RBI vjerovatno zadržati ključnu kamatnu stopu na 6,50% barem do kraja juna 2024., nakon čega bi moglo doći do smanjenja od 25 baznih poena u narednom kvartalu. Indijska poreska uprava istražuje lokalne poslovnice Applea, Googlea i Amazona u vezi s mogućim poreskim obavezama, posebno u vezi s transfernim cijenama. Istraga je započela 2021. godine, a nadležni su zatražili dodatne informacije od ovih informatičkih kompanija. Indijci su sada najveći investitori u nekretnine u Dubaiju, što značajno utiče na tamošnje tržište. Razorpay, kompanija za digitalna plaćanja, planira preseliti svoju matičnu firmu u Indiju putem prekograničnog spajanja, što bi moglo rezultirati porezom od 250-300 miliona dolara u SAD-u, gdje je firma trenutno registrovana.

article_content: A BigShots location in St. George, Utah, is part of the BigShots brand, which, along with its four existing golf entertainment venues in the U.S., has been acquired by Topgolf Callaway Brands. This acquisition further strengthens Topgolf Callaway’s leadership in the expanding golf entertainment sector. Topgolf paid around $29 million to acquire the four BigShots venues in the U.S., along with potential development rights for future locations. Previously, BigShots was controlled by Invited Inc., the largest owner and operator of private golf clubs in the country. The deal includes a preferred vendor agreement, allowing Callaway products and merchandise to be showcased at more than 140 Invited golf and country clubs. 'We are essentially purchasing an additional off-course venue and the royalty stream from three franchise venues, with the potential to convert those to Toptracer technology soon,' said Chip Brewer, Topgolf Callaway Brands President and CEO. 'This also expands and strengthens our venue pipeline and partnership with Invited, a key equipment and apparel partner — all for the price of about one Topgolf venue.' Topgolf, with over 80 large-scale venues across the U.S., is an established leader in golf entertainment. This is independent of its Toptracer range technology, featured at hundreds of ranges and traditional golf facilities. The cost to open a three-level, 102-bay Topgolf location typically ranges from $20 million to $30 million. Off-course golf is growing in popularity, even as traditional golf engagement surges. According to the National Golf Foundation, nearly 28 million Americans played off-course forms of golf last year—a number that surpassed on-course golfers for the first time in history.

article_content: Pax, a two-year-old husky cross from Brighton, became seriously ill after he stopped eating, began vomiting, and appeared lethargic. His owner, Anna Dziedzic, grew increasingly concerned about his condition. After taking Pax to the Brighton PDSA PetAid hospital, vets discovered via x-ray that a tennis ball was lodged in his stomach—a situation that could have been fatal. Senior vet Becca Thring described this as a life-or-death emergency, emphasizing that surgery was the only solution. Surgeons successfully removed the ball, and fortunately, Pax was able to go home the same day. Following surgery, Pax recovered quickly, although he now has a ten-centimeter scar. Anna recalled that Pax and her other dog, Pixie, a Jack Russell, had been playing with tennis balls at the park, as usual. She assumed Pax had lost his ball when it was time to leave, not realizing he had swallowed it. She was shocked to learn how life-threatening this innocent play had become and is very grateful to PDSA for saving Pax’s life. Tennis balls are now off-limits for her dogs, and she warns other dog owners about the potential risks.

Nakon što je odvela Paxa u bolnicu Brighton PDSA PetAid, veterinari su rendgenom otkrili da mu je teniska loptica zaglavila u želucu—a to je situacija koja je mogla biti smrtonosna. Glavna veterinarka Becca Thring opisala je ovu situaciju kao pitanje života ili smrti, naglašavajući da je operacija bila jedino rješenje. Kirurzi su uspješno uklonili lopticu, a srećom, Pax je mogao ići kući isti dan. Nakon operacije, Pax se brzo oporavio, iako sada ima ožiljak dug deset centimetara. Mislila je da je Pax izgubio svoju lopticu na odlasku, ne znajući da ju je progutao. Bila je šokirana kada je saznala koliko je ova bezazlena igra postala opasna i veoma je zahvalna PDSA-u što je spasio Paxov život. Teniske loptice su sada strogo zabranjene za njene pse, a ona upozorava druge vlasnike pasa na moguće rizike.

article_content: Officials from six countries have agreed in Turkey to build the Nabucco pipeline, a U.S.-supported initiative meant to decrease Europe’s dependence on Russian natural gas. This pipeline is planned to start at Turkey’s eastern border and pass through Bulgaria, Romania, and Hungary before reaching a major gas hub in Baumgarten, Austria, increasing energy security for Europe. Germany is also involved in the project, which was formalized in Ankara. At present, Russia holds dominance over Europe’s existing gas pipeline network. In reaction to Nabucco, Russia is planning its own competing South Stream pipeline, which would be routed under the Black Sea to Bulgaria and be co-owned by Russia and Italy. Support for Nabucco increased after Russia stopped gas deliveries to Europe in January due to a pricing dispute with Ukraine, according to industry analysts. The estimated cost of Nabucco is €7.9 billion, approximately $11 billion. Progress on the project has been slow since it was first proposed in 2002, hampered by disagreements among involved countries and uncertainty about gas providers. One primary issue was Turkey's insistence on keeping 15% of the pipeline’s gas for domestic use and export, which European partners opposed. Azerbaijan’s energy minister is expected at the signing, as gas from Shah Deniz 2 is vital to Nabucco’s supply. European representatives are hopeful that additional suppliers, such as Iraq and Turkmenistan, could also participate. Major obstacles remain: several billion dollars must be raised, construction hasn’t started, and gas transportation isn’t expected before 2014. Still, the intergovernmental agreement signed on Monday is seen as a significant step, with experts like John Roberts of Platts indicating the likelihood of the project’s realization has increased.

Gasovod bi trebao krenuti od istočne turske granice, prolazeći kroz Bugarsku, Rumuniju i Mađarsku, do važnog čvorišta u Baumgartenu u Austriji, čime bi se povećala energetska sigurnost za Evropu. Njemačka je također partner u ovom projektu, koji je ozvaničen u Ankari. Trenutno Rusija ima kontrolu nad postojećom mrežom gasovoda koji snabdijevaju Evropu. Kao odgovor na Nabucco, Rusija planira konkurentski gasovod South Stream, koji bi prolazio ispod Crnog mora do Bugarske i koji bi zajednički upravljali Rusija i Italija. Podrška projektu Nabucco porasla je nakon što je Rusija u januaru privremeno zaustavila dotok gasa Evropi zbog cjenovnog spora sa Ukrajinom, kažu analitičari industrije. Procijenjeni trošak projekta je 7,9 milijardi eura, odnosno oko 11 milijardi američkih dolara. Napredak ovog projekta je bio spor još od njegove prvobitne ideje iz 2002. godine, zbog neslaganja među partnerima i nesigurnosti oko izvora snabdijevanja gasom. Glavni predmet spora bila je Turska koja je tražila da zadrži 15% gasa za vlastite potrebe i izvoz, što evropski partneri nisu prihvatili. Očekuje se prisustvo ministra energetike Azerbejdžana na potpisivanju, jer je gas sa polja Shah Deniz 2 od presudne važnosti za snabdijevanje gasovoda. Evropski zvaničnici nadaju se i učešću drugih proizvođača poput Iraka i Turkmenistana. Veliki izazovi još stoje pred projektom: potrebno je osigurati milijarde dolara investicija, izgradnja nije započela i transport gasa se ne očekuje prije 2014. godine. Ipak, analitičari vjeruju da je međudržavni sporazum potpisan u ponedjeljak veliki korak naprijed, ističe svojim komentarom stručnjak John Roberts iz kompanije Platts.

article_content: Antonia Croft, a 23-year-old mother from Wavertree, Liverpool, endured a frightening ordeal when she suffered a heart attack while eight months pregnant. The episode began when her cat, Digsby, ran into the road, causing her acute distress and resulting in shortness of breath and chest pain. She was taken to hospital by ambulance, where doctors determined she had suffered a heart attack triggered by an undetected blood clot. Pregnancy increases the risk of developing blood clots significantly, making women ten times more likely to be affected. Doctors warned Antonia that a natural birth could be extremely risky and scheduled a Caesarean section. Unexpectedly, she went into labor naturally just before the planned operation. Despite the ordeal, her son Don’tae was delivered healthy, though underweight at 4lb 8oz. Both mother and child are now doing well, but Antonia requires ongoing medical monitoring and medication for her heart. She described the terrifying moment: 'Digsby bolted out as I was getting my daughter, Shamayah, ready for school. He ran into the road, and I screamed as a car stopped suddenly. Afterwards, I felt extremely hot and developed chest pain.' Initially, Antonia thought her symptoms were due to late pregnancy and was prescribed painkillers, but after a sleepless night she could barely move. Her partner, Lee Foster, supported her as she was rushed to the Royal Liverpool Hospital, then transferred to Broadgreen Hospital, where she was monitored for five days. Scans confirmed she had suffered a heart attack, which surprised both Antonia and her doctors, as she had no prior symptoms or risk factors. Doctors prepared for a Caesarean delivery three weeks early and administered steroid injections to support her baby's lung development, but Antonia naturally went into labor while at home. Don’tae was delivered safely with a medical team monitoring Antonia’s heart. Fortunately, Digsby was unharmed after the traffic incident. Antonia expressed immense relief and gratitude after her and her son’s recovery. She mentioned that her case may be included in medical journals due to its rarity. She underscores that heart attacks can happen to anyone, regardless of age or health, and that life can change unexpectedly.

Isprva je mislila da su simptomi normalni za kasnu trudnoću i dobila je analgetike, ali nakon besane noći jedva se mogla kretati. Partner Lee Foster bio je uz nju dok su je odvezli u Royal Liverpool Hospital, a zatim prebacili u Broadgreen Hospital, gdje je provela pet dana pod nadzorom. article_content: Tahlia Raven, a three-year-old girl, tragically passed away after experiencing an extremely rare and fatal reaction to parvovirus, also known as slapped cheek disease—a common childhood infection that usually causes only mild symptoms or goes unnoticed altogether. Tahlia had been healthy and enjoying playing outdoors with her five-year-old sister, Annaliese, just the day before her sudden death. She became only the fourth child in the UK to die from parvovirus in the last eight years. Her mother, Karen Glover, expressed her heartbreak over losing her 'beautiful blue-eyed angel,' saying Tahlia had been perfectly healthy and there was no warning something was wrong. A post-mortem revealed that Tahlia had parvovirus present in both her heart and brain, along with a significantly swollen brain and some inflammation in her windpipe. Dr. Marion Malone, a paediatric pathologist at Great Ormond Street Hospital, explained at the inquest in Chelmsford, Essex, that these findings led her to conclude parvovirus was the cause of death—although such fatal cases are extremely rare. The inquest also determined that Tahlia’s death was by natural causes, as no other conditions like meningitis or pneumonia were found, and a previously unknown minor heart defect may not have played any role. Symptoms of the slapped cheek virus often include a mild illness with a red facial rash, and sometimes the rash can spread to the limbs, although most children recover quickly. The main group at risk for severe complications are pregnant women, due to the risk of miscarriage. Karen Glover stated that nothing further could have been done to save Tahlia, and standard medical care would have involved giving medication to manage symptoms. Currently, there is no vaccine for parvovirus, which usually resolves within days.
translated_content: Trogodišnja djevojčica Tahlia Raven tragično je preminula nakon izuzetno rijetke i smrtonosne reakcije na parvovirus, poznat i kao bolest 'pljusnutog obraza'—uobičajena dječja infekcija koja obično izaziva blage simptome ili prođe neprimijećeno. Tahlia je bila zdrava i dan prije smrti uživala je igrajući se na otvorenom sa svojom petogodišnjom sestrom Annaliese. Postala je tek četvrto dijete u Velikoj Britaniji koje je preminulo od parvovirusa u posljednjih osam godina. Njena majka, Karen Glover, izrazila je bol zbog gubitka svoje 'predivne djevojčice plavih očiju', ističući da je Tahlia bila potpuno zdrava i nije bilo nikakvih znakova da nešto nije u redu. Obdukcija je pokazala prisutnost parvovirusa u srcu i mozgu, uz značajno otečen mozak i upalu dušnika. Dr. Marion Malone, pedijatrijski patolog iz bolnice Great Ormond Street, na saslušanju u Chelmsfordu u Essexu objasnila je da su ti nalazi doveli do zaključka da je uzrok smrti bio parvovirus—iako su ovakvi slučajevi izuzetno rijetki. Saslušanje je također utvrdilo da je Tahliina smrt nastupila prirodno, jer nisu pronađeni drugi uzroci poput meningitisa ili upale pluća, dok prisutan blagi srčani defekt vjerovatno nije imao utjecaja. Simptomi bolesti pljusnutog obraza obično uključuju blagu bolest i crveni osip na licu, koji se ponekad može proširiti na udove; većina djece se brzo oporavi. Glavna rizična grupa za ozbiljne komplikacije su trudnice, zbog rizika od spontanog pobačaja. Karen Glover navodi da se ništa više nije moglo učiniti kako bi se spasila Tahlia, dok standardna medicinska njega uključuje davanje lijekova za ublažavanje simptoma. Trenutno ne postoji vakcina za parvovirus, koji obično nestane za nekoliko dana.

article_content: Cheryl Cole has been named the UK’s most influential beauty icon according to a recent survey. The 30-year-old singer and X Factor judge, who just started filming the new series, led a poll involving 1,000 women who were asked which celebrities influence their beauty buying choices. Michelle Keegan came in second, followed by Kate Moss, Rosie Huntington-Whiteley, the Duchess of Cambridge, Jennifer Aniston, Rihanna, Keira Knightley, Miranda Kerr, and iconic actress Audrey Hepburn completing the top ten. The survey underlines how much celebrities shape women's preferences in beauty and cosmetics. Remarkably, 80 percent of respondents said they would buy products recommended by their favorite beauty icons in hopes of replicating their style. Despite the high costs, a quarter of women said they might spend up to £80 on a single celebrity-endorsed product, and 6 percent were willing to go as high as £200. On average, women spend £312 each year emulating the looks of stars like Cheryl Cole. Almost half of the participants admitted to imitating celebrity makeup styles for big events, often turning to YouTube tutorials by influencers such as Lisa Eldridge and Tanya Burr. For example, Eldridge’s tutorial on Cheryl Cole's look has attracted over 700,000 views. Social media has further boosted this trend. Three-quarters of women said they'd quickly buy a beauty product highlighted by their idol on Instagram, Twitter, or in interviews. If an item was out of stock, 61 percent would search for it online. Classic beauty styles remain popular: timeless icons like Audrey Hepburn and the Duchess of Cambridge inspire many, as do the glamorous looks of Michelle Keegan and Kate Moss. However, not all celebrity styles are seen as desirable—Jodie Marsh and Katie Price received the most votes for 'least admired' beauty looks. Emma Leslie, Beauty Editor at Escentual.com—the company behind the survey—said, ‘Women have always been eager to learn the secrets of their beauty inspirations. When a celebrity suggests a product online or in the media, it creates a rush in demand. Cheryl Cole, with her polished appearance and willingness to try new looks, continues to be a trendsetter.’

Michelle Keegan je zauzela drugo mjesto, zatim Kate Moss, Rosie Huntington-Whiteley, vojvotkinja od Cambridgea, Jennifer Aniston, Rihanna, Keira Knightley, Miranda Kerr i legendarna glumica Audrey Hepburn zaokružuju top deset. Istraživanje pokazuje koliko slavne osobe utječu na ženske preferencije u ljepoti i kozmetici. Impresivnih 80 posto ispitanica izjavilo je da bi kupile proizvode preporučene od svojih beauty uzora, nadajući se da će izgledati slično njima. Gotovo polovica ispitanica priznaje da za posebne prilike kopiraju šminku slavnih, često gledajući YouTube tutorijale influencera kao što su Lisa Eldridge i Tanya Burr. Na primjer, Eldridgein tutorijal o izgledu Cheryl Cole ima preko 700.000 pregleda. Društvene mreže dodatno pojačavaju ovaj trend. Tri četvrtine žena kaže da bi brzo kupile kozmetički proizvod koji njihova idolizirana zvijezda spomene na Instagramu, Twitteru ili u intervjuima. Ako proizvoda nema u prodaji, 61 posto traži ga online. Klasični stil ljepote i dalje je popularan: bezvremenske ikone poput Audrey Hepburn i vojvotkinje od Cambridgea i dalje inspiriraju mnoge, baš kao i glamurozni izgled Michelle Keegan i Kate Moss. Ipak, nisu svi stilovi slavnih jednako poželjni—Jodie Marsh i Katie Price dobile su najviše glasova za 'najmanje cijenjene' beauty stilove. Emma Leslie, Beauty urednica na Escentual.com—firmi koja je provela anketu—kaže: ‘Žene su oduvijek željele saznati tajne svojih beauty uzora. Kad slavna osoba preporuči proizvod online ili u medijima, potražnja naglo raste. Cheryl Cole, sa svojim dotjeranim izgledom i spremnošću na isprobavanje novih stilova, i dalje je vodeća trendseterica.’

article_content: Ben Davies, the left-back for Swansea City, is nearing his 21st birthday, but his primary focus is ensuring that his team avoids relegation from the Premier League. As the season reaches its tense finale, all he thinks about is helping Swansea reach the vital 40-point mark that typically guarantees safety. He insists that until this goal is met, personal milestones—like birthday celebrations—can wait. Even though major clubs such as Manchester City, Liverpool, Arsenal, and Atletico Madrid are monitoring his progress, Davies remains fully committed to Swansea at the moment. The interest from Atletico Madrid, currently leading La Liga and preparing to play Chelsea in the Champions League semi-finals, caught him off guard. He first heard the news through a friend's text, and while he finds it encouraging, he insists it won’t distract him from his responsibilities. Davies has ambitions to play at the highest level, but his immediate concern is to help Swansea avoid dropping out of the Premier League. He mentions that his mother would like to organize his 21st birthday party, but he’s told her any celebrations will have to wait until their league status is secure. Swansea manager Garry Monk has been working to solidify team spirit, particularly among the squad’s international players, by assigning everyone to watch a documentary on the club’s turbulent history, 'The Fall and Rise of Swansea City.' Davies says this exercise helped the team understand the club’s significance to local supporters and brought the players closer together. Born in Neath, Wales, Davies is proud of his Welsh roots, speaking the language fluently—just like his family—and regularly giving interviews to Welsh-language media. He values this heritage and wants to help preserve the Welsh language. Although his father envisioned a future for him in rugby—a sport beloved throughout Wales—Davies ultimately chose football, crediting his parents for their guidance and support. Since breaking into Swansea’s first team in August 2012, after Neil Taylor’s injury, Davies has already made over 60 appearances. Davies reflects on his own commitment as a young player, choosing quiet Saturday nights so he could perform at his best on Sundays and steering clear of distractions. While he says he enjoys downtime as much as anyone, he’s saving the celebrations for the summer—provided Swansea secure their place in the league.

article_content: King Albert II of Belgium abdicated his throne today after a 20-year reign, making way for his son Philippe to become the nation’s seventh king. The 79-year-old Albert signed away his royal powers at the Royal Palace in Brussels, witnessed by Prime Minister Elio Di Rupo, who holds the country’s main political authority in this 183-year-old parliamentary democracy. Soon after, 53-year-old Philippe was sworn in as king before Belgium’s lawmakers at Parliament, just a short walk from the palace. The ceremonies took place amidst national celebrations and a significant public turnout in Belgium’s capital. After his investiture, King Philippe appeared on the Royal Palace balcony with his wife, Queen Mathilde, to thank the crowds. The royal couple were greeted with enthusiasm, waving and embracing on an emotional day for both their family and the country. Queen Mathilde participated in public festivities at Parc Royal in Brussels, where she greeted and comforted well-wishers, displaying the royal family’s connection with the people. King Philippe and Queen Mathilde, who have four children, were joined by family members, including the former King and Queen, and former Queen Fabiola, during the celebrations. King Philippe attended his swearing-in alongside two of his four children, Prince Gabriel and Princess Eleonore. Following the official ceremonies, Queen Mathilde met with citizens in Parc Royal, receiving a warm reception. King Albert II officially signed his abdication in the ornate Royal Palace, with Crown Prince Philippe and Prime Minister Di Rupo at his side. In his farewell speech, Albert expressed satisfaction about Belgium’s modernization and urged continued unity among the country’s Dutch-speaking and French-speaking communities. Albert announced his decision to step down just three weeks ago, citing health reasons. Under glittering chandeliers in the palace, Prime Minister Di Rupo praised Albert as 'a great head of state' and acknowledged the historical significance of the event. The day’s events began with a service at the Cathedral of St Michael and St Gudula, attended by the royal family and dignitaries, though no foreign royalty were present due to the short notice of the abdication. The cathedral was filled with Belgian officials and members of the extended royal family. King Philippe and Queen Mathilde greeted well-wishers alongside the cathedral and amid Brussels’ National Day celebrations, which included a military parade and festivities. As Belgium’s new monarch, Philippe is expected to maintain the traditionally neutral role in politics, like his predecessor. The nation faces parliamentary elections in June 2014, a period that may test national unity due to ongoing debates about increasing autonomy for linguistic regions. EU Commission President Jose Manuel Barroso praised Philippe, describing him as 'wise and well-prepared' with strong knowledge of Belgian and European politics. The public’s response was overwhelmingly positive, with crowds filling streets decorated in the colors of the Belgian flag to bid farewell to King Albert and welcome King Philippe.

article_content: San Francisco couple Scott Burry and Dani Vernon, from Christian and Jewish backgrounds, created a unique holiday card blending their traditions. Instead of the usual seasonal greetings, their card shows Burry with their dog Tucker in front of a Christmas tree on one side, while Vernon stands with a Star of David and Hanukkah candles on the other. Burry, 27, said the idea was to do something fun and memorable that celebrates their backgrounds as a family. 'The card is less about ceremonies and more about celebrating where we come from and how we come together,' he told MailOnline. They organized a photoshoot at Left Space studios in San Francisco with friends, using affordable props and festive wallpaper. The finished card was sent to loved ones just before Hanukkah ended on December 5. Feedback from family and friends was overwhelmingly positive, with some calling it the 'best card ever.' Vernon's parents especially enjoyed it and asked for more copies. Burry and Vernon have been together for about four years after meeting at San Francisco State University. Burry is a photographer and Vernon works as an assistant photo editor, and their creative skills helped make the card special. The couple is already brainstorming ideas for next year, including possibly a card featuring a sleigh pulled by photoshopped images of their dog Tucker.

article_content: For years, women—especially mothers—have placed a higher value on job flexibility than on increased salaries. In 1989, legal scholar Joan Williams highlighted how professional workplaces were structured around employees able to always be available—a model that disadvantaged mothers with childcare responsibilities. Williams argued that despite advances in technology, the expected profile of an 'ideal worker' barely changed, and mothers who sought flexibility continued to be seen as less committed. Williams, now a professor at UC Law San Francisco, became disillusioned as businesses maintained traditional in-person ideals, even as they adopted flexible policies on paper. This mindset shifted dramatically during the COVID-19 pandemic, when remote work became widespread. Today, many professional positions only require in-person attendance part-time, providing mothers—and others—with valuable flexibility. Economists link this shift toward remote work to record rates of workforce participation among prime-age women, particularly mothers of young children, with the effect even stronger among college-educated women. Despite increasingly equal earnings between partners in some households, women still usually shoulder more housework and childcare. When work and family obligations clash, women are more likely to pull back at work. Nobel Prize economist Claudia Goldin’s research has shown that occupations demanding inflexible, long hours—like finance and law—further the gender pay gap. While remote and hybrid work haven’t eliminated these issues, the need for constant office attendance has relaxed. Business travel is down, and it’s now typical for workers—not only parents—to leave work by early evening. Research from organizations like the Conference Board and Brookings Institution shows that workers with flexibility in their schedules are more satisfied and less likely to quit—this applies to mothers, fathers, and non-parents alike. However, economists such as Lauren Bauer emphasize that mothers of young children especially need flexibility to remain employed. Census data from 2023 confirms that just a small proportion of teleworking mothers lack any child care. Many, like nonprofit employee Daphne Alsiyao, juggle work hours around childcare, sometimes working after their children go to bed. Workplace flexibility is not a universal fix, but it’s essential for retaining mothers in the workforce. Betsey Stevenson at the University of Michigan notes that high female participation benefits both the economy and individual companies, particularly as women hold most college degrees. For this reason, some employers expand maternity benefits to avoid the higher costs of recruiting replacements. Nonetheless, some leaders and organizations continue to equate on-site presence with productivity. David Solomon, CEO of Goldman Sachs, has dismissed remote work as a passing phase rather than a new standard. deeply rooted 'flexibility stigma' and workplace guilt still impede women’s progress, even though more roles now offer remote or hybrid options. There’s also concern that flexibility might inadvertently reinforce inequity—if mostly women use these options, their career advancement may slow, forming a new kind of ‘mommy track’. Studies reveal that remote staff, especially women, often receive less mentorship and fewer prime projects due to proximity bias. Enhanced workplace flexibility can’t solve all problems; most jobs can’t be done remotely, and many U.S. workers still lack access to paid family leave or affordable childcare. Still, the pandemic has helped make workplace flexibility more mainstream, putting society on a path toward more equitable work options, according to economists like Claudia Goldin. Though it’s not a revolution, these developments have brought workplaces closer to genuine inclusivity, despite ongoing obstacles.
translated_content: Godinama žene—posebno majke—više cijene fleksibilnost na poslu nego veću platu. Još 1989. godine pravna stručnjakinja Joan Williams ukazala je da su profesionalna radna mjesta oblikovana tako da odgovaraju zaposlenicima koji stalno mogu biti dostupni—model koji ne odgovara majkama sa djecom. Williams je isticala da, i pored tehnološkog napretka, očekivanja o 'idealnom radniku' skoro da se nisu promijenila, te su majke koje traže fleksibilnost i dalje percipirane kao manje posvećene. Williams, danas profesorica na UC Law San Francisco, s vremenom se razočarala jer su firme zadržavale tradicionalne vrijednosti rada uživo, čak i kad su formalno uvodile fleksibilnost. Ovakav stav se drastično promijenio tokom pandemije COVID-19, kada je rad od kuće postao masovan. Danas mnogi profesionalni poslovi zahtijevaju samo povremenu prisutnost u kancelariji, pružajući majkama i drugima veću fleksibilnost. Ekonomisti povezuju ovaj trend sa rekordnim stopama zaposlenosti među ženama radne dobi, posebno majkama male djece, a efekat je još izraženiji kod žena s fakultetskim diplomama. Čak i kad su prihodi između partnera slični, žene uglavnom preuzimaju više obaveza oko kuće i djece. Kad posao i porodične obaveze dođu u konflikt, žene su češće te koje se povlače sa posla. Nobelovka Claudia Goldin pokazala je da poslovi sa dugim, nefleksibilnim radnim vremenom—poput onih u finansijama i pravu—produbljuju razliku u platama među polovima. Iako rad na daljinu i hibridni modeli nisu uklonili sve prepreke, potreba za stalnim prisustvom u uredu se smanjila. Smanjeno je i poslovno putovanje, a sada nije neuobičajeno da radnici—ne samo roditelji—završe posao do ranih večernjih sati. Istraživanja organizacija poput Conference Boarda i Brookings Institutiona pokazuju da su radnici sa fleksibilnim rasporedima zadovoljniji i rjeđe daju otkaze—ovo važi jednako za majke, očeve i one bez djece. Ipak, ekonomistkinje poput Lauren Bauer naglašavaju da su posebno majke male djece te koje trebaju fleksibilnost da bi ostale zaposlene. Podaci popisa iz 2023. potvrđuju da je veoma mali broj majki koje rade od kuće potpuno bez ikakvog čuvanja djece. Mnoge, poput radnice nevladine organizacije Daphne Alsiyao, prilagođavaju svoje radno vrijeme obavezama kod kuće, često nastavljajući sa radom nakon što djeca zaspu. Fleksibilnost na radnom mjestu nije univerzalno rješenje, ali je ključna za ostanak majki u radnoj snazi. Betsey Stevenson sa Univerziteta Michigan navodi da viša stopa zaposlenosti žena koristi i ekonomiji i kompanijama, posebno jer žene posjeduju većinu visokoškolskih diploma. Zbog toga neke firme proširuju pogodnosti za porodilje kako ne bi morale plaćati više za regrutaciju novih radnika. Ipak, neki rukovodioci i dalje smatraju da je prisutnost u kancelariji dokaz produktivnosti. Izvršni direktor Goldman Sachsa David Solomon opisao je rad na daljinu kao prolazni trend, a ne trajnu promjenu. Duboko uvriježena ‘stigmatizacija fleksibilnosti’ i osjećaj krivice još uvijek predstavljaju prepreku ženama, iako više poslova sada nudi opciju rada na daljinu ili u hibridnom modelu. Također postoji bojazan da bi fleksibilnost mogla nehotice ojačati nejednakosti—ako je najviše koriste žene, njihov karijerni napredak može biti usporen, što je svojevrsna nova 'majčinska staza'. Studije su pokazale da radnici na daljinu, naročito žene, često imaju manje prilika za mentorstvo i prestižne projekte zbog 'proximity bias' efekta. Veća fleksibilnost ne može riješiti sve probleme—većina poslova se ne može obavljati na daljinu, a mnogi radnici u SAD-u i dalje nemaju plaćeno porodično odsustvo ili pristupačno čuvanje djece. Ipak, pandemija je pomogla da ovakva fleksibilnost postane društveno prihvatljivija, a prema ekonomistima poput Claudie Goldin, time se društvo približava ravnopravnijim radnim opcijama. Iako to nije potpuna transformacija, ovi pomaci su radna mjesta približili stvarnoj inkluzivnosti, uz prisutne izazove.

article_content: John Parry, a 23-year-old English golfer, leads the Austrian Open in Atzenbrugg by a single stroke at the halfway point, after posting a flawless five-under-par 67 in the second round for a total of eight under. Close behind are Northern Ireland's Graeme McDowell, the U.S. Open champion, and Sweden's Pelle Edberg—each recording scores of 68—and Spain's Jose Manuel Lara, who shot 71. Parry expressed satisfaction about leading at this stage to the European Tour website, emphasizing that he prefers having the lead going into the weekend. With his current 117th position in the Race to Dubai standings and only the top 115 retaining European Tour cards for next season, Parry is hoping a good finish will secure his spot for next year. Similarly, Lara (130th) and Edberg (114th) are aiming to secure their cards, with a victory guaranteeing qualification. McDowell, preparing for the upcoming Ryder Cup, made a strong start in this event and is well positioned after making four birdies in his first five holes. Fellow Ryder Cup player Miguel Angel Jimenez is also not far off, finishing four shots back after his own round of 68. Previous overnight leader George Coetzee of South Africa struggled after hitting water twice on the 16th, taking a quadruple-bogey eight and closing with a 76, leaving him five strokes behind.

Iza njega su Graeme McDowell iz Sjeverne Irske, aktuelni pobjednik US Opena, i Šveđanin Pelle Edberg – obojica sa rezultatom 68 – te Španac Jose Manuel Lara koji je odigrao 71. Parry je za zvaničnu stranicu European Toura izjavio da je zadovoljan što vodi u ovoj fazi, naglasivši da mu je draže biti ispred nego u zaostatku uoči vikenda. Sa trenutnom 117. pozicijom na tabeli Race to Dubai, a samo prvih 115 zadržava svoju Tour dozvolu za narednu sezonu, Parry se nada da će mu dobar plasman u Austriji osigurati mjesto sljedeće godine. Slično tome, Lara (130.) i Edberg (114.) pokušavaju da obezbijede svoje karte, a pobjeda na ovom turniru bi im to zagarantovala. McDowell, koji se priprema za nadolazeći Ryder Cup, sjajno je ušao u ovaj događaj i nalazi se u dobroj poziciji nakon što je ostvario četiri birdija u prvih pet rupa. Njegov Ryder Cup suigrač, Miguel Angel Jimenez, također je blizu vodećih, s četiri udarca zaostatka nakon rezultata od 68. Jučerašnji lider George Coetzee iz Južnoafričke Republike imao je težak dan – dva puta je završio u vodi na 16. rupi, napravio "quadruple-bogey" osam i završio sa 76, sada pet udaraca iza vodećeg.

article_content: Lewis Hamilton clinched an important victory at a drenched Suzuka circuit, strengthening his lead in the Formula 1 title race during the Japanese Grand Prix. The event was marred by a severe accident involving Marussia’s Jules Bianchi, which overshadowed the result. Due to torrential rain brought by Typhoon Phanfone, the race began behind the safety car and was halted after only two laps. Competition resumed, and Hamilton overtook Mercedes teammate Nico Rosberg on lap 29, maintaining the lead as worsening weather eventually forced the race to be stopped after 44 laps—short of the scheduled distance. The atmosphere turned somber when Bianchi aquaplaned off the track at the same corner where Adrian Sutil had recently crashed. Bianchi’s car struck a recovery vehicle on the scene, prompting immediate medical attention and his transfer to hospital, where he was found to have sustained critical head injuries that required surgery. In post-race remarks, Hamilton expressed that his thoughts were solely with Bianchi, saying the result felt insignificant under the circumstances. Rosberg offered similar thoughts and praised Hamilton’s performance. Sebastian Vettel secured third place, a notable finish as he announced his departure from Red Bull at the end of the season. Daniel Ricciardo claimed fourth, with Jenson Button in fifth after a timely switch to intermediate tyres. Williams drivers Valtteri Bottas and Felipe Massa finished sixth and seventh, respectively. Points were also scored by Force India teammates Nico Hulkenberg and Sergio Perez, with Jean-Eric Vergne wedged between them in ninth—notably overcoming a 10-place grid drop. Daniil Kvyat, set to replace Vettel in 2015, finished eleventh. Ferrari’s Kimi Raikkonen was the only finisher for his team after Fernando Alonso retired early due to technical issues. Further down the field, Esteban Gutierrez took thirteenth for Sauber, followed by Kevin Magnussen of McLaren, Lotus drivers Romain Grosjean and Pastor Maldonado, with Marcus Ericsson (Caterham), Max Chilton (Marussia), and Kamui Kobayashi (Caterham) closing out the standings.

article_content:
The shirt worn by Sir Bobby Charlton during the 1966 World Cup semi-final is set to be auctioned. This signed jersey was donned by the legendary footballer as he scored both goals in England’s 2-1 victory over Portugal on 26 July 1966. Charlton, who passed away on 21 October at the age of 86, received widespread tributes from the sporting community. The shirt will be sold through Hansons Auctioneers in Derbyshire, with an estimated value of £50,000 to £80,000.

Sir Bobby Charlton is widely recognized as one of the greatest footballers in history, boasting a World Cup, European Cup (now the Champions League), First Division, FA Cup, and a Ballon d'Or to his name. According to an inquest, he died last month following a fall at a care home in Cheshire.

David Wilson-Turner, the head of sports memorabilia at Hansons, described the shirt as, “a magical moment in sporting history—the one and only time England have won the World Cup.” The shirt was initially donated by Sir Bobby to a charity auction following the 1966 World Cup, personally autographed and dedicated to the winning bidder, and confirmed as having been worn during the Portugal match.

Hansons reports the shirt was later bought by a West Midlands man who had previously won the Littlewoods Pools in the early 1990s. In 2000, the shirt was purchased at a London auction for £9,200—approximately £20,000 today—where it had been estimated between £10,000 and £15,000.

The upcoming auction is scheduled for 14 November.
