article_content: The European horse meat scandal swept across several countries, prompting millions of products to be removed from store shelves in the UK, Ireland, France, Spain, Germany, Denmark, Sweden, and Norway. On Friday, the European Union agreed to initiate random DNA tests on meat products. Meanwhile, British authorities found traces of horse meat in school meals, restaurant dishes, hospital food, and supermarket items. A similar incident is considered unlikely in the United States, where horse slaughter and horse meat imports are currently not practiced. According to ABC News, none of the companies or countries implicated in the labeling controversy export beef to the U.S. French meat processor Spanghero was identified by French authorities as a key company involved in the fraud. The country’s investigation into fraudulent meat labeling has focused on this firm, but Spanghero denies wrongdoing. William Hallman, director of the Food Policy Institute at Rutgers University, told ABC News that it's difficult to say such a scandal could never happen in the U.S., but it's far less likely because no horse meat is legally slaughtered for commercial purposes. Although a 2006 ban was lifted in 2011, no U.S. states have resumed the practice, and USDA inspectors are required to be present at all slaughterhouses. Dave Arnold, a food safety expert at the International Culinary Center in New York, said that meat cannot be sold legally without a USDA inspector present, but acknowledged that illegal activity is still possible. Horse meat, although commonly consumed in France, is rarely eaten in the U.S. The European crisis began in January when Irish food safety authorities found horse DNA in burgers sold by British and Irish supermarkets. Silvercrest Foods, the source, withdrew 10 million burgers. Officials first blamed an imported beef-protein additive, then frozen slaughterhouse leftovers from Poland, illustrating the complexity of the food supply chain. Traces of horse meat have been found in a range of products, from supermarket meals like burgers and lasagna to restaurant meals, school lunches, and hospital food. Britain's Food Standards Agency reported that 29 out of 2,501 tested products contained at least 1% horse DNA, mostly in products like burgers, lasagna, and meat sauces. The scandal extended beyond supermarkets. Whitbread PLC, the UK's largest hotel and restaurant company, found horse DNA in some of its lasagna and burgers, expressing disappointment in the processed meat supply chain. Horse meat was also detected in school cottage pies and hospital meals. Officials noted that ongoing testing was likely to reveal more contaminated products. Senior British food inspector Duncan Campbell stated the investigation was not over. European officials described the scandal as fraud, possibly tied to international criminal activity to pass off cheap horse meat as more expensive beef. French and EU authorities traced the fraudulent chain across 28 firms in 13 countries. Meat from abattoirs in Romania was sent through traders and wholesalers before appearing in foods labeled as beef. Dutch and British authorities carried out raids and made arrests in connection with these operations. Horse meat itself is not harmful and is consumed in several European countries. However, in Britain and Ireland, it is considered taboo. There were concerns about the painkiller phenylbutazone (bute) entering the food chain via horse meat, but the risk from small amounts is believed to be low. Europol coordinated a Europe-wide investigation, while the EU agreed to random DNA and bute testing. The crisis has raised questions about control and transparency in the food supply chain. Critics warn that the supply chain is overly complex and not properly regulated. Tonio Borg, EU Health Commissioner, responded that the identification of fraudulent activity showed that traceability in the EU works and assured consumers that the EU would take steps to restore consumer confidence.
translated_content: Evropski skandal s konjskim mesom proširio se na više zemalja, zbog čega su milioni proizvoda povučeni s polica u Velikoj Britaniji, Irskoj, Francuskoj, Španiji, Njemačkoj, Danskoj, Švedskoj i Norveškoj. Evropska unija je u petak odlučila uvesti nasumična DNK testiranja mesnih proizvoda. U međuvremenu, britanske vlasti su pronašle tragove konjetine u obrocima za škole, jelima u restoranima, bolničkoj hrani i supermarketima. Sličan slučaj se smatra malo vjerovatnim u Sjedinjenim Državama, gdje se klanje konja i uvoz konjskog mesa trenutno ne dešavaju. Prema ABC Newsu, nijedna od firmi ili zemalja povezanih sa skandalom nije izvozila govedinu u SAD. Francuski prerađivač mesa Spanghero je od strane francuskih vlasti označen kao ključna firma uključena u prevaru. Istraga o lažnom označavanju mesa fokusira se na ovu firmu, ali Spanghero negira odgovornost. William Hallman, direktor Instituta za politiku hrane na Rutgers univerzitetu, rekao je za ABC News da je teško potpuno isključiti mogućnost sličnog skandala u SAD-u, ali ga smatra mnogo manje vjerovatnim jer se ni konjsko meso legalno ne kolje za prodaju. Iako je zabrana iz 2006. ukinuta 2011., nijedna američka savezna država nije obnovila praksu, a USDA inspektori su obavezni u svim klaonicama. Dave Arnold, stručnjak za sigurnost hrane u International Culinary Center u New Yorku, kaže da se meso ne može legalno prodavati bez USDA inspektora, ali priznaje da ilegalne aktivnosti uvijek postoje. Konjsko meso je uobičajeno u Francuskoj, ali ga se rijetko jede u SAD-u. Evropska kriza počela je u januaru kada su irske vlasti za sigurnost hrane otkrile DNK konja u burgerima prodavanim u britanskim i irskim supermarketima. Silvercrest Foods, izvor kontaminiranih proizvoda, povukao je 10 miliona burgera. Zvaničnici su prvo sumnjali na uvezeni goveđi proteinski dodatak, a zatim na zamrznute klaoničke ostatke iz Poljske, čime je predočena složenost lanca opskrbe hranom. Tragovi konjetine pronađeni su u raznim proizvodima – od gotovih obroka poput burgera i lazanja do menija u restoranima, školskih ručkova i bolničke hrane. Britanska Agencija za standarde hrane ustanovila je da je 29 od 2.501 testiranog proizvoda sadržavalo barem 1% DNK konja, uglavnom u burgerima, lazanji i mesnim umacima. Skandal se proširio izvan supermarketa. Whitbread PLC, najveća hotelska i restoranska kompanija u Velikoj Britaniji, pronašla je konjetinu u nekim svojim lazanjama i burgerima, ističući razočaranje u procesuirani lanac mesa. Konjsko meso pronađeno je i u školskim obrocima (cottage pies) i bolničkoj hrani. Zvaničnici su naglasili da će stalna testiranja vjerovatno otkrivati još kontaminiranih proizvoda. Viši britanski inspektor hrane Duncan Campbell rekao je da istraga nije završena. Evropski zvaničnici su skandal nazvali prevarom, možda povezanom s međunarodnim kriminalnim aktivnostima radi prodaje jeftine konjetine kao skuplje govedine. Francuske i EU vlasti su tragale za prevarom kroz 28 firmi u 13 zemalja. Meso iz rumunskih klaonica prošlo je kroz trgovce i veleprodaje prije nego što je završilo u proizvodima etiketiranim kao govedina. Holandske i britanske vlasti izvršile su racije i izvršile hapšenja u vezi sa slučajem. Konjsko meso samo po sebi nije štetno i jede se u nekoliko evropskih zemalja. Ipak, u Velikoj Britaniji i Irskoj konzumacija se smatra tabuom. Zabrinutost postoji zbog moguće prisutnosti lijeka fenilbutazon (bute) u prehrambenom lancu putem konjskog mesa, ali se mali rizik smatra prihvatljivim. Europol koordinira istragu širom Evrope, dok je EU odobrila nasumična DNK i bute testiranja. Kriza je podigla pitanja o kontroli i transparentnosti prehrambenog lanca. Kritičari upozoravaju da je lanac suviše složen i nedovoljno reguliran. Tonio Borg, evropski komesar za zdravlje, izjavio je da je otkrivanje prevaranskih aktivnosti dokaz da sistem praćenja hrane u EU funkcioniše i uvjerio potrošače da će preduzeti mjere za vraćanje povjerenja.

article_content: Among full-size pickup trucks, the Nissan Titan and Ram 1500 are among the oldest, with model launches in 2016 and 2018. Nissan is discontinuing the Titan in 2024, while Stellantis is updating the Ram 1500 for 2025—eliminating all V8 engines and introducing the Ramcharger variant, which features a V6 engine and a battery. Though not officially called a plug-in hybrid by Stellantis, it functions like one. The 2025 Ram receives a mild facelift, mainly at the front and rear, while keeping most of the bodywork the same. The Ram 1500 continues to stand out for its design. Updates include slimmer headlight clusters and, on Limited trims and above, standard twin bifunctional LED projectors. The grille is slightly wider with a forward lean. A new luxury Tungsten trim debuts for 2025. Previewed earlier on the electric Ram 1500 Rev, Tungsten uses an integrated bumper cover that gives the truck a more upscale appearance. Inside, the Ram 1500 remains familiar but now features upgraded materials and improved touchscreens. Base trims have a new 12-inch high-resolution infotainment display; higher trims have a 14.5-inch screen, and a 10.25-inch display for front passengers, similar to Jeep’s SUVs, with a privacy filter. There are six USB ports up front and four in back. Climate control buttons flank the large screen for convenience. For 2025, the Ram 1500 introduces hands-free driver assistance, similar to Ford BlueCruise and GM Super Cruise, along with a premium Klipsch sound system and trailer hitch assist that uses sensors to align the hitch with trailers. The 2025 Ram 1500 no longer offers V8 engines, as Stellantis looks to improve fuel efficiency. The 3.6-liter Pentastar V6 with the eTorque mild-hybrid system is standard, while the 3.0-liter twin-turbo Hurricane inline-six is available in two versions: standard output (420 hp, 469 lb-ft torque) and high-output (540 hp, 521 lb-ft). The TRX badge is being paused along with the discontinuation of the 700-hp supercharged Hellcat V8, but the new RHO model with the high-output Hurricane engine maintains robust off-road capability. Set to launch in late 2024, the Ram 1500 Ramcharger is a plug-in series hybrid that combines a 92-kWh battery and a V6 generator. It offers an estimated 145 miles of electric range and about 690 miles in total with the generator and gas tank. The system delivers 663 hp and 615 lb-ft torque, reaching 0-60 mph in approximately 4.4 seconds. It includes drive modes like Eco, e-Save, and Electric+. Maximum towing is 14,000 lbs; payload, 2,625 lbs. Unlike the all-electric Rev, the Ramcharger does not have a frunk, due to the V6 generator. However, its extended range and versatility make it suitable for long-distance towing and daily electric driving. Pricing has not been announced. The smaller battery and generator hardware could make the Ramcharger less expensive to produce than the fully electric Rev. Stellantis targets selling 80,000–100,000 electrified Ram trucks in the early years as part of a goal for at least 20% truck electrification and 50% BEV market share by 2030. Gas-powered Ram 1500s with the Hurricane engine go on sale in early 2024, with the Ram 1500 Rev and Ramcharger arriving in the fourth quarter.

article_content: Tony Blair has reiterated his interest in returning to frontline politics, discussing the possibility for the second time in a week. The former Labour prime minister, who left Downing Street in 2007 after a decade in power, said he misses the role and is keen to obtain a senior international position. Blair said he would have considered posts such as President of the EU or leader of the World Bank if they had been offered. He suggested that his experience in business and advisory roles since leaving office, which reportedly earned him around £20 million last year, makes him well-suited for a political comeback. "I feel I've got something to say," Blair told the FT Weekend magazine, adding, "If people want to listen, that's great, and if they don't, that's their choice... I want to emphasize how fast the world around us is changing and how dangerous it is to think we can stand still." His comments come shortly after he stated in another interview that he would like to be Prime Minister again. Since leaving office, Blair, now 59, has used his network to create a multi-million-pound business empire, including an advisory role at JP Morgan, where he reportedly earns £2.5 million per year, as well as with Zurich Insurance Group. He also intends to grow his financial and government advisory firm significantly over the next five years, and expects his team, across private business and foundations, to increase from 150 to 200 staff. Blair, who serves as a Middle East envoy, denies that his business interests conflict with his political work, stating that his business supports philanthropic initiatives like inter-faith dialogue and pro bono work in Africa. He emphasized, "The purpose of these businesses is to generate value. How I then use what I take out of that is my own business...what is important to me is to build foundations of real scale." In an interview with the Evening Standard, Blair suggested he would now be a better Prime Minister, saying he has learned a great deal in recent years that would have helped his leadership. He said, "One of my regrets is that what I have learned over the last five years would have been useful to me as Prime Minister. Seeing how the world is changing gives a clearer picture of the issues the country faces." When asked directly if he would return as Prime Minister, Blair replied: "Yes, sure, but it’s not likely to happen, is it?" Blair also criticized Gordon Brown for moving away from the New Labour policies that secured three election victories, and accused Brown of forcing him out of office. Reflecting on his resignation, Blair said, "I didn’t want to go but I felt that I had to. The alternative would have been to fight an intense internal battle, which I thought would damage the party and the country."

Blair je rekao da bi razmotrio pozicije poput predsjednika EU ili rukovodioca Svjetske banke da su mu bile ponuđene. Sugerisao je da ga iskustvo u poslovnim i savjetodavnim ulogama poslije napuštanja funkcije, za koje je navodno prošle godine zaradio oko 20 miliona funti, čini pogodnim za politički povratak. "Mislim da imam šta da kažem", rekao je Blair za FT Weekend magazin, dodajući: "Ako ljudi žele slušati, sjajno, a ako ne, to je njihov izbor... Želim naglasiti koliko se brzo svijet oko nas mijenja i koliko je opasno misliti da možemo ostati na mjestu." Njegovi komentari dolaze ubrzo nakon što je u drugom intervjuu izjavio da bi volio ponovno biti premijer. Od odlaska sa funkcije, Blair, sada 59 godina, iskoristio je svoju mrežu da izgradi multimilionsko poslovno carstvo, uključujući savjetodavnu ulogu u JP Morgan-u gdje navodno zarađuje 2,5 miliona funti godišnje, kao i u Zurich Insurance Group. Također planira značajno proširiti svoju finansijsku i vladinu savjetodavnu firmu u narednih pet godina te očekuje povećanje broja zaposlenih u privatnoj kompaniji i fondacijama sa 150 na 200. Blair, koji je i izaslanik za Bliski istok, negira da njegovi poslovni interesi ulaze u sukob sa političkim radom, navodeći da njegov biznis podržava filantropske inicijative poput međureligijskog dijaloga i pro bono angažmana u Africi. Naglasio je: "Svrha ovih preduzeća je stvaranje vrijednosti. Kako dalje koristim ono što odatle dobijem je moja stvar... ono što mi je važno jeste gradnja fondacija stvarne veličine." U intervjuu za Evening Standard, Blair je sugerisao da bi sada bio bolji premijer, rekavši da je mnogo naučio prethodnih godina što bi mu koristilo tokom vođenja države. Rekao je: "Jedno od mojih žaljenja je što bi mi iskustva stečena u posljednjih pet godina bila korisna dok sam bio premijer. Kada vidite kako se svijet razvija, jasnije sagledate probleme s kojima se zemlja suočava." Na direktno pitanje da li bi ponovo bio premijer, Blair je odgovorio: "Da, naravno, ali nije baš vjerovatno, zar ne?" Blair je također kritizirao Gordona Browna što se odmaknuo od politika Nove ljevice koje su donijele tri izborne pobjede, i optužio ga da ga je prisilio na odlazak. Osvrćući se na svoju ostavku, Blair je rekao: "Nisam želio otići, ali sam osjećao da moram. Alternativa bi bila žestoka unutarstranačka borba, za koju sam mislio da bi naštetila i stranci i zemlji."

article_content: Simon Mignolet once again faced criticism after his performance in Liverpool’s recent Champions League victory over Ludogorets Razgrad. The Belgian keeper’s mistake allowed an equalizer that nearly cost Liverpool important points, reigniting discussions about whether the team should seek a new number one goalkeeper. Since arriving from Sunderland in 2013 for £9 million, Mignolet was intended as a strong long-term addition for Liverpool. However, his tenure has included several notable mistakes and periods of hesitancy, especially during important matches. While Mignolet is widely recognized for his shot-stopping skills—a quality highlighted by former Liverpool defender Jamie Carragher—concerns persist about his distribution, aerial command, and decision-making under pressure. Mistakes last season, including those in high-profile matches against Manchester City and Chelsea, were cited as reasons Liverpool missed critical opportunities in their pursuit of the Premier League title. Defensive problems this season have also highlighted a lack of cohesion and trust between Mignolet and his defenders, such as Dejan Lovren and Mamadou Sakho. There have been links to Victor Valdes, the ex-Barcelona and Spain international goalkeeper, who is available as a free agent. Valdes’s experience, composure, and technical ability could provide the leadership and stability Liverpool have been lacking in goal. Ultimately, although Mignolet possesses clear strengths, his consistency and all-around game have not met the standards required for a club aiming to compete for major trophies. If he continues as Liverpool's main goalkeeper, the risk of dropping further crucial points remains.

article_content: The Cerrado, Brazil’s extensive savanna biome, is suffering from rapid loss of native vegetation as land is converted into pastures and croplands. This ongoing deforestation is critically affecting vital ecosystem services, according to a group of Brazilian researchers writing in Nature Sustainability. The experts urge that more robust conservation measures and land management plans—such as rehabilitating degraded land and creating ecological corridors—are urgently required.  Covering around 2 million square kilometers—similar in size to Mexico—the Cerrado is South America’s second-largest biome and is recognized as the most biodiverse savanna worldwide, with over 11,600 native plant species. It is the source of many significant Brazilian rivers, making it the world’s only savanna with perennial rivers that supply the country's southern and southeastern regions with water.  According to Brazil’s National Space Research Institute (INPE), between August 2022 and July 2023, the Cerrado’s native vegetation loss rose by 16.5%, amounting to 6,300 km²—the highest level since current monitoring began in 2017. The majority of this deforestation happened in the MaToPiBa region, which includes Maranhão, Tocantins, Piauí, and Bahia, contributing nearly 75% of total loss.  In 2022, the Cerrado’s deforestation increased by 25% compared to the year before, reaching levels comparable to the much larger Amazon. Researchers like Michel Eustáquio Dantas Chaves point out that weaker enforcement and lucrative agriculture are key drivers. They caution that continued vegetation loss raises temperatures, reduces rainfall, disrupts agricultural systems, and threatens food security.  The study notes that the Cerrado largely remains excluded from significant sustainability measures, such as the Amazon Soy Moratorium and recent European rules, leaving about 74% of the biome unprotected. The researchers call for more effective legislation and conservation strategies that recognize the Cerrado’s exceptional biodiversity and crucial functions in climate moderation, water supply, and carbon capture.  On a positive note, advances in technology—like enhanced crop monitoring using data analytics—show that conservation and high-yield agriculture can coexist. The authors support broader implementation of policies like the Plan for Prevention and Control of Deforestation (PPCD), which now covers all biomes, but stress this will require coordinated government efforts, better enforcement, public engagement, and increased investment in monitoring technologies.  The scientists urge reframing ecological and technological funding as strategic investments in Brazil’s environmental resilience and long-term agricultural productivity.

Ovo kontinuirano krčenje šuma ozbiljno ugrožava ključne usluge ekosistema, navodi grupa brazilskih istraživača u časopisu Nature Sustainability. Stručnjaci upozoravaju da su hitno potrebne snažnije mjere zaštite i planovi upravljanja zemljištem – uključujući obnovu degradiranih područja i stvaranje ekoloških koridora.  Sa površinom od oko 2 miliona kvadratnih kilometara—što je veličina slična Meksiku—Cerrado je drugo najveće kopneno područje u Južnoj Americi i najbiodiverzitetnija savana na svijetu, s preko 11.600 autohtonih biljnih vrsta. Iz ovog područja izvire mnogo najvažnijih rijeka Brazila, čineći ga jedinom savanom na svijetu s rijekama koje teku tokom cijele godine i snabdijevaju jug i jugoistok zemlje vodom.  Prema podacima Nacionalnog instituta za svemirska istraživanja Brazila (INPE), od augusta 2022. do jula 2023. godine u Cerradu je izgubljeno 16,5% više prirodne vegetacije, što iznosi 6.300 km²—najviši nivo otkad aktuelni sistem praćenja postoji, od 2017. godine. Većina ovog krčenja zabilježena je u regiji MaToPiBa, koja obuhvata države Maranhão, Tocantins, Piauí i Bahia, a na tom je području izgubljeno skoro 75% ukupne vegetacije.  U 2022. godini, krčenje Cerrada poraslo je za 25% u odnosu na prethodnu godinu, dosegnuvši gotovo iste razmjere kao u mnogo većoj Amazoni. Istraživači poput Michela Eustáquia Dantasa Chavesa ističu da su slabija provedba zakona i profitabilna poljoprivreda ključni uzroci. Upozoravaju da dalji gubitak vegetacije povisuje temperaturu, smanjuje padavine, narušava poljoprivredne sisteme i ugrožava sigurnost prehrane.  Studija ističe kako Cerrado uglavnom nije obuhvaćen glavnim mjerama održivosti, kao što su Moratorijum na soju u Amazonu i nove evropske regulative, što oko 74% ovog bioma ostavlja bez zaštite. Istraživači traže efikasniju legislativu i strategije zaštite koje prepoznaju izuzetan biodiverzitet Cerrada i njegovu ključnu ulogu u klimatskoj regulaciji, snabdijevanju vodom i skladištenju ugljika.  S pozitivne strane, napredak tehnologije—poput bolje kontrole usjeva pomoću analize podataka—pokazuje da očuvanje prirode i visokoprinosna poljoprivreda mogu ići zajedno. Autori podržavaju širenje politika kao što je Plan za prevenciju i kontrolu krčenja šuma (PPCD), koji sada obuhvata sve biome, ali naglašavaju da će uspjeh zahtijevati usklađeni rad vlada, jaču primjenu zakona, uključivanje javnosti i veća ulaganja u tehnologije praćenja.  Naučnici poručuju da se ulaganja u ekologiju i tehnologiju trebaju posmatrati kao strateška investicija u otpornost brazilske životne sredine i dugoročnu poljoprivrednu produktivnost.

article_content: Joanna Toner, 52, a former nursing sister from Tiverton, Devon, took her own life after a prolonged campaign of harassment against her uncle, former BBC weatherman Bill Giles, an inquest heard. Toner, who had previously claimed that Giles was her father, had written letters to him and was charged with harassment, an offense for which she had previously served a prison sentence. Toner failed to appear in court for her latest harassment charge, and police found her dead at her home three days later when they visited her barricaded residence. A coroner determined that Toner died from an overdose of prescription drugs. In 2000, Toner was jailed for 30 months after a nine-year obsession with Giles, during which she made hoax bomb calls to the BBC and threatening phone calls to Giles and his wife Maureen. Toner had previously spent six months in jail for similar incidents and was banned from contacting Giles, the BBC, and the Met Office. Despite a brief pause after her initial imprisonment, Toner resumed her harassment in 1999. Her lawyer stated in 2000 that she intended to pursue her claim about her parenthood through legal means. Toner's fixation began in the late 1980s when her mother, who struggled with alcoholism, claimed Giles was Toner's biological father. Toner had stayed with Giles and his family when he was married to her aunt, but the couple later divorced. Giles remarried in 1991. At a recent inquest in Exeter, it was revealed that Toner had sent more letters to Giles in 2012. Toner's daughter, Dawn Taylor, said she knew her mother had sent a letter before her death but had not seen the other correspondence. Coroner Andrew Cox stated Toner's suicide notes were very personal. Miss Taylor chose to discuss the notes' contents with police privately. Toner failed to attend court in September 2012 to answer new harassment allegations, prompting a warrant for her arrest. Police found her home barricaded, and inside they discovered her dead beside empty pill packets. Toxicology tests confirmed a fatal overdose. The inquest heard that Toner, who suffered from chronic depression dating back to the 1980s as well as hip and back pain, had recently lost her benefits after an altercation at the Job Centre. She had also left the GP's office angry and without receiving a sick note. Neighbors described Toner as friendly but reclusive, with occasional male visitors. Detective Sergeant Angus Cottey confirmed that suicide notes were found and that there was no evidence of third-party involvement. Coroner Andrew Cox concluded, 'I am sure she took her own life and intended to do so.'

Toner, koja je ranije tvrdila da je Giles njen otac, pisala mu je pisma i bila optužena za uznemiravanje, za što je već ranije služila zatvorsku kaznu. Toner se nije pojavila na sudu zbog poslednje optužbe za uznemiravanje, a policija ju je pronašla mrtvu u njenom domu tri dana kasnije kada su posetili njenu zabarikadiranu kuću. Mrtvozornik je utvrdio da je Toner umrla od predoziranja lijekovima na recept. Godine 2000. Toner je osuđena na 30 meseci zatvora nakon devetogodišnje opsesije Gilesom, tokom koje je lažno dojavljivala bombe BBC-u i upućivala preteće telefonske pozive Gilesu i njegovoj supruzi Maureen. Toner je već ranije provela šest meseci u zatvoru zbog sličnih incidenata i zabranjeno joj je bilo kontaktirati Gilesa, BBC i Met Office. Nakon kratkog prekida posle prvobitnog zatvora, Toner je 1999. nastavila uznemiravanje. Njen advokat je 2000. izjavio da namerava pravno potkrijepiti svoju tvrdnju o roditeljstvu. Tonerina opsesija počela je krajem osamdesetih kada je njena majka, koja je imala problema s alkoholom, tvrdila da je Giles njen biološki otac. Toner je boravila kod Gilesa i njegove porodice dok je bio u braku sa njenom tetkom, ali su se kasnije razveli. Giles se ponovno oženio 1991. Na nedavnoj istrazi u Exeteru otkriveno je da je Toner 2012. godine ponovo slala pisma Gilesu. Tonerina ćerka, Dawn Taylor, rekla je da zna da je njena majka poslala pismo pre smrti, ali nije videla ostalu korespondenciju. Mrtvozornik Andrew Cox izjavio je da su Tonerine oproštajne poruke bile veoma lične. Gospođa Taylor odlučila je da sadržaj poruka privatno razmotri s policijom. Toner se nije pojavila na sudu u septembru 2012. kako bi odgovorila na nove optužbe za uznemiravanje, što je dovelo do izdavanja naloga za njeno hapšenje. Policija je pronašla njenu kuću zabarikadiranu, a unutra su otkrili njeno telo pored praznih pakovanja tableta. Toksiološki nalazi potvrdili su smrtonosno predoziranje. Na istrazi je rečeno da je Toner decenijama patila od hronične depresije, kao i bola u kukovima i leđima, te da je nedavno izgubila prava na beneficije nakon incidenta u Zavodu za zapošljavanje. Takođe je uzrujana napustila ordinaciju lekara bez dobijanja potvrde o bolovanju. Komšije su opisale Toner kao ljubaznu, ali povučenu osobu sa povremenim muškim posetiocima. Detektiv Angus Cottey iz policije Devon & Cornwall potvrdio je da su pronađene oproštajne poruke i da nema dokaza o trećoj strani. article_content: James Rhein, a 48-year-old resident of Middletown, New York, was arrested on Monday after demolishing a home on Woodland Avenue using an excavator he had rented. The house, measuring approximately 840 square feet and described as a one-story ranch-style, was legally owned by Rhein’s wife, whose name is on the deed. Authorities state that Rhein faces a felony charge of criminal mischief. Rhein claimed the house had been in disrepair for years and that he intended to obtain a permit to demolish it, but the permit office was closed for Martin Luther King Jr. Day. He then made the decision to proceed with the demolition himself. While Rhein was disposing of debris into dumpsters at the scene, police arrived after being notified by concerned parties. At that time, he had nearly completed demolishing the home. Utility providers had not been informed in advance, which resulted in emergency services being called to disconnect the electric, water, and gas lines safely. Fortunately, no injuries were reported during the incident. Rhein admitted to NBC4 New York that his wife did not know about his plans to demolish the house. He stated she was upset upon learning about it, but later claimed, 'We're good. I'm a good husband, what can I tell you?' Rhein also told reporters that he did not believe he had done anything wrong. Police indicated that additional charges may be forthcoming. Rhein was released after posting $300 bail and is scheduled to appear in Middletown court on January 30.

Kuća, veličine oko 78 kvadratnih metara i opisana kao prizemnica, pravno je bila u vlasništvu Rheinove supruge, čije ime je upisano u vlasnički list. Vlasti navode da se protiv Rheina vodi krivični postupak zbog uništavanja imovine. Rhein je izjavio da je kuća godinama bila u lošem stanju i da je planirao tražiti dozvolu za rušenje, ali je biro za izdavanje dozvola bio zatvoren zbog Dana Martina Luthera Kinga. Potom je sam odlučio krenuti u rušenje. Dok je odlagao građevinski otpad u kontejnere na licu mjesta, policija je došla nakon prijave zabrinutih građana. Tada je gotovo završio sa rušenjem kuće. Komunalne službe nisu bile ranije obaviještene, što je dovelo do hitnog izlaska službi radi isključivanja električne energije, vode i plina. Srećom, niko nije povrijeđen tokom incidenta. Rhein je za NBC4 New York priznao da njegova supruga nije znala za njegove planove. Naveo je da je bila uzrujana kada je saznala, ali je kasnije izjavio: 'Mi smo dobro. Ja sam dobar muž, šta da vam kažem?' Rhein je također rekao novinarima da smatra da nije učinio ništa loše. Policija navodi da su moguće dodatne optužbe. Rhein je pušten nakon što je uplatio kauciju od 300 dolara i treba se pojaviti na sudu u Middletownu 30. januara.

Major shipping carriers, including the U.S. Postal Service (USPS), FedEx, and United Parcel Service (UPS), are prepared to handle the projected increase in package deliveries this holiday season—a reassuring development for both retailers and shoppers. This year’s outlook remains stable and efficient, a welcome change from the pandemic years when disruptions, staffing shortages, and surging online orders strained delivery systems. 

Postmaster General Louis DeJoy stated that the USPS aims for peak season deliveries to be both “superior and routine.” According to Satish Jindel of ShipMatrix, the parcel industry has the capacity to deliver over 120 million packages daily, even though the peak holiday demand is expected to reach 82 million parcels per day, which is slightly lower than last year. Still, Jindel warned consumers not to procrastinate on holiday purchases. “It’s not a ticket to procrastination,” he cautioned.

For many retailers, the holiday season accounts for more than half of their annual sales. The National Retail Federation forecasts U.S. holiday retail sales to increase between 3% and 4% in 2023. Black Friday and Cyber Monday remain two of the busiest shopping days.

To meet seasonal demand, UPS continues on its path to hire around 100,000 workers and is prepared to provide the reliable service shoppers expect, said UPS spokesperson Jim Mayer. FedEx is also hiring in certain locations and stands ready for the holiday rush, according to spokesperson Christina Meek. Meanwhile, the USPS has recruited 10,000 seasonal employees and has installed approximately 150 new package sorting machines since last year, expanding its capacity to handle up to 70 million packages a day.

Jindel predicts on-time delivery rates for FedEx and UPS will be in the mid- to high-90% range, while the USPS performance could also reach the mid-90s. The USPS chose not to impose holiday shipping surcharges, distinguishing itself from FedEx and UPS, who both implemented extra fees for deliveries through January. Even so, Jindel expects about half as many shipments will incur these surcharges compared to last year and notes that some shipping rates have decreased.

___
This story has been updated to correct the United Parcel Service spokesperson’s first name to Jim Mayer, not John.

Ove godine očekuje se stabilna i efikasna isporuka, što je značajna promjena u odnosu na pandemijske godine kada su poremećaji, nedostatak osoblja i rast online narudžbi opteretili sisteme dostave.

Generalni poštar Louis DeJoy izjavio je da USPS ima za cilj da praznične isporuke budu „vrhunske i rutinske.“ Prema podacima Satisha Jindela iz ShipMatrixa, industrija paketa ima kapacitet za isporuku preko 120 miliona paketa dnevno, iako se očekuje da će vrh potražnje tokom praznika biti oko 82 miliona paketa dnevno, što je malo manje nego prošle godine. Ipak, Jindel upozorava potrošače da ne odgađaju prazničnu kupovinu. „To nije dozvola za odugovlačenje“, istakao je.

Za mnoge trgovce, praznična sezona čini više od polovine godišnje prodaje. Nacionalna federacija trgovaca predviđa da će praznična prodaja u SAD-u porasti između 3% i 4% u 2023. godini. Crni petak i Cyber ponedjeljak ostaju dva najprometnija dana za kupovinu.

Kako bi odgovorili na sezonsku potražnju, UPS nastavlja s planom da zaposli oko 100.000 radnika i spreman je pružiti pouzdanu uslugu koju kupci očekuju, rekao je portparol UPS-a Jim Mayer. FedEx također zapošljava u pojedinim lokacijama i spreman je za prazničnu sezonu, navela je portparolka Christina Meek. U međuvremenu, USPS je zaposlio 10.000 sezonskih radnika i instalirao oko 150 novih mašina za sortiranje paketa od prošle godine, čime je povećan kapacitet na 70 miliona paketa dnevno.

Jindel predviđa da će tačnost isporuke na vrijeme za FedEx i UPS biti u srednjim do visokim 90%, dok bi USPS mogao dostići srednje 90%. USPS je odlučio da ne uvede praznične dodatne troškove za isporuku, čime se razlikuje od FedEx-a i UPS-a, koji su uveli dodatne naknade za isporuku do januara. Ipak, Jindel očekuje da će ove godine polovina manje pošiljki biti obuhvaćena tim naknadama u odnosu na prošlu godinu, a neki troškovi dostave su i smanjeni.

___
Ova priča je ažurirana kako bi se ispravno navelo ime portparola United Parcel Service-a: Jim Mayer, a ne John.

article_content: Columbus Short, the former 'Scandal' actor, has pleaded not guilty to a felony battery charge, according to a spokesperson for the Los Angeles Superior Court. Short was arrested in March after allegedly punching and knocking out a patron at a restaurant in West Los Angeles. He appeared in court on Wednesday and is scheduled to return on June 5, when a date for a preliminary hearing may be set. Short has faced other allegations of violence. She filed for a restraining order to keep him away from her and their two-year-old daughter, as well as for a divorce to end their nine-year marriage. Soon after these allegations, Columbus Short announced that he would not return to the hit ABC television series, 'Scandal.' CNN's Joan Yeam contributed to this report.

article_content: A small fragment of Mars that landed on Earth during a meteorite shower is expected to fetch £160,000 at auction. The rock, measuring just 3.5 inches long and weighing 11.5 ounces, originally formed beneath the surface of Mars before being blasted free by an asteroid impact millions of years ago. After traveling through space, the fragment became part of a meteorite shower that landed in the Moroccan desert in 2011. The meteorite was named after the village of Tissint, where it was discovered. Experts have described this meteorite shower as the most significant to strike Earth in the past century. An American company specializing in meteorite collection acquired the meteorite, and earlier this year, sold the main piece (weighing 2.5 pounds) to the Natural History Museum in London. The company retained this smaller fragment, which is now available at auction. The fragment is an igneous rock formed from solidified lava and features a glossy black fusion crust. Jim Walker of Heritage Auctions remarked, 'This piece is part of the same meteorite as the largest fragment from the shower. It fits with the bigger piece like a 3D jigsaw puzzle.' Walker noted that meteorite showers often fall in the Sahara Desert, and local residents have learned to collect unfamiliar stones. Pieces identified as Martian have become highly sought after by collectors, and this specimen is considered reasonably priced due to the scarcity of such material. Walker added, 'This piece has a beautiful fusion crust, which increases its value. Lunar and Martian rocks are the most prized among meteorite collectors, but very little material is available. Most lunar samples are held by NASA and rarely released to the public.' The auction is scheduled to take place in New York on October 14, 2012.

Nakon što je putovao kroz svemir, fragment je postao dio meteorskog pljuska koji je 2011. godine pao u marokansku pustinju. Meteorit je dobio ime po selu Tissint, gdje je pronađen. Stručnjaci su ovaj meteorski pljusak opisali kao najvažniji koji je pogodio Zemlju u posljednjih sto godina. Američka kompanija specijalizirana za sakupljanje meteorita otkupila je meteorit i ranije ove godine prodala glavni komad (težine 1,13 kg) Prirodoslovnom muzeju u Londonu. Kompanija je zadržala ovaj manji fragment koji je sada ponuđen na aukciji. Fragment je magmatska stijena nastala od očvrsle lave i ima sjajnu crnu fuzionu koru. Walker je dodao: 'Ovaj komad ima predivnu fuzionu koru koja dodatno povećava njegovu vrijednost. Lunarna i marsovska stijena su najcjenjenije među kolekcionarima meteorita, ali vrlo malo materijala je dostupno. Većina lunarnih uzoraka je kod NASA-e i rijetko ih daju javnosti.' Aukcija je zakazana za 14. oktobar 2012. u New Yorku.

For the past five years, Perth-based photographer Jarrad Seng has been mistaken for the well-known American DJ Steve Aoki because of their similar looks, including their long, dark hair. When Seng found out that Aoki would be performing in Perth at the Stereosonic festival, he decided to fully embrace the coincidence. With the help of friends, he transformed his appearance using a fake beard, sunglasses, a baseball-style jacket, and a feathered headdress to mimic Aoki’s signature style.

Strolling through the Claremont Showground during the festival, Seng was quickly surrounded by fans eager for selfies, believing he was Aoki. The excitement peaked as real DJ Steve Aoki took the stage, creating plenty of confusion as festivalgoers saw 'Aoki' both in the audience and performing. One fan even lifted Seng onto his shoulders and carried him to the front, aware that he wasn’t the actual DJ but enjoying the joke.

Seng documented the experience in a Facebook video called 'Three hours of silent walking through Stereosonic in Perth… as Steve Aoki,' which gained significant attention online and inspired festivalgoers to share their own "#fakeaoki" moments. Although Seng felt a bit guilty about deceiving so many people, he stressed that the prank was all in good fun.

Eventually, Steve Aoki learned about Seng’s impersonation and brought it up during a radio interview, admitting that he had spotted his doppelgänger in the crowd and even pointed at him. Seng’s playful idea delighted hundreds at the festival, giving everyone a memorable and light-hearted moment.

Kada je saznao da će Aoki nastupati na festivalu Stereosonic u Perthu, Seng je odlučio potpuno prigrliti tu slučajnost. Uz pomoć prijatelja, potpuno se preobrazio – stavio je lažnu bradu, sunčane naočale, bejzbolsku jaknu i perjanicu kako bi oponašao Aokijev prepoznatljivi stil.

Šetajući kroz Claremont Showground tokom festivala, Seng je ubrzo bio okružen fanovima željnim selfija, uvjerenima da je on Aoki. Uzbuđenje je dostiglo vrhunac kada je pravi DJ Steve Aoki izašao na binu, što je dovelo do zabune jer su ga mnogi vidjeli i u publici i na nastupu. Jedan fan ga je čak podigao na ramena i odnio do prvih redova, iako je znao da nije pravi DJ, ali se rado priključio šali.

Seng je cijelo iskustvo snimio i objavio video na Facebooku pod nazivom 'Tri sata tihe šetnje kroz Stereosonic u Perthu... kao Steve Aoki', koji je privukao veliku pažnju online i inspirirao posjetitelje festivala da podijele svoje vlastite "#fakeaoki" trenutke. Iako je Seng priznao da se malo loše osjećao jer je prevario toliko ljudi, naglasio je da je sve bilo u duhu dobre zabave.

Na kraju je i sam Steve Aoki saznao za Sengovu šalu i spomenuo je u radijskom intervjuu, priznajući da je primijetio svog dvojnika u publici i čak mu mahnuo. Sengova duhovita ideja razveselila je stotine ljudi na festivalu, donoseći svima nezaboravan i vedar trenutak.

article_content: Rafael Nadal will determine later this month whether he will compete in November’s ATP World Tour Finals. Reports from Spanish radio on Wednesday said that the world No. 3 would miss the season-ending event in London due to upcoming appendix surgery. However, Nadal’s spokesperson denied these claims and insisted that a decision will be made after he plays at the ATP Swiss Indoors in Basel next week. Last week, Nadal was knocked out in the second round of the Shanghai Masters after being diagnosed with appendicitis. He has acknowledged that he will need surgery after the season, although the exact timing is still uncertain. Last year, Nadal was runner-up to Novak Djokovic at the ATP World Tour Finals at the O2 Arena. Andy Murray, currently ranked 10th in the Race to London—two places outside qualifying—could benefit if Nadal withdraws. There are also questions about whether Novak Djokovic will play at the O2 Arena, as his first child is due in November. Murray continues his efforts to qualify this week in Vienna at the Erste Bank Open, where he plays his opening match on Thursday against world No. 44 Vasek Pospisil.

Međutim, Nadalov portparol je demantovao te navode i naglasio da će odluka biti donesena nakon nastupa na ATP Swiss Indoors turniru u Baselu naredne sedmice. Prošle sedmice, Nadal je ispao u drugom kolu Shanghai Mastersa, nakon što mu je dijagnosticirana upala slijepog crijeva. article_content: Six players from the Motherwell Rugby Club drowned after being caught in strong currents at Bluewater Bay beach in Port Elizabeth, South Africa. The incident took place on Sunday after a training session, as the players went swimming to cool off. One body has been recovered, while five others are missing and presumed drowned after the group was swept out by powerful rip tides. The National Sea Rescue Institute (NSRI) reported that a total of 21 swimmers were caught in the current, with 15 successfully rescued. According to Ian Gray, station commander at NSRI, an extensive search was carried out using three rescue crafts, a rubber duck, a jet ski, and an emergency services helicopter, but no further missing players were found. The missing individuals are believed to be in their early 20s, all members of the Motherwell Rugby Club. A helicopter from the South African Air Force joined the search, which continued into Monday morning. Rescuers described the scene as 'hellish,' with lifeguards overwhelmed by the number of people needing help. Lifesaver Brendon Helm told the media that he and eight colleagues could not reach everyone despite their efforts. The Motherwell Rugby Club confirmed the loss of six players and said families were being informed. Team manager Mcdisi Mazamba explained that the players were enjoying a routine swim following training when the sudden currents swept them away. He recalled seeing arms and hands in the air as the swimmers were taken by the sea. All rescued victims were treated on the beach for shock and near-drowning symptoms. Police have opened an inquest, and the recovered body has been sent for forensic examination. The South African Rugby Union (SARU) described the occurrence as a 'devastating tragedy.' SARU president Oregan Hoskins expressed condolences to the families, noting the players were due to participate in a tournament in Cape Town next month.
translated_content: Šest igrača ragbi kluba Motherwell utopilo se nakon što su ih jake struje zahvatile na plaži Bluewater Bay u Port Elizabethu, Južna Afrika. Incident se dogodio u nedjelju nakon treninga, kada su igrači otišli na kupanje da se osvježe. Jedno tijelo je pronađeno, dok se pet drugih vodi kao nestalo i pretpostavlja se da su se utopili nakon što ih je jaka morska struja odnijela daleko od obale. Nacionalni institut za spasavanje na moru (NSRI) izvijestio je da je ukupno 21 plivač bio zahvaćen tom strujom, a 15 je spašeno. Prema riječima Iana Graya, zapovjednika stanice NSRI, sprovedena je velika potraga uz korištenje tri spasilačka broda, gumenog čamca, jet skija i helikoptera hitne službe, ali nestali igrači nisu pronađeni. Pretpostavlja se da su nestale osobe mladići u ranim dvadesetim godinama, svi članovi ragbi kluba Motherwell. article_content: Over-the-knee boots have made a striking comeback on the High Street, reigniting debates on style and age-appropriateness. This trending footwear, seen on fashion runways, divides opinions—are they empowering or inappropriate, especially for women over 40?  Four writers from the Mail decided to put these boots to the test.  Melissa Kite, 42, tried a £60 pair of thigh-hugging suede boots from Next. Struggling to pull them on, she found them tight, particularly around the ankles, and faced difficulty walking in their four-inch heels. Paired with a mini-dress and no tights, Melissa felt self-conscious, debating whether she looked more like Julia Roberts in 'Pretty Woman' or Robin Williams in 'Mrs. Doubtfire,' according to her boyfriend Will. Later, her friend Stephen appreciated the bold fashion choice, though Melissa was unsure whether onlookers admired her or worried she might trip. While the boots felt restrictive, Melissa enjoyed transforming her look and felt more feminine—if only she could master walking in them.  Frances Hardy, 57, tried £250 Duo Dita suede boots. Getting them zipped required effort, and the fit was uneven until she discovered the importance of correct calf sizing. Once fitted properly and styled with skinny jeans, Frances appreciated the boots' leg-lengthening effect. Her partner, Iain, reservedly approved, and her friends complimented her look during a lunch outing. Her daughter Amy was critical, suggesting the boots suit those with model-like legs, but Frances was inclined to ignore her advice.  Kate Battersby, 50, wore £525 Russell & Bromley snakeskin boots with four-inch heels. Hoping for a chic transformation reminiscent of 'The Devil Wears Prada,' she instead felt her legs looked unflattering and received mostly negative reactions. Friends compared the boots to stage costumes, and a younger acquaintance pointed out their association with younger celebrities. Despite these challenges, Kate concluded the boots weren't for her.  Ruth Sunderland, 46, opted for £149 boots from Dune. As a conservative dresser, Ruth initially worried about the boots being too provocative for her work environment, but found them more reminiscent of the Three Musketeers than anything else. The boots were comfortable and warm, and her mother praised their stylish color. Ruth concluded that while not every pair of thigh boots fits the 'Pretty Woman' stereotype, some can feel both chic and practical.  Ultimately, the article highlights how over-the-knee boots elicit varied reactions, especially regarding age and personal style. The writers’ experiences underscore challenges in fit, comfort, and societal expectations, reflecting broader conversations around fashion and self-expression.

In her memoir, 'Diary of a Mad Diva,' Joan Rivers delivers her signature humor with brutal honesty — especially when it comes to herself. She pokes fun at her age and looks, joking about dating Abraham Lincoln and being so unattractive even mythic beings wouldn’t take notice. Rivers freely discusses her passion for plastic surgery, joking that her hospital visits for procedures like brow-lifts and tummy tucks are almost routine, though she’s quick to admit such changes don’t alter her core nature.

Now in her eighties, Rivers paints herself as a spirited New Yorker who embraces the lively, sometimes rough culture of Manhattan, where daily run-ins are just another part of life. She remains unapologetically bold, embracing her comedic persona by saying what others might not dare.

The autobiography overflows with sharp critiques and unapologetic observations about celebrities and everyday people. Joan expresses her regret at not becoming a Hollywood film star, wryly commenting that roles seemingly suited for her often go to others. Instead, she found her fame through cable television, where she’s known for lampooning celebrities, whom she describes in less-than-flattering terms.

Joan’s humor spares no one — whether she’s talking about city workers, celebrities, or average folks, her jokes and stories are biting and direct. She has little patience for self-pity, trendy fads, or the trappings of modern television, preferring to cut straight to the heart of any topic with sarcasm and candor.

Her writing is rich with analogies, pointed jabs, and classic Rivers one-liners. She targets both the famous and the ordinary, lacing her memoir with jokes about well-known public figures, quirky observations, and even comedic 'curses' she wishes on those who annoy her.

In the end, the book affirms Rivers’ reputation as an inimitable comedic powerhouse — unsentimental, undaunted by trends, and always eager to transform daily frustrations into laughter. Where she jokes that new forensic technology prevents mischief, she finds that delivering a perfectly timed joke is nearly as satisfying.

U svojim memoarima „Dnevnik lude dive“, Joan Rivers donosi svoj tipični humor s brutalnom iskrenošću – posebno kad se šali na sopstveni račun. Zbijajući šale o svojim godinama i izgledu, pominje kako je nekad bila u vezi s Abrahamom Lincolnom i toliko je neprivlačna da je čak ni mitska bića ne primjećuju. Rivers otvoreno govori o svojoj opsesiji plastičnom hirurgijom, našalivši se kako su joj odlasci u bolnicu na operacije poput podizanja obrva ili zatezanja stomaka postali gotovo rutina, ali odmah priznaje da te promjene ne mijenjaju njenu suštinu.

Danas, u osamdesetim, Rivers sebe opisuje kao energičnu Njujorčanku koja voli užurban i ponekad grub život Manhattana, gdje su svakodnevni incidenti jednostavno normalna pojava. Nepokolebljivo je hrabra, njegovajući svoj komički identitet iznoseći ono što drugi ne bi.

Autobiografija je prepuna oštrih kritika i duhovitih uvida o slavnim ličnostima i običnim ljudima. Joan izražava žal zbog propuštene filmske karijere, ironično napominjući da uloge koje bi joj odgovarale često završe kod drugih. Umjesto toga, proslavila se na kablovskoj televiziji, gdje je poznata po ismijavanju slavnih, često ih opisuje bez imalo uljepšavanja.

Joanin humor ne štedi nikoga – bilo da se radi o gradskim radnicima, poznatim ličnostima ili običnim ljudima, njene šale i zapažanja su britki i direktni. Ne podnosi samosažaljenje, modne trendove niti površnost modernih TV emisija, uvijek dajući prednost iskrenosti i sarkazmu.

Njeno pisanje puno je originalnih poređenja, britkih komentara i tipičnih Riversovih šala. U knjizi se jednako šali na račun poznatih ljudi i svakodnevnih situacija, uključujući čak i humoristične „kletve” onima koji je iznerviraju.

Knjiga potvrđuje Riversovu reputaciju kao neponovljive kraljice komedije – bez sentimentalnosti, otporne na trendove i uvijek u stanju da svakodnevnu frustraciju pretvori u smijeh. Dok se šali da joj moderna forenzika ne dopušta stare nestašluke, zaključuje da je dobro ispričana šala skoro pa jednako zadovoljstvo.

article_content: On September 5, New York City enforced strict regulations on Airbnb, causing a significant drop in short-term rental listings. Despite Airbnb's efforts to block these rules, the new law reduced available listings from about 22,000 in August to roughly 3,000—mostly limited to stays of 30 days or more, as required by city law. The intention behind this move was to ease New York’s affordable housing crisis, where the average studio apartment rents for over $3,000 a month. Turning short-term rentals into long-term housing increases available units and could stabilize or lower rental costs. Airbnb denies responsibility for the housing shortage, but evidence from other cities supports such measures. Irvine, California, implemented a similar short-term rental ban in 2018. According to a study in Real Estate Economics, rents in Irvine fell by an average of 3% after the ban, as landlords rented more units long-term, increasing competition and supply. A key factor in Irvine's success was dedicated enforcement. The city worked with a property-tech firm to locate illegal rentals and responded to community concerns. By 2021, Irvine had halved its short-term rental listings, resulting in an estimated $80.7 million reduction in annual total rental payments. Similar studies in Berlin and Boston reveal that Airbnb increases rents in surrounding neighborhoods. When properties shift from long-term to short-term rentals, housing supply decreases, forcing residents to compete for fewer options and raising prices. In Irvine, theories that bans would harm the local economy or tourism did not hold up. Instead, increasing long-term rental supply benefited renters, particularly those at risk of displacement. Programs that pay landlords to convert short-term rentals to long-term use, such as in Summit County, Colorado, are expensive and not easily scalable. Critics and Airbnb representatives argue that several complex factors influence the housing crisis. They question whether bans alone address affordable housing, pointing out ongoing housing shortages. Research generally finds that expanding long-term housing options—even at higher price points—benefits the entire rental market, indirectly assisting lower-income renters. Restricting short-term rentals is not a complete solution, but it can help reduce housing pressures. Katya Schwenk is a Phoenix-based journalist and current fellow at The Lever.
translated_content: Dana 5. septembra, New York City je uveo stroge propise za Airbnb, što je dovelo do značajnog smanjenja kratkoročnog najma. Unatoč pokušajima Airbnb-a da zaustavi ova pravila, novi zakon je smanjio broj dostupnih oglasa sa oko 22.000 u augustu na otprilike 3.000 – većinom ograničenih na boravke od 30 dana ili više, kako nalaže gradski zakon. Cilj ove mjere bio je umanjiti krizu pristupačnog stanovanja u New Yorku, gdje prosječna garsonjera košta preko 3.000 dolara mjesečno. Pretvaranjem kratkoročnih najma u dugoročno stanovanje povećava se broj dostupnih jedinica i mogu se stabilizirati ili smanjiti troškovi najma. Airbnb odbacuje odgovornost za krizu stanovanja, ali primjeri iz drugih gradova podržavaju ovakve mjere. Irvine, Kalifornija, uveo je sličnu zabranu kratkoročnih najma 2018. godine. Studija iz časopisa Real Estate Economics pokazala je da su kirije u Irvineu pale u prosjeku za 3% nakon zabrane, jer su vlasnici više jedinica iznajmljivali za dugoročan najam, povećavajući konkurenciju i ponudu. Glavni faktor uspjeha u Irvineu bila je konzistentna provedba – grad je angažovao tehnološku firmu za nekretnine kako bi identifikovao ilegalne najmove i rješavao prijave iz zajednice. Do 2021. broj kratkoročnih najma u Irvineu prepolovljen je, što je dovelo do procijenjenog smanjenja godišnje potrošnje za najam od 80,7 miliona dolara. Slične studije u Berlinu i Bostonu potvrđuju da Airbnb podiže kirije u okolnim naseljima. Kada se nekretnine preusmjere sa dugoročnog na kratkoročan najam, ponuda stanova se smanjuje, zbog čega stanari moraju više plaćati za manje dostupnih opcija. U Irvineu nisu potvrđene teorije da bi zabrana negativno utjecala na lokalnu ekonomiju ili turizam. Naprotiv, povećanje dugoročnog najma pomoglo je osobama pod rizikom od preseljenja. Programi koji plaćaju vlasnicima da prebace kratkoročne najmove u dugoročne, poput onog u okrugu Summit u Koloradu, su skupi i teško održivi. Kritičari i predstavnici Airbnb-a tvrde da je kriza stanovanja rezultat niza složenih faktora te sumnjaju da zabrana sama po sebi može riješiti problem pristupačnosti, posebno uz postojećih manjak stanova. Istraživanja pokazaju da proširenje opcija dugoročnog najma – čak i skupljih – pozitivno djeluje na cjelokupno tržište, što posredno koristi i onima s nižim primanjima. Ograničenje kratkoročnih najma nije potpuno rješenje, ali može ublažiti pritisak na tržište stanova. Katya Schwenk je novinarka iz Phoenixa i stipendistica u The Lever.

Abu Qatada, a prominent radical preacher with links to Osama Bin Laden, remains in the UK despite prolonged government efforts to deport him to Jordan. The British government is now seeking new assurances from Jordan that Qatada would receive a fair trial without the use of evidence obtained by torture if returned.

A recent ruling by the Court of Appeal accepted that Qatada is seen as a threat, but prioritized concerns about the fairness of his potential trial in Jordan. This legal hurdle has frustrated officials including Deputy Prime Minister Nick Clegg and Home Secretary Theresa May, who have called for renewed action to resolve the issue.

Justice Secretary Chris Grayling has attributed delays in the deportation process to resistance within Parliament to amending human rights laws. As Theresa May plans a final Supreme Court appeal, officials warn that failure could mean Qatada’s release within days. For over a decade, the government has sought to finalize an agreement with Jordan that meets court requirements regarding torture evidence and trial fairness.

The government has reaffirmed its commitment to deporting Qatada and is working closely with Jordanian authorities to secure the necessary legal assurances.

Britanska vlada sada traži nova uvjeravanja od Jordana da će Qatada imati pošteno suđenje i da neće biti korišteni dokazi dobiveni mučenjem, ukoliko bude vraćen.

Nedavna presuda Žalbenog suda priznaje da se Qatadu smatra prijetnjom, ali stavlja fokus na zabrinutost zbog pravednosti suđenja u Jordanu. Ova pravna prepreka izaziva frustraciju kod zvaničnika kao što su zamjenik premijera Nick Clegg i ministrica unutrašnjih poslova Theresa May, koji pozivaju na dodatne napore za rješenje ovog pitanja.

Ministar pravde Chris Grayling odgađanje procesa deportacije pripisuje otporu Parlamenta prema izmjenama zakona o ljudskim pravima. Kako Theresa May planira posljednju žalbu Vrhovnom sudu, zvaničnici upozoravaju da bi neuspjeh mogao značiti Qatadino puštanje na slobodu u roku od nekoliko dana. Više od decenije vlada pokušava postići dogovor s Jordanom koji bi zadovoljio sudske zahtjeve u vezi s isključivanjem dokaza dobivenih mučenjem i osiguravanjem pravednog suđenja.

Vlada je potvrdila svoju odlučnost da deportuje Qatadu i nastavlja blisku saradnju s jordanskim vlastima kako bi osigurala potrebne pravne garancije.

article_content: In Newburgh, New York, two boys survived being buried under a mountain of snow for nearly four hours after a snowplow operator accidentally covered them while they were making a snow fort. Jason ‘J.J.’ Rivera, 9, and his cousin Elijah ‘Papito’ Martinez, 11, were trapped until police and neighbors rescued them. Alarm arose when the boys didn’t come home Wednesday night; after searching without success, their families called police. Officers found the boys had last been seen near the Family Health Center and discovered their location when Officer Brandon Rola noticed a shovel protruding from a snowbank. Acting quickly, Rola and other police, with help from community members, dug through the snow and found a boot, then both boys, who were conscious and breathing thanks to an air pocket in the snow. Sgt. Aaron Weaver attested the air pocket saved their lives. The cousins were treated for cold exposure at Westchester Medical Center and are doing well. Families and police expressed deep relief after the urgent rescue.
translated_content: U Newburghu, New York, dva dječaka preživjela su pošto su skoro četiri sata bila zatrpana ispod gomile snijega nakon što ih je ralica slučajno prekrila dok su pravili snježnu tvrđavu. Jason 'J.J.' Rivera (9) i njegov rođak Elijah 'Papito' Martinez (11) spaseni su zahvaljujući brzoj reakciji policije i komšija. Alarm je podignut kada se dječaci nisu vratili kući u srijedu naveče; nakon bezuspješne potrage, porodice su pozvale policiju. Policajci su saznali da su dječaci posljednji put viđeni kod Family Health Center, a mjesto nesreće otkrili su kada je policajac Brandon Rola primijetio lopatu koja viri iz snijega. On i drugi policajci, zajedno sa komšijama, brzo su počeli da kopaju, pronašli dječju čizmu, a zatim i dječake, koji su bili pri svijesti i disali zahvaljujući džepu zraka ispod snijega. Narednik Aaron Weaver je rekao da im je taj džep zraka spasio život. Rođaci su zbrinuti u Westchester Medical Center zbog izloženosti hladnoći i sada su dobro. Porodice i policija izrazili su veliko olakšanje nakon ove dramatične akcije spašavanja.

article_content: OpenAI, the developer behind ChatGPT, announced on Friday that it has dismissed its co-founder and CEO, Sam Altman, after a review found he was 'not consistently candid in his communications' with the board of directors. The board said in a statement, 'The board no longer has confidence in his ability to continue leading OpenAI.' Since Altman helped bring ChatGPT to worldwide attention, he has become a leading voice in discussions about artificial intelligence’s potential and risks. His unexpected and largely unexplained departure brings uncertainty to the industry's future direction. Mira Murati, OpenAI's chief technology officer, will take over as interim CEO while the company searches for a permanent replacement. The announcement also stated that Greg Brockman, a co-founder and board chairman, would leave his role as chairman. OpenAI initially stated Brockman would stay as president, but he later wrote on X (formerly Twitter), 'based on today’s news, I quit,' indicating his decision to leave. OpenAI did not disclose specifics about Altman's alleged lack of candor, only that it affected the board's ability to fulfill its responsibilities. Altman posted on X shortly after the news: 'i loved my time at openai. it was transformative for me personally, and hopefully the world a little bit. most of all i loved working with such talented people. will have more to say about what’s next later.' Later, he added, 'today was a weird experience in many ways. but one unexpected one is that it has been sorta like reading your own eulogy while you’re still alive. the outpouring of love is awesome. one takeaway: go tell your friends how great you think they are.' A Wall Street Journal report claims Altman felt shocked and upset by his ouster, attributing it to a power struggle with the board, notably involving Ilya Sutskever, OpenAI’s chief scientist and fellow co-founder. Disputes reportedly centered on balancing the pace of AI development with safety concerns. Altman's sudden removal has caused surprise across the tech industry. The announcement comes after a week in which Altman made several public appearances representing the company, marking a significant reversal for the influential AI advocate.

article_content: Move over, Samuel Pepys—a new diarist has emerged whose life's work rivals even the great chronicler of the 17th century. John Gadd is believed to have compiled the largest personal diary ever seen in Britain. His collection weighs half a tonne, consists of 151 volumes, covers more than 21,000 pages and contains over four million words. The diary is also visually rich, featuring more than 33,000 photographs, illustrations, newspaper clippings, and everyday items like wine labels and food wrappers—offering a vivid snapshot of one man's life. At 83 years old, Gadd first started writing his diary in 1947. Aside from an annual two-week break dedicated to meticulously updating indexes, he has consistently logged his daily experiences. Every Christmas, he sets time aside to index the year’s entries and proudly claims he can find any entry within just three minutes. Gadd’s diary is now eight times longer than War and Peace, nearly five times the size of Shakespeare’s collected works, and approaches the total output of Charles Dickens. It is three times the length of Samuel Pepys’ diaries, famous for their documentation of the Enlightenment era. For Gadd, the diary serves as a chronicle of life in and around Fontmell Magna, Dorset, where he lives with his wife, Barbara. 'The volumes document everything. You name it, it’s in there,' he says. 'I write about whatever captures my imagination during the day. I just keep a record in case no one else does—I admit, I’m a total obsessive.' Gadd’s entries include detailed descriptions of village fetes, walks with his beloved Yorkshire Terriers, and collections of favorite wine labels and food wrappers—some showcasing prices from decades past. He also records experiences from a 33-year career as an international pig consultant, which took him all over the world. The diary not only chronicles everyday moments but also major historical changes, such as the transition from vinyl records to CDs, the postal strike of 1988, and community celebrations like village VE Day street parties. It even documents personal memories, like childhood photos and family anecdotes. Gadd indexes his diaries with precision, allowing him to retrieve any subject or illustration within three minutes. He maintains separate indexes for text and illustrations, updating them every Christmas. The diary has now gone on public display for the first time, with ten volumes and an index featured at the Fontmell Magna Village Archive Society’s 9th annual exhibition. Reflecting on decades of writing, Gadd acknowledges that, at first, keeping the diary was hard work and sometimes tedious. Over time, he became more honest in his writing, appreciating how his perspectives changed. 'Looking back, you sometimes don’t like what you read from 30 years ago,' he notes, emphasizing the diary’s value for personal reflection and as a record for future generations.
translated_content: Pomakni se, Samuel Pepys—na scenu je stupio novi kroničar čije životno djelo nadmašuje čak i poznatog kroničara 17. stoljeća. Vjeruje se da je John Gadd sastavio najveći lični dnevnik ikada viđen u Britaniji. Njegova zbirka teži pola tone, sastoji se od 151 sveska, ima više od 21.000 stranica i sadrži preko četiri miliona riječi. Dnevnik je bogato opremljen s više od 33.000 fotografija, ilustracija, novinskih izrezaka i svakodnevnih predmeta poput vinskih etiketa i omota od hrane—pružajući živopisnu sliku jednog života. Sa 83 godine, Gadd je započeo pisanje svog dnevnika još 1947. godine. Osim dvosedmične godišnje pauze koju koristi za temeljito ažuriranje indeksa, on dosljedno bilježi svoja svakodnevna iskustva. Svakog Božića izdvaja vrijeme za indeksiranje zapisa iz prošle godine i sa zadovoljstvom tvrdi da može pronaći bilo koji unos za samo tri minute. Gaddov dnevnik je sada osam puta duži od 'Rata i mira', gotovo pet puta veći od sabranih djela Shakespearea i skoro doseže ukupan opus Charlesa Dickensa. Tri puta je duži od dnevnika Samuela Pepysa, poznatih po dokumentovanju razdoblja prosvjetiteljstva. Za Gadda, dnevnik predstavlja kroniku života u i oko sela Fontmell Magna u Dorsetu, gdje živi sa suprugom Barbarom. 'Sveske bilježe sve. Šta god smislite, tu je,' kaže. 'Pišem o svemu što mi tog dana zaokupi pažnju. Samo vodim zapise u slučaju da to niko drugi ne radi—priznajem, opsesivan sam.' Gaddovi zapisi sadrže detaljne opise seoskih fešti, šetnji sa njegovim voljenim jorkširskim terijerima, kao i zbirku omiljenih vinskih etiketa i omota hrane—neki od njih pokazuju cijene iz davnih vremena. Takođe bilježi iskustva sa svoje 33-godišnje karijere međunarodnog savjetnika za svinjarstvo, što ga je vodilo širom svijeta. Dnevnik obuhvata svakodnevne trenutke, ali i velike istorijske promjene, poput prelaska sa vinila na CD, poštanski štrajk iz 1988. godine i zajedničke proslave kao što su seoske zabave povodom Dana pobjede. Bilježi čak i lična sjećanja, poput fotografija iz djetinjstva i porodičnih anegdota. Gadd veoma precizno indeksira svoje dnevnike, omogućujući sebi da pronađe svaku temu ili ilustraciju za samo tri minute. Drži odvojene indekse za tekst i slike, koje ažurira svake godine za Božić. Dnevnik je sada prvi put izložen javnosti, sa deset svezaka i jednim indeksom predstavljenim na 9. godišnjoj izložbi Arhivskog društva sela Fontmell Magna. Osvrćući se na desetljeća pisanja, Gadd priznaje da je na početku vođenje dnevnika bilo naporno i ponekad dosadno. S vremenom je postajao iskreniji prema sebi i više je cijenio kako su se njegove perspektive mijenjale. 'Kada se osvrnem, ponekad mi se ne sviđa ono što pročitam od prije 30 godina,' ističe, naglašavajući vrijednost dnevnika za ličnu refleksiju i kao zapis za buduće generacije.

article_content: Kyle Vogt has stepped down as CEO of Cruise, General Motors’ self-driving vehicle division, amid increasing concerns about autonomous vehicle safety. Vogt’s resignation, made public late Sunday, follows a full recall of Cruise’s 950 vehicles for software updates after an incident in early October when a Cruise car dragged a pedestrian in San Francisco. State regulators at the California Department of Motor Vehicles have since suspended Cruise’s operating license. Cruise has also paused its services and initiated a review led by outside experts. 'The results of our ongoing reviews will inform our next steps as we work to make Cruise safer, more transparent, and trustworthy,' the company said. 'We remain committed to the vision of safer, cleaner, and more accessible transportation through AV technology.' Cruise gained approval last year to transport paying passengers, but its vehicles have attracted criticism for creating abrupt traffic stops, sparking concerns over public safety and disruption. Late last year, U.S. transportation authorities began investigating reports that Cruise’s robotaxis sometimes brake too suddenly or stop unexpectedly—potentially leaving passengers stranded. These troubles could hinder advances in fully autonomous passenger vehicles without onboard drivers and might bring about stricter national regulations. During the day, Cruise operated approximately 300 robotaxis for free rides; at night, it ran about 100 vehicles that could charge passengers in less busy San Francisco neighborhoods. While Vogt previously asserted that most accidents stemmed from human error rather than automation, Cruise’s board accepted his resignation. Mo Elshenawy, who previously served as executive vice president of engineering, is taking over as President and Chief Technology Officer. Craig Glidden will also serve as President while ensuring continuity as Chief Administrative Officer, as previously announced. GM first acquired a controlling stake in Cruise in 2016 and expanded its ownership to 80% by May 2021. Apart from his work at Cruise, Vogt co-founded livestreaming platform Twitch, which Amazon acquired for roughly $1 billion in 2014. He is also an alumnus of MIT.

Njegova ostavka, objavljena kasno u nedjelju, slijedila je nakon potpunog povlačenja svih 950 Cruise vozila radi ažuriranja softvera, nakon incidenta početkom oktobra kad je jedno Cruise vozilo povuklo pješaka u San Franciscu. Državne vlasti iz kalifornijskog Odjela za motorna vozila potom su suspendirale Cruiseovu operativnu dozvolu. Cruise je također pauzirao usluge i pokrenuo reviziju koju vode vanjski stručnjaci. 'Rezultati naših trenutnih revizija usmjerit će naše naredne korake dok radimo na tome da Cruise učinimo sigurnijim, transparentnijim i pouzdanijim', saopćila je kompanija. 'Ostajemo posvećeni viziji sigurnijeg, čišćeg i dostupnijeg prevoza kroz tehnologiju autonomnih vozila.' Cruise je prošle godine dobio dozvolu za prevoz putnika koji plaćaju vožnju, ali su njihova vozila naišla na kritike zbog iznenadnih zaustavljanja u saobraćaju, uz zabrinutost za sigurnost i ometanje javnosti. Krajem prošle godine američke saobraćajne vlasti počele su provoditi istragu o prijavama da Cruiseovi robotaxiji ponekad naglo koče ili neočekivano staju – što može dovesti do toga da putnici ostanu zaglavljeni. Ovi problemi bi mogli usporiti napredak potpuno autonomnih putničkih vozila bez vozača i izazvati strože nacionalne regulative. Tokom dana, Cruise je koristio oko 300 robotaxija nudeći besplatne vožnje, dok je noću upravljao sa stotinjak vozila koja su mogla naplaćivati vožnje u manje prometnim kvartovima San Francisca. Craig Glidden će također služiti kao predsjednik, a zadržava mjesto glavnog administrativnog direktora, što je najavljeno ranije. GM je prvi put stekao većinsko vlasništvo nad Cruiseom 2016. godine, a kasnije povećao udio na 80% do maja 2021. Osim rada u Cruiseu, Vogt je bio suosnivač platforme Twitch za livestreaming, koju je Amazon kupio za oko milijardu dolara 2014. godine. On je također diplomirao na MIT-u.

article_content: A newly launched online anti-drinking campaign from Australia's DrinkWise is generating discussion about its real impact on young people. The campaign's stylish, black-and-white animated videos—shared via YouTube—promote the idea of drinking with class and moderation, while portraying drunkenness as socially unattractive and damaging to one's image. Yet, some health experts remain unconvinced. Research led by Professor Simone Pettigrew at Curtin University suggests the ads might backfire: young people in the study often enjoyed the humor and animation, with many even feeling encouraged to drink after watching. Critics also highlight that the videos never clarify what counts as excessive drinking; for instance, they fail to mention that more than four drinks can be considered binge drinking. In response, DrinkWise CEO John Scott points to a different study involving over 750 young viewers, claiming the campaign has already led to positive behavioral changes. He insists the messaging is effectively reaching the target audience by using language and visuals that resonate. Although aimed at promoting safer drinking habits, the campaign could unintentionally glamorize alcohol for young viewers, according to some researchers.

Ipak, neki zdravstveni stručnjaci ostaju skeptični. Istraživanje koje vodi profesorica Simone Pettigrew sa Univerziteta Curtin sugeriše da reklame mogu imati suprotan efekat: mladi iz uzorka su uživali u humoru i animaciji, a mnogi su se osjećali čak i podstaknuti na konzumiranje alkohola nakon gledanja. Kritičari takođe naglašavaju da reklame ne definišu šta zapravo predstavlja pretjerano pijenje; primjera radi, nigdje se ne spominje da više od četiri pića predstavlja opijanje. On tvrdi da poruka o umjerenosti dolazi do mladih jer koristi jezik i vizuale koji im odgovaraju. Iako je cilj kampanje promovisanje sigurnijih navika u konzumaciji alkohola, neki istraživači smatraju da bi mogla nenamjerno učiniti alkohol privlačnijim mladima.

article_content: Jean-Claude Juncker, set to become the next President of the European Commission, has stated he will address gender imbalance among Commissioners through portfolio assignments. Juncker is urging EU member states to nominate more women, stressing that a Commission with few women would lack legitimacy and credibility. He warned that if countries do not nominate more women, he may give prominent portfolios specifically to female Commissioners. Juncker told an Austrian newspaper that women could have a 'very good chance' of being chosen for key roles, such as vice-president. UK Prime Minister David Cameron has selected Lord Hill of Oareford as the UK’s candidate for European Commissioner, aiming for a significant economic post, such as competition or financial services. However, Lord Hill is relatively unknown in European circles, and reports indicate that Juncker’s staff had to look him up online. Juncker is said to prefer candidates with high-profile ministerial experience, potentially making it less likely for Lord Hill to secure a leading role. Only four women have been publicly nominated so far. European leaders are set to discuss appointments at a dinner in Brussels this weekend, but Juncker will have the final say over portfolio assignments. A successor to Baroness Ashton, the EU foreign minister for the past five years, will also be chosen. Earlier this summer, Cameron tried but failed to block Juncker’s appointment as Commission President, losing in a 26-to-2 vote among EU states. A Downing Street source told The Daily Telegraph that Lord Hill is ‘the right person for the job’, citing his business background and senior government experience as strong qualifications for the Commissioner role.

Juncker poziva države članice EU da predlože više žena, naglašavajući da Komisija sa malo žena ne bi imala legitimitet ni kredibilitet. article_content: Sarah Pierce’s twin children overcame significant odds even before birth. At 16 weeks pregnant, Sarah, a 40-year-old cashier, was diagnosed with breast cancer and required aggressive treatment. She underwent a mastectomy, chemotherapy, and radiotherapy while carrying twins. Sarah and her partner, Adam Sparkey (27), conceived through IVF after struggling with fertility challenges, including a previous ectopic pregnancy. Despite concerns that chemotherapy could harm the twins, frequent scans showed both babies continued to develop well. Medical experts consider such cases—chemotherapy during a twin pregnancy—extremely rare. After completing radiotherapy at 30 weeks, Sarah gave birth to Jack and Lily by emergency Caesarean section at Newcross Hospital, Wolverhampton, in November 2012. Both were born healthy. Sarah received additional chemotherapy following their birth, as well as a year-long course of Herceptin, and is currently in remission while taking Tamoxifen to reduce cancer recurrence risk. Sarah feels incredibly fortunate, saying her 18-month-old twins are now thriving. A spokesperson for Breakthrough Breast Cancer stated they were unaware of other cases like Sarah’s, emphasizing the uniqueness of her journey.
