Dok je nosila blizance, podvrgla se mastektomiji, hemoterapiji i radioterapiji. Sarah i njen partner Adam Sparkey (27) začeli su blizance putem IVF-a nakon problema sa plodnošću, uključujući i raniju vanmateričnu trudnoću. Iako su postojale brige da bi hemoterapija mogla naštetiti bebama, redovni pregledi pokazivali su da se obje bebe dobro razvijaju. Sarah se osjeća nevjerovatno sretnom, ističući kako su njeni 18-mjesečni blizanci danas puni života. Glasnogovornik organizacije Breakthrough Breast Cancer rekao je da ne znaju za slične slučajeve, što dodatno naglašava koliko je Sarahina priča posebna.

article_content: The Rafah border crossing connecting Gaza to Egypt has been hit multiple times, with human rights groups reporting Israeli airstrikes targeting the Palestinian side. According to Sinai for Human Rights, the third strike in 24 hours fired four missiles and forced the temporary closure of the crossing. Previous attacks damaged facilities in the buffer area between Egypt and Gaza. An Israeli military spokesperson told AFP they could not confirm or deny the airstrikes on Rafah. There was no immediate official statement about the closure from Egyptian or Palestinian authorities. On Tuesday, Israeli officials revised prior guidance that had urged Gaza residents to evacuate to Egypt through Rafah, Gaza’s only exit not under Israeli control. Gaza’s 2.3 million inhabitants are reliant on this 40-kilometer-long territory, entirely encircled by Israel and the sea, except at Rafah. Egypt and Israel have strictly regulated the passage of people and goods, enforcing a blockade on the enclave. Egypt has expressed serious alarm over the violence, pressing Israel to safeguard civilians instead of pushing them towards Sinai. President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi labeled the unfolding events 'highly dangerous,' reiterating Egypt’s commitment to seeking a peaceful resolution. He emphasized that Egypt wouldn’t accept a solution that negatively affects its security, amidst concerns that Palestinians might be forced into Sinai. Egypt, the first Arab nation to formalize ties with Israel, has played a key mediating role during previous Gaza crises and is again seeking to lower tensions. The surge in violence was sparked by a deadly Hamas attack on Israel last weekend, provoking powerful Israeli retaliation. On Monday, Israeli Defence Minister Yoav Gallant declared a 'total blockade' on Gaza, cutting water, food, fuel, and electricity. The United Nations and human rights experts, including Special Rapporteur Francesca Albanese, have warned such measures could constitute war crimes and fuel a humanitarian disaster. Albanese told Al Jazeera the bombings and siege indicate a strategy that endangers civilian lives through starvation and violence. Many in Gaza fear that another mass displacement—like the 'Nakba'—could soon occur. Gaza’s health ministry, as of Tuesday, reported at least 830 dead and more than 4,250 injured since hostilities began. Israeli authorities say more than 900 Israelis have been killed following the Hamas incursion. Growing unease surrounds the fate of Palestinian civilians, who may face an even harsher assault or ground invasion. Gaza’s interior ministry stated that Israeli strikes hit Rafah’s entry gate, and the crossing was also closed from the Egyptian side. Travelers trying to enter Gaza returned to Al Arish in Egypt, sources said. While travel and aid briefly resumed after Monday’s attack, the passage of goods remained halted, according to the UN. That day, about 800 people exited Gaza and 500 entered via Rafah, highlighting the volatility and peril faced by those on both sides.

Prema organizaciji Sinai za ljudska prava, treći napad u 24 sata ispalio je četiri rakete i privremeno zatvorio prelaz. Prethodni napadi oštetili su objekte u zoni razdvajanja između Egipta i Gaze. Glasnogovornik izraelske vojske rekao je za AFP da ne može potvrditi niti negirati zračne napade na Rafah. Nije bilo hitnih službenih izjava o zatvaranju s egipatske ili palestinske strane. U utorak su izraelski dužnosnici promijenili ranije upute koje su pozivale stanovnike Gaze da evakuišu prema Egiptu preko prelaza Rafah – jedinog izlaza koji nije pod izraelskom kontrolom. Na 40 kilometara dugoj teritoriji Gaze, gdje živi 2,3 miliona ljudi, Rafah je jedini izlaz jer je ostatak regije okružen Izraelom i morem. Egipat i Izrael strogo kontrolišu prolaz ljudi i robe, provodeći blokadu nad Gazom. Egipat je izrazio ozbiljnu zabrinutost zbog nasilja, zahtijevajući od Izraela da zaštiti civile, umjesto da ih usmjerava prema Sinaju. Predsjednik Abdel Fattah el-Sisi opisao je trenutnu situaciju kao 'izuzetno opasnu' i ponovio egipatsku posvećenost mirnom rješenju. Naglasio je da Egipat neće prihvatiti rješenje koje ugrožava njegovu sigurnost, jer postoje strahovi da bi Palestinci mogli biti prisiljeni na Sinaj. Egipat, prva arapska zemlja koja je normalizovala odnose s Izraelom, igra važnu ulogu posrednika u prethodnim krizama u Gazi i opet nastoji smiriti situaciju. Najnoviji val nasilja pokrenut je smrtonosnim napadom Hamasa na Izrael tokom prošlog vikenda, što je dovelo do snažnog odgovora Izraela. U ponedjeljak je izraelski ministar odbrane Yoav Gallant proglasio 'potpunu blokadu' Gaze, isključujući vodu, hranu, gorivo i struju. Ujedinjene nacije i stručnjaci za ljudska prava, uključujući i posebnu izvjestiteljku Francescu Albanese, upozoravaju da takve mjere mogu predstavljati ratni zločin i izazvati humanitarnu katastrofu. Albanese je za Al Jazeeru izjavila da bombardovanja i opsada ukazuju na namjeru da se životi civila dovedu u opasnost kroz glad i nasilje. Mnogi u Gazi strahuju da bi mogli biti ponovo masovno protjerani – kao tokom 'Nakbe'. Ministarstvo zdravlja Gaze, do utorka, prijavilo je najmanje 830 poginulih i više od 4.250 ranjenih od početka sukoba. Izraelske vlasti navode da je više od 900 Izraelaca poginulo nakon napada Hamasa. Rastu strahovi za sudbinu palestinskih civila, koji bi mogli doživjeti još žešće napade ili kopnenu invaziju. Ministarstvo unutrašnjih poslova Gaze navelo je da su izraelski napadi pogodili glavni ulazni punkt Rafaha, a prelaz je zatvoren i s egipatske strane. Putnici koji su pokušavali ući u Gazu vratili su se u Al Ariš u Egiptu, navode izvori. Iako su privremeno obnovljeni kretanje i humanitarna pomoć nakon napada u ponedjeljak, prijelaz za transport robe ostao je zatvoren, prema UN-u. Tog dana, oko 800 ljudi napustilo je Gazu, a 500 ušlo putem Rafaha, pokazujući nestabilnost i nesigurnost s obje strane.

article_content: A house-sized asteroid, designated 2014 UF56, is set to make a close approach to Earth today, passing at a distance of about 160,000 kilometers (0.4 times the distance to the Moon) at approximately 9:12 p.m. UTC. The asteroid, estimated to be around 15 meters wide, was only discovered a day before its flyby. Experts stress that there is no risk from the flyby. Despite its proximity, the asteroid will not be visible to the naked eye and will appear faint even through telescopes, reaching a maximum brightness of magnitude +16 as it passes from the constellation Scutum to Capricornus. Asteroid 2014 UF56 was previously observed passing by Mars in 2012 at a distance of 8 million kilometers, and will next approach Earth on February 12, 2018. The Virtual Telescope Project plans to broadcast a live online event with real-time images and scientific commentary on the flyby, starting at 7:00 p.m. UTC on their website: virtualtelescope.eu. Amateur astronomer Bob King notes that while 90% of near-Earth asteroids larger than 1 kilometer have been discovered, surveys are now focusing on identifying objects over 140 meters across. Given the sheer number of smaller asteroids, new objects like 2014 UF56 are found regularly. Separately, images were shared of Comet C/2013 A1 (Siding Spring) taken on October 19, 2014, by NASA’s Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter during the comet’s close flyby of Mars. These are the highest-resolution images ever obtained of a comet from the Oort Cloud, revealing that its nucleus is about 0.4 kilometers (a quarter mile) wide—half the previous estimate. Astronomers Nick Howes and Ron Wodaski, using the Tzec Muan Observatory in Australia, captured images showing the comet’s tail as it neared Mars. Mars appeared unusually bright in these images, as overexposure was required to make the comet visible. Howes described the global collaboration among professional and amateur astronomers leading to these successful observations, which provided valuable educational opportunities. Comet Siding Spring passed within about 140,000 km (87,000 miles) of Mars—almost a third of the distance between Earth and the Moon. NASA confirmed that its Mars spacecraft, along with those from the European Space Agency and India, came through the event unharmed. At present, none of the known potentially hazardous asteroids are on a collision course with Earth, though astronomers continue to survey the skies for new objects.
translated_content: Asteroid veličine kuće, označen kao 2014 UF56, danas će proći blizu Zemlje na udaljenosti od oko 160.000 kilometara (0,4 udaljenosti do Mjeseca) oko 21:12 sati po UTC vremenu. Asteroid, koji je procijenjen na oko 15 metara širine, otkriven je tek dan prije ovog prolaska. Stručnjaci naglašavaju da nema rizika od ovog bliskog prolaska. Uprkos blizini, asteroid neće biti vidljiv golim okom i bit će veoma slab čak i kroz teleskope, dostigavši maksimalnu svjetlinu od magnitude +16 dok prolazi iz sazviježđa Scutum u Capricornus. Asteroid 2014 UF56 je prethodno zabilježen kako prolazi pored Marsa 2012. godine na udaljenosti od 8 miliona kilometara, a sljedeći put će se približiti Zemlji 12. februara 2018. Virtual Telescope Project planira prenositi događaj uživo na internetu sa stvarnim slikama i naučnim komentarima tokom prolaska, počevši od 19:00 sati po UTC-u na njihovoj web stranici: virtualtelescope.eu. Amaterski astronom Bob King ističe da je 90% asteroida bliskih Zemlji većih od 1 kilometra već otkriveno, dok se trenutne opservacije fokusiraju na pronalazak objekata većih od 140 metara. Zbog ogromnog broja manjih asteroida, novi objekti poput 2014 UF56 se redovno otkrivaju. Posebno su podijeljene slike komete C/2013 A1 (Siding Spring) snimljene 19. oktobra 2014. pomoću NASA-inog Mars Reconnaissance Orbitera tokom njenog bliskog prolaska pored Marsa. Ovo su slike najviše rezolucije komete iz Oortovog oblaka ikada, otkrivajući da je jezgro komete oko 0,4 kilometra široko—upola manje od ranijih procjena. Astronomi Nick Howes i Ron Wodaski, koristeći opservatorij Tzec Muan u Australiji, snimili su slike repa komete dok se približavala Marsu. Mars je na tim slikama bio posebno sjajan zbog preeksponiranosti potrebne da se kometa uoči. Howes je opisao globalnu saradnju profesionalnih i amaterskih astronoma koja je omogućila ove vrijedne opservacije i edukativne prilike. Kometa Siding Spring je prohujala na oko 140.000 km (87.000 milja) od Marsa—gotovo trećinu udaljenosti između Zemlje i Mjeseca. NASA je potvrdila da su njene svemirske letjelice, kao i letjelice Evropske svemirske agencije i Indije, prošle bez problema. Trenutno nijedan od poznatih potencijalno opasnih asteroida nije na kursu sudara sa Zemljom, ali astronomi i dalje skeniraju nebo u potrazi za novim objektima.

article_content: Fitness trackers are a wallet-friendly and unobtrusive option compared to smartwatches, making them ideal for those on a budget. When choosing a tracker in 2023, consider how you want to use it, your preferred size, trusted brands, and whether you want a display. Most trackers are compact, featuring a straightforward rectangular design. Some models provide touch displays with smart features similar to entry-level smartwatches, while others rely on a smartphone app for control if they don't have a display.  Here are some standout options for affordable fitness trackers this year:  - The Redmi Band Pro is a top performer under Rs 2,000, equipped with a 1.47-inch AMOLED display. Its smart capabilities put it on par with many affordable smartwatches. On the fitness side, it offers over 100 workout modes, auto workout detection, sleep and heart rate tracking, and blood oxygen (SpO2) measurement. Regular use yields up to two weeks of battery life, stretching to 20 days in power-saving mode.  - The Realme Band 2, priced at Rs 1,800, includes a 1.4-inch TFT screen that reaches 500 nits brightness for better outdoor readability. It supports 90 different sports modes as well as heart rate and SpO2 monitoring. The tracker strap can be easily swapped for customization, and you can pick from up to 50 watch faces through the Realme link app. The battery lasts about 12 days per charge, and it's water-resistant up to 50 meters.  - If you're open to spending a bit more, the Huawei Band 7 at Rs 5,499 is worth a look. It provides automatic SpO2 monitoring, custom wallpaper with your own photos, and access to over 4,000 band faces. While native GPS is absent, pairing it with certain Android phones allows for accurate outdoor activity tracking. The band also displays lunar phases right on your wrist.  - Those focused on accuracy should consider the Fitbit Inspire 2 (Rs 6,299). Despite its basic 2-inch monochrome display, it stands out for precise activity tracking. Owners get a year-long complimentary premium membership for detailed analytics and guided routines. It tracks multiple sports, monitors sleep and heart rate, and lasts up to 10 days on a single charge.

article_content:
Waze, the navigation app from Google, has launched a crash-history alert feature that warns drivers as they approach areas with a history of frequent accidents. These alerts are powered by data reported from the Waze user community and artificial intelligence, helping identify risky locations along your route.

Each year, tragic numbers highlight the dangers on global roads, with nearly 3,700 people dying daily in traffic collisions. Waze users report crashes about every two seconds, reflecting how common these incidents are. The new alert system is designed to give you advance notice—like a message reading “History of crashes — next 1 mile”—when you’re nearing these high-risk stretches. A progress bar also helps visually indicate your proximity to the hazard zone.

Waze does not specify the exact dangers, but the general alert encourages increased driver attention. To prevent distraction, repeat travelers on the same roads will not be notified every time. The feature is available now—just update your Waze app to activate these safety alerts.

Ova upozorenja koriste podatke koje prijavljuje zajednica korisnika Wazea, kao i vještačku inteligenciju, kako bi identificirali rizične lokacije na vašoj ruti.

Nažalost, svakog dana skoro 3.700 ljudi širom svijeta izgubi život u saobraćajnim nesrećama. Korisnici Wazea prijavljuju nesreće otprilike svake dvije sekunde, što pokazuje koliko su one česte. Novi sistem upozorenja vas može unaprijed informisati porukom poput „Historija nesreća – narednih 1 milja” kada se približavate ovakvim dijelovima puta, pri čemu se pojavljuje i vizualna traka koja pokazuje koliko ste blizu zoni opasnosti.

Funkcija je već dostupna—dovoljno je da ažurirate svoju Waze aplikaciju za aktivaciju novih sigurnosnih upozorenja.

article_content: Over a span of up to three years, Italian photographer Gabriele Galimberti journeyed across more than 50 countries to photograph children with their favorite toys for a project called 'Toy Stories.' His photos feature children from places like Sweden, Malawi, Ukraine, and Lebanon, each proudly displaying cherished items such as stuffed animals, toy cars, baseball bats, or miniature dinner sets. Beyond the variety of toys, these portraits tell stories about the children's environments and parental influences. For example, Chiwa from Malawi is pictured with just a few favorite soft toys, while in Canada, Lauren treasures a doll dressed in an outfit like her own. Galimberti captures the joy, pride, and imagination that children share, irrespective of where they live. Collected in a book titled 'Toy Stories,' the 54 vivid photographs are introduced by Ben Machell, who notes that toys often mirror the families and societies children grow up in. Some toys show cultural or economic significance—such as a Mexican boy's trucks that mimic those in his village, or a Chinese child’s fascination with Monopoly. Whether children have a single prized possession, like Taha—a young refugee in Lebanon with his toy car—or an entire collection, Galimberti's images celebrate the unifying happiness that toys bring to young lives around the world.
translated_content: Tokom perioda od tri godine, italijanski fotograf Gabriele Galimberti putovao je kroz više od 50 zemalja kako bi fotografisao djecu sa njihovim omiljenim igračkama u okviru projekta pod nazivom 'Priče o igračkama.' Na njegovim fotografijama nalaze se djeca iz Švedske, Malavija, Ukrajine i Libana, koja sa ponosom pokazuju plišane životinje, autiće, bejzbol palice ili minijaturne setove za večere. Pored raznolikosti igračaka, ovi portreti odražavaju i okruženje djece te uticaj porodice. Na primjer, Chiwa iz Malavija ima samo nekoliko omiljenih mekanih igračaka, dok Lauren iz Kanade najviše voli lutku obučenu kao ona sama. Galimberti bilježi radost, ponos i maštu koju djeca dijele bez obzira na mjesto gdje odrastaju. U knjizi 'Priče o igračkama' sabrane su 54 šarene fotografije, uz uvod Bena Machella, koji naglašava kako igračke često odražavaju porodice i društva u kojima djeca odrastaju. Neke igračke imaju kulturološki ili ekonomski značaj—kao kamioni jednog dječaka iz Meksika koji podsjećaju na vozila u njegovom selu, ili kinesko dijete koje voli Monopoly. Bilo da djeca imaju jednu omiljenu igračku, kao što je Taha—mladi izbjeglica iz Libana sa svojim autićem—ili čitavu kolekciju, Galimbertijeve fotografije slave zajedničku sreću koju igračke donose djeci širom svijeta.

article_content: Reliance Jio is set to bring 5G technology to every part of West Bengal, with the company's rollout on track to be the fastest completed in India by the end of 2023, according to Reliance Industries chairman Mukesh Ambani. Speaking at the Bengal Global Business Summit (BGBS) in Kolkata, Ambani emphasized that Jio has already covered most of Bengal and is particularly focusing on transforming rural areas through 5G. Ambani highlighted that with the rapid expansion of JioFiber (wired broadband) and Jio AirFiber (5G-based fixed wireless access), homes in West Bengal will soon become smart homes, utilizing technologies like artificial intelligence and cloud computing to modernize various sectors of the economy. He said this would generate new employment and entrepreneurship opportunities for millions in West Bengal. Jio has reached 98.8% population coverage in West Bengal and achieved 100% coverage in the Kolkata telecom circle. Ambani expressed gratitude to the people of West Bengal for adopting Jio. Going forward, Reliance Industries will invest further to enhance digital solutions across livelihoods, education, healthcare, and agriculture in Bengal. Separately, the income tax department has detected nearly ₹10,000 crore in tax evasion by online sellers operating via platforms like Instagram and Facebook over the past three years. Notices have been sent to 45 brands, with more expected. Indian companies are now more cautious about mergers and acquisitions, as over 20,000 GST-related notices have been issued since 2022, impacting decision-making around tax liabilities. Additionally, Gautam Singhania, managing director of Raymond, has been accused by his estranged wife Nawaz Modi of assaulting her and their daughter two months ago.

article_content: Nvidia has announced major enhancements to its flagship artificial intelligence chip, the H200, set to launch next year. On Monday, Nvidia revealed that the new chip will offer advanced features and will roll out in partnership with Amazon.com, Alphabet's Google, and Oracle. The H200 will succeed Nvidia's current leading H100 chip. Its main improvement is a higher amount of high-bandwidth memory—a vital component for fast data processing. Nvidia remains dominant in the AI chip market, powering services like OpenAI's ChatGPT and other generative AI applications. The addition of more high-bandwidth memory and a faster connection to processing elements allows these chips to provide quicker responses from AI-powered services. The H200 includes 141 gigabytes of high-bandwidth memory, up from the H100’s 80 gigabytes. Although Nvidia has not disclosed its memory suppliers for the H200, Micron Technology has stated its intention to supply Nvidia, and SK Hynix is already a supplier. Nvidia stated that Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure will be the first cloud providers to offer H200 access. Specialized AI cloud providers CoreWeave, Lambda, and Vultr will also provide early access. (Reporting by Stephen Nellis. Editing by Sam Holmes.)

Nvidia je izjavila da će Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure i Oracle Cloud Infrastructure biti prvi cloud servisi koji će ponuditi pristup H200 čipovima. article_content: T-Mobile has transitioned from a budget-focused carrier to one emphasizing value, frequently bundling streaming services with its plans to encourage customers to choose higher-priced options. The company previously considered automatically shifting customers on older plans to newer, more expensive plans. However, CEO Mike Sievert announced during an October 25, 2023 earnings call (as reported by Ars Technica) that this strategy will no longer move forward. Sievert noted the plan was only a test, and customer feedback indicated it was unpopular. He described the migration as a way to move users from older rate plans to ones that offer greater value to both the company and the customers. Bundling services is especially relevant as streaming providers like Netflix and Disney+ continue to raise their prices, potentially saving customers money through package deals. T-Mobile’s Go5G Plus plans offer substantial value, especially for families, and are often less expensive than competing plans from AT&T and Verizon. Nevertheless, legacy family plans remain popular by offering rates as low as $120 per month, regardless of included services. Despite abandoning the migration plan, T-Mobile reported a 4% year-over-year revenue increase, reaching $15.9 billion. The company recently laid off 5,000 employees as part of the Sprint merger finalization but indicated there are no further layoffs planned. Looking to the future, T-Mobile is expanding its home internet offerings with fixed wireless access and new fiber rollouts. Their ongoing 5G expansion enables these new services. These areas may help compensate for any lost revenue from not moving customers to more expensive wireless plans, though the CEO cautioned that it’s too early to draw conclusions.

Kompanija je ranije planirala automatski prebaciti korisnike sa starijih paketa na novije, skuplje pakete. Međutim, generalni direktor Mike Sievert je tokom finansijskog poziva 25. oktobra 2023. godine (prema Ars Technici) saopćio da ova strategija više nije aktuelna. Sievert je naglasio da je u pitanju bio samo test i da su reakcije korisnika pokazale da plan nije popularan. On je opisao migraciju kao način za prelazak korisnika sa starih tarifa na one koje pružaju više koristi i kompaniji i korisnicima. Kombinovani servisi posebno su bitni jer Netflix i Disney+ stalno povećavaju cijene, pa korisnici mogu uštedjeti kroz pakete. T-Mobile Go5G Plus paketi nude značajnu vrijednost, osobito za porodice, i često su jeftiniji od AT&T-a i Verizona. Ipak, starije porodične tarife ostaju popularne sa cijenom od 120 dolara mjesečno, bez obzira na usluge koje su uključene. Iako je migracijski plan obustavljen, T-Mobile je ostvario rast prihoda od 4% u odnosu na prošlu godinu, na ukupno 15,9 milijardi dolara. Kompanija je nedavno otpustila 5.000 zaposlenika zbog finalizacije spajanja sa Sprintom, ali su naveli da za sada nema novih planova o otkazima. U budućnosti, T-Mobile planira proširiti ponudu kućnog interneta sa dodatnim fiksnim bežičnim pristupom i novim postavljanjem optičke mreže. Širenje 5G omogućuje ove nove usluge. Ove aktivnosti bi mogle nadoknaditi prihod koji bi došao prelaskom korisnika na skuplje telefonske tarife, iako direktor napominje da je prerano za zaključke.

article_content: About 30 asylum seekers are currently staying at the Premier Inn hotel in Horwich, near Bolton, with nightly expenses totaling almost £2,500—all covered by taxpayers. These individuals are awaiting Home Office decisions regarding their asylum status, which led to their temporary accommodation in this three-star hotel situated opposite Bolton Wanderers’ Macron Stadium. While the hotel usually hosts tourists and football fans, it is being used for asylum housing due to prolonged delays in processing. The issue extends beyond Bolton. Recent reports highlight that approximately 150 asylum seekers are residing in various hotels in Bournemouth, and 130 more are staying at the Grand Burstin Hotel in Folkestone, Kent. Serco, operating under a £120 million five-year contract to arrange housing for asylum seekers in North West England, made these bookings because of a shortage of alternative accommodations. The company explained that some asylum seekers were transferred from overcrowded living situations in London, attributing the situation to growing demand as people flee conflict in other countries. This approach has garnered significant criticism. Julie Hilling, Labour MP for Bolton West, has pointed out that delays at the Border Agency worsen difficulties for both applicants and the public. The Taxpayers’ Alliance also argues that housing asylum seekers in hotels is an unnecessarily expensive solution and should only be used as a last resort. The government established the COMPASS project to unify and streamline contracts for asylum accommodation to save costs. However, a National Audit Office report in January flagged that Serco had missed targets regarding accommodation standards and waiting periods, potentially resulting in a £4 million penalty. Humanitarian organizations, such as Refugee Action, suggest that hotel accommodations are mainly a result of a backlog in processing applications rather than increased arrivals. The Home Office insists that hotels are temporary solutions for destitute asylum seekers and that providers have been instructed to keep such arrangements short-term. A spokesperson for Premier Inn acknowledged that a number of government-booked guests are staying at their hotels temporarily, but declined to comment on individual cases. The broader debate continues, calling for swifter case resolutions, prudent public spending, and compassionate treatment of those seeking asylum.

Ove osobe čekaju odluku Ministarstva unutrašnjih poslova o svom statusu azila, zbog čega su privremeno smješteni u ovaj trosobni hotel nasuprot stadionu Macron, domu Bolton Wanderersa. Nedavna izvješća naglašavaju da otprilike 150 tražitelja azila boravi u hotelima u Bournemouthu, dok je još 130 smješteno u hotelu Grand Burstin u Folkestoneu, Kent. Kompanija Serco, koja ima ugovor vrijedan 120 milijuna funti na pet godina za organizaciju smještaja tražitelja azila na sjeverozapadu Engleske, rezervirala je ove hotele zbog nedostatka drugih opcija. Oni navode da su neki tražitelji azila prebačeni iz prenapučenih smještaja u Londonu, a situacija je rezultat povećane potražnje, jer mnogi bježe od sukoba širom svijeta. Ovakvo rješavanje situacije izazvalo je brojne kritike. Julie Hilling, zastupnica laburista iz Bolton Westa, ističe da kašnjenja u graničnoj agenciji pogoršavaju položaj i tražitelja azila i javnosti. Savez poreznih obveznika drži da je smještaj u hotelima preveliki financijski teret i da bi trebao biti posljednja opcija. Vlada je pokrenula COMPASS projekt radi objedinjavanja i pojednostavljenja ugovora za smještaj azilanata, s ciljem smanjenja troškova. Ipak, izvješće državnog Ureda za reviziju iz siječnja navelo je da Serco nije ispunio ciljeve u vezi s kvalitetom i rokovima smještaja, što bi kompaniju moglo koštati do 4 milijuna funti kazne. Humanitarne organizacije poput Refugee Action tvrde da je hotelski smještaj prije rezultat zaostataka u postupcima nego porasta broja tražitelja. Ministarstvo unutrašnjih poslova tvrdi da je hotelski smještaj isključivo privremeno rješenje za siromašne tražitelje, te da su pružatelji usluga upozoreni da takva praksa bude što kraća. Glasnogovornik Premier Inn-a potvrdio je da određen broj gostiju s vladinim rezervacijama privremeno boravi u hotelima, ali nije želio komentirati pojedinačne slučajeve. Rasprava se nastavlja, a zahtjevi za bržom obradom, odgovornim trošenjem javnog novca i humanim postupanjem prema tražiteljima azila ostaju u prvom planu.

article_content: The Euclid mission, led by the European Space Agency (ESA) with support from NASA, has released its first set of five scientific images. Euclid is dedicated to exploring dark matter and dark energy, with full-scale scientific work slated to commence in early 2024. These new images reveal a wealth of cosmic features: a vast collection of far-off galaxies, detailed shots of galaxies close to ours, a dense stellar group known as a globular cluster, and a vivid nebula where stars are born. Nicola Fox of NASA’s Science Mission Directorate highlighted that Euclid’s discoveries will provide lasting benefits for scientists around the world. One featured object, the spiral galaxy IC 342, sits about 11 million light-years from Earth, hidden behind dense regions of the Milky Way. Euclid used its near-infrared tools to look through the obstruction and analyze it. Launched from Cape Canaveral, Florida, on July 1, 2023, Euclid traveled nearly a million miles to take its place in space. After preparing its instruments, the observatory is now functioning as designed. NASA contributed important technology to one of Euclid’s instruments and set up a U.S.-based Euclid data center. American scientists, collaborating internationally, will leverage Euclid’s data to study dark energy, galaxy evolution, and dark matter. Euclid has captured the galaxy NGC 6822, located 1.6 million light-years away, in high definition—a feat completed in just one hour and unattainable for ground-based or narrowly-focused space telescopes. Over its planned six-year mission, Euclid aims to create the most comprehensive 3D map of the universe ever produced, observing nearly a third of the sky and cataloging billions of galaxies up to 10 billion light-years distant. The mission’s image of the Horsehead Nebula, the nearest giant star-forming region to Earth, will aid researchers in finding new young stars and planets that have previously gone unnoticed. Euclid’s wide field of view allows it to rapidly photograph large sections of the sky and collect more galaxies in each shot than telescopes like NASA’s James Webb, which focus on smaller, high-resolution regions. This makes it possible, for example, to capture the entire Perseus cluster—a massive structure 240 million light-years away—in a single image. Unraveling the mysteries of the universe’s rapid expansion and mapping the invisible web of dark matter are central goals of Euclid. With dark matter forming most of the matter in the universe, tracking its distribution may reveal insights into both dark matter and the elusive dark energy. Mike Seiffert, Euclid’s project scientist at JPL, called the mission’s first images the start of a groundbreaking era for cosmology, thanks to the vast and novel dataset it will provide. NASA’s upcoming Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, targeted for launch by May 2027, will support and extend Euclid’s discoveries by providing high-resolution images of galaxies and further investigating dark energy. Together, the missions will deepen our understanding of the universe. The initial data from Euclid are now publicly available to researchers, with further updates planned annually through ESA’s Astronomy Science Archives in Spain—inviting ongoing, worldwide scientific collaboration and discovery.
translated_content: Misija Euclid, koju vodi Evropska svemirska agencija (ESA) uz podršku NASA-e, objavila je svoj prvi set od pet naučnih slika. Euclid ima zadatak da istražuje tamnu materiju i tamnu energiju, a početak redovnih naučnih operacija očekuje se početkom 2024. godine. Ove nove slike prikazuju bogatstvo kosmičkih objekata: ogroman skup udaljenih galaksija, detaljne fotografije nama bliskih galaksija, gustu zvjezdanu grupu poznatu kao kuglasti skup i živopisnu maglinu – mjesto gdje nastaju zvijezde. Nicola Fox iz NASA-inog direktorata za nauku naglasila je da će Euclidova otkrića donijeti dugoročnu korist naučnicima širom svijeta. Među prikazanim objektima je spiralna galaksija IC 342, udaljena oko 11 miliona svjetlosnih godina od Zemlje, skrivena iza guste ravni Mliječnog puta. Euclid je iskoristio svoje infracrvene instrumente da 'zaviri' kroz ovu prepreku i ispita galaksiju. Euclid je lansiran s Cape Canaverala na Floridi 1. jula 2023. godine i prešao je gotovo milion milja do svoje radne pozicije u svemiru. Nakon perioda pripreme instrumenata, opservatorij funkcioniše kako je planirano. NASA je doprinosila ključnom tehnologijom za jedan od instrumenata na Euclidu, a ustanovljen je i američki centar za Euclidove podatke. Naučnici iz SAD-a, u saradnji s kolegama iz drugih zemalja, koristiće Euclidove podatke za proučavanje tamne energije, evolucije galaksija i tamne materije. Euclid je u visokoj rezoluciji uslikao galaksiju NGC 6822, udaljenu 1,6 miliona svjetlosnih godina, i to za samo jedan sat – što nije izvodljivo za teleskope na Zemlji ili usko fokusirane svemirske teleskope. Planirano je da Euclid u toku šestogodišnje misije napravi najopsežniju 3D mapu svemira do sada, obuhvatajući gotovo trećinu neba i beležeći milijarde galaksija do 10 milijardi svjetlosnih godina udaljenosti. Prikaz magline Konjska glava, nama najbližeg regiona sa masovnim formiranjem zvijezda, pomoći će naučnicima da pronađu mlade zvijezde i planete koje su dosad bile skrivene. Euclidovo široko vidno polje omogućava mu da brzo fotografiše velike djelove neba i snimi više galaksija po slici nego teleskopi poput NASA-inog James Webba, koji se fokusiraju na manjim područjima uz višu rezoluciju. Tako je npr. moguće zabilježiti čitav Perseusov skup galaksija – gigantsku strukturu udaljenu 240 miliona svjetlosnih godina – na jednom snimku. Razotkrivanje misterija ubrzanog širenja univerzuma i mapiranje nevidljive mreže tamne materije ključne su misije Euclida. Pošto tamna materija čini većinu materije univerzuma, proučavanje njene raspodjele može donijeti nova saznanja o njoj i o još zagonetnijoj tamnoj energiji. Mike Seiffert, vodeći naučnik Euclid misije u JPL-u, opisao je prve slike kao početak nove ere u kosmologiji zbog obima i novosti podataka koje će misija pružiti. NASA-in teleskop Nancy Grace Roman, čije lansiranje je planirano najkasnije do maja 2027, dopuniće i proširiti Euclidova otkrića pružajući slike galaksija visoke rezolucije i dalje proučavajući tamnu energiju. Zajedno, ove misije će produbiti naše razumijevanje svemira. Početni Euclidovi podaci sada su otvoreni za istraživače, a nova ažuriranja biće dostupna godišnje putem ESA-inog Astronomy Science Archives u Španiji, što omogućava kontinuiranu međunarodnu saradnju i dodatna otkrića.

article_content: Eoin Morgan, newly appointed captain of England’s one-day cricket team, faced a blackmail threat concerning his personal life barely a month into his leadership. This ordeal unfolded right before England’s defeat to Australia in a triangular series that also included India. Despite the distraction, Morgan stayed focused and handled the situation with the calm composure that has become his hallmark. The blackmail stemmed from old correspondence between Morgan and Brooke Tsakirakis, who dated five years earlier. Tsakirakis’s former fiancé, Nick Emery, had demanded £35,000 to keep these past details private. Tsakirakis publicly condemned Emery’s actions, expressively stating that she had no contact with Morgan since their past relationship and regretted being drawn into the scandal. Upon learning of the blackmail attempt, the England and Wales Cricket Board (ECB) involved law enforcement. After Emery expressed remorse, the ECB chose not to press charges. News of the scheme emerged shortly before a match, but Morgan and his team continued to concentrate on their cricket. Tsakirakis clarified that her communications with Morgan occurred when both were single, dismissing claims of recent contact and emphasizing her priority to protect her children. She expressed anger at the false allegations but wished to move on from the situation. Morgan acknowledged the ECB’s swift handling, which allowed him to remain focused on the game. With support from his partner, Tara Ridgeway, and encouragement from teammates, Morgan quickly regained his composure after a challenging start on the field. England coach Peter Moores commended Morgan’s poised leadership during this unexpected challenge. Morgan’s reputation emerged unharmed, with praise for his ability to navigate such adversity early in his captaincy. The support shown by both the team and management highlighted the group’s unity and determination.

Ova neprijatnost dogodila se neposredno prije poraza Engleske od Australije u trokut-seriji u kojoj je učestvovala i Indija. Uprkos ometanju, Morgan je ostao pribran i situaciju je riješio sa smirenošću koja ga karakteriše. Tsakirakis je javno osudila Emeryjeve postupke, naglasivši da nije od tada bila u kontaktu s Morganom i izrazila žaljenje što je uvučena u skandal. Nakon što su saznali za pokušaj ucjene, Engleski i velški kriketski savez (ECB) uključio je policiju. Emery je izrazio kajanje, pa ECB nije podigao optužnicu. Vijesti o skandalu pojavile su se neposredno prije utakmice, ali su Morgan i njegov tim ostali fokusirani na igru. Tsakirakis je pojasnila da se njezina komunikacija s Morganom događala dok su oboje bili slobodni, odbacujući tvrdnje o nedavnom kontaktu i naglašavajući da joj je najvažnije zaštititi svoju djecu. Izrazila je ljutnju zbog lažnih optužbi, ali želi nastaviti dalje. Morgan je zahvalio ECB-u na brzom djelovanju, što mu je omogućilo da ostane usmjeren na kriket. Uz podršku partnerice Tare Ridgeway i ohrabrenje suigrača, brzo je povratio mirnoću nakon izazova na terenu. Trener Engleske, Peter Moores, pohvalio je Morganovo zrelo vođenje tima tokom ove neočekivane situacije. Morganov ugled ostao je netaknut, a pohvale za snalaženje u nevolji došle su od svih. Podrška tima i uprave istaknula je njihovu slogu i odlučnost.

article_content: Adam Neumann's journey with WeWork is often seen as a cautionary business saga. Neumann, known for his magnetic personality and bold ideas—from hosting parties with rap stars to envisioning company expansion to Mars—helped turn WeWork into the leading office space tenant in cities like New York and London. Yet, reality caught up as WeWork eventually filed for bankruptcy protection from its former admirers. The coworking concept wasn’t new—companies like Regus (now IWG) had been around since the 1980s. But when Neumann launched WeWork in 2010, the timing was perfect. The aftermath of the financial crisis left vacant commercial spaces, desperate landlords, and numerous professionals seeking flexible work options powered by mobile technology. Low interest rates made it easy to fund rapid expansion, and enthusiastic investors, fearing they'd miss the next big thing, were willing to pour in massive amounts of money. Neumann, who moved to New York from Israel in 2001, had a string of entrepreneurial ideas before WeWork, including shoes with collapsible heels and baby pants with knee pads. A key moment came when he began subletting his own office, leading to the creation of Greendesk, a communal workspace offering free fair-trade coffee—a hit among freelancers. This success prompted a rebrand to WeWork after securing a major investment from a real estate developer. Strong support from investors like Softbank drove WeWork’s valuation up to $47 billion over seven years. Neumann captivated both employees and backers, growing the company internationally, even as WeWork was losing money at a tremendous rate. Even before the pandemic and interest rate hikes, doubts emerged about why a company renting office space was being valued like a tech giant. By 2017, critical media coverage, including from the Wall Street Journal, highlighted concerns that WeWork’s business model was risky and unsustainable—it leased prime real estate long-term, gambling on filling spaces with enough short-term tenants to stay profitable. The real trouble surfaced when WeWork attempted to go public in 2019. Financial disclosures revealed deeper-than-expected losses and questionable financial arrangements involving Neumann. The IPO failed, causing a $40 billion loss in WeWork’s value, and Neumann stepped down as CEO soon after. The COVID-19 pandemic then dramatically altered the demand for shared workspaces. Despite the company's struggles, Neumann managed to separate his finances from WeWork and left with over $1 billion—twenty times the business’s current worth of around $50 million. Neumann now invests in multiple startups and recently raised $350 million from Andreessen Horowitz, another heavyweight investor. His story remains a striking example of how charisma and market hype can shape—and sometimes distort—the business world.
translated_content: Priča Adama Neumanna i WeWorka često se opisuje kao upozoravajuća poslovna lekcija. Neumann, poznat po svojoj harizmi i smjelim idejama—od zabava sa rep zvijezdama do vizije širenja kompanije na Mars—pomogao je da WeWork postane vodeći zakupac uredskog prostora u gradovima poput New Yorka i Londona. Ipak, stvarnost je stigla na naplatu i WeWork je na kraju zatražio zaštitu od stečaja, od istih onih iznajmljivača koji su ih nekad obožavali. Koncept coworkinga nije bio nov—kompanije poput Regusa (sada IWG) djeluju još od 1980-ih. Ali kad je Neumann pokrenuo WeWork 2010. godine, vrijeme je bilo savršeno. Nakon finansijske krize ostalo je mnogo praznih poslovnih prostora, iznajmljivači su bili očajni, a mnogo profesionalaca željelo je fleksibilne opcije rada zahvaljujući mobilnoj tehnologiji. Niske kamatne stope omogućile su jeftino financiranje brzog širenja, a investitori u strahu da ne propuste „sljedeći veliki hit“ ulagali su enormne iznose novca. Neumann, koji se iz Izraela preselio u New York 2001. godine, imao je niz poduzetnih ideja prije WeWorka, kao što su cipele sa sklopivom petom i dječje hlače s pojačanjem na koljenima. Ključni trenutak dogodio se kad je počeo podnajmljivati vlastiti ured, što je dovelo do nastanka Greendeska, zajedničkog radnog prostora s besplatnom fairtrade kafom, omiljenog među freelancerima. Ovaj uspjeh doveo je do promjene naziva u WeWork nakon što je dobio veliku investiciju od jednog developera nekretnina. Snažna podrška investitora poput Softbanka podigla je vrijednost WeWorka na 47 milijardi dolara tokom sedam godina. Neumann je oduševljavao i zaposlenike i ulagače, šireći kompaniju na međunarodno tržište, iako je WeWork gubio mnogo novca. Čak i prije pandemije i rasta kamatnih stopa pojavile su se sumnje zašto se firma koja izdaje kancelarije vrednuje kao tehnološki gigant. Do 2017. godine, kritička medijska izvještavanja, uključujući Wall Street Journal, ukazivala su na to da je poslovni model WeWorka rizičan i neodrživ—firma je na duge staze zakupila vrhunske poslovne prostore, nadajući se da će ih kratkoročno iznajmiti dovoljno da pokrije troškove i ostvari profit. Pravi problemi su se pojavili kad je WeWork 2019. pokušao izaći na berzu. Finansijski izvještaji su otkrili veće gubitke nego što se mislilo i sumnjive finansijske aranžmane povezane s Neumannom. IPO je propao, procijenjena vrijednost WeWorka pala je za 40 milijardi dolara, a Neumann je ubrzo nakon toga napustio poziciju generalnog direktora. Pandemija COVID-19 dodatno je promijenila potražnju za zajedničkim radnim prostorima. Uprkos problemima kompanije, Neumann je uspio razdvojiti svoje lične financije od WeWorka i otišao s više od milijardu dolara—dvadeset puta više od trenutne vrijednosti firme koja sada vrijedi oko 50 miliona dolara. Sada ulaže u više startupova i nedavno je prikupio 350 miliona dolara od Andreessen Horowitza, još jednog velikog investitora. Njegova priča ostaje upečatljiv primjer kako harizma i tržišni hype mogu oblikovati—pa čak i iskriviti—poslovni svijet.

article_content: Nepal's government has decided to ban TikTok, citing concerns that the app is disrupting social harmony. The announcement followed a Cabinet meeting, with Foreign Minister Narayan Prakash Saud confirming the immediate implementation of the ban. Saud explained that some TikTok content was believed to spread negativity and indecent material, prompting the authorities to call for greater accountability from social media platforms. Along with the ban, Nepal is requiring tech companies to register locally, open offices within the country, pay taxes, and comply with national laws. It remains uncertain what exactly triggered the ban or whether TikTok refused these conditions. Attempts to contact TikTok for comment were unsuccessful. TikTok, owned by China's ByteDance, has faced global concerns about data privacy and possible ties to the Chinese government. A number of countries, including the US, UK, and New Zealand, have prohibited TikTok on government devices over similar worries, despite the company's insistence that it does not share user data with the Chinese authorities. In 2018, Nepal also banned all pornographic websites as part of its efforts to regulate online content.

Odluka je donesena nakon sastanka Vlade, a ministar vanjskih poslova Narayan Prakash Saud potvrdio je da će zabrana odmah stupiti na snagu. Saud je objasnio da se neki sadržaji na TikToku smatraju širenjem negativnosti i neprikladnog materijala, pa su vlasti pozvale društvene mreže na veću odgovornost. Pored ove zabrane, Nepal zahtjeva da tehnološke kompanije budu registrovane lokalno, otvore kancelarije u zemlji, plaćaju poreze i poštuju domaće zakone. Još uvijek nije jasno šta je tačno uzrokovalo zabranu niti da li je TikTok odbio ove uslove. Pokušaji da se dobije komentar od TikToka nisu bili uspješni. TikTok, koji je vlasništvo kineske kompanije ByteDance, suočava se sa globalnim brigama oko privatnosti podataka i potencijalnih veza sa kineskom vladom. Više zemalja, uključujući SAD, Veliku Britaniju i Novi Zeland, zabranilo je TikTok na državnim uređajima zbog sličnih razloga, iako kompanija tvrdi da ne dijeli korisničke podatke sa kineskim vlastima. Nepal je 2018. također zabranio sve pornografske web stranice kako bi regulisao online sadržaj.

article_content: Kevin Gifford, a 52-year-old milkman from Leicester, has been banned from whistling during his morning milk rounds after five local residents complained that his early-morning tunes were waking them up. Gifford, a father of three, received a formal warning from his employer, Kirby & West Dairy, instructing him to stop whistling before 8am. Gifford called the decision 'madness,' arguing that whistling milkmen are part of British tradition, and said most of his customers enjoy his cheerful attitude. He told The Sun newspaper that the complaints were about 'breaching the peace,' and joked that more noise comes from birds than from him. Gifford listens to music through headphones on his rounds and sings or whistles along to perk himself up in the mornings. He admitted he's not a great singer but enjoys uplifting his customers. Some customers appreciate his singing, with one woman expressing her delight at 4:30am, though others did not appreciate the noise. He has been told he may sing or whistle after 8am, although by then his deliveries are usually finished. Gifford described the situation as 'a storm in a teacup' and recalled that in the past, delivery workers made noise without complaints. Kelvin Young, general manager of Kirby & West, confirmed Gifford was disciplined after repeated warnings but emphasized he was not threatened with dismissal. Gifford's favorite music includes hits by The Proclaimers, Sex Pistols, Paul McCartney, Donna Summer, and Elvis Presley, and his favorite artists range from Abba to Lady Gaga.

Gifford, otac troje djece, primio je zvanično upozorenje od svog poslodavca, mljekare Kirby & West, da prestane zviždati prije 8 sati ujutro. Gifford je ovu odluku nazvao 'ludošću', ističući da su zviždanje i veseli mljekari dio britanske tradicije i da većina njegovih mušterija voli njegovu vedrinu. Za novine The Sun rekao je da se žalbe odnose na 'remećenje mira', dodavši u šali da ptice prave više buke od njega. Gifford tokom dostave sluša muziku na slušalicama i pjeva ili zviždi kako bi se oraspoložio ujutro. Priznaje da nije veliki pjevač, ali mu je drago što može oraspoložiti mušterije. Rečeno mu je da može pjevati ili zviždati nakon 8 sati ujutro, iako tada uglavnom već završava dostavu. article_content: OpenAI, the company behind ChatGPT, has announced that Sam Altman will return as Chief Executive Officer, just days after his unexpected removal from the company he co-founded. The update was shared on Wednesday, following intense internal drama and public attention. After being dismissed, Altman was briefly hired by Microsoft. OpenAI stated, “We have reached an agreement in principle for Sam Altman to return as CEO with a new initial board consisting of Bret Taylor (Chair), Larry Summers, and Adam D’Angelo. We are working closely to finalize the details. Thank you for your patience during this period.” Altman also confirmed the development in a tweet, saying, “I love OpenAI, and everything I’ve done in the past few days has been in service of keeping this team and its mission together. When I decided to join Microsoft on Sunday evening, it was clear that was the best path for me and the team. With the new board and Satya’s support, I’m looking forward to returning to OpenAI and strengthening our partnership with Microsoft.” Altman's ousting last Friday prompted hundreds of OpenAI staff members to threaten resignation if he was not reinstated, raising uncertainty about the company’s future as a leader in artificial intelligence.

Novost je objavljena u srijedu, nakon burnih dešavanja unutar kompanije i velike pažnje javnosti. Nakon otkaza, Altman je nakratko bio zaposlen u Microsoftu. "Postigli smo principijelni dogovor da se Sam Altman vrati na poziciju izvršnog direktora sa novim početnim odborom u kojem su Bret Taylor (predsjedavajući), Larry Summers i Adam D’Angelo. Blisko sarađujemo na finaliziranju detalja. Hvala na vašem strpljenju tokom ovog perioda,” saopštili su iz OpenAI-a. Altman je također potvrdio vijest na Twitteru: "Volim OpenAI i sve što sam radio proteklih dana bilo je u službi očuvanja ovog tima i njegove misije. Kada sam u nedjelju navečer odlučio da se pridružim Microsoftu, bilo je jasno da je to najbolji put za mene i tim. Sa novim odborom i podrškom Satye, radujem se povratku u OpenAI i jačanju partnerstva s Microsoftom." Altmanovo otpuštanje prošlog petka natjeralo je stotine zaposlenika OpenAI-a da zaprijete ostavkama ukoliko ne bude vraćen, što je izazvalo nesigurnost oko budućnosti kompanije koja predvodi revoluciju u oblasti umjetne inteligencije.

article_content: Estudiantes de La Plata shocked Brazilian club Cruzeiro on Wednesday to win South American football's greatest prize, the Copa Libertadores. Juan Sebastian Veron was showered in confetti in Belo Horizonte, Brazil, as he lifted the Copa trophy. Estudiantes won 2-1 on aggregate, claiming their first Copa Libertadores title in 39 years. All goals came in the second half of a tense match. The first leg in Argentina ended in a scoreless draw. Cruzeiro's Henrique scored first in the 52nd minute with a long-range shot that deflected off Estudiantes defender Leandro Desabato, according to Goal.com. Five minutes later, Gaston Fernandez equalized for Estudiantes from close range. In the 78th minute, Boselli headed in a corner from captain Juan Sebastian Veron to secure the victory. This was Estudiantes' first time in the final in 39 years, having previously won the Copa Libertadores three consecutive years from 1968 to 1970. The 2009 final marked the 50th anniversary of the tournament, which is South America's equivalent to the UEFA Champions League. Copa Libertadores brings together the 32 best teams from across the continent. The tournament was long dominated by Argentinian sides, with at least one team making every final between 1963 and 1979. Buenos Aires' Independiente won six times during that period. Since the early 1990s, Brazilian clubs have also performed strongly, with 10 finalists from Brazil in the last 10 years. Since the tournament began, every country except Peru and Mexico has produced a winner.

Women in Brooklyn are the most selective online daters in the United States, according to a new study. Analysis by the dating website AYI.com examined over 453,000 online interactions involving single women between the ages of 18 and 99. Findings show that women in Brooklyn were the least likely to respond to messages from prospective matches.

Other cities with less responsive women included Detroit, Minneapolis, Cincinnati, and Los Angeles. Conversely, women in Jersey City, Miami, St. Louis, Las Vegas, and Portland were among the most responsive to online messages.

Local perspectives offer possible reasons for Brooklyn's trends. Rosalie Ryan, 22, a resident of Bushwick, suggested that local men lack confidence and initiative, stating that men are less likely to approach women in person or craft meaningful online messages. She reported closing her online dating account due to a flood of unremarkable messages.

Similarly, Edna Velasco, 27, from Williamsburg, described her experience dating 20 men on OkCupid in a year, with only one meeting her expectations. Velasco said she often gauges a suitor's potential based solely on their initial message and is quick to dismiss those who use generic or inappropriate greetings. She recounted one encounter where a date asked her for 50 cents when he did not have enough money to pay for pizza.

article_content: Film Movement has secured U.S. distribution rights for Maciek Hamela’s documentary 'In the Rearview,' which has received over a dozen awards at film festivals worldwide, including the top honor at Sheffield DocFest. The film provides an intimate look at Ukrainian families seeking safety by crossing the Polish border following Russia’s invasion of Ukraine. It is set for a U.S. theatrical release and will be submitted for the Academy Award for Best Documentary Feature. Director Maciek Hamela and producer Piotr Grawender attended the film’s Dutch premiere at IDFA in Amsterdam, where it was featured in the Best of Fests section, highlighting top documentaries of the year. 'In the Rearview' also made the IDA's shortlist for 2023’s best nonfiction films. During an interview at the Cannes Film Festival, Hamela explained that after Russia’s attack, much of Polish society supported Ukrainians. He personally raised funds for a van and transported people of all ages from Ukraine to Poland, out of danger. Hamela decided to document these journeys by placing a camera inside his van, recording the experiences as they unfolded. Hamela expressed concerns about maintaining intimacy and addressing the ethical considerations of filming people during such vulnerable moments. The documentary debuted at the Millennium Docs Against Gravity festival in Poland in May and was later shown at Cannes in the ACID sidebar. Hamela emphasized his goal for audiences to connect with the people in the film, highlighting the everyday nature of their lives despite the war. He noted that, unlike other documentaries on war and atrocities, he wished to avoid creating a feeling of detachment in viewers. Film Movement President Michael Rosenberg stated, 'We are proud to bring this intimate, yet powerful and devastating film to U.S. audiences, reminding us of the human perspective of a war that continues.' 'In the Rearview' has also been picked up by Filmin (Spain and Portugal), VG (Norway), Fabula (Turkey), and PCCW (Hong Kong). In France, New Story released the film last week, and its Polish theatrical premiere is scheduled for November 24. Cinephil represents the film’s worldwide rights and negotiated the deal with Film Movement. The documentary is produced by Piotr Grawender (Affinity Cine), Maciek Hamela (Pemplum), Jean-Marie Gigon (SaNoSi Productions), and Anna Palenchuk (435 FILMS).

Film pruža intiman prikaz ukrajinskih porodica koje traže sigurnost prelaskom poljske granice nakon ruske invazije na Ukrajinu. Planirana je kinopremijera u SAD-u, a film će biti prijavljen za Oskara za najbolji dokumentarni film. Režiser Maciek Hamela i producent Piotr Grawender prisustvovali su nizozemskoj premijeri filma na IDFA-i u Amsterdamu, gdje je prikazan u sekciji Best of Fests, koja ističe najbolje dokumentarce godine. 'U retrovizoru' se također našao na IDA-inoj listi najboljih dokumentarnih filmova 2023. Tokom intervjua na Filmskom festivalu u Cannesu, Hamela je objasnio da je nakon ruske agresije veliki dio poljskog društva podržao Ukrajince. Lično je prikupio novac za kombi i prevozio ljude svih uzrasta iz Ukrajine u Poljsku, izvan zone opasnosti. Hamela je odlučio dokumentirati ova putovanja postavivši kameru u kombi, bilježeći iskustva iz prve ruke. Hamela je govorio o izazovima očuvanja intime i etičkim pitanjima snimanja ljudi u tako osjetljivim trenucima. Dokumentarac je premijerno prikazan na festivalu Millennium Docs Against Gravity u Poljskoj u maju, a zatim u Cannesu u okviru ACID programa. Hamela je naglasio želju da publika osjeti povezanost s ljudima u filmu, ističući svakodnevnicu njihovih života uprkos ratu. Napomenuo je kako, za razliku od drugih dokumentaraca o ratu i zločinima, želi izbjeći osjećaj udaljenosti kod gledatelja. Predsjednik Film Movementa, Michael Rosenberg, izjavio je: 'Ponosni smo što možemo donijeti ovaj intiman, ali snažan i potresan film američkoj publici, podsjećajući nas na ljudsku stranu rata koji još traje.' 'U retrovizoru' su također otkupili Filmin (Španija i Portugal), VG (Norveška), Fabula (Turska) i PCCW (Hong Kong). New Story je prošle sedmice izdao film u Francuskoj, a poljska kinopremijera zakazana je za 24. novembar. Cinephil predstavlja svjetska prava na film i pregovarao je dogovor sa Film Movementom. Dokumentarac su producirali Piotr Grawender (Affinity Cine), Maciek Hamela (Pemplum), Jean-Marie Gigon (SaNoSi Productions) i Anna Palenchuk (435 FILMS).

article_content: Nearly four decades after a violent crime in south London, the perpetrator has been brought to justice. Paul Bryan, now 62, was found guilty of murdering Roman Szalajko, 62, at Szalajko's home in Kennington in February 1984. At 22, Bryan evaded authorities by taking on the identity of another, older Paul Bryan who passed away in 1987, allowing him to flee the country. The case remained unresolved until 2013 when the Metropolitan Police revisited unsolved crimes. Investigators eventually matched fingerprints from the crime scene to Bryan, but his assumed identity complicated their search. Detective Sergeant Quinn Cutler spent over ten years unraveling the truth behind Bryan's disappearance. Police further reinforced their case by comparing DNA evidence from the scene with hair from Bryan’s late mother, confirming a strong genetic match. In November 2022, Bryan was arrested at Stansted Airport after returning from Portugal, where he had lived under his false identity. Bryan said he changed his identity to seem older for his wife and claimed memory loss from a car accident, but he did not testify in court. At the Old Bailey, Bryan was convicted of murder and also admitted to possessing fake identity documents. He remains in custody and is scheduled to be sentenced on December 8.
translated_content: Gotovo četiri decenije nakon nasilnog zločina u južnom Londonu, počinilac je priveden pravdi. Paul Bryan, sada 62 godine, proglašen je krivim za ubistvo Romana Szalajka (62) u Szalajkovom stanu u Kenningtonu u februaru 1984. Bryan je tada imao 22 godine i izbjegao je vlasti tako što je preuzeo identitet drugog, starijeg Paula Bryana koji je preminuo 1987., što mu je omogućilo da pobjegne iz zemlje. Slučaj je ostao neriješen do 2013. godine, kada je Metropolitanska policija ponovo otvorila neriješene zločine. Istražitelji su na kraju uspjeli povezati otiske prstiju sa mjesta zločina sa Bryanom, ali ih je njegov lažni identitet dugo zavaravao. Detektiv-seržant Quinn Cutler proveo je više od deset godina otkrivajući istinu o Bryanovom nestanku. Policija je dodatno pojačala slučaj upoređujući DNK dokaze sa mjesta zločina sa dlakom Bryanove pokojne majke, potvrdivši snažnu genetsku vezu. U novembru 2022. Bryan je uhapšen na aerodromu Stansted po povratku iz Portugala, gdje je godinama živio pod lažnim identitetom. Bryan je rekao da je promijenio identitet kako bi djelovao starije pred ženom, te je tvrdio da ne pamti mnogo zbog saobraćajne nesreće, ali nije svjedočio na sudu. Na sudu Old Bailey Bryan je osuđen za ubistvo i priznao je posjedovanje lažnih dokumenata. I dalje je u pritvoru i čeka izricanje presude 8. decembra.

article_content: The Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) declared on Tuesday a commitment of $100 million in urgent humanitarian aid to the Gaza Strip, responding to ongoing Israeli attacks amid the conflict with Hamas. Leaders from Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, and the United Arab Emirates met in Muscat and agreed swiftly on this relief effort. This decision was made after reports emerged that at least 200 people had been killed in a strike on a hospital complex in Gaza providing shelter to displaced residents. Hamas, the group that controls Gaza, accused Israel of the attack, but Israeli authorities claimed a misfired rocket by Islamic Jihad, another Iran-backed militia in Gaza, was to blame. Tensions escalated when Hamas militants broke through Israel's border roughly 11 days earlier, resulting in more than 1,400 deaths in southern Israel. Since then, Israel has launched intensive airstrikes in Gaza, with casualties reportedly reaching 3,000. Efforts by Gulf states to transport aid to Gaza involve sending shipments to Egypt's El Arish, intending to deliver supplies via the Rafah border crossing, the only route in and out of Gaza not controlled by Israel. However, the crossing remains closed as of now, with hundreds of aid trucks held up due to Egyptian restrictions amid ongoing Israeli strikes targeting the area. GCC Secretary-General Jasem Mohamed Albudaiwi appealed to the global community for an immediate halt to violence against Gaza’s civilians and stressed opposition to any forced displacement from Gaza, calling it a clear violation of human rights and international standards. The precise mechanisms for distributing the aid have not yet been outlined.
translated_content: Vijeće za zaljevsku suradnju (GCC) je u utorak najavilo paket hitne humanitarne pomoći u iznosu od 100 miliona dolara za Pojas Gaze, odgovarajući na kontinuirane izraelske napade u sukobu s Hamasom. Lideri iz Bahreina, Kuvajta, Omana, Katara, Saudijske Arabije i Ujedinjenih Arapskih Emirata okupili su se u Muskatu i brzo dogovorili ovu akciju pomoći. Ova odluka je donesena nakon izvještaja da je najmanje 200 ljudi poginulo u napadu na bolnički kompleks u Gazi gdje su se sklanjali raseljeni civili. Hamas, koji upravlja Gazom, optužio je Izrael za napad, dok izraelske vlasti tvrde da je riječ o promašenoj raketi koju je ispalio Islamski džihad, još jedna milicija u Gazi koju podržava Iran. Tenziije su eskalirale kada su borci Hamasa prije otprilike 11 dana probili izraelsku granicu, što je rezultiralo smrću više od 1.400 ljudi u južnom Izraelu. Nakon toga, Izrael je pokrenuo intenzivne zračne napade na Gazu, pri čemu je prema izvještajima stradalo oko 3.000 osoba. Zaljevske države pokušavaju dostaviti pomoć Gazi šaljući pošiljke u egipatski El Ariš, s namjerom da ih kroz granični prelaz Rafah — jedini izlaz iz Gaze koji ne kontroliše Izrael — prebace raseljenom stanovništvu. Ipak, prelaz Rafah trenutno je zatvoren, a stotine kamiona s pomoći zadržane su zbog egipatskih ograničenja i ponovljenih izraelskih napada na palestinsku stranu prelaza. Generalni sekretar GCC-a, Jasem Mohamed Albudaiwi, pozvao je međunarodnu zajednicu da hitno zaustavi nasilje nad civilima u Gazi i naglasio protivljenje bilo kakvom prisilnom iseljavanju stanovništva iz Gaze, što predstavlja očito kršenje ljudskih prava i međunarodnih normi. Tačne procedure za isporuku pomoći još uvijek nisu razjašnjene.

article_content: With a nationwide strike commencing, Nigeria's Minister of Labour, Simon Lalong, called an emergency meeting on Tuesday with leaders of the Nigeria Labour Congress (NLC) and Trade Union Congress (TUC). This followed the unions' directive for workers nationwide to cease work from midnight on November 14, 2023. The industrial action was prompted by an incident where NLC President Joe Ajaero and other union officials were assaulted in Owerri, Imo State, ahead of a protest. Police detained Ajaero, citing protective custody due to threats from a mob, while Imo State Governor Hope Uzodimma accused him of attempting to interfere in state politics. In response, the NLC and TUC sent a jointly signed letter—by NLC Secretary Emmanuel Ugboaja and TUC's Nuhu Toro—directing affiliates, including those in education, electricity, and the judiciary, to support the strike. TUC President Festus Osifo emphasized that the strike would continue until the government responds to the unions' demands. The federal government, through presidential adviser Bayo Onanuga, strongly criticized the strike, calling it an illegal effort to pressure authorities and asserting it violates a court order against industrial action. Officials said the dispute centers on a personal matter involving Ajaero, not national issues. Government statements argue that disrupting the economy and daily life is unjustified and harmful to Nigerians. They reiterated the need for labour to respect judicial processes and the rule of law. Despite government condemnation, union leaders remain resolute in their stance, promising to keep members updated and reaffirming their commitment to representing workers' interests.
translated_content: Početkom općeg štrajka, ministar rada Nigerije, Simon Lalong, sazvao je hitan sastanak u utorak s liderima Nigerijskog radničkog kongresa (NLC) i Kongresa sindikata radnika (TUC). Sastanak je uslijedio nakon što su sindikati naložili radnicima širom zemlje da obustave rad od ponoći, 14. novembra 2023. Industrijska akcija je pokrenuta zbog incidenta u kojem su predsjednik NLC-a Joe Ajaero i drugi sindikalni zvaničnici napadnuti u Owerriju, država Imo, neposredno prije najavljenog protesta. Policija je privela Ajaera, tvrdeći da se radilo o zaštitnom pritvoru zbog prijetnje mase, dok je guverner države Imo, Hope Uzodimma, optužio Ajaera za miješanje u politička pitanja u državi. Kao odgovor, NLC i TUC su poslali zajedničko pismo, potpisano od strane sekretara NLC-a Emmanuela Ugboaje i generalnog sekretara TUC-a Nuhu Tora, kojim su pozvali ogranke sindikata iz sektora obrazovanja, elektroenergetike i pravosuđa da podrže štrajk. Predsjednik TUC-a, Festus Osifo, naglasio je da će štrajk trajati dok vlada ne odgovori na zahtjeve sindikata. Savezna vlada, preko savjetnika predsjednika Bayo Onanuga, oštro je kritikovala štrajk, nazivajući ga nezakonitim pokušajem vršenja pritiska na vlasti i tvrdeći da se time krši sudska zabrana industrijskih akcija. Zvaničnici su naveli da je spor vezan za ličnu stvar predsjednika NLC-a, a ne za šire nacionalne probleme. Vladini predstavnici ističu da je obustava privrede i svakodnevnog života neopravdana i štetna za građane Nigerije, te naglašavaju potrebu da sindikati poštuju sudske odluke i vladavinu prava. Uprkos kritikama vlade, vođe sindikata ostaju dosljedni svojoj odluci, obećavajući da će redovno obavještavati članstvo i potvrđujući svoju posvećenost interesima radnika.

article_content: Beyond their military applications, drones have already proven useful as sheep herders, delivery agents, tour guides, filmmakers, archaeologists, and even potential spies. The global economic prospects for these machines are impressive—a 2013 study placed the worldwide market for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) at $89 billion. Supporters highlight the many ways drones could improve lives. 'Really, this technology is an extra tool to help an industry be more effective,' says Gretchen West, executive vice president at the Association for Unmanned Vehicle Systems International (AUVSI). "With precision agriculture, for example, drones can photograph fields, allowing farmers to detect problems that might otherwise go unseen. In law enforcement, drones could help find missing children in the woods, especially when bad weather or rough terrain make ground searches difficult." Despite their potential, integrating drones into daily life is more complex than it seems. Usage is increasing in the public sector globally, but strict regulations curtail commercial drone operations in many countries. For example, the United States currently bans commercial drone use—a policy expected to change when the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) introduces new regulations, planned for 2015. Gretchen West argues that each year of delay costs the U.S. $10 billion in potential economic impact. "I think the U.S. has been at the forefront of this technology, but delaying regulations puts us at risk of losing that edge," West says. "Countries permitting drone flights give their industries an advantage. U.S. manufacturers are creating advanced products but are forced to seek markets overseas." Currently in the U.S., civilian drone use is largely limited to public sector applications, research, and hobbyists—provided hobby drones stay below 400 feet, avoid populated areas, and remain in the operator's line of sight. This restricts non-military manufacturers mostly to producing hobby models, although many have commercial uses. 'We're amazed at the uses that emerge,' says Sue Rosenstock, spokesperson for 3D Robotics, an American hobbyist UAV manufacturer. She estimates that half of 3D Robotics' business is overseas, especially in countries with more lenient regulations. Australia stands out as one of the most open countries. The Outback made headlines when startups Zookal and Flirtey announced plans to deliver textbooks by drone. 'They show how progressive legislation can unlock emerging technology,' Rosenstock notes. Still, privacy concerns surround drones. Nine U.S. states have enacted laws restricting drone use by individuals and law enforcement agencies. 'Drones make surveillance cheaper and easier, and that's likely to increase its use,' warns Ryan Calo, law professor at the University of Washington and affiliate scholar at Stanford Law School's Center for Internet Society. While Calo acknowledges drone surveillance should raise concerns, he believes it could spark important conversations about privacy law. 'Privacy law has lagged behind surveillance technology for years, possibly because it's difficult to grasp the issues—until you imagine drone surveillance. As a result, drones may become a catalyst for better privacy laws,' he argues.
translated_content: Osim vojnih primjena, dronovi su se već dokazali kao čobani, dostavljači, turistički vodiči, filmski snimatelji, arheolozi, pa čak i potencijalni špijuni. Globalni ekonomski potencijal ovih uređaja je impresivan—prema studiji iz 2013. godine, svjetsko tržište bespilotnih letjelica (UAV) procijenjeno je na 89 milijardi dolara. Pristalice ističu brojne načine na koje dronovi mogu poboljšati svakodnevni život. 'Zaista, ova tehnologija je dodatni alat koji pomaže industriji da bude učinkovitija,' kaže Gretchen West, izvršna potpredsjednica Udruženja za bespilotne sisteme međunarodno (AUVSI). 'U preciznoj poljoprivredi, na primjer, dronovi mogu fotografisati polja, omogućavajući poljoprivrednicima da otkriju probleme koje možda ne bi zapazili. U provođenju zakona, dronovi mogu pomoći pri pronalasku nestale djece u šumi, posebno kada loše vrijeme ili težak teren otežavaju pretragu sa zemlje.' Iako imaju veliki potencijal, integracija dronova u svakodnevni život je složenija nego što se čini. Upotreba dronova sve više raste u javnom sektoru širom svijeta, dok stroge regulative u mnogim zemljama ograničavaju komercijalnu upotrebu. Na primjer, Sjedinjene Američke Države trenutno zabranjuju komercijalnu upotrebu dronova, ali se očekuje da će nova pravila Savezne uprave za avijaciju (FAA) stupiti na snagu 2015. godine. Gretchen West smatra da svaka godina odgađanja košta SAD 10 milijardi dolara potencijalnog ekonomskog utjecaja. 'Vjerujem da su SAD predvodnik u ovoj tehnologiji, ali odgađanje regulative nas može koštati te prednosti,' navodi West. 'Druge zemlje koje dopuštaju letove dronova daju prednost vlastitim industrijama. Amerikanci razvijaju napredne proizvode, ali ih nerijetko moraju plasirati na strana tržišta.' Trenutno je civilna upotreba dronova u SAD-u uglavnom ograničena na javne institucije, istraživanja i hobiste—uz uvjet da lete ispod 400 stopa, izbjegavaju naseljena područja i ostaju u vidokrugu operatera. To uglavnom ograničava proizvođače izvan vojne industrije na pravljenje modela za hobiste, iako mnogi od njih imaju i komercijalne primjene. 'Iznenađuje nas raznovrsnost korištenja,' kaže Sue Rosenstock, portparol 3D Robotics, američkog proizvođača bespilotnih letjelica za hobiste. Ona procjenjuje da polovinu poslovanja ostvaruju u inostranstvu, naročito u zemljama sa manje restrikcija. Australija je jedna od najotvorenijih zemalja za upotrebu dronova. Outback je nedavno bio u žiži kada su startupovi Zookal i Flirtey najavili dostavu udžbenika dronovima. 'Oni su odličan primjer kako progresivno zakonodavstvo može otvoriti vrata novim tehnologijama,' navodi Rosenstock. Ipak, zabrinutost za privatnost prati razvoj dronova. Devet američkih saveznih država već je donijelo zakone koji ograničavaju upotrebu dronova od strane privatnih osoba i organa reda. 'Dronovi čine nadzor jeftinijim i lakšim, te je realno očekivati više takvih aktivnosti,' upozorava Ryan Calo, profesor prava na Univerzitetu Washington i saradnik Centra za internet i društvo pri Pravnom fakultetu Stanford. Iako Calo smatra da nadzor putem dronova treba zabrinjavati, vjeruje da bi to moglo potaknuti ključne rasprave o privatnosti. 'Zakon o privatnosti godinama kaska za tehnologijom nadzora, vjerovatno zato što ljudi teško mogu zamisliti problem—dok ne pomisle na nadzor dronovima. Zbog toga bi dronovi mogli biti katalizator za bolju pravnu zaštitu privatnosti,' zaključuje on.

article_content: President Barack Obama was interrupted just minutes into a speech in Kansas City, Missouri, when a woman in the balcony began shouting at him. Obama, who had just started recounting his dining experience from the previous evening, paused and asked, 'I'm sorry, what are you hollering about?' The woman responded, 'Jesus is the God of Israel. He is fully God.' Obama calmly replied, 'I believe in God. Thanks for the prayer. Amen. Thank you,' as she was escorted out by police. After the interruption, Obama attempted to continue his speech but was met with a chorus of supporters chanting, 'We love you!' He humorously acknowledged their affection before returning to his remarks about his visit to the famous Kansas City barbecue restaurant Arthur Bryant's. Jokingly, Obama explained that he wouldn't choose a 'best barbecue' in Kansas City to avoid controversy, noting that while he enjoyed Bryant’s, he hadn't tried enough local spots to judge. 'I’m going to have to try some other barbecue the next time I come in,' he said to audience laughter. Obama also shared that he regularly reads letters from Americans, hearing about their struggles and successes. He noted that along with praise, he also receives criticism, jesting, 'Some say I’m doing a good job. But other people say, “You’re an idiot.”' He appreciates the range of opinions to stay connected with the public. During this Kansas City visit, Obama met with several letter writers, including Victor Fugate, who benefited from the Income Based Repayment Plan for student loans and the Affordable Care Act after losing his job. Fugate expressed gratitude towards the president, joking to the First Lady that dinner with Obama included a beautiful salad, while Obama himself enjoyed half a slab of ribs (but missed out on coleslaw, which had run out). Before leaving the area, Obama made a surprise stop at Parkville Coffee in Missouri, where he tried Ethiopian coffee and bought iced tea for himself and patrons. When offered lavender tea, he declined, lightheartedly saying he wasn't 'confident enough to order that.'
translated_content: Predsjednik Barack Obama je prekinut samo nekoliko minuta nakon početka govora u Kansas Cityju, Missouri, kada je žena s balkona počela vikati na njega. Obama, koji je upravo započeo priču o večeri prethodne noći, zastao je i pitao: 'Izvini, zbog čega vičeš?' Žena mu je odgovorila: 'Isus je Bog Izraela. On je potpuno Bog.' Obama joj je mirno uzvratio: 'Vjerujem u Boga. Hvala na molitvi. Amen. Hvala,' dok su je policajci izvodili iz sale. Nakon prekida, Obama je pokušao nastaviti govor, ali ga je dočekala grupa podržavalaca skandirajući: 'Volimo te!' Uz osmijeh je priznao njihovu ljubaznost prije nego što je nastavio priču o posjeti poznatom restoranu s roštiljem Arthur Bryant's u Kansas Cityju. Obama je šaljivo objasnio kako neće birati 'najbolji roštilj' u Kansas Cityju da izbjegne polemiku, napomenuvši da mu se Bryant’s svidio, ali da nije probao dovoljno restorana da donese odluku. 'Morat ću isprobati još neki roštilj sljedeći put kad dođem,' rekao je publici koja se nasmijala. Obama je također podijelio da redovno čita pisma građana, u kojima iznose svoje probleme i uspjehe. Istakao je da, osim pohvala, prima i kritike, našalivši se: 'Neki kažu da dobro radim posao. A drugi kažu: “Ti si idiot.”' Cijeni različita mišljenja jer tako ostaje povezan s narodom. Tokom ove posjete Kansas Cityju, Obama se susreo s nekoliko autora pisama, među njima i Victorom Fugateom, koji je iskoristio plan otplate studentskih kredita na osnovu prihoda i Zakon o pristupačnoj zdravstvenoj zaštiti nakon što je izgubio posao. Fugate je iskazao zahvalnost predsjedniku, uz šalu Prvoj dami da je večera uključila prelijepu salatu, a Obama je uživao u pola porcije rebarca (ali nije dobio salatu od kupusa jer je bila nestala). Prije odlaska iz grada, Obama je iznenada navratio u Parkville Coffee u Missouriju, gdje je probao etiopijsku kafu i kupio ledeni čaj sebi i gostima. Kada su mu ponudili čaj s lavandom, odbio je s osmijehom rekavši da nije 'dovoljno siguran da to naruči.'
