article_content: The Liberal Democrats are in court seeking to block further allegations regarding sexual misconduct by one of their MPs. The party faces accusations of attempting to suppress details involving claims against Mike Hancock, who is said to have made unwelcome advances toward a vulnerable constituent. Although the allegations first arose three years ago, Hancock was only suspended this week after a report on the case was leaked online. On Thursday, further accusations of a cover-up emerged after Portsmouth Council, controlled by the Liberal Democrats and where Mr. Hancock serves as a councillor, announced plans to ask the High Court to prevent the release of the independent report. This move, expected to cost taxpayers thousands, comes even though a redacted version of the report is already public. Written by QC Nigel Pascoe, the report found 'credible' evidence that the 67-year-old MP engaged in 'serious and unwelcome sexual behavior.' The alleged victim, a 39-year-old woman known as AH, is pursuing a civil case against Hancock after police declined to investigate further. Speaking to the Mail, AH criticized Nick Clegg’s handling of the issue as 'absolutely disgusting' and said she had at times considered self-harm. She expressed feeling let down and accused the Lib Dems of publicly disregarding her complaint, stating the matter should have been addressed in 2010 when she initially came forward. Parts of Pascoe’s report, commissioned by the council for a code of conduct review, were redacted when posted online. AH has formally requested access to the full report. Portsmouth Council’s Conservative and Labour groups want the report published, but this has been blocked by Lib Dem councillors, who cite legal advice that publication should wait until after civil proceedings conclude. According to Mr. Pascoe, there is no reason to withhold the report. Conservative councillor Donna Jones accused the Lib Dems of prioritizing party interests over accountability, comparing the situation to the party's handling of the Lord Rennard case. She claimed the council leader, Gerald Vernon-Jackson—a friend of senior Lib Dem Vince Cable—must have made national leadership aware of the allegations. Jones, who chaired the complaints committee, alleged she was challenged at each stage and ultimately outvoted on making the report public. She asserted that Hancock’s position was untenable, especially in light of the allegations from a vulnerable adult. Hancock was suspended from the party on Wednesday by Lib Dem headquarters but, as of Thursday night, continued to serve as cabinet member for planning on Portsmouth Council. Council solicitor Michael Lawther stated that releasing the report is unnecessary for the ongoing civil case, as both sides can present evidence. He said the report’s release should wait until the council's internal procedures conclude, and it is not standard practice to disclose material from unrelated court cases. Some local Lib Dems defended Hancock, with Portsmouth party chairman Simon Dodd noting Hancock’s over 40-year service to the area. It was revealed that Nick Clegg had been aware of the allegations since February of the previous year. Clegg confirmed publicly that he had received a detailed letter and asked the party’s chief whip to examine the matter. Council leader Vernon-Jackson declined to comment. Decisions about Hancock’s future as an independent councillor and cabinet member are expected imminently. Chelsea began the Premier League season in outstanding form, quickly becoming title favorites and even leading to a bookmaker paying out on their success after just 11 matches. At their height, the west London club held an eight-point lead over Manchester City, though this margin has now narrowed to three. The gap would have been just one point if Manchester City had not relinquished a two-goal lead to draw with Burnley. However, Chelsea striker Didier Drogba insists complacency is not behind the shrinking advantage.

Drogba acknowledged that this season’s title race will likely be close and competitive until the final stretch. He referenced a past situation where a large lead was lost to Manchester United, saying, “We knew it was not over. Eight or nine points are never enough this early in the season.”

Chelsea finished 2014 at the top of the table and were also leaders at Christmas, a period that has historically favored manager Jose Mourinho, who has won the league on every occasion his teams have led on December 25. Mourinho, however, believes Chelsea could be in a more secure position, suggesting his team has been subjected to unfair refereeing—in particular, a controversial incident during their 1-1 draw with Southampton. In that match, Cesc Fabregas was denied a penalty after going down under pressure from Matt Targett, with referee Anthony Taylor instead booking Fabregas for simulation. Mourinho views this as part of an increasing bias against Chelsea.

Drogba commented on the penalty incident, stating the referee was close enough to make the decision and supporting Fabregas’s assertion that it was a penalty, though ultimately noting, “It was still 1-1.”

When asked if accusations of diving are a talking point among players or with management, Drogba played down its significance, suggesting such situations happen due to the game’s pace but aren’t a major issue within the squad.

Mourinho’s public comments regarding diving followed periods of inconsistent play. Chelsea controlled the second half but managed just one shot on target, with Eden Hazard scoring the first-half equalizer. Drogba admitted uncertainty over what might have been lacking in Chelsea’s performance but suggested playing two matches in 48 hours could have affected both teams’ sharpness.

U jednom trenutku, tim iz zapadnog Londona imao je prednost od osam bodova nad Manchester Cityjem, ali se ta razlika sada smanjila na tri. article_content: A bright pink pigeon has been spotted in Darlington, surprising locals who initially thought it was an escaped tropical bird. However, it was revealed that the pigeon had been deliberately dyed. Experts from the Royal Society for the Protection of Birds (RSPB) have condemned the act, warning that changing a bird's natural coloration can make it more susceptible to attacks by other birds and predators. Pat Kingsnorth, owner of the Arc on the Edge wildlife sanctuary in County Durham, explained that unnatural coloring removes the bird's camouflage, putting it at greater risk. She warned that such birds could easily be targeted by other animals or even humans. In another case at the Sea Life London Aquarium, a giant gourami named Gerty turned pink after being fed prawn cocktail-flavored crisps by a previous owner. The aquarium staff, led by curator Jamie Oliver, have since transitioned Gerty to a healthier diet of grapes and bananas. Jamie Oliver stressed that crisps are not suitable food for fish and emphasized the importance of researching pet care before acquiring exotic animals. Aquarium employees note that Gerty is not the only animal surrendered by private owners ill-equipped to care for large or long-lived pets, highlighting a broader issue of impulse pet purchases leading to animal welfare problems.

Međutim, otkriveno je da je golub namjerno obojen. Stručnjaci iz Kraljevskog društva za zaštitu ptica (RSPB) osudili su ovaj čin, upozoravajući da promjena prirodne boje ptice može povećati njenu podložnost napadima drugih ptica i predatora. Pat Kingsnorth, vlasnica utočišta za divlje životinje Arc on the Edge u okrugu Durham, objasnila je da neprirodna boja uklanja kamuflažu ptice i time je čini ranjivijom. Upozorila je da takve ptice lako mogu postati mete drugih životinja ili čak ljudi. U drugom slučaju, u akvariju Sea Life u Londonu, gigantska guramija po imenu Gerty postala je ružičasta jer ju je prethodni vlasnik hranio čipsom s okusom koktela od škampa. Osoblje akvarija, koje vodi kustos Jamie Oliver, prešlo je na zdraviju prehranu za Gerty, uključujući grožđe i banane. Jamie Oliver ističe da čips nije odgovarajuća hrana za ribe i naglašava važnost istraživanja njege kućnih ljubimaca prije nabavke egzotičnih životinja. Zaposlenici akvarija napominju da Gerty nije jedina životinja koju su privatni vlasnici morali predati jer nisu mogli brinuti o velikim ili dugovječnim ljubimcima, čime se ističe širi problem impulzivne kupovine životinja što vodi do problema sa dobrobiti životinja.

article_content: Having close friends at work increases engagement, as shown in a 2022 Gallup report. Friendships with colleagues bring ease and joy to our day, no matter the job. Recently, political conflict, such as the Israel-Hamas war and divisive rhetoric, has strained these important relationships. It's now more essential than ever to create spaces for friendships to begin and grow—especially those that are intercultural and interracial. Ten leaders at the forefront of building understanding and bridging communities shared their experiences in facilitating dialogue and reducing the 'us versus them' mentality common during political strife. Interracial friendships can make workplaces and communities stronger by encouraging empathy, collaboration, and progress—particularly in politically tense times. Yet, in a highly segregated society, such friendships are rare. A 2014 study found that 75% of white Americans have no friends from the Global Majority (Black, Indigenous, and People of Color). International human rights advocate Nancy Yu points out that, 'Interracial conversations lay the groundwork for embracing our differences and building meaningful relationships. Making time to support and learn from each other allows us to grow individually and as communities.' Diversity in the workplace encourages creativity and innovation. Research shows that people from diverse backgrounds working together produce unique solutions, which are vital in a global economy. Embracing diversity is key to addressing current political challenges. Business coach Kay Coughlin emphasizes the need for white women and women of color to intentionally build community, as separation limits everyone's potential for healing. She collaborates with Amena Chaudhry, a Pakistani-American anti-racism leader in higher education, to create learning spaces for leaders ready to challenge workplace discrimination. Despite civil rights laws passed over 60 years ago, societal segregation by race, ethnicity, and class persists—and social media often reinforces these divides, as noted by Time magazine. Dana Brownlee, who teaches workplace antiracism, says laws alone don’t create cultural change. Most people still live in racially segregated communities, and building deeper bonds with those who are different is essential for progress. Brownlee believes that, beyond social media campaigns and book clubs, progress against racism requires authentic relationship-building. Citing Margaret Mead’s words, she reminds us of the power of small, committed groups to change the world. Building and sustaining interracial relationships takes conscious effort and a willingness to step out of comfort zones. Leadership in the workplace must foster environments where diverse friendships are valued. Experts highlight the Interracial Sisterhood Retreat, founded by Future Cain and Karen Fleshman, as an intentional community for women and gender-expansive people of all racial, ethnic, and cultural backgrounds to build understanding and progress together. Author Minda Harts notes these conversations are crucial for addressing both career and mental health challenges facing women of color, as well as shifting the mindset and behavior of white women. Interracial relationships help create inclusive and respectful environments, breaking stereotypes and allowing individuals to be valued for their capabilities rather than race. Advocate Jen Murray, who supports solidarity among gender-expansive and queer people, stresses that in a divided world, communities must commit to co-liberation and inclusive 'siblinghood' to inspire new possibilities and transformation. During political conflict, when racial tensions run high, bonds formed across racial lines can foster understanding and peace. Leaders interviewed all agreed these relationships reduce the ‘us versus them’ mentality. Jennifer Velez, a senior diversity leader, highlighted that struggles tied to race, gender, and sexuality are interconnected, and focusing on only one aspect misses the complexity of people’s lives. She calls for wider inclusion, particularly for Black trans women, within the push for equality. Building new connections and elevating diverse identities can transform society for the better. Conflict coach Sierra DeSalvia notes that facing challenges and hard truths together enables communities to grow. While it can be difficult, intentional engagement and mutual advocacy create opportunities for learning, understanding, and positive change. In times of conflict, interracial relationships show the strength and resilience of human connection. These bonds are essential for societal growth and prosperity, reminding us that common humanity unites us beyond politics. By valuing and nurturing these relationships, we invest in a diverse, equitable, and peaceful future.
translated_content: Imati bliske prijatelje na poslu povećava angažovanost, što pokazuje izvještaj Gallupa iz 2022. Prijateljstva sa kolegama donose lakoću i radost u svakodnevnicu, bez obzira na posao. U posljednje vrijeme, politički konflikti poput rata Izrael-Hamas i podjele u društvu narušavaju ove važne odnose. Sada je važnije nego ikada stvoriti prostor za nova prijateljstva—posebno među različitim kulturama i rasama. Deset lidera u izgradnji međusobnog razumijevanja i povezivanja zajednica podijelilo je iskustva o poticanju dijaloga i smanjenju mentaliteta 'mi protiv njih', posebno za vrijeme političkih napetosti. Međurasna prijateljstva jačaju radna mjesta i zajednicu, podstiču empatiju, saradnju i napredak—posebno u vremenima političke napetosti. Ipak, u veoma podijeljenim društvima takva prijateljstva su rijetka. Studija iz 2014. pokazala je da 75% bijelih Amerikanaca nema prijatelje iz Globalne većine (crnci, domorodački narodi i ljudi drugih boja kože). Nancy Yu, međunarodna zagovornica ljudskih prava, ističe: 'Međurasni razgovori postavljaju temelje za prihvatanje razlika i stvaranje značajnih odnosa. Vrijeme posvećeno međusobnoj podršci i učenju omogućuje nam da rastemo pojedinačno, ali i kao zajednice.' Raznolikost na radnom mjestu potiče kreativnost i inovacije. Istraživanja pokazuju da raznoliki timovi stvaraju jedinstvena rješenja, što je važno za globalnu ekonomiju. Prihvatanje različitosti ključno je u rješavanju aktuelnih političkih izazova. Biznis trenerica Kay Coughlin ističe potrebu da se žene različitih rasa namjerno povezuju, jer nas razdvajanje ograničava. Ona sarađuje sa Amenom Chaudhry, pakistansko-američkom liderkom za antirasizam u obrazovanju, na stvaranju prostora za lidere spremne da promijene radna okruženja. Iako su zakoni o građanskim pravima usvojeni prije više od 60 godina, segregacija po rasi, etničkoj pripadnosti i klasi i dalje postoji—društvene mreže često jačaju te podjele, navodi Time magazin. Dana Brownlee, edukatorica o antirasizmu, kaže da zakoni sami ne mijenjaju kulturu. Većina ljudi i dalje živi u rasno podijeljenim zajednicama, a dublje veze s različitima su ključ za napredak. Brownlee tvrdi da napredak protiv rasizma, osim online kampanja i klubova čitanja, zahtijeva istinsku izgradnju odnosa. Podsjeća na riječi Margaret Mead o moći malih, posvećenih grupa da mijenjaju svijet. Za izgradnju i očuvanje međurasnih odnosa potreban je svjestan trud i izlazak iz zone komfora. Vodstvo treba graditi okruženje gdje su raznolika prijateljstva cijenjena. Stručnjaci ističu Interracial Sisterhood Retreat, koji vode Future Cain i Karen Fleshman, kao zajednicu za žene i rodno ekspanzivne osobe iz svih rasnih, etničkih i kulturnih pozadina za zajednički napredak. Autorica Minda Harts naglašava važnost ovakvih razgovora u rješavanju izazova s kojima se suočavaju žene u boji kože, ali i u promjeni razmišljanja i ponašanja bijelih žena. Međurasni odnosi doprinose inkluzivnoj i poštovanja vrijednoj sredini, rušeći stereotipe i omogućujući da se ljudi vrednuju po sposobnostima, a ne samo po rasi. Zagovornica Jen Murray, koja podupire međusobnu podršku rodno ekspanzivnih i queer osoba, ističe da su zajednice koje teže zajedničkom oslobađanju i inkluzivnosti ključ za nove mogućnosti i društvenu transformaciju. U trenucima političkih tenzija, međurasne veze doprinose razumijevanju i miru; svi lideri su se složili da takve veze smanjuju podjele. Jennifer Velez, liderka za različitost, naglašava međusobnu povezanost borbi za rasnu, rodnu i seksualnu jednakost i potrebu za širim uključivanjem, posebno crnih trans žena. Stvaranje novih konekcija i uzdizanje različitih identiteta može unaprijediti društvo. Sierra DeSalvia, trenerica za sukobe, ističe da suočavanje s izazovima i teškim istinama zajedno vodi zajednice ka rastu. Teško jeste, ali namjerni angažman i podrška donose prilike za učenje i pozitivne promjene. U vremenima konflikata, međurasni odnosi pokazuju snagu i otpornost ljudske povezanosti. Te veze su važne za rast društva, podsjećajući nas da nas zajednička čovječnost ujedinjuje iznad politike. Njegujući i cijeneći ove odnose, ulažemo u pravedniju, raznoliku i mirnu budućnost.

article_content: YouTube has introduced new experimental AI features, including a conversational chatbot designed to provide more information about the videos users are watching. This tool can answer questions related to a video, recommend similar content, and even quiz viewers on educational topics. Alongside the chatbot, YouTube is also testing an AI-powered feature that categorizes a video’s comments into topics, making it easier to navigate discussions. These experiments are part of a broader effort by Google to incorporate AI across its platforms, such as Search, Gmail, and productivity tools. For creators, YouTube has already introduced AI-generated backgrounds for Shorts, AI dubbing for translations, and AI-driven suggestions for video topics and audio. Additionally, YouTube is reportedly developing an AI tool that can generate music tracks in the style of well-known artists. Both new AI features are currently available only to a limited group of users. According to Google, the chatbot is accessible in English on select videos, exclusively for Premium subscribers in the US who are over 18 and using Android devices. The tool appears by clicking an 'Ask' button below the video, allowing users to choose from pre-set prompts or type their own questions, such as asking for a summary or recommendations. The AI comment categorization is also being tested on a small number of English-language videos with large comment sections, accessible via a new 'Topics' button alongside the usual sorting options. YouTube highlights the value of these tools for creators, such as helping them engage with comment discussions more effectively or gather inspiration for new content based on audience feedback. However, YouTube cautions that these features are experimental and may not always function perfectly, particularly regarding the quality of AI-generated comment summaries. Premium users interested in trying these tools can visit youtube.com/new to sign up for comment categorization, with the chatbot expected to become available in the coming weeks.
translated_content: YouTube je uveo nove eksperimentalne AI funkcije, uključujući razgovorni chatbot koji korisnicima pruža više informacija o videima koje gledaju. Ovaj alat može odgovarati na pitanja vezana za video, preporučiti sličan sadržaj, pa čak i postavljati kviz-pitanja gledaocima na obrazovnim temama. Pored chatbota, YouTube testira i AI funkciju koja komentare ispod videa automatski grupiše po temama, olakšavajući snalaženje u diskusijama. Ovi eksperimenti su dio šire inicijative Googlea da integriše AI u svoje platforme, kao što su Search, Gmail i alati za produktivnost. Za kreatore sadržaja, YouTube je već predstavio AI-generirane pozadine za Shorts, AI automatsko prevođenje i AI prijedloge tema i zvuka za video. Također, navodno razvijaju AI alat koji može kreirati muzičke numere u stilu poznatih izvođača. Ove nove funkcije trenutno su dostupne samo ograničenoj grupi korisnika. Prema Googleu, chatbot je dostupan na engleskom jeziku, na određenim videima, isključivo Premium pretplatnicima u SAD-u starijim od 18 godina koji koriste Android uređaje. Alat se pojavljuje klikom na dugme 'Ask' ispod videa, gdje korisnici mogu birati unaprijed ponuđene upite ili napisati vlastita pitanja, poput zahtjeva za sažetak ili preporuku. AI grupisanje komentara testira se na manjem broju videa na engleskom sa velikim brojem komentara, dostupno kroz novu opciju 'Topics' pored postojećih opcija sortiranja. YouTube ističe vrijednost ovih alata za kreatore jer im pomažu da lakše prate diskusije ili pronađu inspiraciju za novi sadržaj na osnovu povratnih informacija publike. Međutim, YouTube naglašava da su ove funkcije eksperimentalne i da možda neće uvijek raditi savršeno, posebno u vezi s AI sažetcima komentara. Premium korisnici zainteresirani za isprobavanje ovih alata mogu posjetiti youtube.com/new i prijaviti se za testiranje grupisanja komentara, dok će chatbot biti dostupan narednih sedmica.

article_content: Archbishop Justin Welby, head of the Church of England, has been diagnosed with pneumonia after what was first thought to be a severe cold. This follows his short trip to Sierra Leone, where he spent three hours at a church-run center for children affected by Ebola. Lambeth Palace stated that Archbishop Welby is recuperating at home and confirmed he does not have Ebola. Because of his illness, Archbishop Welby had to miss the traditional Christmas Day sermon at Canterbury Cathedral. The Very Reverend Robert Willis, Dean of Canterbury, led the service in his place. Welby had intended to speak about the 100th anniversary of the World War I Christmas truce between British and German soldiers, noting that the brief peace did not last and fighting soon resumed. The central message of his planned sermon was that Christmas means much more than just cheerful stories or single-day gestures; it’s about real transformation through Jesus. Welby wanted worshippers to look beyond comforting tales and face the realities that true change requires effort and endurance. Both Lambeth Palace and his spokesperson reiterated that his illness is unrelated to Ebola and that he is receiving appropriate medical attention. Sierra Leone is still battling the effects of the Ebola outbreak, with more than 9,000 cases and almost 2,600 deaths reported. During his brief visit, Welby spent time singing with children and offering support. He also pointed out that the dishonesty and cruelty of leaders across the world remains much as it has for centuries.

Lambeth Palace je saopštio da se Arhiepiskop Welby oporavlja kod kuće te su potvrdili da nema ebolu. Zbog bolesti, Arhiepiskop Welby nije mogao održati tradicionalnu božićnu propovijed u Katedrali u Canterburyju. Umjesto njega, bogosluženje je predvodio dekan Canterburyja, vrlo časni Robert Willis. Welby je planirao govoriti o 100. godišnjici božićnog primirja između britanskih i njemačkih vojnika u Prvom svjetskom ratu, naglašavajući da taj kratki mir nije dugo trajao i da su borbe ubrzo nastavljene. Sijera Leone i dalje se suočava s posljedicama epidemije ebole, sa više od 9.000 slučajeva i skoro 2.600 smrtnih slučajeva. Tokom svoje kratke posjete, Welby je proveo vrijeme pjevajući s djecom i pružajući podršku. Također je istakao da neiskrenost i okrutnost svjetskih lidera i dalje ostaju prisutni kroz stoljeća.

article_content: After earning two medals at the Commonwealth Games, gymnast Louis Smith will return to television before preparing for a comeback with the Great Britain squad next year. The Glasgow Games marked Smith's first major competition since his silver and bronze performances at the London 2012 Olympics. The 25-year-old has enjoyed media attention in the interim, winning Strictly Come Dancing and preparing to appear in the gymnastics-based TV show Tumble later this year. Smith contributed to England's gold medal in the team event and secured bronze in the pommel horse final, demonstrating that he remains one of the sport's top competitors. He aims to rejoin the British gymnastics team in 2015. Smith explained that he will not compete again this year due to existing media commitments, but he intends to continue training and pursue selection for upcoming major competitions, including the 2015 World Championships in Glasgow and possibly the Rio Olympics. During the pommel horse final, Smith attempted a more challenging routine, which, if successful, could have resulted in a higher score than his final 14.966. Although he placed third behind Max Whitlock and winner Daniel Keatings, Smith was pleased with his efforts and enjoyed testing his skills. Looking ahead, Smith will focus on training around his appearances on Tumble, which features other well-known sporting personalities such as boxer Carl Froch. Smith believes he still has more to offer in both fitness and skill, and he is excited for the opportunities that 2015 may bring.

Glasgow je bio njegovo prvo veliko takmičenje od osvajanja srebra i bronze na Olimpijadi u Londonu 2012. Dvadesetpetogodišnjak je uživao u medijskoj pažnji u međuvremenu, pobijedivši u showu Strictly Come Dancing i spremajući se za nastup u gimnastičarskoj TV emisiji Tumble kasnije ove godine. Smith je doprinio zlatu Engleske u ekipnom takmičenju i osvojio bronzu u finalu na konju s hvataljkama, čime je pokazao da i dalje spada među najbolje u ovom sportu. Cilj mu je vratiti se u britanski gimnastički tim 2015. godine. Smith je objasnio da ove godine više neće nastupati zbog postojećih medijskih obaveza, ali namjerava nastaviti sa treninzima i konkuriše za naredna velika takmičenja, uključujući Svjetsko prvenstvo 2015. u Glasgowu i moguće Olimpijske igre u Riju. Tokom finala na konju s hvataljkama, Smith se odlučio za težu rutinu, koja bi, da je bila uspješnija, mogla donijeti veći rezultat od konačnih 14,966. Iako je bio treći, iza Maxa Whitlocka i pobjednika Daniela Keatingsa, Smith je bio zadovoljan svojim nastupom i uživao je u izazovu. Smith vjeruje da još može poboljšati svoju spremnost i vještine te je uzbuđen zbog prilika koje nosi 2015. godina.

article_content: Driven by their dreams of winning medals for their country, almost two dozen girls and young women are training to become wrestlers at the Altius wrestling school. This cluster of white, one-storey buildings sits on a dusty track at the edge of Sisai village in Haryana, northern India. Run by Usha Sharma, India's first female wrestling coach and a police officer, along with her husband Sanjay Sihag, a sports teacher, the academy aims to transform perceptions about women through sport, building their aspirations and self-confidence. ‘In villages, women are often given little value,’ says Sharma, who established the school with Sihag in 2009. ‘Sometimes, animals are regarded as worth more because they contribute to household income.’ Regardless of whether they become champions, these girls—many from humble backgrounds—gain a rare sense of empowerment during their training at the residential centre. In nearby fields, village women, often fully covered, graze cattle. Some of the students might have shared that path if not for the opportunities offered by the school. ‘When I opened the academy and the girls started winning medals, it felt good to see that those who once grazed cows and buffaloes were now being recognized and supported by their families,’ Sharma shares. While wrestling has long been popular among Indian men, with thousands of training centres nationwide, a new generation of female wrestlers is emerging. Many were inspired by Geeta Phogat, who became the first Indian woman to win a Commonwealth Games gold medal in 2010. Recently, Indian women won three bronze medals at the Asian Games in China, and last year, a former Altius student earned a bronze at the Commonwealth Games in the UK.
translated_content: Vođene snovima o osvajanju medalja za svoju zemlju, skoro dvadeset djevojaka i mladih žena trenira da postanu rvačice u Altius rvačkom klubu. Ova grupa bijelih prizemnih zgrada nalazi se na prašnjavoj stazi na rubu sela Sisai u Harayani, sjeverna Indija. Rvački klub vode Usha Sharma, prva ženska trenerska rvanja u Indiji i policijska službenica, zajedno sa svojim suprugom Sanjayem Sihagom, profesorom sporta. Akademija ima za cilj promjenu percepcije o ženama kroz sport, gradeći njihove ambicije i samopouzdanje. ‘Na selu žene često nemaju mnogo vrijednosti’, kaže Sharma, koja je sa Sihagom osnovala školu 2009. godine. ‘Ponekad se životinje smatraju vrednijima jer doprinose kućnom budžetu.’ Bez obzira hoće li postati šampionke, ove djevojke – mnoge iz skromnih porodica – stiču rijetko osjećanje osnaženosti tokom treninga u rezidencijalnom centru. U obližnjim poljima, seoske žene, često potpuno pokrivene, čuvaju stoku. Neke od učenica su možda mogle dijeliti tu sudbinu da im škola nije pružila nove prilike. ‘Kada sam otvorila akademiju i djevojke su počele osvajati medalje, bilo je lijepo vidjeti da one koje su nekada čuvale krave i bivole sada dobijaju priznanje i podršku svojih porodica’, dijeli Sharma. Rvanje je dugo bilo popularno među muškarcima u Indiji, sa hiljadama trening centara širom zemlje, ali sada se pojavljuje nova generacija ženskih rvačica. Mnoge su inspirisane Geetom Phogat, koja je postala prva Indijka koja je osvojila zlatnu medalju na Igrama Commonwealtha 2010. godine. Nedavno su Indijke osvojile tri bronzane medalje na Azijskim igrama u Kini, a prošle godine bivša učenica Altiusa osvojila je bronzu na Igrama Commonwealtha u Velikoj Britaniji.

article_content: Fiona Apple’s recent decision to postpone her South American tour to stay home with her elderly, ailing dog may have disappointed some fans, but she gained many new supporters who understand her choice. I am one of them. When it was time for our dog Mordred to go, he let us know. I had always heard that animals can communicate their suffering, but experiencing it for the first time was overwhelming. Mordred, a massive Irish Wolfhound, was originally my now-husband Douglas’s dog, but quickly became mine too. He walked down the aisle with me when Douglas and I got married a year and a half after we met. Our relationship with Mordred wasn’t always smooth. The first night I met him, he tried to attack me, simply protecting his owner from a stranger. It was only my second date with Douglas, and I was surprised to find him, a responsible man, taking care of two dogs in New York City. We were so distracted by our excitement that we forgot to warn the dogs I’d be visiting. As we entered the apartment, Mordred greeted us with loud snarling and lunged at me. With Douglas holding him back, I realized how enormous he was compared to other dogs I’d seen – larger even than my six-foot-tall date. Mordred was impressive and majestic but wanted nothing to do with me at first. His companion, Morgane the whippet, was friendlier, but Mordred only cared for Douglas and food. I was simply in his way, although I enjoyed being in his world. If you’ve ever walked an Irish Wolfhound in New York City, you know it draws attention. People ask questions like ‘How much does he eat?’ ‘Is he a pony?’ or ‘How much does he weigh?’ The answers: a lot, no, no, 135 pounds. Mordred walked beside us through both city streets and country fields, until the day things changed. He stumbled on the apartment steps and was sick soon after. As Douglas cleaned up, I made soup for him, and for the first time, Mordred leaned against me. For big, stoic dogs, leaning is a sign of affection and trust. After that, when Mordred lost control and had an accident indoors, and the next day when we received his cancer diagnosis, we all leaned on each other for comfort. Though medication shrunk his tumor, giving us another year together, the disease eventually returned and took its toll. Mordred lost weight and became frail, unable to control his bladder and bowels. Thankfully, my boss was understanding and let me work from home sometimes, though not everyone at work shared this compassion. I tried to explain to a colleague what caring for a dying pet involved and why it was important to be there for family, which for us included our dogs. That’s why I respect Fiona Apple’s decision to prioritize her dog over her professional obligations. Eventually, Mordred’s condition worsened further; cancer treatments left him with pneumonia. We knew it was time to say goodbye, so Douglas lifted him into the car, and we all went to the vet together. Mordred found comfort in Douglas’s lap as he passed. Morgane searched for her friend for days, and we felt the same sense of loss. Losing such a large presence leaves a wound you can’t ignore. I understand Apple’s desire to honor her companion to the end. Once a dog loves you, it’s impossible not to return that love.

I ja sam među njima. Kada je došlo vrijeme da naš pas Mordred ode, on nam je to jasno dao do znanja. Uvijek sam čula da životinje mogu pokazati svoju patnju, ali kad to prvi put doživiš, to te slomi. Mordred, ogromni irski vučjak, prvobitno je bio pas mog sadašnjeg muža Douglasa, ali brzo je postao i moj. Pratio me do oltara kad sam se udala za Douglasa, godinu i po nakon upoznavanja. Naš odnos s Mordredom nije uvijek bio lake naravi. Prvu noć kad sam ga upoznala, pokušao me napasti, samo štiteći svog vlasnika od nepoznate žene. To je bio tek moj drugi izlazak s Douglasom i bila sam iznenađena koliko odgovorno brine o dva psa u New Yorku. Bili smo toliko uzbuđeni da smo zaboravili upozoriti pse da dolazim. Kad smo ušli u stan, Mordred nas je dočekao sa snažnim režanjem i skočio na mene. Douglas ga je obuzdao, a ja sam tek tad shvatila koliko je zapravo velik – čak viši i od mog partnera visokog 180 cm. Mordred je bio impresivan i veličanstven, ali u početku nije htio imati posla sa mnom. Njegova prijateljica, hrtica Morgane, bila je mnogo druželjubivija, a Mordred je mario samo za Douglasa i hranu. Ja sam mu bila prepreka, ali mi je ipak bilo drago što sam dio njegovog svijeta. Ako ste ikada šetali irskog vučjaka ulicama New Yorka, znate koliko pažnje privlače. Ljudi stalno pitaju: ‘Koliko jede?’ ‘Je li to poni?’ ‘Koliko je težak?’ Odgovori su: puno, ne, ne, 61 kg. Mordred je bio s nama u gradu i na selu, sve do dana kad se nešto promijenilo. Posrnuo je na stepenicama i ubrzo povratio. Dok je Douglas čistio, pripremala sam mu supu i prvi put se Mordred naslonio na mene. Za velike, ozbiljne pse, naslanjanje znači povjerenje i nježnost. Nakon tog dana, kad je Mordred prvi put imao nezgodu u stanu i dan poslije kad smo čuli dijagnozu raka, i mi smo se međusobno naslanjali za utjehu. Lijekovi su privremeno smanjili tumor i dali nam još godinu dana zajedno, ali bolest se vratila i uništila ga. Izgubio je na težini, bio slab i nije mogao kontrolirati mokrenje. Srećom, moj šef imao je razumijevanja i dopustio mi rad od kuće, iako svi na poslu nisu dijelili taj stav. Pokušala sam kolegama objasniti šta znači brinuti o umirućem ljubimcu i zašto je važno biti uz porodicu – a naši psi jesu porodica. Zato posebno poštujem odluku Fione Apple da stavi svog psa ispred karijere. Na kraju, Mordredovo stanje se dodatno pogoršalo; terapija protiv raka dovela je do upale pluća. Znali smo da je došao kraj, pa ga je Douglas prenio u auto i otišli smo kod veterinara. Mordred je posljednje trenutke proveo uz Douglasa. Morgane ga je danima tražila, a i nama je jako nedostajao. Gubitak takvog stvorenja ostavlja prazninu koju ne možeš popuniti. Razumijem Fioninu želju da svom psu bude uz rame do samog kraja. Kad te pas zavoli, moraš mu uzvratiti istom ljubavlju.

article_content:
A team of Italian tech professionals has launched Mafialeaks, a new website that enables individuals to report Mafia-related crimes anonymously and securely. The platform allows victims, witnesses, and former gang members to send confidential tips to police, prosecutors, and journalists without revealing their identities.

Mafialeaks utilizes encrypted technology, modeled after Wikileaks, to safeguard informants. The volunteers who run the site also remain anonymous, fearing potential Mafia reprisals. According to one organizer who spoke with La Repubblica, fewer than ten people maintain the operation in their spare time, using their own funds.

The site is open to the public, with sections for Mafia insiders, victims, and those with relevant knowledge. Users are encouraged to provide supporting material like photos or audio files. When a report is submitted, it's forwarded to trusted individuals—such as law enforcement, journalists, and anti-Mafia campaigners—who receive notifications.

Mafialeaks aims to gather valuable intelligence, like whereabouts of Mafia bosses or details about extortion schemes. However, authorities worry the site might be misused by criminals to send false information. Magistrate Nicola Gratteri noted that Mafialeaks could help end the culture of silence, but warned that it could also be exploited for personal grudges.

The Sicilian Mafia, also known as Cosa Nostra, arose in the mid-19th century and operates through loosely connected clans that control local territories. Their criminal activities, especially extortion, cost the Sicilian economy over €10 billion yearly, with about 70% of local businesses believed to pay protection money. The Mafia's influence even extends to politics, where some officials have allegedly turned to them for electoral support.

Mafialeaks koristi enkripciju po uzoru na Wikileaks kako bi zaštitio doušnike. Volonteri koji upravljaju sajtom također ostaju anonimni zbog straha od mafijaške odmazde. Prema riječima jednog člana tima za La Repubblicu, manje od deset osoba vodi projekat u slobodno vrijeme i vlastitim sredstvima.

Stranica je dostupna svima, s odjeljcima za insajdere iz mafije, žrtve i one koji imaju korisne informacije. Korisnici se potiču da prilože dokaze poput fotografija ili audio zapisa. Kada se prijava pošalje, ona biva proslijeđena pouzdanim osobama—poput policije, novinara i antimaﬁja aktivista—koji odmah dobijaju obavještenje.

Mafialeaks ima cilj da prikupi dragocjene informacije, poput lokacija skrivenih mafijaških vođa ili detalja o reketiranju. Međutim, vlasti su zabrinute da bi kriminalci mogli zloupotrijebiti stranicu za slanje lažnih informacija. Sudija Nicola Gratteri je naveo da Mafialeaks može pomoći rušenju zida šutnje, ali je upozorio i na mogućnost zloupotrebe iz ličnih osveta.

Sicilijanska mafija, poznata i kao Cosa Nostra, nastala je sredinom 19. stoljeća, a djeluje kroz labavo povezane klanove koji kontrolišu lokalna područja. Njihove kriminalne aktivnosti, posebno reketiranje, koštaju sicilijansku ekonomiju preko 10 milijardi eura godišnje, a procjenjuje se da oko 70% lokalnih firmi plaća zaštitu. Uticaj mafije prodire i u politiku, gdje su neki zvaničnici navodno tražili njihovu podršku na izborima.

article_content: The Federal Government of Nigeria met with domestic refinery operators on Wednesday to address issues with crude oil availability for local refiners. Officials stressed that failing to meet domestic crude oil supply needs would be a national embarrassment, particularly as the Dangote refinery, with a capacity of 650,000 barrels per day, is ready to begin operations and requires a reliable supply of crude. Gbenga Komolafe, Chief Executive of the Nigerian Upstream Petroleum Regulatory Commission (NUPRC), revealed this in Abuja during the meeting. He emphasized the importance of supporting the Dangote refinery and ensuring all domestic refineries have sufficient supply. Komolafe stated that the NUPRC has contacted crude oil producers, requesting data on both committed and uncommitted crude oil volumes. He noted that some producers have not responded, and their input is needed for proper analysis and decision-making about crude allocation for domestic refineries. Once this information is collected, authorities can determine whether the uncommitted crude oil volumes are sufficient to meet the nation’s refinery needs. Komolafe also noted that increasing domestic refining capacity can help reduce petroleum product pump prices, benefiting consumers and the economy. Although Nigeria possesses substantial oil reserves of roughly 38 billion barrels, it remains a net exporter of crude oil but a net importer of refined petroleum products. Komolafe highlighted that this has negatively impacted the economy, especially during the period of fuel subsidies and widespread importation. He concluded by urging stakeholders in the oil sector to collaborate and emphasized the goal of making Nigeria a net exporter of refined petroleum products.

Naglasio je važnost podrške Dangote rafineriji i osiguranja dovoljne opskrbe svim domaćim rafinerijama. Komolafe je kazao da je NUPRC kontaktirao proizvođače nafte, tražeći podatke o količinama vezane i nevezane sirove nafte. Napomenuo je da se neki proizvođači još nisu odazvali i da su njihovi podaci potrebni za pravilnu analizu i donošenje odluka o raspodjeli sirove nafte domaćim rafinerijama. Kada se svi podaci prikupe, nadležni će moći procijeniti jesu li nevezane količine sirove nafte dovoljne za potrebe domaćih rafinerija. article_content: Iran has placed its Revolutionary Guard on high alert, following an order from Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei due to concerns about possible attacks on its nuclear sites by Western powers. This action comes after recent incidents, including the shooting down of a U.S. drone and the attack on the British embassy in Tehran. A series of mysterious events—such as explosions at nuclear facilities, assassinations of scientists, and cyber-attacks—suggest ongoing covert operations against Iran. Experts describe this as a new form of conflict, focusing on impeding Iran's nuclear development. Despite growing international sanctions and diplomatic pressure, President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad remains firm that Iran will continue its nuclear program for peaceful purposes. Efforts to restrict uranium enrichment have so far been unsuccessful. There is increasing speculation about involvement by the U.S. and Israel in these covert attacks and assassinations, but official confirmation is lacking. Attacks have targeted nuclear scientists and resulted in explosions at both military and nuclear sites. Iranian authorities, including Fereydoun Abbasi-Davani, accuse the UK, U.S., and Israel of coordinating attacks on Iranian scientists. The violent storming of the British embassy in Tehran further escalated tensions, caused significant damage, and led to the expulsion of diplomats. Iran’s announcement about the capture of a U.S. RQ-170 stealth drone raised concerns about the security of sensitive technology, though U.S. officials have downplayed these risks. Analysts caution that continued covert actions and escalating sabotage might trigger a larger armed conflict in the region. Some think tanks suggest that if Iran gains nuclear capabilities, a containment policy may be more realistic than prevention. Regional leaders such as UAE Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum express doubt that Iran will actually develop nuclear weapons and warn of devastating consequences should conflict erupt. Nevertheless, ongoing incidents have heightened international tensions.

Ova odluka dolazi nakon nedavnih incidenata, uključujući obaranje američke bespilotne letjelice i napad na britansku ambasadu u Teheranu. Niz misterioznih događaja – poput eksplozija u nuklearnim postrojenjima, ubistava naučnika i cyber napada – ukazuje na kontinuirane tajne operacije protiv Irana. Stručnjaci ovo opisuju kao novi oblik sukoba usmjeren na zaustavljanje iranskog nuklearnog razvoja. Uprkos sve većim međunarodnim sankcijama i diplomatskom pritisku, predsjednik Mahmud Ahmadinedžad ostaje pri stavu da će Iran nastaviti svoj nuklearni program u mirnodopske svrhe. Dosadašnji pokušaji ograničavanja obogaćivanja urana nisu bili uspješni. Sve je više nagađanja o umiješanosti SAD-a i Izraela u ove tajne napade i atentate, iako zvanične potvrde nema. Napadi su bili usmjereni na nuklearne naučnike i prouzrokovali su eksplozije u vojnim i nuklearnim objektima. Iranske vlasti, uključujući Ferejduna Abasi-Davanija, optužuju Veliku Britaniju, SAD i Izrael za organizaciju napada na iranske naučnike. Nasilni upad u britansku ambasadu u Teheranu dodatno je povećao napetosti, doveo do veće štete i protjerivanja diplomata. Iranska vijest o obaranju američke RQ-170 stealth bespilotne letjelice izazvala je zabrinutost oko sigurnosti osjetljive tehnologije, iako su američki zvaničnici umanjili moguće rizike. article_content: Poland is holding a pivotal parliamentary election on Sunday, which will decide whether the right-wing Law and Justice party (PiS) secures an unprecedented third consecutive term or if a united opposition coalition can gain enough support to oust it. Many Polish citizens believe this is the most consequential election since 1989, the year that marked the end of communist rule. The election touches on critical issues including the health of Polish democracy, legal approaches to LGBTQ+ rights and abortion, and the future of foreign alliances—particularly Poland's role as a key ally to Ukraine. Political experts warn the election will not be completely fair following eight years of Law and Justice rule, which they say has undermined checks and balances and increased government control over state institutions, including the judiciary, public media, and the electoral process. Retired nurse Barbara Burs, 63, who voted early in Warsaw, shared that she voted for change because she wants a better and more unified Poland for her children and grandchildren. Approximately 29 million Polish citizens aged 18 and over are eligible to vote. Voters will choose 460 members of the lower house (Sejm) and 100 Senators, with all elected for four-year terms. A referendum is being held simultaneously, covering issues like migration and the retirement age. Opposition groups oppose the referendum, viewing it as an attempt to mobilize the ruling party’s supporters, and have called for a boycott. At some polling stations, people have reportedly declined to vote in the referendum, submitting only their Sejm and Senate ballots. There are more than 31,000 polling stations open throughout Poland from 7 am to 9 pm local time on Sunday, with over 400 additional stations operating abroad. Exit poll results from global polling firm Ipsos will be announced on state broadcaster TVP and commercial stations TVN and Polsat when polls close at 9 pm. The exit poll margin of error is plus or minus two percentage points. To win parliamentary representation, individual parties must secure at least 5% of the vote, and coalitions need a minimum of 8%.
translated_content: Poljska u nedjelju održava ključne parlamentarne izbore, koji će odlučiti hoće li desničarska stranka Pravo i pravda (PiS) osvojiti neviđeni treći uzastopni mandat ili će ujedinjena opozicija uspjeti prikupiti dovoljno podrške da je smijeni. Mnogi Poljaci smatraju da su ovo najvažniji izbori od 1989. godine, kada je okončana komunistička vlast. Izbori obuhvataju ključna pitanja kao što su zdravlje poljske demokratije, pravni pristupi pravima LGBTQ+ osoba i abortusu, te budućnost vanjskih saveza—posebno ulogu Poljske kao ključnog saveznika Ukrajine. Politički stručnjaci upozoravaju da izbori neće biti potpuno fer nakon osam godina vladavine stranke Pravo i pravda, za koje tvrde da su narušili sistem provjera i ravnoteža i povećali državnu kontrolu nad institucijama, uključujući pravosuđe, javne medije i sam izborni proces. Penzionisana medicinska sestra Barbara Burs, 63, koja je glasala rano u Varšavi, rekla je da je glasala za promjene jer želi bolju i ujedinjenu Poljsku za svoju djecu i unučad. Oko 29 miliona poljskih građana starijih od 18 godina ima pravo glasa. Građani biraju 460 članova donjeg doma (Sejm) i 100 senatora, svi na mandat od četiri godine. Istovremeno se održava i referendum o pitanjima kao što su migracije i starosna granica za penziju. Opozicijske grupe protive se referendumu gledajući ga kao pokušaj mobilizacije birača vladajuće stranke i pozivaju na bojkot. Na nekim biračkim mjestima, građani su navodno odbili učestvovati u referendumu, predajući samo listiće za Sejm i Senat. Više od 31.000 biračkih mjesta širom Poljske otvoreno je od 7 do 21 sat po lokalnom vremenu, a više od 400 dodatnih glasačkih mjesta radi u inostranstvu. Rezultate izlaznih anketa globalne istraživačke firme Ipsos objavit će državna televizija TVP i komercijalne stanice TVN i Polsat kada se birališta zatvore u 21 sat. Moguća greška izlazne ankete iznosi plus ili minus dva postotna poena. Za zastupljenost u parlamentu, pojedinačne stranke moraju osvojiti najmanje 5% glasova, a koalicije najmanje 8%.

article_content: The magical world of Harry Potter just got a bit richer with a spotlight on Celestina Warbeck, the 'Singing Sorceress.' Previously a background figure, Celestina now steps forward with a detailed profile on Pottermore, where fans can enjoy a performance of her signature song, 'You Stole My Cauldron but You Can't Have My Heart.' Author J.K. Rowling describes Celestina as one of her favorite supporting characters, inspired by the legendary Shirley Bassey, known for classic James Bond themes. Rowling found the name 'Celestina' from a colleague, feeling it was perfect for a glamorous witch. Celestina is portrayed as a Welsh child prodigy, with a mother who vigorously promoted her by writing letters to Hogwarts's performing arts communities. Her perseverance led to immense stardom, with dedicated fans even getting into broom accidents on the way to her concerts. Tickets for her 'Flighty Aphrodite' tour are so in demand that they appear on the black market at high prices. A favorite singer of Molly Weasley, Celestina lives an eventful life, owning eight homes, having been married three times, and a voice powerful enough to drown out banshees. Her music is also featured at Universal Orlando's Wizarding World of Harry Potter.

article_content: In April 2012, Anthony Hensley drowned in Bay Colony Pond in Des Plaines, Illinois, after a swan attack caused his kayak to tip over. Employed by a company that cared for swans, Hensley had tended to the birds at the condo complex for nearly ten years. According to accounts, while checking on the swans, an aggressive mute swan confronted him, leading to his fall into the water. His heavy boots and clothing made it difficult for him to stay afloat, and despite being a proficient swimmer, he was unable to escape. Last week, Hensley's widow, Amy, lodged a lawsuit against his employer, Knox Swan and Dog, LLC, as well as Bay Colony Drive condo association and Hillcrest Property Management. The complaint states that the defendants either knew or should have known about the dangers associated with mute swans and failed to provide adequate protection. The legal filing references the Illinois Animal Control Act, which can hold animal owners responsible for injuries. The suit seeks financial compensation, with the exact amount unspecified. Anthony Hensley is remembered by family as a caring father and husband. Officials determined the cause of death was accidental drowning. For years, the condo complex used mute swans as a means to control geese, with Hensley overseeing their care. So far, none of the parties targeted in the lawsuit have released public statements.

Teške čizme i odjeća otežali su mu plivanje, tako da, iako je bio dobar plivač, nije uspio da se spasi. article_content: In Costa Rica, an innovative approach is turning black soldier fly larvae into sustainable animal feed by raising them in vertical farms and feeding them with fruit waste. As one of the most biodiverse countries in the world, Costa Rica aims to be Latin America's greenest nation. In Guapiles, about 60 kilometers north of San Jose, the company ProNuvo is putting flies to work, raising black soldier flies (Hermetia illucens) that consume organic waste. According to ProNuvo's president, Miguel Carmona, the larvae are a high-quality protein source for animal feed with a lower environmental impact than beef, fish, or soy-based protein. ProNuvo exports dried larvae, protein powder, and insect oil to the United States, and one Costa Rican tilapia farm also uses their products. The flies are raised in greenhouse cages at around 40°C and high humidity, living about a week and laying 500 eggs each. The larvae hatch in four days and feed on banana, mango, and papaya waste, increasing their weight 10,000 times in 14 days before being processed into protein-rich animal feed. Gabriel Carmona, ProNuvo's general manager, explains that even the larvae waste is used as fertilizer for fruit plantations. ProNuvo's system requires just 300 square meters, compared to 30,000 square meters for beef or 3,000 for soybeans per ton of protein produced. Similarly, fly larvae need only 10,000 liters of water per ton of protein, while beef requires 15.4 million and soybeans 1.6 million liters. Protein production with fly larvae is much faster—just 14 days, compared to six months for soy and three years for cows. ProNuvo is the first company in Latin America to produce insect protein, and similar projects are underway in Kenya, Uganda, and Europe. As global food and fertilizer prices rise due to the war in Ukraine, sustainable alternatives like fly larvae protein are gaining attention.
translated_content: U Kostariki, inovativni pristup pretvara larve crne vojne muhe u održivu stočnu hranu, uzgajajući ih na vertikalnim farmama i hraneći voćnim otpadom. Kao jedna od najbioraznolikijih zemalja na svijetu, Kostarika ima cilj da postane najzelenija nacija Latinske Amerike. U Guapilesu, oko 60 kilometara sjeverno od San Josea, kompanija ProNuvo koristi muhe za posao – uzgajaju crne vojne muhe (Hermetia illucens) koje jedu organski otpad. Predsjednik ProNuvo-a, Miguel Carmona, kaže da su larve izvor visokokvalitetnog proteina za ishranu životinja s manjim uticajem na okoliš od govedine, ribe ili soje. ProNuvo izvozi sušene larve, proteinski prah i ulje od insekata u Sjedinjene Američke Države, a jedan kostarikanski ribnjak s tilapijom također koristi njihove proizvode. Muhe se uzgajaju u kavezima u stakleniku na oko 40°C i visokoj vlazi, žive oko sedmicu dana i polože oko 500 jaja. Larve se izlegu za četiri dana i hrane se otpadom od banane, manga i papaje, te za 14 dana povećaju težinu 10.000 puta prije nego što budu prerađene u stočnu hranu bogatu proteinima. Gabriel Carmona, generalni menadžer ProNuva, objašnjava da se čak i izmet larvi koristi kao đubrivo za voćne plantaže. Sistem ProNuva treba samo 300 kvadratnih metara, u poređenju s 30.000 za govedinu ili 3.000 za soju po toni proizvedenog proteina. Također, larve trebaju samo 10.000 litara vode po toni proteina, dok govedina zahtijeva 15,4 miliona, a soja 1,6 miliona litara. Proizvodnja proteina s larvama muha je mnogo brža—traje samo 14 dana, dok soji treba šest mjeseci, a kravama tri godine. ProNuvo je prva kompanija u Latinskoj Americi koja proizvodi proteinske insekte, a slični projekti postoje u Keniji, Ugandi i Europi. Kako cijene hrane i đubriva rastu zbog rata u Ukrajini, održive alternative poput proteina iz larvi muha privlače sve veću pažnju.

article_content: Best Buy, the nationwide electronics retailer, has announced it will end the sale of DVDs and Blu-rays both in-store and online after this holiday season. This change applies to all 1,129 Best Buy locations, including 969 stores in the United States. While the timeline for Blu-ray removal is not entirely clear, a company spokesperson confirmed the broader move away from physical media. A spokesperson explained to Variety that consumer habits have shifted significantly in the past decade, with streaming services now dominating the way people watch movies and TV shows. This announcement comes just over a month after Netflix sent out its last DVDs, marking the end of its DVD rental business. Despite this shift, Best Buy will continue selling physical game discs, even as the video game industry increasingly moves to digital downloads and streaming. For instance, PlayStation recently launched a streaming service focused on the PS5, but Best Buy believes a substantial market for game discs remains. According to the spokesperson, removing DVDs and Blu-rays will free up store space for innovative tech products, aligning with Best Buy’s intent to focus more on hardware. In its August quarterly earnings report, Best Buy CEO Corie Barry noted that 2023 would likely be the ‘low point’ in tech demand, but expressed optimism for a rebound in sales next year. The leadership did not specifically mention DVD sales, but the company appears to be preparing for increased tech shopping. Industry data from the Digital Entertainment Group shows physical media sales declined nearly 30% in the first half of 2023 compared to the previous year. Streaming subscriptions have grown, though companies like Netflix and Disney plan to increase prices. The soaring growth seen in earlier years has slowed. While Best Buy is ceasing physical media sales, retailers such as Walmart, Target, and Amazon will continue selling these products. Independent shops and a handful of video rental stores also remain, but Best Buy’s exit leaves consumers with fewer options for owning physical copies of movies and shows.
translated_content: Best Buy, nacionalni lanac prodavnica elektronike, najavio je da će ukinuti prodaju DVD-ova i Blu-ray diskova i u prodavnicama i online nakon ove praznične sezone. Ova promjena odnosi se na svih 1.129 Best Buy lokacija, uključujući 969 prodavnica u Sjedinjenim Državama. Iako nije sasvim jasno kada će Blu-ray biti povučen iz prodaje, portparol kompanije je potvrdio šire povlačenje fizičkih medija. Portparol je za Variety objasnio da su se potrošačke navike znatno promijenile u posljednjoj deceniji, a streaming servisi sada dominiraju načinom na koji ljudi gledaju filmove i serije. Ova najava dolazi nešto više od mjesec dana nakon što je Netflix poslao svoje posljednje DVD-ove, čime je okončao svoju uslugu iznajmljivanja DVD-ova. Uprkos ovim promjenama, Best Buy će i dalje prodavati fizičke diskove za video igre, iako se industrija video igara sve više okreće digitalnim preuzimanjima i streamingu. article_content: Chris Smith, a 35-year-old police officer from Catterall, near Preston, wore glasses for two decades before surgery restored his 20:20 vision. He started having severe headaches and dizzy spells after his 2011 honeymoon with wife Samantha. At first, he thought it was just post-holiday fatigue, but a fall at work led to a CT scan that uncovered a non-cancerous, golf ball-sized tumour pressing on his brain—likely present for over twenty years. An urgent craniotomy successfully removed the tumour. When Chris woke up, he was amazed to find he no longer needed glasses. An optician later confirmed his perfect vision had returned. Doctors explained immediate surgery was vital to prevent dangerous complications like seizures or brain damage. Samantha remembers their fear during this time, particularly the prospect of paralysis or memory loss, though hospital staff reassured them about the operation's safety. Chris and Samantha spent the holiday season recovering in hospital. He underwent three months of radiotherapy to target any remaining tumour cells. The treatment affected his pituitary gland, and doctors warned them it could hinder their chances of having children—news that left them heartbroken. Surprisingly, Samantha soon became pregnant, and their son Freddie was born in November 2012. Chris now feels healthier and more energetic than ever. He's training for the London Marathon, raising funds for the neurology department at Royal Preston Hospital where he was treated. He credits consultant Marcia Elizabeth Donaldson-Hugh for her calm and supportive care. On the medical side: Brain tumours can impact eyesight by affecting the optic or cranial nerves, or the brain’s vision processing areas. Tumours in the pituitary gland, temporal lobe, or occipital lobe may cause various types of vision loss, depending on which nerves or regions are involved.

Hitnom kraniotomijom tumor je uspješno uklonjen. Kada se Chris probudio, iznenadio se što mu naočale više nisu potrebne. Optičar je kasnije potvrdio da mu se vid potpuno vratio. Chris i Samantha su božićne i novogodišnje praznike proveli oporavljajući se u bolnici. Chris je zatim završio tromjesečni ciklus radioterapije kako bi uništio eventualne preostale tumorske ćelije. article_content: A recent survey of U.S. employers shows that health insurance premiums provided through work rose by 7% this year, marking a notable jump after minimal change in 2022. The nonprofit health research organization KFF released data explaining that premiums for both family and individual plans increased in step with broader trends of rising wages and inflation. As companies prepare for open enrollment for 2024, experts caution that further increases could be on the horizon. Employer-sponsored health coverage remains the most widespread in the U.S., with about 153 million Americans enrolled. Typically, employers pay at least 70% of the cost, reducing the immediate financial impact for employees. Health coverage premiums are often deducted before taxes, providing further relief to workers. Paul Fronstin from the Employee Benefit Research Institute mentions that while employer contributions help, employees can still feel the effects of rising costs. Gary Claxton, a KFF senior vice president, highlights that health care contracts may delay the direct impact of inflation on premiums. Both Claxton and Fronstin point to the consolidation of health care providers and a backlog of care postponed during the COVID-19 pandemic as factors contributing to current cost increases. Fronstin suggests that another year of rising health care expenses is likely. This article was produced by the Associated Press Health and Science Department, supported financially by the Howard Hughes Medical Institute’s Science and Educational Media Group. The AP retains full editorial control.

Neprofitna organizacija KFF za zdravstvena istraživanja objavila je podatke koji pokazuju da su premije za porodične i pojedinačne planove poskupjele prateći rast plata i opće inflacije. Kompanije se već pripremaju za prijavu na osiguranje za 2024., a stručnjaci upozoravaju na moguće novo povećanje cijena. Zdravstveno osiguranje preko poslodavaca najzastupljenije je u SAD-u, sa oko 153 miliona ljudi koji ga koriste. Poslodavci najčešće pokrivaju najmanje 70% troškova, što umanjuje direktni udar na zaposlenike. Premije se često odbijaju prije oporezivanja, što dodatno olakšava situaciju radnicima. Paul Fronstin iz Instituta za istraživanje beneficija zaposlenih ističe da i uz pomoć poslodavaca, rast troškova ipak osjete i radnici. Gary Claxton, potpredsjednik KFF-a, objašnjava da ugovori u zdravstvu mogu usporiti osjet inflacije na premije. Claxton i Fronstin također ukazuju na konsolidaciju među zdravstvenim ustanovama i naostala čekanja u pružanju zdravstvene njege zbog pandemije COVID-19 kao faktore povećanja troškova. Fronstin smatra da će rast troškova vrlo vjerovatno potrajati i naredne godine. Ovu priču pripremio odjel za zdravstvo i nauku Associated Pressa uz podršku Howard Hughes Medical Institute-ove grupe za naučnu i obrazovnu medijsku podršku, a AP zadržava potpunu uređivačku odgovornost.

article_content:
Varda Space Industries, a California-based company specializing in in-space manufacturing, is shifting its focus to Australia for future capsule landings. After facing regulatory hurdles that prevented its first capsule from reentering and landing in the United States, Varda announced an agreement with Southern Launch, an Australian launch services provider, to land an upcoming mission at the Koonibba Test Range in South Australia. The next mission could launch as early as mid-2024.

The company's first in-space manufacturing capsule, launched in June, remains stuck in orbit after U.S. authorities denied reentry. The U.S. Air Force declined Varda's request to land at a Utah training facility, and the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) did not grant permission for atmospheric reentry, leaving the test mission stranded. The 264-pound (120-kilogram) capsule, designed to manufacture products in microgravity and bring them back to Earth, was scheduled to land at the Utah Test and Training Range in September; it's built to last up to a year in orbit. Varda continues to monitor the capsule's condition and is working with UTTR officials to secure a future landing site.

During its first mission, the capsule successfully grew crystals of ritonavir, a drug used to treat HIV. NASA has noted that protein crystals grown in space can be larger and more perfect than those formed on Earth. However, the mission was unable to fulfill the critical step of returning the manufactured crystals to Earth. According to an FAA spokesperson, the reentry request was denied due to safety, risk, and impact assessments. Delian Asparouhov, Varda’s president and co-founder, attributed the challenge to a lack of precedent and coordination among Varda, the FAA, and UTTR. He told Ars Technica, “It’s pretty complicated to align all these organizations that have a variety of different regulatory approvals and safety officers.”

The Koonibba Test Range, covering 8,880 square miles (23,000 square kilometers) of uninhabited Australian land, now offers Varda an alternative reentry option that may be easier to navigate than U.S. regulations.

Varda Space Industries, kalifornijska kompanija specijalizovana za proizvodnju u svemiru, sada se okreće Australiji za buduća slijetanja svojih kapsula. Nakon što je naišla na regulatorne prepreke koje su spriječile da njihova prva kapsula uđe u atmosferu i sleti u Sjedinjenim Državama, Varda je potpisala ugovor sa Southern Launch, australskim pružateljem lansirnih usluga, za slijetanje naredne misije na Koonibba testnom poligonu u Južnoj Australiji. Očekuje se da bi naredna misija mogla poletjeti već sredinom 2024. godine.

Prva kapsula ove kompanije, lansirana u junu, i dalje je zaglavljena u orbiti nakon što su američke vlasti odbile zahtjev za ponovnim ulaskom. Američko zrakoplovstvo odbilo je zahtjev Varde za slijetanje na vojnom poligonu u Utahu, a Federalna uprava za avijaciju (FAA) nije dala dozvolu za povratak kroz atmosferu, što je ostavilo testnu misiju na čekanju. Kapsula teška 120 kilograma (264 funte), dizajnirana za proizvodnju proizvoda u mikrogravitaciji i njihov povratak na Zemlju, trebala je sletjeti na Utah Test and Training Range u septembru; napravljena je tako da može godinu dana ostati u orbiti. Varda i dalje prati stanje kapsule i sarađuje sa službenicima UTTR-a kako bi pronašli lokaciju za buduće slijetanje.

Tokom prve misije, kapsula je uspješno uzgojila kristale ritonavira, lijeka koji se koristi za liječenje HIV-a. NASA je navela da se proteinski kristali uzgojeni u svemiru mogu formirati veći i savršeniji nego oni proizvedeni na Zemlji. Ipak, misija nije uspjela realizovati ključni korak, a to je povratak ovih kristala na Zemlju. Prema navodima glasnogovornika FAA, zahtjev za ponovni ulazak u atmosferu odbijen je zbog sigurnosnih procjena i analiza rizika i uticaja. Delian Asparouhov, predsjednik i suosnivač Varde, pripisao je izazov nedostatku prethodnog iskustva i koordinacije između Varde, FAA i UTTR-a. Za Ars Technicu je izjavio: "Prilično je komplikovano uskladiti sve ove organizacije koje imaju različite regulatorne dozvole i službenike za sigurnost."

Koonibba testni poligon, koji se prostire na 23.000 kvadratnih kilometara (8.880 kvadratnih milja) nenastanjene australske zemlje, sada Vardi nudi alternativu za povratak kapsula što bi moglo biti lakše za organizovati nego podleći američkim regulativama.

article_content:
The Fair Work Ombudsman has launched an investigation, led by Natalie James, into allegations that some employers are exploiting 417 visa holders by using the visa’s 88-day work requirement to attract free or cheap labour. Over the next five years, an estimated 2.5 to 3.5 million foreign workers are expected to seek employment in Australia, raising concerns among experts about the potential impact on job prospects for Australians.

In the first half of the 2013–14 financial year, more than 128,000 working holiday 417 visas were issued, with expectations that this number will continue to rise. Natalie James emphasized the importance of preserving the integrity of the visa scheme. However, experts such as Dr. Sarah Kaine, a senior lecturer at the University of Technology Sydney, caution that these schemes could be used by employers to lower labour costs by hiring foreign workers, which may undermine Australian wages and workplace conditions.

Dr. Kaine noted that while there is a legitimate need for foreign labour in sectors like agriculture, the greatest risks of exploitation occur in low-regulation industries. She explained that such workers often have less bargaining power, and factors like language and cultural barriers can exacerbate their vulnerabilities.

During the past two financial years, the Fair Work Ombudsman received around 2,000 requests for assistance from 417 visa holders, representing one in three requests from all visa holders. Most of these requests came from workers in hospitality, followed by agriculture, forestry, and fishing.

Tokom narednih pet godina očekuje se da će između 2,5 i 3,5 miliona stranih radnika tražiti zaposlenje u Australiji, što pobuđuje zabrinutost stručnjaka po pitanju mogućeg uticaja na radna mjesta Australaca.

U prvoj polovini finansijske 2013–14. godine izdano je više od 128.000 radnih 417 viza, a očekuje se da će taj broj nastaviti rasti. Sarah Kaine, više predavačice na Univerzitetu tehnologije u Sydneyu, upozoravaju da ovakve šeme mogu poslodavci koristiti za smanjenje troškova rada zapošljavanjem stranih radnika, što može potkopati plate i uslove rada Australaca.

Dr. Kaine ističe da strana radna snaga jeste potrebna u sektorima poput poljoprivrede, ali da je rizik od iskorištavanja najveći u industrijama sa slabijom regulativom. Objašnjava kako ti radnici često imaju manje pregovaračke moći, a jezičke i kulturološke prepreke čine ih dodatno ranjivima.

article_content: A dramatic near-miss happened at Reagan National Airport in Arlington, Virginia, when three US Airways commuter jets narrowly escaped a mid-air collision due to miscommunication in air traffic control. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) is investigating how, on Tuesday afternoon, two departing flights were mistakenly guided toward an arriving plane. Officials noted the three planes, carrying 192 passengers and crew in total, closed a gap of just 1.4 miles within seconds—coming as close as 500 to 600 feet—before a controller caught the error and ordered a swift course change. Thankfully, all aircraft landed safely and no injuries occurred. Investigators say the mix-up was partly caused by sudden changes in flight paths to avoid a storm south of the airport. Air traffic control in Warrenton, Virginia, switched runway procedures but didn’t communicate the updates clearly to all control staff, leading to the incident. These types of mistakes are not uncommon: FAA records reveal that controller operational errors rose from 1,234 in 2009 to 1,895 in 2011, with dozens of the most serious incidents reported last year. In recent years, some controllers have been disciplined for errors and even sleeping on duty. Other close calls have happened at major airports like Chicago O’Hare and San Francisco. Despite repeated incidents, both the FAA and US Airways maintain that safety remains their top priority and have promised comprehensive investigations. The Reagan National episode underscores the critical need for clear communication within increasingly busy air traffic networks.
translated_content: Dramatična bliska situacija dogodila se na aerodromu Reagan National u Arlingtonu, Virginija, kada su tri aviona kompanije US Airways za dlaku izbjegla sudar u zraku zbog nesporazuma među kontrolorima leta. Savezna uprava za avijaciju (FAA) istražuje kako su u utorak poslijepodne dva aviona za polijetanje greškom usmjerena prema avionu koji je prilazio za slijetanje. Zvaničnici su naveli da su se tri aviona, sa ukupno 192 putnika i članova posade, približila na samo 1,4 milje - i to za nekoliko sekundi, na udaljenost od 500 do 600 stopa - prije nego što je kontrolorka uočila grešku i odmah naredila promjenu kursa. Srećom, svi avioni su sigurno sletjeli, bez povrijeđenih. Istražitelji kažu da je do zabune došlo dijelom zbog nagle promjene ruta leta uslijed oluje južno od aerodroma. Kontrolori leta u Warrentonu, Virginija, promijenili su upotrebu piste, ali nisu jasno prenijeli nove informacije svim kolegama u tornju, što je dovelo do incidenta. Ovakvi propusti nisu rijetkost: podaci FAA pokazuju da su greške kontrolora porasle sa 1.234 u 2009. na 1.895 u 2011. godini, uz desetine najtežih incidenata samo prošle godine. Posljednjih godina, neki kontrolori kažnjeni su zbog grešaka i čak spavanja na radnom mjestu. Bliska sudaranja zabilježena su i na važnim aerodromima poput čikaškog O'Harea i San Francisca. I pored ovakvih situacija, FAA i US Airways tvrde da im je sigurnost putnika najvažnija i obećavaju temeljite istrage. Incident na Reagan National još jednom pokazuje koliko je ključno jasno komunicirati unutar sve prometnijeg zračnog prostora.

article_content: Michelle Murphy, an Oklahoma woman, has been released from prison after serving 20 years of a life sentence for the murder of her three-month-old son. Doubts about the DNA evidence used in her conviction led to her release. Murphy was originally convicted in 1994, but a judge overturned her sentence earlier this year after reviewing new evidence. Murphy, now 37, described her long battle to prove her innocence: 'I spent 20 years wrongfully in prison for something I didn't do, and I've been fighting all these years.' Judge William C. Kellough exonerated Murphy, and the decision coincided with the 20th anniversary of her son's death. The Tulsa County District Attorney's Office acknowledged that recent DNA testing, unavailable during the original trial, helped overturn Murphy's conviction. At her initial trial, blood found at the scene was thought to belong to Murphy, but follow-up DNA analysis later proved otherwise. Murphy's attorneys also requested retesting of DNA evidence related to William Lee, a key witness and neighbor who died by suicide before the trial. Lee was the last known person to see the baby alive and had called 911 on the night of the incident. Subsequent evidence raised questions about his involvement. At the time of her conviction, Murphy was 17, and her two-year-old daughter was placed in protective custody. Murphy's defense argued that her taped confession to police was coerced. District Attorney Tim Harris said that due to the loss of evidence over time and the difficulty of finding reliable witnesses after 20 years, the state could not meet its burden of proof. The judge dismissed the case with prejudice, meaning Murphy cannot be tried again for the same crime. Murphy may seek compensation for her wrongful conviction, though Oklahoma law caps such payments at $175,000. Reunited with her family, Murphy is optimistic about rebuilding her life. 'I can learn how to live life free without all this hanging over me,' she told reporters. 'It was traumatic and very hard, but I survived. I'm a survivor.'

Murphy, sada 37 godina, opisala je svoju dugu borbu da dokaže nevinost: 'Provela sam 20 godina nevino u zatvoru za nešto što nisam uradila, i cijelo to vrijeme sam se borila.' Sudija William C. Kellough je oslobodio Murphyjevu krivice, a odluka je donesena tačno na 20. godišnjicu smrti njenog sina. Kancelarija tužioca okruga Tulsa priznala je da je nova DNK analiza, koja nije bila dostupna tokom prvobitnog suđenja, pomogla da se presuda poništi. Isprva su mislili da krv sa mjesta zločina pripada Murphy, ali kasnija DNK analiza je to opovrgnula. Murphyni advokati su također tražili ponovno testiranje DNK dokaza povezanih s Williamom Leejem, ključnim svjedokom i komšijom koji je počinio samoubistvo prije suđenja. Lee je bio posljednja poznata osoba koja je vidjela bebu živu i on je pozvao 911 te noći. Naknadni dokazi doveli su u pitanje njegovu moguću uključenost. U vrijeme presude Murphy je imala samo 17 godina, a njena dvogodišnja kćerka predata je u zaštitu. Njen advokat je tvrdio da je priznanje policiji bilo iznuđeno. Okružni tužilac Tim Harris je izjavio da provođenje novog suđenja nije moguće zbog nedostatka dokaza i starenja svjedoka tokom decenija. Sud je slučaj odbacio s predrasudom, što znači da Murphy ne može biti ponovno optužena. Murphy može tražiti naknadu zbog pogrešne osude, ali zakon Oklahome ograničava takvu isplatu na 175.000 dolara. Ponovo sa porodicom, Murphy je optimistična u vezi sa životom pred sobom. 'Mogu učiti kako da živim slobodno bez toga da mi sve ovo visi nad glavom,' rekla je novinarima. 'Bilo je traumatično i teško, ali preživjela sam. Ja sam preživjela.'
