article_content: Snapchat has been quietly piloting a series of new location-based filters in New York and Los Angeles on its iOS app. These filters use the iPhone’s GPS to determine where users are and then display relevant overlays—for example, a stylized 'Brooklyn' filter is available in Brooklyn, while a flurry of dollar bills appears for those snapping photos in Manhattan’s financial district. To activate these smart filters, users must grant the app access to their location and ensure that filters are enabled through the ‘Manage’ section under ‘Additional Services’ in the settings menu. Those in Manhattan’s theater district receive a unique ‘Broadway’ design, and special overlays have appeared for events like Gay Pride. Unlike traditional photo-editing effects, these additions are clear graphics layered over images, reminiscent of stickers found in other editing tools. Early user feedback has been enthusiastic, but the company has yet to officially introduce or confirm these features. While sponsored filters aren’t currently widespread on Snapchat, the platform did experiment with a branded filter at the Cannes Lions event by allowing snaps to feature a corporate logo and the phrase 'Yes we Cannes.' This move suggests that branded overlays could become a future revenue source for Snapchat, which so far operates without major monetization. Snapchat users have been eager to share these new filters on social media, finding the feature novel but somewhat puzzling. Elsewhere in the messaging space, Facebook, Instagram, Vine, Bebo, and Apple all continue to roll out their own instant and ephemeral messaging features, ramping up competition. For example, Facebook purchased WhatsApp and has been enhancing its Messenger app, while Instagram introduced Instagram Direct, and Apple’s iMessage now supports disappearing audio and video messages. Snapchat itself has expanded with features like real-time chat, video calls, and group sharing for events. Its founders, Evan Spiegel and Bobby Murphy—former Stanford fraternity brothers—lead the Los Angeles-based company, which first caught on with high schoolers in Southern California. Although the company doesn’t disclose active user numbers, it reports that more than 700 million messages are sent daily through its service.

Da biste aktivirali ove pametne filtere, potrebno je dozvoliti aplikaciji pristup lokaciji i uključiti filtere kroz odjeljak ‘Upravljanje’ unutar ‘Dodatnih usluga’ u izborniku postavki. Oni koji se nalaze u kazališnoj četvrti Manhattana dobivaju poseban ‘Broadway’ dizajn, a posebni filteri pojavili su se i povodom događaja poput Gay Pridea. Za razliku od tradicionalnih efekata za uređivanje fotografija, ove su nadogradnje jasne grafike koje se postavljaju preko slika, slično naljepnicama u drugim alatima za uređivanje. Početni dojmovi korisnika su pozitivni, ali kompanija još nije službeno predstavila niti potvrdila ovu funkciju. Iako sponzorisani filteri trenutno nisu široko dostupni na Snapchatu, platforma je eksperimentirala s brendiranim filterom na događaju Cannes Lions, gdje su snimke mogle imati korporativni logo i natpis 'Yes we Cannes.' Ovo pokazuje da brendirane grafike mogu postati budući izvor prihoda za Snapchat, koji za sada posluje bez značajne monetizacije. Korisnici Snapchata veoma rado dijele ove nove filtere na društvenim mrežama, smatrajući ih zanimljivim, iako pomalo zbunjujućim. Istovremeno, Facebook, Instagram, Vine, Bebo i Apple nastavljaju uvoditi vlastite funkcije za instant i prolazne poruke, čime pojačavaju konkurenciju. Na primjer, Facebook je kupio WhatsApp i unapređuje Messenger, dok je Instagram predstavio Instagram Direct, a iMessage od Applea sada omogućava slanje nestajućih audio i video poruka. Snapchat je također proširio svoju ponudu funkcijama poput chatanja u stvarnom vremenu, video poziva i grupnog dijeljenja za događaje. Osnivači kompanije, Evan Spiegel i Bobby Murphy — bivši prijatelji s fakulteta Stanford — vode kompaniju iz Los Angelesa, koja je najprije postala popularna među srednjoškolcima u južnoj Kaliforniji. Premda kompanija ne otkriva broj aktivnih korisnika, navodi da se preko njene usluge dnevno pošalje više od 700 miliona poruka.

article_content: A Danish teenager, Carina Melchior, astonished doctors when she woke from a coma moments after life support was withdrawn in preparation for organ donation. Staff at Aarhus Hospital had believed the 19-year-old was near death after a serious car accident in October 2011 and, following consultation with her family, began making arrangements for organ donation. Unexpectedly, Carina opened her eyes and moved her legs, prompting an immediate reassessment by medical staff. Carina is now recovering at a rehabilitation center. She has regained the ability to walk, talk, and ride her horse, Mathilde. Her family has initiated legal action against the hospital, asserting that doctors were too quick to withdraw care in order to obtain her organs. Her father, Kim Melchior, told Danish newspaper Ekstra Bladet that the family feels the medical staff acted hastily. Their lawyer, Nils Fjeldberg, added that Carina has been deeply affected by the experience, frequently questioning if the doctors intended to end her life. He emphasized the trauma faced by both Carina and her parents, who had believed there was no hope for recovery. Doctors at Aarhus Hospital recommended ending life support after three days in the hospital, believing Carina had little chance of survival and, even if she did, would remain in a vegetative state. After her family agreed to organ donation, preparations were made to disconnect the ventilator, but Carina unexpectedly regained consciousness. Carina's case has ignited a national debate in Denmark about organ donation and end-of-life care. Some registered donors have withdrawn consent, expressing fear that decisions may be made too hastily. In response, the Danish government is considering new guidelines to ensure organ removal preparations are only made after a patient is officially declared clinically dead. Medical experts advise that certain preparations before official brain death are necessary to facilitate successful organ transplantation. One Danish doctor interviewed by MailOnline attributed the incident to miscommunication rather than medical malpractice, emphasizing the importance of clear communication with families during critical times. The hospital has apologized for communication shortcomings with the Melchior family, acknowledging mistakes were made. Medical professionals maintain that Carina was never declared brain dead, and organ procurement was never started.

Osoblje bolnice Aarhus vjerovalo je da je devetnaestogodišnjakinja blizu smrti nakon teške saobraćajne nesreće u oktobru 2011. godine i, nakon konsultacija s porodicom, počelo je pripreme za donaciju organa. Neočekivano, Carina je otvorila oči i pomjerila noge, što je odmah dovelo do nove procjene od strane medicinskog osoblja. Carina se sada oporavlja u rehabilitacijskom centru. Ponovo može hodati, govoriti i jahati svog konja Mathilde. Njena porodica je pokrenula tužbu protiv bolnice, tvrdeći da su ljekari prebrzo obustavili liječenje radi uzimanja njenih organa. Kad je porodica pristala na donaciju organa, počele su pripreme za odvajanje s aparata, ali Carina se neočekivano probudila. Carinin slučaj pokrenuo je nacionalnu raspravu u Danskoj o donaciji organa i zbrinjavanju na kraju života. Medicinski stručnjaci naglašavaju da su određene pripreme prije zvanične potvrde moždane smrti potrebne za uspješan proces transplantacije organa. Jedan danski ljekar koji je govorio za MailOnline izjavio je da je incident posljedica nesporazuma, a ne medicinske greške, naglašavajući važnost jasne komunikacije s porodicama u kritičnim trenucima. Medicinski radnici ističu da Carina nikada nije bila proglašena moždano mrtvom i da proces uzimanja organa nije ni započeo.

article_content: Graham Axford, aged 58, was jailed for four months after being convicted of benefit fraud. He unlawfully received nearly £30,000 in housing and council tax benefits, despite owning a property in Wales and holding part-ownership of a renovated farmhouse in Normandy, France. During the period he was claiming incapacity benefits since 1995, Axford sailed his £25,000 private yacht across the Atlantic, from South Carolina to the Azores, a journey spanning roughly 2,900 miles. The fraud was uncovered by the BBC Panorama program, 'Britain on the Fiddle.' Axford was found guilty on three counts of submitting false information to the London Borough of Croydon, by failing to disclose his UK and French assets in benefit applications filed in 2003 and twice in 2007, leading to an overpayment of £29,456.55. Judge Peter Gow QC stated that Axford misrepresented his mortgage status, continuing to pay a mortgage on the Welsh property which was ultimately sold at a loss. The judge underscored Axford’s repeated dishonesty, significant overpayments received, and his failure to comply with confiscation procedures. While Axford collected incapacity benefits for a back injury resulting from a motorcycle accident, he participated in a 24-hour cycling time-trial and was active as a volunteer, serving at a crisis center and a charity shop for the blind. His defense pointed to his health challenges, including heart disease and a degenerative spine, along with his community involvement.

article_content: Senator Rand Paul visited UC Berkeley—an institution known for progressive activism—on Wednesday night to issue a strong critique of U.S. intelligence agencies. Addressing about 400 students, he condemned the National Security Agency (NSA) for its arrogance and lack of remorse after Edward Snowden’s whistleblowing exposed government surveillance. Paul emphasized that privacy rights are under threat and warned that everyone with a cell phone may be monitored. He criticized both the NSA and the CIA, alleging these agencies misuse their authority and are reluctant to change. Citing the reported spying on Senator Dianne Feinstein’s staff, Paul warned about unchecked power within the intelligence community. He stressed that Americans deserve privacy in their communications. Asked about a potential presidential run in 2016, Paul did not confirm his intentions but indicated that his engagement aims to widen the Republican Party’s appeal. He compared this to Domino’s Pizza’s public commitment to improvement, suggesting the GOP must adapt or face decline. Paul highlighted efforts to connect with a broad range of voters—including students and African Americans—by centering on privacy issues and economic changes, such as proposing 'economic freedom zones' to aid struggling cities through lower taxes and less regulation. He concluded by proposing a bipartisan congressional committee to oversee intelligence operations and prevent misuse of power. Paul also criticized President Obama for allowing extensive surveillance and referenced historical abuses, like J. Edgar Hoover’s monitoring of civil rights activists, to underscore the need for oversight. Paul’s remarks drew strong reactions from the student audience, reflecting widespread concerns about government surveillance and individual privacy.

Obraćajući se oko 400 studenata, osudio je Nacionalnu sigurnosnu agenciju (NSA) zbog arogantnosti i nedostatka kajanja nakon što je Edward Snowden razotkrio vladino prisluškivanje. Paul je naglasio da su prava na privatnost ugrožena te upozorio da svi sa mobilnim telefonom mogu biti nadgledani. Kritikovao je i NSA i CIA-u, tvrdeći da te agencije zloupotrebljavaju ovlasti i nisu spremne na promjene. Pozivajući se na navodno prisluškivanje osoblja senatorice Dianne Feinstein, Paul je upozorio na nekontrolisanu moć obavještajne zajednice. Istakao je da Amerikanci zaslužuju privatnost u svojoj komunikaciji. article_content: Researchers at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) have developed a button-sized self-charging battery capable of converting body heat into electricity. This innovation could one day allow mobile phones to recharge themselves while in your pocket. The battery can autonomously generate power from low-temperature heat sources, operating effectively between 20°C (68°F) and 60°C (140°F), much lower than previous heat-harvesting technologies. The prototype, designed by Dr. Gang Chen and his team at MIT, showcases a new way to charge mobile devices using ambient heat. Dr. Chen, head of MIT's mechanical engineering department, stated that the technology could pave the way for mobile phone batteries that don't require plugging in. He noted: 'It is a self-powered device and could be useful in places without an electric grid. To provide enough power for practical applications, such as mobile phones, improved materials and system designs are needed, and we are working towards that. With further development, these batteries could economically convert low-grade heat into electricity for wider uses—especially since they use inexpensive materials.' Dr. Chen added that this battery technology could be highly valuable for harvesting thermal energy from the environment, particularly in remote locations. Engineers are exploring various solutions to global energy challenges, including a unique British-engineered device that generates electricity from urine. This fuel cell uses bacteria to break down waste, producing power that has, for example, recharged a mobile phone. Dr. Ioannis Ieropoulos from the Bristol Robotics Laboratory at the University of the West of England, together with colleagues at Bristol University, developed this microbial fuel cell. By cultivating bacteria on carbon fiber anodes placed inside ceramic cylinders, they created a battery circuit that channels electrons released as bacteria break down urine, storing the electric charge in a capacitor. The MIT battery operates on the principle of the thermally regenerative electrochemical cycle: a battery charged at high temperature can provide more energy at lower temperatures due to heat absorption. Dr. Chen’s team leveraged this effect to build a 'heat engine' that generates electricity from surrounding heat. Earlier battery versions needed higher temperature differences (about 50°C), but by optimizing the electrodes—made of lead and ionic iron—the team achieved conversion at much lower temperature ranges. This development could allow a phone to recharge from body heat and cool down once out of a pocket, though charging effectiveness decreases in warm environments where body and room temperatures are similar. Dr. Chen estimates converting heat to electricity with about 12% efficiency is feasible between 20°C and 60°C. If refined, this technology could enable mobile phones to be charged simply by carrying them in a pocket and letting them cool. The method could also be applied in vehicles and industries where excess heat goes unused. However, current prototypes (described in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences) achieve up to 2% efficiency. Dr. Chen anticipates improvements by upgrading materials and redesigning the system. He concluded: 'Enormous amounts of low-grade heat exist in industrial processes and the environment. Efficient, low-cost utilization of this energy is key to resolving urgent energy and environmental challenges. The upper efficiency limit for harvesting heat depends on the temperature difference between sources, and for low-temperature heat, this limit is naturally low. Some temperature difference is needed for heat engines to work, which further restricts their operational range.'
translated_content: Istraživači sa Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) razvili su bateriju veličine dugmeta koja se može sama puniti pretvaranjem toplote tijela u električnu energiju. Ova inovacija bi jednog dana mogla omogućiti mobilnim telefonima da se pune dok su vam u džepu. Baterija može autonomno generisati energiju iz izvora toplote niske temperature, radeći efikasno između 20°C (68°F) i 60°C (140°F), što je znatno niže od prethodnih tehnologija za sakupljanje toplote. Prototip, koji su osmislili dr. Gang Chen i njegov tim na MIT-u, pokazuje novi način punjenja mobilnih uređaja pomoću toplote iz okoline. Dr. Chen, šef Odjela za mašinsko inžinjerstvo na MIT-u, izjavio je da bi ova tehnologija mogla otvoriti put ka baterijama za mobilne telefone koje ne zahtijevaju punjenje putem kablova. Istakao je: 'To je uređaj koji se sam pokreće i mogao bi biti koristan na mjestima bez električne mreže. Za dovoljno energije za praktične primjene, poput mobilnih telefona, potrebni su poboljšani materijali i dizajni sistema, a mi radimo na tome. Daljim razvojem, ove baterije bi mogle ekonomski pretvarati toplotu niskog nivoa u električnu energiju za širu primjenu—posebno jer koriste jeftine materijale.' Dr. Chen je dodao da bi ova baterijska tehnologija mogla biti od velike vrijednosti za sakupljanje termalne energije iz okoline, naročito u udaljenim područjima. Inženjeri istražuju razna rješenja za globalne energetske izazove, uključujući i jedinstveni uređaj britanskih inženjera koji generiše električnu energiju iz urina. Ova goriva ćelija koristi bakterije za razgradnju otpada, proizvodeći tako struju koja je, na primjer, napajala mobilni telefon. Dr. Ioannis Ieropoulos iz Bristol Robotics Laboratory na University of the West of England, zajedno sa kolegama sa Bristol University, razvio je ovu mikrobnu gorivu ćeliju. Uzgojem bakterija na anodi od karbonskih vlakana u keramičkim cilindrima, stvoren je baterijski krug koji preusmjerava elektrone koje bakterije oslobađaju razgradnjom urina, skladišteći električni naboj u kondenzatoru. Baterija sa MIT-a radi na principu termalno regenerativnog elektrokemijskog ciklusa: baterija napunjena na visokoj temperaturi može dati više energije na nižim temperaturama zahvaljujući apsorpciji toplote. Tim dr. Chena iskoristio je ovaj efekt kako bi napravio 'toplotni motor' koji generiše električnu energiju iz okoline. Ranije verzije baterije zahtijevale su veće temperaturne razlike (oko 50°C), ali optimizacijom elektroda—napravljenih od olova i jonskog željeza—tim je postigao konverziju pri mnogo nižim temperaturama. Ova inovacija može dozvoliti mobilnim telefonima punjenje od toplote tijela, i hlađenje nakon vađenja iz džepa, iako je punjenje manje efikasno u toplim okruženjima gdje su tjelesna i sobna temperatura slične. Dr. Chen procjenjuje da je moguće pretvaranje toplote u električnu energiju sa otprilike 12% efikasnosti između 20°C i 60°C. Ako se usavrši, ova tehnologija bi mogla omogućiti punjenje mobilnih telefona jednostavno nošenjem u džepu i hlađenjem. Metod bi mogao biti koristan i u vozilima i industrijama gdje se višak toplote ne koristi. Trenutni prototipi (opisani u Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences) dostižu do 2% efikasnosti. Dr. Chen očekuje poboljšanja kroz unapređenje materijala i redizajn sistema. Zaključio je: 'Ogromne količine toplote niskog nivoa postoje u industrijskim procesima i okolini. article_content: Lewis Hamilton has stated he will not risk his chances of winning the Spanish Grand Prix by repeating the erratic driving seen in the previous race in China. Starting from pole position in Barcelona, Hamilton had slowed down and weaved during the parade lap in China, causing drivers behind to brake sharply, with some nearly stopping. According to the Mail on Sunday, race officials discussed Hamilton’s unusual actions but chose not to penalize him at the time. The issue was revisited at the drivers' meeting, where Hamilton apologized and assured his peers he wouldn’t repeat the behavior. Hamilton is well-placed to win Sunday’s race after an excellent qualifying session, finishing 0.168 seconds ahead of teammate Nico Rosberg and securing his fourth pole in five races this season. Despite upgrades by competitors, Mercedes appears to maintain a significant advantage. Daniel Ricciardo of Red Bull was third-fastest, trailing Hamilton by a full second. Rosberg commented on his second-place finish, expressing disappointment but acknowledging Hamilton's stronger qualifying performance. Hamilton has won three out of the four races this season, with Rosberg leading the championship by four points heading into the race. Hamilton's only setback was a technical malfunction in Melbourne, which Rosberg won before finishing second in subsequent races. Hamilton has not led the standings since a brief period in 2012. He emphasized his focus on taking and maintaining the championship lead. Notably, Hamilton achieved pole despite reporting issues with his car, remarking that overnight changes made the car more challenging to handle. Sebastian Vettel faced gearbox issues, forcing him to start 10th and adding to a disappointing season. His teammate, Ricciardo, outperformed him in qualifying. McLaren also struggled, with Jenson Button qualifying eighth and rookie teammate Kevin Magnussen in 15th. The optimistic outlook following Ron Dennis’s return is fading, and further structural changes are needed for improvement.

article_content: ODI cricket is seen as the perfect balance between tradition and modern excitement, making it appealing to both long-time and newer cricket fans. While tournaments like the World Cup grab attention, the enduring appeal often comes from intense rivalries, particularly between India and Australia, which have created some of cricket's most memorable moments. With the 2023 ODI World Cup final on the horizon, here's a look back at classic India-Australia clashes:  1998 – The Sharjah 'Desert Storm': Sachin Tendulkar showcased aggressive batting against Australia after a mid-game sandstorm, scoring 143 runs to bring India to the final by net run rate. He followed up with another century in the final, helping India win the title.  1999 World Cup: Despite unbeaten innings from Ajay Jadeja (100*) and a solid 75 from Robin Singh, India fell 77 runs short chasing Australia’s 282 as Glenn McGrath dismantled the Indian top order.  2001 – Eden Gardens Comeback: Australia's 15-match Test winning streak ended as Harbhajan Singh claimed a historic hat-trick and a 376-run stand from VVS Laxman and Rahul Dravid led to an epic Indian comeback and series win.  2003 World Cup Final: Ricky Ponting’s unbeaten 140 powered Australia while India struggled under pressure, resulting in Australia’s third World Cup title with a 125-run win.  2003-04 Australian Tour: Rahul Dravid and VVS Laxman again anchored India to a rare away Test victory in Adelaide, and the series included a record-breaking draw at the SCG led by Sachin Tendulkar’s 241*.  2009 Hyderabad ODI: Sachin Tendulkar scored 141 chasing a daunting Australian total, but India narrowly lost by three runs.  2011 World Cup Quarterfinal: Yuvraj Singh silenced critics by guiding India past Australia with a match-winning all-round performance of 57* runs and two wickets.  2015 World Cup Semifinal: Steve Smith’s 105 and a fiery display from Australian bowlers ended India's campaign, with India suffering a dramatic batting collapse.  2019 World Cup Group Match: India’s batting, led by Dhawan, Kohli, and Rohit, dominated as India posted a huge total and beat Australia at The Oval.  2018-19 Test Series in Australia: India's team, under Virat Kohli and with Cheteshwar Pujara’s consistency, won their first-ever Test series in Australia.  2020-21 Gabba Victory: Rishabh Pant led a fearless chase at the Gabba, breaking Australia’s 32-year unbeaten Test streak at the venue and delivering a stunning series win for an injury-hit India. article_content: Mumbai Police have initiated legal proceedings after a provocative Facebook post called for the burning of the Mantralaya building and destruction of official documents in protest of the Maratha Kranti Morcha’s demands. The message, seen as capable of inciting unrest, appeared in the ‘Maratha Kranti Morcha’ group and was reportedly written by a user named Shaan Mane. The action was triggered by a tip-off received by a Marine Drive police constable on the evening of October 31. The Cyber Police are now attempting to trace the origin of the post through its IP address as part of their ongoing investigation. A formal case has been registered under sections 505(1)(B) and 506(2) of the Indian Penal Code, regarding attempted public intimidation and disruption. Efforts are underway to identify and apprehend the suspect.

article_content: Former England manager Steve McClaren has praised Roy Hodgson for handling the challenging situation following Raheem Sterling’s absence from England’s Euro 2016 qualifier against Estonia. Liverpool’s Raheem Sterling sparked discussion when he asked to sit out the match due to fatigue, and McClaren noted that several of his Derby players also reported being tired after returning from international duty. McClaren, who led England from 2006 to 2007 and now manages Derby County, expressed sympathy for Hodgson’s position during the ongoing club versus country debate. He stated, ‘I think Roy handled the situation very well. Raheem came on as a substitute, changed the game, and England secured the win—so everyone was happy.’ He continued, ‘Once players are with the national team and deemed fit, you generally have to play them because the goal is to win matches. The national setup isn’t there just to protect players for their clubs.’ McClaren acknowledged that clubs can suffer as their players take on additional matches, but he also recognized the pressures faced by international managers. He drew on his own experience at Derby, highlighting the challenges of playing seven games in 20 days before the international break. ‘I’d love to call managers like Martin O’Neill and Gordon Strachan and say that our players are too tired, but once they’re with the international squad, we have to trust that they’re being looked after. Everyone wants the best for the players, but if they’re fit to play, they have to play,’ said McClaren. Sterling requested to rest for the Estonia game after playing San Marino three days earlier, and Derby forward Chris Martin had already featured in 16 games for Derby and Scotland by this point in the season.

Raheem Sterling iz Liverpoola izazvao je raspravu kada je zatražio da preskoči utakmicu zbog umora, a McClaren je primijetio da su i neki njegovi igrači iz Derbyja prijavili umor nakon povratka iz reprezentacije. article_content: The Bihar government recently increased reservation quotas for deprived castes in state government jobs and educational institutions from 50% to 65%, following a caste survey. This policy became official after Governor Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar approved two new bills. According to the Chief Minister's Office, the enhanced quotas are to be fully implemented to assist those most in need. Chief Minister Nitish Kumar held a meeting with top officials about executing the new system, following the release of the caste survey report. Based on survey findings, the state will provide a one-time financial assistance of Rs 2 lakh to about 94 lakh families who earn less than Rs 6,000 per month. Among these, homeless families will receive Rs 1 lakh each to buy land for building homes. Finance Minister Vijay Kumar Choudhary explained that the caste survey was conducted after the central government declined to carry out a nationwide census. He urged the Union government to start the delayed 2021 Census, including a caste-based headcount. The Bihar Assembly had earlier passed two major bills—the Bihar Reservation of Vacancies in Posts and Services (Amendment) Bill and the Bihar Reservation (Admission in Educational Institutions) (Amendment) Bill—that increased the quotas for Scheduled Castes (from 16% to 20%), Scheduled Tribes (from 1% to 2%), Extremely Backward Classes (from 18% to 25%), and Other Backward Classes (from 15% to 18%). Including a 10% quota for the Economically Weaker Sections, reservations in Bihar now amount to a total of 75%. The Supreme Court had previously set a 50% limit on reservations, a threshold now exceeded by Bihar. In other business news, the Income Tax department has uncovered nearly Rs 10,000 crore in tax evasion by online sellers using platforms such as Instagram and Facebook, issuing notices to multiple companies across India. Meanwhile, the GST department has sent over 20,000 notices since 2022, leading many businesses to review tax liabilities before mergers or business deals. Additionally, Nawaz Modi, estranged wife of Raymond managing director Gautam Singhania, has alleged that Singhania assaulted her and one of their daughters.

article_content: The 2023–24 UEFA Women's Champions League marks the 23rd edition of Europe's top women's club football competition and the 15th since its rebranding. This season is the third to feature a 16-team group stage. Sixteen clubs have qualified for this year's group stage. France leads with three teams: Olympique Lyonnais, Paris Saint-Germain (PSG), and Paris FC. Germany is represented by Bayern Munich and Eintracht Frankfurt, while Spain’s top clubs, Real Madrid and Barcelona, are also present. Chelsea is England’s only representative. Olympique Lyonnais, the tournament's most successful club with eight titles, are determined to recapture the trophy this season. Under coach Sonia Bompastor, Lyon has started strongly, winning all eight opening matches and scoring 33 goals, conceding just two. New additions French international Kadidiatou Diani (from PSG) and Haitian prodigy Melchie Dumornay have joined a lineup including Lindsey Horan, Ada Hegerberg, Eugénie Le Sommer, Selma Bacha, Wendie Renard, and Danielle Van de Donk. Lyon is aiming to move past last season’s quarter-final defeat and pursue another Champions League title. The club’s ambitions are further backed by new American owner Michele Kang. Lyon is drawn in Group B, alongside Slavia Prague (Czech Republic), SKN St. Pölten (Austria), and Brann (Norway). They open the group stage on Tuesday, November 14, away against Slavia Prague. Captain Wendie Renard, who has made the most appearances in the competition’s history, commented, 'We know the path is long, but our goal is to go far, starting with our first match.' The final will take place at San Mamés in Bilbao, Spain. The tournament runs from 14 November 2023 to 25 May 2024. Defending champions Barcelona, along with Olympique Lyonnais, Chelsea, and Bayern Munich, are regarded as strong contenders. Arsenal, Wolfsburg, and Manchester United are notable absentees. Ada Hegerberg remains the top all-time scorer with 59 goals. article_content: JP McManus, an Irish businessman famous for making enormous bets on horse races, is known for his quiet and modest demeanor despite his fearless gambling. Starting out as a bookmaker, McManus earned a legendary status for his readiness to take high-stakes wagers. Industry insiders like Barry Orr from Betfair and David Williams from Ladbrokes commend McManus for his remarkable bravery and understated personality. Now valued at around $1 billion, he is a well-known figure at the Cheltenham Festival, the UK’s leading horse racing betting event, where over $820 million is wagered in just four days. Horse racing’s history is filled with dramatic stories of both massive wins and losses. A notable example is Conor Murphy, once a stable hand, who bet $75 on five of his boss's horses at Cheltenham, turning it into $1.5 million. This stroke of luck helped him realize his ambition of becoming a horse trainer in the US. The 1913 Kentucky Derby saw Donerail, an unlikely contender with 91-1 odds, win the race. A $2 bet on Donerail returned $184.90 back then, which would equate to about $4,300 from a $46 bet today. Donerail only won 10 out of 62 races, making the victory even more remarkable. Australian billionaire Kerry Packer, well-known for his extravagant gambling, often placed bets so large that bookmakers had to team up to accept them. During the 1987 Golden Slipper Stakes in Sydney, Packer lost about $7 million in a single day, including $2 million on his own horse. Italian jockey Frankie Dettori made history in 1996 by claiming victory in all seven races at Britain’s Ascot Festival, beating odds of 25,000-1. Darren Yeats, who staked $89 on an accumulator for those races, walked away with $830,000. Dettori’s achievement was later honored with a statue at Ascot. In another astonishing case, a Yorkshire gambler in Britain transformed a 75-cent bet on eight horses into a $1.5 million payout in 2008, the first million-pound win in a UK betting shop.

Počeo je kao kladioničar, a status legende stekao je spremnošću da prihvati visoke opklade. Industrijski insajderi poput Barryja Orra iz Betfaira i Davida Williamsa iz Ladbrokesa hvale McManusa zbog njegove hrabrosti i nenametljivog ponašanja. Sada procijenjen na oko milijardu dolara, često je viđen na Cheltenham Festivalu, najvažnijem događaju konjičkih trka u Velikoj Britaniji, gdje se u četiri dana uloži više od 820 miliona dolara. Historija konjskih trka obiluje pričama o dramatičnim pobjedama i velikim gubicima. Poseban primjer je Conor Murphy, nekadašnji radnik u štali, koji je s opkladom od 75 dolara na pet konja svog šefa u Cheltenhamu osvojio 1,5 milion dolara. Ova nevjerovatna sreća omogućila mu je da ostvari san i postane trener konja u SAD-u. Na Kentucky Derbiju 1913. godine Donerail, autsajder s kvotom 91 prema 1, pobijedio je u trci. Australski milijarder Kerry Packer, poznat po rizičnom kockanju, često je ulagao toliko novca da su kladioničari morali zajednički prihvatati njegove opklade. Na Golden Slipper Stakes-u u Sydneyju 1987. godine, Packer je izgubio otprilike 7 miliona dolara za jedan dan, uključujući 2 miliona na svog vlastitog konja. Italijanski džokej Frankie Dettori ispisao je povijest 1996. godine, kada je pobijedio u svih sedam trka na Ascot Festivalu u Britaniji, uprkos šansama 25.000 prema 1. Darren Yeats, koji je uložio 89 dolara u akumulatorsku opkladu na te trke, osvojio je 830.000 dolara. Dettorijevo postignuće kasnije je ovjekovječeno statuom na ulazu u Ascot. article_content: Dusky langur monkeys, often called 'spectacled leaf monkeys' due to their distinctive white-ringed eyes, have an appearance reminiscent of cartoon characters. Their playful and expressive faces attract many visitors, especially at Kaeng Krachan National Park in Phetchaburi province, Thailand. Amateur photographer Michael Edward, a 29-year-old IT administrator from Egypt, photographed these charismatic monkeys during a three-week wildlife photography tour across Thailand. He spent several hours observing a group, witnessing their playful interactions among the trees. Baby dusky langurs are born with striking bright orange fur, which transitions to black or brown by around three months of age. The monkeys' unique looks and social behavior continue to captivate tourists and wildlife enthusiasts alike. Unfortunately, dusky langurs are currently classified as 'near threatened.' Experts note that their global population has decreased by over 30 percent in the last 30 years, primarily due to habitat loss from agriculture and expanding human settlements. In Malaysia, road accidents are another significant threat. Their diet mainly consists of leaves, but they also eat seeds, fruit, and flowers. Edward, who has always enjoyed photographing animals in their natural habitats, emphasized his preference for capturing wildlife living freely rather than in captivity. His experiences growing up in Egypt with a variety of animals inspired his passion for wildlife photography.

article_content: Diners in Australia may be surprised to find some McDonald's restaurants temporarily rebranded as 'Macca's', reflecting the affectionate nickname Australians commonly use for the fast-food giant. McDonald's is rebranding 13 of its outlets, including ones in Engadine (southern Sydney) and Kangaroo Point (Queensland), as part of a campaign to celebrate Australia Day on January 26. The new signage is a limited-time change, with stores returning to their traditional branding in early February. Mark Lollback, McDonald's Chief Marketing Officer in Australia, said, 'We're incredibly proud to embrace our uniquely Australian nickname. What better way to show Aussies how proud we are to be part of the Australian community than to change our store signs to the name the community has given us?' The decision was influenced by market research indicating that at least half of Australians refer to McDonald's as 'Macca's'. In a national survey, 'Macca's' ranked as the second most recognized Australianism, just behind 'footy' for Australian Rules football. The nickname's popularity has led McDonald's to campaign for its inclusion in the online edition of Australia's Macquarie Dictionary.

McDonald's privremeno preimenuje 13 svojih lokacija, uključujući one u Engadineu (južni Sydney) i Kangaroo Pointu (Queensland), kao dio kampanje povodom Dana Australije 26. januara. Ima li boljeg načina da pokažemo Australcima koliko smo ponosni biti dio australske zajednice nego da natpise na restoranima promijenimo u ime koje nam je zajednica dala?' Popularnost ovog nadimka podstakla je McDonald's da predloži njegovo uključivanje u online izdanje australijskog Macquarie rječnika.

article_content: Orchidée has emerged as the top color trend this season, overtaking last year’s pastel pink and capturing the attention of fashion fans everywhere. The fashion industry shifts gears quickly—if you’ve just learned about 'Normcore', there’s already new lingo on the scene. 'HEAD', meaning 'high earner, awful dresser', is now a hot topic. Stars like Cristiano Ronaldo, Simon Cowell, Ashton Kutcher, and Peter Crouch are cited as classic examples, thanks to fashion writer Ellie Pither. Haçienda-inspired styles, referencing Manchester’s legendary nightclub era with Spanish elegance, are making a comeback. Picture floppy hats, ornate earrings, and tastefully crafted clutches—elegant rather than rave-ready. Spanish chic, featuring dramatic shapes, fishtail dresses, and statement jewelry, is expected to rise in popularity with the World Cup coming up. Look to style icons like Sofia Vergara and Penelope Cruz for inspiration. The South American-inspired 'Gaucho' trend is also gaining ground, with cropped wide-legged trousers and tailored shirts—historically worn by 19th-century cowboys. Big names like Céline, Marc Jacobs, and Louis Vuitton set the tone, with Victoria Beckham helping popularize the look. 'Arm party' is the buzzword for stacking and mixing jewelry—bracelets, rings, and watches—just as Rita Ora demonstrates. Stacked rings and layered necklaces elevate the ensemble. For outerwear, Christopher Bailey’s Burberry has brought the blanket coat to the forefront, crafting monogrammed wool ponchos and geometric-patterned wraps perfect for British weather and style. On the footwear front, sliders—once regarded as utilitarian—are now in vogue. Designers like Phoebe Philo at Céline elevated these chunky sandals, and now even socks worn with sliders are trendy, as seen on Rita Ora, Bruce Willis, and the Olsen twins. From Nike and Adidas classics to affordable styles at Topshop and ASOS, and luxury options from Celine, Gucci, and Givenchy, sliders are everywhere. Fashion leaders like Miuccia Prada have turned even ‘ugly’ shoes into a must-have. This season’s trends blend bold accessories, retro influences, and a daring embrace of formerly underrated styles—fueling the ever-inventive world of fashion.

Modna industrija brzo mijenja smjerove—ako ste tek usvojili 'Normcore', već su u opticaju novi izrazi. 'HEAD', što znači 'high earner, awful dresser' (osoba sa visokim prihodom i lošim stilom), sada je popularna tema. Zvijezde poput Cristiana Ronalda, Simona Cowella, Ashtona Kutchera i Petera Croucha su tipični primjeri, prema modnoj novinarki Ellie Pither. Haçienda-inspirirani stilovi, koji podsjećaju na legendarnu mančestersku noćnu scenu sa elementima španske elegancije, ponovo su u modi. Zamislite lepršave šešire, bogate naušnice i ukusno izrađene torbice—više sofisticiranost nego rejv. Španski šik, sa dramatičnim krojevima, haljinama 'mermaid' kroja i upadljivim nakitom, očekivano raste u popularnosti sa dolaskom Svjetskog prvenstva. Južnoamerički 'Gaucho' trend takođe stječe popularnost, sa kratkim širokim pantalonama i uglađenim košuljama—inspirisano 19. stoljetnim kaubojima. Brendovi kao što su Céline, Marc Jacobs i Louis Vuitton diktiraju stil, a Victoria Beckham predvodi trend. 'Arm party' je izraz za slojevito nošenje nakita—narukvica, prstenja i satova—što Rita Ora savršeno demonstrira. Složeni prstenovi i višeslojni lančići upotpunjuju izgled. Kad je riječ o gornjoj odjeći, Christopher Bailey iz Burberryja izbacio je blanket-mantil u prvi plan, sa vunenim pončoima sa monogramima i geometrijskim uzorcima, idealnim za britansko vrijeme i stil. article_content: Residents and commuters in the Ojodu-Berger area of Lagos are voicing concern about the deteriorating state of the metal net barricade installed along the roadside. On Wednesday, parts of the barricade were seen fallen onto the pavement near Berger Motor Park, with pedestrians stepping over the damaged sections. The barrier, introduced in May 2017 during the administration of former governor Akinwunmi Ambode, was designed to encourage use of the pedestrian bridge and stop unsafe road crossings. Local transport workers stated that the barricade recently collapsed because its supporting pillars became severely rusted, emphasizing that wind damage—not vandalism—was the cause. One worker, Taofeek, recalled moving the barrier from the road to the walkway after discovering it had toppled. The nuts and bolts anchoring it down were also found to be rusted. Pedestrians and vendors now use the fallen barricade to rest luggage and goods. Trader Lola Omololu cautioned that the remaining standing parts may also collapse soon if repairs are not made. Pedestrian Isaac appealed to the Lagos State government, asking for removal and replacement of the damaged sections, stating that the broken barrier now fails its safety purpose and has become an eyesore. Efforts to contact Lagos State Commissioner for Information, Gbenga Omotoso, were unsuccessful, as he did not respond to calls or messages by the time of reporting.
translated_content: Stanovnici i putnici u području Ojodu-Berger u Lagosu izražavaju zabrinutost zbog propadanja metalne barijere postavljene uz cestu. U srijedu su dijelovi barijere viđeni srušeni na pločniku pored Berger Motor Parka, dok su pješaci prelazili preko oštećenih dijelova. Barijera, uvedena u maju 2017. za vrijeme bivšeg guvernera Akinwunmija Ambodea, trebala je potaknuti korištenje pješačkog mosta i spriječiti nesigurno prelazak ceste. Lokalni radnici u transportu naveli su da se barijera nedavno srušila jer su njezini noseći stubovi ozbiljno zahrđali, naglašavajući da je uzrok oluji vjetar, a ne vandalizam. Jedan od radnika, Taofeek, ispričao je kako je barijeru pomjerio s ceste na pločnik nakon što ju je zatekao srušenu. Također je utvrđeno da su vijci i matice kojima je bila pričvršćena na tlo korodirali. Pješaci i prodavači sada koriste srušenu barijeru za odlaganje prtljaga i robe. Prodavačica Lola Omololu upozorila je da bi i preostali dijelovi mogli uskoro pasti ako se ne poprave. article_content: Portuguese Prime Minister Antonio Costa announced his resignation on Tuesday, following a corruption investigation involving top officials in his administration. Just hours before Costa’s announcement, his chief of staff, Vitor Escaria, was arrested by police during raids on public buildings and private properties. The probe centers on allegations of corruption, malfeasance, and influence peddling in the government's management of lithium mining and hydrogen production projects. Infrastructure Minister Joao Galamba and the head of the country's environmental agency were named formal suspects in the investigation. Costa, who has led Portugal’s Socialist government since 2015, stated in a televised address that he trusts the justice system and maintains his innocence. 'If there are suspicions, then the judicial authorities are free to look into them… I am not above the law,' he said. President Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa is expected to accept Costa’s resignation. Opposition parties have called for the government to step down immediately. The investigation is being led by the state prosecutor’s office and the Supreme Court, which is examining whether Costa was involved in decisions that enabled the projects under scrutiny. Targeted activities include the awarding of lithium mining concessions near Portugal’s border with Spain, and plans for a green hydrogen plant and data center in Sines, about 100 kilometers south of Lisbon—an initiative supported by the European Union. In addition to Costa’s chief of staff, arrest warrants were issued for the mayor of Sines and two executives from Start Campus, the company responsible for building the hydrogen facility and data center.

Istraga se fokusira na optužbe za korupciju, zloupotrebu položaja i trgovinu utjecajem u upravljanju vladinim projektima rudarenja litija i proizvodnje vodonika. Ministar infrastrukture Joao Galamba i direktor državne agencije za zaštitu okoliša formalno su imenovani osumnjičenima u istrazi. Costa, koji predvodi portugalsku socijalističku vladu od 2015. godine, u televizijskom obraćanju izjavio je da vjeruje pravosudnom sistemu i da je nevin. 'Ako postoje sumnje, pravosudni organi ih mogu slobodno istražiti ... Nisam iznad zakona,' poručio je. Očekuje se da će predsjednik Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa prihvatiti njegovu ostavku. Oporbene stranke traže da vlada odmah odstupi. Istragu vode državno tužilaštvo i Vrhovni sud, koji ispituju je li Costa bio uključen u odluke koje su omogućile projekte pod istragom. Ciljane aktivnosti uključuju dodjelu koncesija za rudarenje litija blizu granice sa Španijom, te planiranje fabrike zelenog vodonika i podatkovnog centra u Sinesu, oko 100 kilometara južno od Lisabona — inicijativa koju podržava Evropska unija. Pored šefa kabineta, nalozi za hapšenje izdani su i za gradonačelnika Sinesa te dva direktora kompanije Start Campus, firme odgovorne za izgradnju postrojenja za vodonik i podatkovni centar.

Uber has been fined by Australia's communications regulator for breaching anti-spam laws after the company sent more than two million marketing emails to customers in a single day. The emails, which advertised an alcohol home delivery service, failed to provide recipients with an option to unsubscribe, and over 500,000 of these messages were sent to individuals who had previously opted out of marketing communications, according to the Australian Communications and Media Authority (ACMA). Uber was fined Aus$412,500 (US$260,000) for the violation.

Australian law prohibits sending marketing emails without customer consent and requires a clear option to unsubscribe. ACMA chair Nerida O'Loughlin called Uber's actions an "avoidable error" and emphasized that, "Customers are fed up with their wishes not being respected." In response, Uber admitted its mistake, with a spokesperson telling AFP that the company "had made a mistake" in sending the marketing emails.

According to the ACMA, businesses in Australia have paid more than Aus$11 million in fines over the past 18 months for breaches of spam and telemarketing regulations.

Emailovi, koji su reklamirali kućnu dostavu alkohola, nisu nudili opciju za odjavu sa liste, a preko 500.000 tih poruka poslano je ljudima koji su se već ranije odjavili sa marketinških obavijesti, navodi Australska agencija za komunikacije i medije (ACMA). Uber je za ovo prekršaj kažnjen sa 412.500 australijskih dolara (260.000 američkih dolara).

Australski zakon zabranjuje slanje marketinških emailova bez pristanka korisnika i zahtijeva jasnu opciju za odjavu. Predsjednica ACMA-e, Nerida O'Loughlin, nazvala je postupak Ubera "izbježivom greškom" i istakla: "Korisnici su umorni što im se želje ne poštuju." Kao odgovor, Uber je priznao grešku, a portparol kompanije izjavio za AFP da su "napravili grešku" slanjem ovih emailova.

Prema ACMA-i, firme u Australiji su u posljednjih 18 mjeseci platile više od 11 miliona australijskih dolara kazni zbog kršenja zakona o neželjenoj pošti i telemarketingu.

LILLE, France: George Ford and Owen Farrell will start together for England against Samoa on Saturday, with Freddie Steward returning at fullback and Tom Curry starting at flanker after limited World Cup action so far. However, flanker Jack Willis has been ruled out of the tournament with a neck injury suffered during the Chile match. England have already secured top position in Pool D, but after a two-week break, coach Steve Borthwick is keen for his strongest lineup to take the field ahead of a likely quarter-final in Marseille against Fiji.

"We are very focused on this game. Samoa are a really strong, powerful side; they have a lot of pace and play a physical brand of rugby," Borthwick told reporters. "Our preparation has gone well. I am pleased with the team this week. The break allowed us to come back refreshed, and the squad has continued to build throughout the tournament."

Farrell returns from his four-game suspension to play inside centre, with Ford, man of the match in England's first two games, reclaiming the flyhalf shirt. This will be the first time they have started as a pair since the 2021 Six Nations, a partnership initially favored by former coach Eddie Jones. "I'm very excited to see that partnership on the field," Borthwick said.

Ford and Farrell were at their best in the 2019 World Cup semi-final win over New Zealand, a match in which Manu Tuilagi starred at outside centre – the position he will fill again on Saturday. Notably, this will be Tuilagi's first match against Samoa, his country of birth.

Steward, known for his reliability under the high ball and strong defense, returns at fullback, with Marcus Smith, who impressed against Chile, moving to the bench. Joe Marchant, having played well at centre, shifts to the right wing, and Jonny May stays on the left. Henry Arundell, who equalled a tournament record with five tries against Chile, is not included in the squad.

Curry returns after serving a three-game ban for a dangerous tackle in England's opener against Argentina. Courtney Lawes and Ben Earl round out the back row, with Billy Vunipola named among the replacements. Willis’s latest injury is especially harsh, given his long recovery from a severe knee issue sustained in 2021. "We're very disappointed for him and will name a replacement soon," Borthwick said.

Marcus Smith, 23. Ollie Lawrence.

article_content: Draymond Green is preparing to return to the Golden State Warriors as they face Sacramento, having completed a five-game suspension. This disciplinary action followed Green’s incident in which he put Minnesota Timberwolves’ Rudy Gobert in a headlock during a game, leading to criticism and penalties from the NBA. The Warriors, valued at $7.7 billion and owners of the self-financed Chase Center, decided to retain Green, awarding him a four-year, $100 million contract just months before the incident. Despite past altercations and suspensions—including a widely reported punch of teammate Jordan Poole before the 2022-23 campaign—the team continues to value Green’s contributions on the court. Green holds accolades as a four-time NBA All-Star and All-Defensive First Team member. The Warriors' recent struggles without him underline his role as a key player. NBA executive Joe Dumars characterized Green’s actions as ‘unsportsmanlike and dangerous.’ Coach Steve Kerr also conceded that Green went too far after reviewing the altercation on video. For their involvement, Gobert, Klay Thompson, and Jaden McDaniels each received $25,000 fines. Green, because of a history of similar conduct, lost nearly $770,000 during his suspension. Last season, Green averaged approximately 8.5 points, 7.2 rebounds, and 6.8 assists per game with a personal best shooting percentage of 52.7%. He opted out of a $27.6 million deal to secure his current contract, demonstrating both his value and the Warriors’ willingness to accept his on-court intensity for his overall contributions.

article_content: In horse racing, there is the trifecta. In entertainment, there is the EGOT—recognizing those who have won an Emmy, Grammy, Oscar, and Tony. Perhaps in the future, there will be something called the 'Seacrest'—awarded to those who have hosted programs on all four major American television networks. On Tuesday, CBS announced that Ryan Seacrest will host and produce 'Fashion Rocks,' a two-hour special airing in September. Seacrest already has ties with ABC as host of 'New Year's Rockin' Eve,' with Fox on 'American Idol,' and with NBC. CBS was the only major broadcaster he had yet to work with—until now. Seacrest's agreement with CBS and an extension of his existing contract with NBC were first reported by The Hollywood Reporter. NBC later confirmed that Seacrest has re-signed for another year. A network spokeswoman stated, 'This new deal will include hosting and producing the 2015 Live from the Red Carpet events for E!, contributing to E! News, and hosting and producing specials for both E! and NBC.' There had been speculation that Seacrest might stop hosting red carpet shows, but that is not happening. However, his renewed NBC contract does not include roles with NBC News or NBC Sports. In his 2012 agreement, Seacrest was named a 'special correspondent' on the 'Today' show and contributed to NBC's Olympic coverage. Seacrest told The Hollywood Reporter that he would like to continue collaborating with both divisions. He has already begun discussions with NBC Sports about contributing to the 2016 Rio Olympics, similar to his involvement in the 2012 London Games. However, appearing on 'Today' is less likely, since his morning radio show keeps him in Los Angeles while 'Today' broadcasts from New York.

Astronomers have utilized the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) to observe ceers-2112, the most distant barred spiral galaxy ever detected, dating back more than 11.7 billion years—approximately 2 billion years after the Big Bang. ceers-2112 displays unexpected complexity for such an early era in the universe, featuring a disk and a central bar similar to those found in the Milky Way.

Astrophysicists had previously believed barred spiral galaxies required at least 6.9 billion years after the Big Bang to form, making this discovery particularly striking. This research, published in Nature, now challenges existing models of galaxy evolution and the assumed role of dark matter in these processes. Using JWST’s sophisticated imaging, scientists could analyze ceers-2112’s features in much greater detail than was possible with earlier telescopes.

As lead author Luca Costantin explained, current simulations struggle to account for the existence of such galaxies so early in cosmic history. Alexander de la Vega of UC Riverside stated, "ceers-2112 demonstrates that barred spiral galaxies can develop much sooner than expected." Yetli Rosas Guevara, commenting independently, confirmed that such structures were not anticipated during the universe’s early stages.

Researchers are now re-examining established theories regarding galaxy development. Previous assumptions were that young galaxies were so turbulent and unstable that bars could neither form nor endure. The ceers-2112 discovery forces scientists to reconsider these timelines and highlights possible gaps in current models of dark matter’s influence in the early universe. Co-author Jairo Abreu noted that the prevalence of baryon matter, rather than dark matter, in this ancient galaxy may require scientists to revisit estimates of how much dark matter shaped galaxies in the universe’s youth.

Astronomi su pomoću Svemirskog teleskopa James Webb (JWST) uočili ceers-2112, najudaljeniju spiralnu galaksiju s prečkom do sada, staru više od 11,7 milijardi godina—oko 2 milijarde godina nakon Velikog praska. ceers-2112 pokazuje iznenađujuću složenost za tako ranu fazu svemira, s diskom i centralnom prečkom sličnom onima iz naše Mliječne staze.

Astrofizičari su ranije smatrali da su ovakvim galaksijama potrebne najmanje 6,9 milijardi godina nakon Velikog praska da nastanu, pa je ovo otkriće zaista iznenadilo naučnu zajednicu. Ovo istraživanje, objavljeno u časopisu Nature, dovodi u pitanje postojeće modele formiranja galaksija i ulogu tamne materije u tim procesima. Zahvaljujući naprednim JWST snimcima, naučnici su uspjeli detaljno analizirati karakteristike ceers-2112.

Glavni autor, Luca Costantin, naglašava da postojeće simulacije teško mogu objasniti tako rane galaksije ovog tipa. Alexander de la Vega sa UC Riverside ističe: "ceers-2112 pokazuje da se spiralne galaksije s prečkom mogu razviti mnogo ranije nego što se mislilo." Yetli Rosas Guevara, koja nije bila uključena u istraživanje, potvrdila je da ovakvi oblici nisu očekivani u djetinjstvu svemira.

Naučnici sada preispituju dotadašnje teorije o razvoju galaksija. Prethodna saznanja sugerirala su da su mlade galaksije bile haotične i nestabilne, pa nisu mogle dugo zadržati prečke. Otkriće ceers-2112 tjera naučnike da razmišljaju o novim okvirima i otkriva moguće praznine u razumijevanju uloge tamne materije. Koautor Jairo Abreu naglasio je da može biti potrebno ponovo procijeniti koliko je tamna materija, a koliko obična materija, bila presudna za razvoj galaksija u ranom svemiru.

article_content: Javier Milei, a far-right outsider presidential candidate, has garnered a devoted following among young male voters in Argentina. David Urbani, a 20-year-old economics student, first encountered Milei through simple, accessible economics videos on YouTube, appreciating his academic yet non-political approach. Milei, new to Argentina’s political scene, has quickly risen to global attention as a 'dark horse' in the current presidential race. He faces center-left Economy Minister Sergio Massa in a tightly contested run-off, with polls showing both candidates virtually tied. Much of Milei's momentum comes from his passionate, mostly young male supporters. Some are dedicated libertarians, while others are disillusioned with the established political system. Critics accuse Milei of extreme right-wing views, but his young supporters remain committed. Ramiro Gómez, a 21-year-old IT technician, supports Milei for his willingness to try a new path amid Argentina’s economic struggles. Elected to Argentina’s congress in 2021, Milei launched his presidential bid as a freshman legislator and quickly upset expectations by leading August's open primary vote, outpacing established politicians. He maintained his frontrunner status, finishing second to Massa in October's general election and earning a spot in the run-off. Analysts attribute Milei’s popularity to Argentina’s severe economic crisis, including 140% inflation and currency devaluation. His platform includes deep cuts to government ministries, introducing fees for public healthcare, closing the central bank, and dollarizing the economy. He also mixes libertarian and conservative social views, supporting policies like banning abortion and legalizing organ sales, and has targeted groups such as women, the LGBTQ community, and Pope Francis. Milei’s eccentric persona, from being a former rock band frontman to owning five cloned dogs, and his dramatic campaign stunts—for example, tearing down ministry names on stage—have fueled his appeal. His image as a rebellious outsider resonates, especially among middle- and working-class youth frustrated by job instability. Not all Argentinians support Milei’s more radical ideas. Plans to dollarize the economy face wide opposition; a September poll found about 70% disapproved, and over 170 economists warned it could worsen inflation and debt. Despite controversy, many young Argentinians see Milei as an honest critic of elite corruption, especially given recent scandals involving top politicians like outgoing Vice President Cristina Fernandez, who was convicted of fraud. However, some supporters worry about Milei’s alliances with establishment figures such as former President Mauricio Macri and Patricia Bullrich. Still, there’s optimism among his base that his movement marks a lasting shift, with more young people engaging with economic ideas. Experts note that the endurance of Milei’s influence may depend on election results and future economic trends, while supporters believe that his movement has already ignited real change among youth.

Milei, novajlija na argentinskoj političkoj sceni, brzo se probio na globalni radar kao 'tamni konj' trenutnih predsjedničkih izbora. Suočava se sa centrističkim ministrom ekonomije Sergiom Massom u tijesnoj drugoj izbornoj rundi, a ankete pokazuju gotovo izjednačenu utrku. Većina Mileijeve energije dolazi od njegovih strastvenih, pretežno mladih muških pristalica. Neki su posvećeni libertarijanci, dok su drugi razočarani ustaljenim političkim sistemom. Kritičari optužuju Mileija za ekstremno desničarske stavove, ali njegovi mladi pristalice ostaju vjerni. Izabran u argentinski kongres 2021. godine, Milei je pokrenuo svoju predsjedničku kandidaturu kao novi zastupnik i brzo je iznenadio očekivanja vodeći na otvorenim predizborima u kolovozu, pretekao je etablirane političare. Ostao je među favoritima, završio je drugi iza Masse na općim izborima u oktobru i osigurao mjesto u drugom krugu. Analitičari Mileijevu popularnost pripisuju dubokoj ekonomskoj krizi u Argentini, uključujući inflaciju od 140% i devalvaciju peza. Njegov program uključuje velika smanjenja državnih ministarstava, uvođenje naknada za javno zdravstvo, zatvaranje centralne banke i dolarizaciju ekonomije. Također kombinuje libertarijanske i konzervativne društvene stavove, podržava zabranu abortusa i legalizaciju prodaje organa te često kritikuje grupe poput žena, LGBTQ zajednice i samog papu Franju. Mileijeva ekscentričnost — od toga što je bio frontmen rock benda do posjedovanja pet kloniranih pasa — i njegovi dramatični kampanjski nastupi, poput kidanja imena ministarstava na sceni, dodatno pojačavaju njegovu privlačnost. Njegova slika buntovnog autsajdera posebno odjekuje među mladima srednje i radničke klase frustriranih zbog nestabilnosti zaposlenja. Nisu svi Argentinci skloni Mileijevim radikalnim idejama. Planovi za dolarizaciju ekonomije naišli su na široko protivljenje; u septembarskoj anketi oko 70% ispitanika izjavilo je protivljenje, a više od 170 ekonomista upozorilo je da bi ta promjena mogla pogoršati inflaciju i dug. Usprkos kontroverzama, mnogi mladi Argentinci vide Mileija kao iskrenog kritičara korumpirane elite, pogotovo u kontekstu nedavnih skandala, poput potpredsjednice Cristine Fernandez koja je osuđena za prevaru. Ipak, neki pristalice izražavaju sumnju zbog Mileijevih saveza sa osobama iz političke elite, kao što su bivši predsjednik Mauricio Macri i Patricia Bullrich. I dalje, optimizam u njegovoj bazi je jak, smatrajući da njegov pokret donosi trajne promjene, sa sve više mladih zainteresovanih za ekonomske teme. Stručnjaci napominju da će opstanak Mileijevog utjecaja zavisiti od izbornih rezultata i budućih ekonomskih tokova, dok pristalice vjeruju da je već pokrenuo stvarne promjene među mladima.

article_content: The Inspector-General of Police, Olukayode Egbetokun, has directed the police Electoral Offences Desk to launch immediate investigations into incidents reported during last Saturday’s off-season elections in Imo, Kogi, and Bayelsa states. Force Public Relations Officer, Olumuyiwa Adejobi, announced this in a statement on Tuesday. Egbetokun praised police officers and personnel from other security agencies for helping the elections run smoothly. However, he acknowledged reports of violent incidents during the polls and ordered swift investigations to bring those responsible to justice. He emphasized that, despite previous security concerns, the elections proceeded smoothly overall, thanks to the efforts of security personnel who maintained order and ensured public safety. The IGP instructed Electoral Offences Desk officers, under the supervision of the Deputy Inspector General in charge of the Force Criminal Investigation Department, to begin prompt investigations into these incidents. Egbetokun also expressed gratitude to all security agencies involved in securing the elections, urging officers to uphold professionalism, integrity, and strict adherence to the law and operational guidelines for a stronger democracy in Nigeria.

article_content: Manchester United’s struggles continue as they lose 2-3 at home to Galatasaray, while Arsenal are beaten 2-1 by RC Lens in France in the UEFA Champions League. This marks United's second consecutive defeat in the group stage, an unprecedented occurrence for the club, leaving Erik ten Hag's team at risk of early elimination. Galatasaray’s Argentinian striker Mauro Icardi missed a penalty but redeemed himself by scoring the winning goal after the Turkish side twice came from behind. United's Rasmus Hojlund scored two quality goals, but Galatasaray quickly answered, with Wilfried Zaha scoring against his former club and Kerem Akturkoglu finding the net as well. Casemiro was sent off for a desperate tackle following a poor pass from goalkeeper Andre Onana, and Icardi missed the subsequent penalty. However, Icardi chipped in the decisive goal in the 81st minute. United are now bottom of Group A, six points behind Bayern Munich, who came back to beat FC Copenhagen 2-1 in Denmark. Lukas Lerager scored for Copenhagen, but Bayern leveled through Jamal Musiala and won it late thanks to Mathys Tel. Arsenal suffered their first defeat of the season, losing 2-1 at Lens. Gabriel Jesus put Arsenal ahead in the 14th minute, but Adrien Thomasson equalized for the French side, and Arsenal also saw Bukayo Saka leave the game with an injury before half-time. Wahi, Lens's record signing, scored the winner in the 69th minute. Lens now top Group B with four points, narrowly ahead of Arsenal. PSV Eindhoven drew 2-2 at home with Sevilla after Jordan Teze scored a stoppage-time equalizer in a flurry of late goals. Real Madrid continued their strong form as Jude Bellingham recorded a goal and an assist in a 3-2 win over Napoli in Group C. Napoli led through Leo Ostigard, but Bellingham set up Vinicius Junior to equalize and then scored himself. Piotr Zielinski’s penalty leveled the game for Napoli, but an own goal from goalkeeper Alex Meret, deflecting Federico Valverde's powerful shot, secured Madrid's victory. Braga snatched a dramatic 3-2 win away to Union Berlin with Andre Castro's stoppage-time goal. Union had led by two goals through Sheraldo Becker, but Sikou Niakate and Bruma pulled Braga level before Castro won it from distance. This resulted in Braga's first Champions League win since 2012. Inter Milan beat Benfica 1-0 in Group D, with Marcus Thuram scoring the only goal. Inter are now level on points with Real Sociedad, who defeated Salzburg 2-0 earlier in Austria.

article_content: A new 'anti-hunger' additive is being used in yogurts and smoothies to help dieters feel full after eating smaller amounts, potentially aiding in weight loss. Scientists are developing an ingredient called SATISFIT-LTG as a dietary aid. Dr. Carsten Huettermann of Dow Wolff explained at the American Chemical Society meeting in Philadelphia that tests found volunteers felt full after consuming less food containing the additive. Volunteers who consumed food with SATISFIT-LTG ate 13% fewer calories at a follow-up meal two hours later. The additive is a new type of methyl cellulose, commonly used as a binding agent in ready meals and baked goods. Methyl cellulose is a white powder that dissolves in hot water and turns into a gel when heated. It has been used in food for about 50 years. Unlike conventional methyl cellulose, the new additive forms a gel at body temperature, allowing it to remain in the stomach longer, which increases feelings of fullness. Dr. Huettermann said this ingredient could help people feel satiated after smaller meals, possibly reducing cravings. He added that further studies are planned to better understand its mechanism and potential impact on weight management. SATISFIT-LTG is being developed for use in chilled products like yogurts and smoothies. Emma Williams of the Nutrition Society told The Daily Telegraph that while these findings are promising as a proof-of-concept, more research is needed to fully understand the processes and potential for long-term weight loss. Dr. Huettermann confirmed that further research is underway following the promising initial trials.
translated_content: Novi 'anti-gladni' dodatak koristi se u jogurtima i smoothie napicima kako bi pomogao osobama na dijeti da se osjećaju sito nakon što pojedu manje količine hrane, što bi moglo pomoći pri mršavljenju. Naučnici razvijaju sastojak nazvan SATISFIT-LTG kao pomoć u ishrani. Dr. Carsten Huettermann iz Dow Wolffa objasnio je na sastanku Američkog hemijskog društva u Philadelphiji da su testiranja pokazala da su se volonteri osjećali sito nakon što su pojeli manju količinu hrane koja sadrži ovaj dodatak. Volonteri koji su jeli hranu sa SATISFIT-LTG-om unijeli su 13% manje kalorija u narednom obroku dva sata kasnije. Dodatak je nova vrsta metil celuloze, koja se često koristi kao vezivni agens u gotovim jelima i pekarskim proizvodima. Metil celuloza je bijeli prah koji se rastapa u vrućoj vodi i pretvara u gel kad se zagrije. Već se oko 50 godina koristi u prehrambenoj industriji. Za razliku od obične metil celuloze, novi dodatak formira gel na tjelesnoj temperaturi, što mu omogućava da duže ostaje u želucu i tako pojačava osjećaj sitosti. Dr. Huettermann je rekao da bi ovaj sastojak mogao pomoći ljudima da se osjete sito nakon manjih obroka, što može smanjiti žudnju za dodatnom hranom. Dodao je da su planirane dodatne studije kako bi se bolje razumio mehanizam i mogući utjecaj na upravljanje težinom. SATISFIT-LTG se razvija za upotrebu u rashlađenim proizvodima poput jogurta i smoothie napitaka. Emma Williams iz Nutrition Society izjavila je za The Daily Telegraph da su ova otkrića obećavajuća kao dokaz koncepta, ali je potrebno više istraživanja kako bi se u potpunosti shvatio proces i potencijal za dugoročno mršavljenje. Dr. Huettermann je potvrdio da se dodatna istraživanja provode nakon obećavajućih početnih rezultata.

article_content: Peter Nunn, a 33-year-old blogger from Bristol, is accused of sending abusive and menacing messages to Labour MP Stella Creasy after she supported a campaign to feature Jane Austen on £10 banknotes, a court heard. Creasy, the MP for Walthamstow, received a barrage of offensive messages after backing the successful social media campaign, which aimed to ensure a woman's face would remain on banknotes. Caroline Criado-Perez, a feminist activist, launched the Jane Austen campaign in July after the Bank of England announced the replacement of social reformer Elizabeth Fry with Sir Winston Churchill on £5 notes, and later confirmed Jane Austen would replace Charles Darwin on the £10 note. Prosecutor Alison Morgan told Westminster Magistrates’ Court that Nunn conducted 'a campaign of hatred in various forms towards both women.' Nunn allegedly retweeted and composed messages threatening rape and using derogatory terms, including calling campaigners 'witches.' After being banned from Twitter, Nunn is accused of creating another account to continue posting offensive messages, including repeated threats toward Creasy. The prosecution argued these posts, even if not all part of the criminal charge, demonstrate Nunn's animosity toward the women. Nunn has admitted to retweeting violent messages but claims he did so only to 'further debate.' He denies sending any messages that are grossly offensive, indecent, obscene, or menacing. The offense carries a maximum sentence of six months in prison. The case has been adjourned until September. Although the campaign to feature Jane Austen on banknotes was successful, both Creasy and Criado-Perez faced extensive online abuse as a result of their advocacy.

article_content: A last-minute change to the program at the National September 11 Memorial Museum’s dedication ceremony helped avoid an awkward situation involving New Jersey Governor Chris Christie. Initially, the program scheduled Governor Christie’s remarks to be followed by a performance of ‘Bridge Over Troubled Water’ by Idina Menzel. This sequence sparked speculation on social media that it was a pointed reference to the ‘Bridgegate’ scandal, in which Christie’s staff was accused of intentionally causing traffic problems at the George Washington Bridge for political reasons. Just before the start of the ceremony on May 15, 2014, museum officials announced that Menzel was ill and would not perform. Instead, LaChanze, a Broadway singer who is also a 9/11 widow, replaced her and sang ‘Amazing Grace.’ The museum stated that the change was due to Menzel’s illness and not related to any political messages or the previous song choice. The Simon & Garfunkel song ‘Bridge Over Troubled Water’ has been cited before in connection with the scandal. Governor Christie, a Republican, has consistently denied any involvement or prior knowledge of his staff’s actions regarding the bridge closure. However, the incident affected his reputation and was seen as a setback to his early chances for the 2016 Republican presidential nomination.

Prvobitno je program predviđao da nakon Christiejevog govora nastupi Idina Menzel s pjesmom 'Bridge Over Troubled Water'. Taj redoslijed izazvao je nagađanja na društvenim mrežama da se radi o aluziji na 'Bridgegate' skandal, u kojem su zaposlenici Christiejeve administracije optuženi da su namjerno izazvali saobraćajni kolaps na mostu George Washington iz političkih razloga. Neposredno prije početka ceremonije 15. maja 2014., iz muzeja su saopštili da je Menzel bolesna i da neće nastupiti. Umjesto nje nastupila je LaChanze, brodvejska pjevačica i udovica žrtve napada 11. septembra, koja je izvela 'Amazing Grace'. Muzej je naglasio da je promjena nastupila isključivo zbog bolesti izvođačice, a ne radi političkih poruka ili prethodnog prijedloga pjesme. Pjesma 'Bridge Over Troubled Water' Simona & Garfunkela ranije se često povezivala sa skandalom. Guverner Christie, republikanac, neprestano negira bilo kakvu umiješanost ili predznanje o radnjama zaposlenika koji su zatvorili most. Ovaj incident ipak je ugrozio njegovu reputaciju i smatra se da je smanjio njegove rane šanse za republikansku predsjedničku nominaciju 2016. godine.

article_content:
Spanish police announced on Wednesday that they have dismantled an international pet trafficking ring, rescuing over 400 animals—mostly dogs and cats—and arresting 13 individuals. According to a police statement, the group is suspected of illegally transporting animals from eastern Europe in cramped, poorly ventilated vehicles over distances exceeding 2,000 kilometres. The unsanitary conditions reportedly led some animals to develop infectious diseases, and some died due to mistreatment. Authorities believe that the traffickers forged documents to sell sick animals as if they were healthy.

The investigation began in late 2020 following several complaints about the unsanitary conditions at a pet shop in central Barcelona. Police initially rescued 33 sick dogs and found clear anomalies in their documentation, which prompted them to look into the pets' origins. In a recent operation, police recovered more than 400 animals and arrested 13 people connected to the ring, which was active in Barcelona, Madrid, Andorra, and eastern Europe.

Authorities warn that illegal pet trafficking can threaten public health, as animals bred in such conditions are often unvaccinated and can transmit rabies, parasites, and infectious diseases to people and livestock. Many consumers, attracted by low prices, may unknowingly purchase companion animals online without recognizing these risks. The suspects face charges including animal abuse, fraud, document forgery, and money laundering.

A new animal welfare law which took effect in Spain in September bans the sale of pets in stores or online, although shops have a grace period to rehome existing animals. In the future, only registered breeders will be legally permitted to sell pets.

article_content: President Vladimir Putin has voiced his support for banning Americans from adopting Russian children. At Moscow’s World Trade Centre, Putin called the proposed law appropriate, saying it responds to the recent U.S. Magnitsky Act. Signed by President Barack Obama, the Magnitsky Act penalizes Russians accused of human rights abuses by blocking their U.S. visas and freezing assets. Putin commented that this U.S. legislation harms bilateral relations, stating, 'This, of course, poisons our relationship.' The Act was introduced after concerns over anti-corruption lawyer Sergei Magnitsky’s 2009 death in a Russian prison. The disagreement could compromise efforts by Putin and Obama to improve relations following their respective election victories. At his annual press conference, Putin signaled he would sign the adoption ban and called the Magnitsky Act 'unfriendly.' He described Russia’s legislative response as emotional but appropriate, and indicated the law would also bar U.S. citizens accused of abusing Russian rights. The adoption ban follows reports that some Russian children adopted by Americans have allegedly faced mistreatment. The Kremlin announced that a summit between Obama and Putin could take place in 2013, although Western diplomats said it depends on positive progress in relations. The Magnitsky Act passed in the U.S. Senate by 92 to 4. Moscow strongly condemned the law, which allows freezing assets and denying visas to implicated Russians. The law is named for Sergei Magnitsky, who died after alleging massive tax fraud involving Russian officials. After the Act’s passage, Russia’s Foreign Ministry issued strong criticisms of the U.S., accusing it of hypocrisy regarding human rights. Senator John McCain countered that the Magnitsky Act puts the U.S. on the side of the Russian people. The bill was initially intended to strengthen relations by ending outdated trade restrictions. One adoption case involved Torry Hansen, an American ordered to pay child support after she returned her adopted son to Russia, citing behavioral problems. In the previous year, more than 1,000 Russian children were adopted by U.S. families, according to the BBC. At the same press conference, Putin addressed Syria, saying Russia’s concern is not with Assad’s regime directly but with ending the ongoing conflict. He also denied health rumors and rejected claims of authoritarianism. Amnesty International urged Russian lawmakers to reject the adoption ban, arguing it would hurt human rights defenders. Regional director John Dalhuisen called the bill a 'childish response' and suggested it could be misused against critics and whistleblowers.
