Govoreći u Svjetskom trgovačkom centru u Moskvi, Putin je zakon nazvao prikladnim, ističući da je odgovor na nedavni američki Zakon Magnitski. Taj zakon, koji je potpisao predsjednik Barack Obama, kažnjava Ruse optužene za kršenje ljudskih prava zabranom američkih viza i zamrzavanjem imovine. Putin je izjavio da ova američka legislativa šteti međudržavnim odnosima, rekavši: 'Ovo, naravno, truje naše odnose.' Zakon je donesen nakon zabrinutosti zbog smrti antikorupcijskog advokata Sergeja Magnitskog 2009. godine u ruskom zatvoru. Spor bi mogao ugroziti napore Putina i Obame da poboljšaju odnose nakon nedavnih izbornih pobjeda. Na svojoj godišnjoj konferenciji za novinare, Putin je najavio da će potpisati zabranu usvajanja te nazvao Zakon Magnitski 'neprijateljskim'. On je opisao ruski odgovor kao emocionalan, ali prikladan, i rekao da bi zakon mogao zabraniti ulazak u Rusiju američkim državljanima optuženim za kršenje prava Rusa. Zabrana dolazi nakon izvještaja da su neka ruska djeca, koju su usvojili Amerikanci, navodno bila zlostavljana. Kremlj je najavio da bi samit između Obame i Putina mogao biti održan 2013. godine, iako zapadni diplomati tvrde da to zavisi od napretka u odnosima. Zakon Magnitski usvojen je u američkom Senatu sa 92 glasa za i 4 protiv. Moskva je oštro osudila zakon koji omogućava zamrzavanje imovine i zabranu američkih viza Rusima umiješanim u kršenje ljudskih prava. Zakon nosi ime Sergeja Magnitskog, koji je preminuo nakon što je otkrio veliku poresku prevaru ruskih zvaničnika. Poslije usvajanja zakona, rusko Ministarstvo vanjskih poslova uputilo je oštre kritike SAD-u, optužujući je za licemjerje po pitanju ljudskih prava. Senator John McCain odgovorio je da Zakon Magnitski pokazuje da su SAD na strani ruskog naroda. Prvobitno je zakon bio zamišljen da ojača odnose ukidanjem zastarjelih trgovinskih ograničenja. Jedan slučaj usvajanja uključuje Torry Hansen, Amerikanku kojoj je naloženo da plaća alimentaciju nakon što je vratila svog usvojenog sina u Rusiju, navodeći probleme u ponašanju. Prethodne godine, više od 1000 ruske djece usvojile su američke porodice, navodi BBC. Na istoj konferenciji Putin se osvrnuo i na Siriju, rekavši da Rusiju više brine okončanje sukoba nego sudbina Assadovog režima. Takođe je negirao špekulacije o svom zdravlju i odbacio tvrdnje o autoritarnosti. Amnesty International je pozvao ruske poslanike da odbace zabranu usvajanja, tvrdeći da će zakon naštetiti braniteljima ljudskih prava. Regionalni direktor John Dalhuisen nazvao je zakon 'djetinjastim odgovorom' i upozorio da se može zloupotrijebiti protiv kritičara i uzbunjivača.

article_content: A major incident has been declared at Blackpool Victoria Hospital following severe flooding in the women and children's unit. According to the chief executive, flooding in the basement on Monday led to the loss of power and access throughout the building. The hospital reported that expectant mothers have been transferred to other wards where they continue to receive appropriate care. Damian Vanner, a father-to-be, described the situation as a 'major crisis' after his pregnant partner, who had been induced, had to make an uncomfortable evacuation from the maternity ward to an already overwhelmed day surgery ward. Vanner added that, after discussions with staff and overhearing contractors, it appeared that sewage had overflowed and made contact with the hospital’s electrical distribution board, causing widespread disruption. A hospital spokesperson stated that the exact cause of the flooding is still unknown. Chief Executive Trish Armstrong-Child said: 'We have received support from Lancashire Fire and Rescue Service in reducing localized flooding, but further work is required today to fully clear the area of standing water.' She added, 'Due to this incident, we have contacted patients to rearrange their elective surgery as necessary. Patients who have not been contacted should attend their appointments as planned. Outpatient activity due to take place in the women and children's unit is being individually risk assessed and diverted where appropriate.' The hospital is continuing to manage the situation and urges patients to monitor communications for updates.

Budući otac Damian Vanner opisao je situaciju kao 'veliku krizu' nakon što je njegova trudna partnerica, kojoj je induciran porod, morala hitno evakuisati odjel porodiljstva i preći na već pretrpani odjel dnevne hirurgije. article_content: “Loud” is a fitting name for Rihanna’s summer tour, which debuted with a sold-out show at Baltimore’s 1st Mariner Arena. The concert was not only loud in volume but also in theme, featuring a giant speaker set piece, neon and shiny costumes, and an exuberant production style that matches Rihanna’s reputation for creating hit songs. The show opened with dynamic visuals from four circular, moving video screens and four stationary ones, announcing Rihanna’s arrival. She appeared in an electric blue mini trench coat and hot pink stiletto boots with neon green heels, launching into her Number One hit, “Only Girl (In the World),” from her 2010 album 'Loud.' Before the audience could catch its breath, Rihanna shed the trench coat to reveal a day-glo bikini, joined by backup dancers dressed similarly, and performed “Disturbia,” another Number One hit from 2007’s 'Good Girl Gone Bad.' She seamlessly transitioned into “Shut Up and Drive,” also from 2007, featuring dancers dressed as crash-test dummies smashing a neon-painted car. Over nearly two hours, Rihanna kept up an unrelenting pace, performing 24 songs, changing wardrobes six times, and featuring constant set changes—without losing momentum. The production included musical and video interludes, including several guitar solos, to keep the energy up during scene changes. One highlight was an S&M-themed mini-set that began with Prince’s “Darling Nikki.” Dressed in a tuxedo and carrying a cane, Rihanna interacted playfully with dancers before launching into the song “S&M,” revealing a white bondage corset and handcuffs. The segment included nearly nude male dancers and a female audience participant, ending in a lighthearted pillow fight. Another themed segment had Rihanna atop a pink tank during “Hard,” surrounded by dancers in soldier costumes with pink rifles, and T-shirts launched into the crowd. During “Breakin’ Dishes” and “Glamorous Life,” she moved to the back of the arena to play drums in a Sheila E-style solo. For her sixth outfit change—a gold lamé mini-dress—Rihanna’s encore included “Love the Way You Lie” (with Eminem) and “Umbrella” (with Jay-Z). The finale was more subdued than the earlier spectacle, featuring tuxedoed dancers and pink confetti, but Rihanna maintained high energy until the end, still leaving room for more hits in her repertoire.

article_content: Immigration authorities stopped a wedding in Harrow after suspecting the planned marriage between a Sri Lankan man, 23, and an Italian woman, 21, was a sham. The goal appeared to be for the man to gain EU citizenship and access UK benefits. Acting on a tip-off, Home Office officers intervened at the registry office with cooperation from the Superintendent Registrar. They discovered the Sri Lankan man had overstayed his visa, leading them to detain and later release him on immigration bail pending further investigation. He may be deported if he can't prove a legitimate reason to remain in the UK. The Italian woman was released after being questioned. Immigration Minister Mark Harper expressed determination to stop sham marriages that circumvent immigration laws, and mentioned provisions in the Immigration Bill to extend the investigation period for suspect unions. Officials noted that sham marriages typically involve non-EU nationals marrying EU citizens to attain residency and work rights in the UK. Susan Hall, head of Harrow Council, condemned these arrangements as undermining the seriousness of marriage ceremonies and praised the Home Office's efforts. Members of the public are encouraged to report suspected immigration abuse anonymously via Crimestoppers.

Sumnjalo se da je cilj bio da muškarac dobije EU državljanstvo i pristup benefitima u Velikoj Britaniji. Na osnovu dojave, službenici Ministarstva unutrašnjih poslova su uz saradnju glavnog matičara intervenirali u matičnom uredu. Otkrili su da je muškarac iz Šri Lanke prekoračio boravak po vizi, pa su ga priveli i kasnije pustili uz imigracioni kauciju, dok se ne završi dalja istraga. Može biti deportovan ako ne dokaže opravdan razlog za ostanak u Velikoj Britaniji. Italijanka je puštena nakon ispitivanja. Ministar za imigracije Mark Harper izrazio je odlučnost da zaustavi lažne brakove koji zaobilaze imigracione propise, i spomenuo je uvođenje dužeg perioda istrage za sumnjive brakove u Zakonu o imigraciji. Zvaničnici tvrde da lažni brakovi najčešće uključuju osobe koje nisu iz EU-a, a koje se vjenčavaju s građanima EU da bi dobili boravište i pravo na rad u Britaniji. Susan Hall, liderka općine Harrow, osudila je lažne brakove jer narušavaju ozbiljnost ceremonija vjenčanja te je pohvalila napore Ministarstva unutrašnjih poslova. Građani se pozivaju da anonimno prijave sumnje u zloupotrebu imigracije putem Crimestoppers-a.

article_content: A 19-year-old charity fundraiser, Dylan Jackson, died by suicide after experiencing extreme emotional lows that followed weekend binges of cocaine and alcohol, an inquest has heard. The coroner described cocaine as 'an evil of our society' after Dylan's mother expressed that she could see no other explanation for his sudden death. Bolton Coroners' Court was told Dylan was a cheerful and caring teenager, recently completing a 12-mile Tough Mudder race in support of the Help For Heroes military charity. He often participated in charity runs alongside his stepfather, Stephen Dwyer, who spoke of their close bond. Dylan's parents said they never observed symptoms of depression. However, after one weekend in September, Dylan's stepfather found his body in the family’s garden shed in Farnworth, Greater Manchester, following frantic efforts to locate him. The inquest delivered an open verdict, acknowledging that the combination of cocaine and alcohol likely had a hazardous effect on Dylan, impairing his judgement. Testimony revealed Dylan often spent weekends at friends' homes, pubs, and nightclubs, consuming alcohol and cocaine. After these weekends, he would experience significant lows lasting up to three days, struggling to attend his night-shift job. Dylan's mother, Michaela Dwyer, 38, suspected his drug use began about a year before his death. Though he denied it, she found text messages referencing drugs. Two weeks before his passing, Dylan confided experiencing concerning thoughts and once considered ending his life on a bridge, but shared no concrete plans. On his final night, Dylan was seen in high spirits while out with friends. He returned home in a taxi with several people, disturbing his sister, Bethany. His mother later recalled their last conversation, during which Dylan apologized for the noise. The following day, after Dylan was reported missing, his family and friends searched for him to no avail. That evening, his stepfather discovered Dylan in the shed. Toxicology tests indicated he had cocaine in his system and was more than twice the legal drinking limit. Stephen Dwyer described Dylan's severe mood downturns after weekends of drinking and drug use. He expressed confusion and grief, emphasizing that Dylan had everything to live for and had made no prior threats of self-harm while sober. Coroner Alan Walsh recorded an open verdict, highlighting that cocaine, especially when combined with alcohol, can severely affect judgement and mental health, particularly in young people. Walsh noted Dylan had future plans and showed no intention of self-harm except under substance influence. The coroner paid tribute to Dylan’s charitable work and warned of the dangers of substance abuse, not only to users but to their families. Post-hearing, Stephen Dwyer called Dylan's loss a tragedy, emphasizing the community’s loss and the importance of understanding the dangers associated with drugs and alcohol. Stephen plans to continue running in Dylan's memory, participating in Tough Mudder and the Bupa 10k run. For confidential support, contact the Samaritans on 08457 90 90 90 or visit www.samaritans.org.
translated_content: Devetnaestogodišnji humanitarac Dylan Jackson počinio je samoubistvo nakon što je, prema istrazi, doživljavao snažne emocionalne padove nakon vikenda provedenih u konzumiranju kokaina i alkohola. Sudija je kokain nazvao 'zlo našeg društva', nakon što je Dylanova majka izjavila da ne vidi drugi razlog za njegov iznenadni odlazak. Na Sudu u Boltonu rečeno je da je Dylan bio vedar i brižan tinejdžer, koji je nedavno istrčao 12 milja dugu Tough Mudder trku za vojnu humanitarnu organizaciju Help For Heroes. Redovno je učestvovao na humanitarnim trkama sa svojim očuhom Stephenom Dwyerom, koji je govorio o njihovoj bliskoj vezi. Dylanovi roditelji navode da nikada nisu primijetili znake depresije. Ipak, nakon jednog vikenda u septembru, Dylanov očuh pronašao je njegovo tijelo u šupi porodične kuće u Farnworthu (Greater Manchester) nakon očajničke potrage. Istraga je donijela otvoreni zaključak, navodeći da su kokain i alkohol vjerovatno imali opasan uticaj na Dylana, narušavajući mu prosuđivanje. Svjedoci su opisali da je Dylan često provodio vikende kod prijatelja, po pubovima i noćnim klubovima, konzumirajući alkohol i kokain. Nakon takvih vikenda, doživljavao bi velike padove raspoloženja koji su trajali do tri dana, zbog čega mu je bilo teško da odlazi na noćni posao. Dylanova majka, Michaela Dwyer (38), sumnjala je da se upotreba droga javila otprilike godinu prije smrti. Iako je negirao, pronašla je poruke koje su ukazivale na upotrebu droga. Dvije sedmice pred smrt, Dylan joj je povjerio da ima zabrinjavajuće misli i jednom je razmišljao da skoči s mosta, ali nije imao konkretan plan. Posljednje noći, Dylan je viđen veseo u društvu prijatelja. Kući se vratio taksijem sa više osoba, što je probudilo njegovu sestru Bethany. Majka se prisjetila posljednjeg razgovora, kada joj se Dylan izvinio zbog buke. Narednog dana, kada je Dylan prijavljen kao nestao, porodica i prijatelji bezuspješno su ga tražili. Te večeri, očuh ga je pronašao u šupi. Toksikološki nalazi pokazali su prisustvo kokaina i više nego dvostruku dozvoljenu količinu alkohola. Stephen Dwyer opisao je Dylanove teške padove raspoloženja nakon vikenda provedenih u alkoholu i drogama. Izrazio je zbunjenost i tugu, naglašavajući da je Dylan imao mnogo razloga za život i da nikada nije izražavao namjeru samopovređivanja dok je bio trijezan. Sudija Alan Walsh donio je otvoreni zaključak, naglašavajući da kokain, naročito u kombinaciji s alkoholom, može ozbiljno narušiti prosuđivanje i mentalno zdravlje kod mladih. Walsh je istakao da je Dylan imao planove za budućnost i nije pokazivao namjeru za samopovređivanjem osim pod uticajem supstanci. Sudija je odao priznanje Dylanovim humanitarnim naporima i upozorio na opasnosti zloupotrebe supstanci, ne samo za korisnike nego i za njihove porodice. Nakon saslušanja, Stephen Dwyer je nazvao Dylanov odlazak tragedijom, ističući koliki je gubitak za zajednicu i važnost razumijevanja opasnosti droge i alkohola. Stephen planira i dalje trčati u Dylanovo ime, učestvujući na Tough Mudder i Bupa 10k utrci. Za povjerljivu podršku obratite se Samaritans na 08457 90 90 90 ili posjetite www.samaritans.org.

article_content: Figure skater Ashley Wagner became an unexpected viral sensation at the Sochi Olympics after cameras caught her mouthing 'b******t' in response to her low score. According to TiVo data, viewers consistently rewound her reaction more than any other Olympic moment on Saturday. Wagner, defending her candid response, stated, 'I wear my heart on my sleeve.' Other top replayed moments included remarkable wipeouts by snowboarders, with three of the five most replayed clips featuring falls by Jessika Jenson (US), Ty Walker (US), and Aimee Fuller (Great Britain). Wagner's Olympic debut performance, skating to Pink Floyd's 'Shine On You Crazy Diamond,' earned her a score of 61.30—lower than expected, yet enough for her to advance to the next round. Her expressive reaction went viral, making her one of the weekend's most talked-about athletes on Facebook. However, the Canadian sisters Justine and Chloe Dufour-Lapointe claimed the top medals in the women's moguls event. On Sunday, viewers continued to focus on snowboarding falls. Notably, American Jamie Anderson's gold medal-winning run was not among TiVo's most replayed moments. Other standout athletes from the weekend included Russian figure skater Julia Lipnitskaia and American Gracie Gold. Appearing on the Today Show, Wagner discussed her visible emotions on the ice, admitting a lack of poker face and emphasizing her determination to prove herself, especially after being selected for the Olympic team over Mirai Nagasu, who had finished higher at the US Championships. Wagner's strong team performance helped the United States advance and ultimately win the bronze medal, with Russia taking gold and Canada silver. Julia Lipnitskaia, only 15, led her country's team to victory in the women's competition. Wagner hopes to achieve even better scores in the individual events, set for February 20.

Prema podacima TiVo-a, gledaoci su baš ovaj trenutak premotavali više od bilo kojeg drugog olimpijskog događaja u subotu. Wagner je branila svoju iskrenu reakciju riječima: 'Srce mi je na dlanu.' Među najviše premotavanim trenucima bili su i spektakularni padovi snowboarderki – u tri od pet najgledanijih snimaka pale su Jessika Jenson (SAD), Ty Walker (SAD) i Aimee Fuller (Velika Britanija). Wagner je na svom olimpijskom debiju klizala uz pjesmu 'Shine On You Crazy Diamond' grupe Pink Floyd i osvojila 61,30 bodova – manje od očekivanog, ali dovoljno za prolazak u naredni krug. Njen izražajni odgovor brzo je postao hit na društvenim mrežama, a bila je i među najčešće spominjanim sportistima na Facebooku. Zanimljivo, zlatna vožnja Amerikanke Jamie Anderson nije bila među najgledanijim snimkama na TiVo-u. Ostale istaknute sportašice vikenda bile su ruska klizačica Julia Lipnitskaia i Amerikanka Gracie Gold. Gostujući u emisiji Today, Wagner je govorila o svojim izraženim emocijama na ledu, priznavši da nema 'poker face' i naglasila svoju odlučnost da se dokaže, posebno nakon što je izabrana za olimpijski tim ispred Mirai Nagasu, koja je imala bolji plasman na američkom prvenstvu. article_content: A dispute between Premier Model Management and former staff member Jon Bruce has escalated to London’s High Court, with allegations that Bruce illicitly recruited models and violated his employment agreement. Among the models he is said to have diverted to PRM (Paulo Ribero Management Ltd), which he co-founded with Paulo Ribero while still at Premier, are Talita Correa and Matthew Holbrook. Premier claims Bruce’s dismissal on July 24 was directly linked to these actions. The agency is seeking legal orders for Bruce to return all confidential company materials, with their lawyer, Rupert Butler, stressing the significant harm caused by Bruce’s alleged conduct. One allegation claims £850 was wrongly charged to Premier clients for a model connected to PRM. Judge Michael Kent QC ruled there is sufficient evidence for an interim order compelling Bruce to produce Premier’s property and information within seven days. Representing Bruce and PRM, lawyer Emily Betts refuted the allegations, asserting that Premier is attempting to hinder Bruce’s career without evidence of wrongdoing or unfair advantage. She further argued Bruce’s dismissal was unjustified. This legal battle sheds light on issues of competition, contracts, and recruiting practices in the modeling industry.

Među modelima koje je navodno preusmjerio u PRM (Paulo Ribero Management Ltd), koji je osnovao s Paulom Riberom dok je još bio u Premieru, nalaze se i Talita Correa i Matthew Holbrook. Premier tvrdi da je Bruce otpušten 24. jula upravo zbog tih radnji. Agencija traži sudsku naredbu kojom bi Bruce bio obavezan vratiti sve povjerljive materijale kompanije, a njihov advokat Rupert Butler ističe značajnu štetu koju je, navodno, Bruce uzrokovao. Jedna od optužbi je i da je 850 funti nepropisno naplaćeno klijentima Premier-a za modela povezanog s PRM-om. Sudija Michael Kent QC odlučio je da postoji dovoljno dokaza za privremenu sudsku naredbu kojom se Bruceu nalaže da u roku od sedam dana preda svu imovinu i informacije koje pripadaju Premier-u. Advokatica koja zastupa Brucea i PRM, Emily Betts, odbacila je optužbe, smatrajući da Premier pokušava ograničiti Bruceove mogućnosti zapošljavanja bez dokaza o bilo kakvom nepoštenom postupanju ili prednosti. Također je navela da je otkaz Bruceu bio neopravdan. Ovaj pravni spor ističe probleme konkurencije, ugovornih obaveza i regrutacije u modnoj industriji.

article_content: China’s Foreign Ministry has condemned recent remarks by U.S. President Joe Biden, calling his comments 'extremely wrong' and 'irresponsible political manipulation.' Spokesperson Mao Ning stated that China firmly opposes such statements. Mao also said that some individuals are seeking to sow discord and harm China-U.S. relations, though she did not identify anyone directly. 'Those attempting to undermine ties between China and the United States know who they are,' she noted. President Biden and Chinese President Xi Jinping recently held their first summit in a year, in which they agreed to resume military communications between the two countries. Additionally, China pledged to intensify efforts to crack down on the production of ingredients used to make fentanyl, a substance linked to a deadly epidemic of opioid abuse in the United States. Despite these agreements, President Biden told journalists after meeting with Xi that he still considers the Chinese leader a 'dictator'—a description that has previously infuriated Beijing. Biden commented, 'He’s a dictator in the sense that he runs a Communist country with a government very different from ours.'
translated_content: Ministarstvo vanjskih poslova Kine osudilo je nedavne komentare američkog predsjednika Joea Bidena, nazvavši njegove izjave 'izuzetno pogrešnim' i 'neodgovornom političkom manipulacijom.' Glasnogovornica Mao Ning izjavila je da Kina čvrsto osuđuje takve izjave. Mao je također rekla da neki pojedinci pokušavaju narušiti i poremetiti odnose između Kine i SAD-a, ali nije direktno imenovala nikoga. 'Oni koji pokušavaju potkopati veze između Kine i Sjedinjenih Država znaju ko su,' napomenula je. Predsjednik Biden i kineski predsjednik Xi Jinping nedavno su održali svoj prvi samit u godinu dana, na kojem su se dogovorili da obnove vojne komunikacije između dviju zemalja. article_content: Unison general secretary Dave Prentis announced that the union is working with NHS employers to minimize the impact on patients if a planned four-hour strike goes ahead. NHS staff in England have voted to strike for four hours next month in a dispute over pay, marking the first walkout by health workers in 32 years. Unions are at odds with the government over its refusal to implement a recommended one percent pay rise for NHS workers. Unison, representing 300,000 NHS staff in England, confirmed its members have voted in favor of industrial action. Several other unions, including those representing midwives, are currently balloting their members, and more employees are expected to join the strike on October 13, from 7am to 11am. Up to 500,000 NHS staff represented by nine unions could participate in the walkout. Unison members have also approved four days of industrial action from October 14 to 17, during which staff will be asked to take their allocated breaks. In the industrial action ballot, 68% of members voted in favor of strike action, while 88% supported actions short of a strike. Dave Prentis stated, 'NHS staff don’t take action often or lightly. For many members, this will be their first time participating in a walkout, as the last strike over pay was 32 years ago. The NHS relies on the dedication of its workers, but this government has shown them little respect. We are working with NHS employers to reduce the impact on patients. However, it’s not too late for Health Secretary Jeremy Hunt to prevent this action by negotiating with us, despite his refusal so far.' The Department of Health said they are 'disappointed' that Unison has rejected proposals offering NHS staff at least a one percent pay increase this year, with another percent next year. A spokesperson added that they are eager to work with union representatives to create a 'fairer and more affordable' pay system. This action leads into nationwide demonstrations organized by the Trades Union Congress (TUC) and the Scottish Trades Union Congress (STUC) in London and Glasgow on October 18. Unison is calling for proper NHS funding to ensure adequate staffing and fair compensation. The union is demanding an immediate one percent consolidated pay rise for all NHS staff, as recommended by the Pay Review Body, the living wage of £7.65 per hour for low-paid staff, above-inflation increases for the next financial year, and a commitment to restoring the value of NHS pay. Unison's head of health, Christina McAnea, reiterated that health workers do not take industrial action lightly. She confirmed that Unison members plan to walk out on October 13, followed by four days of industrial action, and urged the health secretary to accept the recommended pay increase. Members in the Ambulance Service will also be called on to not work overtime during this period. Other unions are currently balloting their members and are expected to announce results within two weeks. Unison members in Wales will have a separate ballot between September 30 and October 20. A Department of Health spokesperson repeated their disappointment at the prospect of industrial action and the rejection of their pay proposals, highlighting that the NHS budget has been maintained despite tough financial times and that there are now 13,500 more clinical staff than in 2010. The department stressed the need to balance pay increases with the protection of frontline roles. If the planned strike goes ahead, it will be the first time NHS staff in England have walked out in 32 years. Photos from previous industrial actions show hospital workers on picket lines outside hospitals. The government is also dealing with a series of strikes by other public sector workers. The Public and Commercial Services (PCS) union has called for industrial action on October 15 over long-standing issues of jobs, pay, and workplace conditions. Council workers are also set to strike the day before. These strikes will culminate in a national protest in London on October 18, under the slogan 'Britain Needs A Pay Rise.' According to PCS, many civil servants have faced a 20% drop in income since 2010 due to pay cuts, higher pension contributions, and inflation. Their strike, involving up to 250,000 members, will include employees from Westminster government departments, agencies, and the Wales assembly, but not Scottish government staff. At the Labour Party conference, PCS released a report by tax expert Richard Murphy claiming that tax evasion costs public finances £80 billion a year. The union argues that recovering some of this revenue could significantly alter debates on public spending. PCS general secretary Mark Serwotka has said, 'These strikes demonstrate our resolve to end pay cuts that have diminished public servants' living standards while the wealthy have received tax cuts. Until tax avoidance is tackled and adequate investment is made in our communities and public services, economic recovery will benefit only a select few rather than the wider population.'

NHS osoblje u Engleskoj glasalo je za četverosatni štrajk narednog mjeseca u sporu oko plata, što bi bio prvi takav izlazak zdravstvenih radnika nakon 32 godine. Sindikati su u sukobu s vladom zbog njenog odbijanja da odobri preporučeno povećanje plata od jedan posto za NHS radnike. Nekoliko drugih sindikata, uključujući i one koji predstavljaju babice, provode glasanje među svojim članovima, a očekuje se da će više zaposlenih učestvovati u štrajku 13. oktobra od 7 do 11 sati. Portparol Ministarstva zdravlja ponovio je razočarenje zbog planirane industrijske akcije i odbijanja platnih prijedloga, naglašavajući da je budžet NHS-a zadržan i pored finansijskih izazova, te da sada ima 13.500 više kliničkog osoblja nego 2010. Ministarstvo ističe važnost balansiranja povećanja plata i zaštite ključnih radnih mjesta. Ako do štrajka dođe, to će biti prvi put u 32 godine da NHS osoblje u Engleskoj izlazi u štrajk. Fotografije iz prošlih štrajkova prikazuju zdravstvene radnike na piket linijama ispred bolnica. Vlada se suočava i s nizom drugih štrajkova javnih službenika. Sindikat javnih i komercijalnih službi (PCS) najavio je štrajk 15. oktobra zbog sporova oko poslova, plata i uslova rada. Općinski radnici također štrajkuju dan ranije. Ove industrijske akcije kulminiraju nacionalnim protestom 18. oktobra u Londonu pod sloganom 'Britaniji treba povećanje plata.' PCS tvrdi da su mnogi državni službenici od 2010. pretrpjeli pad prihoda od 20% zbog smanjenja plata, rasta penzijskih doprinosa i inflacije. Očekuje se da će njihov štrajk uključiti do 250.000 članova zaposlenih u vladinim odjeljenjima Westminstera, agencijama i skupštini Welsa, ali ne i škotskoj vladi. Na konferenciji Laburističke stranke, PCS je objavio izvještaj poreznog stručnjaka Richarda Murphyja prema kojem porezna utaja godišnje košta javne finansije 80 milijardi funti. Slower job growth in the US has also helped lower Treasury yields from a 16-year high, enabling a series of delayed deals to enter the market. This move may result in a US tax payment of $250-300 million, given the firm's current US domicile, according to people familiar with the matter.

article_content: Every morning before riding, 51-year-old Gary Stevens walks four miles to warm up his injured knees, preparing them for the physical demands of horse racing at high speeds. After first retiring in 2005, Stevens was financially comfortable and pursued a broadcasting career, along with acting in films like 'Seabiscuit' and the TV series 'Luck.' Yet, he found himself returning to the sport. Describing it as 'middle-aged crazy,' Stevens admits the risks, referencing his 2003 Arlington Million accident that left him with a punctured lung and fractured vertebra. He says, 'People retire and play golf or go fishing. This is my fishing. I'd rather be at the racetrack than the golf course, and I like golf.' Stevens resumed racing last year. His comeback demanded significant sacrifices. He lost enough weight to reach a racing weight of 114 lbs (51.7 kg) with a rigorous two-month regimen. His knees are so damaged he expects to need replacements. Reflecting on his first retirement, Stevens told CNN he appreciated his earlier achievements more with distance. Injuries and the pressure to keep winning were constant concerns. Determined not to diminish his legacy, Stevens aimed to return at a high competitive level. While sporting comebacks often falter, Stevens has had remarkable success, winning 69 races last year, including the Preakness Stakes and Breeders' Cup Classic, bringing his career wins close to 5,000 and earnings to $225 million. He draws parallels with British jockey Lester Piggott, who returned to racing at 55 and quickly won the Breeders' Cup Mile. Stevens says Piggott inspired him, showing a comeback was possible. Stevens' acting work, particularly the cancellation of 'Luck,' prompted his return to racing. He described feeling lost when the show ended and decided to come back to the sport. Stevens met his wife Angie on the set of 'Seabiscuit.' Other highlights from his life include overcoming Perthes syndrome as a child, dropping out of high school to become a jockey, dealing with alcohol issues, and now making a successful return to racing. Now a grandfather, Stevens feels happier than ever, saying, 'It's an unbelievable ride, better than the first time around.' He believes his broadcasting experience made him a more analytical jockey. 'If it ends tomorrow, I'd be a happy guy. My life has been good.'

Nakon što je prvi put otišao u penziju 2005. godine, Stevens je bio financijski osiguran i započeo karijeru sportskog komentatora, kao i glumio u filmovima poput 'Seabiscuit' i u TV seriji 'Luck'. Ipak, ponovo se vratio sportu. Opisujući to kao 'ludilo srednjih godina', Stevens priznaje rizike, prisjećajući se nesreće na Arlington Million trci 2003. godine, kada je zadobio probušeno plućno krilo i slomljen pršljen. Kaže: 'Ljudi odu u penziju i igraju golf ili pecaju. Ovo je moja pecaroška strast. Radije bih bio na hipodromu nego na golf terenu, a volim golf.' Stevens se vratio jahanju prošle godine. Povratak je zahtijevao velike žrtve. Smršao je toliko da je stigao na težinu od 114 funti (51,7 kg) kroz rigorozan dvomjesečni režim. Koljena su mu toliko oštećena da očekuje zamjenu. Osvrćući se na prvu penziju, Stevens je za CNN rekao da je iz daljine više cijenio svoja ranija dostignuća. Povrede i stalni pritisak na pobjedu bili su stalni problemi. Odlučan da ne umanji svoju ostavštinu, Stevens je želio da se vrati na visok takmičarski nivo. Iako povratci u sportu često ne uspijevaju, Stevens je postigao izuzetan uspjeh – prošle godine je pobijedio u 69 trka, uključujući Preakness Stakes i Breeders' Cup Classic, dovodeći broj karijernih pobjeda blizu 5.000 i zaradu do 225 miliona dolara. Poredi se sa britanskim džokejom Lesterom Piggottom, koji se vratio jahanju sa 55 godina i ubrzo pobijedio na Breeders' Cup Mile trci. Stevens kaže da ga je Piggott inspirisao i pokazao da je povratak moguć. Njegov rad kao glumca, posebno otkazivanje serije 'Luck', dodatno je uticao na odluku da se vrati konjičkim trkama. Opisao je osjećaj izgubljenosti nakon završetka serije i odluku da se vrati sportu. Stevens je upoznao suprugu Angie na snimanju filma 'Seabiscuit.' Ostali detalji iz života uključuju prevazilaženje Perthesovog sindroma u djetinjstvu, napuštanje srednje škole radi jahačke karijere, borbu s alkoholom i sada uspješan povratak u sport. Sada kao djed, Stevens je sretniji nego ikad, govoreći: 'Nevjerovatna vožnja, bolja nego prvi put.' Vjeruje da ga je iskustvo komentatora učinilo analitičnijim džokejom. 'Ako sve završi sutra, bio bih sretan čovjek. Moj život je bio dobar.'

article_content: EU researchers are investigating how bacteria, fungi, and other microorganisms can enhance the health of both plants and animals. In 2019, Professor Tom Gilbert and his team noticed that a batch of chickens grew more slowly than in previous trials, despite being raised in the same controlled conditions with identical diets and supplements. The only difference appeared to be exposure to unknown microbes during their journey from a hatchery in Catalonia, Spain. These microbes, part of the wider microbiome—including bacteria, fungi, and viruses—may have influenced the chicks' development. According to Gilbert, this finding highlights how small differences in an animal's early microbiome can have major effects on growth and significant implications for farming. The team's research was part of HoloFood, an EU-funded project that studied the impact of feed and supplements on the microbiome and animal health, focusing on chickens and salmon. The project, which ran for nearly four and a half years, concluded in April 2023. The interplay between an animal's genetics and its microbiome is a growing research field known as hologenomics. The 'holobiont' concept refers to a host and its microbial community functioning as an ecosystem. Microbes begin colonizing animal guts at birth, shaping health by influencing growth, immunity, and nutrient absorption. The microbiome even affects human behavior and social interactions, while soil and plant-associated microbes play key roles in agriculture. Optimizing the microbiome presents an opportunity to promote healthier food systems for an expanding global population and lessen farming's environmental impact by reducing fertilizer and antibiotic use. This area is part of Europe's Food 2030 initiative, aimed at greener, healthier, and more accessible diets. Advances in DNA sequencing have enabled projects like HoloFood to deepen understanding of how food and supplements affect the microbiome and animal well-being, paving the way for more sustainable food production. Trial results showed that fish fed seaweed and mussels—sustainable protein alternatives—remained healthy and grew as well as those given conventional feed, supporting the potential to replace imported soy. Similarly, the EU-funded SIMBA project, led by Dr. Anne Pihlanto at the Natural Resources Institute Finland, found that soy in fish feed can be partly substituted with locally sourced rapeseed meal and seaweed without harming fish health or their gut microbiome. This suggests Europe could reduce dependency on imported soy for aquaculture. Researchers also examined how microbial communities affect crops' growth and resistance to stress factors like disease and drought. For instance, introducing a mixture of four specific microbe species into Arabidopsis plants increased drought tolerance, and other microbial blends improved wheat growth and potato yields in challenging environments like salt marshes. These findings have significant implications for making agriculture more resilient and environmentally friendly, including using seawater irrigation in less arable regions. Data and results from HoloFood and SIMBA are openly accessible through their respective databases, contributing to broader knowledge from other EU-funded research initiatives such as 3D-omics and FindingPheno. Dr. Pihlanto emphasized the ongoing need for additional knowledge about which microbes are most beneficial in different contexts, expressing hope that research will continue to advance.
translated_content: Istraživači iz EU proučavaju kako bakterije, gljive i drugi mikroorganizmi mogu poboljšati zdravlje biljaka i životinja. Godine 2019, profesor Tom Gilbert i njegov tim primijetili su da je jedna grupa pilića rasla sporije nego u prethodnim eksperimentima, iako su odgajani u istim kontrolisanim uslovima sa identičnom ishranom i dodacima. Jedina razlika bila je izloženost nepoznatim mikrobima tokom puta iz inkubatora u Kataloniji, Španija. Ovi mikroorganizmi, dio šireg mikrobioma—uključujući bakterije, gljive i viruse—mogli su uticati na razvoj pilića. Gilbert smatra da ovo otkriće pokazuje kako male razlike u mikrobiomu mladih životinja mogu imati velike efekte na rast i važne posljedice za poljoprivredu. Rad njegovog tima bio je dio projekta HoloFood, koji je finansirala EU i koji je proučavao uticaj hrane i dodataka na mikrobiom i zdravlje životinja, sa fokusom na piliće i losose. Projekat je trajao gotovo četiri i po godine i završen je u aprilu 2023. Povezanost između genetike životinja i njihovog mikrobioma je sve značajnije polje istraživanja koje se naziva hologenomika. Koncept 'holobionta' se odnosi na domaćina i njegovu zajednicu mikroorganizama kao ekosistem. Mikroorganizmi kolonizuju crijeva životinja od rođenja, utičući na zdravlje kroz rast, imunitet i apsorpciju nutrijenata. Mikrobiom čak može uticati na ljudsko ponašanje i društvene interakcije, dok mikroorganizmi u zemljištu i biljkama igraju ključnu ulogu u poljoprivredi. Optimizacija mikrobioma predstavlja priliku za razvoj zdravijeg prehrambenog sistema za rastuću svjetsku populaciju i smanjenje uticaja poljoprivrede na okoliš, smanjujući potrebu za đubrivima i antibioticima. Ovo područje je dio evropske inicijative Food 2030, koja teži zelenijoj, zdravijoj i pristupačnijoj ishrani. Napredak u DNK sekvenciranju omogućio je projektima poput HoloFood-a bolje razumijevanje uticaja hrane i dodataka na mikrobiom i dobrobit životinja i postavio temelje za održiviju proizvodnju hrane. Testovi su pokazali da su ribe hranjene algama i dagnjama—održive alternative proteinima—bile zdrave i rasle jednako dobro kao i ribe na standardnoj ishrani, što pruža mogućnost zamjene uvozne soje. Slično, EU projekat SIMBA, kojim je rukovodila dr. Anne Pihlanto sa Instituta za prirodne resurse Finske, utvrdio je da se dio soje u ishrani riba može zamijeniti lokalnim repičinim sačmom i algama bez negativnog uticaja na zdravlje riba ili njihov mikrobiom. Ovo ukazuje na to da Evropa može smanjiti zavisnost od uvozne soje za akvakulturu. Istraživači su ispitali i kako mikrobne zajednice utiču na rast i otpornost usjeva na stres kao što su bolesti i suša. Primjerice, unošenje mješavine četiri određena mikroorganizma u biljke Arabidopsis povećalo je otpornost na sušu, dok su druge mikrobne kombinacije poboljšale rast pšenice i prinos krompira u zahtjevnim uslovima poput slanih močvara. Ovi rezultati imaju značajne posljedice za otporniju i ekološki prihvatljiviju poljoprivredu, uključujući upotrebu morske vode za navodnjavanje u manje pogodnim područjima. Podaci iz projekata HoloFood i SIMBA javno su dostupni putem njihovih online baza, doprinoseći znanju iz drugih EU istraživačkih inicijativa kao što su 3D-omics i FindingPheno. Dr. Pihlanto je naglasila potrebu za dodatnim istraživanjima o tome koji mikroorganizmi su najkorisniji u različitim situacijama, izražavajući nadu da će se istraživanja nastaviti razvijati.

With Lionel Messi sidelined by injury, Neymar shone as Barcelona’s main man, helping his team to a dominant 4-1 victory over Valladolid. He capped the night with a goal, set up another, and played a vital role in Xavi’s strike, embracing his increased responsibility. Alexis Sanchez added two goals as Barcelona extended their record to eight wins from eight games.

In Madrid, Cristiano Ronaldo rescued Real with a dramatic stoppage-time winner, giving his side a 3-2 triumph over Levante. That goal took his season tally to seven, just behind Messi and Atletico’s Diego Costa. Real, missing Gareth Bale and after several lineup changes, had to come from behind twice with goals from Sergio Ramos and Alvaro Morata before Ronaldo sealed the win. The result moves Real above Villarreal, while Atletico Madrid look to maintain their unbeaten run against Celta Vigo.

Across Germany, Bayern Munich moved atop the Bundesliga following a 1-1 draw against Bayer Leverkusen. Toni Kroos opened the scoring for Bayern, but Sidney Sam soon equalized and Bernd Leno’s saves ensured the points were shared. Borussia Dortmund suffered a 2-0 defeat at Borussia Monchengladbach, who scored twice after Dortmund’s Mats Hummels was sent off late.

Francesco Totti netted twice and Alessandro Florenzi scored before halftime, allowing Roma to maintain their perfect record despite finishing with ten men following Federico Balzaretti’s dismissal. Meanwhile, Monaco climbed to the top of France’s Ligue 1 with a 2-1 win against Saint-Etienne thanks to a late goal from Lucas Ocampos, putting them three points ahead of Paris Saint-Germain.

article_content: A new pain relief drug derived from Botox, developed by a researcher at Sheffield University, may provide months of relief for people with conditions such as cancer, arthritis, migraines, chronic back pain, and post-cesarean section pain. Unlike standard Botox, which is known for its cosmetic uses and risk of localized paralysis, this 'super-Botox' combines the pain-relieving part of botulinum toxin with a component of the tetanus toxin, allowing it to target pain specifically without affecting muscle movement. The drug is designed to offer extended pain relief with a single injection, potentially reducing or eliminating the need for frequent use of traditional painkillers that often cause significant side effects. Professor Bazbek Davletov, who designed the drug at the MRC Laboratory of Molecular Biology in Cambridge, says the compound is engineered by fusing beneficial elements of toxic molecules. Animal trials have shown promising results, and large-scale human trials are anticipated. If successful, the medication could be available in about three years. Using a targeted delivery system, the molecule is transported to the spinal cord, where it can block pain signals from reaching the brain. The estimated cost is around £1,000 per year, potentially making it affordable within the National Health Service. Charities and medical experts, such as those from Cancer Research UK and The Migraine Trust, have welcomed the innovation, highlighting its potential to help manage chronic pain and enhance patients' quality of life. However, experts emphasize that further research and clinical trials are needed before the drug can be made widely available.
translated_content: Novi lijek za ublažavanje bolova, razvijen na Univerzitetu Sheffield na osnovi botoksa, mogao bi pružiti višemjesečno olakšanje osobama koje pate od raka, artritisa, migrena, hroničnih bolova u leđima i bolova nakon carskog reza. Za razliku od klasičnog botoksa, poznatog po kozmetičkoj upotrebi i mogućoj lokalnoj paralizi, ovaj 'super-botoks' spaja analgetsku komponentu botulinum toksina s dijelom toksina tetanusa, omogućujući ciljanje bola bez utjecaja na pokretljivost mišića. Lijek je razvijen kako bi jednim injekcijom pružio dugotrajno olakšanje bola, što potencijalno smanjuje ili uklanja potrebu za čestom upotrebom konvencionalnih analgetika, koji često izazivaju nuspojave. Profesor Bazbek Davletov, koji je lijek osmislio u MRC Laboratoriju za molekularnu biologiju u Cambridgeu, kaže da je spoj proizveden spajanjem korisnih dijelova toksičnih molekula. Testiranja na životinjama su dala obećavajuće rezultate, a očekuju se i veća ispitivanja na ljudima. Ukoliko budu uspješna, lijek bi mogao biti dostupan za oko tri godine. Putem ciljane dostave, molekula se prenosi do kičmene moždine, gdje blokira prenos bolnih signala u mozak. Procijenjena godišnja cijena je oko 1.000 funti, što ga čini pristupačnim za Nacionalni zdravstveni sistem. Organizacije poput Cancer Research UK i The Migraine Trust, te medicinski stručnjaci, pozdravljaju inovaciju zbog njenog potencijala za kontrolu hronične boli i poboljšanje kvaliteta života pacijenata. Ipak, stručnjaci ističu da je prije šire upotrebe potrebno još istraživanja i kliničkih ispitivanja.

article_content: Artist Chloe Mayo unknowingly painted her future husband in 2009, creating an oil portrait of herself holding hands with a dark-bearded man. She set the artwork aside, unaware of its significance. Years afterward, Chloe joined an online dating website and began exchanging messages with Michael Goeman. When they met in person, Chloe was amazed to see Michael looked just like the man in her painting. Worried that Michael might find the coincidence strange, Chloe initially hid the painting under her bed. Soon, she revealed it to him, and Michael responded with humor and interest. Their bond grew stronger, leading to Michael's proposal 18 months later during a trip to the south of France. Three years after they first met, Chloe and Michael married. The painting now hangs in their living room in Worcester Park near Croydon, Surrey, and friends affectionately call Michael 'the man in the painting.' Chloe, a regulation manager for medical equipment, reflected on the unexpected turn of events and now sees meeting Michael as fate.

article_content: Think you know your favorite fictional characters? Their full names might surprise you! Here’s a batch of lesser-known real names behind some iconic pop culture personalities—perfect for your next game night. 1. That Comic Book Guy on The Simpsons? His real name is Jeff Albertson, but creator Matt Groening wanted to call him Louis Lane as a nod to Lois Lane. The staff writers made the call while Groening wasn’t in the room. 2. Barbie, the famous doll, is officially Barbara Millicent Roberts, while Ken’s last name is Carson. 3. Cap’n Crunch’s full name is Captain Horatio Magellan Crunch, sailing the S.S. Guppy. 4. Peppermint Patty from Peanuts was born Patricia Reichardt. 5. Snuffleupagus on Sesame Street answers to Aloysius Snuffleupagus. Fun fact: there was an unaired episode where his parents nearly separated, but it was dropped because test audiences found it too upsetting. 6. The Wizard of Oz isn’t just O.Z.—his birth name is Oscar Zoroaster Phadrig Isaac Norman Henkel Emmannuel Ambroise Diggs. He dropped most of it because the initials spelled ‘PINHEAD’. 7. Did you know Mr. Clean’s rarely-used first name is Veritably? It came from a 1962 contest. 8. The Man With the Yellow Hat from Curious George? His name, in a deleted scene, is Ted Shackleford (but that’s not technically canon). 9. Monopoly’s top-hatted mascot is Milburn Pennybags. The police officer on the board is called Officer Edgar Mallory. 10. On TV’s Night Court, bailiff Bull is really named Nostradamus Shannon. 11. On Entourage, Turtle’s real name is Salvatore Assante. 12. That Sesame Street game show host Guy Smiley? His given name is Bernie Liederkrantz. 13. The Michelin Man’s real name is Bibendum. 14. Gilligan’s Island’s Skipper is Jonas Grumby. 15. The Professor’s full name? Roy Hinkley. 16. Shaggy from Scooby-Doo was christened Norville Rogers. 17. The Pillsbury Doughboy’s official name is Poppin’ Fresh. He has a wife, Poppie Fresh, and their children are Popper and Bun Bun. 18. The Operation board game’s patient is called Cavity Sam. 19. The Lone Ranger’s real name is John Reid. 20. MacGyver’s first name? It’s Angus. 21 & 22. For music trivia: U2’s frontman Bono’s real name is Paul David Hewson, and The Edge is David Howell Evans.

article_content: Huwara, once a vibrant Palestinian town south of Nablus in the occupied West Bank, has become nearly deserted since October 5, following escalating Israeli military activity and violence. Residents describe life under the current closure, imposed by the Israeli army and settlers, as resembling life in a prison. Over a short 6km (3.7-mile) stretch of road through Huwara, there are at least seven Israeli military posts with heavily armed soldiers. For the past 55 days, entry and movement have been severely restricted, deeply impacting the town's 8,000 residents. Israeli soldiers have taken over an unfinished central building, fortifying it with snipers and sandbags, and draping Israeli flags from the structure. Mansour Dmaidi, a 65-year-old lawyer and resident, said, 'Huwara is experiencing its worst period in recent history. It wasn’t even this bad during the Al-Aqsa Intifada (2000-2005).' Though Huwara faced repeated closures over the last eighteen months, restrictions were tightened on October 5, days before the Hamas attack on Israel on October 7, which killed about 1,200 people. On October 5, Israeli forces said a Palestinian shot at a settler’s car, causing no injuries; the alleged shooter was killed on the scene. Later, settlers attacked homes in Huwara, killing 19-year-old Labib Dmaidi. Since then, and amid the outbreak of war in Gaza that has killed over 15,000 Palestinians, mostly women and children, Huwara has turned into a 'ghost town.' The town, previously a commercial hub along the Jenin-Hebron highway, now has only about 80 of its 800 businesses open under strict military oversight. Commerce remains slow and restricted. Mansour said, 'Huwara was the gateway to Nablus, an urban commercial center. Now, it feels like a military camp.' An estimated 700,000 Israeli settlers live in stronghold settlements across the occupied West Bank and East Jerusalem, many constructed on privately owned Palestinian land. The arrival of settlers often leads to more security restrictions. As of early October, there were at least 645 Israeli military checkpoints and barriers limiting Palestinian movement. Most of Huwara’s shops were closed, and residents were prohibited from using the main road until recently. Many residents describe the atmosphere as bleak and hopeless. Across the West Bank, Palestinians have faced increasing hardships since the Israel–Gaza war began. Residents now travel through remote village backroads to avoid military and settler checkpoints, turning short car trips into hours-long journeys. Abdelrahman Dmaidi, a 21-year-old journalist, said Huwara is now split into different sectors, and before partial reopening, he would walk 2km through fields just to reach transport for basic groceries. Commerce has fallen to about 15% of previous levels, with locals saying that settler violence has devastated the economy. Huwara and surrounding villages are some of the hardest-hit by settler violence. On February 27, hundreds of settlers attacked Huwara, causing significant destruction and killing a 37-year-old Palestinian. Damages were estimated at 18 million shekels ($5 million), with continued closures worsening conditions. Following the February attack, Israeli Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich called for the town to be 'wiped out,' which many believe contributed to increased settler violence. There are numerous documented incidents of coordination between soldiers and settlers during such attacks. On November 12, Israeli authorities opened a 'bypass road' in Huwara for settlers, built on land taken from Huwara and neighboring villages. This road serves four settlements with a combined settler population of about 8,000, in an area home to around a million Palestinians, according to rights group Peace Now. After this, the Israeli army allowed limited reopening of the main road and some shops, but settler opposition kept broader closures in place. Today, movement and commerce remain heavily restricted. Mohammad Dmaidi, the father of slain teenager Labib Dmaidi, described their ongoing hardship: 'The settlers still want our main road and shops closed, although a bypass was made for them. Around 4,000 people depend on these shops.' 'No one knows what will happen next,' he said. 'Everyone’s looking at Gaza, while Huwara has struggled for over a year with little notice.'
translated_content: Huwara, nekada živahni palestinski grad južno od Nablusa na okupiranoj Zapadnoj obali, gotovo je opustio od 5. oktobra nakon eskalacije izraelske vojne aktivnosti i nasilja. Stanovnici opisuju život pod trenutnom blokadom, koju su nametnule izraelska vojska i doseljenici, kao život u zatvoru. Na kratkoj dionici puta od 6 km (3,7 milje) kroz Huwaru postavljeno je najmanje sedam izraelskih vojnih punktova sa teško naoružanim vojnicima. Posljednjih 55 dana ulazak i kretanje su strogo ograničeni, što je duboko pogodilo 8.000 stanovnika grada. Izraelski vojnici zauzeli su nedovršenu zgradu u centru, utvrdili je snajperima i vrećama s pijeskom, te na nju postavili izraelske zastave. Mansour Dmaidi, 65-godišnji advokat i stanovnik, rekao je: 'Huwara doživljava najteži period u svojoj novijoj historiji. Nije ovako bilo čak ni tokom Al-Aksa intifade (2000–2005).' Iako je Huwara više puta bila pod blokadom posljednjih osamnaest mjeseci, restrikcije su dodatno pojačane 5. oktobra, nekoliko dana prije Hamasovog napada na Izrael 7. oktobra, u kojem je ubijeno oko 1.200 ljudi. Tog 5. oktobra, izraelske snage su navele da je Palestinac pucao na auto doseljenika, bez povrijeđenih; osumnjičeni je ubijen na licu mjesta. Kasnije su doseljenici napali kuće u Huwari, usmrtivši 19-godišnjeg Labiba Dmaidija. Od tada, uz rat u Gazi koji je odnio preko 15.000 palestinskih života, uglavnom žena i djece, Huwara je postala 'grad duhova.' Grad, nekada trgovačko čvorište na putu Jenin–Hebron, sada ima otvoreno samo oko 80 od svojih 800 firmi pod strogim vojnim nadzorom. Trgovina je i dalje jako ograničena. Mansour je rekao: 'Huwara je bila kapija prema Nablusu, gradski trgovački centar. Sada izgleda kao vojni kamp.' Procjenjuje se da 700.000 izraelskih doseljenika živi u utvrđenim naseljima širom okupirane Zapadne obale i Istočnog Jerusalema, mnoga od njih izgrađena na privatnom palestinskom zemljištu. Dolazak doseljenika često povlači strože sigurnosne mjere. Početkom oktobra bilo je najmanje 645 izraelskih vojnih punktova i barijera koje ograničavaju palestinsko kretanje. Većina trgovina u Huwari bila je zatvorena, a stanovnicima je bilo zabranjeno korištenje glavne ceste do nedavno. Mnogi opisuju atmosferu kao sumornu i beznadežnu. Na Zapadnoj obali Palestinci su doživjeli dodatne teškoće od početka rata u Gazi. Sada moraju koristiti zabačene seoske puteve da izbjegnu vojne i doseljeničke punktove, pretvarajući kratke vožnje u višesatna putovanja. Abdelrahman Dmaidi, 21-godišnji novinar, rekao je da je Huwara sada podijeljena na sektore, te da je prije djelomičnog otvaranja morao pješačiti 2 km kroz polja da bi došao do prevoza za osnovne namirnice. Trgovina je pala na oko 15% nekadašnjeg nivoa, a stanovnici tvrde da je nasilje doseljenika uništilo ekonomiju. Huwara i okolna sela među najviše su pogođenim doseljeničkim nasiljem. Dana 27. februara stotine doseljenika napale su Huwaru, izazvavši veliku štetu, pri čemu je poginuo 37-godišnji Palestinac. Materijalna šteta procijenjena je na 18 miliona šekela (5 miliona dolara), a sve kasnije blokade dodatno su otežale život stanovnika. Nakon februarskog napada, izraelski ministar finansija Bezalel Smotrich pozvao je na 'brisanje' grada, što je, smatraju mnogi, doprinijelo daljoj eskalaciji nasilja doseljenika. Česti su izvještaji o koordinaciji između vojnika i doseljenika tokom napada. Dana 12. novembra izraelske vlasti otvorile su 'obilaznicu' u Huwari za doseljenike, izgrađenu na zemlji oduzetoj Huwari i susjednim selima. Ta cesta služi četiri naselja sa ukupno oko 8.000 doseljenika, u regiji gdje živi oko milion Palestinaca, navodi grupa za ljudska prava Peace Now. Nakon toga, izraelska vojska je dozvolila djelomično otvaranje glavnog puta i dijela trgovina, ali je protivljenje doseljenika dovelo do zadržavanja većine blokada. I danas su kretanje i trgovina strogo ograničeni. Mohammad Dmaidi, otac ubijenog Labiba Dmaidija, opisuje teške okolnosti: 'Doseljenici i dalje traže da naš glavni put i trgovine ostanu zatvoreni, iako je napravljen obilazni put za njih. Oko 4.000 ljudi zavisi od ovih radnji.' 'Niko ne zna šta će biti dalje', rekao je. 'Svi prate situaciju u Gazi, a Huwara se već više od godine bori bez pažnje javnosti.'

article_content: Paramount+ has released the official trailer for 'Lawmen: Bass Reeves,' which is set to premiere with two episodes on Sunday, November 5. The anthology stars David Oyelowo, who also serves as executive producer, alongside Lauren E. Banks, Demi Singleton, Forrest Goodluck, Barry Pepper, Donald Sutherland, and Dennis Quaid. 'Lawmen' follows the journey of Reeves (played by Oyelowo), tracing his rise from enslavement to becoming the first Black U.S. Marshal west of the Mississippi River. During his career, Reeves arrested over 3,000 outlaws, but the burden of the badge was heavy, causing personal and moral challenges that affected his family. Future episodes of the anthology will explore the stories of other notable lawmen and outlaws who made an impact on history. Series creator and showrunner Chad Feehan commented, 'Growing up in Texas, I heard many stories about Bass Reeves—tales of a legendary lawman pursuing the toughest outlaws in the Wild West. That myth stayed with me throughout my life.' Feehan added, 'Not long ago, David Oyelowo invited me to dinner and described his seven-year effort to bring Bass's story to the screen, where myth blends with reality and reveals why Bass's life is more relevant than ever.' He continued, 'I went home, began researching, read books, and listened to podcasts. I became fascinated by the hidden details of Bass's extraordinary life and wanted to support David in honoring his legacy.' 'Lawmen: Bass Reeves' is also executive produced by Taylor Sheridan, David C. Glasser, Jessica Oyelowo, David Permut, Christina Alexandra Voros, Ron Burkle, Bob Yari, and David Hutkin. The series is produced by MTV Entertainment Studios, 101 Studios, Sheridan's Bosque Ranch Productions, and Oyelowo's Yoruba Saxon, and is distributed by Paramount Global Content Distribution outside Paramount+ international markets.

article_content: In the United States, over a third of the food produced ends up uneaten, with much of it being discarded in landfills where it produces methane—a greenhouse gas that greatly contributes to climate change. To tackle this issue, more than 50 local leaders have sent a letter to the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), asking for increased support for municipal governments working to reduce food waste. This appeal follows two recent EPA reports that highlight the massive scale of the nation's food waste and the environmental harm it causes. The officials are seeking expanded grant funding, more technical help for alternatives to landfilling, and updated landfill standards to ensure better prevention, detection, and reduction of methane emissions. Although technology to address methane exists, its use can be difficult since food waste produces methane rapidly as it decomposes. Back in 2015, the EPA and the Department of Agriculture set a national goal to cut food waste in half by 2030. However, Claudia Fabiano, an EPA expert on food waste management, acknowledges that progress has been minimal, saying, 'We've got a long way to go.' According to the EPA, food waste accounts for 58% of methane emissions from landfills, with methane having much more warming potential than carbon dioxide. Now that the scale of the problem is better documented, researchers and elected officials alike are calling for action. They note that addressing food waste will take not just more funding, but also important behavioral and mindset changes. Farmers may need to modify their practices, companies may have to change their packaging and marketing, and individuals must take steps to avoid waste. For the first time since the 1990s, the EPA has revised its hierarchy of waste reduction strategies—placing the prevention of food waste as the top priority, followed by composting and anaerobic digestion, a process converting organic waste into biogas. The updated list offers more detail so communities can make informed choices. Experts also say cutting waste will largely rest on lasting lifestyle changes by individuals, as households are responsible for at least 40% of food waste in the U.S. Weslynne Ashton, a sustainability professor at the Illinois Institute of Technology, noted that American habits often expect abundance, and diverting organic waste requires investment. She believes eliminating organic waste from landfills is possible with the right infrastructure and incentives for both cities and rural regions. With the scope of food waste now better understood, it remains unclear if federal support will be sufficient for significant local change. The EPA has started allocating funds from the Inflation Reduction Act to new recycling and organic waste initiatives, though these programs are just beginning. Some states and cities are already taking steps: since 2022, California has mandated organic waste collection in every jurisdiction, and Chicago recently began a pilot composting program allowing residents to drop off food scraps at various locations. Not all regions are at the same stage, however. Ning Ai, associate professor of urban planning at the University of Illinois Chicago, argues that EPA’s reports could further detail how local solutions might differ by community type—rural versus urban—and appreciated that the new reports document environmental trade-offs among air, water, and land. She said these reports help boost the national movement to reduce food waste.
translated_content: U Sjedinjenim Državama, više od trećine proizvedene hrane završi nepojedeno, a velik dio toga bude bačen na deponije gdje nastaje metan—staklenički plin koji značajno doprinosi klimatskim promjenama. Kako bi riješili ovaj problem, više od 50 lokalnih čelnika poslalo je pismo Agenciji za zaštitu okoliša (EPA), zatraživši veću podršku za općinske vlasti koje rade na smanjenju bacanja hrane. Ovaj poziv upućen je nakon dva nedavna izvještaja EPA-e koja ističu razmjere rasipanja hrane u SAD-u i štete po okoliš. Zvaničnici traže više grantova, dodatnu tehničku pomoć za alternative deponiranju otpada, te ažuriranje standarda za deponije radi bolje prevencije, otkrivanja i smanjenja emisija metana. Iako postoji tehnologija za rješavanje problema s metanom, njezina primjena je izazovna jer organski otpad brzo proizvodi metan dok se raspada. Još 2015. godine, EPA i Ministarstvo poljoprivrede postavili su cilj da se do 2030. godine prepolovi bacanje hrane. Ipak, stručnjakinja EPA-e za upravljanje otpadom hrane, Claudia Fabiano, naglašava da je napredak minimalan, rekavši: 'Pred nama je dug put.' Prema EPA-i, bacanje hrane uzrokuje 58% emisija metana iz deponija, dok metan ima mnogo veći potencijal zagrijavanja od CO2. Sada, kada je problem bolje dokumentovan, istraživači i službenici pozivaju na akciju. Navode da je, osim povećanih ulaganja, potrebna i promjena ponašanja i načina razmišljanja. Poljoprivrednici bi mogli mijenjati svoje metode, kompanije prilagoditi pakovanje i marketing, a pojedinci moraju naći načine kako da manje hrane završi u otpadu. EPA je po prvi put od 1990-ih revidirala strategije za smanjenje otpada, postavljajući prevenciju otpada od hrane kao najveći prioritet, iza koje slijede kompostiranje i anaerobna digestija. Ažurirana hijerarhija daje zajednicama bolje smjernice za odlučivanje. Stručnjaci napominju da je značajno smanjenje otpada uglavnom moguće kroz trajne promjene navika, budući da domaćinstva čine najmanje 40% otpada hrane u SAD-u. Weslynne Ashton, profesorica održivosti sa Tehnološkog instituta u Illinoisu, tvrdi da navika očekivanja obilja u SAD-u otežava rješenje, dok uklanjanje organskog otpada zahtijeva značajna ulaganja. Vjeruje da je moguće eliminisati organski otpad na deponijama uz pravu infrastrukturu i poticaje, u gradovima ali i ruralnim područjima. Dok je problem sada jasnije definisan, ostaje upitno hoće li savezna podrška biti dovoljna za stvarne promjene na lokalnom nivou. EPA je usmjerila dio sredstava iz Zakona o smanjenju inflacije prema reciklaži i organici, ali ti programi su još u početnim fazama. Neki gradovi i savezne države već poduzimaju korake: od 2022. Kalifornija zahtijeva prikupljanje organskog otpada u svim zajednicama, a Čikago je nedavno pokrenuo pilot-program kompostiranja gdje građani sami donose ostatke hrane na određene lokacije. Ipak, nisu svi na istom nivou razvoja. Ning Ai, vanredna profesorica urbanog planiranja na Univerzitetu Illinois u Čikagu, smatra da EPA-ini izvještaji trebaju još detaljnije prikazati način na koji različite sredine mogu prilagoditi lokalna rješenja, te pohvaljuje što noviji izvještaji uzimaju u obzir uticaje na zrak, vodu i zemlju. Vjeruje da ti izvještaji podstiču nacionalni pokret za smanjenje otpada.

article_content: Despite their profound grief, some relatives of victims from Hamas’s October 7 attack are now speaking out against seeking revenge on Gaza. Before this unprecedented assault, Kibbutz Be’eri, set in the northwestern Negev desert, was known for its vibrant community and lush fields—a tranquil haven rooted in communal Zionist values. The 1,100 residents, accustomed to the distant threat of rocket fire, lived together in a tight-knit, socialist-inspired society. Ariella Giniger, 70, recalled visiting her friend Vivian Silver, a 74-year-old Canadian-born peace activist, just weeks before the tragedy. During a morning walk near the Gaza border, Giniger admits feeling uneasy but encouraged her friend to head back for yoga and breakfast. Days later, Silver completed a significant peace march—joining Israeli and Palestinian women advocating for a women-led resolution to the conflict. On October 7—now known as Black Saturday—Hamas fighters broke through the border fence, attacking multiple Israeli communities, including Be’eri, long recognized for its peace advocacy. Silver was confirmed among the deceased after initial hopes she might have been taken captive. The Israeli response was swift and forceful: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu vowed vengeance, launching airstrikes and a ground invasion. So far, at least 11,500 Palestinians, including more than 4,700 children, have died in Gaza. While much of Israeli society expresses support for the war, some bereaved families reject the idea that their losses justify further violence. Vivian Silver’s son, Yonatan Zeigen, emphasized to Al Jazeera that ‘Israel won’t cure our dead babies by killing more babies.’ Silver herself was deeply involved in humanitarian bridges—regularly transporting Gazan patients to Israeli hospitals and working to foster dialogue before travel restrictions and the blockade intensified after 2007. The Israeli government’s security policies have fueled hardship in Gaza, which hosts around 2.3 million Palestinians in a densely populated area under severe restrictions. In 2022 alone, more than 20,000 requests for medical care in Israel were denied, according to B’Tselem. The conflict’s roots run deep: Gaza’s isolation dates back to the mass Palestinian exodus (the Nakba) during the 1948 Arab-Israeli war. Meanwhile, the 1950 Law of Return allows Jews from around the world to settle in Israel. Ongoing competing claims have long frustrated attempts at a two-state solution. Before the latest violence, activists like Udi Goren worked with both Palestinians and Israelis to foster dual-narrative tours. Goren’s cousin was among those abducted during the attacks, further personalizing his calls for an end to hostilities and a focus on securing a ceasefire and the return of captives. Rachel Goldberg-Polin, whose son Hersh was captured by Hamas during a music festival near Gaza, has become a public face for hostage advocacy. She and others stress that cycles of violence only harm innocents—and urge society to pursue dialogue and reject hatred. Goldberg-Polin emphasized the need for empathy, self-reflection, and acknowledgment of wrongdoing on all sides, warning that ‘fear of the other is much easier, but there are still people who want a society that can work for everyone.’
translated_content: Uprkos dubokoj tuzi, neki rođaci žrtava napada Hamasa 7. oktobra sada se izjašnjavaju protiv osvete nad Gazom. Prije ovog nezapamćenog napada, kibuc Be’eri, smješten u sjeverozapadnoj Negev pustinji, bio je poznat po svojoj živopisnoj zajednici i plodnim poljima — mirnom utočištu ukorijenjenom u zajedničkim cionističkim vrijednostima. 1.100 stanovnika, naviknutih na povremenu prijetnju raketama, živjelo je zajedno u bliskoj, socijalistički inspirisanoj zajednici. Ariella Giniger (70) prisjetila se posjete svojoj prijateljici Vivian Silver, 74-godišnjoj mirovnoj aktivistkinji kanadskog porijekla, samo nekoliko sedmica prije tragedije. Tokom jutarnje šetnje blizu granice s Gazom, Giniger je priznala da se osjećala nelagodno, ali je predložila povratak kući na jogu i doručak. Nekoliko dana kasnije, Silver je završila značajan marš za mir — pridruživši se Izraelcima i Palestinkama u zalaganju za rješenje sukoba koje vode žene. Dana 7. oktobra — sada poznatog kao Crna subota — borci Hamasa probili su granicu i napali više izraelskih zajednica, uključujući Be’eri, odavno poznat po svojoj mirovnoj orijentaciji. Silver je potvrđena među stradalima nakon što su prve nade da bi možda bila zarobljena ugašene. Izraelski odgovor bio je brz i snažan: premijer Benjamin Netanyahu obećao je osvetu, pokrenuo zračne napade i kopnenu invaziju. Do sada je u Gazi poginulo najmanje 11.500 Palestinaca, uključujući više od 4.700 djece. Dok većina izraelskog društva podržava rat, neke ožalošćene porodice odbacuju ideju da njihovi gubici opravdavaju daljnje nasilje. Sin Vivian Silver, Yonatan Zeigen, izjavio je za Al Jazeeru da ‘Izrael neće izliječiti naše mrtve bebe ubijanjem još beba.’ I sama Silver bila je duboko posvećena humanitarnom povezivanju — redovno je prevozila pacijente iz Gaze u izraelske bolnice i radila na jačanju dijaloga, prije nego što su putovanja i blokada postali strožiji nakon 2007. Sigurnosna politika izraelske vlade dodatno otežava život u Gazi, gdje živi oko 2,3 miliona Palestinaca u gusto naseljenom području pod teškim ograničenjima. Samo 2022. godine, više od 20.000 zahtjeva za medicinskom njegom u Izraelu je odbijeno, prema organizaciji B’Tselem. Korijeni sukoba su duboki: izolacija Gaze potiče od masovnog egzodusa Palestinaca (Nakba) tokom arapsko-izraelskog rata 1948. godine. Istovremeno, Zakon o povratku iz 1950. godine omogućava Jevrejima iz cijelog svijeta naseljavanje u Izraelu. Sukobi oko zemljišta i propali pokušaji rješenja s dvije države dugo onemogućavaju mir. Prije posljednjeg nasilja, aktivisti poput Udija Gorena radili su s Palestincima i Izraelcima organizujući ture sa dvostrukim narativom. Njegov rođak je kidnapovan tokom napada, što je dodatno motivisalo njegove pozive na prekid sukoba, primirje i povratak zarobljenika. Rachel Goldberg-Polin, čijeg je sina Hersha Hamas oteo tokom muzičkog festivala blizu Gaze, postala je javno poznata kao zagovornica za povratak talaca. Ona i drugi ističu da ciklusi nasilja samo povređuju nedužne i pozivaju društvo da bira dijalog umjesto mržnje. Goldberg-Polin naglašava važnost empatije, samoproučavanja i priznanja krivice sa svih strana, upozoravajući: ‘Strah od drugih je lakši, ali još uvijek ima ljudi koji žele društvo koje može funkcionisati za sve.’

Senior Constable Matthew Hill from South Australia recounted a deeply distressing encounter in Camden Park, Adelaide, last April. Responding to an emergency call, Hill faced Kieran David Cregan, who, while heavily intoxicated on his 63rd birthday, poured petrol over the officer and tried to light it. In court, Hill described the ongoing psychological toll—nightmares and anxiety triggered by the smell of petrol in everyday life. Despite no physical injuries, Hill revealed the attack left him permanently changed, remembering the perpetrator’s hatred-filled gaze. 

Cregan admitted to aggravated endangering of life. His lawyer, Robert Kane, cited Cregan's struggles with alcoholism and a troubled childhood, but noted he receives family support. The prosecution pushed for jail time, while the defense requested a suspended sentence due to Cregan’s circumstances. Judge Geraldine Davison is set to determine the sentence on October 23.

Na sudu je Hill opisao trajne psihološke posljedice—noćne more i anksioznost koje izaziva miris benzina u svakodnevnom životu. Iako nije zadobio fizičke povrede, Hill je otkrio da ga je napad zauvijek promijenio i stalno pamti pogled pun mržnje napadača.

Cregan je priznao krivicu za teško ugrožavanje života. Njegov advokat Robert Kane istakao je Creganove ozbiljne probleme s alkoholom i teško djetinjstvo, ali i podršku porodice. article_content: New Jersey Governor Chris Christie acknowledged on Monday that he often disagreed with the late Senator Frank Lautenberg, but he recognized Lautenberg's legacy of service following the senator's death. Senator Lautenberg, who was the last World War II veteran serving in the U.S. Senate, died early Monday. His passing leaves Christie responsible for appointing a temporary replacement. Christie, a Republican seeking re-election, is faced with a complicated decision due to conflicting New Jersey state laws on when to hold a special election to fill the Senate seat. One statute suggests a special election should be held at the next general election unless the vacancy occurs within 70 days before that election, in which case the timing changes. Because Lautenberg's death happened within 70 days of the primary but not the general election, interpretations differ about whether the special election should take place in November 2013 or be pushed back to November 2014. The governor has authority to set the date, balancing legal and political factors in making his choice. Democratic leaders, such as state party Chairman John Wisniewski, argue that delaying the election would deny voters representation for over a year. Observers point out that a special Senate election this November could increase Democratic turnout, particularly if Newark Mayor Cory Booker enters the race. If Christie postpones the election to 2014 and appoints a temporary replacement, it may trigger lawsuits from Democrats. Possible appointees include Christie ally Joe Kyrillos, Lieutenant Governor Kim Guadagno, Assemblyman Jon Bramnick, and state Senator Tom Kean Jr. There have been rumors about Christie appointing Booker, but both parties have dismissed that scenario. Christie is known for his willingness to work with Democrats; however, his relationship with national conservatives has been strained, notably following his response to Superstorm Sandy and his cooperation with President Obama. Some Republicans warn that if Christie selects a moderate Republican or someone viewed as not conservative enough, it could harm his standing among national conservative voters ahead of a possible 2016 presidential campaign. As of now, Governor Christie has not announced his decision regarding the Senate appointment or the timing of the special election.

Senator Lautenberg, posljednji veteran Drugog svjetskog rata u američkom Senatu, preminuo je rano u ponedjeljak. Njegova smrt ostavlja Christieu odgovornost da imenuje privremenog zamjenika. Christie, republikanac koji traži reizbor, suočen je sa složenom odlukom zbog sukobljenih zakona New Jerseyja o tome kada treba održati posebne izbore za popunu mjesta u Senatu. Jedan zakon predviđa da bi posebni izbori trebali biti održani na prvim narednim općim izborima, osim ako upražnjenje ne nastupi unutar 70 dana prije tih izbora, kada se termin mijenja. Pošto se Lautenbergova smrt dogodila unutar 70 dana od predizbora, ali ne i općih izbora, postoje različita tumačenja o tome treba li posebne izbore održati u novembru 2013. ili ih odgoditi do novembra 2014. Guverner ima ovlasti da odredi datum, uravnotežujući pravne i političke faktore prilikom donošenja odluke. Vođe demokrata, poput predsjednika stranke Johna Wisniewskog, tvrde da bi odgađanje izbora uskraćivalo biračima zastupljenost više od godinu dana. Promatrači napominju da bi posebni izbori za Senat ovog novembra mogli povećati izlaznost demokrata, osobito ako gradonačelnik Newarka Cory Booker uđe u trku. Ako Christie odgodi izbore do 2014. i imenuje privremenog zamjenika, to bi moglo izazvati tužbe demokrata. Mogući kandidati su Christiejev saveznik Joe Kyrillos, potguvernerka Kim Guadagno, skupštinski zastupnik Jon Bramnick i senator Tom Kean Jr. Bilo je glasina da bi Christie mogao imenovati Bookera, ali obje strane su odbacile tu mogućnost. Neki republikanci upozoravaju da bi izbor umjerenog republikanca ili nekoga koga ne smatraju dovoljno konzervativnim mogao narušiti njegovu podršku među konzervativnim glasačima, posebno pred mogućnost predsjedničke kampanje 2016. Trenutno, guverner Christie još nije objavio odluku o imenovanju u Senat niti o datumu održavanja posebnih izbora.
