article_content: Kobe Bryant's 17th NBA season appeared to end abruptly during a routine drive toward the basket. He felt a pop as he pushed off his left foot, initially believing someone had kicked him. Bryant fell in pain, and the Los Angeles Lakers suspect he tore his Achilles tendon Friday night, likely sidelining him for the rest of the season and requiring months of rehabilitation. Some have speculated this injury could jeopardize his illustrious career. In the second half of the Lakers' 118-116 victory over the Golden State Warriors, Bryant was injured while logging heavy minutes—averaging over 38 per game, more than any teammate and any league player over 30. After the injury, the NBA’s fourth all-time leading scorer realized he would probably miss the playoffs for only the second time, even if the Lakers secure the eighth seed in the Western Conference. Visibly emotional and on crutches in the locker room, Bryant described this as 'by far' the most disappointing injury of his career, but he quickly vowed to recover: 'I know I can do this. It's fueling me.' With two games left in the regular season, the Lakers (42-37) were one game ahead of the Utah Jazz for the final playoff spot. Bryant, who scored 34 points despite hyperextending his left knee earlier in the game, managed to make two free throws after the Achilles injury before heading to the locker room. His teammates rallied afterward, led by Pau Gasol and Dwight Howard. Even in pain, Bryant pledged to support his team by analyzing game film and offering insights off the court. Returning from an Achilles tear—often requiring many months of rehab—will be challenging for the 34-year-old, who is known for playing through injuries. Teammates like Pau Gasol, Jodie Meeks, Steve Blake, and Metta World Peace expressed their support on the court, while coach Mike D’Antoni praised Bryant’s toughness and resilience. Bryant is set to earn nearly $30.5 million next season in the final year of his deal, and with Dwight Howard approaching free agency, the Lakers’ future remains uncertain. Bryant had played all 48 minutes and scored 47 points in the prior game in Portland, and despite his injury, continued his clutch leadership as Warriors guard Stephen Curry scored 47 in a spectacular effort. While there is debate about whether Bryant's heavy workload contributed to the injury, he referred to it as a 'freak situation.' Pau Gasol commended Bryant’s heart and leadership, saying, 'He’s been an example for us.' The Lakers aim to continue their playoff quest, even without their star on the floor.

Bryant je pao od boli, a Los Angeles Lakersi sumnjaju da je pokidao Ahilovu tetivu u petak navečer, što će ga vjerovatno udaljiti s terena do kraja sezone i zahtijevati mjesece rehabilitacije. Saigrači su u finišu preokrenuli utakmicu, predvođeni Pauom Gasolom i Dwightom Howardom. Iako povrijeđen, Bryant je obećao pomagati timu analizom utakmica i savjetima s klupe. Lakersi žele nastaviti borbu za doigravanje, iako im Bryant neće moći pomoći na terenu.

At 44, Abhisit Vejjajiva has become Thailand's youngest prime minister in over 60 years and the nation's third leader in just four months, following a period of significant political instability. Soon after taking office, Abhisit spoke to CNN's Dan Rivers on Talk Asia. Thailand's recent turmoil—marked by widespread protests and the closure of international airports—traces back to the military coup in 2006, which ousted then-Prime Minister Thaksin Shinawatra, leader of the People's Power Party (PPP).

In September, the Constitutional Court removed Thaksin’s initial successor, Samak Sundaravej, after ruling that he had violated the constitution by participating as a paid guest on a TV cooking show. Samak was replaced by Thaksin’s brother-in-law, Somchai Wongsawat, who faced immediate protests accusing him of leading a proxy government for Thaksin. Somchai, too, was ousted by a Constitutional Court decision.

On December 15, Abhisit was chosen by parliament to become prime minister. His primary challenge is restoring stability to a country once counted among the region’s most stable. A career politician, Abhisit was born in Newcastle, England, to wealthy Thai-Chinese parents. He attended prestigious Eton College and studied politics, philosophy, and economics at Oxford University.

Though critical of corruption and cronyism in Thai politics, the path to Abhisit's leadership was not straightforward; he failed to win national elections as Democrat Party leader since 2005. His parliamentary appointment relied on the support of factions from the now-banned PPP, many of whom he had previously criticized. Now, Abhisit leads a coalition government with a slim majority, which has prompted political commentators to question how long he will remain in office—some suggesting that more than a year would be an achievement.

Despite his age, Abhisit can cite 17 years of political experience, having become an MP at 27. He is regarded as young, cosmopolitan, and reputable for maintaining integrity, having publicly opposed the 2006 coup against Thaksin. Nevertheless, critics accuse him of borrowing policies from Thaksin and point to his party’s boycott of the 2006 snap election, which contributed to the subsequent constitutional crisis. Most of Abhisit’s support comes from the educated middle class, and bridging divides within Thai society is among his top priorities.

"He needs to send a clear signal of change that he is a leader who will reach out to all," said Bunranaj Smutharak, spokesman for the Democrat Party. "We are confident the long turmoil over the past two years will be brought to an end by this change in government. What we aim to do is reunite the country."

"Mora poslati jasnu poruku o promjenama, da je lider koji će se obraćati svima", rekao je Bunranaj Smutharak, portparol Demokratske stranke. "Vjerujemo da će ova promjena u vladi okončati dvogodišnje nemire. Naš cilj je ponovno ujediniti zemlju."

article_content: A Conservative minister has proposed introducing a 'distinction' grade for driving tests to help improve road safety. Skills Minister Matthew Hancock argued that it is limiting for learner drivers to only pass or fail the test. He suggested that establishing a higher achievement level could motivate drivers to aim higher and may prompt insurance companies to offer lower premiums to top performers, potentially making roads safer. Government statistics show that almost a quarter of fatal or serious road accidents last year involved a driver under the age of 24. Drivers in this age group are approximately four times more likely to be involved in serious accidents. In response, the government is also considering raising the minimum driving age to 18 from the current 17. Under the proposed measures, youths may need to wait until 19 to qualify for a full license. Additionally, all drivers under 30 could be restricted from giving lifts to friends or driving at night for a year after passing their test. Currently, learner drivers receive a report after the test showing the number of minor and major faults; up to 15 minors are permitted before failing. There is currently no official 'distinction' grade. Matthew Hancock, Conservative MP for West Suffolk, presented his suggestion last week at a car factory event in Oxford, attended by apprentices and Prime Minister David Cameron. Hancock noted that new approaches in apprenticeship assessments, including pass, fail, or distinction, could be applied to driving tests. Separately, parents dropping off or picking up children at school could soon be monitored by cameras targeting illegal parking. The cameras, which operate during school drop-off and pick-up times, record vehicles in restricted areas. The footage is sent to local councils, which can issue fines of up to £120. The system is being tested by several councils in and outside London and is manufactured by Videalert. Actor Tom Conti, 71, criticized the cameras, likening them to excessive surveillance and arguing that councils are using them for revenue rather than safety. The Department for Business and Skills clarified that a distinction grade for driving tests is not official government policy but acknowledged Hancock's support for the idea, especially given his close ties to Chancellor George Osborne. AA president Edmund King described the concept as 'interesting' and suggested it could help make roads safer. He proposed that a distinction could be reserved for those completing advanced lessons and excelling in their tests, possibly leading to lower insurance premiums for new drivers.

Ministar za vještine, Matthew Hancock, smatra da je ograničavajuće to što kandidati mogu samo položiti ili pasti na ispitu. On predlaže da viši nivo postignuća može motivisati vozače da budu bolji, što bi moglo navesti osiguravajuće kuće da ponude niže premije najboljima i tako potencijalno učiniti ceste sigurnijima. Vladina statistika pokazuje da je gotovo četvrtina smrtnih ili težih saobraćajnih nesreća prošle godine uključila vozača mlađeg od 24 godine. Vozači ove starosne grupe su otprilike četiri puta češće učesnici ozbiljnih nesreća. Kao odgovor, Vlada razmatra podizanje minimalne dobi za polaganje vozačkog na 18 godina, umjesto sadašnjih 17. Po predloženim mjerama, mladi bi možda morali čekati do 19. godine za dobijanje pune dozvole. Pored toga, svim vozačima mlađim od 30 moglo bi biti zabranjeno voziti prijatelje ili voziti noću tokom 12 mjeseci nakon polaganja ispita. Trenutno kandidati nakon ispita dobijaju izvještaj s brojem manjih ili većih grešaka; dozvoljeno je do 15 manjih grešaka prije nego padnu. Trenutno ne postoji službena ocjena 'izvanredno'. Matthew Hancock, konzervativni zastupnik Zapadnog Suffolka, iznio je prijedlog prošle sedmice u fabrici automobila u Oxfordu, na događaju s pripravnicima i premijerom Davidom Cameronom. Naglasio je da bi novi sistem ocjenjivanja u stručnim školama — prolaz, pad ili izvanredno — mogao biti primijenjen i na vozačke ispite. Odvojeno, roditelji koji dovoze ili preuzimaju djecu iz škole uskoro bi mogli biti pod kamerama zbog nepropisnog parkiranja. Kamere, koje rade tokom dolaska i odlaska učenika, snimaju vozila u zabranjenim zonama, a snimke se šalju općinama koje mogu izreći kazne do 120 funti. Sistem testira nekoliko općina u Londonu i izvan njega, a proizvođač je Videalert. Glumac Tom Conti (71) kritikovao je kamere, uporedivši ih s pretjeranim nadzorom i izjavio da ih općine koriste radi prihoda, a ne sigurnosti. Vladin Odjel za posao i vještine pojasnio je da ocjena 'izvanredno' nije službena politika, ali su priznali Hancockovu podršku toj ideji, s obzirom na njegove bliske veze s kancelarom Georgeom Osborneom. Predsjednik AA, Edmund King, rekao je da je taj koncept 'zanimljiv' i da bi mogao pomoći u sigurnosti na cestama. article_content: Gift Okpara, also called General 2-Baba and reportedly the leader of the Iceland cult in Rivers State, has publicly denied any involvement in the killing of SP Bako Angbashin, the Divisional Police Officer of Ahoada East. In a voice note broadcast on a local radio station, Okpara claimed he spoke to Angbashin shortly before his death and insisted he was not present during the attack, which took place on his community's road. Okpara explained that his group disarmed and accepted a government amnesty, yet their rival gang did not, instead targeting his members and even killing his brother. According to him, the government's failure to intervene led his group back to armed conflict, which he described as self-defense. He rejected accusations of involvement in kidnapping, oil theft, or other crimes, stating that he is only involved in the dredging business and is not financially backed by any traditional leader. Okpara added that he sees himself as standing up for local youths. After Angbashin's murder in September 2023 in the Odiemude community, police declared Okpara the primary suspect. Despite several raids resulting in arrests and shootings of other suspects, Okpara remains missing, and authorities have not recovered the officer's body. Over fifty individuals, including a traditional ruler and former local government chairman, are currently on trial related to the case.

U glasovnoj poruci emitovanoj na lokalnoj radio stanici, Okpara je tvrdio da je razgovarao sa Angbashin-om neposredno prije njegove smrti i insistirao da nije bio prisutan tokom napada, koji se dogodio na putu u njegovoj zajednici. Okpara je objasnio da je njegova grupa predala oružje i prihvatila vladinu amnestiju, dok su njihovi suparnici iz druge bande odbili da se razoružaju i umjesto toga napali njegove članove, pa čak ubili i njegovog brata. Prema njemu, vladin propust da reaguje natjerao je njegovu grupu da se vrati oružanim sukobima, što opisuje kao samoodbranu. Odbacio je optužbe da je uključen u otmice, krađu nafte ili druge zločine, naglašavajući da se bavi isključivo poslom bagerisanja i da ga ne finansira nijedan tradicionalni vođa. Okpara je naveo da sebe vidi kao nekoga ko se zalaže za lokalnu omladinu. Nakon Angbashinovog ubistva u septembru 2023. u zajednici Odiemude, policija je Okparu proglasila glavnim osumnjičenim. Uprkos brojnim racijama, hapšenjima i ubistvima drugih osumnjičenih, Okpara je i dalje u bjekstvu, a tijelo ubijenog policajca još nije pronađeno. Više od pedeset ljudi, uključujući jednog tradicionalnog vladara i bivšeg predsjednika opštine, trenutno je na suđenju zbog ovog slučaja.

article_content: If you tried to buy a graphics card during the pandemic, you probably noticed the prices of PC components, especially GPUs, skyrocketed. Now, GPU prices are climbing again, but for different reasons. This isn’t good news if you were planning an upgrade, particularly if you’re eyeing top-tier cards like the Nvidia RTX 4090, which has seen the biggest price jumps. Multiple RTX 4090 models have become significantly more expensive. For example, the Zotac Gaming AMP Extreme AIRO was selling on Newegg for $1,650 in September; now, it costs $1,930—a 17% increase. It’s not just higher prices that are concerning—many RTX 4090 cards are out of stock altogether. On major sites, every model is currently unavailable, leaving customers with few options, no matter the price. Interestingly, this mainly impacts the RTX 4090. Other GPUs from Nvidia and AMD still sell at or below their suggested retail prices. What’s behind the RTX 4090 shortage and price hikes? Experts suggest it’s related to the recent U.S. government ban on exporting AI-capable GPUs to China. While the ban mostly covers Nvidia’s AI-focused cards like the A100, the RTX 4090 is also included. As a result, there’s been a buying frenzy in China—Wccftech reports RTX 4090 prices there nearly doubled overnight—which has affected global availability and pricing. While this situation may only be temporary, shoppers are understandably worried. With the holiday season approaching, further price increases and shortages may continue, but hopefully not to the degree seen during the pandemic or the recent AI boom.

Sada cijene GPU-ova ponovo rastu, ali iz drugih razloga. Ovo nije dobra vijest za one koji planiraju nadogradnju, posebno ako ciljate vrhunske kartice poput Nvidia RTX 4090, koja je najviše poskupjela. Više modela RTX 4090 postalo je znatno skuplje. Na primjer, Zotac Gaming AMP Extreme AIRO se u septembru na Neweggu prodavao za 1.650 dolara; sada košta 1.930 dolara—što je povećanje od 17%. Nisu samo više cijene zabrinjavajuće—mnoge RTX 4090 kartice su potpuno rasprodate. Na većim stranicama svaki model je trenutno nedostupan, tako da kupci imaju malo opcija bez obzira na cijenu. Zanimljivo je da ovo uglavnom utiče na RTX 4090. Ostale grafičke kartice iz Nvidia-e i AMD-a i dalje se prodaju po preporučenim ili nižim cijenama. Šta stoji iza nestašice i rasta cijena RTX 4090? Stručnjaci sugerišu da je razlog nedavna zabrana američke vlade na izvoz GPU-ova sposobnih za AI u Kinu. Iako zabrana prvenstveno obuhvata Nvidia-ine AI kartice kao što je A100, i RTX 4090 je na spisku. Kao rezultat, u Kini je nastala prava pomama za kupovinu—Wccftech izvještava da su cijene RTX 4090 tamo skoro udvostručene preko noći—što je uticalo na dostupnost i cijene širom svijeta. Iako bi situacija mogla biti privremena, kupci su s razlogom zabrinuti. S prazničnom sezonom pred vratima, moguće su dodatne nestašice i poskupljenja, ali se nadamo da neće biti kao tokom pandemije ili nedavnog AI booma.

article_content: As 'Fringe' reaches its final season, John Noble – who plays the brilliant but quirky scientist Walter Bishop – spoke with CNN about this significant moment for the sci-fi favorite. The series, adored by fans over five years, is concluding its run on Fox, with reruns also featured on the Science Channel. Noble reflected on how finishing the show feels both rewarding and a little sad, crediting deep friendships formed among the cast and crew during their filming years together in Vancouver. He commended the Science Channel for their genuine enthusiasm, highlighting the network's commitment to exploring the show’s scientific elements and providing 'Fringe' with an enthusiastic new audience. In the final season, the main characters face intense pressure as they assemble a plan to combat the enigmatic Observers. Noble noted that these pivotal episodes give every character a chance to reach meaningful conclusions, likening it to writing the final chapters of a book. Commenting on Peter Bishop’s storyline, where he uses Observer technology, Noble described the plot as inventive, allowing Joshua Jackson’s character to evolve in interesting ways, while showing both Peter’s and Walter’s struggles with their own flaws. Noble also shared about a brief production pause for his health, explaining that he needed time to address ongoing sleep issues. He praised the supportive production team and shared that he recovered well. Although initially hesitant, Noble has embraced Twitter and now appreciates its ability to connect quickly with audiences. He recounted how a tweet about actress Georgina Haig sparked unexpected speculation, illustrating the surprises of social media. Noble debunked the myth that he indulges in junk food on set like his character, stating that in reality, actors avoid such snacks due to filming demands, though he fondly remembered enjoying a bacon sandwich once. Looking forward to the finale, Noble expressed faith in executive producer Joel Wyman, who is both writing and directing the concluding episode. He expects the last chapter to reflect the passion of everyone involved and deliver a powerful end to the series.

Serija, omiljena među fanovima pet godina, završava na Foxu, dok se reprize prikazuju i na Science Channelu. Noble je rekao da kraj serije izaziva i osjećaj postignuća i tugu, jer su među glumačkom i produkcijskom ekipom tokom godina u Vancouveru nastala snažna prijateljstva. On je posebno pohvalio Science Channel za njihovu iskrenu podršku i interes, ističući koliko je važno što istražuju naučne teme iz serije i daju joj novu publiku. U finalnoj sezoni, glavni likovi se nalaze pod velikim pritiskom dok pokušavaju osmisliti plan za borbu protiv zagonetnih Observera. Noble je primijetio da ove ključne epizode omogućavaju svakom liku da prođe kroz svoje završno poglavlje, što poredi s pisanjem kraja knjige. Govoreći o priči koja uključuje Petera Bishopa i njegovu upotrebu tehnologije Observera, Noble je pohvalio kreativni zaokret, koji Joshuai Jacksonu pruža priliku za razvoj lika, dok obojica – i Peter i Walter – prolaze kroz vlastite slabosti. Noble je spomenuo i kratko zaustavljanje snimanja zbog zdravlja, navodeći da je morao riješiti dugotrajne probleme sa snom i pohvalio podršku ekipe, rekavši da se potpuno oporavio. Iako u početku nije bio ljubitelj društvenih mreža, Noble je prihvatio Twitter te sada cijeni njegovu mogućnost za direktnu komunikaciju s obožavateljima. Prisjetio se kako je tvit o Georgini Haig izazvao razne špekulacije, što ilustrira nepredvidivost društvenih mreža. Noble je razjasnio da zapravo izbjegava nezdravu hranu na setu, iako njegov lik uživa u njoj, jer bi stalno grickanje otežalo snimanje, ali se prisjetio jednog posebnog sendviča sa slaninom. Na kraju, Noble je izrazio povjerenje u izvršnog producenta Joela Wymana, koji piše i režira završnicu. Vjeruje da će posljednja epizoda odražavati strast ekipe i donijeti spektakularan kraj serije.

article_content: Uruguay striker Luis Suarez scored late in the first half to secure a 1-1 draw against Peru in their opening match of the 2011 Copa America. Paolo Guerrero put Peru ahead after 23 minutes, taking advantage of a long ball upfield, rounding Uruguay goalkeeper Fernando Muslera, and finishing into an empty net. Suarez equalized for Uruguay just before halftime, finishing from inside the penalty area after receiving a pass from Ajax’s Nicolas Lodeiro. Atletico Madrid’s Diego Forlan had a chance to win it for Uruguay but shot over the bar with only the goalkeeper to beat. Chile are top of Group C after coming from behind to beat Mexico 2-1. Mexico took the lead when Cruz Azul defender Nestor Araujo headed past Chile goalkeeper Claudio Bravo. Chile equalized through substitute Esteban Paredes, who scored following confusion in the Mexico defense during a corner. Arturo Vidal put Chile ahead in the 73rd minute with a strong header from another set piece. All four teams return to action on Friday: Uruguay play Chile, and Mexico face Peru.

article_content: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL), headquartered in Bengaluru, has selected 139 candidates for its 46th batch of Management and Design Trainees from a pool of over 30,000 applicants. The trainees were officially inducted at a ceremony held on Wednesday. Over the next 52 weeks, they will undergo comprehensive training at the HAL Management Academy, specializing in fields including aeronautics, production, electrical, electronics, computer science, finance, human resources, and legal. At the ceremony, HAL's Chairman and Managing Director (Additional Charge), C B Ananthakrishnan, released seven handbooks on technical and managerial topics. Ananthakrishnan emphasized HAL's position among India's top 40 companies by market capitalization and expressed optimism for the future, noting the company's ongoing development of new products and alignment with the 'Aatmanirbhar Bharat' (self-reliant India) initiative. He expressed the aim for continued double-digit growth.

Pripravnici su službeno primljeni na ceremoniji održanoj u srijedu. Tokom narednih 52 sedmice proći će kroz sveobuhvatnu obuku u HAL Management Academy, specijalizirajući se u oblastima kao što su aeronautika, proizvodnja, elektrotehnika, elektronika, računarstvo, finansije, ljudski resursi i pravo. Na ceremoniji je predsjednik i generalni direktor HAL-a (privremeno), C B Ananthakrishnan, predstavio sedam priručnika iz tehničkih i menadžerskih oblasti. Ananthakrishnan je naglasio poziciju HAL-a među 40 najvećih indijskih kompanija po tržišnoj kapitalizaciji i izrazio optimizam za budućnost, ističući kontinuirani razvoj novih proizvoda i povezivanje s inicijativom 'Aatmanirbhar Bharat' (samopouzdana Indija). article_content: Dozens of disabled travelers filed complaints with Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport about invasive TSA security checks that left them feeling violated and humiliated, according to records released this week. One complaint involved an 82-year-old woman using a wheelchair, who was reportedly asked to remove her prosthetic breast by a TSA agent in June 2012. Overall, 26 complaints were made against the Arizona airport involving people with disabilities in 2012—twice the national average. Among those affected was Marine Cpl Toran Gaal, who lost both legs in an IED explosion in Afghanistan, and was allegedly subjected to invasive searches at Phoenix airport in March. According to the Arizona Republic, the complaint on behalf of the 82-year-old woman stated she posed no safety risk due to her age and physical condition and should not have faced such undignified treatment. Another breast cancer survivor said a TSA agent performed a public pat-down of her prosthetic breast, forcing her to reveal it, and that the incident 'ruined my vacation.' A prominent March incident involved Cpl Toran Gaal, an Afghan War veteran and double amputee, who was allegedly asked to remove his prosthetic legs and stand without his wheelchair. The TSA denies this claim, saying surveillance footage does not show his prosthetics being removed. MailOnline contacted Phoenix Airport for comment about the high number of complaints. Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport received more than double the national average of complaints regarding its security checkpoints in 2012. In a statement to MailOnline, the TSA said it strives to treat every passenger with dignity and respect, and that secondary screening occurs if an anomaly is detected. The agency maintains passengers should not be required to remove or lift clothing to reveal sensitive body areas or remove prosthetics. TSA indicated it works with organizations, including breast cancer advocacy groups, to improve procedures and enhance the passenger experience while ensuring safety. The TSA recommends that travelers with disabilities or medical conditions call ahead to learn what to expect during screening. According to the TSA website, if an agent deems a pat-down necessary, a private screening can be requested by the passenger at any time, and the agent should offer this option. It is against TSA policy to ask a passenger to remove or lift clothing to reveal a sensitive area.

article_content: Prime Minister David Cameron is prepared to give Scottish 16 and 17-year-olds the right to vote in the upcoming independence referendum. Though this is regarded as a win for the Scottish National Party, Cameron reaffirmed his commitment to keeping the United Kingdom together. Cameron is scheduled to meet with Scottish First Minister Alex Salmond in Edinburgh to finalize the details for the referendum. While the SNP calls the inclusion of younger voters a victory, a recent Mail on Sunday poll found just 26% of young Scots back independence, with 59% opposed. Rather than allow an additional question on increased powers, the referendum will present a straightforward choice on whether Scotland should become independent. Speaking at the Conservative Party gathering, Cameron highlighted the significance of unity, referencing the recent Olympic Games as a moment that showcased a strong British identity. He joked that Salmond was perhaps the only one not enjoying the shared spirit. The Scottish Parliament will decide on voting arrangements and eligibility, but this set-up is unique to the independence referendum, not a template for other elections. The Scottish government is responsible for registering all eligible 16 and 17-year-olds. Surveys indicate that most young people currently oppose Scottish independence, which some officials suggest may be linked to their international perspective. Education Secretary Michael Gove, who has family ties in Scotland, said numerous UK ministers will join the campaign, describing the matter as deeply personal. In other news, Health Secretary Jeremy Hunt admitted there might be a wait before a cap is set on long-term elderly care costs, challenging Cameron’s earlier pledge to impose a £35,000 ceiling. Hunt mentioned the possibility of a higher cap or limiting who qualifies, citing economist Andrew Dilnot’s analysis and the projected yearly cost of £1.7 billion.

Ministar obrazovanja Michael Gove, čija porodica živi u Škotskoj, najavio je da će brojni britanski ministri učestvovati u kampanji, istaknuvši koliko mu ta tema lično znači. U odvojenom dešavanju, ministar zdravstva Jeremy Hunt priznao je da bi moglo potrajati dok se ne uvede ograničenje troškova za dugotrajnu njegu starijih, dovodeći u pitanje Cameronovo ranije obećanje o limitu od 35.000 funti. Hunt je spomenuo eventualno viši limit ili ograničeniju podobnost, pozivajući se na procjene ekonomiste Andrewa Dilnota i očekivane godišnje troškove od 1,7 milijardi funti.

article_content: West Bengal’s Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee has appealed to Union Home Minister Amit Shah to focus on reaching agreement among stakeholders before proceeding with major changes to the country’s criminal laws. Banerjee, in her letter, stressed that radically overhauling core criminal codes—like the Indian Penal Code, the Code of Criminal Procedure, and the Indian Evidence Act—could deeply and permanently affect India’s political landscape and society. The Centre introduced new bills—Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam—to replace these longstanding statutes. Banerjee underscored how significant these reforms are for the country’s legal system and everyday life, urging Shah to be mindful of the implications. She warned that enacting the bills without thorough consensus among stakeholders could lead to serious, long-term consequences.

U svom pismu Shah-u naglasila je da bi radikalna izmjena ključnih krivičnih zakona—poput Indijskog krivičnog zakona, Zakona o krivičnom postupku i Zakona o dokazima—mogla duboko i trajno uticati na politički i društveni okvir Indije. Vlada je predložila nove nacrte zakona—Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita i Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam—kako bi zamijenila postojeće propise. Banerjee je istakla koliko su ove reforme važne za pravni sistem i svakodnevni život u zemlji te upozorila Shaha na moguće posljedice. Upozorila je da bi usvajanje ovih zakona bez šireg dogovora moglo imati ozbiljne, dugoročne posljedice.

article_content: A testimonial match to celebrate Deco, the former Portuguese footballer, will take place on July 25. The event will feature Porto’s celebrated 2004 Champions League lineup against Barcelona’s 2006 champions. Jose Mourinho, who currently manages Chelsea, is set to coach Porto at the Dragao Stadium, while Frank Rijkaard will take charge of Barcelona’s squad. Football icons Lionel Messi, Ronaldinho, Samuel Eto'o, and Henrik Larsson are expected to play for Barcelona. Xavi and Andres Iniesta may also participate if their fitness allows after the World Cup. This match is particularly significant for Messi, who started his Barcelona career at the Dragao Stadium and has often spoken about Ronaldinho’s positive impact on him. Messi has previously stated that Ronaldinho made adjusting to Barcelona much easier and was essential in changing the club’s fortunes. Deco, who enjoyed success with Porto, Barcelona, Chelsea, and finished his career at Fluminense, retired earlier this year. Porto’s Ricardo Carvalho and Paulo Ferreira are also set to appear, with kickoff scheduled for 7:45pm.

Postoji mogućnost da se Xavi i Andres Iniesta uključe, ovisno o njihovoj spremnosti nakon Svjetskog prvenstva. Ova utakmica je posebno emotivna za Messija, koji je za Barcelonu debitovao baš na stadionu Dragao i mnogo puta naglasio koliko mu je Ronaldinho pomogao da se prilagodi. Messi je izjavio da mu je Ronaldinho znatno olakšao prilagodbu i bio ključan za promjene u klubu. Deco je imao blistavu karijeru u Portu, Barceloni, Chelseaju, a posljednje nastupe zabilježio je u Fluminenseu, prije nego što se ranije ove godine povukao. Legende Porta Ricardo Carvalho i Paulo Ferreira također će igrati, a početak susreta zakazan je za 19:45.

article_content: Cardiff City is set to officially appoint Russell Slade, who previously managed Leyton Orient, as their new head coach. Since his departure from Orient, Slade has been acting as a consultant for Cardiff while compensation arrangements were finalized. The club has been without a permanent manager since Ole Gunnar Solskjaer stepped down on September 18, with Scott Young and Danny Gabbidon handling interim management duties. Slade has recently traveled with the squad, observing from the stands during matches, including the recent 1-0 defeat to Blackpool, the victory over Sheffield Wednesday, and the draw at Brighton. After a downturn in Orient's form, Slade resigned from his role there on September 24. Before settling on Slade, Cardiff also considered Dundee's Paul Hartley. Club owner Vincent Tan has voiced strong confidence in Slade, expressing the hope that he might achieve the kind of managerial longevity seen with Arsenal’s Arsene Wenger. Slade started his coaching career in 1994 and has previously managed Notts County, Scarborough, Grimsby Town, Yeovil Town, and Brighton.

article_content: In recent months, I have encouraged my patients to receive the flu vaccine. Many agreed, but some refused. Today, when I check Google’s national flu trend map, I see that almost the entire country is marked in alarming red, indicating 'intense' flu activity. According to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), 41 states are experiencing widespread flu outbreaks. There are 26 times more flu cases this year compared to last year. In Boston, near my primary care practice, a public health emergency was declared this past Wednesday. Seeing these headlines, I am reminded to be more persuasive about promoting the flu vaccine. More people need to be protected by getting vaccinated earlier in the season. Like many clinics nationwide, my office is overwhelmed with patients suffering from coughs, runny noses, fevers, and body aches—many likely caused by the flu. Thankfully, most adults recover. However, young children, the elderly, and those with chronic health conditions like asthma, diabetes, or cancer are at higher risk for serious complications. Severe cases can lead to pneumonia, hospitalization, or even death. Pediatrician William Rodriguez with the Food and Drug Administration notes that 43 to 153 children have died from the flu over the past 10 seasons. This season alone, 18 children have already died. One reason this year’s outbreak is so severe is that the dominant strain, H3N2, hasn’t circulated this widely since 2002–03 and tends to cause more serious illness. Another factor is that relatively few people have received the flu shot. This year’s vaccine matches the circulating viruses well and offers about 60% protection—yet over half of Americans skip the vaccine. Only 46% received it last year, and this year’s rates are similar. Many believe the myth that you can get the flu from the flu shot, but there are no live viruses in the vaccine. If someone becomes sick after getting vaccinated, it’s likely due to another non-influenza virus with similar symptoms. Others say, ‘I've never needed the shot before and I've been fine.’ For some, the flu can be mild, but for others it’s debilitating, and infected people risk spreading it to vulnerable individuals, potentially with devastating consequences. Frank Esper, an expert in viral respiratory diseases at UH Case Medical Center in Ohio, stresses that 'Every time you vaccinate yourself, you're not just protecting yourself, but you're protecting everyone you know, including the young and pregnant women.' It is not too late to get your flu shot. If you haven’t already, consider getting vaccinated. While it takes about two weeks for full protection, flu season has not yet peaked. I realize I need to do more to correct misconceptions and persuade more patients to get vaccinated. Patients can help, too: stay informed, learn from the current flu crisis, and be proactive about getting vaccinated earlier in future seasons. (The opinions expressed here are those of Kevin Pho.)
translated_content: Posljednjih nekoliko mjeseci poticao sam svoje pacijente da prime vakcinu protiv gripe. Mnogi su pristali, ali neki su odbili. Danas, kada pogledam Googleovu nacionalnu kartu širenja gripe, vidim da je gotovo cijela zemlja označena alarmantno crvenom bojom, što označava 'intenzivnu' aktivnost gripe. Prema Centrima za kontrolu i prevenciju bolesti (CDC), 41 savezna država bilježi raširene epidemije gripe. Ove godine ima 26 puta više slučajeva gripe nego prošle. U Bostonu, blizu moje ordinacije, prošle srijede proglašena je zdravstvena vanredna situacija. Gledajući ove naslove, podsjećam se da budem uvjerljiviji kad promovišem vakcinu protiv gripe. Veći broj ljudi treba biti zaštićen primanjem vakcine ranije tokom sezone. Poput mnogih ambulanti u zemlji, moja ordinacija je pretrpana pacijentima koji pate od kašlja, curenja nosa, temperatura i bolova u tijelu—simptomi koje vjerovatno uzrokuje gripa. Srećom, većina odraslih se oporavi. No, mala djeca, stariji i osobe s kroničnim zdravstvenim stanjima poput astme, dijabetesa ili raka su izloženi većem riziku od ozbiljnih komplikacija. Teški slučajevi mogu dovesti do upale pluća, hospitalizacije, pa čak i smrti. Pedijatar William Rodriguez iz Agencije za hranu i lijekove navodi da je tokom posljednjih 10 sezona gripe umrlo između 43 i 153 djece. Samo ove sezone, već je umrlo 18 djece. Jedan od razloga zašto je ovogodišnja epidemija toliko ozbiljna je što dominantni soj H3N2 nije bio toliko rasprostranjen još od 2002–03. godine i obično uzrokuje ozbiljnije bolesti. Drugi razlog je relativno mali broj vakcinisanih osoba. Ove godine vakcina dobro odgovara virusima u cirkulaciji i pruža oko 60% zaštite, ali više od pola Amerikanaca preskoči vakcinaciju. Prošle godine samo 46% je primilo vakcinu, a ovogodišnji postotak je sličan. Mnogi vjeruju u mit da mogu dobiti gripu od vakcine, ali u vakcini nema živih virusa. Ako se neko razboli nakon vakcine, to je vjerovatno posljedica neke druge virusne infekcije sa sličnim simptomima. Drugi kažu: 'Nikad nisam primao/la vakcinu i bio/la sam dobro.' Za neke gripa može biti blaga, ali za druge je iscrpljujuća, a zaraženi ljudi mogu prenijeti gripu ranjivim osobama, što može imati teške posljedice. Frank Esper, stručnjak za respiratorne virusne bolesti iz medicinskog centra UH Case u Ohiju, naglašava da 'Svaki put kada se vakcinišete, ne štitite samo sebe već i sve oko sebe, uključujući djecu i trudnice.' Još nije kasno za vakcinu protiv gripe. Ako je još niste primili, razmislite o tome. Za punu zaštitu potrebno je oko dvije sedmice, a sezona gripe još nije dostigla vrhunac. Shvatam da moram još više raditi na razbijanju mitova i uvjeravanju pacijenata da se vakcinišu. I sami pacijenti mogu pomoći: informišite se, učite iz aktuelne krize i budite proaktivni pa se vakcinišite ranije u narednim sezonama. (Mišljenja iznesena ovdje su osobna, iznosi ih Kevin Pho.)

article_content: The Reign of Cats and Dogs made a splash over the weekend as both Saturday and Sunday celebrated our four-legged friends with great success. The two-day event was held at Bicentennial Park on Glebe Foreshore, in Sydney's inner west, New South Wales. Dogs from the RSPCA and 12 other animal shelters found loving homes on Saturday, while famous cats were featured in a special showcase on Sunday. On Saturday, 1,500 people attended the Rescue Me canine event from 10am to 2pm. An RSPCA spokeswoman described the event as a huge success, noting the lively turnout. Guests enjoyed a variety of food options including a Yum Cha stand, a New York pastrami deli, Mr Whippy, and a coffee truck. In total, 50 dogs were adopted, including 10 from the RSPCA. Several breeds did particularly well with the crowds: five greyhounds and four cattle dogs were adopted. The remaining dogs will return to their shelters to await adoption. On Sunday evening, the New South Wales RSPCA hosted the International Cat Film Festival at 6pm in the park. This feline celebration, inspired by the global Internet Cat Video Festival, brought cat lovers together to watch famous internet cats on the big screen. The festival sold around 1,900 tickets and offered family attractions such as a Cattoo Parlour for temporary tattoos, an RSPCA merchandise tent, cat toy-making activities, and a live Twitter feed displayed on the big screen. A VIP area featured oversized bean bags for relaxation. RSPCA noted that cats are among the most searched topics online, with millions of cat videos viewed globally every day. Organizers considered the event a great success.

article_content: Authorities in New Delhi, India's smog-choked capital, have extended the emergency closure of schools for another week, as air pollution levels remain hazardous. Every autumn, New Delhi is enveloped in thick smog, mainly caused by stubble burning from farmers in neighboring agricultural states. The city is often ranked among the most polluted globally, with its yearly smog linked to hundreds of thousands of premature deaths. Due to persistently high pollution, Delhi Education Minister Atishi announced on X (formerly Twitter) that primary schools will stay closed until November 10. Secondary schools now have the option to shift to online classes. IQAir, an air quality monitoring firm, reports that New Delhi, which has 30 million residents, was once again ranked as the world's most polluted city on Sunday. Delhi authorities annually restrict construction activities and limit road traffic when pollution becomes severe. Nevertheless, critics argue that the government fails to tackle the agricultural roots of the crisis. Farmers in neighboring states are a powerful political group, and efforts to impose stricter penalties for stubble burning have faced resistance. A cricket World Cup match between Sri Lanka and Bangladesh is set for Monday in New Delhi. Both teams canceled their pre-match training sessions recently due to health risks from the smog. Bangladesh coach Chandika Hathurusingha acknowledged they have 'no choice' but to play despite the concerns, noting that some asthmatic players avoided training due to poor air quality. Dangerous PM2.5 particle levels reached 570 micrograms per cubic meter on Sunday, nearly 40 times over the World Health Organization's recommended daily maximum. A 2020 Lancet study attributed 1.67 million deaths in India to air pollution the previous year, including almost 17,500 in New Delhi. Research from the University of Chicago’s Energy Policy Institute finds the average city resident could lose nearly 12 years of life expectancy because of the pollution. India remains heavily reliant on coal for energy and has resisted calls to phase it out. The country's per capita coal emissions have risen by 29% in the past seven years.

article_content: Roger Federer was eliminated from the U.S. Open after a surprise defeat by Czech sixth seed Tomas Berdych, ending the world No. 1's quest for a record sixth title in the professional era. Berdych secured a 7-6 (7-1), 6-4, 3-6, 6-3 victory in under three hours during Wednesday's evening session, reaching the semifinals at Flushing Meadows for the first time. “I just didn’t come up with the goods tonight,” Federer said on the official tournament website after playing his first match in four days, due to a walkover against American Mardy Fish. “He probably created more chances than I did, which is why he ended up winning.” Federer's exit marks his earliest departure from New York since 2003. His record against the 26-year-old Berdych now stands at 11-5. Berdych previously defeated Federer at the 2004 Olympics and in the 2010 Wimbledon quarterfinals. In the semifinals, Berdych will play Olympic champion Andy Murray, who overcame Marin Cilic after dropping the first set. Murray rallied to win 3-6, 7-6 (7-4), 6-2, 6-0. Cilic, who held a 5-1 lead in the second set, missed multiple opportunities and lost momentum. Murray capitalized and dominated the remaining sets to secure his spot in the semis. The match was moved from Arthur Ashe Stadium to Louis Armstrong Stadium. Murray, a 2008 U.S. Open finalist, initially struggled with the transition and the small crowd against Cilic, who had beaten him at the tournament three years prior. “You have to create your own atmosphere on the court, but I played better when the crowd filled up,” said Murray, who is still seeking his first grand slam title after losing to Federer in the Wimbledon final in July. “Switching courts makes it harder to find rhythm. I've never played especially well on that court.” Earlier, 2009 U.S. Open champion Juan Martin Del Potro ended Andy Roddick's career by defeating the American in four sets during their rain-delayed fourth-round match on Arthur Ashe. Roddick, the last U.S. male to win a grand slam (at the U.S. Open in 2003), had announced this would be his final tournament. He lost to the seventh-seeded Argentinian Del Potro, who now faces defending champion Novak Djokovic in the quarterfinals. When play resumed with the first set tied 6-6 from Tuesday, Roddick took the tiebreaker but could not make further progress against Del Potro, the 23-year-old Olympic bronze medalist. Del Potro won 6-7 (1-7), 7-6 (7-4), 6-2, 6-4. Roddick was visibly emotional in his final game and received a huge ovation from the Arthur Ashe Stadium crowd. “Playing the last five games was tough. Once I got down a break, I could barely look at my players’ box,” a moved Roddick said. “I don't quite know how to feel. I'm a little overwhelmed. Usually I can process things quickly, but not this time.” World No. 2 Djokovic progressed comfortably as his opponent Stanislas Wawrinka retired when trailing by two sets and 3-1 in the third. The Swiss 18th seed felt ill as their rain-delayed match quickly ended. “It’s unfortunate for him, but I was playing well in the last two sets,” said Djokovic, who reached his sixth straight U.S. Open quarterfinal with just 20 games lost in four matches. “Hopefully I can keep that going.” Djokovic's fellow Serbian, eighth seed Janko Tipsarevic, advanced to the U.S. Open quarterfinals for a second consecutive year, beating Germany’s Philipp Kohlschreiber 6-3, 7-6 (7-5), 6-2. Tipsarevic will next play Spain's fourth seed David Ferrer, in excellent form during this year's final grand slam.

Berdych je izborio pobjedu od 7-6 (7-1), 6-4, 3-6, 6-3 za manje od tri sata u večernjoj sesiji u srijedu, plasiravši se prvi put u polufinale Flushing Meadowsa. „Jednostavno nisam bio dovoljno dobar večeras“, rekao je Federer na zvaničnoj web-stranici turnira nakon što je igrao prvi meč u četiri dana, zbog predaje meča Amerikanca Mardyja Fish-a. “Vjerovatno je on stvorio više prilika od mene, zato je i pobijedio.” Federerov odlazak označava njegov najraniji ispad u New Yorku od 2003. godine. Njegov omjer protiv 26-godišnjeg Berdycha sada iznosi 11-5. Berdych je prethodno pobijedio Federera na Olimpijadi 2004. i u četvrtfinalu Wimbledona 2010. U polufinalu, Berdych će igrati sa olimpijskim prvakom Andyjem Murrayjom, koji je savladao Marina Čilića nakon izgubljenog prvog seta. Murray je preokrenuo i pobijedio sa 3-6, 7-6 (7-4), 6-2, 6-0. Čilić, koji je imao vodstvo od 5-1 u drugom setu, propustio je mnoge prilike i izgubio zamah. Murray je to iskoristio i dominirao u preostalim setovima, osiguravši plasman u polufinale. Meč je prebačen sa Arthur Ashe stadiona na Louis Armstrong stadion. Murray, finalista US Opena iz 2008, isprva se mučio s prelaskom i malim brojem publike protiv Čilića, koji ga je pobijedio na istom turniru prije tri godine. “Moraš sam stvoriti atmosferu na terenu, ali sam igrao bolje kad se tribine napunile,” rekao je Murray, koji još traga za svojom prvom grand slam titulom nakon što je izgubio od Federera u finalu Wimbledona u julu. “Promjena terena otežava pronalaženje ritma. Nikad nisam posebno dobro igrao na tom terenu.” Ranije je šampion US Opena iz 2009., Juan Martin Del Potro, završio karijeru Andyja Roddicka pobjedom u četiri seta tokom njihovog kišom odgođenog meča četvrtog kola na Arthur Ashe stadionu. Roddick, posljednji američki muški pobjednik grand slama (US Open 2003.), najavio je da mu je ovo posljednji turnir. Izgubio je od sedmog nosioca Argentinca Del Potra, koji sada igra protiv branioca titule Novaka Đokovića u četvrtfinalu. Kada se igra nastavila sa 6-6 u prvom setu iz utorka, Roddick je dobio tie-break, ali nije mogao napredovati protiv 23-godišnjeg Del Potra, osvajača olimpijske bronzane medalje. Del Potro je slavio 6-7 (1-7), 7-6 (7-4), 6-2, 6-4. Roddick je bio vidno emotivan u svojoj posljednjoj igri i dobio je ogroman aplauz publike na Arthur Ashe stadionu. „Igranje zadnjih pet gemova bilo je teško. Kada sam izgubio break, jedva da sam mogao pogledati svoju ložu,“ rekao je emotivni Roddick. “Ne znam tačno šta osjećam. Malo sam preplavljen. Obično brzo procesuiram stvari, ali sada nije tako.” Drugi nosioc Novak Đoković prošao je dalje bez većih problema jer je njegov protivnik Stanislas Wawrinka predao kada je gubio dva seta i 3-1 u trećem. Švicarac, 18. nosioc, žalio se na loše zdravlje, pa je meč brzo završen. “Nije mu bilo lako, ali sam ja igrao dobro u zadnja dva seta,” rekao je Đoković, koji je izborio šesto uzastopno četvrtfinale US Opena izgubivši samo 20 gemova u četiri meča. “Nadam se da mogu nastaviti ovako.” Đokovićev sunarodnjak, osmi nosioc Janko Tipsarević, drugi put zaredom se plasirao u četvrtfinale US Opena, pobijedivši Nijemca Philippa Kohlschreibera 6-3, 7-6 (7-5), 6-2. Tipsarević će igrati protiv četvrtog nosioca Španca Davida Ferrera, koji je takođe u odličnoj formi na ovogodišnjem posljednjem grand slamu.

article_content: A comprehensive study by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) has concluded that COVID-19 vaccination does not increase the risk of unexplained sudden deaths among young adults in India. Instead, the study found that hospitalization due to COVID-19, a family history of sudden death, and certain lifestyle behaviors such as recent binge drinking and vigorous physical activity raised the likelihood of unexplained deaths in this group. The research, titled "Factors associated with sudden deaths among adults aged 18-45 years in India - a multicentric matched case-control study," was published in the Indian Journal of Medical Research. "We found no evidence of a positive association of COVID-19 vaccination with unexplained sudden death among young adults. On the contrary, the present study indicates that COVID-19 vaccination actually reduced the risk in this age group," the study states. The investigation included healthy individuals aged 18-45 who had no known co-morbidities and died unexpectedly (less than 24 hours after hospitalization or seen healthy up to 24 hours before death) of unexplained causes between October 1, 2021, and March 31, 2023. The study was conducted using data from 47 tertiary care hospitals across India. For each case, four controls matched by age, gender, and neighborhood were included. Researchers gathered information about COVID-19 vaccination and infection, family history of sudden death, smoking, recreational drug use, alcohol consumption, and recent intense physical activity. Anecdotal reports of sudden deaths among young adults spurred this investigation, as concerns rose that COVID-19 or its vaccination could be related. Official sources have since clarified these concerns through the study.
translated_content: Opsežna studija koju je sproveo Indijski savjet za medicinska istraživanja (ICMR) zaključila je da vakcinacija protiv COVID-19 ne povećava rizik od iznenadnih neobjašnjenih smrti među mladim odraslim osobama u Indiji. Umjesto toga, studija je utvrdila da hospitalizacija zbog COVID-19, porodična anamneza iznenadne smrti i određeni stilovi života, kao što su nedavno prekomjerno konzumiranje alkohola i intenzivna fizička aktivnost, povećavaju vjerovatnoću iznenadnih smrti u ovoj grupi. Istraživanje pod nazivom "Faktori povezani s iznenadnim smrtima među odraslima uzrasta od 18 do 45 godina u Indiji – multicentrična studija tipa podudaranja slučaja i kontrole" objavljeno je u časopisu Indian Journal of Medical Research. "Nismo pronašli dokaze o pozitivnoj povezanosti vakcinacije protiv COVID-19 sa iznenadnom neobjašnjivom smrću među mladim odraslim osobama. Naprotiv, ova studija pokazuje da vakcinacija zapravo smanjuje rizik u ovoj starosnoj grupi", navodi se u istraživanju. Istraživanje je uključilo zdrave osobe starosti od 18 do 45 godina bez poznatih komorbiditeta koje su iznenada umrle (manje od 24 sata nakon hospitalizacije ili viđene kao zdrave do 24 sata prije smrti) od neobjašnjenih uzroka u periodu od 1. oktobra 2021. do 31. marta 2023. Studija je sprovedena na osnovu podataka iz 47 tercijarnih bolnica širom Indije. Za svaki slučaj su bila uključena četiri kontrolna sudionika usklađena po godinama, spolu i susjedstvu. Istraživači su prikupljali podatke o vakcinaciji i infekciji COVID-19, porodičnoj istoriji iznenadne smrti, pušenju, rekreativnoj upotrebi droga, konzumiranju alkohola i nedavnim intenzivnim fizičkim aktivnostima. Anegdotalni izvještaji o iznenadnim smrtnim ishodima mladih odraslih potakli su ovo istraživanje, jer su se pojavile sumnje da bi to moglo biti povezano s COVID-19 ili vakcinacijom. Zvanični izvori su sada ove sumnje razjasnili kroz studiju.

article_content: When baby Isaac Curtis was born struggling to breathe, doctors determined he needed specialist care immediately. He was taken from his parents and transferred between hospitals far from home as doctors worked to save his life. The family was eventually reunited closer to home after the Children’s Air Ambulance safely transported Isaac back to his local hospital in Somerset in a special ‘baby pod’ that allowed him to breathe during the journey. Isaac wore tiny ear defenders for his helicopter ride, which covered the 170 miles from Leicester to Musgrove Hospital in Taunton in only 59 minutes. The Children’s Air Ambulance was called upon to transport Isaac from Leicester Glenfield Hospital, where he had received life-saving treatment, to be closer to his family in Taunton. Doctors first became concerned shortly after Isaac's birth when he showed signs of severe respiratory distress and lung damage. He was diagnosed with acute meconium aspiration—a condition caused when a baby inhales its own waste products during labor—after a long two-day labor. Paramedics drove Isaac to Bristol Royal Infirmary, where he was placed on a mechanical ventilator to clear his lungs. Doctors warned his mother Rebecca that he might not survive the 50-mile journey and prepared her for the worst. Isaac made it to the hospital, but the ventilator was ineffective. Specialists from Leicester Glenfield Hospital were called, bringing with them the only mobile ECMO (Extra Corporeal Membrane Oxygenation) machine in the country. ECMO is a machine that pumps blood and oxygen around the body artificially. Isaac was transferred to Leicester, spent two nights receiving ECMO treatment, and began responding well. His parents, Rebecca Curtis and her husband, followed by car, and after the difficult labor, Rebecca was relieved to hear Isaac would be returning home to Taunton. The baby was stabilized in the Children's Air Ambulance baby pod before being flown by pilots Shaun Tinkler Rose and Paul Hogan back to Somerset, while his parents made the five-hour journey by road. Rebecca Curtis described how difficult it was to trust her baby to the helicopter crew, but she was reassured by being allowed onboard to take photos and receiving regular updates from the team. After three more weeks of treatment at Taunton hospital, Isaac is now home and doing well, though he still uses oxygen. Doctors expect him to make a full recovery with no long-term side effects. Rebecca Curtis is planning to run a half marathon next year to raise funds for the Children’s Air Ambulance as a thank you. She praised the service, saying, 'The Children’s Air Ambulance provides an amazing service and we are so grateful they were there to help Isaac when he needed them most.' The Children’s Air Ambulance is the only dedicated helicopter ambulance service in England and Wales focused on transferring critically ill children and babies to specialist hospitals and is equipped with pediatric equipment. The charity, funded entirely by public donations, launched its first helicopter in October 2012. The Agusta Grand 109S helicopter can reach speeds up to 200 mph. Nearly two thirds of children assisted by the air ambulance are under three months old.
translated_content: Kada se beba Isaac Curtis rodila s poteškoćama u disanju, doktori su odmah zaključili da mu je potrebna specijalizirana njega. Odveden je od roditelja i prebačen u više bolnica daleko od kuće dok su ljekari pokušavali spasiti njegov život. Porodica je na kraju ponovo bila zajedno bliže kući nakon što je Dječija zračna hitna pomoć sigurno prevezla Isaaca nazad u njegovu lokalnu bolnicu u Somersetu u posebnoj 'bebi kapsuli' koja mu je omogućila da diše tokom puta. Isaac je nosio male štitnike za uši tokom vožnje helikopterom, koji je prešao 274 kilometra od Leicestera do bolnice Musgrove u Tauntonu za samo 59 minuta. Dječija zračna hitna pomoć je pozvana da preveze Isaaca iz bolnice Glenfield u Leicesteru, gdje je primio životno važan tretman, kako bi bio bliže porodici u Tauntonu. Doktori su se zabrinuli odmah po Isaacovom rođenju, kada je pokazao znakove teške respiratorne nevolje i oštećenja pluća. Dijagnosticirana mu je akutna aspiracija mekonija—stanje koje nastaje kada beba udahne vlastite otpadne tvari tokom porođaja—poslije dugog, dvodnevnog porođaja. Hitna pomoć je prevezla Isaaca u Kraljevsku bolnicu u Bristolu, gdje je stavljen na mehanički ventilator kako bi mu očistili pluća. Ljekari su upozorili njegovu majku Rebeku da možda neće preživjeti put dug 80 kilometara i pripremili je na najgore. Isaac je ipak stigao do bolnice, ali ventilator nije bio učinkovit. Stručnjaci iz bolnice Glenfield u Leicesteru su pozvani, donijevši sa sobom jedini mobilni ECMO (ekstrakorporalna membranska oksigenacija) aparat u zemlji. ECMO je uređaj koji umjetno pumpa krv i kisik kroz tijelo. Isaac je prebačen u Leicester, proveo dvije noći na ECMO tretmanu i počeo se dobro oporavljati. Njegovi roditelji, Rebecca Curtis i njen suprug, putovali su autom, a nakon teškog porođaja Rebecca je bila presretna kada je saznala da će Isaac ipak biti vraćen u Taunton. Beba je stabilizirana u 'bebi kapsuli' Dječije zračne hitne pomoći prije nego su je piloti Shaun Tinkler Rose i Paul Hogan prevezli ponovo u Somerset, dok su roditelji putovali automobilom, što je trajalo pet sati. Rebecca Curtis je ispričala da joj je bilo jako teško ostaviti bebu posadi helikoptera, ali ju je umirilo što su joj omogućili da Isaaca fotografiše prije polijetanja i redovno joj javljali kako put protječe. Nakon još tri sedmice liječenja u bolnici Taunton, Isaac je sada kod kuće i dobro se oporavlja, iako još uvijek koristi kisik. Ljekari očekuju potpuni oporavak bez dugoročnih posljedica. Rebecca Curtis planira sljedeće godine trčati polumaraton kako bi prikupila sredstva za Dječiju zračnu hitnu pomoć kao znak zahvalnosti. Pohvalila je službu riječima: 'Dječija zračna hitna pomoć pruža nevjerovatnu uslugu i jako smo zahvalni što su bili tu za Isaaca kada mu je bilo najpotrebnije.' Dječija zračna hitna pomoć je jedina specijalizirana helikopterska hitna služba u Engleskoj i Walesu, namijenjena prevozu teško bolesne djece i beba do specijalističkih bolnica i opremljena je pedijatrijskom opremom. Ova humanitarna organizacija, koju u potpunosti finansiraju javne donacije, svoj prvi helikopter dobila je u oktobru 2012. Helikopter Agusta Grand 109S može dostići brzinu do 320 km/h. article_content: Google Chrome is introducing a helpful new feature that allows users to share their saved passwords with others, though access is currently limited. Highlighted by X user Leopeva64 (via Android Police), the update lets certain users share passwords directly from Google Password Manager in Chrome for desktop. At the moment, this password sharing feature is available in Chrome Canary builds, allowing users to easily share credentials with family members. Leopeva64 demonstrated how the 'share' button appears below login details in the Password Manager section. When sharing, information such as the website address, username, password, and any user notes are included. The process features animations showing the credentials being sent to chosen contacts within the family group linked to a Google account. Users must select the specific contact to share with, and recipients can use the shared credentials if they also have the Chrome Password Manager enabled. Notably, once a password is shared, the only way to stop access for a family member is to change the original password on the site. There is currently no explicit option to revoke or update shared credentials after sharing. Earlier this year, Google Password Manager received updates for Chrome desktop, including a dedicated spot in the menu and an option to add a desktop shortcut. While the new sharing feature is only in the Canary version for now, it may be made widely available in the stable Chrome build soon. Chrome users can also enable the feature by using the flag at chrome://flags/#password-sharing. Both the sharer and the recipient must enable this flag for the feature to work before its official release. Although this feature is useful, its arrival comes after major apps like Netflix and Disney Plus have taken measures against password sharing.

article_content: Golden Hillock School in Birmingham is disputing the findings of an Ofsted report, which criticized the school for not doing enough to protect its students from extremist influences. The report, leaked before publication, indicated shortcomings in safeguarding students from radical ideas and highlighted concerns over school leadership and the handling of sex and relationship education. The school and the Park View Educational Trust (PVET), which oversees Golden Hillock and two others, have rejected the report's conclusions, claiming they are politically motivated and misrepresent the school. PVET maintains that Ofsted found no evidence of the school promoting or tolerating extremism. The trust points out that it had managed the school for only five months prior to the inspection, and that much of the data used in the assessment dated from before their administration. Golden Hillock became one of 21 Birmingham schools under investigation after an unsigned letter—widely dismissed as a hoax—alleged organized attempts by extremist groups to control certain school boards. This letter triggered several official investigations, including those by Ofsted, police, and local authorities. PVET stated that the inspection took place amidst heightened suspicion fueled by the so-called Trojan Horse letter. While inspectors recommended better student awareness about extremism, PVET rejected claims about inadequate staff training and the school's preparation of students for life in modern Britain. A Trust spokesperson confirmed they are legally challenging the Ofsted report, firmly denying that the school deserves its 'inadequate' rating, and expressing disappointment that their efforts for improvement have been overlooked. In contrast, other Birmingham schools investigated in the controversy recently received positive Ofsted assessments for leadership and safeguarding. The situation has become a political issue, with critics of Education Secretary Michael Gove arguing that he failed to act on earlier warnings about the Trojan Horse allegations. They assert that his handling of the matter has fallen short.

Izvještaj, koji je procurio prije zvanične objave, ukazao je na nedostatke u zaštiti učenika od radikalnih ideja te naveo zabrinutosti u vezi sa školskim rukovodstvom i učenjem o seksu i međuljudskim odnosima. PVET ističe da Ofsted nije pronašao dokaze da škola promoviše ili toleriše ekstremizam. article_content: A Boeing 787 Dreamliner operated by Ethiopian Airlines completed the first commercial flight since the global grounding of the fleet in January, following safety concerns over its batteries. The aircraft flew from Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, to Nairobi's Jomo Kenyatta International Airport after air safety authorities approved Boeing’s redesigned battery system. The 787 Dreamliners had been grounded worldwide in January after incidents involving smouldering batteries, including a fire on a Japan Airlines 787 in Boston and an emergency landing by an All Nippon Airways 787 in Japan. The US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) stated that Boeing's new battery system significantly reduces the risk of fire. Ethiopian Airlines became the world's first carrier to resume Dreamliner flights after the improvements. Randy Tinseth, Boeing Commercial Airplanes’ Vice President of Marketing, was among the passengers for the test flight, ensuring the return to service went smoothly. Boeing engineer Richard J. Horigan reported in Nairobi that, while all potential causes of battery fires have been addressed, the exact root cause may never be known due to evidence being destroyed by heat. There are currently 50 Dreamliners in service worldwide. The 787 is Boeing's most advanced commercial aircraft, being the first airliner built primarily with lightweight composites and relying more heavily on electronic systems over traditional mechanical or hydraulic systems. It also makes extensive use of lithium ion batteries, chosen for their lightweight, fast recharging, and higher energy capacity. Boeing promotes the 787 as delivering 20% better fuel efficiency than other mid-sized airliners. Once the FAA approves the modifications for each aircraft, airlines can return them to service. United Airlines, the sole US operator of the 787, has sent one of its six Dreamliners for battery updates and plans to resume domestic flights on May 31, depending on the completion of upgrades. Neither of the battery incidents involved United Airlines jets. Boeing announced that deliveries of the 787 are expected to resume in May. The grounding, which began on January 16, was the FAA’s first mandated grounding of an entire aircraft model since 1979. UBS analyst David Strauss estimated that the 787 issues may cost Boeing $6 billion this year; furthermore, the plane remains more expensive to produce than its revenue from sales. Boeing is preparing to deliver the new battery kits, with installations scheduled roughly in order of original aircraft delivery. Ray Conner, President of Boeing’s commercial airplane division, stated: 'The Boeing team is ready to help get our customers’ 787s back in the air where they belong.' United Airlines intends to launch its Denver-to-Tokyo service on June 10, pending the completion of necessary battery modifications.

Dreamlineri 787 su prizemljeni širom svijeta u januaru nakon incidenata sa tinjajućim baterijama, uključujući požar na avionu Japan Airlinesa u Bostonu i prinudno slijetanje aviona All Nippon Airwaysa u Japanu. Također koristi litijum-jonske baterije zbog njihove male težine, bržeg punjenja i veće energetske efikasnosti. Boeing promoviše 787 kao avion koji ima 20% bolju potrošnju goriva nego drugi avioni srednje veličine. Nakon što FAA odobri modifikacije za svaki avion, aviokompanije ih mogu vratiti u promet. Analitičar UBS-a, David Strauss, procijenio je da će problemi sa 787 ove godine Boeinga koštati 6 milijardi dolara; pored toga, izrada aviona i dalje košta više nego što donosi prihoda od prodaje. Boeing se priprema za isporuku novih setova baterija, pri čemu će se instalacija obavljati otprilike po redoslijedu prve isporuke aviona. Ray Conner, predsjednik Boeingove divizije komercijalnih aviona, izjavio je: 'Boeing tim je spreman pomoći da naši korisnici vrate svoje 787-ice u zrak, tamo gdje im je mjesto.' United Airlines planira pokrenuti let od Denvera do Tokija 10. juna, pod uvjetom da se modifikacije baterija završe na vrijeme.

According to the Institute for the Study of War (ISW), Russia has notably increased its stockpile of high-precision, long-range missiles, despite Western sanctions aimed at restricting its weapons production. Vadym Skibitskyi, spokesperson for Ukraine’s Main Military Intelligence Directorate, stated that by November 6, Russia had about 870 such missiles in reserve, up from 585 in August. This sharp rise points to faster-than-expected domestic missile production, with 115 missiles reportedly made in October alone.

Western countries applied sanctions to prevent Russia from acquiring foreign-made components essential for advanced missiles, but Russia has managed to circumvent these sanctions by procuring parts through intermediaries and allied nations. British intelligence believes Russia is stockpiling missiles, possibly preparing for renewed strikes against Ukraine’s energy infrastructure during winter. Despite efforts to block access to components, Ukrainian sources found that Russian missiles used in attacks still contained numerous foreign parts. Experts are urging stronger Western action to cut off the Kremlin’s financial and material support for illicit weapons manufacturing. Analysts view Russia’s use of long-range missiles as part of a strategy to target Ukraine’s military and civilian assets with the aim of breaking the country’s resolve.

article_content: The Society for Family Health (SFH) has launched a program aimed at preventing unwanted pregnancies among women in Niger State. As part of the initiative, 150 health care workers and community mobilisers have been trained to promote and support the use of self-care contraceptives. Of these, 100 were trained as family planning providers and 50 as community mobilisers across 81 facilities. According to Nufin’allah Al-hamdu, Behavioural Change Communication Officer for SFH DISC, the goal is to empower women with greater control over their sexual and reproductive health, so they can make informed choices about pregnancy. Al-hamdu noted that providing access to self-injectable contraceptives is expected to help prevent unintended pregnancies, ease pressure on health care facilities, and improve reproductive health outcomes. Other benefits of self-injection include reduced crowding in health care centers, shorter waiting times, cost savings on transportation, and a lighter workload for health care providers.

Od tog broja, 100 je obučeno kao pružatelji usluga planiranja porodice, a 50 kao mobilizatori iz zajednice, i to u 81 ustanovi. Prema riječima Nufin’allaha Al-hamdua, službenika za komunikaciju o promjeni ponašanja u SFH DISC, cilj je osnažiti žene većom kontrolom nad njihovim seksualnim i reproduktivnim zdravljem kako bi mogle donositi informisane odluke o trudnoći. article_content: Quinton de Kock led South Africa’s explosive batting with a spectacular 174 as they defeated Bangladesh by 149 runs to strengthen their chances of reaching the semi-finals of the 50-over World Cup on Tuesday, October 24. De Kock hit the highest individual score of the ongoing tournament, and South Africa’s middle order dominated a struggling Bangladesh bowling attack to reach 382-5 at the Wankhede Stadium after electing to bat first. South Africa’s pace attack struck early, reducing Bangladesh to 58-5 before bowling them out for 233 in 46.4 overs, recording their fourth win in five matches. Mahmudullah was the standout for Bangladesh with a run-a-ball 111, but it wasn’t enough to avoid a heavy defeat. ‘Sometimes you try and rush it and things don’t go your way, but I still think it was a great day for us,’ said stand-in skipper Aiden Markram, as South Africa moved up to second place in the points table, just behind India. ‘Form is something you can't take for granted, and we won’t do that as players — we keep striving to deliver big performances every game.’ De Kock had announced he would retire from one-day internationals after this World Cup, and he looked determined to make his final ODI campaign memorable. South Africa lost Reeza Hendricks and Rassie van der Dussen in quick succession after Markram, leading the side with Temba Bavuma unwell, won the toss and chose to bat. De Kock and Markram steadied the innings with a 131-run partnership before De Kock and Heinrich Klaasen launched a fierce attack, putting on 142 runs from 87 balls. De Kock brought up his third century in five matches, overtaking India’s Virat Kohli as the top run-scorer in the tournament. A double century seemed possible, but he was dismissed after 140 balls, having hit seven sixes and 15 fours. His departure did not slow South Africa, as Klaasen and David Miller (34* off 15 balls) kept the run rate high, with Klaasen smashing 90 from 49 balls. Together, they hit a combined 12 sixes, and South Africa piled on 144 runs in the last 10 overs. Bangladesh started their chase quietly, but Marco Jansen made early inroads, removing Tanzid Hasan and Najmul Hossain Shanto in consecutive deliveries. Bangladesh slipped further when key players Shakib Al Hasan and Mushfiqur Rahim were dismissed, leaving them at 42-2 inside 12 overs. Despite Mahmudullah’s resistance, South Africa eventually bowled Bangladesh out to secure a comfortable victory. Mahmudullah hit four sixes and 11 fours in his determined innings, which only delayed Bangladesh’s fourth loss in five matches. ‘Quinton de Kock batted exceptionally well and Klaasen finished it off — we had no answers,’ Bangladesh captain Shakib said. ‘Conceding 144 runs in the last 10 overs was probably our most expensive period of bowling in the last 10-15 years.’

De Kock je postigao najviši pojedinačni rezultat na ovom turniru, a srednja linija Južne Afrike dominirala je nad oslabljenim napadom Bangladeša, postigavši ukupno 382-5 na stadionu Wankhede nakon što su izabrali da prvi batiraju. Južnoafrički brzi bacači su odmah načinili problem, smanjili Bangladeš na 58-5 i kasnije ih izbacili za ukupno 233 u 46.4 overa, čime su upisali svoju četvrtu pobjedu u pet utakmica. Mahmudullah je bio najbolji u Bangladešu sa 111 osvojenih poena, ali to nije bilo dovoljno da spriječi uvjerljiv poraz. „Ponekad pokušate ubrzati, pa stvari ne idu po planu, ali mislim da je ovo bio sjajan dan za nas,“ rekao je privremeni kapiten Aiden Markram, nakon što je Južna Afrika zauzela drugo mjesto na tabeli, odmah iza Indije. „Forma nije nešto što se može uzeti zdravo za gotovo i mi to svakako nećemo činiti — stalno nastojimo pružiti velike partije u svakoj utakmici.“ De Kock je najavio povlačenje iz jednodevnih međunarodnih mečeva nakon ovog Svjetskog prvenstva i očigledno želi da posljednji nastup učini nezaboravnim. Južna Afrika je izgubila Reezu Hendricksa i Rassieja van der Dussena u brzom nizu nakon što je Markram, umjesto bolesnog Tembe Bavume, dobio bacanje i odlučio da batiraju prvi. De Kock i Markram stabilizovali su igru sa 131 poenom zajedno, prije nego što su De Kock i Heinrich Klaasen silovito napali, dodavši 142 poena iz 87 lopti. De Kock je postigao svoj treći stotinu u pet mečeva, preuzevši prvo mjesto na listi strijelaca od indijskog Virata Kohlija. Izgledalo je kao da može stići do 200, ali je uhvaćen nakon 140 lopti, uz sedam šestica i 15 četvorki. Njegov izlazak nije usporio Južnu Afriku, jer su Klaasen i David Miller (34* iz 15 lopti) održali visoku dinamiku; Klaasen je udario 90 iz 49 lopti. Zajedno su udarili ukupno 12 šestica, a Južna Afrika je postigla 144 poena u posljednjih 10 overa. Bangladeš je počeo tiho u svojim prvim overima, ali je Marco Jansen donio prednost, izbacivši Tanzida Hasana i Najmula Hossaina Shanta iz dvije uzastopne lopte. Bangladeš je još više oslabio kad su ključni igrači Shakib Al Hasan i Mushfiqur Rahim izbačeni, ostavljajući tim na 42-2 unutar 12 overa. Uprkos Mahmudullahovom otporu, Južna Afrika je na kraju izbacila Bangladeš i upisala uvjerljivu pobjedu. Mahmudullah je u izuzetnoj partiji upisao četiri šestice i 11 četvorki, ali je to samo odgodilo četvrti poraz Bangladeša u pet mečeva. „Quinton de Kock je odigrao odlično, a Klaasen je završio posao — nismo imali rješenja,“ poručio je kapiten Bangladeša Shakib. „Primiti 144 poena u posljednjih 10 overa vjerovatno je najskuplji period u našoj igri posljednjih 10-15 godina.“

article_content: Elon Musk has stated he has not encountered any signs of extraterrestrial life during his ventures into space. Speaking at the 74th International Astronautical Congress, where he received the World Space Award, the SpaceX CEO reflected on his views regarding aliens. During the event, Musk addressed questions about extraterrestrial life with his characteristic humor. 'People often ask me if I’ve seen any evidence of aliens—and I unfortunately have seen no evidence of aliens yet,' he said, adding jokingly, 'We are the aliens.' The discussion also focused on the SpaceX Starship mega-rocket, which Musk described as making the Falcon 1 seem like 'a child's toy.' However, Musk reiterated his belief that humanity might be alone in the vast universe, stating, 'My observations suggest that humanity is all that exists in a vast darkness.' Musk once addressed the topic of aliens in a conversation with Twitter employees in June 2022, prior to acquiring the company, where he similarly expressed skepticism about the existence of concrete evidence for alien life. Despite this, Musk has often joked about the possibility of life beyond Earth, and even playfully suggested he could be 'an alien walking among us.' He noted that if aliens were to visit Earth, he’d likely be among the first to know. Additionally, Musk mentioned that his new artificial intelligence company, xAI, could assist humanity in addressing challenges related to contacting alien life if it exists.

article_content: Ashley Locker, 21, from Scarborough, North Yorkshire, survived a serious car accident early last Thursday when his silver MG ZR struck a tree and was heavily damaged. Despite the severity of the crash, Ashley’s injuries included a broken right arm (which required plates and screws), a foot wound needing 11 stitches, and some cuts and bruises. Rescuers suggested that his height and build (6 feet 3 inches, roughly 18 stone) may have contributed to his survival during the crash. The accident took place just after 7:15 am on Cross Lane, close to Ashley’s home. The force of the impact broke his seat, sending him—still belted in—into the back seat area. Although there were initial fears of more serious injuries, including possible spinal damage, doctors ultimately confirmed only his broken arm and minor wounds. Ashley’s mother, Gill, expressed deep relief and gratitude to emergency responders, noting how quickly firefighters freed him and how the air ambulance was ready in case his injuries were critical. The family was shocked when they saw photos of the wreck, but feel very fortunate that Ashley was not more badly hurt. After being released from hospital on Friday night, Ashley has been recovering at home with support from his family. On Facebook, Ashley called himself 'one of the luckiest people alive' and thanked everyone for their messages. He currently works for McCain Foods in Scarborough and has about two years of driving experience.
