Iako je sudar bio ozbiljan, Ashley je prošao s polomljenom desnom rukom (koja je fiksirana pločicama i vijcima), ranom na stopalu koja je zahtijevala 11 šavova, te nekoliko posjekotina i modrica. Spasioci su naglasili da su njegova visina i građa (6 stopa 3 inča, oko 114 kg) možda doprinijeli njegovom preživljavanju. Nesreća se desila nešto poslije 7:15 ujutro u ulici Cross Lane, nedaleko od Ashleyeve kuće. Snaga udara je slomila njegovo sjedište i, iako je nosio pojas, bacila ga je u zadnji dio automobila. Iako su se u početku pribojavali ozbiljnih povreda, uključujući oštećenje kičme, ljekari su na kraju utvrdili samo slomljenu ruku i manje povrede. Ashleyeva majka Gill izrazila je veliko olakšanje i zahvalnost hitnim službama, pohvalivši brzinu kojom su vatrogasci izvukli njenog sina i to što je helikopterska hitna pomoć bila spremna ako budu potrebni. Porodica je bila šokirana slikama uništenog auta, ali su veoma zahvalni što je Ashley prošao s lakšim povredama. Nakon što je u petak navečer otpušten iz bolnice, Ashley se oporavlja kod kuće uz podršku porodice. Na Facebooku je napisao da je 'jedan od najsretnijih ljudi na svijetu' i zahvalio se svima na porukama. Radi u McCain Foods u Scarboroughu i ima oko dvije godine vozačkog iskustva.

article_content: A young soldier, Matthew Cottrell, aged 24, was tragically killed after being struck by a coach on a dark, unlit road near Poole, Dorset. Cottrell, who was just two weeks away from marrying his fiancée, Debbie Smith, had been returning to his army barracks after a night out with colleagues. Lacking enough money to pay the taxi fare, he was dropped off by driver Jovan Josic when the fare matched the cash Cottrell had. He began walking alone along the A35. Wearing dark clothing and using his phone as a torch, Cottrell was walking along the side of the road when he was hit from behind by a 14-ton single-decker coach traveling around 50mph. The coach driver, Kenneth Baker, said he only saw Cottrell at the moment of impact as he tried to avoid an oncoming lorry. Cottrell’s friends, traveling in another taxi, came across the accident shortly after and tried to resuscitate him, but he was pronounced dead at the scene. A post-mortem revealed that Cottrell was three and a half times over the legal drink-drive limit. During the inquest, it emerged that the army had an informal policy to reimburse taxi drivers transporting soldiers who lacked the fare, but local taxi companies were unaware. The coroner, Sheriff Payne, ruled the death accidental and voiced concerns about the road's danger to pedestrians and the communication gap regarding the army's policy. After the hearing, Debbie Smith said she hoped taxi drivers would, in the future, choose safer drop-off locations. Cottrell’s mother was seen hugging coach driver Kenneth Baker, whom investigators found not at fault. The case drew attention to communication gaps and the need to improve safety measures for service personnel.

Cottrell, koji je bio samo dvije sedmice udaljen od vjenčanja sa svojom zaručnicom Debbie Smith, vraćao se u vojnu kasarnu nakon izlaska s kolegama. Budući da nije imao dovoljno novca za taksi, vozač Jovan Josic ga je ostavio kad je iznos na taksimetru dostigao Cottrellov iznos. Počeo je sam hodati duž A35. Obučen u tamnu odjeću i koristeći mobitel kao lampu, Cottrell je hodao uz cestu kada ga je s leđa udario 14-tonski jednokatni autobus koji se kretao oko 80 km/h. Vozač autobusa, Kenneth Baker, rekao je da je Cottrella primijetio tek u trenutku sudara dok je pokušavao izbjeći nadolazeći kamion. Cottrellovi prijatelji, koji su išli drugim taksijem, naišli su na mjesto nesreće ubrzo poslije i pokušali ga reanimirati, ali je proglašen mrtvim na mjestu događaja. Tokom istrage, otkriveno je da vojska ima neformalnu politiku nadoknade taksi vozačima koji prevezu vojnike koji nemaju novac, ali lokalne taksi kompanije za to nisu znale. Sudija, Sheriff Payne, zaključio je da je smrt bila nesretan slučaj i izrazio zabrinutost zbog opasnosti ceste za pješake i nedostatka komunikacije oko vojne politike. article_content: Tom Cruise might have made a great rock star, as his energetic performances in films like 'Risky Business,' 'The Color of Money,' 'Tropic Thunder,' and 'Magnolia' show. Despite these musical moments, Cruise has generally avoided starring in a full musical, possibly to maintain his action-hero image. That changes with 'Rock of Ages,' a film that pays tribute to 1980s hair metal. In 'Rock of Ages,' Cruise plays Stacee Jaxx, a flamboyant rock icon inspired by figures like Axl Rose and Steven Tyler. While Stacee is a supporting character in the stage musical, Cruise becomes the highlight of the film. He portrays Jaxx's eccentric, celebrity-fueled lifestyle with charisma, owning every scene he's in. The film also stars Julianne Hough as Sherrie Christian, a small-town girl who arrives in Hollywood to pursue her dream of singing. Instead, she ends up working at the legendary Bourbon Room and starts a romance with her co-worker Drew, played by Diego Boneta. Drew also dreams of stardom, but his story takes a back seat to the film's main spectacle. Notable cast members include Alec Baldwin, Russell Brand, Malin Akerman, and Catherine Zeta-Jones as Patricia Whitmore, the mayor's wife determined to shut down the Bourbon Room. Director Adam Shankman, known for his work on 'Hairspray' and 'Glee,' encourages the cast to embrace the film's exaggerated style. The result is a self-aware, comedic musical where characters frequently break into classic FM rock anthems. Catherine Zeta-Jones also stands out in her campy performance. Though the film often leans into parody, it delivers plenty of fun if viewers go along for the ride. While Cruise's absence is noticeable, his performance brings energy to the screen whenever he appears. 'Rock of Ages' is a playful and entertaining take on the '80s rock scene, blending celebration and satire.

article_content: A British businessman who lost his nose to cancer is having a new one grown in his arm, thanks to pioneering work by experts at University College London (UCL). Led by Professor Alex Seifalian, the team hopes to transplant the new nose onto the man’s face so he can regain both the look and function of his original nose—including the sense of feeling and smell. This new nose, the first in the world to be grown entirely from scratch, will replicate the slightly crooked shape of his original. Professor Seifalian said the patient insisted on keeping the original shape: 'His nose was slightly bent to the left and we asked if he wanted it straight, but he wanted it exactly the same.' The process began with a glass mould of the original nose, coated with a synthetic, honeycomb-like material, creating a scaffold for millions of stem cells. These cells, provided with nutrients in a bioreactor at UCL, developed into cartilage. Meanwhile, the skin on the man's arm was stretched with an inflated balloon to make space for the nose scaffold. About two months ago, the nose framework replaced the balloon under the stretched skin. Now, the new nose is developing inside his arm, forming nerves, blood vessels, and being covered by his own skin. Professor Seifalian remarked, 'We can make the nose but we can't make the skin.' After at least three months, surgeons will remove the new nose and attach it to the man’s face in an operation that should not leave scars. The skin of his arm will be stitched together and should return to normal. The patient, who wishes to remain anonymous, lost his original nose to skin cancer, and further treatment caused additional damage, leaving him nearly housebound. If successful, this technique may help others—from accident victims to wounded soldiers. Earlier attempts in the US, such as growing ears on mice in the 1990s, were unsuccessful, but medical science has advanced greatly since then. Professor Seifalian aims to eventually grow a complete face in the lab for transplantation. He told BBC Focus magazine, 'We have got all our fingers crossed until they are breaking.' The innovative treatment could provide new hope for people needing facial reconstruction.
translated_content: Britanski biznismen koji je izgubio nos zbog raka sada uzgaja novi nos u svojoj ruci, zahvaljujući pionirskom radu stručnjaka sa University College London (UCL). Tim na čelu s profesorom Aleksom Seifalianom nada se da će mu novi nos biti presađen na lice kako bi povratio izgled i funkcije originalnog nosa – uključujući osjećaj dodira i mirisa. Ovaj novi nos, prvi u svijetu koji je potpuno uzgojen od nule, replicirat će blago iskrivljen oblik njegovog prijašnjeg nosa. Profesor Seifalian je rekao da je pacijent insistirao da novi nos bude istog oblika: 'Njegov nos je bio malo savijen ulijevo i pitali smo ga želi li ravan, ali je htio baš isti.' Proces je započeo izradom staklenog kalupa originalnog nosa, koji je premazan sintetičkim materijalom nalik saću, stvarajući okvir za milione matičnih ćelija. Te ćelije su, uz potrebne hranjive materije u bioreaktoru na UCL-u, razvile hrskavicu. U međuvremenu je koža na njegovoj ruci proširena pomoću malog balona kako bi se napravio prostor za novi nos. Prije otprilike dva mjeseca, okvir za nos zamijenio je balon ispod rastegnute kože. Novi nos sada se razvija unutar njegove ruke, stvara živce, krvne žile i prekriven je njegovom kožom. Profesor Seifalian je primijetio: 'Možemo napraviti nos, ali ne možemo napraviti kožu.' Nakon najmanje tri mjeseca, hirurzi će ukloniti novi nos i pričvrstiti ga na lice operacijom koja ne bi trebala ostaviti ožiljke. Koža na njegovoj ruci će biti ušivena i trebala bi se vratiti u normalu. Pacijent, koji želi ostati anoniman, izgubio je nos zbog raka kože, a dodatne terapije prouzrokovale su još štete, što ga je gotovo potpuno povuklo iz društva. Ako zahvat uspije, ova tehnika bi mogla pomoći i drugima – od žrtava nesreća do ranjenih vojnika. Prijašnji pokušaji u SAD-u, poput uzgoja ušiju na miševima tokom 90-ih, nisu uspjeli, ali je medicina od tada znatno napredovala. Profesor Seifalian želi jednog dana uzgojiti čitavo lice u laboratoriju za transplantaciju. Za BBC Focus magazin rekao je: 'Držimo fige dok ne puknu.' Ovaj inovativni zahvat mogao bi donijeti novu nadu svima kojima treba rekonstrukcija lica.

article_content: Prince Andrew’s efforts to save the Duke of Wellington’s battalion from defence cuts received a boost last night after reports that the Army chief behind the plans intends to discuss the issue with him. Well-placed sources said Major General Graham Binns, the Regimental Colonel of the Yorkshire Regiment, may reconsider the decision to sever the Army’s link with the victor of the Battle of Waterloo. The Duke of Wellington’s battalion, formally known as the 3rd Battalion, Yorkshire Regiment and comprising 600 soldiers, is expected to be one of the most high-profile units affected by Army cuts to be announced this week. The regiment is set to be reduced to two battalions. Prince Andrew, who is Colonel-in-Chief of the Duke of Wellington’s battalion, which is currently serving in Afghanistan, strongly supports efforts to preserve the historic name. Last week, Prince Andrew expressed his passionate care for the battalion’s soldiers, raising hopes that the decision may be reconsidered. He also recently dined with Yorkshire Regiment officers. Many former officers were surprised when Maj Gen Binns announced two months ago that the Wellington’s name would disappear with the reduction from three to two battalions. After pushback, he is now reportedly considering options to retain the historic name. Proposals include naming the two remaining Yorkshire Regiment battalions after the Duke of York and the Duke of Wellington, or naming a company after the Duke of Wellington. A spokeswoman for Prince Andrew said he had not met Maj Gen Binns last week, but would not comment on whether they had spoken. The Army’s cuts, which will shrink its fighting strength to 82,000—the lowest since the Napoleonic Wars—could see several other famous units lose their names, including the Argyll and Sutherland Highlanders (whose Royal Colonel is the Queen), the Royal Scots Dragoon Guards, 3rd Battalion Mercian Regiment, and 2nd Battalion Royal Regiment of Fusiliers. Defence Secretary Philip Hammond is expected to argue that the reductions focus on regiments with the most foreign-born soldiers, especially those with a high proportion of Commonwealth recruits. However, critics say this seems inconsistent with his decision to exempt the Gurkhas, a regiment previously supported by actress Joanna Lumley. One source claimed: 'The Scots, Welsh, and Gurkhas have avoided the brunt of these cuts for political reasons, so English regiments face a harsh reality.' A Ministry of Defence spokesperson stated, 'The traditions and heritage of the regimental system are hugely respected. The Defence Secretary has made it clear that the regimental system remains fundamental to the British Army’s fighting power. This will not change.'

article_content: Queens Park Rangers (QPR) secured a dramatic promotion to the Premier League by defeating Derby County 1-0 in the Championship play-off final at Wembley. Derby had dominated most of the match, but it was veteran striker Bobby Zamora—often underestimated due to past injuries—who scored a decisive goal in the 90th minute, sparking ecstatic celebrations among QPR supporters. Even after losing Gary O'Neil to a red card with half an hour remaining, QPR’s defense held strong. Goalkeeper Robert Green, along with a resilient backline, managed to absorb heavy pressure from Derby's attackers throughout the game. The financial stakes were exceptionally high for QPR, as promotion was estimated to bring in around £134 million—a vital sum for a club with reported financial losses. The triumph brought immense relief to manager Harry Redknapp and chairman Tony Fernandes, who had both faced significant criticism in recent seasons. For Derby County, the defeat was a bitter disappointment. Despite finishing five points ahead of QPR during the regular season and controlling much of the play-off final, a late misstep meant they missed out on promotion. Manager Steve McClaren expressed pride in his squad's performance and looked to the future with hope. A crowd of 87,348 witnessed the tension-filled spectacle, as QPR's experienced squad managed to prevail in the face of adversity. While Derby displayed greater energy and dominated for long stretches, QPR’s seasoned players capitalized on their sole chance to change the club’s fate. For Zamora—whose contract with QPR was expiring—the goal marked a defining moment, ensuring his place in club history by scoring what many described as the goal that safeguarded both QPR’s football future and finances.

In February, Mark Bova purchased a used 2018 Tesla Model S. Before leaving the dealership, he bought insurance directly from Tesla, finding the $93 monthly premium very reasonable. Just sixteen days later, while driving home along the Capital Beltway in Maryland and using Autopilot—Tesla’s automated driving system—the car began beeping, abruptly veered left, hit a median, and flipped over. Bova escaped through a window as the car filled with smoke and was taken to the hospital with back injuries that later required surgery. “I’m a former Green Beret,” Bova said, referring to his U.S. Army Special Forces service. “That was probably the second-most traumatic thing I’ve gone through other than being in combat.”

His challenges didn’t end there. Launched in 2019, Tesla Insurance promised “vastly better” service for policyholders, according to CEO Elon Musk, who once pledged “same-day” collision repairs. Yet Bova reports he has struggled with Tesla Insurance since his accident, waiting seven months for payment on his totaled vehicle and still seeking reimbursement for about $50,000 in medical expenses. Because Autopilot was involved, Bova was told his case required attention from Tesla’s product liability department. He endured hours on hold, repeated disconnections, and was promised a callback—four months later, he’s still waiting. Tesla and Musk did not respond to Reuters’ detailed questions for this story.

Bova is not alone. Numerous complaints on social media, the Better Business Bureau, and interviews with multiple policyholders reveal similar frustrations, although some customers do praise Tesla Insurance’s low rates. Many, however, complain of long waits for payouts and repairs and difficulty reaching claims adjusters. Tesla officials have said they started the insurance to address high insurance quotes for their vehicles, which are expensive to repair. Despite vows to revolutionize auto insurance, Tesla at times operated the insurer with just a handful of adjusters handling hundreds of claims, overwhelming the staff according to several knowledgeable sources.

Such operational issues appear in line with broader concerns about rushed management practices at Musk’s companies. Musk’s stewardship of other firms, including Twitter (now X), SpaceX, and Neuralink, has drawn criticism over staff cuts, content controversies, workplace safety, and animal welfare. At Tesla, issues have included employees sharing sensitive recordings from car cameras and controversy over claims about driving range, resulting in investigations and lawsuits.

Tesla Insurance faces growing scrutiny from regulators and attorneys. The Ohio Department of Insurance found Tesla violated regulations on timely communication with policyholders and considered formal investigations. While complaints are not uncommon in the auto insurance industry, exact numbers against Tesla Insurance are unclear; some states keep such data confidential.

Customers describe their experiences as frustrating and slow. Phil Fioresi Sr. in California said it took around 15 calls to reach someone after his daughter’s Tesla was struck by another Tesla policyholder. Tesla Insurance has not disclosed the number of adjusters, but sources say those hired in California in late 2021 were quickly overwhelmed. With over 50,000 vehicles insured in California at that time, adjusters handled far more cases than at traditional insurers, often taking on hundreds each. Unlike competitors, Tesla’s adjusters had to both answer phones and process claims. Even with recent expansion and hiring in other states, reports of service delays persist.

Musk has claimed a “vastly better” customer experience for Tesla insurance users, promising quick, hassle-free repairs, but many customers find these promises unmet.

Tesla began offering insurance following complaints about high premiums for its cars, driven by repair costs. In 2017, AAA raised Tesla rates by up to 30%, citing higher-than-average claim frequencies—a finding Tesla disputed. Tesla first launched InsureMyTesla with Liberty Mutual, but high rates persisted, and the product was eventually withdrawn from the U.S. Tesla Insurance debuted in California in 2019 through State National Insurance Company, which has had the worst consumer complaint record among California’s top 50 auto insurers according to the state. Musk repeatedly touted the insurance as “revolutionary” and predicted it could one day represent a significant share of Tesla’s business.

Tesla Insurance now operates in several states and is applying to expand further. In many areas, monthly premiums are linked to a “Safety Score” calculated using vehicle sensors and driving behavior. Two class-action lawsuits allege that inaccurate warnings and sensor errors unfairly lower scores and raise premiums—Tesla has denied the allegations.

Other policyholders recount struggles obtaining proof of insurance, reporting technical glitches with the Tesla app, and long hold times. Some have had to cancel and reissue policies to resolve technical problems.

Tesla has moved to in-house claims adjusting, hiring staff in Utah in late 2021, but adjusters soon faced surging caseloads from multiple states. Customers were encouraged to use the app to report claims, but frequent glitches forced many to call instead, leading to long delays.

Several policyholders shared stories of waiting months for repairs or payment. Jonathan Garcia, an Ohio physician, submitted a claim after a deer collision and had to call almost daily for three months before receiving a response from Tesla Insurance. The Ohio Department of Insurance found Tesla did not meet timely communication requirements. It took about six months to repair Garcia’s car; he later switched insurers at a higher cost, saying he would pay substantially more to avoid Tesla Insurance again.

Scott Sawyer in California switched to Tesla Insurance for convenience but experienced long delays after accidents. At one point, he and his wife drove their car for months while waiting for parts, then had to involve a lawyer to resolve a subsequent claim. Sawyer said he ultimately received an offer to settle but said he would not continue with Tesla Insurance.

The experiences of these customers highlight a recurring gap between Tesla Insurance’s bold marketing claims and policyholders’ realities.

U februaru je Mark Bova kupio polovni Tesla Model S iz 2018. godine. Prije nego što je napustio salon, uzeo je osiguranje direktno od Tesle, smatrajući mjesečnu premiju od 93 dolara vrlo povoljnom. Samo šesnaest dana kasnije, dok se vozio kući po autoputu Capital Beltway u Marylandu i koristio Autopilot — Teslin automatizovani sistem vožnje — auto je počeo da pišti, naglo skrenulo ulijevo, udarilo u srednji pojas i prevrnulo se. Bova je pobjegao kroz prozor dok se vozilo punilo dimom te je prevezen u bolnicu s povredama leđa zbog kojih je kasnije morao na operaciju. "Ja sam bivši zeleni beretka," rekao je Bova, pozivajući se na službu u američkim specijalnim snagama. "Ovo je vjerovatno druga najtraumatičnija stvar koju sam doživio, osim borbe."

Njegovi problemi tu nisu stali. Tesla Insurance, pokrenut 2019. godine, obećavao je "mnogo bolju" uslugu za osiguranike, prema riječima direktora Elona Muska, koji je čak obećao i popravke istog dana. Ipak, Bova kaže da se bori s Teslinim osiguranjem otkako je doživio nesreću — čekao je sedam mjeseci na isplatu za totalno uništeno vozilo i još uvijek nije dobio nadoknadu za oko 50.000 dolara medicinskih troškova. Pošto je Autopilot bio uključen, rečeno mu je da se njegova prijava mora prebaciti u Teslin odjel za odgovornost proizvoda. Sate je provodio na čekanju, bio prekidan i obećan mu je povratni poziv — četiri mjeseca kasnije još uvijek čeka. Tesla i Musk nisu komentarisali upite Reutersa za ovaj izvještaj.

Bova nije izuzetak. Brojne žalbe na društvenim mrežama, BBB web stranici i kroz intervjue sa više osiguranika pokazuju slična razočarenja, mada neki hvale niske cijene Tesla osiguranja. Mnogi se žale na duga čekanja na isplate i popravke te teškoću da stupe u kontakt s procjeniteljima šteta. Tesla je navela da je pokrenula osiguranje kako bi riješila problem visokih premija zbog skupih popravki. Unatoč obećanjima o revoluciji na tržištu auto-osiguranja, Tesla je često radila sa samo nekoliko procjenitelja za stotine prijava, što je dovelo do zagušenja, navode upućeni.

Takvi problemi uklapaju se u šire kritike na račun Muskove uprave i drugih njegovih kompanija. Upravljanje Twitterom (sada X), SpaceX-om i Neuralinkom izazvalo je polemike zbog otkaza, sadržaja, sigurnosti rada i dobrobiti životinja. U Tesli su radnici dijelili osjetljive video zapise s kamera automobila, a osporavane su i tvrdnje o dometu vozila, što je dovelo do istraga i tužbi.

Tesla Insurance je pod sve većom pažnjom regulatora i advokata. Odeljenje za osiguranje države Ohio potvrdilo je da je Tesla prekršila propise o pravovremenoj komunikaciji i razmatrala je formalne istrage. Iako pritužbe nisu rijetkost u branši auto-osiguranja, nije jasno koliko ih je tačno upućeno protiv Tesle jer su podaci u pojedinim državama povjerljivi.

Korisnici opisuju iskustva kao frustrirajuća i spora. Phil Fioresi Sr. iz Kalifornije kaže da mu je trebalo oko 15 poziva da dobije nekoga nakon što je njegova kćerka imala udes sa drugim Teslinim osiguranikom. Tesla Insurance ne objavljuje broj procjenitelja, ali izvori tvrde da su oni zaposleni u Kaliforniji krajem 2021. brzo bili preplavljeni prijavama. Sa više od 50.000 osiguranih vozila u toj saveznoj državi, procjenitelji su obrađivali mnogo više slučajeva nego u tradicionalnim osiguranjima, nekad i nekoliko stotina. Za razliku od konkurencije, Teslini procjenitelji morali su istovremeno odgovarati na pozive i rješavati štete. I uz širenje i nova zapošljavanja u drugim državama, žalbe na kašnjenja i dalje se pojavljuju.

Musk je tvrdio da korisnici Tesla osiguranja imaju "daleko bolje" iskustvo, obećavši brze, bezbolne popravke, ali mnogi korisnici smatraju da ta obećanja nisu ispunjena.

Tesla je ponudila osiguranje kao odgovor na žalbe zbog visokih premija uslovljenih skupim popravkama. Godine 2017. AAA je povećala premije za Teslu do 30%, navodeći veće frekvencije šteta — nešto što je Tesla osporavala. Prvi pokušaj sa InsureMyTesla i Liberty Mutual nije riješio problem skupih premija i povučen je iz SAD. Tesla Insurance predstavljena je u Kaliforniji 2019. u partnerstvu sa State National Insurance Company, koji ima najgore ocjene korisnika među 50 najvećih auto-osiguranja, prema državnim podacima. Musk je više puta najavljivao osiguranje kao "revolucionarno" i prognozirao da bi jednog dana mogao predstavljati značajan dio Teslinog poslovanja.

Tesla Insurance danas posluje u više država i planira dalje širenje. U mnogim regijama mjesečne premije su povezane sa "Safety Score" rezultatima izračunatim putem senzora i vozačkih navika. Dvije kolektivne tužbe tvrde da netačna upozorenja i greške senzora nepravedno snižavaju rezultate i povisuju premije — Tesla osporava te tvrdnje.

Druge osiguranike muči problem dobijanja potvrde o osiguranju zbog tehničkih problema s Tesla aplikacijom i dugih čekanja. Neki su morali otkazati pa ponovo otvoriti polise zbog softverskih grešaka.

Tesla je krajem 2021. počela zapošljavati procjenitelje u Utahu, ali su ubrzo bili preopterećeni mnoštvom prijava iz različitih država. Osiguranicima je savjetovano da koriste aplikaciju za prijavu štete, ali greške su ih često tjerale da zovu telefonom, uz duga čekanja.

Neki korisnici su čekali mjesecima na popravke ili isplatu. Jonathan Garcia, ljekar iz Ohaja, podnio je zahtjev nakon što mu je jelen oštetio auto i morao je gotovo svakodnevno zvati tri mjeseca prije nego što je dobio odgovor. Odeljenje za osiguranje Ohaja utvrdilo je da Tesla nije pravovremeno komunicirala. Popravka je trajala oko šest mjeseci; kasnije je prešao kod drugog osiguratelja po višoj cijeni, rekavši da bi platio i više samo da izbjegne Tesla osiguranje.

Scott Sawyer iz Kalifornije prešao je na Tesla Insurance zbog praktičnosti, ali doživio je dugotrajna kašnjenja nakon nesreća. U jednom trenutku, on i supruga su mjesecima vozili auto s oštećenjima čekajući dijelove, a morali su angažovati advokata da riješe štetu. Sawyer je na kraju dobio ponudu za isplatu štete, ali više ne namjerava koristiti Tesla Insurance.

Iskustva ovih korisnika pokazuju jaz između smjelih marketinških obećanja Tesla osiguranja i stvarnosti njihovih korisnika.

article_content: Motorola continues its tradition of affordable smartphones with the Razr (2023), launching it as the most budget-friendly new foldable phone in the U.S. at $699, initially offered at $599. While there are some compromises compared to the premium Razr Plus, the Razr (2023) offers distinct features like a vegan leather finish and a brushed metal frame, available in colors such as Sage Green, Vanilla Cream, Summer Lilac, and Cherry Blossom. Its 6.9-inch OLED main display boasts a 144Hz refresh rate and reaches up to 1400 nits of brightness, with a crease that's minimal and comparable to that of more expensive models. The sturdy hinge design, also seen on the Plus model, allows the phone to stay open at various angles. Powered by the Snapdragon 7 Gen 1 processor with 8GB of RAM and 128GB of storage (no expansion options), the Razr (2023) handles daily tasks and gaming smoothly. Motorola's MyUX interface adds useful gestures and features, including Moto Unplugged for digital wellness and Ready For for desktop-like capabilities. Battery performance stands out with its 4200mAh capacity, aided by 30W wired and 5W wireless charging for near all-day use. The modest 1.5-inch cover display offers quick access to notifications, essentials like weather, media, and shortcuts, and lets users preview selfies. However, its functionality is limited due to its small size. The main camera provides higher resolution than the Razr Plus but delivers inconsistent image quality. While photos can be good, camera performance is generally less reliable than premium competitors. Storage options are limited to a single 128GB model in the U.S., with no option for expansion. Rival devices include the Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 5—more powerful but costlier, with a larger cover display and shorter battery life—as well as the OPPO Find N3 Flip and TECNO Phantom V Flip, which have different strengths but may not be widely available stateside. Motorola promises three operating system updates and four years of security patches, an improvement over past practices but still trailing leading brands. Overall, the Razr (2023) is ideal for those interested in trying foldable phones at an accessible price, accepting trade-offs in camera quality, cover screen utility, and high-end features.

Iako ima određene kompromise u odnosu na skuplji Razr Plus, Razr (2023) donosi poseban dizajn sa veganskom kožom i matiranim metalnim okvirom, dostupan u bojama Sage Green, Vanilla Cream, Summer Lilac i Cherry Blossom. Glavni OLED ekran od 6,9 inča ima brzinu osvježavanja od 144Hz i jačinu svjetla do 1400 nita, a nabor na ekranu je minimalan i sličan skupljim modelima. Razr (2023) glatko obavlja svakodnevne zadatke i igrice, zahvaljujući i laganom MyUX interfejsu koji uključuje korisne gestove i funkcije poput Moto Unplugged za digitalni odmor i Ready For za desktop iskustvo. Baterija od 4200mAh je izuzetna, uz podršku za brzo punjenje od 30W žično i 5W bežično, što omogućava korištenje kroz cijeli dan. Mali vanjski ekran od 1,5 inča služi za brzi pregled notifikacija, osnovnih informacija, muzike i prečica, kao i za pregled selfija. Međutim, funkcionalnost mu je ograničena veličinom. article_content: John Oliver, host of 'Last Week Tonight,' made it clear that the recent Hollywood writers' strike was no vacation for those involved. Appearing on 'Late Night with Seth Meyers' on Monday, Oliver addressed the common misconception that time off during the strike was enjoyable. He explained that many people assumed the strike was like a holiday and would often share that sentiment with him. Although Oliver usually ignored these remarks, he described a memorable encounter with a fan in an elevator. When the fan said, 'At least you're getting a nice vacation, that must be nice,' Oliver followed the fan out and asserted, 'You're absolutely wrong about that.' The writers' strike ended on September 27 after the Writers Guild of America (WGA) reached an agreement with the Alliance of Motion Picture and Television Producers. The deal secured better pay, AI protections, and minimum staffing requirements. The nearly 150-day strike was the WGA's second-longest, surpassed only by the 1988 strike. Todd Holmes, an entertainment industry professor at California State University, Northridge, estimated the strike cost California's economy about $3 billion in its first 100 days. During the strike, Oliver, Meyers, and other late night hosts, including Stephen Colbert, Jimmy Fallon, and Jimmy Kimmel, created a limited-series podcast called 'Strike Force Five,' with proceeds going to support their out-of-work staff. Oliver's representatives did not immediately respond to Insider's request for comment, which was sent outside normal business hours.
translated_content: John Oliver, voditelj emisije 'Last Week Tonight', jasno je izjavio da nedavni štrajk holivudskih scenarista nikako nije bio odmor za one koji su u njemu sudjelovali. Gostujući u emisiji 'Late Night with Seth Meyers' u ponedjeljak, Oliver se osvrnuo na čestu zabludu da je vrijeme provedeno u štrajku bilo ugodno. Objasnio je kako mnogi ljudi pretpostavljaju da je štrajk poput odmora i često mu to govore. Iako je Oliver obično ignorisao takve komentare, opisao je nezaboravan susret s obožavateljem u liftu. Kada je obožavatelj rekao: 'Barem imaš lijep odmor, to sigurno prija,' Oliver ga je ispratio iz lifta i odlučno odgovorio: 'Apsolutno niste u pravu oko toga.' Štrajk scenarista završen je 27. septembra, nakon što je Udruženje američkih scenarista (WGA) postiglo dogovor s Alijansom filmskih i televizijskih producenata. Dogovor je osigurao bolja primanja, zaštitu od umjetne inteligencije i minimalan broj osoblja. Štrajk, koji je trajao skoro 150 dana, bio je drugi najduži u povijesti WGA, odmah iza štrajka iz 1988. godine. Todd Holmes, profesor industrije zabave na California State University, Northridge, procijenio je da je štrajk u prvih 100 dana koštao kalifornijsku ekonomiju oko 3 milijarde dolara. Tokom štrajka, Oliver, Meyers i drugi voditelji kasnovečernjih emisija, uključujući Stephena Colberta, Jimmyja Fallona i Jimmyja Kimmela, pokrenuli su ograničeni podcast pod nazivom 'Strike Force Five', a prihodi su išli za podršku njihovim zaposlenicima koji su ostali bez posla. Oliverovi predstavnici nisu odmah odgovorili na Insiderov zahtjev za komentar, koji je poslan izvan redovnog radnog vremena.

article_content: After England’s Under-21 team clinched a 4-2 aggregate win over Croatia to qualify for the 2015 European Championship in the Czech Republic, manager Gareth Southgate commended his players for their bravery in keeping possession, even under pressure. Southgate was especially pleased with how the squad continued to press and pass confidently during their 2-1 victory in the second leg in Vinkovci. With the tie level at 1-1 by halftime, England’s persistence with their passing proved crucial. A key goal from Leicester City’s centre back Liam Moore put England in front, helping secure their place in next summer’s tournament. Southgate lightheartedly referred to his own time as a player, joking that past England teams sometimes struggled to retain the ball because of him. In his post-match talk, Southgate praised his players for being receptive to new ideas and encouraged them to challenge old stereotypes about English football. He remarked, 'People say we can’t play that way, but you’ve just shown we can.' He highlighted the squad’s determination through two difficult matches and praised their readiness for upcoming challenges. Southgate finished by celebrating his team’s strong performance and their growing potential against stronger opponents at the tournament.

article_content:
Michelle Lynne Kosilek, a transgender woman incarcerated for the 1990 murder of her wife Cheryl, may receive state-funded electrolysis hair removal, pending expert evaluation of medical necessity. Kosilek, who was born Robert Kosilek, has already received hormone therapy, psychotherapy, and previous electrolysis treatments while serving a life sentence as a woman in an all-male Massachusetts prison.

A federal judge, Mark Wolf, recently ruled that Kosilek's Eighth Amendment rights were violated when the state prison department refused to pay for her sex reassignment surgery. The Department of Corrections has been instructed to seek an expert opinion on whether further electrolysis is medically necessary, with a deadline set for early November. The state is currently appealing Judge Wolf's decision.

The case has drawn significant public attention and controversy, with some officials and members of the public arguing that taxpayer funds should not be used for such medical procedures, especially for incarcerated persons convicted of serious crimes. Kosilek has experienced severe psychological distress due to gender dysphoria, including suicide attempts and self-harm, prompting courts to acknowledge her need for adequate medical treatment.

Research suggests that gender-affirming procedures, including surgery and electrolysis, are considered medically necessary by many professionals treating gender dysphoria. Estimates indicate hundreds of transgender Americans undergo such surgeries annually, though many institutions and insurance companies still consider them elective.

While federal law and previous court decisions require that state prisons provide medically necessary care to inmates, fewer cases have involved gender-affirming surgeries. Kosilek's legal battle has become a focal point in ongoing debates about prisoner rights and the responsibilities of state institutions. Her attorney praised the judge’s ruling as attentive and courageous.

Kosilek began transitioning from male to female after being indicted and legally changed her name. She continues to live as a woman in the male facility at MCI-Norfolk prison. This case remains significant in the ongoing discussion about medical care, rights, and responsibilities within the U.S. prison system.
translated_content:
Michelle Lynne Kosilek, transrodna žena koja izdržava kaznu zbog ubistva supruge Cheryl 1990. godine, možda će dobiti državno finansirano uklanjanje dlaka elektrolizom, ukoliko stručnjaci procijene da je medicinski potrebno. Kosilek, rođena kao Robert Kosilek, već je primila hormonsku terapiju, psihoterapiju i prethodne tretmane elektrolizom dok izdržava doživotnu kaznu kao žena u muškom zatvoru u Massachusettsu.

Savezni sudija Mark Wolf je nedavno odlučio da su Kosilekina prava po Osmoj amandmani prekršena kada je državni zatvorski odjel odbio platiti operaciju promjene spola. Odjel za popravne ustanove mora angažirati stručnjaka koji će procijeniti da li je dalja elektroliza medicinski neophodna, uz rok do početka novembra. Država se trenutno žali na tu odluku.

Slučaj je izazvao veliku pažnju i kontroverze u javnosti, jer neki zvaničnici i građani smatraju da porezni obveznici ne bi trebali snositi trošak ovakvih zahvata, posebno za zatvorenike osuđene za teška krivična djela. Kosilek je imala ozbiljne psihološke poteškoće zbog rodne disforije, uključujući pokušaje samoubistva i samopovređivanja, što je sud navelo da prizna njenu potrebu za adekvatnim medicinskim tretmanom.

Prema istraživanjima, stručnjaci procjenjuju da su zahvati afirmacije roda, uključujući operaciju i elektrolizu, medicinski potrebni kod osoba sa rodnom disforijom. Procjene pokazuju da stotine transrodnih Amerikanaca godišnje prolaze takve operacije, iako ih mnoge institucije i osiguravajuća društva i dalje smatraju izbornim.

Iako savezni zakon i sudske odluke zahtijevaju da zatvori pruže medicinski opravdanu njegu zatvorenicima, malo slučajeva uključuje operacije afirmacije roda. Kosilekina pravna borba postala je centralna tema u raspravama o pravima zatvorenika i odgovornostima države. Njena advokatica je sudsku odluku ocijenila hrabrom i pažljivom.

Kosilek je započela tranziciju nakon podizanja optužnice i legalno promijenila ime. Nastavlja živjeti kao žena u muškoj ustanovi MCI-Norfolk. Ovaj slučaj je značajan za raspravu o zdravstvenoj njezi i pravima u američkom zatvorskom sistemu.

article_content: President Bola Tinubu will meet on Friday afternoon with aides to Ondo State Governor Rotimi Akeredolu, Deputy Governor Lucky Aiyedatiwa, and other key stakeholders, including members of the Ondo State House of Assembly, at the Presidential Villa in Abuja. The purpose is to address the ongoing leadership crisis in Ondo State. This meeting comes after Ondo State Elders and Leaders urgently appealed to President Tinubu to intervene to prevent the crisis from escalating further. They also called on the national and state leadership of the All Progressives Congress (APC) to ensure discipline and provide guidance for those in power. In a letter signed by convener Reuben Fasontanti and secretary Bakkita Bello, the elders requested that the Ondo State House of Assembly avoid impeaching either Governor Akeredolu or Deputy Governor Aiyedatiwa. They also emphasized that unelected individuals should not interfere in the work of the three branches of government. Ondo State has been experiencing political turbulence, notably as Governor Akeredolu spent three months in Germany for medical treatment. Since his return in early September, he has been operating from Ibadan, the capital of Oyo State, not from Ondo State. During Akeredolu's absence, Deputy Governor Aiyedatiwa has faced an impeachment process by state lawmakers over allegations of gross misconduct. President Tinubu also instructed the police to withdraw from the Ondo State House of Assembly premises in Akure to help reduce tensions. The public and political observers are now looking to federal and APC leadership for steps that will resolve the crisis and bring stability back to Ondo State.

Svrha sastanka je rješavanje tekuće krize liderstva u državi Ondo. Ovaj sastanak dolazi nakon što su starješine i lideri države Ondo hitno apelovali na predsjednika Tinubua da interveniše i spriječi dalje eskaliranje krize. Također su pozvali rukovodstva na državnom i nacionalnom nivou stranke na vlasti, Sveopće progresivne kongrese (APC), da osiguraju disciplinu i pruže smjernice za one na vlasti. U pismu koje su potpisali organizator Reuben Fasontanti i sekretar Bakkita Bello, starješine su zatražile da Skupština države Ondo ne pokreće opoziv ni protiv guvernera Akeredolua ni protiv zamjenika guvernera Aiyedatiwe. Također su naglasili da neizabrane osobe ne bi trebale ometati rad tri grane vlasti. Od povratka početkom septembra, radi iz Ibadana, glavnog grada države Oyo, a ne iz same države Ondo. Tokom odsustva Akeredolua, zamjenik guvernera Aiyedatiwa suočio se sa procesom opoziva od strane državnih zakonodavaca zbog optužbi za tešku povredu dužnosti. article_content: The United Nations agency that aids Palestinian refugees has announced that its humanitarian work in Gaza might soon come to a halt, as the Israeli blockade prevents fuel deliveries. Fuel has not entered Gaza for more than a month, worsening the already severe humanitarian crisis. Thomas White, who leads UNRWA operations in Gaza, stated on social media that all assistance efforts could stop within 48 hours if the siege continues. The ongoing Israeli military campaign, involving heavy airstrikes and a ground operation, has left Gaza critically short of food, electricity, and fuel. Humanitarian organizations are struggling to help the many displaced and injured people in these conditions. According to Palestinian officials, over 11,240 people—including more than 4,600 children—have died in Gaza since October 7, when conflict began after a Hamas attack in southern Israel led to about 1,200 Israeli deaths. The United Nations has also recorded the deaths of 101 staff members in Gaza since the escalation. Gaza’s health system is close to collapse. Hospitals have run dangerously low on fuel, frustrating doctors and threatening the lives of patients, including infants in incubators. Since November 10, cut communication has made casualty updates inconsistent. Israeli forces have encircled al-Shifa Hospital in northern Gaza, trapping over 650 patients and staff inside. Health officials say that 32 patients have died recently as power has run out. Israel claims the facility is above Hamas tunnels, an allegation denied by Hamas. Medical staff report their hospital’s water infrastructure has been severely damaged, leaving just enough water for those who remain. Officials are warning that deteriorating sanitation and shortages could trigger disease outbreaks. The fuel shortage has forced two major water distribution providers to cease operations, cutting off clean water for nearly 200,000 residents as reported by UNRWA’s Gaza chief. Displaced residents like Mansour Shouman, now sheltering at Nasser Hospital in southern Gaza, say conditions there are basic at best, and safety is still not guaranteed. Despite earlier advice to head south for safety, he states that casualties and burials continue to rise.
translated_content: UN-ova agencija koja pomaže palestinskim izbjeglicama objavila je da bi njen humanitarni rad u Gazi mogao uskoro prestati, jer izraelska blokada sprječava dopremu goriva. Već više od mjesec dana gorivo ne ulazi u Gazu, što dodatno otežava tešku humanitarnu situaciju. Thomas White, vođa UNRWA operacija u Gazi, izjavio je na društvenim mrežama da bi pomoć mogla prestati za 48 sati ako opsada potraje. Izraelska vojna ofanziva, koja uključuje težak zračni i kopneni napad, ostavila je Gazu bez hrane, struje i goriva. Humanitarne organizacije bore se da pomognu brojnim raseljenima i povrijeđenima u ovakvim uslovima. Prema palestinskim vlastima, više od 11.240 ljudi – uključujući više od 4.600 djece – poginulo je u Gazi od 7. oktobra, kada je sukob izbio nakon Hamasovog napada na jug Izraela koji je odnio oko 1.200 izraelskih života. UN navodi da je 101 njihov radnik ubijen u Gazi od početka sukoba. Zdravstveni sistem u Gazi je pred kolapsom. Bolnice gotovo nemaju goriva, što ugrožava živote pacijenata, čak i novorođenčadi u inkubatorima, a ljekari su očajni. Zbog prekida komunikacija od 10. novembra, podaci o žrtvama su nepotpuni. Izraelske trupe opkolile su bolnicu al-Shifa na sjeveru Gaze, gdje je blokirano više od 650 pacijenata i medicinara. Prema zdravstvenim zvaničnicima, 32 pacijenta su preminula posljednjih dana zbog nestanka struje. Izrael tvrdi da se ispod bolnice nalaze Hamasovi tuneli, što Hamas poriče. Medicinsko osoblje navodi da je vodna infrastruktura poništena bombardovanjem, pa je preostala samo minimalna količina vode za osoblje i pacijente. Zvaničnici upozoravaju na opasnost od epidemija zbog loših higijenskih uslova. Zbog nestašice goriva, dva glavna distributera vode su prestala raditi, zbog čega je 200.000 ljudi ostalo bez pitke vode, saopštio je UNRWA. article_content: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has officially ended her relationship with Andrea Giambruno, her partner of nearly a decade. Meloni made the announcement on social media shortly after explicit off-air remarks by Giambruno, a television presenter, were broadcast on a popular satirical show. The couple, who first met in 2015, share a seven-year-old daughter named Ginevra. In her post, Meloni expressed appreciation for the years spent together, acknowledging both the good times and challenges, and thanked Giambruno for their daughter, calling her the most important part of her life. Meloni remarked that their paths had diverged for some time, and it was time to accept this reality. Giambruno recently attracted public criticism after the show 'Striscia La Notizia' aired private footage in which he was heard making flirtatious and explicit remarks to female colleagues, referencing an affair and making suggestive comments. When questioned off-camera about his conduct, he seemed unconcerned, saying he was 'just joking.' This incident follows previous controversy in which Giambruno was accused of insensitive remarks about sexual violence, suggesting women could avoid risk by not becoming intoxicated. Meloni, who has advocated conservative family values and opposed same-sex parenting, previously distanced herself from Giambruno's comments, stating she should not be held responsible for statements made by journalists during their professional duties. After the separation news, Meloni received support messages from fellow politicians. Deputy Prime Minister Matteo Salvini and Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani both publicly expressed their solidarity. Alessandro Zan, a member of the Democratic Party and supporter of LGBTQ rights, suggested Meloni’s stance on traditional families had become more complicated. The broadcast reignited wider discussions on sexism and the culture of Italian television, a topic often brought up in connection with Mediaset, the broadcaster formerly owned by Silvio Berlusconi. The creator of 'Striscia La Notizia' commented that Meloni might one day see the broadcast as a favor. The episode has spotlighted ongoing concerns about media conduct and gender issues in Italy.

Dodala je da su im se putevi već neko vrijeme razilazili i da je došlo vrijeme da to priznaju. Giambruno je nedavno naišao na osudu javnosti nakon što je emisija 'Striscia La Notizia' prikazala privatne snimke gdje se čuje kako upućuje koketne i eksplicitne komentare kolegicama, spominjući aferu i davanje sugestivnih izjava. Na upite izvan kamere o svom ponašanju, rekao je da se 'samo šali.' Taj incident dolazi nakon prethodne kontroverze kada je optužen za neosjetljive komentare o seksualnom nasilju, sugerišući da bi žene mogle izbjeći rizik ako se ne opijaju. Meloni, poznata po zalaganju za konzervativne porodične vrijednosti i protivljenju istospolnom roditeljstvu, ranije se distancirala od Giambrunovih izjava te naglasila da ne treba biti odgovorna za novinarske komentare tokom njihovog rada. Nakon objave o razdvajanju, Meloni je dobila poruke podrške od kolega političara. Zamjenik premijera Matteo Salvini i ministar vanjskih poslova Antonio Tajani javno su izrazili solidarnost. Kreator 'Striscia La Notizia' izjavio je da će Meloni možda jednog dana tu emisiju smatrati uslugom. Ova epizoda dodatno je naglasila postojeće zabrinutosti oko ponašanja medija i pitanja rodne ravnopravnosti u Italiji.

article_content: Savannah Guthrie, co-anchor of the Today show, has welcomed her first child with her husband, Mike Feldman—a daughter named Vale Guthrie Feldman. Vale was born early Wednesday morning at a hospital in New York City, weighing 8.5 pounds and measuring 19.5 inches, according to Savannah’s colleagues. Her husband Mike, a political consultant, also expressed his joy on social media, calling his daughter's sounds music to his ears. The couple married in March in Tucson, Arizona, announcing Savannah's pregnancy at their wedding reception. On the Today show, anchor Matt Lauer shared that the name Vale comes from Old English, meaning 'valley by a stream'. Colleagues remarked on the baby's peaceful temperament, blue eyes, and notably chubby cheeks. Savannah joked to her team that baby Vale is currently 'more cheek than baby', sharing her excitement. Today show host Natalie Morales mentioned that Savannah was thrilled and in high spirits, despite having had just one hour of sleep after the birth. Messages of congratulations flooded in from viewers, friends, and rival TV hosts alike. Savannah had only just begun her maternity leave a week before her due date, and NBC has not yet named her stand-in on the Today show. Throughout her pregnancy, Savannah regularly shared updates with fans—through her Today.com blog and on-air segments—about her journey to motherhood. She talked about swapping heels for sneakers and discussed her emotional connection with her baby following a long struggle with fertility, often writing about her thoughts, prayers, and songs for her soon-to-arrive child.

article_content: Nobel laureate and Columbia University professor Joseph Stiglitz contends the recent financial crisis was foreseeable, implicating both government regulators and financial sector leaders as responsible. Noting his previous positions, including serving as chairman of the Council of Economic Advisers under President Clinton and chief economist at the World Bank, Stiglitz argues the Federal Reserve contributed to the crisis by flooding markets with inexpensive credit and by weakening regulatory oversight. This combination fueled a devastating housing bubble. Stiglitz explains that, although the collapse surprised many, it resembled prior crises involving excessive borrowing. He highlights the use of complex financial products by institutions, which obscured the extent of risks undertaken, making this episode especially destructive. Regulators like Alan Greenspan put too much trust in self-regulation and missed warning signs within the financial system. He further criticizes policy moves like the 2001 tax cuts, which he asserts primarily aided the wealthy, and the Iraq War, which increased oil prices and funneled money overseas. Efforts by the Federal Reserve to support the economy—pushing easy credit—shifted economic activity toward housing, causing household savings rates to drop dramatically. According to Stiglitz, bank executives and financial firms worsened matters by prioritizing immediate profits and high bonuses over long-term stability and prudent lending, fostering a culture of risky practices and inadequate oversight. Stiglitz observes a recurring pattern in which proponents of free markets seek government intervention after crises. To safeguard against future collapses, he recommends reforms such as linking executive pay to long-term results, setting up regulatory commissions for financial product safety and systemic stability, tightening rules to restrain risky lending, enhancing consumer protections, and ensuring no bank is so large that its failure would threaten the system. While Stiglitz admits that no reform can make the financial system crisis-proof, he believes such steps can reduce both the likelihood and potential severity of future downturns.
translated_content: Dobitnik Nobelove nagrade i profesor na Univerzitetu Columbia, Joseph Stiglitz, tvrdi da je nedavna finansijska kriza bila predvidiva te smatra kako su i državni regulatori i lideri finansijskog sektora odgovorni. Navodeći svoje prethodne pozicije, uključujući funkciju predsjedavajućeg Savjeta ekonomskih savjetnika za vrijeme predsjednika Clintona i glavnog ekonomiste Svjetske banke, Stiglitz ističe da su Federalne rezerve doprinijele krizi puštanjem jeftinog kredita na tržište te slabljenjem regulatornog nadzora. Ova kombinacija dovela je do razornog stambenog balona. Stiglitz objašnjava da, iako je kolaps iznenadio mnoge, on podsjeća na ranije krize izazvane pretjeranim zaduživanjem. Ističe kako su kompleksni finansijski proizvodi korišteni u institucijama prikrili stvarnu razinu rizika, čineći ovu krizu posebno pogubnom. Regulatori poput Alana Greenspana previše su vjerovali u samoregulaciju i propustili alarmantne signale u finansijskom sistemu. Također kritikuje političke odluke, poput poreznih smanjenja iz 2001. godine (za koje navodi da su uglavnom koristila bogatima) i rata u Iraku, koji je povećao cijene nafte i odliv novca u inostranstvo. Federalne rezerve su pokušale podstaći ekonomiju olakšanim kreditima, što je preusmjerilo potrošnju na nekretnine i izazvalo znatan pad štednje domaćinstava. Po Stiglitzu, menadžeri banaka i finansijske kompanije dodatno su pogoršali situaciju stavljajući kratkoročne profite i visoke bonuse ispred dugoročne stabilnosti i odgovornog kreditiranja, stvarajući kulturu rizičnog ponašanja i slabog nadzora. Stiglitz uočava obrazac u kojem zagovarači slobodnog tržišta nakon kriza traže podršku države. Za zaštitu od budućih kolapsa preporučuje mjere kao što su vezivanje menadžerskih plaća uz dugoročne rezultate, formiranje regulatornih komisija za sigurnost finansijskih proizvoda i stabilnost sistema, jačanje nadzora nad rizičnim kreditiranjem, unapređenje zaštite potrošača i sprječavanje da bilo koja banka postane prevelika da bi smjela propasti. Iako priznaje da nijedna reforma ne može u potpunosti otkloniti rizik od financijskih kriza, Stiglitz smatra da ovakve mjere mogu smanjiti učestalost i ozbiljnost budućih kriza.

article_content: A family of five was killed in a tragic car accident on Mother's Day while heading to Disneyland in California. The victims have been identified as Cynthia Jimenez, who was set to celebrate her fifth birthday, her mother Angelica Garcia (25), her father Gerardo Jimenez, and her brothers Ivan (2) and Freddie (9). According to authorities, the family was driving through Hesperia, San Bernardino County, when a delivery van crashed into their Honda sedan at Main Street and Balsam Avenue. The van, driven by 30-year-old Joshua Smith, allegedly swerved into oncoming traffic and struck the family's car, which was stopped at a stop sign. The van landed on top of the car, crushing it. Smith, who is suspected of driving under the influence of prescription drugs, sustained only minor injuries. He reportedly told police he looked away for a moment before losing control of the van. No arrests have been made, and the investigation is ongoing. Family members are devastated, with the children’s grandfather expressing deep sorrow after realizing his family was involved in the crash that he had earlier driven past. Both Gerardo Jimenez and Freddie were taken to the hospital but later died from their injuries. Angelica Garcia and Cynthia were pronounced dead at the scene. It was only after the van was lifted off the car that authorities discovered the body of two-year-old Ivan. Tributes have been left at the scene, including five candles to honor the lost family.

Prema navodima vlasti, porodica je putovala kroz Hesperiu, okrug San Bernardino, kada se dostavno vozilo sudarilo s njihovom Honda limuzinom na uglu Main Street i Balsam Avenue. Dostavno vozilo, kojim je upravljao 30-godišnji Joshua Smith, navodno je prešlo u suprotnu traku i udarilo u automobil porodice, koji je bio zaustavljen na znaku stop. Vozilo se prevrnulo na vrh auta, zdrobivši ga. Smith, za kojeg se sumnja da je vozio pod utjecajem lijekova na recept, zadobio je samo lakše povrede. Navodno je policiji rekao da je samo na trenutak skrenuo pogled i izgubio kontrolu nad vozilom. Nije bilo hapšenja, a istraga je još uvijek u toku. Članovi porodice su shrvani, a djed djece je izrazio duboku tugu nakon što je shvatio da je njegova porodica bila uključena u nesreću pored koje je ranije prošao. Gerardo Jimenez i Freddie prevezeni su u bolnicu, ali su kasnije podlegli povredama. Angelica Garcia i Cynthia proglašene su mrtvima na licu mjesta. Tek nakon što je dostavno vozilo uklonjeno sa automobila, vlasti su pronašle tijelo dvogodišnjeg Ivana. Na mjestu nesreće ostavljene su počasti, uključujući pet svijeća u znak sjećanja na izgubljenu porodicu.

article_content: New research published for National Apprenticeship Week highlights the significant value of on-the-job learning and apprenticeship programs. Amid global events and economic uncertainty, one persistent challenge remains: businesses still struggle to find skilled workers for open roles, leading to changes in recruitment strategies. Multiverse, a workforce development company, found that terms like 'upskilling,' 'reskilling,' and 'on-the-job training' appear in job ads 6.5 times more often than five years ago. Employers are now focusing on offering training opportunities at work instead of relying mostly on benefits like higher pay or remote work. With more employers valuing skills over traditional degrees, apprenticeships are increasingly seen as key to connecting talent with job openings. 'Education has become the key way for organizations to secure talent,' says Euan Blair, founder and CEO of Multiverse. He believes apprenticeships offer practical career growth for workers and help companies build stronger pipelines. Blair points to the U.K.'s approach, noting it has 25% more apprenticeship participants than the U.S., despite a smaller workforce. The U.K.'s Apprenticeship Levy policy provides financial incentives for businesses to train apprentices, helping to expand these programs into new industries. Blair suggests that the U.S. could benefit from similar investments, as 76% of American workers currently occupy positions with limited advancement. According to Multiverse’s research, 128 million U.S. workers, divided into four distinct groups, could improve their careers through apprenticeships. Blair highlights that each of these groups can make the most of learning on the job, estimating this could lead to over 830,000 new apprenticeships annually and add around $28.5 billion to workers’ earnings. Besides aiding career mobility and building talent pipelines, apprenticeships can strengthen workforce diversity. People from low-income and underrepresented backgrounds are more likely to hold lower-wage jobs that offer few paths forward. Blair says widening access to apprenticeships can help address these inequalities and diversify sought-after professions. Young people starting their careers aren’t the only ones who can benefit—existing employees can gain from upskilling too. 'Our data shows 68 million workers could realize tangible improvements through new training opportunities at their current jobs,' Blair says. Investing in the skills of their current workforce allows companies to fill vital roles and boost morale in a cost-effective way. Companies also stand to gain from apprenticeships. According to reports, every £1 invested in U.K. apprenticeships returns £27; in the U.S., each dollar invested gives back $1.44, highlighting mutual benefits. As National Apprenticeship Week wraps up, it’s a good time to consider how apprenticeship programs can help bridge labor gaps and boost career growth—helping both workers and employers thrive.
translated_content: Novo istraživanje objavljeno povodom Nacionalne sedmice pripravništva ističe značajnu vrijednost učenja na radnom mjestu i programa pripravništva. Usred globalnih dešavanja i ekonomske nesigurnosti, jedan uporan izazov ostaje: kompanije i dalje teško pronalaze kvalifikovane radnike za otvorene pozicije, što dovodi do promjena u strategijama zapošljavanja. Multiverse, firma za razvoj radne snage, otkrila je da se termini poput 'usavršavanje', 'prekvalifikacija' i 'učenje na radnom mjestu' sada pojavljuju u oglasima za posao 6,5 puta češće nego prije pet godina. Poslodavci sada ističu mogućnosti za obuku na poslu, umjesto da se uglavnom oslanjaju na benefite poput veće plate ili rada na daljinu. Kako poslodavci sve više cijene vještine u odnosu na tradicionalne diplome, pripravništvo se sve češće smatra ključem za povezivanje talenata s radnim mjestima. 'Obrazovanje je postalo ključni način da organizacije pronađu talente', kaže Euan Blair, osnivač i direktor Multiversea. On smatra da pripravništvo nudi praktičan profesionalni napredak radnicima i pomaže kompanijama da izgrade jače timove. Blair ističe pristup Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva, napominjući da ono ima 25% više ljudi u programima pripravništva nego SAD, iako ima manju radnu snagu. Politika 'Apprenticeship Levy' u Ujedinjenom Kraljevstvu stvara financijske poticaje kompanijama za obuku pripravnika, što je omogućilo širenje ovih programa na različite industrije. Blair navodi da bi i SAD mogao imati koristi od sličnih ulaganja, s obzirom da čak 76% američkih radnika radi na poslovima s malim mogućnostima za napredovanje. Prema istraživanju Multiversea, 128 miliona američkih radnika, podijeljenih u četiri posebne grupe, moglo bi unaprijediti svoje karijere kroz pripravništvo. Blair naglašava da svaka od ovih grupa najviše može iskoristiti učenje na radnom mjestu, procjenjujući da to može donijeti više od 830.000 novih pripravničkih mjesta godišnje i povećati zaradu radnika za oko 28,5 milijardi dolara. Osim pomoći u napredovanju i razvoju talenata, pripravništvo može donijeti veću raznolikost u radnu snagu. Osobe iz porodica s niskim primanjima i manjinskih zajednica češće rade poslove s niskim platama i malo šansi za napredak. Blair ističe da proširenje pristupa pripravništvu može pomoći smanjiti ove nejednakosti i diversificirati najtraženije profesije. Nisu samo mladi na početku karijere ti koji mogu imati koristi—i postojeći radnici mogu napredovati kroz obuku. 'Naši podaci pokazuju da bi 68 miliona zaposlenih moglo značajno napredovati kroz nove mogućnosti usavršavanja na trenutnim radnim mjestima', kaže Blair. Ulaganjem u razvoj vještina sadašnjih zaposlenika, firme mogu popuniti ključna radna mjesta i povećati moral na isplativ način. I poslodavci imaju koristi od pripravništva. Prema izvještajima, svaki uloženi funtu u pripravništvo u Ujedinjenom Kraljevstvu vraća čak 27 funti; u SAD, svaki dolar vraća 1,44 dolara. To pokazuje obostrane koristi. Kako se Nacionalna sedmica pripravništva bliži kraju, pravo je vrijeme da razmislimo koliko programi pripravništva mogu pomoći tržištu rada i napredovanju u karijeri—na korist i zaposlenima i poslodavcima.

article_content: 'The Chosen One' is a bold message to have on your boots heading into a World Cup final, but it seemed to work for Bastian Schweinsteiger. The German midfielder was bloodied during the match against Argentina, but it proved worthwhile in Germany’s 1-0 victory in extra time. Schweinsteiger’s boots bore the intriguing inscription, reflecting both confidence and a touch of arrogance. Schweinsteiger was injured after a collision with Sergio Aguero, who was already on a yellow card but remained in the game despite leading with his arm. Schweinsteiger’s distinctive choices in gear didn’t stop at his boots—he is also known for his old shinpads. Schweinsteiger, however, saw his own message as a positive omen. In the Maracana dressing rooms, there were a variety of unique kit decisions, from vintage shinpads to a wide selection of boots. Donald Sterling, the longtime owner of the Los Angeles Clippers, is facing intense criticism after audio emerged in which he is allegedly heard making racist remarks to his girlfriend, V. Stiviano. In the tape, reportedly featuring Sterling, a man rebukes his partner for engaging publicly with Black individuals—including Magic Johnson and Matt Kemp—and makes additional offensive racial comments. While the recording's authenticity has yet to be confirmed, Sterling has not denied its content, and the incident has brought renewed attention to his long-documented history of discriminatory behavior.

Over the years, the NBA has received numerous warnings about Sterling’s conduct but has stopped short of significant intervention. The latest revelations sparked condemnation from prominent players like LeBron James and Michael Jordan, as well as from President Barack Obama. The manner in which the recording was obtained remains unclear, though TMZ published it first, and speculation continues regarding Stiviano’s involvement due to her legal disputes with Sterling. Regardless, the public reaction has been one of overwhelming outrage.

There are growing demands for the NBA to respond forcefully, with parallels drawn to former Cincinnati Reds owner Marge Schott, who was banned from baseball after similar scandals. Many believe that a mere suspension or request for Sterling to sell the team would be inadequate. Instead, calls for a lifetime ban and removal of franchise rights have gathered pace. Notably, Sterling purchased the Clippers in 1981 for $12 million, and the team is now estimated by Forbes to be worth $575 million, further fueling the debate over appropriate consequences.

Though Clippers players and some teams have staged symbolic protests, such as reversing their warm-up attire and wearing black socks, critics argue that stronger collective action—potentially in the form of a boycott—would more powerfully denounce racism and pressure the NBA to act. As the situation evolves, commissioner Adam Silver faces widespread calls to take decisive action and demonstrate a zero-tolerance stance on discrimination in the league.

article_content: The American Ornithological Society (AOS) has announced that dozens of bird species in the US and Canada will receive new names, moving away from those honoring individuals and instead focusing on the birds’ habitats and traits. This change aims to address longstanding controversy over bird names linked to people, some of whom had racist histories, and to foster a more inclusive birdwatching community. Between seventy and eighty bird species will be renamed. Judith Scarl, CEO of the AOS, explained, 'Exclusionary naming conventions developed in the 1800s, clouded by racism and misogyny, don't work for us today. The time has come to transform this process and redirect the focus where it belongs: on the birds.' Birds slated for renaming include Wilson’s warbler and Wilson’s snipe, both previously named for 19th-century naturalist Alexander Wilson. In 2020, the AOS also renamed a bird originally named after Confederate General John P. McCown, now called the thick-billed longspur. The AOS will establish a new committee, composed of individuals with expertise in social sciences, communications, ornithology, and taxonomy, to oversee the renaming effort. The process will also involve public participation. According to the organization, these 'momentous decisions' are intended to move away from harmful and exclusionary English bird names. Meanwhile, the National Audubon Society decided earlier this year to keep its name after internal debate. While its namesake, James John Audubon, was a renowned naturalist and illustrator, he also owned slaves and held harmful views about Black and Indigenous people, as acknowledged by the society. Susan Bell, a board member, noted, 'The name has come to represent more than one person’s work. It reflects a broader love of birds, nature, and a non-partisan approach to conservation.'

Ova promjena ima cilj riješiti dugogodišnju kontroverzu oko imenovanja ptica po osobama, od kojih su neki imali rasističku prošlost, te stvoriti inkluzivniju zajednicu ljubitelja ptica. article_content: Barring a significant decline in crude oil prices, American drivers should expect gas prices to exceed $3 per gallon—if they aren’t seeing those rates already—according to the latest Lundberg Survey of continental U.S. filling stations. Published on Friday, the survey found the national average for a gallon of self-serve unleaded gasoline rose to $2.91, up 3.9 cents from two weeks earlier, survey publisher Trilby Lundberg reported. "Once again, crude oil prices are the driving force," Lundberg explained. A rebound in crude has pushed prices nearly $8 higher per barrel; at $89 per barrel, crude oil is at a 25-month high. Lundberg predicts further increases at the pump due to wholesale gasoline price hikes, noting that retailer profit margins have dropped by about half in the last two weeks—down to less than six cents per gallon. To maintain profit, gas stations will need to raise prices. "We may easily pay three dollars or more per gallon by Christmas," Lundberg said. The survey shows gas prices almost 28 cents higher than this time last year. About 2,500 gas stations were sampled. Among surveyed cities, Long Island, New York reported the highest average at $3.21 per gallon, while Denver, Colorado saw the lowest at $2.61. Other city averages: Albuquerque, NM: $2.75; Atlanta, GA: $2.84; Baltimore, MD: $2.90; Chicago, IL: $3.09; Miami, FL: $2.96; Minneapolis, MN: $3.03; Philadelphia, PA: $3.02; Portland, OR: $2.99; San Francisco, CA: $3.19.

Anketa objavljena u petak pokazala je da je nacionalni prosjek za galon benzina (samousluživanje, bezolovni) porastao na 2,91 dolara, što je povećanje od 3,9 centi u odnosu na anketu sprovedenu prije dvije sedmice, izvijestila je izdavačica ankete Trilby Lundberg. "Ponovo su cijene sirove nafte glavni pokretač," objasnila je Lundberg. Nagli rast cijena sirove nafte doveo je do toga da je cijena po barelu porasla za skoro 8 dolara; na 89 dolara po barelu, sirova nafta je na najvišem nivou u posljednjih 25 mjeseci. Lundberg predviđa daljnji rast cijena na pumpama zbog povećanja veleprodajnih cijena goriva, napominjući da su profitne marže prodavača goriva opale za oko polovinu u posljednje dvije sedmice—na manje od šest centi po galonu. article_content: Social media platform TikTok will suspend its online shopping service in Indonesia to comply with new government regulations in South East Asia's largest economy. The suspension will take effect at 17:00 Jakarta time (10:00 GMT). Indonesian authorities state that the new rules are intended to protect local physical and online retailers. Indonesia was the first country to trial TikTok's e-commerce platform in 2021 and quickly became one of TikTok Shop's largest markets. Last week, the Indonesian government announced regulations requiring TikTok to separate its shopping feature from the video-sharing service in the country. Indonesian Trade Minister Zulkifli Hasan said, 'Now, e-commerce cannot become social media. It is separated.' He added that social media platforms had a week to comply with the new rules or risk losing their licenses to operate in Indonesia. The announcement followed a statement by President Joko Widodo last month: 'We need to be careful with e-commerce. It can be very good if there are regulations but can turn bad if there aren't any regulations.' In a statement on Tuesday, TikTok said, 'Our priority is to remain compliant with local laws and regulations. As such, we will no longer facilitate e-commerce transactions in TikTok Shop Indonesia.' Online retail in Indonesia has grown rapidly in recent years. According to the country's central bank, the value of e-commerce sales is expected to increase more than sixfold from 2018 to next year, reaching 689 trillion Indonesian rupiah ($44bn; £36.5bn). Since launching in Indonesia two years ago, TikTok Shop has gained significant market share in an online shopping market dominated by Tokopedia, Shopee, and Lazada. Indonesia, with more than 278 million people, has 125 million TikTok users. These include six million sellers and many more creators who earn income by promoting products through TikTok Shop. In June, TikTok CEO Shou Zi Chew visited Indonesia and pledged to invest billions of dollars in the region over the next three to five years. The growth of e-commerce has greatly impacted traditional shop owners, like Sukmamalingga, who has run a Muslim clothing store at the Tanah Abang Market in Jakarta for nine years. 'None of my customers from regions in Indonesia shop anymore, even though I often send photos of new clothing models,' he told BBC News Indonesia. Government data shows Indonesia is home to over 64 million micro, small, and medium enterprises, which make up nearly two-thirds of the country's economy. These new rules are another setback for TikTok, coming amid global scrutiny from the US, European Union, and UK, where the app has faced restrictions due to security concerns. Additional reporting by Quinawaty Pasaribu for BBC News Indonesia.

Zbog toga više nećemo omogućavati e-trgovinske transakcije putem TikTok Shop Indonezija.' Online prodaja u Indoneziji naglo je porasla posljednjih godina. Od lansiranja u Indoneziji prije dvije godine, TikTok Shop je stekao značajan tržišni udio na tržištu online kupovine kojim dominiraju Tokopedia, Shopee i Lazada. To uključuje šest miliona prodavača i mnogo više kreatora koji zarađuju promoviranjem proizvoda putem TikTok Shop-a. U junu je izvršni direktor TikToka Shou Zi Chew posjetio Indoneziju i obećao ulaganje milijardi dolara u region tokom naredne tri do pet godina. Rast e-trgovine značajno je uticao na vlasnike tradicionalnih trgovina, poput Sukmamalingge, koji devet godina vodi prodavnicu muslimanske odjeće na tržnici Tanah Abang u Džakarti. 'Nijedan od mojih kupaca iz drugih regija u Indoneziji više ne kupuje, iako često šaljem slike novih modela odjeće,' rekao je za BBC News Indonesia. Vladini podaci pokazuju da Indonezija ima više od 64 miliona mikro, malih i srednjih preduzeća, koja čine skoro dvije trećine ekonomije zemlje. Ova nova pravila predstavljaju još jedan udarac za TikTok, uz globalnu pažnju iz SAD-a, Evropske unije i Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva, gdje se aplikacija suočava sa ograničenjima zbog zabrinutosti za sigurnost. article_content: Kieran Maxwell, 14, from Bishop Auckland in County Durham, lost his left leg to cancer but is now pursuing his dream of becoming a Paralympian after being inspired by the London 2012 heroes. He is halfway to raising the £25,000 needed for a new prosthetic limb, hoping it will help him compete in the 2016 Rio de Janeiro Paralympics and 'win gold for Britain.' During the Olympic torch relay in his hometown in June 2012, Kieran stumbled due to his heavy NHS prosthetic limb, which was designed for someone twice his weight. His determination and bravery caught public attention, inspiring the UK's largest lottery winners, Colin and Chris Weir, to donate a lightweight limb for his daily use. Kieran has since become an accomplished acrobatic gymnast, a sport being considered for Olympic status, and is aiming to win the national championships in 2013. He said, 'Before I lost my leg I couldn't even do a forward roll, but now I can do them easily, as well as handstands and cartwheels. I'm now working on learning somersaults.' Now in remission, Kieran is fundraising for a specially designed prosthetic leg to help him pursue his Paralympic dream. 'I love everything about gymnastics. It makes me feel like I'm not different from other people,' he shared. Despite undergoing intensive chemotherapy, Kieran had his left leg amputated below the knee in March 2011 after being diagnosed with Ewing's Sarcoma in October 2010—a rare and aggressive cancer affecting about 30 children in the UK each year. Kieran's mother, Nicola, expressed her pride: 'He has had to make decisions as a child that no child should have to make. He's such a special boy.' The Weirs, after hearing about Kieran's situation through a family connection, donated funds for a new lightweight prosthetic leg. Their generosity has allowed Kieran to participate in sports and activities with his friends. Nicola said, 'What the Weirs did was amazing. Kieran looks and walks like any other boy now.' A fundraising website, designed by Alienation Digital, has been launched to support the Kieran Maxwell Fund, helping to raise awareness and funds for Kieran's prosthetic limb and future endeavors.

article_content: Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, the current Asian Games champions, have made it to the men’s doubles semifinals at the China Masters Super 750 badminton tournament in Shenzhen. The Indian pair won convincingly against Indonesia’s Leo Rolly Carnando and Daniel Marthin, taking the match in straight sets, 21-16, 21-14, over 46 minutes. Having already secured titles at the Indonesia Super 1000, Korea Super 500, and Swiss Super 300 this year, Satwik and Chirag will face either He Ji Ting and Ren Xiang Yu or eighth seeds Liu Yu Chen and Ou Xuan Yi from China in the semifinals. Throughout the quarterfinal, the Indian duo displayed impressive coordination and regularly rotated positions while executing aggressive attacks that left their Indonesian opponents struggling. After a tight beginning that saw the score tied at 14-14, Satwik and Chirag pressed ahead to dominate the remainder of the match. Chirag’s well-timed plays helped India pull ahead late in the first game. The pair carried their strong performance into the second game, quickly moving up 5-2 and then 11-6 at the interval. Their consistent pressure kept the Indonesians on the back foot. The match featured notable moments, including a 48-shot rally won by Marthin. Ultimately, Satwik and Chirag clinched the win after reaching seven match points and securing victory with a successful video referral.
