Indijski par je uvjerljivo pobijedio indonežanski dvojac Lea Rollyja Carnanda i Daniela Marthina u dva seta, 21-16, 21-14, za 46 minuta. Nakon što su već ove godine osvojili turnire Indonesia Super 1000, Korea Super 500 i Swiss Super 300, Satwik i Chirag će se u polufinalu suočiti sa pobjednicima kineskog četvrtfinala: He Ji Ting i Ren Xiang Yu ili osmi nositelji Liu Yu Chen i Ou Xuan Yi. Tokom četvrtfinala, indijski dvojac je pokazao odličnu koordinaciju i često su mijenjali pozicije, dok su agresivnim napadima zadavali probleme svojim indonežanskim protivnicima. Nakon izjednačenog početka i rezultata 14-14, Satwik i Chirag su pojačali tempo i preuzeli kontrolu nad ostatkom meča. Chiragove pravovremene reakcije pomogle su indijskom paru da se odvoji krajem prvog seta. Par je održavao snažan nastup i u drugom setu, brzo povevši 5-2, a zatim 11-6 na pauzi. Njihov kontinuirani pritisak ostavio je Indonežane bez odgovora. Meč je obilježila i razmjena od 48 udaraca koju je dobio Marthin. Na kraju, Satwik i Chirag su zaključili pobjedu nakon sedam meč lopti i potvrde putem video provjere.

article_content: A homeless man has been charged after allegedly urinating on $1,000 worth of books at a Florida library. Benjamin Wilson, 24, was reportedly seen by a patron as he urinated on a stack of books inside Tavares Public Library over the weekend. He had entered the library to use its free WiFi to download apps onto his tablet. Library staff said Wilson was behaving unusually, suggesting he might have been intoxicated or under the influence of drugs. They told police his eyes did not react to light changes, his speech was severely slurred, and he struggled to stand or form complete thoughts. Wilson reportedly fell asleep in a chair, later collapsing. Witnesses said he then stumbled around before stopping, at which point another patron claimed to have seen him urinate on the books. Lake County deputies responded and found Wilson slurring his speech and unable to stand without assistance. During a search, officers found half a white pill inside a green cigarette pack on his person. The pill was sent for laboratory testing, and Wilson was taken to jail. Several library rental books were found to be wet. Local news station My News 13 reported that Wilson was charged with criminal mischief and disorderly intoxication. It remains unclear whether he deliberately urinated on the books or if it was an accident. The incident follows a similar case less than a month ago involving Orion Jones, a 20-year-old food runner accused of urinating on a coworker from a nightclub balcony in Key West. Police tasered Jones after he attempted to flee.
translated_content: Beskućnik je optužen nakon što je navodno urinirao na knjige u vrijednosti od 1.000 dolara u biblioteci na Floridi. Ušao je u biblioteku da koristi besplatni WiFi i skine aplikacije na svoj tablet. Osoblje biblioteke saopštilo je da se Wilson ponašao neobično, sugerišući da je možda bio pod uticajem alkohola ili droge. Policiji su rekli da mu oči nisu reagovale na promjene svjetlosti, govor mu je bio izrazito nerazgovjetan, a jedva je stajao i formulisao rečenice. Wilson je navodno zaspao na stolici, a kasnije se i srušio. Svjedoci su rekli da je potom teturao dok nije stao, a tada je drugi posjetilac tvrdio da ga je vidio kako urinira na knjige. Policija okruga Lake došla je na lice mjesta i zatekla Wilsona kako nerazgovjetno govori i ne može stajati bez pomoći. Tokom pretresa, pronašli su kod njega pola bijele tablete u paklici zelenih cigareta. Tableta je poslana na laboratorijsku analizu, a Wilson je priveden. Nekoliko iznajmljenih knjiga iz biblioteke pronađeno je mokro. Lokalna stanica My News 13 izvijestila je da je Wilson optužen za huliganizam i nered zbog pijanstva. Još uvijek nije jasno da li je namjerno urinirao na knjige ili je to bio nesretan slučaj. Incident se dogodio manje od mjesec dana nakon sličnog slučaja u kojem je Orion Jones (20), pomoćni konobar, optužen da je urinirao na kolegicu s balkona noćnog kluba u Key Westu. Policija je upotrijebila elektrosoker nakon što je Jones pokušao pobjeći.

article_content: After a seemingly productive summit in San Francisco between US President Joe Biden and Chinese President Xi Jinping, a remark by Biden threatened to undermine the progress both leaders aimed for. When asked by a CNN reporter if he would still call Xi a 'dictator,' referencing Biden’s earlier comments that angered Beijing, Biden replied, 'Well, he is. He’s a dictator in the sense that he’s in charge of a communist country based on a government completely different from ours.' This statement came soon after Biden had praised the meeting with Xi, calling it one of the most constructive and productive discussions they’d had. The summit, their first in a year, resulted in promises to restore military communications, collaborate on artificial intelligence safety, and tackle the problem of fentanyl being trafficked from China to the US. However, the leaders made no breakthroughs on ongoing disputes such as the future of Taiwan, tariffs, sanctions, or the release of US citizens held in China. Biden’s use of the term 'dictator' once again overshadowed efforts to ease tensions. While Xi did not mention the comment during a dinner with US business leaders, China’s foreign ministry forcefully rejected Biden’s statement at a press briefing in Beijing. Spokesperson Mao Ning described the remarks as highly inappropriate and politically manipulative, adding that some individuals want to damage US-China relations but will not succeed. She declined to specify who she was referencing. Following the summit, the Chinese foreign ministry reiterated that as long as the nations respect each other, coexist peacefully, and seek win-win cooperation, they can move beyond differences. The ministry highlighted the importance of understanding each other’s principles and boundaries, and avoiding provocative actions or mixed signals. Biden has labeled Xi a dictator multiple times before, including in speeches and public events over the last two years, leading to repeated objections from China. After one such remark earlier this year, Beijing called his comments baseless, irresponsible, and a violation of diplomatic norms. Despite criticism, Biden has stood by his descriptions of Xi, insisting that they have not had a real impact on relations and expressing confidence he will meet Xi again soon. The White House has not issued any clarification or comment regarding Biden’s latest statement.
translated_content: Nakon naizgled produktivnog samita u San Franciscu između američkog predsjednika Joea Bidena i kineskog predsjednika Xi Jinpinga, jedna Bidenova izjava prijeti da ugrozi napredak kojem su oba lidera težila. Kada ga je novinar CNN-a upitao hoće li i dalje nazivati Xi-ja 'diktatorom', referirajući se na njegove ranije komentare koji su naljutili Peking, Biden je odgovorio: 'Pa, jeste. On je diktator u smislu da vodi komunističku zemlju sa sistemom vlasti potpuno različitim od našeg.' Ova izjava je uslijedila poslije Bidenove pohvale sastanku s Xi-jem, nazivajući ga jednim od najkonstruktivnijih i najproduktivnijih koje su imali. Samit, prvi takav susret u godinu dana, donio je obećanja o obnovi vojne komunikacije, saradnji na sigurnosti vještačke inteligencije i borbi protiv šverca fentanila iz Kine u SAD. Ipak, nisu uspjeli postići napredak po pitanjima poput Tajvana, tarifa, sankcija ili oslobađanja američkih državljana u Kini. Bidenova ponovna upotreba izraza 'diktator' bacila je sjenu na pokušaje smirivanja tenzija. Dok Xi nije spomenuo ovaj komentar na večeri s američkim privrednicima, kinesko ministarstvo vanjskih poslova je snažno odbacilo Bidenovu izjavu na pres konferenciji u Pekingu. Portparolka Mao Ning je to opisala kao krajnje neispravno i političku manipulaciju, dodajući da neki pokušavaju narušiti odnose SAD-a i Kine, ali da neće uspjeti. Nije precizirala na koga misli. Nakon samita, kinesko ministarstvo vanjskih poslova je još jednom naglasilo važnost međusobnog poštovanja, mirne koegzistencije i saradnje na obostranu korist, ističući da se razlike mogu prevazići. Ministarstvo je ukazalo na važnost razumijevanja principa i crvenih linija te izbjegavanja provokativnih poteza i nejasnoća. Biden je više puta tokom protekle dvije godine javno nazvao Xi-ja diktatorom, što je svaki put izazvalo oštre reakcije Kine. Nakon jedne nedavne izjave, Peking je njegove riječi okarakterisao kao neutemeljene, neodgovorne i kršenje diplomatskih normi. Uprkos kritikama, Biden ostaje pri svom stavu, tvrdeći da komentari nisu negativno uticali na odnose i izražava uvjerenje da će se uskoro ponovo sastati s Xi-jem. Bijela kuća nije nudila dodatna pojašnjenja ili komentare na najnoviju izjavu.

article_content: Venus Williams, a former two-time US Open champion, was eliminated in the second round following a hard-fought three-set contest against Zheng Jie from China. Their battle, which exceeded three hours, ranks among the longest women's singles matches in the event's history. Currently ranked 60th, Williams has dealt with recurring injuries and is still managing her recovery from Sjogren’s Syndrome, which was diagnosed at this Grand Slam two years ago. Though disappointed, the 33-year-old American emphasized the positives in her performance, specifically noting her serving and her ongoing rehabilitation. 'There are plenty of encouraging aspects for me to build on, and I’ll keep working to convert my opportunities into victories,' Williams told reporters. On the women's side, Sloane Stephens, seeded 15th, delivered a dominant performance to defeat Poland's Urszula Radwanska 6-1, 6-1. The young American highlighted her determination and focus for the win and now moves on to play Jamie Hampton, another American. Third seed Agnieszka Radwanska advanced with a straight-sets win against Maria-Teresa Torro-Flor of Spain, contrasting with her sister Urszula's earlier defeat. In the men’s draw, defending champion Andy Murray cruised past Michael Llodra of France in straight sets, booking a matchup with Argentina's Leandro Mayer in the next round. Murray remarked that his comfort and readiness helped his smooth start as he began defending a Grand Slam title for the first time. American tennis veteran James Blake played his farewell US Open after announcing his retirement, losing a tight five-setter to Ivo Karlovic of Croatia. Blake, who is 33, closes the chapter on a 14-year professional career. Elsewhere, sixth-seed Juan Martin del Potro defeated Guillermo Garcia-Lopez, and former world number one Lleyton Hewitt bested American wildcard Brian Baker. Del Potro and Hewitt will face each other in the upcoming round.

Williams, danas 60. na svjetskoj listi, bori se s ponovnim povredama i još uvijek se oporavlja od Sjögrenovog sindroma, koji joj je dijagnosticiran baš na ovom Grand Slamu prije dvije godine. Iako razočarana, 33-godišnja Amerikanka naglasila je pozitivne aspekte svog nastupa, posebno poboljšan servis i napredak u rehabilitaciji. 'Puno je ohrabrujućih stvari na kojima mogu raditi i trudit ću se da prilike pretvorim u pobjede,' rekla je Williams novinarima. U ženskoj konkurenciji, Sloane Stephens, 15. nositeljica, ostvarila je dominantnu pobjedu nad Poljakinjom Urszulom Radwanskom rezultatom 6-1, 6-1. Mlada Amerikanka je istaknula odlučnost i fokus, a u sljedećem kolu igra protiv sunarodnjakinje Jamie Hampton. U muškoj konkurenciji, branilac naslova Andy Murray lako je savladao Francuza Michaela Llodru, čime je osigurao meč protiv Argentinca Leandra Mayera u sljedećem kolu. Murray je istakao da su mu spremnost i iskustvo pomogli da uspješno započne odbranu Grand Slam titule. Američki teniski veteran James Blake odigrao je svoj oproštajni US Open nakon najave povlačenja, izgubivši tijesno u pet setova od Hrvata Ive Karlovića. Del Potro i Hewitt sastaju se u narednom kolu.

article_content: Thanks to heightened solar activity, the northern lights could soon be visible in more southern regions than usual. Following recent dazzling displays that lit up the skies as far south as Italy and Greece, another burst of solar energy is expected to bring the aurora borealis to parts of the northern United States on November 9, 2023. This new auroral opportunity comes after experts, including SpaceWeather.com as well as forecasts from NOAA and NASA, predicted a fresh geomagnetic storm fueled by a coronal mass ejection from the sun. While the upcoming storm won’t match the intensity of last weekend’s G3-class event, it may still trigger G2-level storm activity—enough for skywatchers in states from New York to Washington to possibly witness the spectacle. NOAA's Space Weather Prediction Center projects that G1-level magnetic storms will start Saturday afternoon, followed by stronger G2 conditions in the evening through early Sunday morning. For the best chance to see or photograph the aurora, enthusiasts are advised to head away from city lights and use manual cameras capable of long exposures. Auroras form when charged particles from the sun, propelled by solar events like coronal mass ejections, stream into Earth's atmosphere. When these particles interact with Earth’s magnetic field, they create glowing patterns—typically green and red—around the planet’s poles. During periods of high solar activity, this auroral oval broadens, making the spectacle visible further from the poles. The sun is currently approaching the peak of its 11-year solar cycle, with scientists predicting solar maximum to occur between January and October 2024. With this elevated activity, skywatchers in higher latitudes, and even those living further south than normal, may see more frequent and widespread auroral displays. If you’re hoping to catch a glimpse, keep your cameras ready and your eyes on the sky!

Ova nova prilika za promatranje aurore dolazi nakon što su stručnjaci, uključujući SpaceWeather.com te prognoze NOAA-e i NASA-e, predvidjeli novu geomagnetsku oluju uzrokovanu koronalnim masovnim izbacivanjem sa Sunca. Iako nadolazeća oluja neće biti toliko jaka kao prošlosedmični događaj klase G3, ipak bi mogla izazvati oluju nivoa G2—dovoljno da zaljubljenici u nebo u državama od New Yorka do Washingtona možda ugledaju ovaj prizor. NOAA-in Centar za prognozu svemirskog vremena predviđa da će oluje G1 nivoa početi u subotu poslijepodne, uz jača G2 stanja tokom večeri i rane nedjelje. Za najbolju priliku da vidite ili fotografišete auroru, preporučuje se otići dalje od svjetlosnog zagađenja i koristiti manuelne kamere koje mogu snimati dugotrajnu ekspoziciju. Aurore nastaju kada nabijene čestice sa Sunca, pokrenute solarnim događajima kao što su koronalna izbacivanja mase, ulaze u Zemljinu atmosferu. Kada ove čestice stupe u interakciju sa Zemljinim magnetnim poljem, stvaraju svjetlosne pojave—obično zelene i crvene—oko polova planete. Tokom perioda visoke solarne aktivnosti, ta auroralna ovalna zona se širi i čini ovu pojavu vidljivom i dalje od polova. Sunce se trenutno približava vrhuncu svog jedanaestogodišnjeg solarnog ciklusa, a naučnici predviđaju da će solarni maksimum biti između januara i oktobra 2024. godine. Uz pojačanu aktivnost, ljubitelji neba na višim geografskim širinama, pa čak i oni južnije nego inače, mogli bi češće uživati u ovom neobičnom svjetlosnom spektaklu. Ako se nadate da ćete je vidjeti, pripremite kamere i držite pogled uprt ka nebu!

article_content: Recently, the Tiny Desk series at NPR hosted a standout performance by pianist Conrad Tao and tap dancer/choreographer Caleb Teicher. The event nearly faced cancellation when a multi-car accident delayed the delivery of the tap floor. Thankfully, no injuries occurred, and the floor was retrieved just in time thanks to a swift effort involving a rented U-Haul. Tao and Teicher then delivered an inventive blend of styles, performing both Bach's intricate classics and Gershwin's lively pieces. Teicher’s precise tap rhythms intertwined with Tao’s expressive piano, especially showcasing the dance-like qualities within Bach's works. The two also performed a jointly composed, slower piece, softening the mood as Teicher danced in quiet shoes and Tao played melodies with hints of Chopin. Their dynamic collaboration reached a crescendo during 'Rhapsody in Blue,' with Tao’s energetic piano matched by Teicher’s charismatic and inventive tap. As former prodigies, their mutual inspiration was evident, resulting in a performance that captivated and delighted the audience.
translated_content: Nedavno je serijal Tiny Desk na NPR-u ugostio izuzetnu izvedbu pijaniste Conrada Taoa i tap plesača/koreografa Caleba Teichera. Događaj je umalo otkazan jer je višestruka saobraćajna nesreća odgodila dostavu tap podija. Srećom, niko nije povrijeđen, a pod je na vrijeme spašen zahvaljujući brzoj intervenciji i unajmljenom U-Haulu. Tao i Teicher su zatim izveli inovativan spoj stilova, svirajući Bachove kompleksne klasike i živopisna Gershwinova djela. Teicherovi precizni tap ritmovi su se ispreplitali sa Taoovim izražajnim klavirom, posebno ističući plesne osobine Bachovih kompozicija. Također su zajedno izveli sporiju numeru koju su zajedno napisali, opuštajući atmosferu dok je Teicher tapkao u tihim cipelama, a Tao svirao melodije nalik Chopinu. Njihova dinamična saradnja kulminirala je tokom 'Rhapsody in Blue', gdje je Taoova energična svirka bila ravna Teicherovom karizmatičnom i inovativnom tap plesu. Kao bivši čudotvorci, njihova međusobna inspiracija bila je očita, donoseći nastup koji je u potpunosti očarao publiku.
